articleTitle: Laser beam welding of dissimilar metals of aluminum alloy and galvanized steel sheet
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Using CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> laser, Laser Lap Welding for dissimilar metals of 5A05 aluminum alloy (upper side) and ST04Z galvanized steel sheet (lower side) that both of 1mm thickness was experimented. Moreover, the microscopic structure, mechanical performance of weld joints were also analyzed and tested. The experimental results indicated that: typical melt-brazed lap joints were fused by melted 5A05 and un-melted ST04Z sheet. Fractures basically occurred in heat-affected zone (HAZ) of 5A05. Its density was 94MPa, acknowledged as gliding fracture.

articleTitle: Full-scale test study on DX piles and post grouting bored piles
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the fast developing of superstructures and skyscrapers, the demands for high bearing capacity of pile foundations have been raised. Based on the axial loading test results of DX piles and post grouting bored piles, this paper mainly studies the bearing capacities of DX piles with the comparison of the post grouting bored piles. Test result shows that the bells of DX piles located on different strata bear the loads in turn from the top to bottom. It not only can greatly improve the bearing capacity, but also effectively controls the settlement. Adopting the DX pile can greatly reduce the diameter and/or length of piles, while it can well satisfy the requirements of high bearing capacity, which can receive good economic and social benefits.

articleTitle: Designing and mechanical simulation analysis of grid-earth-rock emergency pavement slab
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: On the basis of the structure of grid-earth-rock, fiberglass reinforced epoxy resin, a kind of composite material, is adopted to prepare the emergency pavement slab for road rapid repair with the purpose of disaster relief. According to the structure, material parameter, application environment and actual conditions of emergency pavement slab, on the premise of the "partial safety" design principle, a finite element model which based on the theory of elastic mechanics is established with model assumptions. Stress states of emergency pavement slab in the three most unfavorable conditions are analyzed with the help of ABAQUS to verify the safety and reliability of the slab's structural strength. The results indicate that the maximum tensile stress, the maximum compressive stress and the maximum shearing stress, as well as the maximum vertical deformation withstood by the system of emergency pavement slab are in the strength range of material. The strength of emergency pavement slab meets the requirement of material and traffic load. The slab is applicable to engineering practices.

articleTitle: Correlation analysis of heavy metal content in the huai yam and the soil in huai yam planting areas of Wenxian
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to research the pollution and the correlation of the heavy mental in the huai yam and the Soil of wenxian, we collected 9 huai yam samples, 9 huai yam soil samples and 1 wheat soil sample in the areas, the content of Cu, Cr, Pb, Zn, Ni have been done. The results show that: in 9 huai yam samples,the contamitations of the 5 heavy mental elements are not beyond the standard limits,but the content of Cu, Zn is close to the standard limits; in 9 huai yam soil samples,the contamitations of the 5 heavy mental elements are not beyond the standard limits,the single pollution index maximum of Cu, Cr, Pb, Zn, Mare 0.361, 0.345, 0.597, 0.182, 0.939, the content of Zn is the max of the 5 heavy mental elements,it is 1.41 times of the content in the wheat soil sample, and close to the standard limits, the results of the correlation analysis show that the correlation coefficient of Cu, Zn is 0.916, 0.953,the correlation is obvious, but the correlation coefficient of Cr, Pb, Ni is 0.043, 0.298, 0.128, the correlation is not obvious.

articleTitle: The investigation on soft sensor technique of sinter mixture moisture
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Measurement about sinter mixture moisture is an important and indispensable part. In recent years, appeared in a variety of new moisture measuring devices, but each measurement method has to adapt to situations and limitations. In this paper, the analysis and research based on sintering technology and sintering process parameters, determine the sinter mixture moisture soft sensor auxiliary variable and soft sensor model modeling method. The results show that sinter mixture moisture soft sensor technique is effective, also the technique with high measuring accuracy.

articleTitle: Method of equivalent research of typical automotive parts
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: -The sample corrosion shape and appearance are compared between vehicle accelerated corrosion test and laboratory accelerated corrosion test. An equivalent relationship between laboratory accelerated corrosion and actual service condition is obtained on the basis of the research of distribution characteristics for two corrosion damage. The calculation indicates that this relationship of typical component: y = 32.86 e<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.5x</sup> (where, y is time of laboratory accelerated corrosion, x is time of actual service condition), thereby laying a foundation for anti-corrosion design and coating selection.

articleTitle: Diagnosis method for single fault of aerospace bearings
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Roundness, roughness and bad channel shape of bearing ring are important factors which influence the friction torque of sensitive bearings. In this paper, as for gyroscope framework sensitive bearings, the dynamic friction torque of bearing with four defects is analyzed, the four defects include outer ring in bad gully shape, inner circle in bad gully shape, inner ring in bad roundness and inner ring in bad roughness. Fourier transform, wavelet analysis and mathematical statistics are used. And some parameter indexes are also calculated .

articleTitle: Iterative learning control of nonlinear marine course system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The paper analyze the mathematical model of ship steering system and propose a control algorithm of ship steering system based on iterative learning control. In the article, we describe the principle of iterative learning control, analyze the dynamic equation of ship steering system, and demonstrate the convergence of corresponding updating law. The numerical simulations show that iterative learning control overcomes the difficult to establish accurate mathematical model of the ship steering system, and improves learning control convergence and convergence rate, the algorithm is efficient and worthy.

articleTitle: Study on designing driving coil with cooling chunnel of Electromagnetism Drive
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Electromagnetism Drive is launcher which utilizes magnetic traveling wave produced by impulse or alternating current to drive projectiles with coil or magnetic material, essentially is a linear electric motor. The heat wasting affect coil gun's efficiency and capability, high temperature of driving coil will reduce its life, indeed burnout coil, and when enhancing firing rate, we need calculate effect of temperature rising. The paper have designed and produced driving coil with cooling chunnel, have changed conventional flat copper line to hollow copper.

articleTitle: Construction risk management through insurance and bonding in China
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper is a review of the risk management process and risks commonly associated with construction projects, particularly the roles of insurance and bonding as tools of managing such risks and how to make better use of the insurers' resource in China.

articleTitle: Analysis of application characteristics of Chinese traditional architectural symbols
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Traditional architectural symbols are neither simply architectures, nor purely morphological symbols, but a kind of symbol which can be applied in the architecture to manifest specific regional culture with its own architectural functional characteristics. Under the principles of architectural semiotics, this paper will analyze the architectural symbols in order to explore the characteristics and application significance of traditional architectural symbols when they are applied in the modern architectural design, making a summary of its application.

articleTitle: The study of ship's Oil spill risk management
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Risk management is researched in this paper. It proposed a framework for preventing ship's Oil spill from happening. There are four parts in risk management framework. Risk identification, risk estimation, risk assessment and risk control are all important part in risk management. The role of risk management framework is to use the minimum cost but achieve maximize security.

articleTitle: The research on fuzzy PI self-setting control for Motor-type ELSD
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper discusses the working principle and basic structure of electronically controlled limited slip differential (ELSD). And then, it designs the fuzzy PI self-setting controller for Motor-type ELSD. The simulation and rig test showed that this controller can adjust the limited-slip performance of ELSD according to the driving condition of vehicle. It is beneficial to the application and promotion of ELSD.

articleTitle: Studies on Loosened zone of surrounding rock underground powerhouse cavities for Jinping I Hydropower Station in construction
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces the test results of loosened zone of surrounding rock underground powerhouse cavities for Jinping I Hydropower Station in construction and the results are analyzed and studied. Loosened zone of surrounding rock scale and distribution are influenced by geological conditions and excavation, Loosened zone of surrounding rock in upstream and downstream sidewall obvious asymmetry. Downstream side upper and upstream side mid-lower of main powerhouse is bigger; upstream side-wall bottom and downstream side-wall mid-upper of main transformer chamber is large. Loosened zone of surrounding rock and wave velocity change has obvious time- related feature, loosened zone development and rock wave decrease is faster excavation early; after excavation, it is stopped gradually, but, finish this process needs six months. Wave velocity decrease degree of surrounding rock rapid decline reduced with depth increase, superficial wave velocity of surrounding rock attenuation is obvious. Loosened zone of surrounding rock and wave velocity change are influenced by extra geostress, low rock mass strength, lithology, structure surface, geological conditions and construction excavation unloading.

articleTitle: The analysis of the bearing capacity of scaffold used in the collar beam construction of Bao-Xi railway CFST arch bridge
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In the construction of concrete filled steel tubular arch bridge, the bearing performance of scaffold is the key to the project. Based on the actual situation of the bridge across the HuangYan highway on the Bao-Xi railway corridor, the full support openings construction method is adopted and firstly set up the beam then the part of arch. The design method of construction scaffold and doorways beam is described and through the large finite element software ANSYS its deformation and stress were analyzed and checked. The results show that the stents and strander beams are meet the requirements. And the construction methods do not affect traffic, carrying capacity is strong, good stability, suitable for girder and arch construction crossing big barriers and traffic is heavy.

articleTitle: Method and model of B-Ga-Al diffusion processes for fabrication of silicon on insulator wafer with buried P-type layer
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to explore the fabrication method of the BPL SOI wafer, we tried to combine thermal diffusion of B-Ga-Al into Si process with SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>-SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> bonding and etch back process. Therefore, in this paper, the diffusion law of B-Ga-Al into Si was mainly studied and its complementary error function-Gauss united distribution model of Ga concentration and numerical integration mode based on Gauss distribution of differential elements of Al concentration were established. Then the results of the above models simulated with numerical integration method were compared with the results simulated with Silvaco TCAD—a world famous software for simulation of semiconductor technologies and devices, which indicates that both fit well each other. Therefore the models established characterize the diffusion law of B-Ga-Al in Si very well and are very applied to guideline the design, simulation and fabrication of lateral super-high voltage RF/power semiconductor devices with BPL SOI wafer both in theory and in practical.

articleTitle: The technical research of heat insulation and controlling of the temperature with the biogas digesters in the severe cold regions in winter
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In the reason of the low air temperature and the low ground temperature in the severe cold region in winter, the rates of producing and using biogas are low. It presents a new thought about producing biogas with the joint operation of the solar heating and gas fired boiler by heat, and Stay in control of the temperature in the pond, so it can regular service in the extremely cold regions in winter.

articleTitle: Study of quantity characteristics of double valves fuel injection system with electronically controlled
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Double valves system simulation model is established in AMESim environment, By comparing with experiment, The simulation model can accurately predict injection characteristics of the double valves system. The influence of the parameters such as piston diameter, cam velocity, piston matching clearance, SV valve lift, NCV valve lift, needle valve lift and injector diameter on the main fuel injection quantity fluctuation is analyzed in details with the simulation model in the whole working conditions The change rule of the main injection quantity fluctuation with speed and injection pulse is obtained under different parameters, The results show that piston diameter, cam velocity and injector diameter are the key characteristic parameters on the main fuel injection quantity fluctuation.

articleTitle: The study on the emissions of a direct injection diesel engine fuelled with methanol/biodiesel blends
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Engine experiments were conducted on an 186FA diesel engine fueled with biodiesel and methanol/biodiesel blends, the formation of diesel engine pollutants was analyzed from the perspective of the methanol biodiesel blended fuel properties and chemical kinetics. Experimental results indicate that, compared with pure biodiesel, Pe=1.57 kW, biodiesel blended with 5% could lend to an increase of 279.1% in CO emission and an increase of 96.3% in HC emission. Increasing the proportion of methanol in the blends, NOx emission decreased. The NOx emissions reduction 42.7% using BM15 at full load rated speed. The exhaust smoke was almost the same at low load and not more than 0.1 BSU. At high load, the exhaust smoke decreased 51.2% using BM15. Mixed fuel spray characteristics and fuel properties of the dual role of lead Zeldovich mechanism slowed down the whole chain reaction. In the process of burning, more OH free radical is generated and reacts with the soot precursor acetylene (C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>), which suppresses the formation of soot, and leads to a decrease in smoke emissions.

articleTitle: Smart grid interoperability model
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper analyses several trends in smart grid system for the use of technology, performance and configuration. Smart grid conceptual reference model is researched. The characteristics of this model satisfy security, reliability, privacy, and national policy. This model includes interoperability model, information interoperability, and information network model.

articleTitle: The research and application of a portable and intelligent blast furnace cooling water temperature difference measurement instrument
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces the research and application process of a intelligent measuring instrument used to measure the water temperature difference in blast furnace cooling system. The operation principle, the main design breakthrough point, instrument calibration and the experiment application problems are mainly described. The results show that the Instrument is particularly suitable for open-circuit cooling system of blast furnace and the occasions of continuous multi-point temperature measurement. It can effectively improve the efficiency and the accuracy of temperature difference measurement of cooling water in blast furnace.

articleTitle: Computation of the simplest normal form for the singularity of two non-semisimple double zero eigenvalues
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper a method is presented for computing the simplest normal form for a vector field associated with the singularity of two non-semisimple double zero eigenvalues. The method developed here uses the lower order nonlinear terms in the normal form for the simplifications of higher order terms. An explicit formulae are derived, which can be used to compute the coefficients of the simplest normal form and the associated nonlinear transformation. The theoretical model for the nonlinear oscillation of a simply supported rectangular thin plate is given to demonstrate the computational efficiency of the method.

articleTitle: The simulation analysis of LPG engine combustion process by fire
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the AVL fire software, this article conduct three-dimensional analog computation on combustion process of LPG engine which converted by single cylinder gasoline engine. According to the reckoning calculations, it analyzed homogeneous mixture lean burn conditions, the generation process of emissions and affecting factors of LPG engine. The analysis of analog computation results provided reference for the perfection of the combustion process of LPG engine.

articleTitle: Research and design of ramcompressed rotor for rotary ramjet engine
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper the principle of shock wave compression is applied to high speed rotor. The structure of the rotor is designed base on analysis of shock wave effect to rampressor and researches the effects of Mach number, shock wave angle to static pressure, static temperature and so on. Computational fluid dynamics simulation analysis is did to obtaine flow distribution under different Mach number.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Optimization of hydrogen cooled turbo-generator rotor wedge cooling method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Preparation and characterization of hollow micro-spheres alumina carrier with honeycomb structure
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Honeycomb structured Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> have been prepared take advantage of the CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> generated by calcination, which escaped quickly and broke the shell wall of hollow spheres to form the honeycomb structure. The impact of preparation conditions of colloidal glucose carbon spheres on the properties of alumina carrier was studied. The samples were characterized by X-ray diffraction (XRD), scanning electron microscope (SEM). The alumina crystal formation changed from amorphous structure into γ-Al<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> as the calcination temperature increased. The integrity of structure can be controlled to be best when the calcination temperature is 500°C. When the concentration is 0.4 mol/L, the alumina has the largest specific surface, pore volume, and the pore diameter under the experimental conditions. The concentration has an optimum concentration range around 0.4 mol/L.

articleTitle: Numerical study of the effect of air outlet opening on natural ventilation in a workshop
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The natural ventilation in an industrial workshop with heat sources was numerically simulated by computational fluid dynamics (CFD) method. The numerical calculation was carried out to simulate the flow and temperature feld in the workshop by realizable k-ε turbulent model combined with a Discrete Ordinate (DO) radiation model which took into account the radiation between the heat source and the wall. The effect of different height of air outlet opening on ventilation was analyzed. Results showed that the ventilation rate increased a little as the height of air outlet opening increased. When the height of air outlet opening was higher than the height of air inlet opening, the ventilation rate did not increase further. The average air temperature at operation zone decreased, but slightly as the air outlet height increased, while the difference between air inlet and outlet temperature almost kept constant. The heat distribution factor decreased as the height of air outlet opening increased. Therefore, a reasonable higher height of air outlet opening was helpful to improve the natural ventilation performance, but its effect was very small.

articleTitle: Finite element analysis on behavior of β=0.8 RHS trusses with concrete-filled in Partial chords
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Finite element analysis on three trusses were carried in order to study the effect for behavior of rectangular hollow section (RHS) truss with the concrete filled in partial chord. The first specimen was a RHS truss, the second one was a RHS truss with concrete-filled in the compressive chord, and the third one was a concrete-filled steel tube truss. The results show that the failure of three trusses were due to the joint failure, however the failure modes were different and changed by the concrete filled in chord. The bearing capacity of three trusses were controlled by the jionts and the strength and stiffness of jionts were increased by the concrete filled in the chord, therefore the bearing capacity of trusses were increased while the deformation of trusses were decreased. The RHS truss with concrete-filled in partial chord have some distinct advantages in engineering application, because the steel tube joint can meet the requirements of the plastic deformation and the concrete filled in chord can improve the bearing capacity of truss.

articleTitle: Three-dimensional stability analyses of isotropic earth slope based on strength reduction FEM
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The slope stability analysis with the shear strength reduction FEM can make the Rock and soil slopes achieve the limit failure state, and direct sliding surface location and slope stability safety factor can be obtained. From 3D perspective, through a variety examples of different loading conditions are calculated, the safety factor and the destruction mechanism of slope under the action of gravity and uniform rigid overload are researched and the results of two-dimensional limit equilibrium, 2D and 3D strength reduction FEM of calculation are compared. The results showed that Strength reduction FEM can be accurate and effective application of three-dimensional slope stability analysis. The results showed that: Strength reduction FEM can be accurate and effective application of three-dimensional slope stability analysis; Three-dimensional safety factor than plane strain conditions is to be larger, but little difference; With the load from the edge slope crest farther, the safety factor is greater. In addition, the location and size of slide of every cross sections of 3D slope is not same. Therefore, using simplified plane strain is too conservative, some important projects should complement the slope 3D finite element analysis.

articleTitle: Characterization of nickel-bismuth doped tin dioxide electrode
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The characterization of nickel and bismuth doped tin dioxide electrode was studied through the means of SEM, XRD techniques and electrochemistry testing system. The results indicated that, comparing with highly effective nickel and antimony doped tin dioxide electrode, nickel and bismuth doped tin dioxide electrode showed the ability of generating ozone to some extent, though whose efficiency was not as high as that of nickel and antimony doped tin dioxide electrode. Meanwhile, the reasons for decreasing of electrode's ability caused by element replacement were also discussed.

articleTitle: Study on electromagnetic detection transmitter system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The limited transmitting frequency and the adaptability of geological conditions are the main problems which the geological electromagnetic detection faced in our country. To obtain more parameters at the same power supply and improve the detection of depth and efficiency, the power supply technology of multi-frequency and a constant amplitude is developed and applied, meanwhile, this paper introduces the basic principles of transmission systems and the design of waveform synthesis unit, main circuit, isolated driver unit, the buffer unit and the control systems, ultimately the experiments prove the transmitter we designed has the excellent characteristic which has super wideband and wide range of load regulating. The design of transmitting is reasonable, the system designed has the stable and reliable performances. The whole design and experiments play a promoting role in the development of electromagnetic detection technology.

articleTitle: Impermeability quality evaluation of rock mass
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The impermeability of rock mass is one of important indexes to evaluate the rock foundation of hydraulic structure and underground-water caverns, which have direct relation to rock quality and necessity to take impermeable measure. The paper build the indexes system of evaluating rock impermeability that taking the dam rock mass of Gauanyinyan Hydropower Station as an example, extension assessment method is used to appraised rock impermeability. The results coincided with the evaluation results according conditions, which indicated that this system is feasible to evaluate the impermeability quality of rock.

articleTitle: Dielectric barrier discharges plasma inactivation of Microcystis aeruginosa: Effects and mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this study, effects and mechanisms of inactivation of Microcystis aeruginosa(MA) were studied. The absorption spectrum and the electrolyte permeability of MA were measured. Before and after plasma treatment, the cell morphology was observed via the scanning electron microscopy (SEM).The role and contribution of active species in DBD plasma was studied. The results showed that the height of the absorption peak decreased and the plasma activity cracks the cell, resulting in cellular content leakage after treatment; The free radicals played a major role, followed by hydrogen peroxide, ozone and ultraviolet was faint in the inactivation of MA in DBD plasma.

articleTitle: Studies on the limiting resistant torque characteristics of the Skewed-Roller Slipping Clutch
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As a novel power transmission component, the Skewed -Roller Slipping Clutch (SRSC) combines both clutch and bearing functions. In this paper, with the considerations of frictional contact and dynamic equilibrium of the rollers, the effects of roller profiled parameters on the von Mises stress are discussed and the optimal modification parameters are calculated under the different axial loads. In addition, the limiting resistant torque characteristics of the SRSC with optimal profiled rollers are discussed in detail.

articleTitle: Dynamic design and analysis of the new space CCD camera
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As an important load of a light satellite, the space CCD camera will endure very complicated dynamics environment when transporting and launching. In this paper, The FEM model of the CCD camera is created by MSC. Patran/Nastran, then the model analysis, sinusoidal vibration and random vibration of the structure is performed. Based on the results, it proves that the CCD camera is satisfied in the ordinary condition, and this can be a reference for the similar design work.

articleTitle: FVM-based method to prediction of velocity of landslide
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Landslide motion is a dynamic process with rather complex mode. The calculation of sliding velocity is the basis of surge prediction. This study presented the results of three-dimensional dynamic simulation to the selected landslide using a finite volume method (FVM). The three-dimensional geological mode was set up based on the digital elevation model (DEM) and the information of slip surface from drills and field outcrops. The modeling properties were obtained from the results of experiments. The sliding process of sliding body is simulated and the sliding velocity of micro units of landslide is calculated by using FVM. The results showed that the sliding velocity firstly increase along the direction of movement of the landslide, then gradually decrease, which consist with the law of motion of landslide. The sliding velocity from FVM almost coincides with that of other two methods, i.e. Pan method and energy method. Therefore, FVM method can be used to calculate the velocity of landslide and it is not dependent on the calculated profile and the terrain of slip surface. It reproduces the whole process of failure, development and sliding dynamically.

articleTitle: Contrastive analysis and test study of compaction standards used in China and Germany
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper introduced the quality control and quality assurance tests used during high-speed railway subgrade construction by China and Germany. Through laboratory Proctor compaction tests and in-situ tests using two kinds of filling materials, the correlations between compaction grade used in China and Proctor density used in Germany are obtained. The relations among the porosity, compaction grade and Proctor density are analyzed, and reasonable controlling indexes for porosity used in the high-speed railway for middling grained and coarse grained soil are put forward. The different stiffness coefficients for the subgrade are studied by field tests through the plate load tests, and the relation between them is obtained. Finally some suggestions on compaction quality inspection of subgrade and embankment are proposed.

articleTitle: Development of access controller based on dual-CPU design
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to improve reliability and speediness of access control system, in hardware design, the shortcomings of access controller with a CPU is analyzed in this paper. The core module of the hardware system is designed based on two microcontrollers. In software design, main program and subprogram are programmed according to coordinate and independent mode. The card reader controlling, door magnetism and illegal entrance alarm, door monitoring and controlling, useful data communicating, and other functions are achieved by the modular design of access control system. Experiment results in real field show that dual-CPU design proposed in this paper improves greatly the reliability and work efficiency of the access controller.

articleTitle: Analysis to heat loss of steam pipeline network in economic development zone
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Energy conservation and rational usage of energy is China's basic national policy. The present steam consumption and heat loss of its pipeline network in Tianjin airport economic development zone is recorded, then zonal steam distribution efficiency is calculated to be 37.56 % by the steam consumption data, and zonal heat loss is in inverse proportion to steam distribution efficiency with factor of 8.312 × 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> kW, that is, in direct proportion to steam produce, steam enthalpy difference, inverse proportion to steam consumption with factor of 83.12 kW by the steam distribution efficiency, offering reasons to optimize steam pipeline network operation, and cover steam requirement with minimal energy consumption.

articleTitle: Anti-synchronization of Liu system and Rössler system with unknown parameters based on adaptive control
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper treats chaos anti-synchronization between Liu system and Rossler system with unknown parameters via adaptive control. Based on Lyapunov stability theory, the adaptive control law and the parameter update rule for unknown parameters are derived to ensure the anti-synchronization of the two non-identical chaotic systems. Numerical simulations are also shown to verify the results.

articleTitle: A dynamic burst detection model over data streams
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Burst detection techniques over data streams has been attracting board and home scholars' more attention due to it's broad applications in financial, medical service, telecommunication and other critical important areas. In order to detect bursts of positive data streams, negative data streams, first, we propose a dynamic burst detection model over data stream. Based on the model, we embed a two-dimensional array into SAT(shifted aggregation tree), and construct a elastic data structure ASAT given the input. At last, we propose a elastic burst detection algorithm over data streams. The algorithm not only can detect bursts of monotonous accumulation function and non-monotonous accumulation function, but also can search burst on large scale of negative, constant data streams. Experiments show that this algorithm is both efficient and effective.

articleTitle: Research of section torsion beam based on multi-body dynamics
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The three models of torsion beam and vehicle are constructed respectively based on three modeling solutions using one Geely car in order to accurately construct suspension model of torsion beam. And then different simulation analysis is performed, e.g. parallel wheel travel, opposite wheel travel, lateral force, pulse road test, steady-state circle. Moreover, simulation result and test value are compared. The comparison indicates that the simulation result of four section torsion beam model is similar to experimental value. It is accordingly presented that it is reasonable to construct a model by four section torsion beams when performing a simulation analysis on torsion beam suspension.

articleTitle: A low-complexity IRA-LDPC coded noncoherent unitary space-time modulation system on Rayleigh flat fading channel
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This letter constructs a practical low- complexity coded modulation MIMO system which concatenates the IRA-LDPC codes based on the permutation Q-matrix with the noncoherent unitary space-time modulation (USTM) based on sine-cosine function for Rayleigh flat fading channel. In the receiver, we adopt dual detecting scheme: first relative coarse low complexity ML detect and then relative precise MAP detect with shrinking search range of constellation points. Combining the dual detecting scheme with the Belief-Propagation (BP) iterative decoding algorithm comes into being an iterative feedback demodulate-decoding system. The IRA-LDPC coded modulation system can obtain about 15 dB coding gain at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> BER over the uncoded USTM system. Some results are based on simulation testing.

Author Keywords: iterative feedback demodulate-decoding low-density parity-check (LDPC) codes

articleTitle: Study on combustion process estimation using frequency information of diesel engine vibration acceleration signal
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A novel frequency analysis method is proposed based on S-transform time-frequency domain analysis. Contrast between the new method and discrete fourier transform shows that the new method has better frequency resolution. Vibration acceleration measured when 195 single cylinder engine is running in different load, speed and injection advanced angle are analyzed using the new frequency analysis method. Contrast between frequency energy of vibration acceleration and maximum pressure increase rate is carried out and results show that there is close relationship between them. According to the analysis, a new method using frequency energy of vibration acceleration as characteristic parameter for combustion status is proposed. Verification is carried out in a four cylinder diesel engine and results show the characteristic parameter is feasible.

articleTitle: Slenderness limit for hybrid FRP-concrete-steel double-skin tubular columns
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes hybrid FRP-concrete-steel double-skin tubular columns of different lengths based on numerical method. Parametric study is carried out on the parameters including eccentricity ratio, normalized eccentricity, void ratio, diameter-to-thickness ratio, yield strength of steel tube, confinement stiffness ratio and strain ratio, and a simplified formula which can be used in practical design to calculate the slenderness ratio limit is presented. This formula provides precise and conservative results compared with the results of analysis software.

articleTitle: Dynamic simulation of rocket launch system based on virtual prototype technology
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The virtual prototype of multiply rocket launch system are built with dynamic simulation software-ADAMS. Constraining relations among rigid bodies are simulated. Exterior force caused by multiply rocket launch system firing is analyzed. Dynamic simulation is carried out when rocket firing. Curves of initial displacement of direction pipe and curves of initial velocity and acceleration of rocket projectile changing as time are obtained. It can provide a theory foundation for evaluating dynamic characteristics of rocket launch system such as initial interference and improving its performance.

articleTitle: Thread probe measuring angle calculation of flexible calibration
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Large tubular serrated thread detection method uses a new type of threaded probe, the Cone anvil of the probe is selected by the thread teeth type . The angle between the axis of thread and cone is 60°, the calibration device in this paper is designed to flexible to the angle of calibration, and the measuring range of flexible calibration for anvil is theoretical analyzed and calculated.

articleTitle: The analysis of attenuation of trapezoid ridge waveguide by finite difference time domain
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The article analyses the attenuation characteristics and power capacities of trapezoid double ridge waveguide in TE mode by using FDTD firstly to abate microwave deterioration when transmitting in ridge waveguide. Meanwhile, the article offers the attenuation constant and power capacity data and spectrum graph in some degree of trapezoid ridge waveguide in different structural parameter. The result demonstrates the standard attenuation constant data of trapezoid double ridge waveguide decrease progressively when frequency enlarging, while normalization attenuation constant monotonous increase progressively when normalization cut-off wavelength enlarging. The power capacity monotonous decrease progressively when normalization cut-off wavelength enlarging and increasing when ridge separation distance or ridge breadth enlarging. The study conclusion offers certain valuable data references to the design of ridge waveguide.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on natural design seismic wave in Yinchuan
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Grain pricing in the Huanghuaihai Plain based on green accounting
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the theory of ecology and economics, resources depletion and environmental degradation due to grain production were comprehensively accounted and the full cost of grain production was analyzed. The cost of grain production in Quzhou County, Hebei Province, an alluvial area in the Huanghuaihai Plain, was investigated using the methods of market price, replacement price, shadow engineering, opportunity cost, and so on to estimate the cost of grain production. A green accounting model for the cost of grain production was constructed and theoretical price of grain was discussed deeply. Results showed that the theoretical price of grain in the region was 1.90 Yuan·kg<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> for wheat and 1.45 Yuan·kg<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> for corn in 2008, in which the resource-environmental prices for the crops were 0.50 Yuan·kg<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> and 0.43 Yuan·kg<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>, respectively. However, the actual price was 1.62 Yuan·kg<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> for wheat and 1.38 Yuan·kg<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> for corn. The current actual price of grain in the region can not reflect the resource-environmental cost of grain production. A reasonable grain price mechanism of compensation for the use of resources and environment must be built to promote the development of regional economic life and the harmony between man and nature.

articleTitle: Inverse identification research for dynamic constitutive parameters of thread material based on MSARS algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to solve the inverse identification problem of material dynamic constitutive parameters while cutting the thread, and obtain the parameters which can describe the material dynamic mechanical properties correctly. The MSARS algorithm was adopted in this paper, and by the use of this algorithm, a Johnson-Cook model parameters inverse identification research which used known thread material constitutive model as validation test model was completed. The result showed that the algorithm was able to obtain relatively correct parameters in less iteration, thus proposed a reliable method to obtain the material parameters during the process of finite element simulation, and guarantee the credibility of numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Preliminary analysis of the effectiveness of desalting leaching using spring irrigation for use of brackish water for under-film drip irrigation of cotton
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In the plain irrigation districts in the Tarim Basin, Xinjiang where water resources are scarce, irrigation using brackish water is of great significance. The biggest problem with brackish water irrigation is salt accumulation in soil. The focus of concern of people is that, after 1-year application of brackish water irrigation, whether it is necessary to leach salt using winter irrigation or spring irrigation before sowing of the next year. This paper comprised data of easily dissolvable salt of 0~60cm in soil which monitored from monitoring area S1 before and after spring irrigation in 2010 in Tarim Township of Yuli County, Xinjiang and salt tolerance indexes during germination, seedling and budding, flowering and boll generating, and boll opening periods of cotton (which are 7.1 g/kg,6.9g/kg,8.2g/kg and 9.2g/kg). The result shows that: in monitoring area S1, we can desalt leaching using spring irrigation once every other year to maintain the germination and growth requirements. The soil desalting ratio of monitoring area S1 before and after spring irrigation is 11.9%~84.2%. Then we can conclude that the effectiveness of desalting leaching using spring irrigation in monitoring areas S1 were significant.

Author Keywords: plain irrigation districts in the Tarim Basin

articleTitle: Analysis of the capability of casing tripping in horizontal well
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The emergence of horizontal wells brought new vigor to the oil and gas exploration. However, the casing is bended with the hole at the curved portion in horizontal wells, which makes running casing more difficult, because the resistance is larger in horizontal wells than that in vertical ones. Whether the casing strings can run in the bending of horizontal wells relates to the completion style, which can be judged according to casing force analysis. Through the force analysis of casing string units in two and three dimensions wellbores, we get the generic algorithm to calculate the axial loading of directional wells. The algorithm is applicable to calculate the axial loading of all types of casing strings. The accurate analysis of frictional resistance can provide a reliable basis for the drilling equipment selection, optimizing the parameters of casing strings, and choosing the way to trip in.

articleTitle: Flotation separation of Cu-Fe sulfide at low basicity for A Cu-Ag multi-metal ores
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to solve some issues of Cu-Fe sulfide flotation separation at high basicity, the experiment on flotation separation of Cu-Fe sulfide at low basicity for a Cu-Ag multi-metal ores in Jiangxi province used the DT series depressor of Jiangxi University of Science and Technology. The results showed that flotation separation of Cu-Fe sulfide with the depressor DT-2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">#</sup> at low basicity of pH=8, the grades and recoveries of copper and sulfur concentrates were 22.49%, 33.07% and 88.76%, 62.25% respectively. Meanwhile, the silver grade and recovery are 1391.6 g/t and 71.59% in the copper concentrate.

articleTitle: Research on the impact Of intermittent aeration ways on short-cut nitrification
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The short-cut nitrification was conducted in three SBBR reactors of different intermittent aeration ways. Experiments were carried out to observe the impact of aeration change frequency, the addition of an anoxia phrase and anoxia time, under the condition of COD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Cr</sub> among 100 ~ 200mg/L, concentration of NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N around 120 mg/L, temperature of (23 + 1)°C, pH of 6.7-7.0, initial MLSS around 3,500mg/L. It can be concluded from the results that short-cut nitrification was conducted well in the model of low aeration change frequency and a anoxia phrase of 30~40s, and the NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N removal rate was above 53% and nitrosoation rate was above 84% within a reaction cycle of 4 hours.

articleTitle: The existence of the solution for the nonlinear coupled oscillator networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we discuss the existence of solutions for networks of nonlinear parametrically forced oscillators. We deals with one type of nonlinear coupled system from the studying of the honeycomb sandwich plate. Based on the Implicit Function Theorem, the periodic orbit of the coupled system are derived by the hyperbolicity condition. The method of Poincare map is utilized to obtain solutions from the uncoupled case persist for small coupling. These results show that under certain conditions the stability of the solutions for the nonlinear coupled dynamical system are found.

articleTitle: Production of iminodiacetic acid by electrodeionization with bipolar membrane
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In view of some inherent disadvantage of traditional technique, a special electrodeionization(BMEDI) process coupled with bipolar membrane was developed to produce iminodiacetic acid (IDA) from iminodiacetic acid disodium salt (IDANa<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>). The BMEDI stack comprises three compartments which are separated with two bipolar membranes, one cation exchange membrane and one anion exchange membrane. The influences of operation time, current density and IDANa<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> concentration on the operating performances were investigated. The results show that with current density of 10 mA·cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup> and IDANa<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> concentration of 0.1 mol·L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>, the recovery rate of IDA could reach 86.7%. It was indicated that the recovery rate of IDA and energy consumption increased as current density increased, and current efficiency increased as IDANa<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> concentration increased.

articleTitle: Analysis on air-solid two-phase flow in the sieving-setup of a new -model hammer mill based on FVM
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The simulation on air-solid two phase flow mechanism in sieving set-up of a new-model hammer mill was performed using software FLUENT, and the relation ship of the material-sieving efficiency and the factors were analyzed in this paper, It is provided a theoretical basis for the further optimization design.

articleTitle: Research of notch fatigue crack initiation cycles for 10 steel
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: There were some the axial surface defects with extremely small openings and the shape like crack on the oxygen pipeline in a company, and they all were difficult to be eliminated. In order to determine whether these defects could be safe, the fatigue test was carried out on 10 steel with real and artificial surface defects. According to the test result, the method by which a notch fatigue crack initiation cycles was estimated, was proposed and the safety analysis of 10 steel was done. The results show that the 10 steel could be safe in the existing conditions. The steel has been used for more than 10 years, so it proves that the evaluation result is correct and safe.

articleTitle: High-rise steel structure's performance-based fire protection design based on degree of probabilistic reliability
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The fire-resistant calculation and design of high-rise steel structure is an important aspect of performance-based fire protection design. This article which focuses on the development of fire-safety design, discusses some methods on fire-resistant design in the demand of different norms. It explained that the key point of performance-based fire protection design is the proper analysis of the risk of a fire danger to a tall building. The target of the design based on the degree of probabilistic reliability.

articleTitle: Guidelines for synergetic utilization of Chinese agricultural land based on the emergy balance law
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the emergy balance law as theoretical support, the basic principle to guide synergetic utilization of agricultural land with the emergy balance law is expounded by defining the basic connotations of that theory, and emergy indexes of Chinese agricultural land system are established; the synergetic degrees of China's agricultural land system in the past 10 years are judged so as to form a new idea on the synergetic utilization of Chinese agricultural land. The results show that: the synergetic degree of China's agricultural land system is decreased year by year, which is mainly shown in the fact that a high output is based on a high input despite a basically balanced status of emergy input and output of China's agricultural land system. Moreover, the pressure of adverse environmental impact of excessive fossil energy on the agricultural land ecological system keeps rising. Therefore, only by adjusting the structure of China's agricultural land based on the emergy balance law can the dual functions of land as a resource product and for ecological services be maintained and can existence of the synergy of the ecological system of China's agricultural land be guaranteed.

articleTitle: Detection, appraisement and strengthening of a plant building after fire
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A plant building with storage of flammable materials was partly RC frame, and partly steel frame. After fire, most part of the steel frame collapsed, and the RC frame was badly damaged. Firstly, the depths of carbonation of concrete and concrete strength were detected, and then fire safety status of the plant structure was appraised. Finally, based on appraisement results, the plant structure was strengthened.

articleTitle: Database design and implementation based on GIS in slope engineering
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The data information to be involved in the slope unstability evaluation is huge, and the data structure type is complex. The traditional method to manage the saved data is backward. Because the slope management of the spatial geological information lacks systematization, the prediction results will be poorer in certainty and accuracy. Therefore, the management quality is affected. This paper designed the mining slope libraries and established the slope basal information database based on GIS technology, so that we can effectively manage the digital slope information. This study provided a basis for the design and treatment of the slope stability.

articleTitle: Research on defining equipment support unit based on fuzzy clustering analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Incorporate & integrated support (IIS) requires integrated employment of support forces, based on support unit. The precondition is specialty combination of support personnel. Formerly every service supported itself separately and support specialties were excessive. The condition greatly restricted realization of IIS. Aiming at the problem, this paper uses fuzzy clustering analysis to reform support specialties. The research can establish the foundation of integrated employment of support forces and IIS.

articleTitle: Modeling and fault analysis of EMB motor
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the simulink model of the Brushless DC Motor (BLDCM), which's the actuator of the Electro-Mechanical Braking (EMB) system, was established. And then, typical faults of the BLDCM were analyzed. These faults included the faults of the motor, the power transistor, and the Hall sensor. In addition, the detailed theoretical analysis of these faults simulation results and their effect on braking ability are given.

articleTitle: Impact of global climatic change on runoff in the upper reaches of the Yellow River
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Drought and flood is a kind of the highest frequency and the most severe natural disaster in the world at present. The excessive and little amount of runoff will cause flood and drought. This paper studies the impact of solar activity and ocean-atmospheric interactivity on runoff change in the upper reaches of the Yellow River, using the measured runoff data from the Guide hydrological station. The relationship of between sunspot relative numbers and runoff change was analyzed with the grey correlation and cross spectrum method. Results show that there is a positive correlation between them; the impact of El Nino and La Nina phenomenon on high-low runoff change was analyzed statistically. These conclusions provide scientific ground for analyzing the physical cause of drought and flood disaster.

articleTitle: Degradation of PCB52 in Aqueous Solution by ultrasound/Fenton process
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The degradation of PCB52 in aqueous solution by ultrasound/Fenton process was investigated. And the effects of ultrasonic power, ultrasonic frequency, initial pH values of the solution and dosage of hydrogen peroxide and ferrous ions on the degradation efficiency were studied. The results indicated that the degradation efficiency increased with the decrease of pH value, and the ultrasonic frequency, ultrasonic power, and dosage of hydrogen peroxide and ferrous ions existed optimal values. At the temperature of (25+2)°C, the optimum conditions of the degradation of PCB52 by ultrasound/Fenton process included ultrasonic power of 700w, ultrasonic frequency of 28 kHz, initial pH values of 4.0 and the dosage of hydrogen peroxide and ferrous ions of 86mmol/L and lmmol/L, respectively. In the optimal conditions, the degradation of PCB52 was in conformity with pseudo-first order kinetics. Ultrasound/Fenton process achieved better degradation of PCB52 than ultrasound or Fenton reagent alone, which decomposed 92.8% of 70 μ g/L PCB52 within 60 minute in optimum conditions.

articleTitle: Dynamic analysis of the oscillation system for continues casting mold
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By using the theory of the static dynamic analysis method, the kinematics and dynamic characteristic of the half-leaf spring oscillator is investigated. Based on building the model of the static dynamic analysis, parameters are solved by using MATLAB and reviewed by Adams. The acceleration of shaker of the half-leaf spring oscillator is less than other bar. And the movement of mould is more stable, the possible fracture of oscillating-arm is found.

articleTitle: Study on key technology of mechanical system design and manufacture technology of three-axis turntable
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to design requirements, a dividing structure was applied in the mechanical design of three-axis turntable, which includes designed as inner frame, middle frame and outer frame. Angular contact ball bearings with P4 level were used in order to meet space requirement. In selecting motor, the factor of motor torque increase resulted from the three-axis coupling effect was considered and maximum toque of motor met the requirement of maximum load under maximum speed. ZL114A is selected as the material of inner frame, middle frame and outer frame, and QT700-2 as the material of shaft of frames. In manufacturing process, the heat treating of multiple artificial aging, multiple feeding with small amount of feed and intermittent machining methods are used in the machining of the A-alloy frames. In assembling, eccentric amount of bearings were kept in the same direction and bearings were preloaded according to empirical formula. According to optical autocollimation theory, light tube, 24-face prism, planar mirror and pentaprism were used to check angular error among three axes of rotation and the corresponding orthogonality errors. The test results met the design requirements.

articleTitle: The synthesis and characterization of glycine-lead
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Glycine-lead was synthesized with glycine and lead hydroxide as raw materials.The optimum technological conditions were that molar ratio of glycine to lead hydroxide was 2:1, reaction time was 6h ,reaction temperature was70~80°C and pH value was 6. The yield was 60.53%. Composition and structure of the complex were characterized by mass spectrometry and HyperChem software. Its composition was Pb(NHCH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>COOH)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>.

articleTitle: Study and application of reinforcement of soft foundation with grouting anchor pipe nail
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to reinforce the soft foundation of bridge pier while the overweight vehicles' crossing, according to the balance calculation of ultimate bearing capacity about the round shallow foundation, the static pressure grouting with anchor nail was used to reinforce the soft base in the Yaquepu-Jiangjiaji overpass bridge in Jingmen, HuBei province and good results were achieved. It shows that the static pressure grouting with anchor nail to reinforce the soft foundation precedes the other methods. The practical results show a practical guidance and application significance for the soft foundation reinforce engineering.

articleTitle: Millimeter wave near-field wideband array holographic imaging system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, based on analysis principles of millimeter-wave near-field wideband array holographic imaging techniques, millimeter-wave near-field holographic imaging system is recommended. Its principle is that a millimeter-wave radiation launches the millimeter-wave signals, then the echo reflected from the target to interface with the original signal, the millimeter-wave holograph has been got. Finally, the millimeter-wave holograph treatment with algorithms such as Flourier Transform, compensation and image restoration, it obtains the millimeter-wave image of target. Millimeter-wave near-field holographic image has high speed, high resolution and strong three-dimension sense, which has broad application prospects in concealed weapons detection.

articleTitle: Distribution and relationships of phosphorus fractions in sediments of middle-lower reach of East Tiaoxi River
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To investigate the potential bioavailability and mobility of Phosphorus (P) in sediment, Measurements and Testing (SMT) programme was employed to characterize the distribution of P in the middle-lower reaches of East Tiaoxi River. The results showed that the inorganic phosphorus (IP) was the predominant fraction of total phosphorus (TP). There was a watershed for the percentage of non-apatite inorganic phosphorus (NAIP) and apatite inorganic phosphorus (AP) in IP in Deqing County. The IP was mainly distributed in the NAIP fraction from Pingyao town to Deqing County, while the IP mainly distributed in the AP fraction from Deqing county to Huzhou city.

articleTitle: The temperature adaptability of solar greenhouse vegetable in winter in Guanzhong and Northern Shaanxi
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Abstract-To analyse the vegetable adaptability of greenhouse, the temperature and humidity of greenhouse was measured in Yulin, Yan'an and Yangling solar greenhouse. The effective temperature and single factor ecological distance were introduced to evaluate the temperature adaptability of vegetable. The results showed that the relative humidity inside the greenhouse was the largest, and the diurnal temperature variation was the minimum in Yangling. It was not propitious to the growth of fruit vegetables. The temperature adaptability of leafy vegetables was greater than fruit vegetables. The temperature adaptability of fruit vegetables was tomato >; cucumber>; capsicum>; Eggplant; The temperature adaptability of leafy vegetables was leaf lettuce >; celery>; cabbage>; greengrocery. The temperature adaptation index of 8 kinds of vegetables was the best in Yangling. The temperature in Yangling can meet the requirement of cucumber, tomato and other temperature-resistant vegetables growth. The temperature wais low in January in Yulin and Yan'an, so thermal insulation and other measures need to be strengthened to meet the cucumber, tomato and other temperature-resistant vegetables growth requirement.

articleTitle: Comparison of the test and measurement system with the automatic control system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The article compares the automatic control system with test and measurement system from several aspects in detail, such as their mathematical models, mathematical tools that analyze questions, and quality evaluation. In order to better understand the differences and relations of the two systems, we couldn't copy the theories and methods mutually.

articleTitle: Solution of complex characteristic equation of LPFG sensors coated with complex refractive index double-layer films
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The theoretic mode of LPFG coated with the weak absorption film and the sensing film is first put forward. Based on the coupled-mode theory, the complex characteristic equation of this LPFG is set up. The question on how to resolve the complex characteristic equation is analyzed theoretically in detail. The complex roots of LPFG weak absorption film coated are coincident with the results of D. V. Ignacio. In addition, there are Inf and numerical overflow in the resolution of the complex characteristic equation of metal film coated LPFG. These problems are solved through approximate deformation and scaling implementation in Bessel function. The complex roots of metal film coated LPFG are coincident with the results of Z. J. Zhang. The study proves the correction of the theoretic model, and provides theoretical foundation for studying the coupling and transmission characteristics of this kind of LPFG.

articleTitle: The three-dimensional virtual design technique based on AutodeskInventor2010 of food packaging rigid container
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Introducing the software environment and related concepts of the three-dimensional virtual design technique which based on AutodeskInventor2010 of food packaging rigid container, summarizing the design purpose and process, related modeling and rendering technique, establishing knowledge base and post management of above-mentioned technique, illustrated its applying feasibility by food packaging container producing factory from examples. The technique is significant for a enterprise to reduce productions developing and producing cycle, reduce productions costs, and improve productions quality and competitive advantage.

articleTitle: Research of acoustic characteristics and modal analysis of the muffler for steam trap
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: It had a spectrum analysis on noise of the domestic company's steam trap in high temperature and pressure by domain integral, then the noise fountainhead was founded that occurs on 1500–2500Hz frequency based on FW-H acoustic model of FLUENT aero-acoustics software. According to the characteristic of the frequency spectrum of the noise signal, mechanism with the high acoustic level and principle of throttle step-down, throttle injection muffler of steam trap was designed, and the spectrum analysis was implemented, the results show that numerical analysis match with the theoretical analysis. The vibration modal analysis for muffler was made by using software ANSYS, its natural frequency(170.84–207.76Hz)is much lower than noise peak value frequency(2000–4000Hz), and the silencer can't produce resonance in the noise peak. Modal shapes show that amplitude fluctuations was relatively steady and produce a small deformation of the muffler, the noise was not conducive to the surrounding, which provides the reliable basis for the noise elimination vibration damping and capability choiceness.

articleTitle: Phase-field simulations of non-isothermal binary alloys solidification with Neumann boundary conditions
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The dendrite growth process during the non isothermal solidification of the Al-4.5%Cu binary alloy was simulated by using the phase-field model with the Neumann boundary conditions. Solute diffusion equation and heat transfer equation were solved simultaneously. The dendrite growth, solute and temperature profile in the non-isothermal solidification were investigated. The results indicate that the simulation with Neumann boundary conditions agree well with the features commonly observed in real solidification of binary alloy.The tip speed decreased and the tip radius increases at first. Then both of the tip speed and radius become larger. Finally the tip speed and radius reduce gradually over time, the solute gradients exist in the interface before the dendrite tip is the highest. The temperature in non-isothermal solidification decreases at first and then gradually increase.

articleTitle: A project variable metric algorithm for solving electromagnetic inverse problems
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a new project variable metric algorithm, for solving the electromagnetic inverse problems, is proposed. The electromagnetic inverse problem is considered to be a nonlinear programming with equality constraints. By using an appropriate parameter, the problem is transferred an unconstrained optimization problem. The method is proposed by computing an explicit search direction per each iterative.

articleTitle: Variation of the fraction transformations and mobility of Cu and Zn in municipal sludge with pH
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the laboratory experiment, the variation of the fraction transformations and mobility of Cu and Zn in municipal sludge with pH were discussed in this study. The results show that pH has an important influence on the fraction transformations and mobility of Cu and Zn. The oxidizable fraction and residual fraction are the main ones of Cu in sludge solutions, While the percentage of acid soluble /exchangeable fraction and reducible fraction are not negligible to the fractions of Zn in sludge solutions. According to the fractions of Cu and Zn, the stability of Cu is high and the bioavailabilty is poor, but the mobility and bioavailabilty of Zn are all high. It is concluded that with pH level increased the mobility and bioavailabilty of Cu and Zn have dropped according to the experiment result that the fractions of Cu and Zn have been transferred to oxidizable fraction and residual fraction.

articleTitle: Influence of seepage on elastoplastic solutions of tunnels based on hyperbolic Mohr strength criterion
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The hyperbolic Mohr strength criterion can describe the rock failure properties better than the Mohr Coulomb strength criterion, especially the rock tensile property. Based on Mohr strength theory with hyperbolic failure envelope, an elastoplastic analysis of tunnels is presented by considering the seepage. An example is analyzed and contrasted with and without considering seepage. The radius of plastic zone with considering influence of seepage is larger than that without considering the influence. The results also indicate that the seepage have significant influences on plastic zone and tangential stress and radial stress. The results provide a theory base for stability analysis of surrounding rocks and engineering practice in tunnels, especially the failure envelopes of surrounding rocks take the form of hyperbolic.

articleTitle: Discussion of the maximum design current velocity of small towns' drainage pipelines in South China
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: There are a lot of problems in designing the small towns' drainage pipelines. A reasonable selection of design velocity has really important practical significance. Through the discussion of theoretical analysis and engineering examples which is concluded that the limited design current velocity standard (5m/s) could be broken in small mountain towns when new type engineering plastics drainage pipelines were used. The design current velocity is increased a little, the piping deposition phenomenon and the project cost would be reduced much more.

articleTitle: Dynamic integration oriented data exchange methods for distributed instrument
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
