abstract: The dynamic integration of measure resources in the distributed environment is absorbing more and more research focus for its requirements in modern producing enterprises for low-cost products. In this paper, the data exchange methods for distributed instrument is proposed, and the data exchange model is discussed which implemented the communication of the modules of the measurement instrument. And then the control mechanism of the data exchange is studied which manages the information of the measurement components and schedules the data process in the measurement cases. In this way, a group of measurement components and the distributed measurement units can be connected together dynamically. Based on the hardware concepts, the measurement component is proposed for instrument component design. The data exchange patterns among measurement components can be configured according to the communication address of software bus. The measurement data can propagate among the configured data logical flow ways asynchronously, and users can plug and unplug any components to the measurement platform. Finally, the proposed reconfigurable measurement example is present. The application case shows that the proposed way can accelerate the collaboration of production for different enterprise and improve the producing efficiency.

articleTitle: Group decision making in safety planning for earthquake disaster area reconstruction*
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The construction of earthquake disaster area involves a multitude of concerns, where safety considerations generally range primacy. During practical reconstruction planning, sometimes there are many schemes providing to expert, and many factors restrict the process of decision making. So this article regards the safety planning of earthquake reconstruction area as a multi-attribute group decision making process, applying group decision and fuzzy theory. This methodology integrates dynamically and interactively risk and deterministic safety analysis and deliberation processes. We discuss the application of this method for an instance. The results of this study indicate ways for how to consider more efficiently and effectively safety issues in safety planning of earthquake reconstruction area. This methodology can help infrastructure providers, spatial planners, and emergency responders and so on to converge their views on safety in reconstruction planning.

articleTitle: Static behavior analysis of a space structure composed of annular tensile cable-truss structure and single layer lattice shell
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A new type of space structure combined with annular tensile cable-truss structure and single layer lattice shell is introduced. The new structural system is to reduce the space occupied by roof structure and could be laid by the rigid roofing material easily. And then a series of new composite spatial structures composed of the annular tensile cable-truss structure and other spatial structure are proposed. Ribbed composite spatial structures combined with annular tensile cable-truss structure and single layer lattice shell was taken as an example and its static behavior under full-span load and half-span load was analyzed. The effect of prestress level on static behavior of the structure was studied. The results will provide a reference for a further design and project application of such structure.

articleTitle: Design and construction of intermediate tower's deepwater steel boxed cofferdam concurrently used as boring platform for Maanshan Changjiang River Highway Bridge
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The double-arm steel boxed cofferdam is used in the suspension bridge of left branch channels of Ma an Shan Chang Jiang River Highway Bridge's foundation for the intermediate tower, concurrently used as boring platform. The cofferdam satisfies functions of driving and guiding of the steel casings, sup-porting of the boring platform, using as the water retaining structure during construction of the pile cap, Causing dry construction environment under water and so no. The cofferdam relies on one's own buoyancy to floating according to the water level of construction, and which support on pile guarding-cylinder of corresponding position. The paper especially introduces the design characteristic, principle, method and construction craft of steel boxed cofferdam-platform.

articleTitle: Study on simulation of extended-circular flights of rotary dryers
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In the paper, extended-circular flights characteristics of rotary dryers is researched. On the basis of the mathematical model, a set of equations has been derived to calculate the solids holdup on extended-circular flights in such dryers. The solids holdup and its ratio to the maximum are explored. A kind of practical rotary dryer is simulated by VB program language. The simulated results, obtained in three different conditions, show that the mathematical model established for the solids holdup is correct, because the results inosculate with the fact. Furthermore, the programming provides valuable reference to such research.

articleTitle: Study on static rigidity of a high-speed vertical machining centers named VH1100
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Stiffness is an important index of machining centers' performance. The stiffness of high-speed vertical machining centers named VH1100 is analyzed by finite element method. The finite element analysis model of the machining centers is built considering the linear stiffness of double linear guide rails and the axial stiffness of double ball screw and ball bearing. The deformation of the machining centers is computed for various configurations with the results indicating that the stiffness along the y direction is better but the z direction is worse, the results can be used to optimize the machining centers' designs.

articleTitle: Laboratory experimental research and analysis on strength increasing trend of cement clays from shield work well of wuxi subway
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Plenty of unconfined compressive shear tests were performed on reconstituted clays from shield work well of wuxi subway tunnel mixed with cement to investigate the effects of water content, cement content and curing time on the strength behavior of the cemented clays. A formula of unconfined compressive strength is proposed by fitting the examination data of cemented clays. The strength formula proposed in this study can be used for derivation the cement-pure soil ratio with the knowned unconfined compressive strength,the strength formula can also be used for predicting the unconfined compressive strength,based on certain conditions.

articleTitle: Study on early forecast and recognition of emergency braking based on FCM and PNN
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Driver emergency braking was distinguished and predicted exactly difficult. In order to gain the test data of driver emergency braking action, 7 professional drivers whose age were 23 to 45 years old were chose and 3 scenes of driver braking behavior including leading vehicle braking deceleration, a vehicle or pedestrian suddenly forced into the road way were designed and simulated by means of road test. And the test data about running speed, distance between vehicles, braking pedal speed and time interval of driving action were captured by the data acquisition system with sensors. Utilizing relative fuzzy cluster making, the test data were normalized for the probabilistic neural network (PNN). Under different number of training sample data selected from test data, neural network construction model based on the PNN was built and simulated. The results show that when the number of training sample data is 46 the hit rate is 95.3 %. And more, the results indicate the validity of fuzzy normalization and PNN with adequate road test data, consequently, are an effective method for recognition and prediction of driver emergency braking.

articleTitle: Discussions on teaching methods for engaging students in engineering graphics course
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Engineering graphics course is one of the specialized core courses for the major “civil construction”. However, it is difficult for freshmen, as it is comparatively logical and needs professional knowledge, that caused some students were not interested in it. So some teaching methods for engaging students are very important and essential in instructional activities. The article summarized some problems which existed in teaching process. And a series of teaching methods were proposed for improving the teaching quality and teaching effect. As a result, the methods to enrich teaching contents were effective for engaging students.

articleTitle: Anoxic/aerobic biological aerated filter for treatment of domestic sewage
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The anoxic-aerobic biological aerated filter(BAF) was used to treat the domestic sewage reused from a power plant with its characteristics. The paper introduced the whole process, the relevant processing unit and major equipment, and analysis the actual effect by the BAF treatment. The results showed that, the every water quality of the actual effluent had reached the national "domestic wastewater discharge standard" level A, and the process is suitable for treating the domestic wastewater.

articleTitle: Autocorrelation performance improvement of CML Hyperchaos sequence based on APAS theorem
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Hyperchaos sequences have been widely used as a kind of complex pseudorandom sequences. But some well known Hyperchaos sequences, such as CML sequence, have poor autocorrelation performance, and their applications are limited. Based on recently presented APAS theorem, we modified CML map to S-CML map, and S-CML sequence has excellent autocorrelation performance, whereas its other performances are remained invariant or become better, and can be used more widely.

articleTitle: Dynamic analysis of load sense steering hydraulic system priority valve
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Priority valve is one of the key components of hydraulic steering-system and its performance decides the stability of steering-system. Taking the YXL priority valve as an example, Basing on analytical method and SIMULINK, establish the priority valve dynamic mathematical model and simulation model and analyze the laws and the influences of the key parameters such as the steering wheel rotation speed, steering system load quality, flow gain, pressure-flow coefficient and steering cylinders effective area on dynamic response characteristics with the simulation analysis. This part of work lays the solid foundation for optimization design of priority valve.

articleTitle: A modified Krylov subspace model reduction method based on the Chebyshev polynomials
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we present a modified Krylov subspace model reduction method for linear time invariable systems based on the Chebyshev polynomials. Noting the structure of the Chebyshev polynomial coefficient matrices, which are calculated approximately via the Chebyshev polynomial expansion of the state variable, we employ Krylov subspace to construct decent projection matrices. A reduced order system is produced in two-sided projection framework by combining the time and the frequency domain analysis. Two numerical examples are used to illustrate the efficiency of the method.

articleTitle: Research on digital design method of worm helicoidal surface
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the requirement of high quality, precision and reliability of worm driving device, it is difficult to fulfil these demands by traditional design method based on formula derivation. Digital technology is a viable means to resolve this problem. In this paper digital expression means of helicoidal surface is presented. Based on research the method to obtain digital helicoidal surface by each kind of generating curve, a new way using straight line as generating curve to design three ordinary helicoidal surface named Archimedes' helicoidal surface, straight sided normal helicoidal surface and involute screw surface is put forward.

articleTitle: The relationship between the derivative of LEMP in near-field on the surface of ground and that of channel-base current of lightning return stroke
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The results by accurately calculating with dipole method show that the waveform of the derivative of the electric field and waveform of the derivative of approximate calculation are consistent within 50 meters; and the derivative of the waveform of the magnetic field and the derivative waveform of approximate calculation are consistent within 200 meters.

Author Keywords: channel-base current of lightning return stroke

articleTitle: The vibration reduction and appraisal for little branch of a Nuclear Power Station
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Some little branches of conventional island are with great vibration during the operation of XX Nuclear Power Station, Which may cause some bad effect on the safety of the power station. This paper analyses the whole system the little branches belonged to, and then proposed the vibration reduction and appraisal based on the vibration test results.

articleTitle: Study on the recycle of rare-earth in rare-earth leaching wastewater
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The recycle of rare-earth elements in the low-concentration rare-earth wastewater was studied in this paper. There was a certain variation on the solution conductivity, current and temperature when the voltage, pH and electrode changed. The conductivities had upward trend under different conditions but the rates of gradual change were different, similarly, the current decreased gradually under different treatment conditions but the decreased trends were different. Under the different conditions, there were significant differences in the content and the order of precipitation in the rare-earth solution. The study found that the recovery of the rare-earth elements was good when the pH was between 6 and 9, voltage was 18V around and the Al was used as anode.

articleTitle: Simulation for structure Optimization design on truck rollover test
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Safety for the occupants of medium-heavy truck is a prime consideration for cab structure design. Among front, rear impact and rollover accident, it is rollover that results in severe Casualty for occupants. Especially during the whole process of 180° rollover accidents,including two steps,the first step is 90° rollover, the second step is 90° rollover up to 180°. A new more legal and strict rollover safety test requirement is specified by ECE R29-03[1] of amendments to ECE R29-02[2]. The non linear explicit finite element program LS-DYNA was introduced. In this paper, the application of this numerical method by the example of a real heavy truck of FAW having been passed according to ECE R29-02 is presented and compared with new requirements of ECE R29-03. The most important is a good feasible laboratory test method is found by comparison of simulation result. Finally, the paper gives a low-cost and reduced-weight improvement measures for cabin structure Optimization design in order to pass the approval test of ECE R29-03.

articleTitle: The CBM Recovery factor prediction of PanZhuang area in QinShui basion
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The determination of CBM Recovery is critical to the development of CBM industry. There are three approaches for recovery factor determination including analogy, sorption isotherm and reservoir simulation. In this work, the applicability of the three approches were detailedly analyzed. Further more,based on the study of geological characteristic of PanZhuang district and the collection of gas content and reservoir pressure,recovery factors under different abandoned pressures for 3# and 15# coal bed were calculated in terms of sorption isotherm. In addition, reservoir simulations were conducted to determine the recovery factors as well. By comparing the results of these two approaches, the technical recovery factor and the economic recovery factor of 3# coal bed is finally estimated at 53.77% and 50.63% respectively. While for 15# coal bed they are 51.62% and 47.36% respectively.

articleTitle: The design of mine air door based on the finite element analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the air door structure is analyzed and the deformed position is obtained by using the finite element analysis method according to the actual situations of the traditional structure of mine air door, and on this basis, a new air door structure which can withstand the increasing pressure is designed, this new structure solve the problem of easy deformation of the air door.

articleTitle: CMP pressure control based on dual-modes controller
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Chemical Mechanical Polishing (CMP) is the most effective wafer global planarization technology. The quality of polishing not only depends on slurry, but also depends on the precise control of polishing pressure. This paper presents a bang-bang+ dual-modes gain-variable PID controller which is used as the core control strategy to overcome the phenomena of long adjustment time, large overshooting and so on. The strategy has the advantages of the robustness, fast dynamic response of the bang-bang controller and the high steady-state accuracy of the gain-variable PID controller. Experiment results show that the dual-modes controller is feasible, practical and correct.

articleTitle: Improvement on electromagnetic compatibility of voltage source PWM rectifier based on chaotic SVPWM
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a novel chaotic space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) scheme is applied to PWM rectifier. Such an approach takes advantage of continuous power spectrum of chaotic sequence to suppress the peaky switching harmonics, and then fundamentally restrains electromagnetic interference(EMI) caused by harmonics. Compared with the conventional fixed frequency PWM rectifier, the proposed scheme can significantly reduced harmonic peak of output voltage at one or multiples switching frequency, besides, the operating performances at transient and steady state are not affected. MATLAB / SIMULINK simulation results verify the validity.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The roadside clear zone distance research
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Study on transcutaneous energy transmission system for heart pump
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to achieve wireless energy transmission of artificial heart implemented in the body, a transcutaneous energy transmission system is designed using non-contact coupling to transfer power based on electromagnetic induction. Switch control circuitry is used in the system to convert external DC into high frequency AC(HFAC). The HFAC is coupled to the secondary circuit at the transcutaneous transformer, then rectified and supplied to the artificial heart pump and the internal batteries. The output voltage information is fed back to the control unit of the primary side using a wireless communication link.

articleTitle: Application of mine electric method to probe mine water-conducting or water-bearing structures in potential under coal mining face floor
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, in order to clarify the water-rich of the coal face, the mine DC method is used to explore the mine water-conducting or water-bearing structures in potential under coal mining face floor at NO.10 Coal Seam of Cheng-He Mining Area, and analyzing on the hydrogeological rules of Ordovician limestone, and developed a series of application research preventing floor water invasion at NO.10 Coal Seam. The results show that this technology is relatively suitable for spatial positions and distribution laws detecting the mine water-conducting or water-bearing structures under coal mining face floor, and provides effective scientific basis for water prevention work of working face. The practice shows that the geophysical technology is extremely important to prevent the water inrush of working face and to guarantee the safe production in Cheng-He Mining Area.

articleTitle: Optimization design of C-post wire rope safety barrier
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The paper presents a new type of wire rope safety barrier, which has many posts with C-shaped cross section and 5 ropes, by way of designing the shape of the post, the diameter of the rope, the arrangement and the number of ropes etc., on the basis of the form of structure of the most advanced foreign existing wire rope safety barrier — BRIFEN. And in order to realize that the barrier is designed as A class protective flexible safety fence, a series of finite element models are established, taking the thickness of the steel plate of C-post. After simulation experiment, discussion and analysis, the relation of the maximum dynamic deformation and the thickness of C-post is gotten. The research shows that the flexural strength of C-post increases and the corresponding maximum dynamic deformation decreases with the thickness of C-post increases, which providing an important reference for subsequent research and Vehicle Crash Test.

articleTitle: Fuzzy compensation control based on the synchronization error of 80MN titanium-alloy forging hydraulic press
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Aimed at the conflict between the synchronization error and the distribution of the force on the slide in the four-corner leveling control, according to the characteristics of the structure of 80MN titanium-alloy forging hydraulic press, a compensation controller is designed with fuzzy control method based on the feedback linearization decoupling control. Nonlinear flow distribution of all hydraulic cylinders is adjusted to improve the synchronization accuracy of the system further. The result of the system simulation shows the method is very valid.

articleTitle: Study of active ultrasonic localization in LED street light controller
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Considering problems of the present LED street light controller, we present a method that uses active ultrasonic localization system in LED street light controller to realize energy-saving and intelligent control. Based on binaural effect, we establish a localization model, which can realize real time localization by signals of binaural time difference and binaural level difference. We obtain the model solution for real time localization of moving target. By the rotation of the binaural sensors array, we resolve the problem that the target is unable to locate in binaural signals when it is in the median surface. We design the localization waveform signal of the ultrasonic system, and make simulation experiments. The simulation results show that the model is effective.

articleTitle: The application of LCC technology in hyperstatic hydraulic support
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Life cycle cost (LCC) is introduced into product design stage, and consideration of LCC in the product's design process is the trend of science development. The product's creditability (RMS) is the most active factor of LCC, only attach importance to RMS when the project begins, can LCC make a real cut down. Fully considerating LCC in the design process of hyperstatic hydraulic support, and applying innovative structure and simple design can promote the RMS and reduce the LCC of hyperstatic hydraulic support, which can bring great economic benefits for enterprises.

articleTitle: Study of the neural network constitutive models for turfy soil with different decomposition degree
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The turfy soil is of a special humus soil. The decomposition degree is the main factor on the physical and mechanical properties of turfy soil. To build the turfy soil constitutive model, there are a few shortages such as the calculation cumbersome and low accuracy for parameter value with the method of traditional models. Furthermore, those methods did not reflect the influence of strength that effected by decomposition degree of the turfy soil. In this paper, the relationship of stress-strain with different decomposition degrees of turfy soil was carried out through indoor tests. Based on above experimental results, an improved method, which divided into different zones according to different decomposition degrees of turfy soil and calculated combining with neural network constitutive model is put forward. The result shows that, the neural network of turfy soil has good fitting precision and good generalization ability. It can fully describe the influence of the turfy soil..

articleTitle: Improved fuzzy control for resistance spot welding based on microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces the development of an enhanced controller for resistance spot welding. The control system based on AduC812 embedded microcontroller with true RMS detecting IC is described in detail. In accordance with the characteristics of the welding process, an improved fuzzy approach for welding current control with varying factors and varying structure has been implemented. Experimental results proved that the controller and its algorithm are applicable.

articleTitle: Analysis of excavator cab structure vibration and its noise response
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The numerical calculation and analysis for the coupling of vibration and interior sound field of a resistance cab has been carried out by using the FEM and the acoustic analysis software. This paper introduces the specific steps of the method of vibration's modal analysis and the method of harmonic response analysis. Through calculation and analysis, get wainscot thickness which has the influence of vibration noise excavator cab, so as to find the biggest part of vibration, the parts of the improved structure, and finally reach the effect of noise.

articleTitle: FD-TD analysis of bandwidth characteristics in the asymmetrical ridge rectangular waveguide
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The finite-difference time-domain (FDTD) method is applied to analyzing the influence of the ridge position on the cutoff wavelength and bandwidth of the dominant mode in the ridge waveguide. The cutoff wavelength and bandwidth of the dominant mode of the asymmetrical single- and double-ridge rectangular waveguide have been analyzed. Numerical results demonstrate that FD-TD method is precise and efficient, and the cutoff wavelength and bandwidth can be adjusted by changing the ridge dimensions as well as by adjusting its position.

articleTitle: Kinematic constraint conditions and dynamic equations of spatial flexible parallel manipulator
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The primary goal of this research is dynamics modeling and analysis of spatial parallel manipulator with flexible links. A new model of spatial finite element beam model is proposed. The kinematic constraint conditions of the moving platform and the branches of the spatial flexible parallel manipulator are derived. The dynamic model of the moving platform is developed based on the Newton-Euler principle. Then, using the kinematic constraint equations and dynamic model of the moving platform, the overall system dynamic equations of the parallel manipulator are obtained through assembling the dynamic equations of elements. Finally, the numerical simulation of a 3-RRS parallel manipulator was presented and compared with the results of SAMCEF software simulation. The results showed that the effectiveness and correctness of the dynamic models proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Design research on the temperature sensor in hot iron based on ANSYS emulation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The research on internally-formed pillar-shaped temperature field must be do, in order to solve the structure design and work mode design problems of the hot metal temperature sensor for the blast furnace. But the massive manpower and material resources would be consumed if the experimental method is utilized purely. Heat-conducting analysis model is established on pillar-shaped cavity by applying ANSYS. With simulating the characters of heat-conducting in the molten iron during temperature measurement , setting up parameters, putting on heat loads and setting up time, simulation study on the temperature field is carried out, and some graphic results are presented. Meanwhile, simulation experiments in lab and verifying experiments on site of the hot metal are carried out, which lead to the same results as ANSYS. This simulation study has an important guide meaning in optimizing the sensor design.

articleTitle: Design of vibro-replacement stone column for foundation of multipurpose utility tunnels in Dalian
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The efficiency of end bearing vibro-replacement stone columns in reducing the settlement of a multipurpose utility tunnels foundation system is designed in this paper. The foundation system is designed to consist of a large number of regularly spaced vibro-replacement stone columns of unequal length installed in a weak soil layer ( stratum includes plain fill, silty clay including mire, clay, cobble, stone and bedrock ) and supporting a rigid mat. At first, the analysis summarizes the influence of such factors as the column spacing, the weak soil properties, properties of the granular medium used in constructing the column, the in situ stresses caused by the installation technique, the depth of the bedrock relative to the tip of the columns and the magnitude of the uniformly distributed load carried by the supported raft foundation. The second, the paper examines the s-p, s-lg t curve of the single piles, the plane load of soil between piles, the composite foundation of the multi-pile. This paper is concluded by presenting a number of design parameter that was used in the construction of such a foundation scheme.

articleTitle: The study of motorized trunk treatment with advance and retreat injection needle and its clamping structure
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the study of manual injection of trunk treatment, this paper proposed the feasibility of motorized advance and retreat injection needle. And motorized clamping structure is designed to ensure that the distance between the injection needle and the trunk is under control. The special designed needle structure, can improve the stability of needle probing in and out of trunk, and enable the injection needles probe a certain depth into the trunk within a short period of time, which ensures the implementation of the injection process.

articleTitle: Construction of dynamic feature semantic network based on model designed by feature
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to improve practical application of feature technology, feature operator is defined to describe feature manufacturing information, which is added into semantic network to construct a dynamic semantic network. As designed by feature by model could store feature type and feature relationship information, it is used in the construction of dynamic feature semantic network At last, the example shows that the proposed semantic network construct system could work well.

articleTitle: Research of cruise pre-warning system based on MMW radar
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The cruise pre-warning system is established based on millimeter wave radar. The cruise control system is preliminarily discussed in this paper. First, a braking model is constructed according to classical braking theory. And then identification and control (I&C) module is programmed by Matlab/simulink software. Moreover, multiple objects behind a car detected by radar are identified and controlled. An I&C module is connected to Carsim 8.01 virtual radar module. The virtual object and simulation environment are set in Carsim and then simulation is performed. Finally, I&C strategy is verified by actual vehicle.

articleTitle: The design of control system for SZ-40 injection molding machine base on PLC
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper mainly introduces the application of FX-ON40MR PLC in the hydraulic control system of SZ-40 injection molding machine, the working principle of the hydraulic system in addition to the hardware and software used in PLC control system. The advanced design have endowed the molding machine advantages as follow:simple operation, high reliability, strong anti-interference ability and simple programming.

articleTitle: Detection of boom rotating angle for roadheader robot based on triaxial digit acceleration sensor
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The detection of the boom rotating angle during the heading process of the roadheader robot was the key technology of the automatic control for the roadheader. With the boom always been a certain angle to the vertical (or horizontal) direction during the mine heading process of the roadheader robot, the intersection angle between each axis and gravity direction could be applied to detect the movement postures of the mine roadheaders' boom with of the triaxial digit acceleration sensor ADXL345 fixed on the boom and to detect the rotating angle of the boom. The analysis showed that in comparison with the traditional linear displacement sensor applied to detect the stroke of the hydraulic cylinder for the detection of the boom rotating angle mode, the detection of the triaxial acceleration sensor would require less number of the sensors, not require A/D converter, make detection circuitry simplification and the detection results of the triaxial acceleration sensor would not be influenced by the front or rear and right or left inclination of the roadheader robot in the mine roadway.

articleTitle: Research on control system of new type ceramic polishing machine
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the shortcomings of the conventional polishing machine, a new type of control system on ceramic polishing machine was designed: and then using the counters and tachometers, grinding time can be automatically controlled; control system composed of loading sensor is good to precisely control the loading force during polishing; It effectively overcame the wear on valves and feed liquid pumps by using regulating system with automatic mixing function, reducing the incidence of clogging.The results indicate that ceramic polishing machine can process high-precision ceramic products at the low cost to satisfy the needs of production and scientific research greatly.

articleTitle: Similar simulation experimental investigation on the stability of the stope roof of gently inclined medium thick phosphate rock under the ming of cemented backfilling of waste rock
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the gently inclined medium thick phosphate rock of the deep part of the east mining section of +2150 level of Jinning-Six mine of Yunnan phosphate Co., Ltd , the similar simulation model experiment of the stability of stope roof under cemented backfilling mining of waste rock was carried out by the mine pressure plane stress modeling experimental frame of college of resource and environmental sciences. Based on the experimental results, the stress changing law of the above roof of stope roof after the filling of stope along the strike direction of phosphate were investigated. Then the gently inclined medium thick phosphate rock of the deep part of the east mining section of Jinning-Six mine of Yunnan phosphate Co., Ltd could efficiently recover, and the surface in mining areas could also be protected.

Author Keywords: gently inclined medium thick phosphate rock
the mining of cemented backfilling of waste rock

articleTitle: Discussion of coal mine development prospects of low-carbon economy
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The article focuses on important of a low carbon economy development .Developing a low carbon economy as a coordinated social economy development .Energy security and the basic ways to address climate change, has been generally recognized around the world. The development of low-carbon economy, improving the proportion of renewable energy, can effectively reduce primary energy consumption of carbon emissions. CBM is the most used in today's society the value of new clean energy. Development and utilization of coal bed methane, for the protection of the coal mining safety, protecting the global environment, improve energy structure, ease the contradiction between energy supply and demand, and promote sustainable development, is of great significance.

articleTitle: Analysis of the PSD and PDF characteristics on typical flow regime of gas-liquid two-phase flow in horizontal pipes
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based the experiment of gas-liquid two-phase flow in horizontal pipes, a lot of datas of pressure, pressure difference were analyzed statistically, obtained and summarized the characteristics of probability density function (PSD) and power spectral density function (PDF) on three flow regime: stratified flow, slug flow, annular flow. And compared characteristics of PSD and PDF on pressure, pressure difference signal of differential flow regime. It found that PSD and PDF can be used for flow pattern identification, then provides a new reference method for flow pattern identification.

articleTitle: The development and prospect of biochar carbon sequestration based on agriculture and forestry resources in China
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The approach to biochar carbon sequestration from crop residues and forestry wastes offer a possibility to turn biomass management into a carbon-negative industry, by right of its long storage time and high carbon content in plant biomass. This approach is under development and is currently considered as an attractive candidate for inclusion in the global carbon market. This paper analyzes the necessity of biochar research in Chinese low-carbon economy. Our analysis shows from the perspectives of emission reductions, biochar compound fertilizer, and soil amendments that biochar carbon sequestration is an effective approach to ameliorate the ecological environment, accelerate agriculture and rural economy development. Additionally, when it comes to the application prospect of biochar on carbon-trading schemes, the support for biochar research and development must be strengthened at the national level, for it not only has environmental, ecological, economic, and social significances, but also is in line with the strategic objective of sustainable development of the country.

articleTitle: Control system software design of injection molding machine based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Injection molding machine is a specialized plastic molding machines, whose control technology is the one of the key technologies to enhance the overall technical level of the injection molding machine.Injection molding machine controller was introduced based on a ARM processor using the PID neural network forward algorithm in this paper. The the design plan of the controller software was given, and the design method was described briefly at the sametime. Software design focused on the temperature measurement and control program module, temperature controller structure and control flow due to the PID neural network was written. The controller carried out the process of injection molding machine control tasks by using the dual ARM processor control system of the main lower structure and PID neural network, which obtained a better control effect and provided a reference for the control system software design on different models of injection molding machine.

articleTitle: Research and experiment on Affinity Propagation clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces Affinity Propagation (AP) clustering algorithm, which is intensively researched by some scholars owing to its advantage of fast speed and no need of setting the initial clusters manually. Mainly analyzed the characteristics of Affinity Propagation clustering algorithm at first, and then compared several principle similarity calculating methods based on Euclidean distance and Mahalanobis distance and etc. Experiment on AP clustering algorithm were done with the parts of the UCI data sets, thus the effectiveness of this algorithm was verified. Finally, the experimental results were analyzed in general.

articleTitle: Development of deep hole machining tool
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Deep processing of closed or semi-closed determines the fact that the cutting heat is not easy to diffuse; the situation of the cutting tool can not be directly observed; chips difficult to discharge, tools prone to wear and collapse, the quality of surface difficult to ensure; drills need to have sufficient rigidity, because thin-walled tubular parts tend to make deep center hole deviated or deformable. For these problems, our predecessors made arduous explorations and various attempts, the most important among which is the exploration of deep-hole cutting tools. In fact, it is the improved tool as a key factor that promotes the deep processing technology.

articleTitle: Time-dependent reliability analysis of cable-stayed bridge based on Monte-Carlo stochastic FEM
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to establish accurate stochastic finite element model, reliability analysis of long-span cable-stayed bridge should consider structure's geometrical non-linearity, system conversion during construction process and other influence. Traditional method to analyze load effect is not suitable to cable stayed bridge for it's redundancy character. Monte-Carlo stochastic FEM is appropriate, which can express the non-linear relationship between load and load effect factually. Load effects get by Monte-Carlo stochastic FEM are combined to different limit state. The time-dependent reliability index of cable-stayed bridge is calculated considering resistance deterioration. The results show that Monte-Carlo stochastic FEM is an efficient approach to analyze cable-stayed bridge's load effect and is accorded with engineering reliability assessment.

articleTitle: Measuring and calibrating flow rate of primary air for medium speed mills by numerical simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The numerical model is built for the primary air duct of the pulverizing system with medium speed mills, and the inner flow fields are simulated by employing the commercial code of FLUENT. The simulated results show that the lengths of the straight ducts before and behind the measuring element are too short to meet the requirement of the flow rate measurement of the primary air due to the compact design in many domestic power plants. The actual flow at the cross section where the measuring element is installed is irregular and disordered and the air velocity obtained by the single measuring element is not the area-weighted average value. The blowing of cool primary air also aggravates the disorder of the flow fields. It is concluded that the flow rate of the primary air can not be measured precisely. The numerical simulation method could be adopted to measure and calibrate the flow rate of the primary air, which can avoid the limitations of the existing method. This solution could improve the precision and reduce the cost of the measurement, which will be a good alternative for the domestic power plants.

articleTitle: The analysis and research on water quality and consumption in concentrated apple juice production
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Water was heavily dissipated in the process of concentrated apple juice production, and then poured as wastewater with high organic loadings. The quality and quantity of wastewater varied significantly in different production processes. Based on the investigation of several local enterprises, the quality of inlet and outlet was monitored by national standard methods in a representative factory. The results showed that new fresh water consumption and wastewater emission were 1956.8m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/d and 2614m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/d respectively with 13.05m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> new freshwater and 17.43m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> wastewater per ton concentrated apple juice. Drainage amounts of all technical units were in the following descending order: washing fruit, resin cleaning and equipment cleaning. In detail, drainage in the washing fruit made up about 40 percent of total drainage. COD in wastewater reached up to 11600mg/L at the site of resin cleaning with discharge amount about 450m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/d. These units were key aspects in the cleaning production for this enterprise. In a word, this factory have a great potential of water saving and pollutant reducing.

articleTitle: Research on 3-demision terrain generating technique for simulation of battlefield visualization
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In simulation of battlefield visualization, the modeling of terrain can affect the simulation effect directly, so focusing on the 3D terrain modeling should be emphasized. In this paper, technique of 3D terrain modeling and optimizing is discussed in detail, and so is the normal steps of modeling of 3D terrain with Multigen Creator. Especially how to obtain and preprocess the original data, and the main algorithms to modeling 3D terrain in Multigen Creator, and some significant techniques in 3D terrain modeling. Finally, one exquisite and intuitionistic terrain model is created in Multigen Creator.

articleTitle: Analysis of cable curve and determination of finished state of self-anchored suspension bridge
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As the nonlinear characteristic of self-anchored suspension bridges is very obvious in cable system, and cable curve has a great influence on the internal force of the structure, the analysis of cable curve and the determination of finished state of self-anchored suspension bridge have become a difficulty in the design. The main purpose this paper is providing a solution to these problems. Taking Qingdao Bay single-tower self-anchored suspension bridge as an example, the final stage and initial stage of the line-types of main cables are both analyzed, via using a spatial model. First, a simplified cable model is established to achieve the original geometrical line-type of the cable and the horizontal tension of cables. Then the calculation is analyzed accurately, followed by iterative calculation based on the result of the first stage until convergence. After building a model in the finished state, the internal force of main cables and hangers, as well as the spatial coordinates of main cables will be obtained. Therefore, the initial internal forces of each part of the structure will be calculated.

articleTitle: Investigation of combination characteristic of damage location and intensity in arch using wavelet coefficient
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Arch is a typical complex structure comparing with beam and plate in bridge system. This paper investigates the damage characteristic combining the crack location with the crack intensity in arch. Initially, the first four displacement modes of intact and different damaged arch are simulated and the displacement mode changes are obtained. Next, the wavelet transformation is applied to the displacement mode changes in arch and wavelet coefficients at damage loci are picked. Finally, the damage index including damage location and damage intensity in arch is provided and plotted. The results show that wavelet coefficient module maximum of mode changes can be the damage indicator and is influenced by damage location and damage intensity. The damage indicator is proportional to the damage intensity and present monotonic trend according to damage location which depend on the mode order. At the same time, the large modulus maximum corresponds to small damage combination of location and intensity in the first four modes.

articleTitle: Low-dimensional approximation strategy for a class of nonlinear distributed parameter systems
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A new low-dimensional approximation strategy is proposed for a class of nonlinear distributed parameter systems (DPS) with nonlinear uncertainties. Firstly, spectral method is used to obtain spectral based model with nominal nonlinear terms of DPS. After neglecting the nonlinear terms of the spectral based model, balanced truncation model reduction is carried out to obtain a balanced transform matrix and reduced linear terms. Lastly, a low-dimensional hybrid intelligent neural network model is used to identify spectral based model, while neural network is trained to approximate uncertain nonlinear terms. The simulation for spatio-temperature evolution of catalytic rod are presented to show the effectiveness of this low dimensional approximation strategy.

articleTitle: Decalin dehydrogenation on active carbon supported Pt-Ni bimetallic catalysts
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Pt-Ni bimetallic catalysts and their corresponding monometallic catalysts supported on active carbon were prepared by incipient wetness impregnation or chelating formaldehyde reduction. The effect of feed/catalyst ratio and the metal impregnation sequence for active carbon supported bimetallic nanoparticle on dehydrogenation activity of decalin was investigated. The results showed that the conversion of decalin increased up to 72% over 3%Pt/C catalyst when the feed/catalyst ratio reached 3.3 mL/g, under which condition the catalyst was in the liquid film state, having a higher temperature and larger contact area. The Pt-Ni/C bimetallic catalyst showed higher activity than either Pt/C or Ni/C monometallic catalyst. The impregnation sequence has a significant effect on the catalytic performance of three bimetallic supported catalysts. Pt first catalyst displayed the best dehydrogenation activity and selectivity to naphthalene. It reveals that the impregnation sequence more likely altered the location of active metal species and the formation of Pt-Ni bimetallic bond, which lead to the different catalytic behavior for decalin dehydrogenation.

articleTitle: Diesel noise measurement and control of behavior analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the standard 9-point and the sound pressure test in the noise Semi-anechoic chamber, the diesel engine was carried out at idle and standard conditions and maximum torque of conditions of machine noise experiment. Using near sound field sound intensity measurement methods, distinguishing the noise source, the average sound pressure level of the experiment proved the feasibility of covering materials and noise reduction. The results show that: that were the main source of noise of oil pan and the surface of the cylinder covers, exhaust pipes and air pressure pump. After covering composites, the best noise reduction at idle speed, the machine noise decreases 2.5dB (A).

articleTitle: A classification model based on extenics with weighted features for rolling bearing quality test
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Considering the characteristics of multi-attribute decision making in analysis and detection of rolling bearing quality grades, a new model is built based on entropy theory and extension classification algorithm for analysis of rolling bearing quality grades. The qualitative description of matter element model is built with the training dataset using extension theory, and the objective weight coefficient of each characteristics is calculated based on the concept of entropy, then using correlative functions in extenics theory, the weighted correlative grade of the objects which unknown quality grades and each matter-element object in knowledge database is calculated quantitatively, and the quality classes of the object is judged according to the rules pre-set. Experimental results show that the method can realize effectively the classification of rolling bearing quality, and has the advantages such as simple model, reliable results, and high detection speed. articleTitle: Study on gear-tooth bending fatigue strength of China-made steel
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper expatiates a modified test way and the gear-tooth bending fatigue strength of 12 China-made steel gears because their endurance limits were found lower than that ISO6336 or GB3480 commended. A integrated R-S-N curve is completed combining the group test method with up-down test method. The result shows that their bending fatigue limit stresses are equivalent to what ISO6336 or GB3480 offers. It is necessary to use the up-down method to determine the endurance limits expect the traditional group test method. The keen cycle number N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</inf> on the bending fatigue R-S-N curve is not at the point N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> which is much smaller than N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</inf>.

articleTitle: Application of Grey Relational Analysis Method in evaluation of bearing design projects
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: There are the APH(Analytical Hierarchy Process), the Ideal Point Method, the Multiattribute Decision-making Method, the FCA(Fuzzy Comprehensive Assessment) and the MOP(Multi Object Programming) to evaluate the initial design projects of bearing, but the application of these methods either has some shortages, or is complicated, so this paper used the Grey Relational Analysis Method which is very easy to evaluate the different design projects of a three points contacting ball bearing, finally the optimal project was gotten.

articleTitle: The application of TPS modified asphalts in granulated crumb rubber asphalt mixture
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Granulated crumb rubber asphalt pavement is a new kind of pavement with higher elasticity and effective anti-ice performance, contact interact state between asphalt mixture structure and materials is changed by means of adding granulated crumb rubber into asphalt mixture, so pavement is prone to in compact and flake off, its service lifetime decreases, in this paper research work, we chosen TPS modified asphalts with high viscosity as binder, studied the difference of all kinds of performance aspects among TPS modified asphalts, SBS modified asphalt and groundmass asphalt, and compared with the pavement performances of granulated crumb rubber asphalt mixture with these different asphalts, the test results indicates that TPS modified asphalts can evidently improve moisture stability and other pavement performances of granulated crumb rubber asphalt pavement, also enhance service lifetime of asphalt pavement.

articleTitle: Research on Doppler frequency-shift in satellite communications based on ephemeris of satellite
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The satellite orbit parameters in the ephemeris and location of land receiver were studied. Universal mathematic models of Doppler frequency-shift were deduced using geometric vector. The Doppler frequency between satellites and land receivers and relations of Doppler frequency-shift and elevation angle are analyzed in low, middle and high orbits, and algorithm models were constructed. The simulation results show the effectiveness and universality of the models, and it could be used for estimation and compensation of Doppler frequency-shift.

articleTitle: The YAG laser texturing technology and application with controllable disorder distribution
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The special morphology of spots isolated from each other could lead the laser texturing (LT) sheet to better stamping and coating properties, compared with shot Blast texturing (SBT) sheet and Electro-discharge Texturing (EDT) sheet. While the spots with regular distribution caused the laser texturing sheet appearing fringes easily. There were three methods to achieve YAG laser texturing disorder distribution spots, including controlling disorder delay, controlling disorder deflection, and controlling disorder image carving, which could reach the disorder spots texturing effect of EDT, and resolve the fringes problem of laser texturing. JM-3000 YAG laser texturing equipment was composed by mechanical system, laser system, controlling system, the outside optical system, frequency conversion cooling system and protection gas system, which achieved the disorder spots distribution of YAG laser texturing.

articleTitle: Notes on MacNeal slender beam
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The MacNeal slender beam was calculated under several equivalent treatments respectively with Q4 element, the results showed evident differences of about only three significant digits around each other. These equivalent treatments include equivalent stiffness method and equivalent load method for beam's thickness, changing elasticity Modulus E and load F in proportion, changing node numbering, different solvers of square root method and improved square root method. The 2-norm condition number of stiffness matrix checked by Matlab is up to 1e5, which indicates the problem is much ill-conditioned, accordingly the abnormal differences among results were explained by disturbance of ill-conditioned equations. Further analysis concluded the main cause for this model's ill-condition is the beam's slenderness, not the element's irregular shape, and in order to obtain stable result, a necessary, simple and effective method is to calculate with double precision.

articleTitle: Influence of explosion parameters on energy distribution of blast vibration signals with wavelet packet analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Blast vibration analysis is one of the important foundations for studying the control technology of blast vibration damage. According to blast vibration live data that has been collected and the characteristics of short-time non-stationary random signals, the wavelet packet energy spectrum analysis for blast vibration signal has made by wavelet packet analysis technology and the signals were measured under different explosion parameters (the maximal section dose, the distance of blast source to measuring point, the section number of millisecond detonator). Energy distributions for different frequency bands of blast vibration signal are obtained and the characteristics of energy distributions for blast vibration signal which measured under different explosion parameters are analyzed. From blast vibration signal energy, the decreasing law of blast seismic waves which measured under different explosion parameters is studied and the wavelet packet analysis method is an effective means for studying seismic effect induced by blast.

articleTitle: Study of cone NC sheet metal incremental forming
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The principle of NC incremental sheet metal forming as well as the process planning, experiment of cone forming are presented. Because the deformation of sheet metal only occurs around the tool head and the deformed region is subjected to stretch deformation and thins, and surface area increases. Sheet metal forming stepwise is to lead to the whole sheet metal deformation. According to sine law, a cone with θ smaller than limit half-apex angle can't be formed by NC incremental sheet metal forming process in a single process, rather, it must be formed in multi processes. Thus, the multi time path process method is presented to form the cone, and the experiment is made to verify it. A cone can be formed from a sheet metal in NC incremental forming process by choosing appropriate tool-path planning. The fracture in the forming component can be avoided by these methods. A cone of uniform wall-thickness can be formed by NC incremental forming process.

articleTitle: A review on regional environmental risk study
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In recent, regional economy in China has developed rapidly accompanied by corresponding environmental risks in regional-scale. On this question, this article review the domestic and international progress in the evolution of regional environmental risk studies from the aspects of risk resources and risk receptors related to quantitative environmental risk assessment and land use security planning. On the based of literature review, the further research prospects for dynamic changing mechanism of environmental risk in regional level is proposed by the method of combining the remote sensing, geographic information system, quantitative environmental risk assessment and regional planning.

articleTitle: Predictive functional control simulation of boiler combustion control system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The predictive functional control is a novel predictive control algorithm. It increases the regularity by introducing the concept of basis functions and improves the response speed and accuracy meeting the industrial process proposed requirements whose algorithm is simple and implementation. Boiler combustion system is a complex time-varying dynamic process with multiple control loops, strong nonlinear, strong coupling, time delay, strong interference features. The traditional PID control algorithm is difficult to achieve good tracking of the process parameters and the ideal control. Predict functional control is used in the boiler combustion for the characteristics of the boiler combustion control system, the simulation results show that the predictive functional control has strong adaptability and high control accuracy, improve the system's combustion efficiency. The control effect is good than the traditional PID control algorithm

articleTitle: Electromagnetic measurement and tomography
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Electromagnetic measurement applies the theory of electromagnetic induction to the measurement. The tomography based on the electromagnetic measurement was proposed about a decade ago. Because of its characteristics of non-contact and non invasion, the electromagnetic tomography is studied widely. The difficulties of the electromagnetic measurement are analyzed in this paper, and according to the different properties of measured objects in industry and medicine, we introduce the Electromagnetic Tomography used in industry and medicine. This paper presents a design strategy based on Field Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGA) which is used in the electromagnetic measurement and tomography systems. At last, the problems and trend of development about the electromagnetic measurement and tomography are discussed.

articleTitle: Study on remote PLC experiment system based on web
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to requirements, a solution of remote PLC experiment system has been introduced, including total architecture, hardware and software design. We made a remote experiment in order to control simple mechanical equipment with S7-200 PLC. Then through CP243-1IT, mechanism, PLC, server and clients from internet are mutually connected. By visiting lab web and operating panel of console interface, students can finish required tests at any time. Exams indicate that the scheme of system is feasible.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Dynamic simulation and optimization design of polished rod hoisting system based on VB combined with matlab and ansys
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Hydrogeochemical controls on fluorosis in the abandoned Yellow River flooding delta, East China
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Fluorosis is the most widespread and serious endemic disease in the abandoned Yellow River flooding delta of East China. Regional geochemical investigation indicates that host rocks containing F rich minerals of Archaean and Proterozoic stages are the geochemical source for the high fluoride groundwater. Over 1500 times flooding of the Abandoned Yellow River forms the flooding delta and refigures the local landform, which particularly provides favorable conditions for the fluoride accumulation in groundwater. 310 groundwater samples were collected in the central part of the flooding delta to address the chemistry of high fluoride groundwater. Test results indicate that fluoride concentration of the groundwater ranges from 0.2-6.7mg/L. 72.8% groundwater samples have fluoride above the China maximum permissible limit of 1.0mg/L for drinking water. In Heze, Feng, Pei and Tongshan Counties, groundwater with more than 6 mg/L fluoride was even observed. Local people are high exposure to naturally occurring fluoride in shallow groundwater of the abandoned Yellow River flooding delta. The groundwater in high fluoride is plotted on HCO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-K+Na, SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>-K+Na, HCO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-Mg type of the Piper classification. F" in the groundwater are positively correlated with HCO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> and Na<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>+K<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> and negatively correlated with Ca2+.Groundwater with F<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> concentration of over 3.5 mg/L generally occurs in the alkaline environment. Activity of different fluorine complex spices was quantified using PHREEQC package. According to the calculation, MgF<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> and CaF<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> in the groundwater are the poisoning parameters controlling the endemic fluorosis of the abandoned Yellow River flooding delta.

articleTitle: Machine-calculation for driving hypoid gears of helix generating method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By means of meshing theory, vector and matrix, a new manufacturing method what is called helix generating method is developed in the thesis. Manufacturing theory and machine calculation method of helix generating method are researched, model of cutting driving hypoid gears with new manufacturing method is built, machine-tool setting expression of relation is developed based tooth cutting model, and mathematical model of hypoid gears is built Validity and practicability of the method were proved by a numerical example.

articleTitle: Study on Realtime Ahead Detection Technology for mining roadway based on double frequency induced method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Realtime Ahead Detection Technology used in mechanized excavation of coal mine roadway adopts Dual Frequency Induced Polarization Method to predict the geologic anomalies hidden before the excavating face. In the paper, considering the characteristics of mechanized excavation of coal mine roadway, the author puts forward the features of ideal ahead detection method which could be used in geologic anomalies prediction of roadway excavation. Several detecting probes would be used to emit detecting currents and receive induced polarization information in Realtime Ahead Detection Technology. According to adjusting current intensity and close sequence of detecting probes, we could scan the geological mass before the excavating face in different angles and depths. Thus, the hidden geologic anomalies could be predicted in time. This paper also discussed the possibility to realize the integration of the detector and the roadheader machine.

articleTitle: Multisensor information fusion algorithm and application combining D-S evidence theory and BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In modern medical science, several medical data signals are required to be collected together at the same time, such as, pulse, heart sound, respiratory sound, and so on. So that multisensor is necessary to gather multichannel signals, and to extract their respective feature, and finally produce the fused diagnosis results. This paper proposed a method of multisensor information fusion which combines BP neural network and D-S evidence theory. In this way, the weak real-time of mono-neural network, caused by the frequent iterative times, is perfected and the conduction of D-S evidence theory to the system is more accurate, in terms of applying large numbers of standard samples to neural network training. Finally our algorithm is proved to be practicable by experiments.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Combustion characteristics of test and research on electronic control fuel injection system of cars GDI engine
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Sulfur balance in the treatment of sulfur-containing wastewater in a biotrickling reactor
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Biological sulfite reduction was studied in a laboratory-scale anaerobic biotrickling reactor packed with ceramic granule for biomass attachment. Inoculated with the Sulfate-reducing Bacteria isolated from landfill leachate, the reactor was operated for 72h per cycle at room temperature with a sulfite loading rate of 1360 mg/L. The sulfite removal efficiency reached 97% after 9.5h. However, the total sulfur and Chemical Oxygen Demand (COD) reduction were 40% and 48.2% respectively at that time. To quantify various sulfur speciations, calculation of sulfur balance was performed, which revealed that up to 76% of sulfite removed was converted to elemental sulfur. In addition, the Oxidation-reduction potential (ORP) maintained within the range of -61mv to -20mv, which is different from the widely reported value: lower than -1000mv. It is effective to treat sulfur-contining waste water using biotrickling reactor.

articleTitle: Research on neutralization mechanism of concrete subjected to acid rain
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: There are a great number of concrete structures existing in the atmospheric environment. The process of industrialization has led to the severe air pollution. The acid rain areas expand so severely that the neutralization of concrete is increasingly concerned about. Acid rain is the most ordinary acidic material in the atmospheric environment. In this paper, the neutralization process of acid rain was analyzed through the theory of diffusion and mass transfer, and the neutralization mechanism of concrete acid rain eroded was revealed, which is significant for the durability design and for the further investigation of reinforcement corrosion and service life prediction of concrete structures.

articleTitle: Research on ANN-based feature recognition and manufacturing behavior sequence
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper presents an intelligent manufacturing feature extraction method and the reasoning method of manufacturing behavior sequence. This method mainly used pre-trained BP neural network to identify the B-rep model representation of the product After that, manufacturing behavior sequence constraint model was built, and the initial sequence was acquired through knowledge-based process templates and knowledge-based process templates. After evaluation of mathematical models and analysis of software Deform, the rational optimum manufacturing behavior sequence was acquired Through a lot testing, the validity of the system was verified

articleTitle: A wavelet packet analysis based method for fault diagnosis of dynamic circuits
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A novel method based on the wavelet packet analysis is proposed for the fault diagnosis of dynamic circuit. In the proposed method, a fixed unstable AC signal is used as the stimulant of a dynamic circuit, and the responses are captured and disassembled by the wavelet packet analysis. Many faults in dynamic circuit are sensitive to frequencies, which are the chief difficulties of traditional DC based diagnosis method. By the stimulation of the unstable AC signal, the responses of dynamic circuit should be different from normal and fault conditions, and all of dynamic fault in the CUT can be sensitized. In the further step, the fault characters are obtained by the wavelet packet analysis of the output signals. Compared to the DC based fault diagnosis method and traditional AC fault dictionary, the superiority of the presented strategy is exemplified in the success fault diagnosis. The test results demonstrate that the applying of energy criterion after wavelet packet analysis is powerful and reliable method.
