Simulated experiments are carried out in the end to analyze the robustness of the results, and from the experiments the RMS error of each parameter in intrinsic matrix of the camera increases almost linearly with the noise level and it is in allowable range.

articleTitle: Research on new method of automobile developing process reengineering
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The development method of automobile is put forward which is based on Information Synthesis Approach (ISA), Concurrent Engineering (CE) and Net Brainstorm (NBS), which aims at accelerating development of Automobile. There are four modules such as development preparation; automobile design, automobile manufacturing and automobile sell which make a magic ball according to rules of ISA. The four modules can subdivide into little magic balls. The balls of same hierarchy are carried through by Concurrent Engineering. In order to find more and better development concepts, they feed back information reciprocally with principle of ISA. NBS is the main innovation mode in every job of automobile development.

articleTitle: Unsaturated soil seepage analysis using temporal adaptive transformation method with under-relaxation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This research tends to develop robust numerical methods for solving the highly nonlinear partial differential equation describing unsaturated soil flow. Based on the research of a modified transformation method with under-relaxation, the numerical performance of this promising method with automatic temporal adaptive scheme is investigated. Example shows that such a combination approach can be a robust numerical method for practical unsaturated flow simulations, as it provides the most efficient solution at minimal computational cost; its performance is rather robust with moderate changes of several parameters introduced; and it is conceptually and computationally simple which can be easily incorporated into existing software codes based on the backward Euler scheme.

articleTitle: Numerical Analysis of Diesel Engine oxygen-enriched Combustion Characteristic Based on the Simplified Mechanism of n-heptane Oxidation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the simplified n-heptane oxidation chemical kinetics model and the multi-dimensional Diesel combustion model coupled method, from both the macro and micro perspective of the combustion in cylinder, cylinder pressure, temperature, heat release rate, fuel and NO emissions' development and changes of different concentrations of oxygen-enriched combustion in engine were analyzed. By comparison with the experimental results verified the correctness of the model used. Also found that: oxygen-enriched combustion can promote the formation of combustible mixture, which making the burn more quickly and fully, also make the premixed combustion and diffusion combustion heat release rates change. In the condition of oxygen-enriched combustion, cylinder peak pressure, pressure rise rate, peak temperature, temperature rise rate, NO generation capacity and its distribution are increasing with the oxygen concentration. In addition, the temperature uniformity increases gradually as the concentration of oxygen in cylinder, while the pressure uniformity declines after reaching a peak point. Finally, this paper proposed some specific technologies to control the diesel engin's bad combustion and emission performances cased by oxygen-enriched combustion, which can not only give full play to the advantage of the oxygen-enriched combustion technoloy, but also can guarantee the performance of diesel engine's emission.

articleTitle: Study on application model of three-tiered architecture
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper discusses characteristics and merits of three-tiered architecture in the system application, points out the core idea of three-tiered architecture is the distribution of calculation and data. This Paper put forward a basic principle that the middle tier should be a buffer of other tiers and the balance point of all loads, and it should be expanded for future business requirements. Based on this principle, we propose a new perspective that the middle tier in traditional three-tiered architecture should be logically divided into Basic Business Tier, Kernel Business Tier and Business Presentation Tier. Finally, the realization of this division is introduced with the example of the doctor's advice management in Hospital Management Information System.

articleTitle: Effects of ambient conditions on the impedance-based health monitoring technique
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In practical application of electro-mechanical impedance (EMI) technique, the monitored structure is constantly undergoing change due to external boundary conditions and the surrounding ambience. This change, in most cases, is considered to be normal and a part of the everyday use of the structure. The aim of this paper is to examine and obtain a better understanding of practical issues that are a result of monitoring the health of structures in an uncontrolled field environment. Comparison study on EMI signatures between the change of ambient conditions and induced structural damages is also implemented. This paper tries to provide an in-depth view through experimental analysis if this health monitoring technique is to be successfully used in practical applications.

articleTitle: A village landscape analysis based on the natural ecosystem
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: When making a great effort to develop the new countryside today, what the designers focus on is making the village landscape coordinate with the natural landscape, and expressing the characteristic of the ecological village more orderly and efficiently. This essay studied the connotation and significance of the landscape in Yinhuwan ecological village of Sanqing Mountain form the perspectives of its overall mountains and waters environment, ecological design and spiritual space, supported with various analysis in the aspects of settlements, ecosystem and regional characteristic related to architectural study.

articleTitle: Study on one-dimension consolidation mechanism, equation and Analytical Solution of soft soil in vacuum preloading
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Measured values of excess pore water pressure in soil under vacuum preloading were analyzed. Action process of vacuum preloading was compartmentalized three phases. They were seepage consolidation in shallow soil and “surcharge” effect in deep soil by vacuum suction, consolidation stabilization in shallow soil and transformation of “surcharge” effect to “negative pressure” effect in deep soil, seepage consolidation in deep soil under “negative pressure” effect and to balance. Action mechanism root of vacuum preloading was not negative pressure difference solely, which was produced by seepage field. The root was “positive pressure” action and “negative pressure” action together during different stage. The root also included the two pressures superposition under the especial phenomenon of vacuum preloading: water level falling. “Two springs” soil consolidation model of one dimension was established and was applied to analyzing soil consolidation. In early stage of vacuum preloading, “positive pressure” was dominant action in soil consolidation. Effect area of suction was limited and maximal deepness: l<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</inf> was defined. After the early stage, “negative pressure” became dominant action. Soil consolidation equation was established and initial, boundary condition were defined. Analytical Solutions of excess pore water pressure were obtained and discussed.

articleTitle: Design and implement of 3D chemical pipes
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: There exist plenty of pipe drawings of the design and production in chemical enterprises. Some problems related to 3D pipe design were studied in the paper. It involved 3D pipe reconstruction based on 2D pipe drawings and 3D pipe modeling based on parametric technique. Coordinate transformation, recognizing and matching of pipe segments, 3D parametric design were researched. The conditions to determine pipe's interference were analyzed in details. On the platform of AutoCAD, with VBA being used as a development tool, a case study was realized.

articleTitle: The numerical simulation analysis of adjacent building vibration induced by urban subway transit
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The numerical simulation analysis of adjacent building vibration induced by urban subway transit is made under simple and multiple support excitation, and is compared to experiment and analysis in situ. The results show that: (1) about the adjacent building vibration induced by urban subway transit, the numerical simulation analysis under multiple support excitation is more close to in situ experiment and analysis than under simple support excitation; (2) floor's vibration is mainly expressed floor slab vibration, and the amplified vibration between floors mainly concentrate to the low band below 20 Hz.; (3) the numerical simulation analysis should consider the damping effect of ground vertical vibrations induced by urban subway transit in building, as far as possible to adopt the theoretical mode under multiple support excitation, which can get more objective and scientific analysis conclusion.

articleTitle: Prediction method for running-in status of wet clutch based on third-order cumulant
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Third-order cumulant is used in running-in status prediction of wet clutch because of its suppression for Gaussion Noise. Third-order cumulant of torque signal during running-in of wet clutch is calculated. It shows that the method is useful by comparing the third-order cumulant curves at different running in status.

articleTitle: Research on braking energy regeneration of slewing mechanism in hybrid excavator
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As the study of hybrid power further developed, people start to pay attention to braking energy regeneration, which has never been made fully use for a long time. This paper studied braking energy regeneration of excavator slewing mechanism. The slewing mechanism is driven by ISG, and ultra-capacity is used as electrical power source. Referring to the model of ISG and ultra-capacity provided in the software ADVISOR, the slewing system model was built based on Matlab/Simulink, and then the process was simulated on energy regeneration. At last, this work compared energy consumption and SOC of the ultra-capacity between the two slewing systems with and without braking energy regeneration. The simulation result shows that braking energy regenerating system can drastically decrease the energy consumption.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Design and research on support plate torsion spring of special electromechanical device
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research and application of VCR plus technology in hot strip mills
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: VCR technology in hot strip mills can increase transverse stiffness of loaded gap, heighten control effect of roll bending, improve distribution of contact force between backup roll and work roll. However it appears to lack coordination with CVC work roll. A new objective function of VCR plus design curve was established with considering the contour of CVC, and simulation was carried out to verify the effectiveness of VCR plus by two dimensional variable thickness finite element method. The on site test results show that VCR plus technology is proved to be effective in strip profile and flatness improvement, roll consumption reduction and increase of rolled product length of rolling cycle in CVC mills.

articleTitle: Risk analysis and emergency measures for shallow tunnel construction embedded in watery and arenaceous stratum
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the shotcrete cracking danger that happened on shallow tunnel construction of Shenzhen Metro, this paper analyses the major predisposing factors and their interaction for dangers occurred at shallow tunnel construction, which embedded in watery and arenaceous stratum. We put forward the corresponding measures based on the actual situation. According to the monitoring date, we make regression analysis using MATLAB, and evaluate the effectiveness of measures. The research result shows that, controlling the loss of groundwater is the key to avoid this kind of accident.

articleTitle: Research of automobile panel dies deformation based on similitude theory
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper, on the basis of the Buckingham Pi theory and the dimensional analysis, the dynamic similarity criterion is derived for the mold structure of stamping. To validate the criterions, a numerical simulation is conducted, and the results show fairly good corresponding relationship. It provides a foundation for the physical simulation and a reliable method for the die-face compensation of automobile panel dies.

articleTitle: Effect of yaw velocity feedback in electric power steering system on handling stability of vehicle
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Using a yaw velocity sensor into EPS (electric power steering system), we can build up a man-vehicle system model including EPS in the paper. After simulation analysis, it is shown that vehicle's yaw velocity response is improved remarkably by introducing yaw velocity negative feed into the model with front wheel's steer angle step input and the EPS powered torque response curve arises evenly and slowly. This is useful to vehicles' driving at high speed on low friction coefficient road so as to improve the vehicles' safety in driving.

articleTitle: A general query middleware based on web service
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Data query plays an important role in the information application system. Data query in the traditional design method need to be constantly redesigned with the change of user requirements, which increases the workload of system development, reducing development efficiency and software reuse. After abstracting and extracting the common elements of the query, a scalable, flexible configuration, reusable general query middleware based on web service technology is designed. General query middleware consists of two parts. One is the query configuration module for the system designers. Another is the general query module for end-users. System designers and end-users need only some simple operations to achieve integrated query function, reducing duplication of code and improving development efficiency.

articleTitle: Protect environment and explore a new sustainable socio economic development road under the guidance of scientific outlook on development
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the development of global economy, environmental problems have become core issues of human concerns. Human society and environment are an organic unity, and environment is the fundamental condition for human survival and the material base of social production sustainable development. The essence of solving environmental problems is to deal with the relationship between human and nature, human and human, economy development and environment protection.

articleTitle: Mechanism study on vibration and noise reduction of circular saw with slots and filling material based on the theory of elastic wave
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to obtain the mechanism of vibration and noise reduction of circular saws and perform further optimization design, based on the characteristic of propagation in the medium interface of blending wave, mechanism of vibration and noise reduction on circular saw blades with slots and filling materials was expounded from the view of transmission interruption and dissipation of elastic wave. The change of wave amplitude was calculated quantitatively based on the theory of propagation of blending wave when incident wave pass the filling material under the parametric excitation. The results show wave amplitude decreased sharply; filling material can absorb and interdict the vibration wave resulted from external excitation, so as to reduce the vibration and noise, the theory was verified by field test. That study provided new ideas and theoretical basis for the design of circular saw blade.

articleTitle: Evaluation of student dormitory's design project based on improved AHP
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article has a research on four representative student residence's design project from four aspects through AHP method looking forward to revealing future dormitory planning, designing and building.

articleTitle: Development of flexible three-dimensional machining force measurement and analysis system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A flexible computer aided test system of three-dimensional cutting force is introduced in this paper. Based on USB serial communication protocol, the computer data acquisition hardware platform of three-dimensional machining force measurement and analysis system is built. The measurement and analysis software system is developed under Microsoft visual studio development environment, which includes several function software packages, such as turning force testing software package, milling force testing software package, grinding force testing software package, drilling force testing software package. With these software packages, machining force of different processing types could be monitored online and processed offline both in time domain and in frequency domain. The machining force regression models could be established by using single factor analysis method. The three-dimensional milling force testing experiments results show that the flexible testing and analysis system could meet the three-dimensional cutting test of different processes, and the regression models coincide with the cutting force variation law. Meanwhile the testing system is very flexible, which could adapt to different process and different force sensors and also could meet any general current or voltage signal test.

articleTitle: Nonlinear dynamics modeling of axially moving cantilever laminated composite plates
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the nonlinear dynamics modeling of an axially moving cantilever rectangular laminated composite plate excited by aerodynamic force were studied for the first time. The major results of this paper as following: Firstly, based on the third-order shear deformable plate theory, the nonlinear governing equations of motion for an axially moving cantilever rectangular laminated plate were deduced by using the Hamilton's principle, and the nonlinear Piston Theory was employed to model external loading. Secondly, the vibration mode-shape functions of the axially moving cantilever plate were calculated based on the general solution of four-order homogeneous ordinary differential equation, and the Galerkin method was utilized to reduce the governing partial differential equations to a two-degree-of-freedom ordinary differential equation, and then the characteristics of the nonlinear dynamics equation were analyzed.

articleTitle: Application research of ground shortest path based on GIS in the Emergency Rescue Information Management System for airport airside
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Aviation safety is the base for the operation of air transportation system. It plays a significant role in maneuvering accidents quickly and efficiently. In this paper, the network of airport on the airside was analyzed from the aspect of aviation safety; then a nodes-arcs relation database was built to describe the airside network topology and the Dijkstra algorithm was employed to search the shortest path between the nodes. At last, MapX and a GIS re-developing tool were used to carry out the Emergency Rescue Information Management System development for a domestic large-scale airport under the Visual Basic environment. This system can provide supports for visual and convenient decision-making in airport emergency rescue events; and also expand MapX's spatial analyzing ability to develop an applied GIS system.

articleTitle: The influence of calcium to the map precipitate recycled from wastewater
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The advantage of magnesium ammonium phosphate (MAP) precipitation method is the integrate of wastewater treatment and resources recovery. But generally, there have Ca<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> and Mg<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> in the wastewater, so there may have MAP and hydroxyapatite (HAP) simultaneously in the precipitate. The MAP can be used as slow release fertilizer directly; the HAP is just used as industrial raw material. So, the value of MAP is higher relatively. In order to get pure MAP, it is necessary to find out the influence of Ca<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> to MAP precipitation. The precipitation experiments under different Ca<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> concentration and different pH value were respectively conducted in simulation wastewater and landfill leachate. The NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-N removal rate, precipitation productivity and constituents were analysed, the influence of Ca<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> to MAP precipitation were summarized in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on performance evaluation of Inter-Satellites laser communication system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Considering that noises with different kinds of distribution, the Gaussian Approximation method is firstly used to evaluate the Inter-Satellites Laser Communications performance precisely. The Moment Generating Function expression of considering shot noise, background optical noise and hot noise is firstly derived. Using this MGF, Gaussian Approximation (GA) method is used to evaluate the Bit Rate Error performance of system. The system performance of OOK modulation of traditional method is compared with GA method in direct detection system. Results indicate that the performance of Inter-Satellites Laser Communications by GA is different from traditional method.

articleTitle: The study on the damped vibration of a strongly cubic nonlinear oscillator
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The approximately analytic solution of the differential equation of the damped vibration of a strongly cubic nonlinear oscillator has been obtained by improved elliptic function averaging method. The result is proven to be valid by numerical experiments. The properties of damped vibration of a cubic nonlinear system are discussed according to the approximate expression.

articleTitle: Delay detached eddy simulation of hydraulic characteristics after a new sudden lateral enlargement and vertical drop at the end of reversion curve of a spillway
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The numerical simulation of hydraulic characteristics is carried out with delay detached eddy simulation (DDES) model and VOF method. The simulation results agree well with experimental date. The flow condition is smooth, the length of lateral cavity gradually increases with the size of lateral enlargement increases, only small water-wing emerges after the lateral cavity and the backwater do not appear in bottom cavity. The research results can provide the reference for design and scientific research.

articleTitle: The monitoring and method of controlled blasting demolition of long span arch bridges
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the demolition plan of a long span arch bridge is discussed, finite element analysis is done according to the demolition progress, and the monitoring of the blasting demolition is introduced. The demolition plan for long span arch bridges is decided base on the structural property, using the method of from upside to downside to deconstruct the upstructure, and the blasting method to destroy the rib of arch bridge, and the monitoring and safe evaluation of the nearby new bridge is made. This result can be a good case for same project later.

articleTitle: Research on the fracture toughness test methods for high grade pipeline steel
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to overcome the insufficiency in the existing standard methods of fracture toughness, which are not generally suitable for the steel pipeline, this paper tries to seek a palatable solution to the problem. The relevant tests were carried out by using four kinds of casing pipes (APIX70, APIX80, APIX100 and 4145 drill collar steel), and the parameters of plane-strain fracture toughness KIC, J-integral and CTOD values were measured by three-point-bending tests. Through the observation of the fracture morphology of the specimen, the paper had analyzed the experimental results in the microscope scale. The results show that the CTOD values drop successively from X70 steel, X80 steel to X100 steel. As the thickness is limited and the plane strain condition for measuring K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">IC</sub> couldn't be meeted, K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">IC</sub> fracture toughness test for X70 steel, X80 steel and X100 steel cannot obtain the effective experimental result. The J integral test result indicate that only the X100 steel can obtain the effective J value. Therefore, comparing with K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">IC</sub> or J integral, CTOD is a more reasonable and easier way to discribe the fracture toughness of high grade pipeline steel, although CTOD theory is imperfect.

articleTitle: Application of ANSYS/PDS in reliability analysis of Formation-Cement-Casing
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the finite element theory, Probabilistic finite element method would be able to analyze the elastic response of parameters' uncertainty to model. The assembly of Formation- Cement-Casing in complex conditions was analyzed using ANSYS PDS technique; the probabilistic finite element method was built up for the assembly of Formation-Cement-Casing. This method could be able to consider the uncertainty factors of complex formation and cement, as well as the random factors of casing strength. In accordance with the case study, the effect of assembly's uncertainty factors on casing reliability was analyzed. The casing reliability was calculated under the influence of random factors.

articleTitle: Vibration transmission analyze based on wavelet theory and higher order spectrum
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The vibration of internal structure and car body of rolling stock influences the safety of train operation directly. Due to non-stationary feature of vibration signal, traditional spectrum analysis and PSD methods are limited. In this paper, mechanical vibration transmission relationship is researched based on wavelet denoising technique and higher order spectrum analysis by the use of the character that wavelet decomposition possess the function of self-adapting time-frequency localization characteristic and higher order spectrum can restrain the additive gauss noise, putting forward frequency response function based on 1.5 dimension spectrum. The effect of vibration transmission relationship based on wavelet de-noising and 1.5 dimension spectrum is better than power spectrum though analyzing and comparing, the results could be taken into consideration in vehicle structural design.

articleTitle: The application of Improved Back Propagation Neural Network on the determination of river longitudinal dispersion coefficient
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The Improved Back Propagation Neural Network (IBPN) model was developed to predict the longitudinal dispersion coefficient for natural rivers. The hydraulic variables [mean flow depth (H), flow velocity (u) and shear velocity (u*)] and geometric characteristic [channel width (B)] constituted inputs to the IBPN model, whereas the longitudinal dispersion coefficient (Kx) was the target model output. The model was trained and tested using 23 data sets of hydraulic and geometric parameters, of which first 20 data sets were used to train and validate the model, and the rest data to test. In this model, cross validation theory was applied. To overcome the shortage of the traditional BPN model, the network was designed to determine the optimal weights and thresholds by random sampling at the interval (−1,1) for 1000 times, which would generate an output as close as possible to the target values of the output. The training of the IBPN model was accomplished with the no error fitting and the prediction average relative error was 8.07%. The results indicated that both prediction accuracy and the generalization ability were significantly improved.

articleTitle: Research on the caisson sinking method of north anchorage of Taizhou Changjiang River highway bridge
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The north anchorage of Taizhou Changjiang River highway bridge is made by a large open caisson, length of the caisson is 67.9m, the width is 52.0m, and the height is 57m. The caisson divided into 11 segments in total, the first segment is 8m long, made by steel covered concrete, the 10th segment is 4m long, and the other are 5m, all made by reinforced concrete. By Surveying, Choosing by the fact that the first step compares, Researching by construction risk and construction work efficiency and Calculating comparison, the caisson sinking method was chosen finally to be partial drainage method, and the choose detail was introduced in this paper. The chosen caisson sinking method was proved to be feasible in practice, and the experience could be useful for the other similar engineering.

articleTitle: Experiment investigation on dynamic performance of tool system and influential factors
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the experiment of machine spindle raising-speed idle running and vibration testing, different vibration characteristics of spindles with and without tool system in various rotational speeds were obtained, then changing the key structural parameters of diameter and length, we obtained the vibration characteristics of machine spindle system when idle running again. By the way of spectrum analysis, testing results and summarized rules can be the reference of evaluating dynamic performance of tool system, and can also help to afford an optimized goal for the dynamic design of tool system's structural parameters.

articleTitle: Research on collaborative reasoning for distributed reasoner
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper investigates an extension to description logic based knowledge reasoning by means of decomposing and rewriting complicated hybrid concepts into partitions. An approach which automatically decomposes the whole knowledge base into description logic compatible and constraints solver, is presented. System architecture for knowledge reasoning is two-fold. First, complex description logics with powerful representation ability and Second, how to reason with the combination of inferences from distributed heterogeneous reasoner.

articleTitle: Application study on the solar energy heating system in Luoyang
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we comparative analysis the solar floor radiation heating and convention heating on the basis of integrated heating price. We also analysis the energy-saving and environmental benefit against the solar energy system and domestic hot water system. At last ,we get a optimum heating scheme in Luoyang.

articleTitle: A novel digital predistortion technique for Ultra Wide-Band radar pulse-compression signals
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Ultra Wide-Band (UWB) radar pulse-compression signal generation systems using digital techniques have received a great deal of attention recently due to their flexibility, repeatability, and wide range of stable operating frequencies. Unfortunately, the performance of generated signals is limited by the analog and digital components used in these systems. In this paper, a novel digital predistortion correction technique which adopts the addition of digital signal processing in the time domain is put forward. The principle of this proposed method is investigated profoundly by mathematical derivations, and the corresponding computer experiments are performed by using MATLAB language. The results demonstrate that it can increase the quality and performance of UWB signals considerably and satisfy the requirements of UWB radar systems.

articleTitle: The design principles and control measures of preventing the cracks in the exterior wall insulation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to the major phenomenon of the cracks occurring in the exterior wall insulation of the building, it analyzes the causes of the fracture and the potential harm of the cracks in the main building structure. Combined with the engineering practice, it puts forward the design principles and control measures of preventing the cracks in the wall insulation in accordance with the crack-caused principles and the crack-resistance mechanism.

articleTitle: Study on the left-turn of non-power-driven vehicles at signalized intersection
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper studies the left-turn of non-power-driven vehicles in the condition of little interference to motor vehicles at signal intersections, and puts forward an oblique way crossing the street for left-turn nonpower-driven vehicles. It first compares the oblique crossing way with the traditional left-turn of nonpower-driven vehicles through an example. Then makes a simulation by means of VISSIM and calculates the capacity and travel delay, thus to verify the formula in HCM that applies to bicycles also is applicable to non-motor vehicles. At last, the comparison between computational travel delay and the simulation delay shows that: the average delay can be reduced by 53.8%, and the crossing time and waiting time can be reduced by 40.6% when the non-motor vehicles turn left by the left-turn phrase of motor vehicles.

articleTitle: The detection system of vehicle driving simulator attitude based on ADXL335
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to overcome the shortcoming of traditional vehicle attitude measurement methods which realize on vehicle driving simulator, a new attitude measurement system based on MEMS sensors was studied. It proposed the innovative method of differential measurement. The configuration and software design of system were discussed. The feasibility of system was proved by tests. The result showed that it could meet the requirements of accuracy of vehicle driving simulator attitude measurement. It was a practical measurement system.

articleTitle: Analysis of driving capacity on traveling wave pump of magnetic fluid
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The decoupled question of magnetic fluid and magnetic field is investigated by the Boundary-Step by Step Hand Method. The magnetic field intensity and the saturation magnetization of magnetic fluid affect driving capacity of magnetic fluid traveling wave pump directly. The driving capacity increases increasing of the magnetic field intensity and the saturation magnetization of magnetic fluid. The viscosity of the magnetic fluid affects the driving capacity too. The viscosity of magnetic fluid can change when the magnetic field changes. The viscosity increases when magnetic field increases. When magnetization of magnetic fluid reaches saturation, the viscosity changes tardily. The driving capacity reduces with the increasing of the viscosity. The shape of the magnetic pole affects the driving capacity. The magnetic induction in the pump can be changed with the changing on the shape of magnetic pole. The driving capacity is max when the pole angle is 450.

articleTitle: Modeling shipping energy saving and emission reduction in three gorges Wanzhou district and its application
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to evaluate the contribution of Wanzhou shipping on energy saving and emission reduction, this paper built an estimation model with three parameters, which are transportation sharing rate, energy consumption factor or emission factor, and baseline year. The calculation results shows that: (1) Wanzhou shipping can save 87,000 tons of fuel and reduce 67 million tons of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions each year, it is an energy-saving and environment-friendly modes of transportation; (2) Wanzhou shipping can save 430 million yuan on fuel consumption and 67 million yuan on CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions, it is a cost-effective mode of transportation; (3) Wanzhou shipping is the lowest energy consumption and CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emissions mode in comprehensive transportation system, so, it is worthy for the government to increase investment and accelerate its development.

articleTitle: Modal analysis of transmission gear in gearbox based on SolidWorks
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A truck gearbox was chosen as research object of the text. 3D model of transmission gear was firstly built up by using SolidWorks software, and the Simulation module was utilized for modal analysis of transmission gear by using finite element method. The modal forms and deformation extent of transmission gear under several frequencies were gained and analyzed the maximum displacement deformation of gear with loading. It provides a reference for reverse engineering and optimization design of transmission gear.

articleTitle: Application of hot-formed sheet steel on inner panel of front cross member
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The hot-formed sheet steel is successfully applied on a vehicle by analysis of simulation test of strength, material and third point curve. The application of this material can increase not only the strength but also improve energy-absorbing efficiency. Meanwhile, the lightweight is not only achieved but also the vehicle safety crash is improved.

Author Keywords: Inner Panel of Front Cross Member

articleTitle: Modeling research of a combined press device for ridge-till and no-till seeders
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: On the basis of building the three-dimensional models of compacting wheels, press cylinders, axis, tube and connecting rods, the virtual assembly model of the combined press device for ridge-till and no-till seeders was constructed with Autodesk Inventor. Compacting wheels were developed to compact the ridge sides. Press cylinders were designed to press the planting zones. Two tubes were used to make the maize stubbles pass. The parameters including materials behavior and rotation inertia of key components can be acquired in the model and make for dynamics analysis.

articleTitle: Research on electromagnetic protection of mobile power station's generator
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Mobile power station is the electric source of military equipment, In order to enhance the stations' ability to fit the future war, the electromagnetic protection ability Of military mobile power station's generator should be enhanced. In this paper, the problem of electromagnetic protection of military mobile power station's generator is raised; the main electromagnetic interference causes and interference ways are analyzed, and it's pointed out that The generator suffers electromagnetic interference mainly coming from cables; the practical model of the couple of generator's stator and rotor is given; at last, the development directions of generator's electromagnetic protection are pointed out.

articleTitle: Research on static clustering for wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) are typically comprised of a large number of sensors which are randomly deployed for detecting and monitoring tasks. There are many researches about WSNs which are distributed and deployed in environments where they may not have been designed into a particular control path, and are often very dynamic. However, there are also some cases that WSNs can be controlled easily and are static in most time. In this paper, a static Clustering strategy is proposed to acquire good network performance. And an energy model of this strategy is presented to help determine the initial energy allocation of these clusters heads and nodes. At last, a simulation is presented to show how the energy allocation is determined to makes network lifetimes much longer.

articleTitle: In-situ thermal response test of the ground thermal properties for a ground source heat pump project located in the Inner Mongolia district
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Ground thermal properties are important parameters for the design of ground heat exchangers (GHE) used in ground source heat pump (GSHP). In order to estimate the ground thermal properties of site, an experimental apparatus of in-situ thermal response test (TRT) was designed and built to measure the temperature response of ground, the experimental apparatus, test methodology and data analysis method were presented in detail. Based on the apparatus and data analysis model, a test project of GSHP located in the Hohhot of Inner Mongolia has been performed to determine the site ground thermal properties. The test results indicate that for the test borehole, the ground initial temperature is about 8.9~9.2°C, the effective thermal conductivity and volumetric specific heat are 2.25 W/(m·K) and 2045 kJ/(m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>·K) respectively, and the borehole thermal resistance is about 0.133 (m·K)/W. At the same time, the voltage stabilizer and thermal insulation for exposed pipe should be used to improve test accuracy. The test data after 10 h should be selected to proceed for obtaining the results. The experimental validation shows that the thermal response experimental apparatus and analysis model proposed in this paper is feasible and can be used for the determination of ground thermal properties in the practical GSHP project.

articleTitle: Effect of electrical pulse on dynamic recrystallization of ferrite and properties of High-Carbon Chromium steel
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By taking the traditional Gleeble method as a reference, this paper studies the influence of electrical pulse (1x10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>-2x10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) on the High-Carbon Chromium steel 9Cr18 (specimens: φl0*20mm) in three heating temperatures (500°C,600°C,700°C) and three deformation amounts (10%,25%,40%). Compared with Gleeble tests in the same conditions, stress-strain curves show that the electrical pulse significantly reduces the maximum deformation resistance with the maximum decreasing amplitude 24.5% at 600°C; TEM results demonstrate that electrical pulse not only refines grain size, but also reduces the dynamic re-crystallization temperature (decreasing amplitude is about 100°C). In steel processing with pulse current in ferrite temperature range, dynamic recrystallization will occur in a lower temperature, which will reduce the deformation resistance greatly. What is more, the dynamically recrystallized grain size in this lower temperature range is smaller due to pulse current and the grain grows slowly and can be easily controlled. As a result, 1μm ultrafine grain microstructure can be obtained.

articleTitle: Applied research of bolt-inject support technology in deep coal mine extremely unstable coal roadway
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Anchor bolt and grouting combination supporting technology has both advantages of bolting support and can use grouting fissure filling surrounding rock fracture, blends anchoring, hole sealing, grouting technology for a whole, to the rock mass anchor external and grouting inside, bolt-inject form a multilayer effective combination arch and bearing load together. Anchor bolt and grouting technology adopted for extremely unstable roadway in Qinan Coalmine, control of roadway deformation successfully, and maintain roadway stability.

articleTitle: Ecological rehabilitation design of artificial river and seasonal variation of water quality In Tianjin airport economic area
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The artificial river in Tianjin airport economic area takes reclaimed water, rain floods and other unconventional sources as landscape water, six years' good operation indicates that the implementation of ecological restoration project can successfully prevent the eutrophication in reclaimed water river, overcome the difficult problem of maintaining water quality. Through site study, we sum up the main ecological restoration technology. There are reasonable layout, ecological riverbanh, aquaticanimals and plants, supplemented by artificial waterweeds and aeration techniques in serious part. We also obtain the main engineering design parameters and seasonal changes of river ecology and water quality. This is expected to provide a reference for ecological rehabilitation of similar rivers.

articleTitle: The way for process decision of generative CAPP
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The way for process decision of generative CAPP was studied in this paper, since process decision capacity determines the performance of CAPP system. Process decision problem was analyzed using hierarchical planning based on character and the basic generative CAPP process decision model was built. We use the production rules to describe the knowledge rules and propose a decision-making process by combining the knowledge rules reasoning with the case-based reasoning method. Thus, automation of the decision making process and both efficiency and quality of the process design are improved while the cycle of the process design is shorten simultaneously. This paper resolves some current problems existing in the development of CAPP system and may have a reference for the research and development of CAPP system.

articleTitle: Research on the temperature rising influence on the gas chamber length of hydro-pneumatic spring
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to phenomenon of suspension temperature rising lead to vehicle state change, a research method of gas chamber length of hydro-pneumatic spring is presented. The diagram of single barrel hydro-pneumatic spring is given. With regard to the structural feature of single barrel hydro-pneumatic spring, the system elastic force is deduce respectively according to two situations that known and unknown initial height of air chamber occurred possibly in design by using the equation of state of real gas. Meanwhile, the equation that calculates air quality in airtight container is built. The elastic characteristic of sample is tested and is compared with the analytic solution of the equation so as to validate the correctness of this research method. At the same time, the research on the influence rule relevant parameter on elastic force of hydro-pneumatic spring is developed, and the conclusion offers reference to the design of air spring.

articleTitle: Enhancement effect of microwave irradiation for treatment of low biodegradable organic wastewaters with a new combined process
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: From various aspects, enhancement effects of microwave irradiation were investigated systematically to treat various low biodegradable organic wastewaters. The results showed when microwave irradiation process was introduced to enhance coagulation and Fenton oxidation process, the degradation efficiency of organic substances was promoted greatly, and treatment time and various dosages of flocculant, oxidant and catalyzer were also reduced respectively. The mechanism discussion also indicated that microwave irradiation process brought not only the thermal efficiency but also the non-thermal efficiency, which embodied mainly the special effect of microwave electromagnetism field on the structure of organic substance. The electromagnetism field could reduce the chemical bond intensity of molecule through polarization effect, hydrogen bond distortion and activation energy change, and heighten the oxidation effect of hydroxyl radical to degrade some special refractory organics. The excellent performance of this new combined process was mostly attributed to the synergetic effect between microwave irradiation, homogeneous Fenton oxidation and coagulation process.

articleTitle: Biofiltration of waste gas containing sulfide hydrogen and toluene
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A laboratory-scale biofilter was used to treat waste gas containing sulfide hydrogen and toluene. Its performance, transformation mechanisms of substances and microbiological characteristics were investigated in this study. The inlet concentrations of sulfide hydrogen and toluene varied from 30~300 mg/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> and the inlet air flow rate was 420 L/h, equivalent to empty bed residence time of 40s. The experimental results showed that both sulfide hydrogen and toluene can be efficiently removed in the biofilter. Removal efficiency of above 93.1% for sulfide hydrogen and above 85.6% for toluene can be obtained. The main products obtained in the biodegradation process of sulfide hydrogen was sulphate and elemental sulphur, while their percentages were different at various inlet loading rates of sulfide hydrogen. There was a strong correlation between the CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> production and inlet toluene concentration. The results in microbial analysis had proven that both fungi and acidophilic thiobacilli were dominant in the biofilter in stable operation.

articleTitle: Effect study of initial stress on bearing capacity of dumbbell-shaped CFST bridge
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Steel tube may produce initial stress under the process of the steel tube concrete arch bridge construction, how old effect does it to ultimate load of stability of arch rib, so far there is nobody bringing forward the data studying concretely. According to construction steel tube concrete arch bridge, The calculation method of spatial solid-beam element which contains the initial stress was introduced to analyze the effect of initial stress on the bearing capacity of dumbbell-shaped CSFT arch bridge. According to this method, a computing program was introduced and influence of initial stress ratio, sectional steel ratio and spans were studied based on these. And result indicates that initial stress existence makes the limit bearing the weight of arch rib force lessening, maximal reach to approach 18%, In addition, a formula for the bearing capacity of dumbbell-shaped CFST arch bridge which considered the effect of initial stress was proposed.

Author Keywords: Concrete Filled Steel Tube Arch Bridge

articleTitle: Amelioraiton of triangle transport networks and its application
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By the principles of mid-point primate polarization and center of gravity primate polarization, this paper put forth two triangle networks with fractal geometry nature, i.e. (1) mid-point polarization network and (2) centre of gravity polarization network. After introducing concept of dendrite dimension, the paper determined their dendrite dimensions, suggesting that the mid-point polarization network (MPN) hold both growth-triangle advantages and optimal fractal dimension for an ideal transport network. Upon this view, this article discussed the application of MPN with an example of core urban agglomeration of Henan province, whose ideal transport network planning being given as well.

articleTitle: Research on precision testing and error compensation for B-axis of turning and milling composite machine tool
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In the paper, the error source of turning and milling composite machine tool is analyzed, and the method of improving machining precision are put forward. The positioning precision of the B-axis of the turning and milling composite machine tool is tested by laser interferometer and rotary-axis regulator. The error compensation is researched according to the test result. The result of the experiment indicates that B-axis positioning precision has satisfied the required precision of machine tools.

Author Keywords: turning and milling composite machine tool

articleTitle: Numerical simulation research on larger industrial heat exchanger
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The advantages and disadvantages of numerical simulation models for shell-and-tube heat exchanger were compared, and the experiments for small-sized shell-and-tube heat exchanger are carried out. The calculational results of whole entity model were compared with the experimental results, and the calculational results of periodic whole section model were compared with the periodic sections of the whole entity model, and the validity of the periodic whole section model was verified. The numerical simulation of the large-scale heat exchanger are carried out using the periodic whole section model, and the calculational results show that when the baffle pitch and flow rate increase twice, the temperature difference, the average heat transfer coefficient and the pressure drop are all increased, and the errors of the temperature difference, the average heat transfer coefficient are within 5%, and the error of the pressure drop is 10.75%.

articleTitle: Almost surely asymptotic stability of neutral stochastic neural networks with multiple time-varying delays
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we study the almost surely asymptotic stability of neutral stochastic neural networks with multiple time-varying delays. By using Lyapunov-Krasovskii and linear matrix inequality approach, we obtain some sufficient conditions to ensure the stability of neutral stochastic neural networks. The results are show to be generalizations of some previously published results and are less conservative than existing results.

articleTitle: Study on the properties of sea sand concrete
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Sea sand concrete is a kind of concrete in which mixed sea sand as fine aggregate, which is large-scale application in the coastal areas in recent years, especially in Ningbo area. The sea sand solves the problem of river sand shortage, coupled with cheaper price, most of the ready-mixed concrete companies are willing to use desalted sea sand instead of river sand. Many companies even are using sea sand without any treatments. The history of using sea sand in our country is very short, so the durability of the sea sand concrete need to be tested by many projects in the future, along with the development of science and technology and the invention of precision instruments, the durability of sea sand concrete will be adequate assurance. Ningbo area has a wide range usage of sea sand concrete. By measuring the strength of sea sand concrete with fly ash, finding out the law of strength for the sea sand concrete by the presence of fly ash.At the same time, we used electron scanner to analysis the sea sand concrete internal microstructure, researched the influence of chlorine salts on sea sand concrete micro-structural features.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Bertoni-Walfisch propagation model for mobile radio
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: some theoretical and experimental models have been considered for the prediction of the path loss in mobile communications system. However, one knows that in real environment, the received signal is subject to variations. In general, the Bertoni-Walfisch model used foresees path loss when the height of building is vary or the center-center spacing of the rows of the building is vary. A new extension of this model is made in this work, which consists of simulating some of its parameters as the two parameters are random variables. Finally, this paper has given comparison between measured data and this model.

articleTitle: Development and trend of high-speed hydrodynamic and hydrostatic hybrid spindle unit
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: High-speed hydrodynamic and hydrostatic hybrid spindle unit is a new product of spindle in recent years, and it is the most promising high-speed spindle product to be developed with our own intellectual property and brand in the field of high speed spindle in China. By researching in the current development in high-speed hydrodynamic and hydrostatic hybrid spindle unit and the technology involved, this article explores the shortcomings of the technology of high-speed hydrodynamic and hydrostatic hybrid spindle unit, coming up with the trend of development of high-speed hydrodynamic and hydrostatic hybrid spindle unit.

Author Keywords: hydrodynamic and hydrostatic hybrid spindle unit

articleTitle: Wetland area classification and accuracy evaluation of Poyang Lake based on remote sensing
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper was primarily conducted to probe into the method and approach which could improve classification accuracy of wetland, made experiment of the computer automatic classification methods to Landsat TM Image covering Poyang Lake wetland. In experiment firstly used unsupervised classification to remote sensing image, made progress of manual work interpreted to make certain their attributes, then transformed their outcome to the file of classification cyclostyle, and then carried out supervised classification, it indicated that the classification precision of Poyang Lake wetland was improved through these means.

articleTitle: Research of auto NVH material performance and noise reduction effect
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The NVH material is widely used on a vehicle as one of important means to improve auto NVH performance. The composition, operational mechanism, application area and performance features of three NVH materials such as damping, strengthening and sound absorption material are discussed in this paper. Moreover, specific application of three materials is introduced in combination with some vibration-damping and noise-reducing methods on some prototypes.

articleTitle: A study on comparison of atmospheric temperature profiles
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Remote sensed images provide useful information of the atmosphere. The aim of this study is to introduce the temperature profile of the atmosphere from Moderate-resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS), and compare it with the Thermodynamic Initial Guess Retrieval (TIGR) data set, the atmospheric temperature profile from Second Simulation of the Satellite Signal in the Solar Spectrum (6S), and the U.S. standard atmosphere in 1962 (US62). The result illustrates the capability of remote sensed images in atmospheric temperature profile retrieval, which is important when there is no previous information or sample data set of atmospheric temperature available. However, the comparison also indicates that the validity of atmospheric temperature profile needs to be improved much more.

articleTitle: The design for data collection terminal based on 32-bit Atmel
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: 32-bit Atmel chip is a RISC micro-controller, which is several times faster than conventional CISC structure in both instruction and data throughput. The chip has very rich analog and digital peripheral, and has FLASH memory and system-programmable EEPROM, which greatly improve the flexibility and eliminate the bottleneck of accessing to external memory, and improve the security for program and data. Using it in data collection terminal can make a good rewarding.

articleTitle: Research on the 4-axis numerical control flame cutting machine for practice teaching
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The 4-axis numerical control flame cutting machine for teaching is designed base on an idle lathe, the machine will be used for practical teaching in cutting complex intersecting curve of steel pipe.The mathematical model of intersection curve for two axes intersecting vertically is introduced in the paper,and the algorithm of track controlling is designed .The design of track controlling software for pipe intersection curve cutting by means of visual basic 6.0. The result of test shows that the algorithm of track controlling and the software of track controlling are correct.The result of research can provide the equipment for practice teaching, so students's capacity of applying theory to reality can be trained effectively,and students can easily know how to develop numerical control equipment.The machine is designed based on the idle lathe, consequently, the cost of machine made is reduced much.

articleTitle: Study on stability of geogrids-reinforced high embankment
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to study stability of geogrids-reinforced high embankment, by indoor direct shear test and pull-off test respectively, interface properities between geogrids and stuffing were studied. The study results indicate that: the variation of water content of stuffing have great influence on geogrids-reinforced high embankment, along with increasing of water content of stuffing, the frictional resistance of reinforced soil interface decreases gradually, relative displacement of reinforced soil increases, soil shear strength decreases, thus it makes that the stable safety coefficient of geogrids-reinforced high embankment shows downtrend.

articleTitle: Strengthening effect analysis of lightweight aggregate concrete restrained by steel tube
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based the test results of lightweight aggregate concrete-filled steel stub columns with square section and circular section, strengthening effect of lightweight aggregate concrete restrained by steel tube was studied. Various parameters influence to strengthening coefficient of lightweight aggregate concrete was analyzed. Different concrete and steel stub section were compared. The results show that the strengthening coefficient increases as the lightweight aggregate concrete strength and width (diameter) to thickness ratio increase, and as the steel ratio and confining coefficient decrease. The strengthening coefficient of lightweight aggregate concrete is higher than normal aggregate concrete's. And the square one is also higher than the circular one.

articleTitle: Development of multi-axis stepper motion control system based on nios II
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to the present problem that the motion control system of stepper motor use the structure of micro controller unit (MCU) and complex programmable logic device (CPLD). This method has some disadvantages such as high cost and complex circuit. To improve these problems, the stepper motor control system based on Nios II is developed. The FPGA is the core of the system and Nios II is created in its internal. Nios II implements the function of the speed control and interpolation algorithm and the communication between the computer and FPGA. The system has characteristics of small size, high integration, high stability and flexibility.

articleTitle: An analysis of the dispersive features of Galerkin meshfree formulation for shear deformable beam
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A dispersion analysis is presented for the Galerkin meshfree formulation of shear deformable beam problem. The meshfree formation employed herein is based on the method of stabilized conforming nodal integration. This formulation can exactly reproduce the bending exactness and more importantly is locking-free. The dispersion analysis is carried out by expressing the nodal variables in a harmonic form. Subsequently by substituting the nodal variables into the meshfree semi-discretized equation the characteristic equation can be rationally established. Thereafter the numerical frequency can be obtained from the characteristic equation. The dispersion performance of the present formulation is compared with those based on the methods of Gauss integration and direct nodal integration. Numerical results show that the present formulation has the most favorable dispersion performance.

articleTitle: The structure and flow field analysis for a new static and dynamic combined high efficient mixer
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A new static and dynamic combined high efficient mixer, which combines the advantages of static mixer and dynamic mixing agitator, with the structure of alternative connection of the helical stationary blade, transition element and rotary blade wheel, is original designed by the author. The eddy flow is formed out of two-phase flow by the stationary blade and the hetero blade wheel is driven by the eddy flow. Meanwhile, the mixture degree of the two-phase flow is improved by the shearing action. The most characteristic design is: applied force is not required, therefore the energy is saved and the mixture efficiency is enhanced. Followed by the illustration of the structure, the preliminary analysis of the two-phase flow field is carried out, which provides some proofs for the selection and optimization of the static and dynamic combined high efficient mixer structural parameters.

articleTitle: Study on the effect of hydrolysis acidification for divisional influent ABR
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The experimentation adopted anaerobic baffled reactor (ABR) which has four compartments, and the reactor with influent ratio of 4∶3∶2∶1. The effect of hydrolysis acidification was studied by divisional influent that compared with the single influent of the anaerobic baffled reactor. The results show that the effluent of divisional influent were more formic acid and acetic acid than single influent, and the divisional influent may improve the COD removal efficiency and increase the ability of hydrolysis acidification of ABR.

articleTitle: Script files analysis and parameterization operation of GT-POWER
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: From the model established, running and the data post-processing, the operation of GT POWER is in GT-ISE and the method is simple and efficient. In order to solve the problem of reducing repeat work in GT-POWER operation, intuitively correspond and alter of the model parameter also and the secondary development of software and modularization of background of software development which is accord the specific needs of engine design. This paper will give a detailed analysis of running and the scripting data of GT POWER. On this basis, a model of single cylinder diesel engines is established to specifically explain this new idea. First using other software to mapping and replace the data of script file, and write a program to startup GT, then compared the calculated results and make a simple interface with software, make its intuitive convenience. It is useful to the new software development which is accord to the special requirements of customers.

articleTitle: System dynamic analysis for motor car-Influence of wheel tread reprofiling
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to learn influence of wheel tread reprofiling on dynamics behaviors of high speed electric motor car, wheel tread worn and dynamics characteristics of motor car was studied before and after wheel tread reprofiling. Experimental results show: The maximum vibration acceleration of axle housing was significantly reduced after wheel tread reprofiling, the influence of wheel tread reprofiling on the maximum vibration acceleration of bogie frame, air spring, car body was not significant, the main vibration frequency components of axle housing, bogie frame, air spring, car body were changed and some high frequency vibration components were significantly reduced after wheel tread reprofiling, the capacity of vibration isolation of primary & secondary suspension was perfect before wheel tread reprofiling and was much better after wheel tread reprofiling, and the lateral stability of motor car was slightly improved after wheel tread reprofiling.

articleTitle: Research on hydrophilicity and hydrophobicity of adsorption of NOM on metal oxide/ water interface in different pH values
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The hydrophobicity before and after humic acid's adsorption on Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> nanoparticles in various solution conditions was investigated with FTIR spectrum and thermogravimetric analysis methods. The results showed that, when the ionic strength was kept at 0, 0.005, 0.01 and 0.05mol/kg and pH value was changed from 7 to 12, the thermal weight loss of the complex, which formed after the adsorption of nano Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> and the dissolved humic acid molecules, decreased at first and then increased as the pH value increased. The hydrophilicity reduced and hydrophobicity enhanced when the pH value increased from 7 to 10, while the hydrophilicity enhanced and hydrophobicity reduced when the pH value increased from 10 to 12. When the ionic strength was 0.001mol/kg, and pH value was changed from 7 to 12, the thermal weight loss of the complex decreased as the pH value increased, which provided the evidence that the hydrophilicity reduced and hydrophobicity enhanced. The FTIR spectrum results indicated that the functional groups, which played a significant role in the hydrophilicity and hydrophobicity of the complex after adsorption process of nano Fe<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> and the dissolved humic acid molecules, might be hydrophilic hydroxyl-OH, carbonyl C=0 and the hydrophobic alkane CH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>.

articleTitle: Reconstruction of the village PPP project risk analysis and risk allocation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: PPP model is expected to solve the difficulty of finance in city village reconstruction. The risk of PPP project during its implementation becomes the key question of common concern for all the participants. There are more risks than common projects in PPP projects. The risk will be particularly analysed and the tactics of risk allocation will be effectively brought forward in the city village reconstruction PPP project to put forward an ecosystem evaluation index system.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: INS/GPS integrated navigation technique for intelligent vehicles
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Performance-based design of smoke control strategy for an urban traffic tunnel fire
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To ensure the safe evacuating environment in an urban traffic tunnel fire, the performance based design of smoke control strategy was applied in this paper. A preliminary design of the smoke control strategy was evaluated by using the software FDS. By analyzing the distribution of the temperature and visibility around the fire source, it was found that the preliminary strategy could not satisfy the requirement for the evacuation. After modifying the preliminary strategy, the smoke control effects and evacuation results were simulated and analyzed again. The results indicate that the improved strategy could successfully control the movement of the smoke and provide desirable evacuating environment.

articleTitle: Analysis of optimization operation for ultra-supercritical pressure generating units
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Main parts of the unit bears great temperature variation when turbine starts up, shuts down or operates under shaving peaking, which generates alternating thermal stress in rotator. The turbine operation experience indicates that alternating thermal stress is the key fact influencing ability of turbine to adapt to load variation and span loss. To a considerable degree, low cycle thermal fatigue span of the turbine stands for span of the whole unit, thus thermal calculation and monitor of turbine rotator is of great importance.
