This paper analyzes features of 600MW usc turbine unit in Hanshan power plant, calculates thermal parameter and heat transfer coefficient under load varioation in each level, and adopts finite element method to simulates temperature field and stress field when shuts down, to find out dangerous moments and points, as reference to guide turbine operation when shuts down.

articleTitle: Finite element analysis and strength calculation of steel-plate silo
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper, the strength of the steel plate silo is calculated according to the relevant design specification. The finite element software SAP2000 is used to model and analysis the silo base on the finite element method. The results based on the two methods are compared and the good agreements can be obtained, indicating that the finite element model is correct.

articleTitle: The effect of electric current on coupling temperature field of stainless steel/copper under friction and wear
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The coupling temperature field for aluminum stainless steel composite conductor rail/ collector shoe was simulated by finite element software ANSYS, the maximum coupled temperature changing under different current (150~600 A) and constant side distance(0.27m) was studied. The results show that, with the increasing of current, the maximum coupled temperature almost keeps unchanging when the relative sliding velocity is 120 km/h and normal force is 150 N; the maximum coupled temperature keeps unchanging at firstly and then rises when relative sliding velocity is 120km/h and normal force is 120N; In the other conditions, the maximum coupled temperature rises with the increasing of current.

articleTitle: Research for cylindricity prediction model of inner-hole honing
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the stroke length, honing pressure on the influence law of the inner-hole honing cylindricity, and presents a method of the development of cylindricity prediction model based on the response surface methodology. The paper uses central composite face-centered design methodology to design the test, and variance analyses is applied to check the fitting degree of the prediction model. According to analyzing the effect and edge effect of various processing factors, Knowing about the stroke length influences the inner-hole honing cylindricity more than the honing pressure.

articleTitle: Formulation of river health index and its application to the upper reach of minjiang river
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the analysis of the characteristic index system of river health prevailing in other countries, a formula to calculate the river health's index in five different aspects, i. e. hydrology, river morphology, condition of riparian zone, water environment and aquatic organisms was brought forth. A four-grade evaluation system including “healthy, sub-healthy, morbid, deteriorative” was founded on this formula. The evaluation system for river health was adopted to estimate the river health status of the upper reach of minjiang river. This evaluation result of river health conforms to the reality of the upper reach of minjiang river, and the development of hydropower station had brought enormous influence to the upper reach of minjiang river.

articleTitle: Control research on broken coal-wall and roof in the complex geological conditions
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Through analyzing the methane geologic data in fully mechanized mining face of the Tonghua Babao mine, based on practical application in the complex geological conditions of fully-mechanized mining In the domestic, on the basis of the characteristics of broken coal-wall and roof in fully-mechanized mining face, and analyzing chemical grouting reinforcement mechanism, the specific coal-wall and roof reinforcing schemes are made respectively.The paper detailedly introduce two kinds of anchor structure, installation method and process parameters. In the process of mining, effectively prevent working face for large pieces of damage of coal-wall and roof, thereby, for the first fully-mechanized working face in Babao mine safe and efficient production well provide security.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Developments trend of new infrared detectors domestic and abroad
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study of FPGA technology applied for stepping motor subdivision drive
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Limited by the manufacture technics, the stepping motor has big step angles and low frequency vibration, and can only be applied to those situations with low demand. This paper designs a method to realize subdivision drive for the stepping motor based on FPGA chip. Firstly, PWM control waveform data table are stored in embedded memory module of FPGA. Secondly, multiple PWM control signals are produced by the digital comparator synchronously. Finally, we realize subdivision control for the step angles of stepping motor. Test result shows that the stepping motor subdivision drive technology can decrease the stepping angle of stepping motor, improve the stabilization and flexibility and has preferable practical value.

articleTitle: Inner boundary conditions of mindlin plate with a finite-length part-through crack
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the inner boundary conditions of a simply supported rectangular Mindlin plate with a finite-length Part-through crack is first obtained. The part-through crack on the plate surface having an arbitrary length and depth is assumed to be open, non-propagating and parallel to one side of the plate. Based on Mindlin plate theory and Hamilton theory, we got the governing equations of motion. Then, the rectangular plate is decomposed into two domains and an artificial spring with a varying stiffness along the crack is used to describe the elastic behavior of the plate at the interconnection boundaries between two domains. We got the strain energy release rate (G) through the stress intensity factor (K). Then, the rotary discontinuity condition is acquired. After complex derivation, we obtained the inner boundary conditions of rectangular cracked Mindlin Plate.

articleTitle: Construction and application of water flow chart in steel rolling process
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the work flow of steel rolling process, the water flow chart was built and its valuation index of water-use was confirmed by using the tracking observation principle of the material flow analysis theory combined with medium and small cycle theory of system energy conservation. The water-use status of steel rolling process was analyzed. A case study on a plant, its water-using situation and the deficiencies of water system were analyzed and evaluated. Through optimizing: the amount of new industrial water decreases by 0.159m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/t(steel), efflux wastewater decreases by 0.286 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/t(steel), water resource efficiency increases by 70.32, water environmental efficiency increases by 73.58t/ m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>.

articleTitle: Analysis and determination of water level control system of boiler drum
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper has discussed the popular method of control and deeply analyzed the dynamic and static characteristics of the water level based on analyzing the main factors influencing the water level of drum. This paper begins with the balance of heat and substance of water in boiler's bubble and educes the universal mechanism controlling model to describe the water level of boiler and studies the character of control model of three pulse. Through an analysis of several kinds of control schemes, study and compare, select impulse three systems as the optimum control scheme, put forth effort to study the characteristic of impulse three systems.

articleTitle: The study of driver's starting intentions
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A driver's intention may be affected by a number of sources such as the driver's current control actions, their visual scanning behavior, and the traffic environment. In this paper, research interest is focused on the driver's starting intentions of a passenger car equipped with Automatic Mechanical Transmission (AMT) or Dual Clutch Transmission (DCT). It is found that basically, the driver's kinesthetic sense is the acceleration, but not the speed. Therefore, a dynamic model for the driveline is proposed according to engine test data and vehicle general parameters in order to analyze the influence of the pedal opening, the first and the second derivatives on the starting intentions. The orthogonal test design is applied to treat the variables and their combinations for the driver decision making in the launching. It is demonstrated by the numerical results that sequences of the factors have different effects on starting intentions, but the effects of interaction of the factors can be ignored.

articleTitle: The research of demarcation for bogie force-measuring frame of high-speed locomotive
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper focuses mainly on the general method of load demarcation for bogie force-measuring frame of high-speed locomotives. Taking 200km/h high-speed electric locomotive bogie frame as the case-study subject, force systems of force-measuring frame are decomposed into five basic force series: floating-sinking dynamic load, roll dynamic load, lateral dynamic load, torsion dynamic load and motor dynamic load. Then the load modes and load values are established. Based on the symmetry and anti-symmetry of structure and five types of loads, a suitable bridging form of frame load demarcation is selected. Therefore, schemes of dynamic load demarcation are analyzed and confirmed finally.

articleTitle: State of the art of researches on racking performance of post and beam timber construction
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Post and beam construction is suitable for modern wooden building because of its excellent performance and aesthetic appearance. It can be classified as mortise-tenon connection system, dowel type connection system and glued-in rods connection system according to connection types. A literature review of researches on racking performance of post and beam timber constructions over last two decades was presented in this paper. It is shown that the main efforts and contributions of the researchers focused on the performance of moment connections. The points of future research works were proposed for the development of ductile and high-strength connections, post and beam constructions and hybrid system with post and beam frames and light frame shearwalls.

articleTitle: Analysis of fire resistance of portal steel frame structure under different connections
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper makes finite element analysis of fire resistance under different connections for portal steel frames. Fire protection not apply on the secondary beam, there are two ways of girder-column's connection to calculate: beam connection, and pin connection. The results of the analysis indicate that the mechanical behavior of steel frames in fire conditions is dominated by the effects of thermal loading, thermal expansion and thermal gradient. The overall deformation of pin connection is larger than it of beam connection, and the stress suffered by beam structure is bigger than pin structure. When the overall beam steel frames' connection is taken by local pin connection, the stress of structure will reduce, helping to ensure strength and stability of steel structures. The deformation of the girder can be reduced when the beam connection is taken place by pin connection. The conclusion provides a reference for structural engineers on fire resistant design of steel frame.

articleTitle: The tactics of architecture education under the contemporary cultural environment
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper expounds the tactics of architecture education in China under the contemporary cultural environment. It is said that we should cultivate the students to possess the Philosophy and the Art qualities, with which they would not be restricted with many regulations and would design the real shock-hearted great works.

articleTitle: Chemical evolution of mesons in hadronic matter
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: We derive a set of rate equations describing the chemical equilibration of pions, rho mesons, kaons, and vector kaons, and discuss their consequences for meson equilibration in heavy ion collisions. The evolution of hadronic matter is then described by a kinetic model that takes into account mesons absorption and regeneration. The fugacity of pion decreases while the fugacity of rho, kaon, and vector kaon increase with increasing time. The quark-interchange process plays an very important role in the evolvement of hadronic matter.

articleTitle: The nonlinear compensation of output frequency of the I/F converter
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: I / F converter are the circuit which can convert the current signal to the linear proportional frequency signal [1]. Actually due to various reasons there are some non-linear elements in the circuit. Paper use ADI's ADuc847 processors as the main chip, and add the appropriate compensation circuit as peripheral circuits to compensate the non-linear elements. Firstly we sample the input and output data. Then we process the data by Matlab to obtain the compensation formula. Finally, we program to realize the compensation by the compensational circuit.

articleTitle: The research about ingredient of biaxial orientation pipe and the online detection of orientation by ultrasonic
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Research about the ingredient of biaxial orientation pipe and discuss the online detection of molecular orientation by ultrasonic. Identified the dosage of the main additives and influence to the material properties by orthogonal experiment; Calibrate the ultrasonic velocity that perpendicular to the oriented direction of the sample by infrared dichroism, then found a good linear relationship between them, illustrate it is a feasible measurement for the molecular orientation of the samples online by ultrasonic. Calibrate the ultrasonic velocity with infrared dichroism by the PVC-O material introduced by this paper, further illustration that this is a feasible and generic method Finally, discuss the influence of the relaxation to the molecular orientation.

articleTitle: Composition-dependent properties of MgxZn1−xO films by sputtering
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The properties of Mg<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Zn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1−x</inf>O films dependent on composition were studied in this paper. The experiment showed that the composition of films prepared by sputtering was affected by ambient condition and annealing temperature. The increasing Mg content was in favor of increasing crystal quality of films, and didn't change the wurtzite structure of films. The band gap changed between 3.4 and 4.0 eV, which was dependent on Mg content in films and consistent well with the previous reported theory on alloyed films. These results above showed that Mg<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>Zn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1−x</inf>O films by sputtering could be used as barrier layers in ZnO-based heterostructures.

articleTitle: The sweeping spectrum range and the instantaneous frequency estimation of the nonlinear chirp signal
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes a method to accurately estimate sweeping spectrum range and the instantaneous frequency of the nonlinear chirp signal. Considering the lack of study in nonlinear chirp signal, we utilize SPWVD to analyze the non-linear chirp signal, then obtain the time-frequency distribution. The transferred results are utilized to estimate the sweeping spectrum range and the instantaneous frequency, with the use of curve fitting tool. Simulation results are well consistent with our expectation.

articleTitle: The research of silicon carbide rod heat control based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper a method was introduced to control the heating process of silicon carbide rod by SCR based on PLC in that they exhibit strengths of silicon carbide rod heating and prolong the life of silicon carbide rod. This system can realize precise temperature control and automatic temperature control in according to the furnace heating curves, prolonging the life of the elements and stove, saving energy and promote efficiency, improving product quality.

articleTitle: Quantitative Analysis of combined effect of multiple factors on CO2 internal corrosion in gas gathering pipeline
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: There are a number of factors affecting CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> internal corrosion in gas gathering pipelines and there exist the interaction and constraints between these factors affecting corrosion. For this reason, the qualitative analysis of combined effect of multiple factors on internal corrosion in the gas gathering pipeline using improved interpretative structural modeling is carried out in the paper, comprehensively searching factors affecting CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> internal corrosion in gas gathering pipeline, analyzing of the relevance between factors affecting internal corrosion of pipeline, and identifying the logic relationship among the direct and indirect factors affecting internal corrosion of pipeline to lay a good foundation for the best corrosion control measures. And then the quantification of various factors affecting corrosion is done by combining with Analytical Hierarchy Process (AHP) , to identify the relative importance of the factors affecting internal corrosion of gas gathering pipeline in quantitative way through comparison , Which will provide more reasonable reference of quantitative decision making for the future pipeline corrosion control and integrity management.

articleTitle: Open NC system design based on embedded flexible manufacturing system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Embedded FMS has many advantages, such as control flexibility, simplicity, good real-time, low cost etc. Open CNC system integrated embedded FMS can solve the existing problems between traditional NC system and industrialized production of NC application software. This paper adopts the structure of "NC embedded PC type", designed an open CNC system based on the IPC and movement control card. The open CNC system was integrated into the embedded FMS through the Ethernet. It provides a good foundation for CNC system network, and makes it more easily to control the NC machining unit in the FMS. It is adapt to the requirements of the industrial development for NC technology of network.

articleTitle: Design of a trial undulator applied in THz radiation source
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The undulator is the key component in the THz radiation source based on FEL. According to the theory, we proposed the basic requirements of the undulator. We will create a trial undulator in order to verify the feasibility of these requirements, and accumulate the experience. With the use of the finite element calculation software OPERA3D, we modify the structural parameters of the undulator gradually to meet the requirements of the peak, width of the good field and first integration. We also prove that the correnction magnet could make the field meet the requirement of the second integration.

articleTitle: Phylogenetic analysis and Biodegradation characteristics of a kind of Normal foam agents degradation bacterium
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A kind of Normal foam agents' degradation bacterium is separated from Foam flooding injection allocation standing in Shengli oilfield by Hungate technology. Through appraisal result of Form, Physiology and biochemistry and Molecular biology, Bacterial strain is G<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>, Short sindbis, Sporeless, Obligate anaerobes. Similarity is 99% between the bacterial strain and Clostridium bifermentans. We name the bacterial strain as Clostridium bifermentans DY. The results show that: the degradation of this bacterial strain to foam agent is 82.8%, the bacterial strain is with foam agent as the only carbon source, the biochemical sex of foam agent is higher than 0.4. From Ht, we can see that the surface texture and the functional group change a lot after this bacterial strains role.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Parametric design research of cam drive mechanism
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Development and application of the wireless transmission device in field data
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to transmit the field data to the monitoring center and monitor the production process in real time, the characteristics of field instruments signal are analyzed, a all-purpose wireless transmission device for field data is designed, which is developed based on MSP430 Microcontroller. For the sake of acquiring the field data and not disturbing instrument signal to transmit to the original control system at the same time, a signal distribution module is designed. The general interface that is used for different kinds of field instruments is developed. Experimental results show that this device has the characteristics of high accuracy, low power consumption and stable performance in the process of transmitting field data. Therefore, this device has very good application prospect.

articleTitle: Preparation and characterization of activated pyrolytic tire char
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Pyrolytic tire char was used to prepare activated carbon by steam. The effects of such factors as pretreatment, activation temperature, rate of water vapor and activation time upon the adsorption properties of AC have been investigated. The prepared activated pyrolytic tire char were characterized by N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> physisorption, XRD, FT-IR and elemental analyses. The optimum process parameters and listed as follows: activation temperature 800°C, the rate of water vapor 2g/min, activation time 2h.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of impact of the upstream discharge on salinity at Qingcaosha reservoir
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Saline intrusion in the Yangtze River Estuary has been an unavoidable problem which has a direct impact on water intakes for Shanghai's public drinking, industrial and agricultural usage. By using the Delft3D model, a numerical model is set up for simulation of saltwater intrusion in the Yangtze River estuary. This model is used to study the saltwater intrusion and to predict the salinity changes around Qingcaosha reservoir under the different upstream flow discharge conditions, which related with the operations of the South to North Water Transfer and the Three Gorges. Finally, this paper presents the functional relationships between the salinity at the water intakes of the Qingcaosha reservoir and the fresh water discharge of the Yangtze River and gives out an alarming flow rate of 9,000m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/s at Datong gauging station to prevent the Qingcaosha reservoir from the salt water intrusion.

articleTitle: FPGA-based design on control circuit of electricity-powered toy car
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The design on control system of electricity-powered toy car is one of the main elements at every undergraduate competition on electronic design. Traditionally, the control circuit is MCU-based, while this paper conducts a research work on FPGA platform. FPGA-based circuit has both rich logic resources and a high speed of working frequency, therefore it can provide a more reliable performance for the toy car compared with the traditional control circuit.

articleTitle: Design of low cost low power home independent photovoltaic power system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to solve the difficult problem of electricity in remote areas, we design a low cost, low power, home solar power system. The system mainly consists of buck-boost circuit, UC3906 intelligent battery charging circuit , an unidirectional high-frequency link inverter and STC12C5410AD single chip. STC12C5410AD single chip realizes the functions of detecting the circuit voltage,monitoring battery Performance and producing various feedback control signals . The system has the characteristics of simple circuit, low cost, high efficiency, stable and reliable .

articleTitle: Field testing study of deep soil displacement distribution during shield excavation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In the construction of urban rail transit (URT), how to predict and control the deep soil displacement caused by shield excavation to ensure the safety of existed underground structures is a larger problem during designs and constructions nowadays. Taking the shield construction of line 15 as the research background, this article adapted the method of field test to study the deep soil displacement distribution rule in the direction of shield advancing when the shield is excavating. Except the central measuring points of the shield, the other points ranging between 28.8m and 7.2m from cutting wheel to exterior protected construction indicates that, soil displacement direction is much the same as the excavation direction; and the displacement distribution curve relatively coincides with linear curve; while the displacement direction in the center of the shield is opposite to excavation direction,and the displacement distribution relatively coincides with linear curve from ground surface to the top of the shield, and relatively coincides with normal distribution curve from the the top of shield to the deep area of measuring points, all the measuring points ranging from 7.2m to 3.6m shows that the direction of soil displacement is the same with the excavation direction and with the increasing of shield excavation displacement, the displacement distribution can better coincides with the normal distribution curve, and the maximum displacement point is just in the center of shield or lm above the shield.

articleTitle: A novel multi-strategy cognitive routing
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The cognitive routing can collect the network information, analyze the information and make the routing decision. A multi strategy cognitive routing will choose the routing strategy adaptively by different network environment. In this paper, a cognitive multi strategy routing with QoS constraint and load balance is proposed. If the payload of network is light, parameters of QoS performance, such as bandwidth and delay, should be emphasized to guarantee. The load balance would be taken more attention, while the payload is heavy. As the simulation results show, the proposed cognitive multi-strategy routing protocol offers a better performance of delay and throughput.

articleTitle: Theoretical study on characteristics of clipping for different layered structure
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the classification and analysis for different layered structures and layered materials, the characteristics of clipping of them were deep systematically analyzed in theory. The relation between layout and effectivity of them was discussed after being compared, and the laws of relatively effective layout were presented. The conclusion of the study may be helpful for designing the layered structures or layered materials in design of protective engineering and impact-resistance materials.

articleTitle: Characteristic of combustion noise in a non-road diesel engine fueled with bio-diesel
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To investigate the characteristic of combustion noise in a non-road diesel engine, tests with different bio-diesel ratio fuel were conducted. According to the cylinder pressures of 100 consecutive combustion cycles, combustion noise was analyzed. The results show that, with the increase of blended bio-diesel ratio, both the maximum cylinder pressure and the maximum rate of pressure rise all have increasing trends. The cylinder pressure level at frequency of 1000 Hz increases with blended bio-diesel ratio. In the test with B50 fuel, the biggest value of combustion noise appears and its value is about 0.5 dB(A) bigger than that of diesel at full load. The blending of bio-diesel has a dual effect on combustion noise which contributes to the increase of combustion noise and the reduction of it. At the same time, advance angle of fuel supply has great influence on combustion noise of diesel engine fueled with bio-diesel and fuel supply delay can properly reduce combustion noise of diesel engine effectively.

articleTitle: Study on control strategy of starting process for clutch of AMT vehicle
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The control strategy of cultch engagement process for AMT vehicle starting stage was researched in this paper, and the control strategy of multi-stages which developed based on fuzzy-control was introduced. The initial-starting stage, starting-accelerate stage and tend to synchronous stage of clutch was controlled in fuzzy closed-loop. In order to increase the control accuracy, the control parameters were optimized respectively, and a reasonable fuzzy control rule base was designed. An electronic-control system based on Freescale MC9S12DT128 microcontroller was developed. Bench test was taken on the first gear and second gear, the results show that: or the jerk and friction work of the engagement process is in allowable range, the vehicle can be started quickly and smoothly.

articleTitle: Optimizing of operation parameters in EDI process by orthogonal test method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In recent years, electrode ionization technology has been widely used for ultrapure water production. The effects of major operational parameters such as feed hardness, dilute flux and stack voltage on dilute product resistivity and scaling extend were investigated through an orthogonal experiment(L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sub>(3)<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>). The factorial results of Design-Expert software revealed that the interaction of dilute flux and stack voltage influenced the dilute product resistivity most significantly, while the single factor of stack voltage was the main influencing factor on the scaling index (SI), which was proposed to quantify the scaling extend. It was found that dilute product resistivity maximization (16.38 MΩ·cm) and scaling index minimization can be achieved when feed hardness, dilute flux and stack voltage were 3.9 mg/L (as CaCO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>), 21 L/h and 14V, respectively, which can be used for designing and operating a large scale process.

articleTitle: Development of the solar evaporation-dehumidification cooling system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Solar evaporation dehumidification cooling system makes use of low-grade solar energy as heat resource, and its development and utilization for energy conservation and emissions reduction is of great significance. A new cooling prototype composed of evaporation dehumidification cooling device (i.e. air dehumidification device, indirect and direct evaporation cooling device) and solar energy regenerator (i.e. solar energy collector, desiccant regenerator) was designed and developed. Experimental prototype had been tested for 3 years in summer in Jinyun county, Zhejiang province, China. The results showed that the outdoor air could be cooled to 17 °C(dry ball temperature) at the condition of 35 °C and 50-60% relative moisture, and moisture content in air was dehumidified from 22 g/kg to 10 g/kg. EER<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> and EER<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> of the evaporation dehumidification cooling device could achieve 12.03 and 0.99, respectively. Solar energy consumption was 92% and electricity consumption was only 8% of the cooling energy consumption. In the solar energy regenerator, air moisture content increment between inlet and outlet could reach 50.4 g/kg and regeneration efficiency was 58%. In general solar energy utilization rate in the whole system was 76.5%. It was concluded that this solar evaporative dehumidification cooling system achieved expected performance, and that established research foundation of solar cooling technology for large-scale application.

articleTitle: Strong convergence theorems of relaxed hybrid steepest-descent methods for variational inequalities
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: We suggest and analysis a three-step relaxed hybrid steepest-descent method for finding the solution of the variational inequalities, prove a strong convergence theorems for the method under some suitable conditions. Our result can be considered as an extension and improvement of the previously known results.

articleTitle: Fuzzy comprehensive evaluation on slag-removal system plan selection in thermo-electricity project
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Combining with the characteristics of thermo-electricity project, following the principles and methods of the evaluation index selection, this paper constructed the index system of slag-removal system plan evaluation in the thermo-electricity project from economic factors and technical factors. Taking this as the foundation, this paper then built the multistage fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model of slag-removal system plan. Finally, example of the thermo-electricity project in Xinjiang Changji is given to illustrate the scientific and impartiality of the model.

articleTitle: Variations of soil properties in succession process of Phragmites community in estuarine wetland of Panjin
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The estuarine wetland ofPanjin, Liaoning, China is an alluvial-marine plain of 5, 200 km2 in area, which was originated from a series of rivers, including Liaohe River, Shuangtaizi River, Dalinghe River, Xiaolinghe River and Daqinghe River. With the warming up of the climate and the decreasing of runoff from the upper reaches, degeneration plagues gradually arose in the Phragmites community. From the edge zone of Phragmites population, there successively arose four stripped plant populations, namely, Phragmites-Typha population, Limonium population, Suaeda population and mudflat nudation. In the community succession process, coevolution occurred in soil nutrients. Studies were carried out on variations of soil nutrients at different succession stages and different levels of the same succession stage. Results show that contents of organic matter, total nitrogen, total phosphorus and soluble salts in surface soil were all higher than those in bottom stratum; Soluble salt content in surface soil increased from Phragmites population to mudflat nudation.

articleTitle: Study of the medium-long load forecasting based on the identical dimension addition grey model
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The principle of identical dimension additional prediction was discussed based on the Grey theory in this paper. The identical dimension additional dynamic grey model in the medium-long term load forecasting had been put forward in the power system, and the annual load value in this region of 1999–2009 was forecasted by modeling on the basis of this region's historical load data. According to inspection of the posterior error and relative error caused by the forecasting results, the following could be realized. This method has the advantages of the need of less samples, the higher forecast precision, the faster calculating rate, and it is a practical medium-long term load forecasting method in the power system.

articleTitle: Levitation fluctuation constraint strategy in bearingless motor based on disturbance acceleration observation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The levitation fluctuation is unavoidable when bearingless motor is working. The motor's working performance can be affected by levitation fluctuation. It is vital to constrain the levitation fluctuation. In this paper, a kind of consequent-pole bearingless permanent magnet-type motor is studied and levitation fluctuation sources are analyzed. Because the normal levitation control algorithm PID is not good at anti-disturbance, the radial disturbance acceleration observer of motor's rotor is proposed. Based on the observed disturbance acceleration, a conception of equivalent disturbance current is proposed based on the relationship between disturbance acceleration and levitation control current. The equivalent disturbance current is introduced in levitation control to constrain levitation fluctuation. The simulation results show the proposed strategy can constrain levitation fluctuation and achieve steady operation when it is comparison with using PID controller only.

articleTitle: Development and design of paint coating's preparation system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to the powder paint coating's preparation, designed a set of powder system with micro smash and classification. Optimized the structure of the grinding machine, Used independent SLK superfine powder machine's classification. Through controlled and corresponded parameter of system. While satisfied with the product's grain-size distribution, Raised the production efficiency, Reduced the energy consumption, System performance to be stable by the trial production.

articleTitle: Analysis and research of card ticket's security based on card scraping & vending technology
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In a new card ticket scraping and vending device of TVM (Ticket Vending Machine), the interaction between the scraper and the super-thin & non-contact IC card was analyzed by FEM (Finite Element Method) in this paper. A new improved project for ticket ejecting module of TVM was proposed to overcome the defects of traditional method of vending tickets with friction wheel, which hurts the cards easily with low control accuracy. Finite element models of the scraper-ticket collision in two types were created and the structural transient of the card was analyzed. The ticket's security was verified by analyzing the maximum stress of the ticket and the deformation at the location of the chip.

articleTitle: Analysis on managers' behavior choices under the fixed wages form in state-owned enterprise
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In state-owned enterprises, managers must consider reputation strongly. Based on this premise, through the establishment of model, the paper analyzes the behavior choice of state-owned enterprise managers under the form of fixed wages, and obtains the conclusion that under the fixed wage the efforts of state enterprise managers are not zero.

articleTitle: Sustainable infrastructure under the influence of mega-events
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: From the view of sustainable development, the paper analyzes the influence of mega-events on urban infrastructure construction and sustainable development, including urban reconstruction and rational upgrade. The paper selects the city of Guangzhou as a case for in-depth analysis. Studies are focusing on the city's infrastructure development before and after the Ninth National Games, including analysis of four aspects: infrastructure investment and structural changes in the investment industry, infrastructure projects, public facilities and open space, and public transport facilities. It aims to reveal the gradual influence of mega-events on urban infrastructure, and to reflect on the relationship between them.

articleTitle: Dynamic characteristics of a space structure composed of annular tensile cable-truss structure and single layer lattice shell
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A new type of space structure combined with annular tensile cable-truss structure and single layer lattice shell is introduced. The annular tensile cable-truss structures with rigid bars instead of stable cables could be covered by the rigid roofing material. Ribbed composite spatial structures composed of cable-truss structure and single layer lattice shell was taken as an example and its dynamic characteristics under full-span load and half-span load were analyzed by block Lanczos method. The effect of prestress level and load level on dynamic behavior of the structure was studied. The results are valuable for the dynamic response research on the earthquakes and wind vibration and will provide a reference for a further design and project application of such structure.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on technology of prevention outburst with uncovering coal rapidly in Cross-cut in severe Outburst Coal seam
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Direct torque control of permanent magnet synchronous motor based on second order sliding mode
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Direct torque control system of permanent magnet synchronous motor based on second order sliding mode speed controller is introduced to solve the problem that flux linkage and rectangular pulse are both too big in the direct torque control of permanent magnet synchronous motor, it is difficult to control at low speed. This method not only makes the state of system converge in limited time, decreases the torque at a low speed and lessens the flux linkage ripples, but also has strong robust to system parameters and external interference. Besides, the vibration in sliding mode control is eliminated effectively. The simulation results show the efficiency of the control stratagem proposed in the paper.

articleTitle: Analysis on vibration and vibration-elimination of nuclear-powered pipe
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Some pipe lines of a nuclear power plant exists serious vibration that seriously affected the normal production safety. By the spectral analysis of measured time domain signal, the main vibration frequency of the pipe lines was obtained. The model analysis was processed with pipe stress analysis software CAESAR II. The natural frequency was found. According to the causes of pipe lines vibration, the simple way of eliminating the vibration was given, and the results showed that the vibrating method effect is effective.

articleTitle: Analysis and evaluation of soil heavy metals in the southern suburbs of Jiaozuo
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the contents of heavy metals in the southern suburb soil of Jiaozuo city, including Pb, Zn, Ni, Cu, Co and Mn, are determined. The corresponding data was assessed using the methods of single-factor pollution index as well as synthetic pollution index. Based on the characteristics of the contents of the soil heavy metals, the reasons for the heavy metal pollution of soil are analyzed and discussed. The results show that in the experimental area, the surface soil always contains a target heavy metal below the background value. In other words, the soil is slightly-polluted, wherein, Ni is the dominating pollution factor, Pb is a factor resulting in slight pollution, Mn>; Zn and Cu are with the single-factor pollution index around 1.0 which indicates that the soil are at the levels of cleanness or warning line, and for Co the soil is at the safety level. In addition, the synthetic pollution index indicates the soil is at the levels of slight pollution or above.

articleTitle: The study on radar synthesis measurement technology
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Take example for a airborne radar, this dissertation elaborates some key technologies such as the design of Test Unit Adapter , the automatic testing of antenna scanning parameter, the simulation of moving target, the closed loop calibration of microwave signal and IVI in the process of organizing the radar Automatic Test System on the basis of PXI bus and GPIB bus. The study in this dissertation will not only provide the universal technique for the development of radar ATS, but also provide a valuable reference to the engineering application of other electronic equipment.

articleTitle: Study on the interaction of a single pile and pile groups with the soil in layered foundation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Applying fundamental solution in a multilayered elastic medium, the pile and its corresponding soil foundation are first discretized into cylinder and circular elements, and then the equations of stress and displacements are established for piles and soil foundation respectively. The Integral equations for obtaining loads and displacements of pile-foundation interaction are presented by using displacement compatibility. The numerical method for analyzing the pile-foundation interaction is developed for considering the nonhomogeneous properties of the soil. By using the fundamental solutions of layered elastic solids, the proposed method can be used for analyzing of the pile-foundation interaction in nonhomogeneous soils with parameters arbitrarily changing along depth. With the correctness and accuracy verified by the practical engineering design, the proposed method can achieve more satisfactory results compared with the existing methods.

Author Keywords: the fundamental solutions of layered elastic solids
a single pile or pile groups

articleTitle: Research advance of thermodynamic systems with nonaqueous working fluids applied in low-temperature energy power generation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a review of the status of power generation with nonaqueous working fluids from low temperature thermal resource, the features, equipment composition and working processed as well as comparison of two main types of thermodynamic cycles which are Organic Rankine Cycle(ORC) and Kalina Cycle and nonaqueous working fluids including their classification and filter criteria for thermodynamic cycles. Nonaqueous working fluids thermodynamic cycles are applied to the conversion of geothermal energy, low-temperature solar energy, ocean thermal energy and industrial low-temperature waste heat etc. Most of thermodynamic cycle systems for low-temperature thermal resource could be classed as ORC system and Kalina system all of which have respective advantages and limitations. Besides cycle type the working fluids would affect significantly the general efficiency of the entire thermodynamic system. The evaluating indicators for working fluids include critical temperature, critical pressure, global warming potential (GWP) and toxicity etc. as well as system efficiency (exergy efficiency included) for the final evaluation. Based on the advantages and limitations of ORC and Kalina cycle the mixed working fluids are developed and respective thermodynamic cycles illustrate bright prospect.

articleTitle: Research on method of calculating the bearing capacity of timber columns repaired and strengthened by BFRPS
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: It is doubted whether wood columns could be reinforced when their bearing capacities are under requirement, and there are few studies on it. In this paper, eight wood columns, including six basalt fibers reinforced plastic sheet (BFRPS) and two compared members, are tested. Based on the damage characteristics, mechanical performance, bearing capacity calculation method is explored mainly. And the calculation formula used for wood columns strengthened and repaired by BFRPS is formed by analyzing the experimental data. The calculation results based on the formula agree well with the experimental data. The experiment and formula can provide reference and theoretical basis for practical reinforcement construction.

articleTitle: Intelligent sliding-mode control based on cloud model for ship steering
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to satisfy the requirement of strong robustness of ship motion controller, an intelligent sliding-mode controller based on cloud model is designed. With reasoning method of cloud models, the reaching speed of the controller can be dynamically adjusted and the chattering problem is solved. The validity of the controller is demonstrated by the simulation of the ship course control.

articleTitle: Poles' effect on the qualities of a two-wheeled large-angle balancing mobile
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper mainly discusses the poles' effect on the performance of a two-wheeled balancing mobile, which is inherently unstable and so needs to be stabilized in a large angel range by a balance control unit. Three aspects are included: first, similarity between the linearization model and the original nonlinear system model is increased by using feedback linearization; Second, system transient performance >; robustness >; angel-controllable range are analyzed by state variables, control voltage and sensitivity function , which are all changed with poles' positions; Finally, the conclusion is that poles' effect on angel-controllable range is contrary to the transient performance, stability and robustness.

articleTitle: Analysis of pulse optimization of frontal crash on a specific vehicle
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The frontal crash is an important item relating to C-NCAP test and regulations. The vehicle crash pulse has a vital influence on injury value of driver's head and chest in 100% frontal rigid carrier crash. In order to this problem, the vehicle crash pulse is analyzed and a structural optimization solution is presented with regard to a specific vehicle. The peak value of crash pulse can be reduced by optimizing rear fixing bolt on sub-frame and increasing the energy-absorbing efficiency on load path. As a result, the analysis of restraint system indicates that the injury value of driver's head and chest is significantly reduced, thereby achieving the objective of safety development.

articleTitle: Research on the design method of conceptual detailed planning
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Le Shui Xin Ju district lies to the northeast of Chaoyang; it is about to be planned to be a great-hearted district which contains multiple functions including office, commerce, administrative management, research, design, recreation, ecological residential community, and so on. The paper systematically reviews the conceptual detailed planning of Le Shui Xin Ju district from angles of plan survey, plan principle and idea, plan structure and spatial arrangement, spatial model research, road system, green space system, landscape system, functional district of river beach. Through the actual case, the author deems that conceptual detailed planning possesses positive significance in the aspects of spatial model research, demand behavior analysis, landscape system analysis, and so on. If designers take design result of conceptual detailed planning as beneficial supplement of statutory plans system, then statutory plans could be improved and optimized, and fit the need of new situation, new idea, and new target.

articleTitle: The exploration of natural gas pressure loss calculation method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Pressure loss is the technical and economic indicator for the amount of energy consumed in the course of transmission. The calculation of on-way resistance coefficients and local resistance coefficients were analyzed. The calculation model of on-way pressure loss and local pressure loss was established. The practice shows that the calculation method can be used to analyze the pressure loss during transmitting, to evaluate the operating conditions and to provide technical support for safety, high efficiency and stable operation of natural gas transmission.

articleTitle: Preparation of K2O/ZrO2 catalyst and its Use in the synthesis of Di-2-ethylhexyl carbonate
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O/ZrO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O/ZrO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sub>La<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3-x</sub> (x=0.4%, 0.5%, 0.6%, 0.7% and 0.8%) catalysts for the synthesis of di-2 ethylhexyl carbonate from dimethyl carbonate and 2-ethyl hexanol were prepared by impregnation method calcinated at 773K, 873K and 973K. The activity of K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O/ZrO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sub>La<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3-</sub>0.6% catalyst reached the yield of 81.18% for di-2-ethylhexyl carbonate when the calcination temperature was 973K. XRD and Raman measurements of catalysts revealed that the tetragonal and monoclinic zirconia phase were observed in the catalysts. It was benefited to increase the basicity of catalysts that K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O dispersed on the surface of the carrier. The monoclinic zirconia phase decreased when the content of La increased.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research of impact test method based on tri-component force
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Harbin city wetland safety analysis and countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Urban wetland ecosystems play in the city to maintain ecosystem equilibrium, wetland ecosystems in maintaining the safety of the ecological functions of wetlands play a huge role. Articles by SPSS statistical software, using factor analysis method and clustering analysis method to select a number of indicators before and after the Songhua River pollution incident on the North Pine wetlands were studied. The results show that: the highest level of ecological security in the eastern region, the worst safety in the western region. Songhua River pollution incident, the best scores of the Eastern biological factors; Eastern stability of the strongest water pollution incident; loose the safety of northern wetlands in water pollution after a downward trend. That pollution directly affects the safety of urban wetland.

articleTitle: Geotechnical stability simulation of single bucket offshore platform under vertical cyclic loading
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Despite of upper structure failure, emphasis is laid upon the ground silt which is a very common in Bohai Bay. In order to explore the soil stress, reduced-scale tests are performed by groups of transducers. By programming, the model test analysis can be converted into real stress of prototype platform. Then a series of Drucker-Prager yield criteria as well as Mohr-Coulomb criterion are employed to judge the soil stability. By contrast, result derived from DP-2 and DP-4, with M-C results as reference, is adopted. In conclusion, considering vertical cyclic loading alone, foundation silt of the offshore platform is 1) unconditionally stable when 500 tons oil weight is exerted and 2) globally stable when 1000 tons oil weight is exerted. Balancing economic efficiency and engineering safety, daily oil storage of the caisson can be designed 1000 tons.

articleTitle: The measuring of elastic modulus based on ultrasonic
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The measuring of elastic modulus based on ultrasonic is the key to improve the propagation time measurement accuracy. In addition to the use of advanced equipment and software algorithms, the error of measurement time caused by the acoustic coupler interface can be completely avoided by use of step-axis specimen. Using time interval between primary and secondary pulses can effectively eliminate the extra delay.

articleTitle: Mixed FEM of B-spline wavelet on the interval for beam structures based on node parameters
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on generalized variational principle of long beams and interpolation of shape functions of B-spline wavelet on the interval (BSWI), mixed FEM of BSWI based on node parameters for beam structures was proposed. By taking node parameters as interpolation coefficients, this method has many advantages, such as easy dealing with the boundary conditions and meeting the continuity of node quantities between adjacent elements. And with it, the deflection and moment functions of beam can be calculated simultaneously, the shortcoming of low accuracy in beam moment calculation with traditional FEM can be overcome. Mixed FEM of BSWI based on node parameters can be used in various kinds of analysis of beam structures, and the numerical examples indicate that the method have the advantages of high accuracy and less computation amounts.

articleTitle: Deep defects analysis and treatment of in-situ bored pile based on grouting technique
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In construction of pile foundation of a certain bridge main piers, in-situ bored piles with diameter 2000mm and length 37m were used. One of the piles was blocked with a second perfusion, and deep defects occurred. Considering above part of defect pile can not meet the design requirements, deep defects detection and treatment should be undertaken. Low strain dynamic test and core drilling method are used to take deep defects detection and treatment and grouting strengthening scheme is put forward. Results show that the method in this paper is feasible and effective and pile body strength and integrity can reach requirements.

articleTitle: The study on the development tendency of the Chinese road traffic safety management
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The current road traffic safety management system in china does not meet the requirements of the "big traffic management" objectively, the experience of traffic management in foreign developed countries suggests that to deepen reform of the road traffic safety management system in china should be separated between the powers of policy-making and execution in terms of authority function, more man-centered in terms of value standard, and more informationalized in terms of functional means. To set up a standardized and unified system of road traffic safety laws gradually is the primary measures for the reform of the road traffic safety management system in china. Furthermore, china should pay more attention to the construction of road traffic safety management planning and establish a comprehensive road traffic safety administration, when the conditions are ripe.

articleTitle: The research on phenolic resin modified by nanoparticles and used for magnesite-carbon brick binder
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The research method use nanoparticles to modify the phenolic resin binder for magnesite-carbon brick. The normal detection indexes of phenolic resins is suited to ued as the binder. FESEM images show that the nanoparticles are distributed uniformly without agglomeration almost. The physical-chemical property analyses show that the magnesite-carbon brick using this modified phenolic resin as binder possesses a low apparent porosity and a high bulk density and compression strength. Especially, the compression strength of the magnesite-carbon bricks after heat treatment for 200°C x12h increase to 43.94MPa and 41.35MPa, respectively. The results also show that with the increase of heat treatment temperature, the compression strength and the bulk density of magnesite-carbon bricks decrease and the apparent porosity magnesite-carbon bricks increases. The physical-chemical property shows a significant change from 200 °C to 1100°C. However the change is not obviously from 1100°C to 1550 °C and shows worse trend with the increase of heat treatment temperature.

articleTitle: Study and application of dislocation repair of arch rib of steel tubular arch bridge with negative pressure grouting
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Steel tubular arch bridge is a common bridge style for highway. Dislocation of the concrete at arch rib is a popular disease of such bridge. In order to solve the issue, a grouting material with high strength, low viscosity, high penetration, low temperature resistance and flexibility was used to reinforce dislocation of the arch rib concrete. The excellent properties of the material performed from our reinforcing experiments proved its advantages for dislocation repair of arch rib of steel tubular arch bridge. The research results show a practical significance for the diseases of arch rib concrete.

Author Keywords: high penetration and low temperature resistance

articleTitle: The antiseismic energy dissipation safety factor of the reinforced concrete bridge piers based on the inverse deduction of the Park-Ang damage model
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The concept of the antiseismic energy dissipation safety factor of the reinforced concrete bridge pier is put forward based on the dynamic energy equation of multi-degree structures and the inverse deduction of the Park-Ang damage model under given displacement and damage controlling conditions. In addition, a real concrete pier is analyzed in practical to show the feasibility of the theory, where the popular finite element software is utilized. The results show that the real ability of energy dissipation of the reinforced concrete bridge pier can be calculated under given displacement and damage controlling conditions and then the safety factor can be obtained subsequently in varied earthquake waves. This method may provide an effective means for the antiseismic assessment of the existing concrete bridge piers.

Author Keywords: Inverse deduction of Park-Ang damage model
Safety factor of the antiseismic energy dissipation

articleTitle: The technologic study in tension-reducing steel tube
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The paper provides the related formula on the tension-reducing technology. According to the relevant formula, the software of Visual Basic 6.0 is used to design the process. Then the programs and methods also are introduced. The results of software will be applied in practical so that the process parameters are obtained more efficiently and convenient. According to the technology of stretch-reducing rolling process, the three-dimension model of 12-stand tension reducing is built. And finite element software of MARC is used to analysis thermal-mechanical coupled state by the non-linear of elastic-plastic method. The stress distribution of pipe is obtained in the process of reducing tension process. Theoretical calculation values are compared with simulation and measured values, whose results are consistent. It provides the theory basis for the study of the tension reducing process, and guidance for real production.

articleTitle: Model analysis of single stacker fork based on FEM
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to the high strength and stiffness characteristics requirement of single stacker fork structural, the finite element method (FEM) was applied to analyze statics of single stacker fork under different operation conditions. The natural frequency and modal shape etc. were gotten. The results provide an effective optimization method for single stacker fork design.

articleTitle: The research and application for improving the coarse pitch numerical control program
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By the method of feeding hierarchically several times and applying the Calculation and circulatory function of NC system, we can changing the value of the variable and complete the process for different types of thread well. Also, the coarse pitch's shortcomings, including the special shapes of the section, the poor chip removal when processing, the severe vibration when cutting, unable to use traditional means to turn the thread, and so on, is avoided.

articleTitle: The research of Electromachanical Actuator control system development based on the MATLAB platform using the RTDX
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to rapidly develop the control system code of the Electromachanical Actuator (EMA), the DSP development platform is established mostly based on the MATLAB, and the development metheod is researched. First, the DSP development platform archtecture in the environment of MATLAB is briefly introduced. And the principle of data exchange is showed. Then, the EMA hardware structure is necessarily explained, which one is for the developer to conveniently configure the system. Finally, the developer reasonably configures the DSP models used in the simulink and constitutes them to speed and position closed loop control system of the EMA, by using the RTDX and the MATLAB GUI. The EMA control system code will be debuged rapidly through this platform. The executed DSP code will be generated automatically. And the result of degugging would be showed on the MATLAB GUI. For generlly speaking, the difficulties of the EMA control system code development method is reduced and the development cycle is shortened through the MATLAB model. This system development method is fast and effective.

articleTitle: The thought of the optimization algorithm for the commodity hard-packaging size
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the high level demand of modern industrial products for package, and the complexity of the best hard packing size design with the gradual popularization of the container logistics: too many design factors need to be considered so that the traditional experience can't afford. Only apply the optimization means can have comprehensive consideration and settlement. According to the practical difficulties encountered in the industry, this article for varies of practical problems, comparing the modern algorithms and the traditional algorithms of the commodity hard packing size container optimization design. By using different algorithms to solve many actual examples later conduct scientific method of Intercomparison results, we summarized the advantages and disadvantages of the modern algorithms and traditional algorithms for solving different scale models. It provides important reference for designers when taking the size optimization design.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The research on HEV Ni-MH battery discharge model
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Float state and static stability analysis of the biomimetic robotic dolphin designed on the change of the barycenter
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the structure of biomimetic robotic dolphin designed on changing the barycenter is described. Through a barycenter adjustor which can change the dolphin's center of gravity by swinging an inside counterweight, it can realize the dolphin's pitching movement underwater. By means of the mass properties function of SolidWorks, the dolphin's buoyant center and barycenter, and the center of gravity for every part are analyzed and calculated. They are the foundation for further study. The dolphin's zero trimming and trimming caused by the barycenter adjustor are analyzed and calculated. According to the barycenter moving principle and the principle of the motion of a point in Cartesian coordinate system, the influence on the dolphin's float state and static stability caused by the counterweight swinging in vertical and horizontal longitudinal direction are respectively presented. The above analysis and calculation are validated by the moment balance principle. Finally, the factors which influence the dolphin's float state and static stability are discussed. The study in this paper is the foundation of the subsequent mechanical design, control system design, simulation and optimum design for the biomimetic robotic dolphlin.

articleTitle: Research on NOx formation of flat-flame combustion with HTAC Technology
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the single swirl burner flat-flame combustion, the technology of High Temperature Air Combustion (HTAC) was adopted. The central combustion speed field under burner was measured by Particle Image Velocimetry (PIV) technique, as the same time, the temperature distribution in the furnace and concentration distribution of NO were measured by sensors. It appeared that with HTAC technology, combustion was stabilization, and fuel completely burnt; temperature distributing got uniformity, NOx formation decreased to 30ppm. Though regenerator, air temperature increased from 20°C to 200°C, smoke temperature decreased from 800°C to 80°C, it achieved the effect of energy conservation and environment protect.

articleTitle: Adsorption of roxarsone from aqueous solution onto multiwalled carbon nanotubes
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Roxarsone is an organic arsenic compound existing extensively in animal wastewater, while multiwalled carbon nanotubes (MWCNTs) is a good adsorbent for the removal of trace organic pollutants from aqueous solution. In this study, the effect of various experimental parameters, such as adsorbent content, initial pH, ionic strength and temperature was investigated using batch adsorption experiment. The results show that MWCNTs is an effective adsorbent for the removal of roxarsone from aqueous solution. The maximum adsorption capacity is 9.355 mg/g at 20°C. The adsorption of roxarsone from aqueous solution onto MWCNTs was spontaneous, exothermic, and followed Freundlich isotherms.

articleTitle: The calculation on liquid holdup in horizontal gasliquid two-phase annular flow
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Liquid holdup is one of the important parameters in the calculation of multiphase flow, annular flow is a common flow regime in the condensating natural gas pipeline. In this paper, based the momentum equation, combined with pig experimental data of gas-liquid two-phase annular flow in large-scale loop, calculated the theoretical liquid holdup. The calculated theoretical data and experimental date were compared and analyzed, the results showed that theory and experiment had a good agreement, thus the experimental and theoretical calculation methods on liquid holdup of gas-liquid two-phase annular flow phase were established.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of wave-induced dynamic response of saturated silt seabed
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Owing to the difference in sedimentary environment and substance source, soil strata within the depth range of 10 m vary significantly in strata sequence, size distribution and physical-mechanical properties in different areas of the Yellow River Delta. This leads to great difference in characteristics of dynamic responses under wave loading, and hence different characteristics of the evolution and failure of soil bodies. Key factors of soil evolution can be revealed by comprehensively analyzing the differences of dynamic responses of soil. In this paper, on the basis of Biot's Consolidation Theory, with the stagger-grid high-order finite difference method, five typical sedimentary sequences of silty seabed of Chendao Sea area were taken as models to numerically simulate and analyze the variation of stress field, displacement field and excess pore water pressure in non-uniform layered seabed. Comparisons between analytical results and actually measured field results show that sedimentary sequence plays the key role in the stability of the seabed, and the stratum with a structure hard in the upper part and soft in the lower part is the most unstable.

articleTitle: Research on mechanism of increment reinforced subgrade bearing capacity
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
