articleTitle: Research on fuzzy random reliability based on wear Prediction model
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The four main factors that influence the metal wear performance are determined. Wear Prediction model is developed based on partial least-squares regression method including the four parameters. The fuzzy and random characteristic of metal wear is analysed and the method of the prediction of fuzzy random reliability of metal wear is carried out according to the wear prediction model. The modal is generally used when the materials and working conditions are similar, and the wear reliability can be predicted if the distribution of the influencing factors are given.

articleTitle: Optimization for high voltage porcelain insulators steel foot structural
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: High voltage porcelain insulators are playing an important role in high voltage transmission line. They are long term operation in complex environment, and there are high safe requirement for high voltage transmission line. So the improvements of the mechanical and electrical characteristics become very important. In this paper, we take the steel foot structural of the high voltage porcelain insulators as the optimization object, apply the least squares approach to optimize it. The results of the optimization show that it can not only improve the mechanical characteristics, but also save production cost.

articleTitle: Experimental study on steel fiber reinforced concrete columns under low cyclic
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The main objective was to study steel fiber's effect to improve the seismic performance of concrete columns under Low Cyclic. The axial compressive ratio of all columns was 0.11, and the shear span ratio was 3. Through the low cyclic loading test of steel fiber reinforced concrete components that steel fiber were added at the volume fractions of 1.0%, 1.5%, 2.0%. The cracking and damage process of the specimens were studied. The failure patterns and hysteretic behavior of column specimens with different steel fiber volume fractions were analyzed. The test results indicated: the performances of reinforced concrete such as ductility and energy dissipation have been strengthened by steel fiber, but not increasing with fiber content. When the admixture of 1.5% the seismic performance of column specimens to achieve optimal.

articleTitle: Hydraulic sheet metal bending machine hydraulic servo valve synchronization systems research
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Hydraulic sheet metal bending machine synchronous hydraulic servo valves is the key technology of bending machine, in this paper, the principle of hydraulic synchronizing system are analysed and the hydraulic servo valve synchronous feedback institutions were studied and discussed.

articleTitle: Emergency treatment of phenol contamination in low temperature source water by powdered activated carbon
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In view of the possibility of Phenol pollution accident existing in source water, experimental study on the application of powdered activated carbon (PAC) regarded as an emergency way to Phenol pollution treatment is performed in this article, taking the water from Songhua River as raw water. Comparing the Phenol adsorption efficiency of four types of powdered activated carbon through static tests at 9, 2# PAC can remove Phenol pollutant with the best effect, the rate of adsorption fits the Lagergren second order kinetic model well. The influence of pH and temperature on the adsorption effect of 2#PAC are researched simultaneously. Then the optimum dosages of 2#PAC and adsorption time are determined in conditions of different Phenol exceeding standard multiples.

articleTitle: Research on Carbon Problems in the construction industry
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the reasons of phenomenon of resources and energy waste, which will increase the CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission, in the first 3 stages of the construction: the feasibility study stage, the designing stage and the construction stage. And then relevant suggestions are given.

articleTitle: Original design on the power transmission mechanism of a twin-rotor piston engine
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to increase the power density of the piston engine, the power transmission mechanism of a twin-rotor piston engine based on differential velocity principle is introduced. Firstly, the precept of the engine principle is developed, and the velocity of the rotors is designed, then the structure and the kinematic simulation of the power transmission mechanism are derived. The results show that the combined mechanism composed of the hypocycloidal planet gear mechanism and the crank rock mechanism can satisfy the design principle of the twin-rotor piston engine, the number of the airtight cavity and its vary is related to the gear ratio, the power frequency of the engine is increased obviously.

articleTitle: Field monitor and research of optimizing design on deep buried road tunnel in loosen and fractured layer
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to probe into the properties of deep buried road tunnel in loosen and fractured layer, the group have monitored some items, including ground surface settlement, net space convergence, and stress of steel arch centering, strain of steel arch centering. Based on the monitoring results, we point out that the best time of influence sphere of time and space during tunnel excavation under this geology conditions, and analyse the stress properties of surrounding rock and supporting system. The analysis results provide basis for optimizing design, and the optimized supporting parameters meet the requirement of stress according to theoretical calculation. The conclusion can serve as example to other projects in design, construction and monitor under similar condition.

articleTitle: The design of a Solar-Pull-Push-DC-Power-Supply based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to the requirement of a wild-radio's power supply, a 25V/5A Solar-Pull-Push-DC-Power Supply with high precision and quickly dynamic response has been developed The CPU is TMS320LF2407A, the main circuit is pull-push DC/DC converter, and PWM control method has been used too. The accuracy and the dynamic response have been greatly improved because of the use of a digital PID regulator. So the response time is only 0.2s when the load current achieves 5A from 1A, and the ripple voltage is only 94mV when the load current is 5A. The results of application proved this solar-DC-Power-Supply is not only fully satisfied with the requirement but also have the advantages of precise output voltage, high stability, quickly dynamic response etc.

articleTitle: On the application of foamed composites in building energy efficiency
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Under the background of the global energy crisis and advocating low-carbon economy, people's awareness of energy-saving has been continuously improved. A series of energy saving equipment, technology and materials etc. have come out along with the development of science and technology. In the global energy consumption system, the energy consumption of the building account for a relatively large proportion. Therefore, energy-saving building has become the focal point of developing the future construction and building energy efficiency can be regarded as the most effective and direct measure to resolve the conflict of the energy shortage, reduce environmental pollution and promote sustainable development of economy. With the consideration of structural design and material selection, energy-saving buildings should choose heat-retaining materials to reduce heat transfer. The foamed composites, the new fire-resistant material, just meet the needs with its low prices, excellent thermal insulation and less environmental pollution and will be used widely in the fields of building energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Prediction at China's coal production quality based on VEC model early “12 5”
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A VEC model which Includes four coherent variables tested by unit test and co-integration test for the study of China's total amount of coal production was set up, the fitted value for history of the model was satisfactory through tested. The paper predicted total amount of coal production by the model, got important conclusions through the analysis of the simulation results. At last put forward relevant measures and developing goal.

articleTitle: Study on the removal of Pb2+ in water by γ-irradiation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Radiation-induced removal of Pb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> ( 0.1 mmol-L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> ) in aqueous solutions by γ-irradiation was studied in this paper. The results showed that the removal of Pb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> by γ-irradiation was first-order reaction. Several factors which might affect the removal efficiency of Pb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> were examed. Dissolved oxygen (DO) in water restrained the removal of Pb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>. Sodium carbonate (Na<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>) was added into the solution as relatively non-toxic hydroxyl radical scavenger. And the removal efficiency of Pb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> was enhanced after the addition of 0.1 mmol/L Na<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>. The removal efficiency of Pb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> decreased in the presence of organic matters (such as EDTA). And increasing irradiation dosage was a better way to weaken the impact of organic matters to the removal of Pb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> by γ-irradiation.

articleTitle: How the interference between flows influents the fairness of IEEE 802.11 DCF
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: IEEE 802.11 DCF protocol exhibit severe fairness problem in many scenarios. In this paper, the reasons why fairness problem appears is given and proved by simulation. The study reveals that the interference among contending MAC flows is different when fairness problem happens. This paper consider that different interference between MAC flows cause the DCF unfair. A parameter named FI (Fairness Indicator) is defined to indicate the interference level of a flow. When the contending flows' FI values are not same, their capabilities of obtaining channel are different. The flow with smaller FI will get more chance to access channel. Our analysis proved that in order to conquer the fairness problem, FI must be changed by someway.

articleTitle: An optimization model of integrated forward/reverse logistics network for manufacturer of Joint operations under uncertain environment
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: An optimization model of integrated forward/reverse logistics network for manufacturer of jiont operations is proposed under uncertain environment, the model can solve location selection of distribution center, recycling center and recycling processing center, and flow allocation between facilities. Then a steps for solving the model was given by transforming the model to certain model. Since such network design problems belong to a class of NP hard problems, a genetic algorithm is presented. Finally the validity of the model was demonstrated by a numerical example.

articleTitle: The research on investment control of large-scale project in karst area of Guangxi
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Investment control of large-scale projects in karst area has its own particularity and uncertainty. Based on Earned Value theory, this paper explored investment control in construction stage of large-scale project in karst area and then took a true case to show the use of Earned Value. The results showed that it would be helpful to make effective measures to manage project funds.

articleTitle: The model and experimental study for vibration control in Deep-hole Boring
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: On the base of studying the forming mechanism of self-excitation vibration and helix lobes in deep-hole boring, the paper established a mechanical model and analysed the effect of the length of the guide pads on the vibration and stability. Moreover, the reasonable length of the guide pads was verified by the experiments of the guide pads testing.

articleTitle: Application of improved ant colony algorithm in load distribution optimization of tandem cold rolling
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on equipment parameters of a certain 1450 mm tandem cold rolling, the load distribution mode of proportional rolling force was employed and reduction distribution ratio of every engine frame was defined as ant colony optimization parameters on certain conditions. The optimal load distribution was obtained through loop computation of improved ant colony algorithm. Simulated results show that the improved ant colony algorithm has fast program execution, good astringency, accurate optimal value and can effectively prevent object function value from local minimum. This method can be applied to real manufacture as a new load distribution optimization method of tandem cold mill.

articleTitle: Study on the theoretical system of green mining based on the scientific concept of development
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the need of green mining development and large-scale development of ecological environmental damage as the background in China's coal resources, It analyzes the basis theory of mining resources, economy, people, environmental mutually relies on and restrict, green mining industry composition, characteristics and green mining industry. It gives the connotation and definition of green mining and constructs the theoretical system of green mining and laid a foundation for the construction and development of green mining.

articleTitle: Influences of shields to the inductance with transient currents
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Frequency of currents, material properties and physical shapes can influence the inductance. Especially for the transient current and linear medium, the current density may vary greatly to change the inductance. Based on the analysis of inductance calculation, a transformer model is introduced to illustrate the contributions of parameters to inductances. Numerical experiments are given to verify the results using software ANSOFT Maxwell SV. The results show that influences of the shields to the inductance with certain transient currents can be neglected.

articleTitle: Screening of 4 dominant strains and their condition of degrading pollutants from cooking fume
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the activated sludge which taken from the oxidation ditch of the sewage treatment plant was domesticated for 40d with simulated cooking fumes, and 4 strains of dominant microbes were gained after screened twice, named as ZH-01, HL-03, XJ-021 and BD-55, degradation rates to pollutants from cooking fumes was determined as 60.95%, 68.81%, 65.22%, 74.57% respectively. 4 strains of dominant microbes were morphologically, preliminarily identified as Mucor spp., Paecilomyces lilacinus, Pseudomonas aeraginosa, and Rhodosporidium toruloide. Degradation conditions including temperature, pH, dissolved oxygen, reaction time and inoculation volume, match style of dominant microbes were optimized.

articleTitle: The effect of pre-deformation on the tensile properties for the CoCr alloy
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: There are many reports about pre-deformation on microstructure and mechanical properties of the alloy, but none about the CoCr alloy. This research proposed solutions to the compression and expansion test of the stents, and established an accurate test method to assess the mechanical properties of products, analyzed the pre-deformation on it and summarized the stress-strain characteristics of the material being compressed and tensile. Given the practical process of stents placement, we produced a test piece made by CoCr alloy. We had it compressed before stretching, analyzing the pre-deformation on extension rate, ultimate strength and yield strength and other mechanical properties. The tensile elongation of CoCr alloy can be influenced by pre-deformation, which had an important significance for practical design and production.

articleTitle: Boundary absorbing computations in wave simulation with the finite element method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The simulation of wave propagation has important applications in many problems such as in computational seismology. Here, we focus on boundary absorbing computations in wave simulation with the finite element method on triangular mesh. The first-order and second-order absorbing boundary conditions based on wave decomposition are presented. Moreover, the absorbing conditions for corners are proposed. The weak formulations combined with absorbing conditions are derived. Numerical computations for a complex model show that boundary reflections are eliminated and the computational efficiency is high by using the mass-lumping technique.

articleTitle: The ISMVSC system for PMSM based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The integral sliding mode variable structure control (ISMVSC)has many characteristics such as fast response,small overshoot,strong robustness and antidisturbance,so it is suitable for permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM)which is a high-order,nonlinear and strong coupling multi-variant system.The ISMVSC strategy is introduced into the vector control system of the PMSM,and the system is implemented by DSP TMS320F2812 in this paper. The experimental results show the system has good dynamic and static performance and strong robustness to parameters variation.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation on the determining technological parameters of vibratory aging treating for large-sized welding box-section beam structures
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to determining technological parameters of vibratory aging treating for large-sized welding box-section beam structures, kinetic analysis was carried out according to the industrial standard. The natural frequency, vibration mode and the curves of amplitude-frequency were obtained by using Finite Element Analysis (FEA), This gave some suggestions for reference no how to determine the technological parameters for large-sized welding structures.

articleTitle: Design and realization of gas-solid two-phase flow standard facility
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Gas-solid two-phase flow is complicated and random, gas-solid two-phase flow standard facility is a very important method for the study of gas-solid two-phase flow problem. As to the design requirements of standard facility, a gas-solid two-phase flow standard facility used to calibratio electrostatic sensor is designed.

articleTitle: On the existence of periodic orbits in the CR3BP
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In the case of the circular restricted three-body problem (CR3BP), the existence of periodic orbits is strictly proved for the firstand third-order time dependent approximate system in the inertial frame. Moreover, the expression of periodic orbits for the first order nonautonomous system of CR3BP is presented analytically, which makes a difference for the known results obtained by semi-analytical and semi-numerical methods in the rotating frame.

articleTitle: A DNA genetic algorithm with reconstruct operator for chemical process modeling
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A DNA genetic algorithm with reconstruct operator (rDNA-GA) is presented in this paper. In the proposed algorithm, potential solutions of the problems are represented as individuals with nucleotide bases, and genetic operators inspired by DNA operations are adopted over the individuals. Among the genetic operators, reconstruct operator is a new operator which is used to improve the diversity of the population through reconstructing the similar individuals of the population. The simulation results of two test functions show that rDNA-GA outperforms another method, AGA. Finally, rDNA-GA is used to estimate the parameters of a chemical engineering process, the hydrogen reaction models. And the result shows the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm compared with other reported models obtained by other algorithms.

articleTitle: Structural correlations between liquid and solid Ag70Au30 alloy
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Through the high temperature X-ray diffraction, structural evolution of Ag<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">70</sub>Au<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">30</sub> alloy with varying temperatures has been investigated. The liquid alloy experiences a sudden structure change nearby 1150°C, which has been further thermodynamically confirmed by Differential Scanning Calorimetry (DSC). Small pre-peaks have been found in the structure factor (S(Q)) curves, indicating the stable medium range order (MRO) structure in the melt. As the temperature decreases from 1100°C to 1000°C, MRO structure gets more pronounced. Compared with the structures of Ag<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">90</sub>Au<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub>, Transmission Electron Microscope (TEM) results reveal that Ag<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">70</sub>Au<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">30</sub> alloy possesses much finer grains. It is concluded that there are strong correlations between melt and solid in Ag<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">70</sub>Au<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">30</sub> alloy, and MRO structure in the liquid favors refined solid microstructure.

articleTitle: Finite element analysis of bonding connections between cold-formed steel Z sections
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To ensure that lapped connections in continuous Z-purlins have a good effect on moment transfer, this paper presents a bonding connection. A finite element model was established to study the behaviors of the bonding connections, including the strength and stiffness, and to compare with the traditional bolt connections. The analysis shows that, the bonding connection can transfer moment effectively, and this connection has a great improvement on its load bearing behavior compared with the traditional bolt connection. Consequently, the bonding connection can achieve the expected design requirements of continuous Z-purlins.

articleTitle: Computer simulation for stress distribution of prestressed cables
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The shear stress distribution of the prestressed cables was analyzed in a nonlinear finite element method, also the dynamic evolution law of shear stress distribution was researched. It was demonstrated by numerical analysis that, with the increase of load, the whole anchorage system generally underwent elastic stage, elastic-plastic slip stage, elastic-plastic slipping-debonding stage and failure stage. When the anchorage length was small, it only underwent elastic stage, elastic-plastic slip stage, and failure stage without elastic-plastic slipping-debonding stage, and in this case, the anchorage system expressed destabilizing failure and sudden damage of anchorage system. Analysis shows that interface' s mechanical behaviors are properly described by finite element analysis model of anchorage body interface mechanics which is establish base on experimental results, especially the composite interface unit combining solid unit with expansion character and contact unit was established creatively, by which the expansion and slipping characters of interface are properly expressed.

articleTitle: Experimental study on Eisenia foetida activation of heavy metals (Pb,Cd) in residual sludge
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Taking the residual sludge from wastewater treatment plant of China University of Mining and Technology as research object, through activating machenism experiments, study the growth of Eisenia foetida and the impact on bioavailability of heavy metals by Eisenia foetida. The results showed that the Eisenia foetida could grow normally in the sludge to a certain concentration of Pb, Cd , had good tolerance and different activating effectson heavy metals. When concentration of Pb was 400mg/kg, the increment of activation rate was a maximum,the added value was 19.93mg/kg; due to the toxicity of Cd, the effects on activation rate was little .

articleTitle: A novel digital sphygmomanometer using Cortex-M3 microcontroller
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This issue introduced a new design of sphygmomanometer which do not need complicated signal conditioning circuit. Based on digital signal processing technology, it achieved a sphygmomanometer with the least spare parts needed. All signal processing procedures are accomplished by digital filters using ARM Cortex-M3 microcontroller, which were both stable and cost-saving.

articleTitle: Application of measurement technology of sound intensity in noise source identification of automotive interior noise
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: An application of measurement method of sound intensity is discussed from practical engineering perspective based on experimental analysis to identify the main noise source of vehicle. The 3D sound intensity charts are plotted to find the main noise source which adversely affects interior noise of a specific vehicle at idle condition. Meanwhile, the relevant components are optimized and improved in combination with frequency spectrum analysis to reduce interior noise and improve vehicle NVH performance. The test results indicate that the technology of source intensity measurement and frequency spectrum analysis can be applied to identify the main noise source quickly, and the improvement method is presented accordingly.

articleTitle: Study of high-power and high-energy laser fiber coupler
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The cause and mechanism of damage caused by input laser on fiber's input end face are analysised in this paper, when high-power and highenergy laser input into. And a kind of special reflective fiber coupler is developed. It can change laser spot into a light disk whose dimension is equal to or less than the fiber section's. The laser energy is evenly distributed on light disk and the laser power density is lower than laser fiber's damage threshold. Making use of electrooptical Q-switching Nd:YAG laser whose output spike pulse's peak power is 15 KW. Through experiment, the coupling efficiency can get to 80-85%. In addition, the fiber's input end face is not damaged via longer work time. Then this device satisfies actual applying requirement.

articleTitle: Simulation on actuating input-combinations of 5-UPS/PRPU Parallel Machine Tool
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The actuating input selection is an important basic problem for the parallel mechanism. There are 5 kinds of reasonable actuating input-combinations in 5-UPS/PRPU Parallel Machine Tool. Three typical motion paths are planed in the workspace of the PMT in order to determine the optimum input-combinations. The dynamic simulation without working load is carried out by the ADMAS software when the moving platform moves along the typical paths. The curves of square sum of actuating forces of 5 input-combinations show that the actuating input-combination of the 5 UPS limbs is the best one, which curve is the most smooth, and the peak value is the lowest.

articleTitle: Algorithm research on GPS-based bus-stop auto-announcement system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Aiming at improving the accuracy of bus-stop auto announcement system, based on the Cohen-Sutherland line clipping algorithm, an improved algorithm is proposed. We can divide bus-stop area into 5 parts according longitude and latitude, with only one given collection point. Meanwhile, no collection azimuth angle is needed. According to region code and track code, pulling in judgment and pulling out judgment could be deduced. Accurate judgment could also be available when vehicles turn round. The test result shows that improved algorithm is real-time, keen and feasible.

articleTitle: Based on different loading areas of steel structure framework simulation research of fire resistance performance
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on finite element analysis software ANSYS, a company warehouse properties of door type steel frame structure has been studied under the action of fire. Taking the whole structure as research object, the paper used beam element and shell element to simulate the column, prime beam, second beam and concrete slab in the structure respectively. When linking the slab and the beam by beam connection and linking the column and the beam by pin connection at the same time, the influences of the whole structure have been considered based on different areas affected by fire. The results of analysis draw three conclusions. Firstly, large-span and strong constraints beam of structure and column-beam joint are the adverse regions affected by fire. Secondly, the column which bears multiple components is the weak link of steel structure. Finally, it is the temperature gradient in the direction of slab thickness that plays a crucial role in the ability of the overall fire resistance of steel structure.

articleTitle: Study on the method of use hot-box to calibrate heat flux sensor
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As the heat flux sensor calibration's using conditions and the conditions of demarcate the sensor is inconsistent coefficient C, it would results in large measurement errors when using Heat flow meter to detect the heat transfer coefficient of the wall. This Article is research on the methods that applicate the hot-box to demarcate the heat flux sensor calibration coefficients C. The results show that using flat tests to calibrate the heat flux sensor's coefficient C is 12.2%~18.9% smaller than applicating the protective box. Utilization protective box to calibrate heat flow meter is feasible, and the methods is simple, high precision, convenient and quick.

articleTitle: Theoretical simulation and experimental study of phosphorus concentration profiles in laser doped crystalline silicon solar cells
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a nonlinear numerical model of laser heating on crystalline silicon solar cells has been established based on the thermodynamic method. According to the non-steady temperature field gained by finite difference method, variation characteristics of melt front as a function of time are described during laser melting of crystalline silicon. Considering the features of liquid phase diffusion of phosphorus atoms in melting silicon, theoretical simulation for phosphorus diffusion behavior and the evolution of phosphorus concentration profiles at various times are achieved by the image method. The theoretical phosphorus concentration profile is in good agreement with the corresponding experimental ECV data.

articleTitle: The application of GPRS remote wireless automatic monitoring system to Health Monitoring in Guangdong Science Center
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces the technology of Structural Health Monitoring. It also presents the application of remote wireless automatic health monitoring system based on GPRS in Guangdong Science Center. Some conclusions are reached, which could be useful in the similar engineering.

articleTitle: Analysis of the problems and causes in defining soil and water loss control responsibility areas of development projects
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Whether the soil and water loss control responsibility areas are reasonably difined or not, directly related to the control duties and responsibilities of the project construction units, it's also the basis for the water conservancy administrative departments to supervise, inspect and receiving. This article discussed several problems in defining water and soil erosion control responsibility areas, such as the ambiguousness of the concept of soil and water loss control responsibility areas, the unclearness of the limitation of the influencing areas, the unsuitability contraction or expansion of soil and water loss control responsibility areas and so on. Furthermore, it analyzed the reasons of the inaccurate definition, and prospected the future situation of soil and water conservation.

Author Keywords: soil and water loss control responsibility areas

articleTitle: Study on the structural form selection of high-rise building with MATLAB self-organizing competitive neural network
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As the civil engineering technology development, the structural form selection is more and more important in the design of high-rise building. However, due to the structural from selection of high-rise building is a very complex issue, this paper proposed a kind of method of MATLAB self-organizing competitive neural network for the structural form selection of the high-rise building. The results show that the method is feasible and can help designers select the appropriate structure.

articleTitle: A research of similarity design of collision guardrails under the overpass
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to solve the safety problem of different grades roads and crashworthy capacity of overpass design, to meet the traffic safety requirements under different conditions, by using similar principle, several overpass crashworthy barrier in different levels had been gotten here, and had been proved to have better adaptability. In preliminary work, the optimum structure parameter of SH overpass crashworthy barrier had been gotten through orthogonal test, and this research is also based on the orthogonal test majorization result. During the similarity design, the similarity design for every parameter of barrier would be done through measuring the impact force, and to get the optimum structure parameters of overpass crashworthy barriers in different degrades. Finally, every group similarity majorization result had been checked, and the result showed that different grades crashworthy barrier which based on similarity principle design could meet the safety requirements for different crashworthy grades overpasses. This design not only could reduce cost, but also had better suitability and engineering utility.

articleTitle: The design and dynamics analysis of trajectory correction actuator with canard
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A new concept two-dimension trajectory correction system based on canard is presented through analyzing researches of trajectory correction at home and abroad. Design considerations and method is proposed. By the establishment of dynamic model and feasibility analysis of the new system, the result indicates that the structure is simple and the action is reliable under the system requirements. Method here would be built better foundation for further engineering design and experiments for systems of the two-dimensional trajectory correction.

articleTitle: Study on rheology property of muddy clay
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on a lot of laboratory tests, the creep behavior of muddy clay is studied when unloading. The changes of heave ratio, void ratio and heave modulus under different stress levels and unloading ratios are discussed in detail. The result indicates the relation between void ratio and log-time is linear, and the heave modulus decreases sharply with time and is 2-7 times as much as compression modulus when test is at the steady stage of soil sample heave.

articleTitle: Stabilization and tracking precision improved based on disturbance observer
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the kinematics of semi-strapdown seeker, the framework coordinate of the semi-strapdown seeker is established and the optical axis stabilization equation of semi-strapdown seeker is deduced based on product of exponential (POE) formula. The stabilization control principle block diagram of semi-strapdown seeker is shown based on the stabilization equation. The main influence factors of the stability precision are pointed out, such as friction disturbance, velocity measurement noise and missile disturbance. For the sake of improving the stabilization precision and tracking precision, disturbance observer was proposed in the inner loop of semi-strapdown seeker servo-control system. The low frequency external disturbance and high frequency velocity measurement noise are effectively restrained by the disturbance observer as shown in hardware-in-loop simulation, and optical axis stabilization precision and tracking precision are greatly improved.

articleTitle: Analysis of inhomogeneously filled cavities by vector finite element method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Accurate analysis of inhomogeneously filled cavities by vector finite element method (VFEM) is presented in this paper. A generalized theory is presented and a tetrahedral subdivision element is exerted for the analysis of inhomogeneously loaded cavities. As a validation, the resonant frequencies of the rectangular and cylindrical cavities filled with dielectric of different types are computed and a comparison with analytical results is made. The examples show excellent flexibility and efficiency of the VFEM method in analysing inhomogeneously filled cavities.

articleTitle: Analysis of deformations of a machine tools' beam caused by linear motor's normal force
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Loads of two linear guides have been analyzed by mechanics theory. A simplified mechanical model of Permanent Magnet Linear Synchronous Motor (PMLSM) feeding system is established with a VH1100 high-speed vertical machining centers as the object of study. On the basis of the simplified mechanical model, when moving parts are in different stroke of X-axis, deformation of a gantry type beam has been analyzed by finite element method. Deformation of the beam has been measured. The normal force of PMLSM has been achieved by finite element simulation and relevant experiments. The simulation results are in good agreement with measured data, indicating the accuracy of the model.

articleTitle: Study on the CO concentration upper limit in highway tunnel
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to perfect criterion of CO concentration upper limit in the design of ventilation system for road tunnel, the influence of CO on person is analyzed, and the influence is judged by the COHb concentration made in human blood. On the basis of Coburn-Forster-Kane model, the relationship between CO concentration and COHb concentration in human blood is analyzed. Then the relationship between the time the vehicles passing through the tunnel and the CO concentration upper limit is obtained. The influence of altitude, ventilation type and traffic situation on the CO concentration upper limit is also analyzed here. Forming all these results in table, comparing with the CO concentration upper limit of criterion, it's clear that the longer the time requires passing through the tunnel, the higher the value is in criterion. The result can be used to guide design of ventilation system for road tunnel.

articleTitle: Study of available wind resources in the built environment
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to wind characteristics in the built environment, favorable conditions of wind power in the built environment were represented. Some indexes which evaluate available wind resources in the built environment were first put forward, and wind resources of three basic building forms integrated with wind turbines were discussed, which can be a reference to the promotion and application of wind power in the built environment.

articleTitle: Research progress and prospect of testing and application technology of highway snow-melting agent at home and abroad
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The strong corrosive, low environmental protection and improper use of highway chloride snow-melting agent would result in transport infrastructure severe corrosion, reduce their service life and cause environmental hazards so that the economic and environmental losses are greater than snowmelt efficacy. So far, it is a difficult problem which has not been solved at home and abroad. Firstly, the paper systemically reviewed the updated research progress of corrosion and environmental hazards of highway chloride snow-melting agent internationally and nationally, which have reference meanings for reducing the transport infrastructure corrosion and environmental hazards caused by highway snow-melting agent in China. Secondly, testing and application technology of highway snow-melting agent are stated. On this basis, some key problems needed to be solved in the study of highway snow-melting agent are pointed out. Finally, the future development and research directions of highway snow-melting agent are discussed.

articleTitle: Research on new magnetic roller for magnetite preselection with discarding tailings
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: That magnetite preselection with discarding tailings can effectively improve the grinding ore grade, which reduces the production costs, so we designed a kind of new magnetic roller. The magnetic separator is constituted by several modular magnetic rollers, whose magnetic system with fan-shaped and annular magnet, Considering magnetic field strength and magnetic depth, this paper manufactured a small prototype based on characteristic theory of magnetic field, then had an experimental study on lean magnetite of Baiyunebo West Mine. Through the discarding tailings test, TFe grade increase 8 percentage points, tailings grade is less than 13%, and tailings cast rate is 56%.

articleTitle: Evaluation of competitive capacity about regional mineral resources based on dynamic coordinated development
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Mineral resources offer foundations and security for socioeconomic development. Whether competitiveness of mineral resources is strong or not directly determines the level of mining development and capacity of mineral resources supply. Based on the meaning of competitive capacity of mineral resources, this paper specifies its connotation and establishes a comprehensive competitiveness assessment index system of regional mineral resources after integrated analysis of various impact factors on competitiveness of regional mineral resources. The system involves three aspects: development degree of competitiveness of mineral resources, continuation degree of competitiveness of mineral resources and coordination degree of competitiveness of mineral resources, covers five subordinate systems: mineral resources endowment, exploitation of mineral resources, mining market development, influence from eco-environment and socio-economic support and 22 assessment indicators. Combining with analysis and calculation of each indicator, a simple and practical analysis assessment model is established which offers practical research methods and ideas for launching research of competitive capacity of regional mineral resources.

articleTitle: Research on fault polygon extraction and smoothing method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a method of fault polygon extraction and smoothing. It uses boundary tracking algorithm to extract breakpoint locations to form polygon file, and uses parameters of angles between fault polygonal lines as well as edge length and so on to do the work of smoothing, on condition that it keeps its original shape. This method improves the visual effect and aesthetic extent and offers a better way for seismic data interpretation. Based on seismic image validation in many areas by Daqing Oilfield, this method can effectively extract fault polygons and deburr, having a very significant effect on smoothing.

articleTitle: Fluid-solid coupling analysis of safety of waterproof gate
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A FLAC-3D fluid-solid numerical simulation was performed to analyze the stability and anti-water ability of the waterproof gate. Analysis indicates that under water pressure 10.3MPa, the structure of underground chamber of waterproof gate and surrounding rock mass are under plastic state partially, but are basically stable and usable. In case of water filling in the tunnel, water seepage amount is closely related to and directly proportional to water pressure. Most of the seepage spread to the surrounding rock, with only a little seeping into the underground chamber and the tunnel. Due to large seepage amount in the longer water-filled tunnel and the limited capacity of high-pressure pump, it is almost impossible to realize 10.3MPa water injection test though the waterproof gate can meet utilization requirements, which fully proves the necessity of performing numerical simulation. The result shows that the FLAC-3D based fluid-solid coupling analysis on waterproof gate is more practical and effective, which provides a reliable analysis method with a very good application prospect.

articleTitle: Influence of processing parameters of semicircular drawbead on the critical blankholder force for drawing cone part
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Accoding to the geometry of semicircular drawbead and the mechanics characteristic of the blank during drawing cone part with drawbead, the maximum blankholder force for avoid inner-buckle are critically calculated. And the influence of processing parameters of drawbead on the critical blankholder force are studied. Then increasing radius of the drawbead, the resistance of drawbead decrease so that the critical blankholder force increase and the reasonable range of blankholder force enlarge, and the critical blankholder force decrease with increase of drawbead hightness so that the reasonable range of blankholder force lessen.

articleTitle: Performance optimization of miller cycle apply on a natural gas engine
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Natural gas is a relatively ideal clean alternative energy, but the higher ignition temperature, the slower flame propagation speed and the smaller coefficient of molecular after the combustion all result in lower thermal efficiency. Miller cycle is based on changing the intake valve closing time to achieve high expansion ratio than compression ratio, therefore it can improve the thermal efficiency to some extent. In this paper, the engine performance of applying the Miller cycle on a nature gas engine is studied using GT-Power, and optimized for different levels of compression ratio and for different engine spend. Simulation results indicated that, after applying the Miller cycle engine full load power and fuel combustion rate get worse at low engine speed but improved at high speeds. Also the compression pressure and temperature are lower, which reduces engine knocking tendency and formation rate of harmful exhaust gas emissions. The best intake valve timing for different engine speed and loads needs careful calibration.

articleTitle: Prototype development of AN 8mm-band two dimensional interferometric synthetic aperture radiometer
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A prototype of 8mm band two dimensional Intererometric Synthetic Aperture Radiometer (InSARad) has been developed in the Electromagnetics Laboratory of BeiHang University. It consists of a Y-shaped antenna array with 24 antenna/receiver elements, a FPGA based 1bit/2levels digital cross-correlation unit and a data processing subsystem. The primary testing and imaging experiments have been carried out, and the initial results are encouraging. The instrument overview, calibration method, and preliminary imaging results are presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Fast VETSFD-TDFEM for 2-D electromagnetic scattering analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The Volumetric Excitation method in Total- and Scattered-Field Decomposition (VETSFD) technique is applied to Time Domain Finite Element Method (TDFEM) for some electromagnetic scattering analysis of representative 2-D objects. The detailed algorithms of VETSFD-TDFEM are presented in this paper. The numerical leakage of the presented VETSFD-TDFEM is -HOdB in absence of scatterer, which is much less than that of Huygen's surface method. Furthermore, the presented method is accelerated with OpenMP parallelization technique and the efficiency of TDFEM is improved consequently. The bistatic Radar Cross Section (RCS) of some representative objects are computed, which demonstrate that the given fast VETSFD-TDFEM is an efficient and accurate method for wideband electromagnetic scattering analysis of complex objects.

articleTitle: Factorial decomposition of GHGs emissions of Taiwan electricity production
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper examines the sources and paths of greenhouse gases (GHGs) emissions of Taiwan electricity generation 1982-2009. The components of the electricity production were analyzed by applying factorial decomposition method. The model regarding the linkage between primary energy use, economic output and GHGs emissions intensity of electricity generation of Taiwan are derived. The major effects of the emissions include economic output effect, electricity intensity, thermal power shares effect, and emissions intensity of thermal power. Results of the fuel input of the thermal power analysis also showed that the fuel generation mix effect is the major component of the emissions. The fuel input efficiency factors, fuel input per kWh, have negative effect on emissions intensity of the thermal electricity, but the effect is small. In order to sustain the economic performances of Taiwan social/economic needs, low carbon technologies like renewables or energy efficiency should be developed in the future.

articleTitle: Formation of soluble microbial products (SMP) in an anaerobic sludge system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A bench-scale experiment has been carried out to investigate the formation of soluble microbial products in an anaerobic baffled reactor (ABR) treating buffered synthetic glucose substrate (about 500mg COD/L) under mesophilic temperatures. Generally, SMP production increased with decreasing temperature. A higher SMP to soluble chemical oxygen demand (SCOD) ratio was found at high temperature because of complete volatile fatty acid degradation. SMP accounted for amount to 0.85 of the SCOD in the effluent of the ABR. The performance of each compartment under organic load shock was different. In general, the fluctuation of SMP concentration in acidogenesis zone was bigger than in methanogenic zone which probably due to more SMPs are produced during acidogenesis than during methanogenesis. The other reason probally was the microorganisms in the rear compartment extremely deficient in nutrients and the SMP was partially consumed as a secondary metabolite.

articleTitle: Development of an intelligent modeling system for detailed design of steel Industrial plant structures
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The primary program principles and techniques of the development of integrated CAD software for detailed design of steel Industrial plant structures, including the frame work, hierarchic data structure, 3D modeling algorithm and automatic generation of 2D drawings and CNC data, are introduced. An intelligent modeling system for detailed design is developed. In the modeling system, a 3D solid model can be easily constructed. Moreover, structure properties and design requirements are integrated into the intelligent model. Therefore, details of the structure can be designed automatically and edited visually according to design knowledge, and 2D drawings and CNC data can be generated automatically.

articleTitle: Study of EMP effects experiment on the solid state relay
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: An experiment of EMP effects on the solid state relay is described. In order to get the radiation interference threshold value of the relay, the length of the connection is cut as short as possible. The radiation interference threshold value is found to be superior to 75kV/m. By using capacitor coupling, the conduction interference voltage threshold value 3850V is found. The experiment results also show that the EMP interference at the input port of the relay can induce transient switching on, which can cause misworking.

articleTitle: Information scheduling optimization algorithm based on FlexRay
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to meet future communications with high fault tolerance, high reliability and real-time, etc., the Information Scheduling on the FlexRay were studied in this article. According to the analysis of the information scheduling and delay characteristics, propose optimization scheduling algorithm based on the principle of balance, and improve the bandwidth utilization of FlexRay.

articleTitle: Conductivity and mechanical properties study of steel fiber reinforced graphite conductive concrete
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the conductive properties of ordinary concrete are improved through adding a certain proportion of steel fiber and graphite. For the production of electrically conductive concrete were electrified with both AC and DC. Then its conductivity and mechanical properties were compared to do a number of pilot studies.

articleTitle: Analyses on factors influenced top-coal caving of fully mechanized mining for thick coal seam
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: For the actual implementation of fully-mechanized caving mining in thick coal seam in China, systems analysis of the influence factors of top coal capability, including natural geological factors and technology factors. Influence factors of top coal capability, constitute analysis of fully mechanized caving coal loss, thereby reducing loss of coal, improve mining rate of fully mechanized caving is the urgent need to solve a problem. Reasonable choice of caving top coal caving technology and determine the appropriate parameter is the main measure of improving coal recovery ratio, analysis and solution of these problems in ensuring mine achieve stable yield, high yield, high efficiency, high recovery ratio of main technical means.

articleTitle: The research and implementation of vehicle tracking system based on color histogram
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A set of solutions for vehicle tracking module of intelligent transportation system is proposed. A vehicle tracking system based on color histogram distance and binary information is implemented. The System solves camera calibration, vehicle moving prediction, vehicle tracking and other issues. Three experiment under different scenarios results that the accuracy of the vehicle identification up to 90%. The system can fluently run on common equipments, can meet the real-time demand, and has good adaptability.

articleTitle: Test of post-fire bearing capacity of ceramsite concrete filled steel columns after exposure to fire
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The experimental investigation of post-fire mechanical behavior of a set of unprotected short columns of ceramsite concrete filled steel tubes (CCFST) are conducted, variation of residual bearing capacity of the short columns of CCFST after exposure to fire are discussed. Based on the test results, effect of the factors, such as dimension of cross section of the specimen, concrete mix proportion on the post-fire bearing capacity were especially investigated. It is shown that the CCFST short columns after exposure to fire have higher post-fire bearing capacity and better ductility, and there was no descent segment in load-displacement curves of the most specimens. It was concluded that effect law of the maximum value of response temperatures on bearing capacity of CCFST short columns after exposure to fire is related to some key parameters of the specimen which are mix proportion, dimension of cross section of the specimens. It is shown that the post-fire bearing capacity of the CCFST short columns decreases with increment of water cement ratio of the concrete of the specimens subjected to fire load.

articleTitle: Measurement techniques for multiphase flow in productivity evaluation in petroleum industry
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: DST is now partly replaced by pumpout wireline formation tester in fluid sampling and reservoir productivity evaluation. With the successful development of the ERCT wireline tester in China, it is important to make advantage of the ERCT's large volume pumping capability, continuous testing property, complete sampling function and various fluid identity methods to evaluate reservoir more precisely with the tool's testing data and sampling information. The variation of gas and liquid compressibility factors are studied. And the measurement software is programmed, which can fit the testing pressure of pump chamber stochastically and dynamically, calculate the bubble point pressure of formation fluid automatically according to the slope of the fitted curve. And then whether there is multiphase flow in the reservoir will be judged. Finally the productivity of the reservoir will be evaluated. The research of this paper has great theoretical and application reference. And applications of this research in a well of wireline formation test by COSL have obtained favorable effectiveness.

articleTitle: The research on the energy-saving ways of the electric transmission on the bridge crane
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the background of energy-saving, this paper analyzes the relevant ways of energy-saving of the crane. From four kinds of different speed control, it analyzes their mechanical properties, energy consuming and the influence on dynamic load factor. It gets that speed control by frequency variation has the least impact on grid and the smooth speed. At last, thinking about the energy feedback, energy loss will further reduce.

articleTitle: Preparation of diclofop-methyl enantiomers by a semi-preparative high-performance liquid chromatography
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A chiral stationary phase (CSP) was prepared by coating cellulose tris(4-methylbenzoate) (CTMB) onto aminopropylated silica gel. Chiral herbicide diclofop-methyl (DM) was well resolved on analytical coated-CTMB CSP using 85/15 n-hexane/isopropanol as the mobile phase by high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), and the semi-preparation of DM enantiomers was conducted by the semi-chromatography. With a concentration 10000 ppm and a 20 µL loop, the yields of (+)-DM and (−)-DM were 1.590 mg/h and 1.583 mg/h, respectively.

articleTitle: Parameters and process of electrochemical machining of blades
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Electrochemical processing is processing techniques combined electric spark machining with digital control machine technology. Electrolytic process generating method is used to cast the impeller blades and hub surface. It is effective method to improve the accuracy of the impeller to reduce flow resistance . The shape of the cathode tool is taper shank ball. According to the experimental data is used to determine the processing parameters.The five-axis CNC EDM machine is used to complete the turbine blades and hub of the surface processing. Machined surface roughness gets to the design requirements.

articleTitle: Design on SOC module-level functional verification platform
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In the traditional IP verification methodology, module level verification platform have limitations such as uncontrollability, low efficiency, huge workload, long verification time and poor reusability. To resolve these problems, a SOC function verification virtual platform based on bus transaction level strategy is proposed. The virtual verification platform is composed of system component function models, which are described by high level abstraction modeling methods. The platform provides incentives in bus transaction mode based on simulation. The experimental results of practical application show that the platform can improve IP verification efficiency and enhance IP verification reusability. The practical construction and methodology can be used in other function verification platform.

articleTitle: Prediction model in correcting distortion for elevator guide rail base on FEM method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As the elevator's guidance system, the elevator guide rail is an important component affecting the safety and comfortableness of elevator. Its distortion degree is an important factor to restricting the development of express elevator. FEM software ABAQUS is used to analyze the correcting method for six initial distortion degree rail in this thesis, the plan of dividing into different steps is put foreword, numerical simulation of correcting stroke parameter for every distortion degree is finished, and obtain satisfactory results, then get the T guide rail's correcting stroke prediction model based on the parameter.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of a new set of fully nonlinear Boussinesq wave equations
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A new form of second-order fully nonlinear Boussinesq wave equations is established by introducing four parameters, with linear dispersion, shoaling and nonlinearity properties improvement and without having its mathematical form changed, and the new equations are fit for deeper water and can give good results of wave transformation from deep to shallow water, and a numerical model is established to show the effectiveness of the new equations when wave translates over an elliptic shoal.

articleTitle: For the pressurized water on the coal-mining exploration review
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the deep development of coal mining, the underground mining will face serious threats to the confined aquifer, mining under safe water pressure of aquifer has become the main way to mine deep coal resources. At the same time, the auxiliary waterproof method is particularly important to adapt to the mining. Faced with the mining technological challenges in the deep coal mining, with the analysis of the advantages and disadvantages of the retreating and advancing mining, comparing with their applicable condition, the retreating mining become a main mining method. Then according to the critical water-inrush coefficient to decide whether the danger of water-inrush exists in this mine, combining with the water pressure, thickness of water-resisting layer, fault-dip, critical water-inrush coefficient and so on to design reasonable size of waterproof pillar. Finally, the way with the assistant of the waterproof pillar and the retreating mining of underground mining becomes the major mining type. With those, we can be sure of the safety mining in the confined aquifer and prevent the flooded Wells accidents efficiently.

Author Keywords: mining under safe water pressure of aquifer

articleTitle: Deformation properties of diaphragm wall due to deep foundation pit of subway station in Ningbo soft soil
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to the field measured data of a deep foundation pit of subway station of Ningbo rail transit, the paper studies the varieties of deformation rate and cumulative deformation along with excavation time, and estimates the proportion of deformation under different construction phases based on 450 monitoring data of 4 deep foundation pits. The result shows that the main deformation of diaphragm wall due to deep foundation pit of subway station in Ningbo soft soil happens in the third and the forth phases, and these two conditions should be the key point of hierarchical control.

articleTitle: Field experiments on triaxial mixing pile reinforcing the extra-deep starting and ending well of shield tunnel
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Shield excavation starting and ending is the important thing for shield tunnel, which more attention should be paid to. Therefor, field experiments on the triaxial mixing pile have been made in the reinforced engineering for shield excavation starting and ending of Wuxi city. The experiments explore the both of mixing control and effectiveness tests. Mixing control should have a focus on cement adding contents, water-cement-ratio of cement paste, and the matching relation between the cement paste flow and drill pipes' speed. Effectiveness test should have a focus on uniformity, unconfined compressive strength testing in the laboratory and the impermeability of pile samples. And the triaxial mixing pile drill and cutting tool has been improved, which enhance the efficiency of drilling. The results have directive value to the reinforced engineering for shield excavation starting and ending of Wuxi city.

articleTitle: A novel design for the receiver of SAW reader
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: DC-offset and 1/f noise are serious deficiencies of zero-IF receiver that it is limited in the application. A novel zero-IF receiver solution is presented to solve the problems about the DC-offset and 1/f noise of zero-IF. A receiver of the 915MHz SAW reader is designed, basing on the novel solution. The simulation platform of the circuit model and the communication system model are built under the environment of ADS. The parameters of each module are determined by calculating and simulating, combing ADIsimRF with ADS software in the receiver. The correctness of the receiver's model is verified by the bit error rate simulation with communication system model. The furthest distance for receiver identification is 12 m, while its bit error rate is smaller than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup>.

articleTitle: The study on Size effect of fracture toughness of test of undisturbed frozen soils based on Gray theory
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the previous undisturbed frozen field test, the research and analysis on the Size effect of fracture toughness K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">IC</sub> of vertical crack and herringbone crack of undisturbed frozen soils specimens of test I is performed emphatically, and it is found the rules that it varies with volume change. Meanwhile, a theoretical prediction by using the Gray System Theory methods is made and the theoretical prediction results K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">IC</sub> has been gotten, which is compared with the results of the test and the error fits the accuracy requirement. Thus it has been made a meaningful exploration for the research method of Size effect of fracture toughness K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">IC</sub> of test I of undisturbed frozen soils.

articleTitle: Calculation of groundwater use by natural vegetation in the non-irrigated plain areas in Xinjiang
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper takes the non-irrigated plain areas in Xinjiang as the study area, where the natural vegetation draws water mainly from the shallow groundwater to satisfy its demands. Through interpretation of TM satellite images and hydro-geological investigations, understanding of the unsaturated strata, shallow water depth, distribution and coverage of natural vegetation was obtained. Based on calculation units divided by using GIS techniques and data of shallow water evapo-transpiration from the typical area groundwater balancing experimental stations, parameters of phreatic water evaporation and vegetation conversion parameters were decided and thus the total groundwater use by the natural vegetation in the study area is calculated as 63.7762×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup>m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/a under current conditions.

articleTitle: Study on car body vibration transmissibility analysis approach for railway passenger carriage
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the analysis of car body vibration sources for railway passenger carriage, and combined with a vibration transmissibility test which was carried out at a passenger compartment of high-speed train, this article elaborated the car body vibration transmissibility analysis approach which established by coherence function method and transfer function method. In this way, available vibration contribution order, vibration work force and transmission attenuation law and more would be acquired, which all would be the foundation for further optimizing the structure of car body, extending the fatigue life of component and improving the ride comfort. The conclusion confirmed that the analysis approach of car body vibration transmissibility for railway passenger carriage was feasible.

articleTitle: Optimization of the level of SS crash barrier Overpass Bridge on highway
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on traffic specification, the characteristics of traffic accidents on highway Overpass Bridge and current security situation associated, a new barrier has been developed to satisfy the requirement to endure the crash from large truck. To obtain the optimal structural parameters of barrier, an orthogonal method is applied to determine the vehicle- crash to barrier model that enables the simulation to 25 sets of cross-section parameters, in which design variations are 6 parameters from barrier cross-section and for each variation considerate 5 levels. Then, SPSS method is applied to analyze the 25 sets of experiment results. Consequently, parameters' effects on barrier performances are analyzed. Finally, a validation is performed based on optimal structural parameters obtained by analysis of SPSS. The result demonstrates the proposed barrier can prevent trucks of rolling and climbing effectively. Thus, overpass bridge pier is well protected. The barrier designed in this work has a good application characteristic.

articleTitle: Strength finite element analysis of 130t liquid iron tank lifting lug
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As a kind of large metallurgy equipment, liquid iron tank was used more widely. This paper took 130t liquid iron tank as an example. Three dimensions solid model of liquid iron tank lifting lug was constructed by ANSYS software in this paper. Grid division, restriction, load and strength finite element analysis were also made on relevant computation model. The relevant equivalent stress distribution rule of liquid iron tank lifting lug was found. The position of maximum equivalent stress was found. Liquid iron tank lifting lug can satisfy the use demand under slow lifting up working condition was proved. This analysis provides a practical and effective research method for research the strength and reliability of liquid iron tank. It also provides a theory base for corporation to recast and design liquid iron tank.

articleTitle: Free-standing TiO2 nanotube arrays fabricated by anodization
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: We review the preparation technology and applied research of free-standing TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> nanotube arrays films fabricated by anodization. The free-standing films are detached from Ti foil by employing the chemical etching, methanol evaporation induction, ultrasonic processing and preparation condition regulation, and the technological characteristics, film characters and their applied research are reviewed. At last, the research trends and applied inspections are prospected.

articleTitle: Design of electrostatic velocimetry correlator used in gas-solid two-phase flow
