publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The velocity of solid particles in gas-solid two-phase flow is an important parameter, which can reflect the flow condition of gas-solid two-phase flow. However, it is difficult to be measured. The electrostatic sensor combined with correlation technique provides a proper solution to the velocity measurement of gas-solid two-phase flow. The digital signal controller dsPIC33F, which has the advantages of MCU and DSP, had been used in the design of embedded correlator. This correlator has the advantages of simple structure, good real-time performance, high reliability and low power consumption. Through the experiments on the belt electrostatic induction apparatus, this system can meet the requirement of the velocity measurement of gas-solid two-phase flow.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study of NURBS-based multi-axis NC milling tool path generation algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis and optimization of the slide block of YQK-1250 hydraulic machine based on ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study on the removal of nitrate from water by Fe/C micro-electrolysis process
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The removal of nitrate by micro-electrolysis process was studied. According to principles of micro-electrolysis, the reaction column was fed with iron filings and granular activated carbon. By controlling pH value, NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> - N concentration, HRT, aeration, the influence of these factors were investigated. The results showed that when at the case of 1~2.5 of pH value, 40 mg/L of NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>-N, 90 min of HRT,180~260 of air/water rate, 4:3 of Fe/C(cubage), 68% denitrification rate was achieved. The pH value and aeration amount has a lager influence on the treatment effect. The removal of nitrate by micro-electrolysis process was effective.

articleTitle: Reasonable coal pillar size design in Xiaoming mine
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The pillar size has great influence not only on the stability of surrounding rock, but also on the recovery rate of coal resources, which directly affects the economic benefits of coal. According to XiaoMing tiefa coalmining group geological conditions and the use of coal pillar, it adopts field measurement, numerical simulation and theory calculation methods to get small coal pillar width and reasonable wide size of coal pillar. Use rock stratum detect to find out the fissures, faults, broken area; analyze the coal pillar stress and displacement distribution of the different pillar widths (3, 5, 8, 10,15and20m) by FLAC2D simulation of numerical simulation software, determine a reasonable size finally.lt provides a guarantee of security for the exploitation of the mine.

articleTitle: The application of ultrasonic flowmeter on trade measurement in Yulin gas field
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the working principle and system components of ultrasonic flowmeter are briefly introduced In accordance with ultrasonic flowmeter applicated in YuLin gas field, comparing the transmission error of upper and lower streams measurement on this basis, the pre-Operation measurement error and actual flow test/ calibration are explored and analyzed, and for the better use of ultrasonic flowmeter, authors put forward their understanding and recommendations.

articleTitle: Analysis of vertically freezing reinforcement for shield launching and accessing on load-structure model
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Vertically freezing is a reliable method of reinforcement for shield launching and accessing. Engineers often use Japanese formula to determine the thickness of the reinforcement. At the same time, some engineers use another formula, which is deduced by the elastic theory about circular plate under different constraints. By finite element analysis on load-structure model this paper discusses the constraint characteristic of the reinforcement under different design parameters to judge the rationality of existing design method. Analysis results suggest that the Japanese formula is conservative. This paper presents modified calculation methods of maximum tensile stress, maximum deflection and maximum shear stress, and provides a new design method.

articleTitle: Analysis on flexibility of industrial welding robots and simulation research
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the authors are analyze the work space of industrial welding robots by employing Monte Carlo methods (MC) and kinematical analysis, and provide a way to determine conveniently whether or not a hollow or cavity exists in the work space through simulation. By employing the concept of flexibility, flexibility ration and service sphere, the authors are also to analyze the flexibility of any point in the work space of the robots, and to obtain the flexible work space, which provides reference basis for the follow-up development of industrial welding robots in terms of improving their performance and the flexibility in the workspace.

articleTitle: Subgrade moisture content forecast based on probability of precipitation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The correlation between subgrade water content and precipitation in Tacheng and Altay was analyzed, to determine the range of subgrade water content with different precipitation probabilities. According to the statistical analysis of historical data of precipitation, precipitation intervals with different reliabilities were calculated by interval estimation method. Humidity sensors were buried to observed the subgrade water content and precipitation in the same period, then the subgrade water content with different precipitation probabilities were obtained by establishing the functional relationship between subgrade moisture content and precipitation. The results showed that, there was a good correlation between subgrade moisture content and precipitation. The precipitation interval were [14.8,19.6], [15.2,19.2] and [15.4 , 19.0] when reliability were 95%, 90%, 85% The subgrade water content intervals were [3.97,4.31], [4.01,4.28] and [4.02,4.27] with precipitation probability of 95% 90% 85%.

articleTitle: Research of China's industrial sustainable development facing climate change
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Global climate change is having a profound impact on the human well-being and development, which has become a great concern and challenge for the world-wide governments. Industry, as the most important trade that consumes energy and resources, is our main direction to achieve the goals of reducing carbon intensity emission. This paper first analyzes the opportunities as well as challenges which the industry in China is faced up to as a consequence of climate change. Then, it mainly refers to our achievements in energy saving and emission reduction. On the basis, it points out that we should take the road of sustainable development by means of developing circular economy and promoting low Carbon technology to cope with climate change.

articleTitle: Study on stress and deformation of support pillar of vacuum flat glazing
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Vacuum glazing is a new energy-saving material; the damage of it is caused mainly by the tensile stress. Shape and parameters of support pillars are the key factors causing stress and deformation of glass. In this paper, stress distribution and parameters of vacuum glazing effect on stress and deformation have been researched according the Atmospheric effects using finite element method. The paper suggests that contact areas between support pillar deformed and glass are the key factors which affect forces and deformation of support pillars, also basis for shape options and preferential conditions for support pillars' structure.

articleTitle: Stress analysis of high-strength bolts for steel box
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The biggest overhead gantry is studied in this paper, which has the biggest span and bearing capacity in the world. With sub-model technology, the rule of the mechanics performance on the high-strength bolts is studied. Compared with the traditional calculation method, the sub-model technology shows its accuracy, validity and reliability in analyzing large steel structure as well as the conservatism of the traditional calculation method which can be enhanced greatly.

articleTitle: DFT accurate amplitude, phase and frequency analysis method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: DFT accurate amplitude, phase and frequency analysis method is proposed in this paper, which takes full advantage of the relationship between apFFT(all phase FFT) and traditional FFT, and the character of apFFT not changing the signal's phase. The method resolves the errors that exist when the spectrum line is not on the peak position when implemented DFT on the signal, with clear definition and simple algorithm .The frequency error is little than 0.00006 frequency resolution and the phase error is little than 0.0000001 and the amplitude error is little than 0.02%, so the method has great value.

articleTitle: Analysis on shear stress in interlayer interface of concrete bride deck pavement
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: For studying the behavior of concrete bride deck pavement, the physiochemical property of interlayer interface was analyzed from microscopic view. Much initial pore and many initial cracks and low strength cement crystals were existed in the interlayer interface because of the cast time difference. A total of 32 samples were tested for studying the shear performance of pre- and post-casting concrete interface and the FEM analysis was done for the same reason. The results show that shear steel is the key factor in shearing of the Interlayer Interface. The shear stiffness and the cracking load are marked increased and the shear property and the service performance are shaped improved while the ratio of shear steel is more than the minimum one.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: An estimation of urban ecosystem health under mode of recycling economy
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The study on noise of main parts of diesel engine based on spectrum analysis technology
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The noise of the main parts of high pressure common-rail diesel engine was analyzed in this paper. The near-field noise of main parts of diesel engine was measured by using spectrum analysis technology, and the noise sources were identified. The results showed that the engine noise was increased rapidly with the increase of speed. With the increase of load, the engine noise was almost kept the same. The main noise sources of the engine were oil pump, oil pan, crankshaft pulley and air cleaner. At low speed, the main noise source was intake air noise of air cleaner. At high speed, the main noise source was oil pan.

articleTitle: Removal of chromium Cr(VI) by electroflocculation process with double-aluminum electrode from wastewater
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Currently chromium Cr(VI) wastewater treatment by traditional chemical methods have many disadvantages. In this work, the optimized conditions of removal chromium Cr(VI) by the electroflocculation with double-aluminum electrode were investigated. The removal efficiency are mainly influenced by pH value, the current density, the distance between two electrodes, the raw concentration of chromium Cr(VI), the concentration of NaCl, the temperature of the solution and sediment time. It has been found that, when the chromium Cr(VI) ion concentration of wastewater was 20mg/L, the optimal treatment condition were pH of 5.0, the current density of 8 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, temperature of 25 °C, the NaCl concentration of 5 mmol, the distance between two electrode of 3cm, the electrolyze time of 1h, the sediment time of of 20min, the removal rate of chromium Cr(VI) can reach 80%.

articleTitle: Improved swing frame of mine trunk based on stress and strain analysis and fatigue life
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Fatigue is an important failure mode for swing frame of mine trunk. However, swing frame have so many attributes that it is difficult to analyze their fatigue damage using experimental measurement methods. In this paper the stress and strain analysis of swing frame is obtained by MSC. Patran software with the help of the dynamic analysis from MSC. Adams software. Improved model of swing frame is made according to stress concentration. The fatigue life predictions of unimproved and improved swing frame are achieved via the theory of cumulative damage in fatigue by MSC. Fatigue software. The results show that the fatigue life of improved swing frame is extended and satisfied with the practical application.

articleTitle: Research on improvement of the sludge odor by using HAS soil stabilizer and mechanism
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The instability of the sludge will cause odor and other environmental pollution in the process of disposal and reuse. HAS soil stabilizer, Lime and Portland cement are used in this paper to modify the sewage. The experimental results showed that added by a certain content of the HAS Soil Stabilizer in sludge would be a good modification effect on removing Ammonia and Hydrogen Sulfide. When the curing time was 14d and the content was 15%, the concentration of Ammonia was 5μg/L and the removal rate could reach 93.5%. When the curing time was 3d and the content was 10% or more, the concentration of Hydrogen Sulfide can be reduced to below 0.06μg/L and the removal rate could reach 95%, conforming to the relative standards. The SEM photos of 15% HAS modified sludge showed that Ettringite and Calcium Silicate hydrate crystals were the mainly hydration products, they formed a kind of three-dimensional crystal network and completely changed the original sludge structure, which effectively prevented the organic matter to further decay, made the sludge stabilized and achieved the improvement of sludge odor.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Instantaneous velocity test system of automatic mechanism driving component based on virtual instrument
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Point error research on fast calculating construction deformation observation control point based on Adobe Acrobat Software and CASIO program
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Adobe Acrobat 7.0 Professional Software can be used in engineering technology. We can conveniently measure the length between the straight lines (two points) and its correspondence increment of coordinate in the drawings by making use of this software function. In addition, we can choose different angle observations and the precise of distance observations (such as electronic tachometer), provide a new method for fast and accurately calculating the error of the traverse point and carrying out the plan of optimized measure and calculation point error by using the programmed calculator fx-4500p as well as the program developed by the author himself.

articleTitle: Feature analysis of industrial solid waste exchange's company in TEDA, Tianjin — A case study of industrial symbiosis in China
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The paper introduces the generation of industrial solid waste exchange, focused on the feature analysis of TEDA industrial solid waste exchange's company. On the basis of analysis on characteristic of industrial waste company, including company's size, consist and location, the paper point out the management situation of reclamation companies.

articleTitle: Research on the approaches of low-carbonization of residential building based on whole life cycle theory
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Under the grim situation of greenhouse gas emissions in China, the low-carbonization approaches in four stages: planning and design, construction, use, and demolition stage was analyzed from the perspective of the whole life cycle theory to reduce carbon emissions in residential buildings. The enhancement of energy saving effect, the use of low carbon building materials, the improvement of energy efficiency and the increase of resource recycling rate are regarded as key measures to achieve Low-carbonization of residential building.

articleTitle: The effects of pre-load magnitude on the radial loading performance of pre-loaded cylindrical roller bearings
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In accordance with the theory of contact mechanics, the radial stiffness, maximum contact stress and maximum radial load of pre-loaded hollow and solid cylindrical roller bearings are simulated with finite element method. And the effects of pre-load magnitude on the radial stiffness, maximum contact stress and maximum radial load of the bearings are researched mainly. The results show that the larger pre-load magnitude is, the larger the radial stiffness, the maximum contact stress and the maximum radial load are. Rational combination of pre-load magnitude and hollow ratio does not only enhance the radial stiffness, but also depress the maximum contact stress. The research offers the references for designing and using the pre-loaded cylindrical roller bearings.

articleTitle: Preparation of chitosan supported by modified bentonite and its discoloration with printing and dyeing wastewater
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The preparation of chitosan supported by modified bentonite and the optimum conditions on its decoloration with printing and dyeing wastewater were studied. The results showed that the concentration of modified sulfuric acid was 1mol/L, and the determination of mass ratio between bentonite and chitosan when supported was 0.03g/g. When dealing with printing and dyeing wastewater, the best conditions were when the shaking rate at 150r/min, the temperature at 30°C, pH value at 6, with the dosage of chitosan supported by modified bentonite at 0.006g per milliliter wastewater, and under this condition the discoloration rate with printing and dyeing wastewater reached 90.5%.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research of detection of a crack on pressure vessel based on both of acoustic emission diagnosis and ultrasonic testing
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Study on ecological compensation mechanism for urban drinking water source areas in Tibet
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the achievement of sustainable development of drinking water source areas in Tibet, the key elements of the ecological compensation for drinking water source areas are discussed by means of theoretical analysis, investigation and model calculation, which include the subject and object, the standards, the patterns and the capital sources. And corresponding ecological compensation mechanism accord with the actual situation of Tibet urban drinking water sources areas is established. This study, which specially pays more attention to how to promote the marketization and the diversification of compensation channels, provides new perspective and scientific reference for the construction and management of drinking water source areas in Tibet.

articleTitle: Spatial analysis of masonry building in earthquake
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the analytic model of continuous deep beam with elastic supports for masonry buildings, this paper analysis the transferring ways of spatial system that is composed of reinforced concrete floor and masonry wall in horizontal seismic action. Three types of floor forms are put forward according to the rigidness of floors and the ratio of the span of floors to the height of masonry wall-rigid diaphragms, semi-rigid diaphragms and flexible diaphragms. The transferring ways of seismic load on the floors to masonry wall were received.

articleTitle: Analysis of the effect of tunnel construction on frame structure buildings in Xiamen Airport Road
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Wu Cun Shan Tunnel in Xiamen Airport Road Phase I Project is a shallow-buried, large-span and hidden-digging tunnel which passes through high-density building cluster under complicated geological conditions. 67 buildings are being influenced by tunnel construction along the tunnel. In order to ensure the safety of surface buildings in the tunnel construction, CRD excavation method are adopted in some sections which initiates a precedent of construction of double-arch tunnel with CRD method in China. The effect of tunnel construction on frame structure buildings is analyzed through site monitoring of surface building settlement, crack development in this paper. The results show that excavation of tunnel face CRD1~5 has the most important influence on the building settlement. The longer the construction period is, the greater building settlement and crack width change, and vice versa. Grouting in the tunnel can decrease building settlement caused by tunnel excavation effectively. The main reason that causes building cracking and development of cracks existed is uneven settlement. And the ability of the building to resist down concave deformation is stronger than that to upper convex deformation. While width variation of cracks lags behind variation of uneven settlement. Cracks caused by tunnel construction mainly distribute around the door and window openings in the longitudinal filler wall and the connection part between frame beam-column and filler wall.

articleTitle: Three-sample rotation vector algorithm with angular rate input
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to research the attitude algorithm with angular rate input under the conical motion, a optimal three-sample rotation vector algorithm based on single-step Newton backward interpolation is proposed. Using the principle of limited rigid body rotation and the characteristic of angular rate input, three-sample rotation vector algorithm is derivated. To minimum attitude errors, three-sample rotation vector algorithm is optimized. Three angular rate extraction methods of single-step entire sample recursion, multi-step entire sample and single-step Newton backward interpolation are proposed. Under the condition of conical motion with semi-cone angle 3° and angular frequency 2πrad/s, simulation is done. The simulation results show that single-step Newton backward interpolation is superior to the other two methods, and its maximum error peak is 0.01°, error drift rate is 0.036°/h. Experiments in three-axis flying turntable with the same parameters are carried out, and the results show that error drift rates of three-channels are less than those of traditional quaternion, which are 13.53%, 12.08% and 23.68% lower respectively. It also verified that the new algorithm can perform a high accuracy under the conical motion.

articleTitle: Supply chain coordination of construction management based on multi-agent
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper designs a multi-agent based framework for supply chain coordination in construction management through adopting the agent technology and regarding the construction supply chain as a typical multi agent system. This framework integrates the specialty agents (contractor agent, designer agent, supplier agent, owner agent) and service agents (coordinator agent, monitor agent, name server agent) into a multi-agent system through the Internet. Since different members in the construction supply chain have different preferences on the decision attributes (such as cost, time, quality, safety and environment), a multi-attribute negotiation mechanism is established by constructing the multi-attribute negotiation model, describing the multi attribute negotiation process, and designing the multi-attribute negotiation protocol. The establishment of this mechanism for construction supply chain coordination is based on negotiation theory and utility theory and aimed at promoting the coordination between specialty agents in it. Finally, the prototype system is developed by using a multi-agent system development environment. The experiment indicates that can solve problems in the construction supply chain operation and provides a solution to supply chain coordination in construction.

articleTitle: Study on reinforced scheme of reinforced loess by triaxial tests
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Loess located in Xi'an were collected. 13 schemes which in different reinforced layers were designed to study the effect of all-round pressure, reinforced layers, reinforced location and layer spacing by traixial tests under 4 kinds of all-round pressure. Through the comparison of normalization strength, it is shown that the principal stress difference decrease along with increase of reinforced layers. In certain range of reinforced layers and layer spacing, the principal stress difference increase along with reinforced layers. Through comparing maximum principal stress of the 13 kinds of scheme and combined with damage form of samples, it is concluded that there was a optimal reinforced position P where the material could be most efficient. Along with increase of reinforced layers, the effect of the plan which put reinforced material equably increased too, then it was explained by equivalent confining pressure principle. In addition, the data also shown that it was not the more and the closer reinforced layers the better, but there was an optimal reinforced layer spacing D, the computing method of D was given by us. The conclusions can be used as guidance for the loess reinforcement project.

articleTitle: A smoke detection algorithm of energy difference between frames based on adaptive LOG operator on the infrared video processing
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: It is conductive to discover the fire or smoke leakage in the monitor region that detecting the smoke area clearly. Firstly, an adaptive LOG algorithm of smoke detection based on energy difference is proposed by the paper. After detecting the enhancement smoke area by energy difference between frames, dynamic accumulation, filtering and extracting smoke leakage position will be performed. The experiment shows, the method proposed by the paper can detect smoke in infrared video perfectly, and avoid the influence that the thermal infrared imager can't detect the leaking location of smoke sensitively because of the radiation of high-temperature field surrounding by.

articleTitle: Influence of groundwater level lowering on working behavior of composite foundation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to study the influences of groundwater level lowering on the working behavior of composite foundation, both applied load and groundwater level lowering for composite foundation are analyzed by numerical analysis method. Considering the interaction between composite foundation, cushion and foundation, the working behaviors of composite foundation, such as the displacement of soil and reinforced piles, skin friction distribution of pile and pile axial stress are studied fore and after groundwater lowering. The results showed that, compared with non-groundwater lowering, the settlement of foundation, including soil and reinforced pile increase, axial stress in pile enhance, pile-soil stress ratio improve in the same applied load. Increase of load acted on the foundation would promote above-mentioned phenomena. In reinforced piles, the influences of negative skin friction increase gradually, neutral point move down, downdrag caused by negative skin friction increase, skin friction along the piles develop more fully with groundwater lowering more deeper. It may be useful for the research of working behavior of composite foundation after soil settlement.

articleTitle: Key technologies of the new concept safety system for vehicle automatic anti-collision
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to enhance the anti-collision capacity of the vehicle, the key technologies of the vehicle automatic anti collision new concept safety system has been raised, to analyze the contact-impact mechanical properties of CST, and to study CST electric controlling system which be triggered at the safety state to the braking system, and then through the prototype debugging, a anticipative effect had be gotten yet.

articleTitle: Analysis of transmission characteristics of waveguide with double ridges on the short narrowside using finite element method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, transmission characteristics of waveguide with double ridge on the short narrowside are Comprehensively studied using finite element method because reported literatures abotut this waveguide are lack at present. The data and curves of cutoff wavelength, single mode bandwidth, characteristic impedance, attenuation constant, power handling capability of waveguide with double ridge on the short narrowside are obtained. The data show that waveguide with double ridge on the short narrowside has small cut-off wavelength, single mode bandwidth and attenuation constant as well as great characteristic impedance and power handling capability. Therefore, it can be used for narrow bandwidth filters and transmission systems. The conclusions will be carried out waveguide with double ridge on the short narrowside to provide reference data and design parameters for the engineering application.

Author Keywords: waveguide with double ridge on the short narrowside

articleTitle: Research on the interaction of rock-mass with multiple cracks under seepage pressure
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In actual geotechnical engineering, many rock-mass which contains mang cracks, are in water environment. These adjacent cracks would interact with each and the seepage pressure changes cracks status and also affects the stress state in rock. According to the theory of fracture mechanics, the mechanical model of rock-mass which including multi-crack under the action of seepage preasure was set up. Based on principle of superposition, the formula for calculating stress intensity factor was built. The stress intensity factor of cracks are calculated in different conditions, such as different crack distance, different crack angle and different seepage pressure. The results suggest that, the crack tip' stress field caused by interaction of cracks has significant influence if distance between two cracks is short. The influence of adjacent cracks interaction is related to the distance between two cracks, with the crack distance increases, the SIF is close to a fixed value which is calculated without considering the interaction between cracks. The results also show that the seepage pressure significant affects the stress field near crack tip and the stress intensity factor K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">I</sub> increases along with seepage pressure increasing. This research results can provide a theoretical basis to study the fractured rock mass failure under seepage pressure condition.

articleTitle: Low temperature performance evaluation of hard asphalt binder
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Analyzing if ductility parameter at 10°C can evaluate the low temperature performance of hard binder of 50-pen with binder tests and mixture tests. Two kinds of 50-pen asphalt are selected. The SHRP results show that both of them are PG70-16 binders. Then the mix design of AC-20 asphalt mixture was done with two 50-pen binders and one 70-pen binders. Wheel trafficking tests and splitting strength tests for freeze-thaw samples are conducted. Evaluate mixtures' low temperature performance by bending test and bending creep test. Compare 50-pen hard binders to the 70-pen binder, which PG is PG64-22, the asphalt mixture using 50-pen hard binder has better high temperature stability, and there is little difference in low temperature performance. So It is conclude that the ductility of 50-pen hard asphalt has no directly relevance with the low temperature performance of asphalt mixture.

articleTitle: Magnesium electrolyzer structural optimization based on energy balance
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The diaphragmless magnesium electrolyzer was the main equipment for molten salt electrolysis to produce magnesium. The major energy-consuming in production process was electric energy. With the continuous development of science and technology, reducing energy loss had attracted people's attention. In this paper, in order to obtain the electrolyzer with the structure of high capacity and low energy consumption, the structural parameters of electrolyzer were changed on the basis of energy balance equation, and the factors affecting electrolyze were analyzed and summarized.

articleTitle: Real-time alarming of ship-collision accidents for bridges
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the development of the economy, more traffic infrastructures are in needed. A great number of bridges crossing rivers or oceans are built. While, the bridge accidents due to typhoon, earthquake, ship-collision and so on have occurred more frequently, which causes severe loss of life and property. Because of the lack of real-time alarming systems, evitable loss may be caused. This paper presents a method for real-time alarming of ship-collision accidents for bridges using the monitoring data of acceleration or displacement. The variation rate of the monitoring data at any sampling instant is first calculated. The Euler distance of the change rate is then obtained. Through calculating the cumulative probability of the Euler distance, the alarming threshold will be determined for the normal state of the bridge. When a ship-collision accident occurs, the calculated Euler distance is greater than the early-determined alarming threshold, which means that the bridge is under an abnormal condition. The alarming system will be triggered and the bridge should be inspected, maintained and even closed if necessary. This paper analyzed the monitoring data of the ship-collision accidents in 2005 and 2009 for a large span cable-suspension bridge using the proposed alarming method. It proves to be an efficient and effective method for the real-time alarming of ship collision accidents for the bridge.

articleTitle: Analysis on the influence of the posture error of 3-TPT PMT movable platform
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper takes one kind of 3-TPT Parallel Machine Tool (PMT) as the object to study. It mainly analyzes the influence of the posture error of PMT movable platform on its position error. Firstly, on the basis of introducing the structure of PMT, the kinematics of this machine is analyzed, and the kinematics equation of the parallel mechanism is obtained. Then the influence situation of the posture error of the movable platform to its position error is studied based on the kinematics analysis results, and the mathematical expression of error influence is established, thus the theoretical foundation for the comprehensive establishment of error model and the error compensation of this PMT is laid.

articleTitle: Identification of criteria analysis of the rights of ancient lights for constructions
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As a kind of right based on the basic real right of real estate, neighboring right should be protected effectively. Due to the real estate property of constructions, new construction behaviors may result to some influences on the rights of the owner or user of the existing neighboring constructions, such as neighboring right-right of ancient lights etc. This, therefore, will lead to disputes between the new construction behavior agent and the owner or user of the existing buildings. After analyzing the identification criteria of the right of ancient lights of the neighboring constructions by case study, the following are found: sunshine spacing criteria are not enough for realizing protection on the right of ancient lights effectively; sunshine duration criteria are enough for realizing protection on the right of ancient lights effectively.

Author Keywords: Identification of rights of ancient light

articleTitle: Development of automatic welding system applied in subsea pipeline laying
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to explore deep water oil and gas fields in South China Sea area, an automatic welding system applied in subsea pipeline laying has been developed, which has several features such as GMAW process, two welding carriages with dual torch, narrow gap and internal line up clamp fitted with copper backing rings. The welding carriage is specially designed for offshore application, so it is compact and lightweight. The control system of the automatic welding station is constructed on the CANOpen bus and Ethernet technologies, so the flexibility and reliability of the system are greatly improved, and the pipeline welding process also can be monitored remotely.

articleTitle: Network planning method for distribution systems based on planning analytical foundation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Network planning is one of the important content in the distribution network In order to increase the reliability of power supply, to ensure voltage quality, and to reduce power loss, network planning method for distribution systems is proposed to form radial network automatically based on the planning analytical foundation. According to the load moment, the method is presented to partition power supply area, and voltage drop of each user in the area which is limited in allowable bound. Under taking account of voltage drop, line transfer capabilities, and physical restrictions, the distribution network framework is formed automatically, and the functions are accomplished to automatic routing and linking hand in hand, which are in accordance with rules of minimum power loss, shortest path method, and minimum load moment. The real example results show that associated load data are inputted easily, the initial distributing map is formed automatically, and network framework is accomplished automatically. Also based on the planning analytical foundation, the results can be showed, which is easy to analyze and employ planning scheme.

articleTitle: Discussion of Acipenser Sinensis habitat suitability index model
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the former researches by minimum method on the impacts of the ecological impact factors (water depth, water temperature, substrate, et al) on suitability indices of adult fish growth, spawning and hatch, we calculate the habitat suitability indices by the parallel method, and use different simulation equations (polynomial equation, exponential equation, logistic equation, et al) to compare the parallel method with the minimum method, which shows that the result of parallel method matches the measured data better, equation of higher degree can show habitat suitability index model better, and the coefficient of determination up to more than 0.9, and provide reference for the researches on the effect of eco-factors on the Acipenser Sinensis effectively.

articleTitle: Application of hinged connection handle in concrete structures of high-rise building
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Typically, to meet the higher requirements of stiffness and integrity, a rigid connection is mostly used between the structural elements of high-rise building structures. However, in some special cases, it is more appropriate that hinged connection handle is used in some special parts of the structures. Several special circumstances about the application of hinged connection handle in structures of high-rise building was summarized in this paper, and the methods to realize the hinged connection handle in structural design and construction was pointed out.

articleTitle: Mode-dependent non-fragile H∞ controller design for discrete-time Markovian jump system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Considering the presence of additive norm-bounded controller parameter variations, this paper deals with the problem of mode-dependent non-fragile H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> controller design for discrete-time Markovian jump system with the assumption that the jump parameters of discrete-time Markovian jump system is available. The main contribution of the paper is to provide a linear matrix inequality(LMI) approach for designing a mode-dependent non-fragile H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> controller on the basis of several important lemmas. It is shown that the mode-dependent non-fragile H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> controller can be constructed through numerical solution of a set of coupled linear matrix inequalities. By employing LMI toolbox of Matlab 7.0 for numercial simulation, an example is finally provided to demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed approach through the state response curves and the output response curve and also by comparison with normal method of H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> controller design in which controller parameter variation are not considered beforhand.

articleTitle: Dynamic analyses for plates on half space by point-radiate infinite element
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The model of 3D point-radiate 8-node infinite element and a new kind of radiate damping matrix applicable to 3D curved boundary are developed for the dynamic analyses of plates on half space foundation. The radiate pole of the infinite element is at the origin of the global coordinate system and the artificial boundary is a sphere. The mesh of infinite element is performed only on the artificial boundary and a general solution is not needed. By coupling finite/infinite elements and applying the presented radiate damping matrix, the elastic recovery capacity and radiation damping effect of the half space are simulated. The 3D analyses of dynamic problems of plates on the half space are carried out. Compared to FEM, the present approach needs less nodes and elements, and shows good accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Analysis on transmission characteristic of contactless power transfer system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Physical model and mathematical model of the contactless power transfer (CPT) system is established, the main factors affecting the energy transmission efficiency is analyzed according to the basic theory in detail, thus the method to enhance the energy transmission efficiency is the parameters optimization. The impedance increase of the isolating transformer primary side is analyzed, and it is indicated that the impedance increase reduces the energy transmission efficiency.

articleTitle: The study on standard of rock reference site
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The method of rock reference site spectral ratios is commonly used to analysis site effects, and it is facing an issue on how to select rock reference site. Generally, the average shear-wave velocity has become a standard parameter for quantifying site response at a site. However, soil site effect shows uncertainty with <inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">30</sup> criterion, due to amplification effect of rock reference site itself. The present article suggests various selection standard of rock reference site, such as two parameters, V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">30</sup> and the site predominant frequency (f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>) are used to select rock reference site. Using strong motion recorders from the KiK-net Japanese database and based on each site horizontal-to-vertical spectral ratios and surface over depth spectral ratio, the variability of the estimated rock reference site response for five different categories, according to V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">30</sup> and f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> values, are compared. The results demonstrate that with selection standard of rock reference site of V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">30</sup> or f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> can lead to a corresponding wide variety in site amplification, and with V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">s</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">30</sup> and f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf> two parameters it significantly reduces the variability to the amplification and the amplified frequency band of the rock response. In the end, this criterion is thus proposed as selection standard of rock reference site.

articleTitle: Moulds CAD/ CAM based on AutoCAD and MasterCAM
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: AutoCAD is a famous software for moulds design, MasterCAM is a popular soft ware of NC- machining. This paper aims at taking f ull advantages of this two kinds of software to design and manufacture mould. Through the example of designing and manufacturing of cell phone covermould, expound the method and technological process of NC machining by using this two kinds of software.

articleTitle: Study of a new shoulder-type electric brush cutter
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Developments in power electronic switches and low-cost actuator based on an electronic controller have made it possible to design and implement many functions for a new electric brush cutter. Such an attempt has made in this work by using an electronic controller to control this new brush cutter. Certain important issues in design including the making signal generator and its driver, some kinds of sensors, dynamic status display, and a DC voltage regulator have been resolved. The performances of the proposed shoulder-type brush cutter were validated through extensive experiments and a laboratory scale implementation.

articleTitle: Earthquake resistance present situation and suggestion of the rural buildings
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: There are many houses in towns damaged in earthquake. In order to elaborate the earthquake resistance present situation, many towns in Hanzhong have been made field survey, and the local residents' earthquake resistance consciousness has been also surveyed. The earthquake damages in different frames have been compared and the earthquake resistance capacity of self-built houses in towns was analyzed detailed. The local earthquake resistance theory improvement was put forward, and establishing long-acting mechanisms and improving these houses' earthquake resistance in batches intensively were also put forward, and the preferences for improving rural buildings earthquake resistance capacities are provided in the end.

articleTitle: A new measuring method of friction losses of prestressed tendon in post-tensioning
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article is based on the basic principle of the calculation of friction losses of prestressed tendon in post-tensioning, and it also put forward a new method which can measure effectively coefficient of friction (μ), wobble factor (k) and the friction loss rate of anchorage zone. With the measured actual elongation of prestressed tendon and the known jacking force, the method can get the unknown parameters by solving nonlinear equations. This method does not need to use stress sensor, and the test can be done with the only need of common measuring tools and equipment, and the process is simple. It has important reference value to construction and detection of post-tensioning system.

Author Keywords: friction loss rate of anchorage zone

articleTitle: The strong-coupling bound magnetopolaron in a quantum well
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the properties of the strong coupling bound magnetopolaron in quantum well are studied by using the linear combination operator and the unitary transformation method. The variational relation of the ground-state energy of the bound magnetopolaron in a quantum well with the Coulomb bound potential, the vibration frequency, magnetic field and the well-width is derived. The results of numerical calculation show that the ground-state energy is different because of different values of the Coulomb bound potential, the vibration frequency, magnetic field and the well-width, it will decrease with increasing magnetic field, and it will increase with increasing the Coulomb bound potential and the well-width; when magnetic field and the Coulomb bound potential take a certain value, the ground-state energy will increase with increasing the well-width.

articleTitle: Optimization steady state control of turbofan engine in the whole flight envelop based on Support Vector Machines
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper aims to present a method to design the optimization steady state nonlinear controller of turbofan engine which is applicable for the whole flight envelop. First, based on the linear small deviation mathematical models of some representative operation points of turbofan in various flight conditions, the linear quadratic regulators of turbofan are designed respectively and the optimization linear controller parameters are obtained. Then, the SVM method is put forward and applied to synthesize each linear controller to redesign a nonlinear controller via Support Vector Machines (SVM), so the nonlinear controller designed is theoretically applicable in the whole flight envelop. The inputs of SVM are the flight altitude, flight mach number, and the throttle actuator angle. The outputs are the feedback matrix parameters which represent linear controller design results. The SVM is trained and obtained offline. Numerical experiments are carried out to verify the validity of the method. Simulation results show that the relative error of controller design is less than 2% in the whole flight envelop, and the method can meet engine control precision well.

articleTitle: Prediction of rural electricity consumption based on Grey-Markov model
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Along with the rapidly developing rural economy and the change of people's consumption concept, rural electricity consumption increased rapidly. The scientific prediction for rural electricity consumption is the decision-making basis and guarantee for plan in the next reconstruction of rural distribution network. There are many common prediction methods, which has its own relative merits and disadvantages. In this paper, Grey-Markov model is applied to predict rural electricity consumption. And the result shows that this predictive method has better precision and it is practical. The paper provided a scientific basis for the planned development of rural power system.

articleTitle: Dynamic and static analysis and design of the 3-axis double-column machine tool
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The FEA model of the 3-axis double-column machine tool is built using FEA method. According to the practical machining process, the static stiffness of the machine tool is defined, and the dynamic and static characteristic is investigated. Using the part rigid method, the contribution of various assemblies to the whole stiffness is obtained. The deformation under the gravity and cutting force is analyzed in detail. The influence of the thickness of the plate^ the crossbeam structure .. the spindle length out of the headstock and the location of the headstock is also studied. The theory proposed in this paper would be useful for the structural optimization and development of such kind of double-column machine tool.

articleTitle: Quantitative analysis on stability for deep foundation pit support structure
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The size of the reliability index can reflect the stability of excavation. This paper analyzes the engineering structure that is derived the reliability index, and the engineering model of structural reliability methods. The different types of supporting structure are taken into account, including the additional load, earth pressure, a variety of loads, the analysis of the main failure mode of instability as well as the establishment of the supporting structure on different limit state equations. Thus, it can establish the structure-based engineering and the reliability analysis on the reliability models.

articleTitle: A SIFT descriptor with local kernel color histograms
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: SIFT (Scale Invariant Feature Transform) has proved to be the most robust local invariant feature descriptor in object recognition and matching. Being designed mainly for the gray images, SIFT shows its vulnerability when deal with color images. To overcome this problem and increase the descriptor's distinctiveness, we introduce a new descriptor, a combination of the SIFT approach and the improved local kernel color histograms, which shows a better performance than the original SIFT through experiments. Moreover, the experiments results show that the radio of correct matches increase and the mismatch radio remain constant simultaneously.

articleTitle: Electric driving requirements of large CMOS CCD array based on a 3-phase CCD cell by SOI LDMOS
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to obtain the electric driven requirements of large CMOS CCD array based on a 3-phase OPG structure of CCD cell, process and device simulations of the 3-phase OPG structure of CCD cell in 0.5μm SOI CMOS technology were carried out with Silvaco TCAD - one of the authoritative semiconductor process and device simulators. Then the theory on charge and discharge of resistor-capacitor net was adopted to model the circuit architecture of the 3-phase OPG CCD cell based on the obtained process and device simulation results. After that, the electric driven requirements of large 3-phase OPG CMOS CCD array were deduced, based on which the electric driven requirements of large 3-phase OPG CMOS CCD array were outlined by SOI LDMOS.

articleTitle: Study on oxidation and dissolution of tungsten carbide in water
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The conductance changes of tungsten carbide powder in water were investigated in order to study the extent of its oxidation and dissolution by Conductivity Meter. The conductances of different suspension were determined as the changes of concentration, temperature, immersion time and pH values with time were measured in this article. Simultaneously, different aqueous media impacting on oxidation and dissolution of tungsten carbide powder was also studied. The experimental data show that conductance changes results from the oxidation and dissolution of tungsten carbide in water. Owing to pH values in different suspension change significantly, There may be formed tungstate ions and dissociated the proton dissociation at the same time.

articleTitle: Phytoplankton assemblage variation in relation to environmental parameters at two river reaches in Chongming Island
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Phytoplankton assemblage and the relative environmental parameters were investigated at different river reaches (the Nanheng River and Laoyao River) monthly from September 2008 to August 2009. In November and May during the one-year period, large-scale water diversion from the Yangtze River had been carried out through the Nanheng River. Redundancy analysis (RDA) was used to discover the most important regulating parameters in relation to seasonal and spatial variations in different rivers. The RDA triplots showed that at the Nanheng River water temperature (Tem), chlorophyll a (Chl-a), conductivity (Ec), water diversion (H), total nitrogen (TN), and ortho-phosphorus (PO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3−</sup>) had the most profound impacts on the phytoplankton assemblage, while at the Laoyao River, only water temperature (Tem) and conductivity (Ec) were the most important. Our results suggest that timely water diversion from the Yangtze River could improve the water quality by decreasing nutrients concentration as well as phytoplankton biomass.

articleTitle: Intelligent control of flywheel energy storage based on neural network
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the flywheel energy storage control efficient, recurrent fuzzy neural network (RFNN) is adopted. Off-line learning of RFNN controller is finished. Simulative function of RFNN controller and simulative model of the system are built up. Simulations are finished and the result from the RFNN controller is compared with the one from PID controller. Finally, in the experiments, flywheel is charged by AC network using RFNN controller. The effect of RFNN controller and PID controller are compared, it is easy to see that the response speed of RFNN controller is faster than PID controller, the stable precision is better. This electronic document is a “live” template. The various components of your paper [title, text, heads, etc.] are already defined on the style sheet, as illustrated by the portions given in this document.

articleTitle: Dynamic response test and analysis of a typical aviation pipeline
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on experiments and calculations, the characteristics of a typical aviation pipeline were analyzed. Acceleration excitation experiments of the pipeline were carried out by shaking table, and the dynamic response values at a specific spot of the pipeline were gotten. Considering the additional mass caused by acceleration sensor, based on harmonic response calculations between 100Hz and 1000Hz, the response calculation values were obtained, and the calculations were compared with tests. Respectively, the calculations were analyzed when the elastic modulus, density and damping ratio changed. The results show that the changes of elastic modulus and density are contrast to the influence of vibration responses. The influence extent depends on the relative position of the excitation frequencies to mode frequencies; there is an extremum within excitation frequency range. Damping ratio has little effect on the mode frequencies; it affects mainly the amplitude.

articleTitle: Study on the motion control system of a novel 3-DOF PKM module based on Turbo PMAC
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, an open architecture CNC system is developed for a 5-axes hybrid kinematic machine tool. The architecture of this system consists of Turbo PMAC motion control card and PC. The hardware and software of the system are described respectively. The development of the CNC system using LabVIEW is proved successful. The system can be used in practical applications to meet processing requirements of the large aircraft's structure.

articleTitle: Study on the staff scheduling and evaluation model of Human-machine hybrid production system in small and medium manufacturing enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper considers small and medium manufacturing enterprises in China, a large number of artificial, machine mixed mode of production, for this - mixed-mode production model machines were analyzed, and according to the degree of artificial influence on the processes by three types of processes, the establishment of a skills matrix, capability and capacity assessment model matrices and gives the man - machine hybrid system distribution matrix model. On this basis, the proposed task-based method of comparing the pressure and capacity and the establishment of task-based evaluation model and personal skills, the use of genetic algorithms an empirical study of this model, the actual allocation of production workers has a guiding effect.

articleTitle: Prevention and control of debris flow in the small watershed based on ecological landscape remediation: a case study of the Tianchi Lake Nature Reserve in Xinjiang, China
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In China, there are massive scenic spots located in mountain areas where debris flow of small watershed, landslide, collapse ,and other disasters are well developed.The debris flow disaster does not only harm the quality of the downstream scenic landscape resources, but also threaten the visitors' life safety. This paper analyzed the features of debris flow disaster in the Tianchi Lake Nature Reserve in Xinjiang.Based on the previous study of debris flow prevention and control pattern, and the concept of river ecological landscape remediation, this paper scientifically proposed the ecological landscape remediation countermeasures through comprehensively utilization of geological disaster ruined landscape resources, in order to protect natural ecological landscape in the scenic debris flow area. In the disaster area, the method of engineering protection is taken to control debris flow, and in the downstream area the integrated prevention and control pattern are taken, which is combining artificial landscape intervention with natural landscape coordination, in order to reach the aim of the remediation of debris flow disaster in scenic spot and an effective integration of scenic resources in the spots.

Author Keywords: debris flow of the small watershed

articleTitle: Lesson from the development of domestic and foreign rural timber residence
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Timber residence is a kind of green construction and has been widely used in western countries. This paper presents the situation of the construction of rural residence in China, and investigates the architectural features and construction requirements of rural timber residence in developed countries such as the United States, Canada, Italy, Finland and Japan. Combined with the application status of timber residence in China and foreign experience in the construction of rural timber residence, some advice for the future development of China's new rural construction is raised. Research results show that although timber residence was widely used in China in history, people have a skeptical attitude towards it due to the defects in design and construction management, and related research for timber residence is relatively few at this stage in China; While timber residence is one of the main structural form in developed countries for rural residence, and its successful application can provide enlightenment and help for China.

articleTitle: Dynamics and driving factors on Hongjiannao lake in northern shaanxi province
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The paper studied on dynamics and driving factors on Hongjiannao Lake since its formation with topographic map calculation, field survey and remote sensing technology. Based on the analyses on climate and land use, the main factor of lake change was found during 1981-2005. The results showed that Hongjiaonao Lake increased to 67km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> with 5.5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup>m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> of water volume in 1960s from only 1.3km in 1920s. The lake shrunk sharply after 1990s while stable about 55-60km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> during 1970s-1980s. The annual variations on lake area and water volume were 1.1 km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and 0.17×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup>m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> respectively after 2000. The reduction of lake inflow mainly led to sharp decline in Hongjiannao Lake because of climate changes during 1981-1989 and 1994-2000. The reduction of rainfall runoff accounted for 73.7 percent of the reduction of runoff into the lake during 1981-1989. The amount of runoff reduction was five times than the actual amount of runoff during 1994-2000 when water consumption for human activities reduced 0.402×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup>m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. Human activities on the vegetation coverage changes was mainly contributed to reduction of lake inflow during 1989-1994 and 2000-2004. Meanwhile, the construction of reservoir significantly reduced the water volume into the lake after 2004.

articleTitle: Study on optimization design of coal filling mining pipeline parameters
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Through analyzing current coal mining filling technology, this paper puts forward a new method of optimization design of filling line parameters. Combined with coal mining technical condition one Tangshan mine, the main working parameters in like paste slurry filling pipeline conveying process has identified, such as velocity, the maximum working pressure, dry filling inner diameter, filling pipe wall thickness and other parameters, which achieved good effect on site. It provides technical support for filling technology application on large-scale in our country and realizing mining under buildings and saving cost mining.

articleTitle: Improved method of tracking the maximum power point for photovoltaic system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: On the basis of analyzing the principle of perturb and observe algorithm and incremental conductance algorithm which are the traditional algorithm of the maximum power point tracking, a new MPPT algorithm based on bee evolution modifying particle swarm optimization (BEMPSO) combined with perturbation and observation or incremental conductance control is proposed. Simulation of the algorithm based on Matlab is carried out. Experimental results show that the two methods is a successful and feasible approach to achieve the maximum power point tracking under bad conditions.

Author Keywords: bee evolution modifying particle swarm optimization (BEMPSO)

articleTitle: Surface characterization and alternate of related technological parameters for LST
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Laser surface texturing is regarded as a useful method for improving tribological property of working surface. Meanwhile, the variables of technology have undetectable effects on surface topographies, such as pulse frequency induced by the distances of pulse-acting points and the revolution speed of optic axis. Doubtlessly, laser power turns to be a complicated function of these variables, which devoted to a tough way to express their relations accurately for ahead of study. Moreover, enough basic tents of theory can be borrowed to interruption for expectation in the process of micro-texturing on critical surfaces. And thus pulse frequency and the distance between mirror and material surface were chosen and studied for improving the surface topographies realized by Nd<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>: YAG laser, assisting a better performance of friction and wear. The single-factor method was exerted in the process of analysis, one international 3D morphology meter and its accessory codes were adopted before the analysis of constitutive influence by referred parameters in given duration on characteristic parameters of texturing surface, the results are shown in figures by Abbott curve and characteristic parameters that were compared in the literate.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Multiobjective evolutionary algorithms applied to compressor stations network optimization scheduling control system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Application of laser welder LW-21-L in hot-dip galvanizing line
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the development of modern hot-dip galvanizing technology, the automation technology is also improved daily and laser welder also become the developing trend in the future. In order to ensure continuous production, MCC hengtong cold-rolled technology company has introduced the French's CLECIM LW - 21 - L laser welder. Through the field application and improvement, it indicates: the welding process is advanced, and it has high automation level. Meanwhile it can reduce the rate of parking effectively and reduce the cost of production.

articleTitle: The assessment of emergency system to sudden nature disaster in the city
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The rescue on sudden nature disaster depends on emergency system in great extent in the city. Face to more and more severe disaster, the construction of emergency system becomes more and more important. The paper establish the evaluation standard of emergency system, then takes Nantong which lies on Yangzi estuary as an example, analysis the emergency system in Chongchuan region whose people and economic is biggest density. The results show the key problems to restrict sudden system contraction are the store of sudden water source and disaster relief materials. So, the area should increase the store and reinforce the management.

articleTitle: The GPS-RTK satellite positioning technology and its application in construction of large scale bridge
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper describes the principle of positioning and the system composition of the GPS-RTK satellite positioning technology, introduces the application of this technology in positioning construction of steel casing and steel pipe, super large steel suspended-box of Sutong bridge and its application in measurement of underwater landform. These applications verified many superiorities such as: high accuracy of measurement, good reliability of data, rapid positioning, few operators, all weather operationing, etc., it's applicable for construction measurement of bridge engineering.

articleTitle: Closed-form solution exploration study for general second-order vehicle control system modeling
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper first studies the math model for heavy duty vehicle (HDV) control systems with focus on the general 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> order system model that can be represented by a 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> order differential equation. For general 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> order differential equations, the paper discusses them in two categories, one is the homogeneous and the other is non-homogeneous, and illustrates the general closed-form solutions for each category. Then the paper moves on to the practical 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">nd</sup> order mechanical vibration system considering Coulomb friction since most HDV system models can be simplified to such a system model. The paper illustrates closed-form solutions for both steering forced and force-free scenarios assuming certain forms of steering force. Overall, the paper demonstrates a set of solutions on what closed-form solutions are available for general HDV control system and how to use them to get the exact closed-form solutions under various simplification assumptions or conditions.

articleTitle: The dynamic simulation experimental research on treatment of acid coal mine drainage by loess-microorganism system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Taking Lishi loess as the media and domestic sewage as the carbon source for treating agent of acid mine drainage, this paper discussed the feasibility of acid mine drainage dynamic processing by loess-microbial system in the soil column.
