The results achieved are as follows: (1) the domestic sewage whose value of COD is less than 120mg/L, can activate sulfate reducing bacteria (SRB), but it is difficult to maintain its continuous reproductive; (2) After High organic sewage with an extra 4.5mg/L molasses infiltrated into the upper layer of the soil column, Eh values are all negative at each depth of soil column in the 6th test day and reduce to below -400mv in the 10th day, where become a beneficial reductive environment to the growth of SRB; (3)After a 5-day experiment, a smell of H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S appears at the bottom of the soil column. At 20cm depth, the maximum removal rate of SO4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sup> can reach 95.5% after 82 days, however, the maximum removal rates at the depth of 40cm, 60cm, 80cm, and 100cm (the bottom outlet) in the 94th day are 91.6%, 89.1%, 84.9%, 77.8%, respectively; (4) The maximum removal rate of SO4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sup> decreases along with the increase of depth in the same period.

articleTitle: A new structure of line traveling wave pump on magnetic fluid
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The adding magnetic field affects the distributing shape of magnetic fluid. According to the magnetic particles of the magnetic fluid, the adding magnetic fluid is affected. The decoupled question between the magnetic field and force is solved by the Boundary-Step by Step-Hand and Hand Iterative method. The stream of magnetic fluid is produced by the traveling wave magnetic field. The velocity of the magnetic fluid can increased with the increasing saturation magnetization and magnetic field. The difference press is max in the center line of pump, and the difference is min in the edge of pump. The acceleration is max in the center line of pump, and the acceleration is min in the edge of pump. The velocity of center line is max, and the edge is min with the same time interval. The velocity of magnetic fluid reduces from the center line to edge.

articleTitle: Analysis of segmental cave-in Probability of Maojingba tunnel in Daqing-Guangzhou Expressway
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Risks are widely existing in highway tunnel construction and are related to many influential factors. Based on the analysis of engineering conditions of Maojingba tunnel in Daqing-Guangzhou Expressway, a grey-clustering model is established to evaluate the segmental cave-in Probability level. In this study, six influencing factor, including surrounding rock gradation, tectonics, tunnel embedment depth, cross-section span, segment length, and the constructional methodology is considered. In order to rationally calibrate these parameters in different dimensions, a criterion set is studied and employed to classify the six influential factors into four severity grades. A group of triangular weight functions are devised to calculate the membership value of risk factors to probability grades. With the quantification process, natural engineering conditions are synthesized to work out the probability level of cave-in risk. The analyzed possibility of five segments is compared to an expert assessment and have shown good agreement. This indicates that the proposed probability analyzing model is suitable. The results can be used to evaluate the cave-in risk level for highway tunnels.

articleTitle: The scattering property of small anisotropic dielectric ellipsoids
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The distribution of electric field of an anisotropic dielectric elliptical sphere is presented by reforming both the electromagnetic parameter and shape parameter of this ellipsoid based on the scales transformation of electromagnetic theory. The obtained results are tested. The RCS of the anisotropic target is founded. Simulations show that the direction of incident electric field and the dielectric constant tensor influences RCS remarkably but the target' size has not a great effect on it. The obtained results have some significance in the research of electromagnetic scattering by a complicated anisotropic target.

articleTitle: Study on planning strategy of residential district design based on local climate in Ganzhou city
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Nowadays global climatic deterioration is critical. Study on improving comfortability of micro-climate environment of residential district based on local natural and social environment by means of adopting effective advanced technologies has received more and more attention. By analyzing the climatic features and residential district design of Ganzhou city, planning strategy of improving comfortability of micro-climate environment is explored in this paper.

articleTitle: Research on dam seepage detecting based on EH-4
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the signal spectral leak problem of continuous conductivity imaging system of EH-4 after Fourier transform of signals adopted from field surveying under different frequency, which influences the data quality. On the base of analyzing and understanding the characteristics and function of different window functions, combined with the analysis and interpretation on the data during the detection of dam leak, the spatial locations of dam seepage are determined, which provides the scientific proof on purdah grouting.

articleTitle: Dynamics simulation of high speed slot-puncher indexing system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on virtual prototyping technology, this paper analyzed the dynamic characteristics of high speed slot-puncher output indexing system with the high-frequency input response. The virtual prototype according to the structure of the indexing system is established in ADAMS by using the Gear Dynamics theory. The dynamic characteristics with high-frequency input are obtained by studying the virtual prototype simulation. The study provides a practical approach to improve the indexing precision of high speed slot-puncher in the high-speed condition.

articleTitle: Analysis on reservoir desilting by spiral flow
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article analyzed the reservoir siltation and the prevention measure, to achieve a new desilting method with the advantages of low energy consumption, high sediment concentration, long-distance transport, and silt discharge and sediment transport through spiral flow can achieve these requirements. According to the experiment we can discover that using the spiral flow to discharge reservoir desilting can achieve the purpose of industrial application.

articleTitle: Two-stage DEA evaluation model with ideal-DMU
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper analyses the advantage of Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) in the “relative inferiority” evaluation of the same Decision-Making Unit (DMU). It is expounded that the benefit evaluation model can't achieve the whole sorting of DMU and can't guide the DMU to improve the insufficiency in the information. We puts forward the decision making model of two-stage DEA evaluation with the ideal decision making units. This model realizes the DMU whole sorting need by introducing the ideal decision making units, then we give the DEA decision making model based on standard efficiency index, thereby the information resources of each DEA is more fully extracted. Moreover, this paper points out the improved direction and goals of each DMU at the input/output through the analysis of each DEA management information about the projection point on the DEA effective frontier. Finally, the simulation analysis on the running benefit of 8 undergraduate college in a province achieves the purpose of evaluation decision making well, and proofs the adaptability and advantage of the mode illustrated in this paper in benefit evaluation decision making system.

articleTitle: Tests of ionic soil stabilizer reinforcing expansive soil
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Ionic soil stabilizer was used to reinforce expansive soil and improve its working performance. 4 groups of stabilized soil with different mixture proportion were designed to investigate the effects of improvement. The expansibility and strength of stabilized soils were studied through a series of tests. The chemical composition, cation exchange capacity, microstructure and BET surface area were tested and analyzed as well. It was found that the total swelling and shrinking percentage and the plasticity index decreased significantly. The compressive strength of stabilized soil and its stability in water were effectively improved. It was also found that the cation exchange capacity and BET surface area of swelling soil decreased by mixing ISS into it. The microstructure of swelling soil was changed from layered structure to grainy one by adding a certain dosage of ISS and lime into it.

articleTitle: Study on the algorithm of increasing turning feedrate during continuous machining for multiple line segment trajectory
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Feedrate is a crucial parameter of continuous machining, and acute variation of feedrate will significantly affect the surface quality of parts machined. Thus, for high-speed and high-precision continuous machining towards multiple line segment trajectory, the turning feedrate should be increased as much as possible, so that the variation of feedrate will be decreased and the surface quality will be improved. In this paper, the concept of turning angle is described, the profile error and acceleration during turning of multiple line segment trajectory are analyzed, and an optimization algorithm is presented. Through optimizing the turning angle, the turning feedrate is increased. Finally, experimental results indicate that the proposed algorithm can dramatically increase the turning feedrate under the limitation of profile error.

articleTitle: Research on inductance parameters of transformer winding applied transient voltage
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the transformer winding inductance model which presented by P.I. Fergested, a new kind of calculation method is presented, which the inductance parameters are divided into the hollow inductance and core inductance two separate parts, each part is divided into self-inductance and mutual-inductance, while the related parameter values are discussed. The measurement results are consistent with the calculation results of the inductance parameters in an actual transformer winding model, which verifies the calculation method is correct and feasible, the theoretical basis can be provided for accurately analyzing the very fast transient process in the transformer winding.

articleTitle: Study of automated point layout of radiological environment monitoring
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Automated point layout plays an important pole in early phase nuclear emergency management which should take into account of nuke accidents source, weather condition, geography environment and other factors. However, owe to most of point selecting is done as manual work., there are some problems emerge as the too much of time cost, low efficiency in the course of working point layout etc. This paper proposes a kind of automatic technology framework which do points selecting based on forecast of pollutant diffuse model. Farther, the traditional method and its revised method are proposed, and point selecting achieve more scientifically and rationally. The experimental results show that our automated point layout could provide obvious improvements over previously methods, and the method could be widely used in emergency management of other kinds of accidents.

articleTitle: Research of Active Disturbance Rejection Controller in speed regulation of induction motor
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to overcome the drawbacks of the bad low speed performance of the direct torque control of induction motor. Active Disturbance Rejection Controller (ADRC) replaces the classic PID in a speed loop method on the base of the direct torque control of induction motor is proposed. Through the simulation results of different speeds show that the speed modulation performance of ADRC-DTC basically consistent at the high or low speed, to overcome the disadvantage of the low speed performance declined, improve the response speed, and effectively solve the contradictions between quick speed and overshoot.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of automatic access control system based on the face recognition
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper we introduce the design and implementation of an automatic access control system using PCA-based face recognition technique (ACFR). The system uses real time monitoring pictures to recognize face by principal component analysis (PCA), and makes access control according to the result of face recognition. PCA extracts the main feature information of face, which gets the greatest dimension reduction with the least information lost, and makes the system faster and more accurate. In addition, in order to reduce the influence of the shooting angle and light, ACFR has adopted multi-source camera and shadowless lamp method. In terms of the system's effect, ACFR has great potential applications.

articleTitle: Loader transmission multi-parameters optimization design based on the satisfactory degree theory
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Aimed at the no-rationality of the single optimization design of the loader transmission, after the analysis of its design requirement, the satisfactory optimization design is developed. The satisfactory degree function in the loader transmission based on the generalized satisfactory degree theory is explored. Multi-parameters optimization design of the loader transmission based on the satisfactory degree theory, artificial neural network and genetic algorithm is introduced. It is shown that this method not only can improve the quality of the design, but also can represent the requirement of the designer and user much more. It provides a new approach to the design of the loader transmission.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the setting of vertical clearance under the overpass bridge
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Measures to improve the recovery rate of fully mechanized caving
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Through exposition on top coal caving mining method, as well as fully-mechanized top-coal mining method in the current development and prospect of China's largest coal enterprises, at the same time it can bring great benefits, also raised its recycling rate is still generally low phenomenon, effect analysis of the main reasons: at the end of the early mining losses, loss of head loss, caving technology and so on. On the analysis of these factors individually, summarizes the measures to improve resources recovery. Study shows: selected scientific and reasonable exploitation of design and top-coal caving technology and equipment, increasing fragmentation and a sound management system, so as to achieve the objective of increasing resource recovery.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Matching research between ZOTYE AUTO and a new generation of Double-CST
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Ant colony optimization for design of FIR filters with signed-power-of-two coefficients
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A heuristic approach based on ant colony optimization is proposed for the design of multiplierless finite impulse response (FIR) filters with signed-power-of-two (SPT) coefficients. The objective is to minimize non-zero SPT terms to reduce the number of adders that are needed for filtering with constant SPT coefficients, while meeting the required specifications of the filter. Each SPT coefficient is placed on several virtual paths whose length is determined by non-zero SPT terms. Each ant searches for the shortest path according to the residual pheromone that is dynamically calculated by measuring the distance between current path and previous optimal path. Simulation results show that suboptimal solutions can be obtained within reasonable computational time.

articleTitle: IFDS operation mechanism and its implementation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to deal better with the changeful market demand, based on IFDS for modern instrument manufacturing, people make researches on the product family and the operation mechanism of IFDS. In the design process, first, people determine the variants of products through grid dividing markets; and then find main related design parameters in the product family. In order to establish flexible product platform, people have to find out the core structure of a product and refine its public module and flexible module by the aid of IFDS operation mechanism; and finally add specific elements to the platform. In the end, the author takes the development of the product family of concentrator solar energy system for example to prove the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: The singularity research of a novel 2T2R parallel mechanism
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Kinematic pairs being reasonable arranged, a novel spatial parallel mechanism of 2RPU-2SPU possessing four degrees of freedom (DOFs) is built. This mechanism is composed of fixed and moving platform by means of four parallel bars containing two adjacent RPU limps and two adjacent SPU limps. Moving character is analysed by using screw theory and DOFs are calculated by revised Kutzbach-GrAbler formula. The moving platform of this mechanism has two translational and two rotational (2T2R) DOFs. Input of chosen is discussed so that the constraint screws are obtained when four drivers are locked. The special position of this mechanism leads to determinant of constraint screws being equal to zero, that is to say, mechanism is clear at singular configuration. This analysis lays a foundation for further research on kinematics and dynamics.

articleTitle: Research of ship structural system reliability considering fatigue-strength coupling
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the research of failure mechanism of structure subjected to fixed and fatigue load, ship structural system reliability model is established considering fatigue-strength coupling. For the problem of large amount of calculation of searching main failure mode by using advanced branch-and-bound method, incremental time method is proposed. The bearing damage ratio and bearing force ratio parameter are put forward, and the units, which can be combined to generate the system main failure mode, are found out with the criteria of minimum increment of time. This method can be a theoretical reference for a quick reasonable assessment of ship structural system reliability.

articleTitle: Research on machining precision of CNC spiral bevel gear grinding machine
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The paper studies on the method of laser vector measurement, error detection principle of the spiral bevel gear, and the way of compensating the volumetric error of the computer numerical control spiral bevel gear grinding machine. Experiments have proved that the machining precision is improved through compensating the positioning errors and linear errors separated from the volumetric error.

Author Keywords: CNC spiral bevel gear grinding machine

articleTitle: Numerical simulation and optimization of aerodynamic performance in a radial air turbine
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: 3D viscous numerical simulation of internal flow field in a radial air turbine was investigated under the design condition by using CFD software FINE™/Turbo. The effects of two kinds of geometry shapes on the aerodynamic performance and secondary flow were analyzed in detail. The results indicate that, compared to the original, the efficiency of impeller with curved blades is evidently increased, and can meet the requirement according to the system parameters design. There are complicated flow phenomena in the flow of the rotor. By using the proper curved blades, the separation loss can be weakened and higher aerodynamic performance can be achieved. The achievements obtained from this paper would provide information for further engineering design of air turbine with optimal performance.

articleTitle: Influence of free chlorine on nitrite accumulation in biological aerated filter(BAF)
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The influence of free chlorine on the nitrite accumulation in Biological Aerated Filter (BAF) was investigated by adding chlorine in the bioreactor in order to carry out a shortcut nitrification-denitrification. The relationship of the adding dosage and feeding modes of free chlorine and the nitrite accumulation in BAF were also considered. The results show that the nitrite accumulation could be achieved by adding chlorine. When the influent concentration of chlorine was 4mg/L, the concentration of effluent nitrite nitrogen was increased remarkably after the system had been operated for 20 days, and the nitrite accumulation rate could be kept in 60%–70%. The steady state of nitrite accumulation could be maintained with decreasing in the concentration of the influent chlorine, and could also be maintained at a certain degree with the adding mode of intermittent chlorination.

articleTitle: Discussion on the applicable standards of railway environmental noise
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Combined with the argument of applicable environmental noise evaluation standards in Beijingyuan section of Nanjing-Hangzhou express railway project, relational law and standards about railway environmental noise are discussed in this paper, and proposals to revise relational law and standards are advanced.

articleTitle: Application of the BP network evaluation method in desulfurization technology selection of thermo-electricity project
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: There are many kinds of indexes in desulfurization technology selection of thermo-electricity project, between which complicated nonlinear relation is presented. It is difficult to calculate and lack of effective evaluation methods. In this paper, a comprehensive evaluation index system of desulfurization technology selection has been built, the BP neural network evaluation method is applied to desulfurization technology selection, and finally the rationality and feasibility is computed through example. This method provides a new idea for desulfurization technology selection, which is in good value of application.

articleTitle: The study on self-adaptive predictive arithmetic based on RBF neural network applied in the proportion control of hydrogen and nitrogen in synthesis ammonia production
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Aim at the control questions of more interference factors, time-variant and oversize time delay in the proportion control of hydrogen and nitrogen in synthesis ammonia production, a self-adaptive predictive PID control scheme based on RBF neural network theory is presented, using ahead predictive to overcome large delay, and PID arithmetic based on RBF network to adjust the parameter of controller on-line. Results of simulation experiment show that this method has quick system response, strong adaptability and better robustness, it will be has wide perspective and practicability for the proportion of hydrogen and nitrogen in synthesis ammonia production.

Author Keywords: proportion control of hydrogen and nitrogen

articleTitle: Research on the micropump based on the magnetocaloric effect of magnetic fluid
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In recent years, the collapse of critical components due to over heating has been a big issue in the micro electro-mechanical system. The magnetocaloric properties of magnetic fluid can be use to remove the undesired heat generated in the system without any mechanical moving parts. In this paper, Mn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.78</inf>Zn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.22</inf>Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> magnetic fluid has been prepared by a precipitation reaction method. Its magnetization property, magnetocaloric effect and the Curie temperature have been experimentally studied using vibrating sample magnetometer. A micropump based on the magnetocaloric effect of magnetic fluid is designed which provides a new method to solve the problems caused by over heating in the micro electro-mechanical system. The working principle of the magnetocaloric pump is introduced and the pump pressure achieved by magnetic fluid is theoretically analyzed using the Bernoulli equation. The result obtained from experiment and calculation shows that the pump is able to provide a pressure of 540.3 Pa using the Mn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.78</inf>Zn<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0.22</inf>Fe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> magnetic fluid at an external magnetic field intensity of 5×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup> A/m and with a temperature gradient of 40 °C.

articleTitle: Dynamic optimization design of valve train in internal combustion engine
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Valve train is one of important mechanisms in internal combustion engine. Dynamic model with single degree of freedom has been built for the valve train. And the optimization of valve train dynamics is studied by means of alternated one dimension searching method. The optimizing results show that the method is correct and the dynamic characteristics are improved.

articleTitle: Trampling effects on the stolon growth of centipedegrass
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Five treatment groups i.e. Control, Intensity 1 (T1), Intensity 2 (T2), Intensity 3 (T3) and Intensity 4 (T4) were conducted through simulated trampling. Stolon density of centipedegrass (Eremochloa ophiuroides) was significantly affected by trampling (p<0.01). With the exception of T4, with an increase of growth days, the density of stolon gradually increased in length from Control to T3. Stolon density increased after moderate trampling disturbance of T1, and decreased gradually due to over-trampling from T2 to T4.

articleTitle: Study on energy efficiency renovation of existing residential buildings in severe cold district
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As an energy hungry developing area in northeast severe cold district, high building' s energy consumption will certainly confine the regional economical development and restrict increase of people' s living standard. Taking existing residential buildings of northeast severe cold district as the subject investigated, according to the local climatic features in northeast severe cold district, and based on overall understanding and partial experimental research in related materials of envelope construction, this research analyzes effects of exterior walls', roofing' s, doors' and windows' thermal performances and constitutions on building' s energy consumption. Importance of existing residential buildings energy efficiency for improving energy-saving reform plan is discussed, meanwhile it contributes scientific evidence to accurate design of building envelope structures.

articleTitle: The effect on methane emission by different soil enzyme activity in paddy soil
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this study, with the paddy soil by different fertilized in Chengdu Plain, we have researched the correlation between soil cataloes, phosphates and unease activity and CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> emission. The results showed that: (1) in the rice growth period, the Soil cataloes, phosphates and unease activity for each treatment got the trend that decreasing first and then increasing, decreasing finally. The soil cataloes, phosphates and unease activity maximized at tailoring stage, heading stage next, followed by the jointing stage, maturity is the lowest. (2) CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> emission from paddy soil in each treatment was decreased in the whole rice growth period. From the tailoring to jointing stage CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> emission reduced much larger than the others. (3) We got a significant positive correlation between CH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> emission and soil enzymatic activities in DM, T3 and T4 treatments.

articleTitle: Neural network and antenna model application on pulse magnetic field measurement
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Introduces a pulse magnetic field measurement system which is used in strong electromagnetic environment. A small loop antenna is used as pulse magnetic field sensor and a wide band analog fiber transmission device is used to transmit the signal. The system uses BP neural network to calibrate the nonlinearity of the fiber transmission device and uses the model of the antenna to recover the pulse magnetic field. Using Matlab function to realize the system method can simplify the program. An experiment result shows that the system is suitable for measuring wide band pulse magnetic field.

articleTitle: Study of IC slabs reinforcement by transversal prestressing tension
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to overcome the deficiencies of vertical prestressing tension in engineering applications , the paper puts forward the transversal prestressing tension reinforcement technology and its principles and methods. The research, based on the reinforcement of concrete slab, focuses on the construction techniques and construction designs of the transversal prestressing tension reinforcement. Compared with vertical prestressing tension, the transversal prestressing tension reinforcement technology has its unique advantages of convenient application in the spot of reinforcement and applicability to small or medium member reinforcement. Results show that the transversal prestressing tension reinforcement technology has its characteristics of simpler anchoring and node construction, less equipment requirements and easier construction techniques; reinforced structure can meet the demands of safety and durability.

articleTitle: Study on maximal allowable discharge amount of toxicant based on ecological risk
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Because of the absence of water quality standards, it is difficult to estimate maximal allowable discharge amount (MADA) into a river system for most toxicants. This paper introduces the procedure and methodology of ecological risk assessment to the research of MADA for toxicants. The Fuxi River in Ningbo City is taken as a case to study the MADA of toxicant acrylonitrile. The basic method is to calculate ecological risk under different discharge amount, and estimate MADA based on both risk values and water ecological standards. Two approaches are proposed in this paper: joint probability curve approach and total ecologic risk approach. MADA under different protection level and hazard probability is estimated through joint probability curve approach; MADA under different total ecological risk is estimated through total ecologic risk approach. The former can provide various standards for toxicants with complicated computation, and the latter has less reference value in determination of MADA due to the limited information though it is easy to compute.

articleTitle: The geological hazards characteristics and engineering geology environment separating in Fushun city
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Fushun city is a famous coalfield in the world, it appears serious damage because of mining work through hundred years, for this reason the development of the city is puzzled by geological hazards; it produces landslide, ground deformation, land surface gap and minging tremor on account of excavating in well and in the open air around Fushun coalfield, they threaten directly the people life and property safe. In order to ensure the city sustainable development, we need separating the city land resources into several segments. The paper discusses the type of geological hazards in Fushun city, on the basis of researching we separate the area into three parts: bad area of engineering geology environment, badder area of engineering geology environment and general area of engineering geology environment, they can provide scientific geological basis for the development and plan of the city.

articleTitle: Thermal-structure coupling analysis and optional design of altiplano rolling kitchen pressure vessel
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: On the basis of theoretical analysis, using finite element analysis software ABAQUS, establish the finite element model of thermal-structure coupling of plateau kitchen pressure vessel, and constraint scheme were studied, By thermal-structural coupling finite element analysis, obtained the stress distribution and deformation of pressure vessel body in actual working temperature and pressure, According to the stress concentration phenomenon generated at the bottom of pressure vessel, carry out the optimization design for radian curve. Through calculation and analysis results, provide effective reference data and meaningful theoretical guidance for the further optimal design and final production application of pressure vessel body.

articleTitle: Study on correlation between food consumption and discharge of domestic pollutants in urban area
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this study, the regulations of pollutant discharge in the whole process of food consumption (from pre-market food treatment to food processing, digest and pollutant discharge) were investigated Results suggested that potential pollutant-discharge coefficients were affected by the kinds of food and nutrients; the potential pollution of grain was the greatest while grain, vegetable, meat, fruit and sea food were major potential pollution sources and took up over 90% of potential pollutant discharge; the sequence of the effects of different food processing methods on environment was: frying and stewing >; braising and boiling; the discharge coefficients for various pollutant indices were sequenced as RBOD5<;RCOD<;RTN<;RTP; except COD discharge coefficient, all other pollutant discharge coefficients of women were significantly higher than those of men; the diet structure and food match were also important factors that affected the pollutant discharge coefficients of human body. Presently, the basic variation trend of Chinese diet structure is the reduction in the consumption of cereal and yam and the increase in animal food Therefore, attentions should be paid to the potential environmental problems induced by changes in the food consumption structure.

articleTitle: Path planning of robotic griding for workpieces with complex surface
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Robotic grinding for workpiece with complex surface is a new processing method. The theory and implementation of path planning is the key of this method. To solve time-consuming problem of path planning with demonstration system, we established a complete set of process for griding path planning. The relation of the coordinates transformation was analyzed in this method. And the method to access the matrix of coordinates transformation was also discussed. Then the analysis of tool position was studied in theory and was realized by a self-designed software. Robot kinematics model was established and solved at last. The method can be directly used for the robotic control by solving the movement of the joints. We proved the method was suitable for path planning of robotic grinding by using the movement for a simulation.

articleTitle: Research on automatic jump control of wrapper rolls base on CAN bus
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The design idea of automatic jump control system for wrapper rolls controlled by electro-hydraulic controller Base on CAN Bus. Modify PID parameter was carried out by the electrohydraulic controller which improve the parameters turning to be flexible, Establish its mathematic modeling. Emulation analysis and analogue loading verification are conducted. The results show that the system influenced by the PID parameters. Combined with electro-hydraulic controller can achieve to control effect well.

articleTitle: Design and optimization of automatic machine for almond opening
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper describes the structure of a automatic machine for opening apricot-core, including feed tray, guiding slot 1, clamping and transportation belts, cutting mechanism, guiding slot 2 and collection holder. And this paper focus mainly on the clamping and transportation belts's design and optimization. Based on the past physics character data of almond and the structure of opening almond machine, we have done the stress analysis and deformation analysis of clamping and transportation belts using Ansys software. Identified the basic dimensions and clamping force of the clamping and transportation belts. Optimized the overall structure of the fully automatic machine for opening almond.

articleTitle: Two stage beamforming localization algorithm for secondary sound source
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A new algorithm SRP-W is proposed to localize the secondary sound source. SRP is first used to estimate the largest sound source location. GCC is weighted to decrease the largest sound cross-corelation peak and keep the secondary sound cross-corelation peak. SRP-W can be used to localize the secondary source which is submerged by the largest one. Results of experiments on data simulation and in the semi-anechoic room demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Research on construction technology of cantilever expansion of some stage hall grid structure
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on some stage hall grid structure adopts high altitude scattered expansion construction technology, the original construction technical scheme adopts a T-shaped scaffold to construct, but this scheme will influence the underground stage hall's construction, and its cost is larger, therefore recommend a bar supporting frame to be built as starting unit, then to form stable unit, then to dismantl scaffold for cantilever expansion construction. Using this new construction technology, we need to study the stability conditions of starting unit and stress and strain distribution of construction assembly process, to satisfy grid structure construction standard. Therefore, this article analyzes the grid construction according to construction steps in detail, altogether 45 construction steps, analyzes starting unit's the change rule of the stresses and deformations, analyzes the stresses and deformations of the cantilever expansion part, analyzes construction arch of the grid structure. The analysis results show that the new construction technology is a feasible construction scheme.

articleTitle: Process prediction model for wood plastic composites pencil boards based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Corn straw fiber powder and high-density polyethylene as the main raw materials, polystyrene, silane and paraffin as adhesives, coupling agents and lubricants, respectively, plant fiber composite materials were prepared for the replacement osf basswood pencil board. How the mass ratios of the corn straw powder, high density polyethylene and polystyrene influence the performance of the composite pencil boards were analyzed. The process prediction model for composite pencil boards based on BP neural network was designed, whose accuracy is up to 6%.

articleTitle: Preparation and characterization of polysaccharide/ protein biodegradable membrane
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Carboxyl Methyl Glucomannan and Soy Protein were complexed to prepare biodegradable membrane-forming materials. By solution methods, discussing the factors of mass ratio, pH, crosslinker agent amount, reaction time and temperature, Measuring rheological property of compound sol. The best conditions of preparing compound were determined. The structure of compound was characterized by FT-IR The properties of apparent characteristics, tensile strength, moisture resistance and gas barrier of compound membranes were tested The results indicated that the compound can be widely used as biodegradable membrane-forming materials.

articleTitle: Dynamics and control of injection molding takeout manipulator
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A robot manipulator is expected to play an important role in the production process of plastic factory. A sliding mode controller is present for a 4-DOF injection molding machines take out manipulator. The dynamic model of the manipulator has been built, and the stability of the control system is analyzed with the Lyapunov theory. The simulation experiment about the desired position trajectory tracking is carried out, and the results show that the built controller is effective.

articleTitle: Effects of defoliation on the growth plasticity in stolon of centipedegrass
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Effects of defoliation frequency on the growth plasticity in stolon of centipede grass (Eremochloa ophiuroides) planted as sprigs after transplantation were studied in southern Kyushu, Japan. Plants transplanted were defoliated at intervals of 10 (D10), 20 (D20), 30 (D30) and 60 (D60) days. Tuft coverage, stolon density, stolon diameter and branching angle significantly responded to defoliation frequency after transplantation onward, showing a response pattern of D30>D60>D20>D10 (P<0.05). Intermediate defoliation (D30) contributed most to the regrowth of centipede grass with a high stolon density, nearly twice as much as that in D10. In spite of the small variations of both the diameter and branching angle among different treatments, the difference of these two among the treatments was significant after 60 days of transplanting (P<0.05).

articleTitle: A modal analysis of bucket foundation breakwater based on the Lanczos method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The bucket foundation breakwater is a new type of structure applied in port and coastal engineering, the stability of which is sustained by the bucket foundation penetrated in soft soil. According to the project of extending breakwaters in Tianjin Port, a three-dimensional finite element model is developed and used in modal analysis based on the Lanczos method. It is resulted that the movement modes of this new type of structure in soft soil foundation in the previous modals are mainly described as the displacement along horizontal direction, the movement up and down along vertical direction and the rotation round a point under the bucket; the longest natural period of vibration of the system is far away from the external excitation wave force period, so the structure will not be instable for resonance under the dynamic wave load.

articleTitle: A watermark scheme based on residual
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a watermark scheme based on imbedding watermark in the residual between the two successive frames. The watermark is imbedded in the high-frequency coefficients of the obtained DCT of the residual. The scheme can resist the attack of compression coding effectively. The simulations show that the scheme has good performances to resist Gauss attack, pepper and salt attack, cutting and compression attack.

articleTitle: An Analysis on the hydraulic resistance balance in the household horizontal heating system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article analyzes the influence on hydraulic resistance balance from the temperature differences between supply and return water, the specific frictional resistance of vertical two pipe, thermal pressure and pressure drop of household in the household heating system. It adopts Kirchhoffs law to evaluate the hydraulic balance status of vertical two-pipe down feed direct return system in the household heating system and draws the conclusion that an vertical two-pipe down feed direct return system is more suitable for the household heating system, where there is no balancing regulator. Furthermore, this article calculates the range of the average specific frictional resistance of the common riser, and determines the factors that might affect the hydraulic resistance balance.

articleTitle: Study on residual strength of concrete filled steel tube after exposure to explosing impact
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The residual bearing mechanism of concrete filled steel tubular beams with different casing hoop steel coefficients after exposure to explosing impact were experimentally investigated. The experiments were carried out on the reaction frame for loading, and the pressure and the residual deformation modes were recorded. The results show that the concrete filled steel tubular beams have good anti-explosion ability and the casing hoop steel coefficient is an important factor to the value of residual strength.

articleTitle: On the ontology-based semantic indexing mechanism in vocabulary knowledge base
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The traditional keyword searching mechanism has been unable to meet the needs of current expert knowledge base in searching based on semantic. Considering that the current indexing mechanism in the administration in the area of political affairs vocabulary knowledge management is lack of the ability of query reasoning, this paper combines with the optimizing B+ tree index and inverted index, and proposes semantic indexing mechanism based on ontology in vocabulary knowledge base of political affairs. This mechanism uses ontology to perform semantic annotation for vocabulary knowledge, and realizes high-efficient retrieval of semantic relations of vocabulary knowledge by building semantic indexing. The experimental results show that the mechanism has batter query inference ability and recall ratio in comparison with traditional B+ tree index and inverted index.

articleTitle: Analysis on deformation of diaphragm wall joints in soft soil
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Excessive horizontal deformation of diaphragm wall joints could lead to the difficulty in pulling locked port tube out, hoisting of reinforcing cage, percolating water in joints and so on. By analysing the problem and cause of deformation in diaphragm wall joints, bringing up the deformation analytical model of locked port tube based on elastic foundation beam, researching on the example project of diaphragm walls from a subway station in soft soil. The result shows that duo to a void of 6~8mm in the joining of locked port tube, the maximum deformation of calculated value is about 50mm lesser than monitored deformation in the practical scenarios. In order to decrease the deformation of locked port tube effectively, sands should be used as backfill in overbreaking grooves and the reasonable embedded depth of tube toe should be 1.0~1.5m.

articleTitle: Design of an axially telescoping wing control system based on servo motor
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a control system of axially telescoping wing experimental device is investigated. The control system is composed of STC89C52 SCM, an AC servo motor and two margin micro-switches. Based on the experimental device, a new design of telescoping wing is given. Telescoping wing is a kind of morphing wing, and is represented by an axially moving cantilever beam/plate. Telescoping wing is able to change its wing area and aspect ratio in order to adapt to the variable environments. The extending and retracting of telescoping wings could accomplish different actions and meet diverse needs in variable flight environments. Thus, the research of retractable wing is of great significance for both theory study and practical application.

articleTitle: Visualization of the experts' opinion consistency for group discussion
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: How to guide discussions in the group of experts from the divergent to convergent thinking is one of the hot issues of Hall for Workshop of Metasynthetic Engineering. This paper presents a method for consistency analysis and visualization of group's opinions. The consistency of group can be measured through the Euclidean distance. The raw experts' opinions are shown and analysed, and multidimensional scaling methods are used to visualize the group state to scattered-point graph. The group consistency analysis and visualization can be unified by drawing the group consistency on the graph directly. Finally, the visualizations of experts' opinion and group state are implemented in the case of the simulation-based weapons acquisition to verify the validity of the method.

articleTitle: Vector-matrix analysis method for designing disk-shaped milling-tool outlines in forming helical surfaces
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The manufacturing technique of helical surfaces is one of important tasks in developing single screw hydraulic machines. Using vector and matrix theory, a geometric relationship of contact points located at the contiguous curve between the spiral curved surface of workpiece and the disk shaped milling-tool rotary camber, is analyzed thoroughly. The common point equation and the perpendicular equation located at contact points are established according to the conjugate mesh theory. Then a new effective method based on vector-matrix analysis theory is derived for designing the disk-shaped milling tool outlines in forming spiral curved surfaces. Finally a special CAD software package of machining cylindrical spiral curved surfaces is developed.

articleTitle: Research for surface semielliptical crack stress intensity factor numerical simulation in power station heat exchange tube
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces through the Ansys parametric design language (APDL) to establish finite element model containing surface semielliptical crack expansion of power station heat exchange tube. The type of finite element is used in this program is isoparametric degradation singular element, whice simulates crack stress singularities. And the crack front is token discrete. Based on this kind of finite element model, the stress intensity factor value of the different shapes of crack at different depths has been calculated, the stress intensity factor value of distribution has been analysed and researched at the progress of different initial shape crack front expanding. And it provides important data for the prediction of the tube fatigue damage and using life. The results of this study show that: with the crack's growth, the shape of crack which has different initial shape will tend to be in a shape ratio range.

articleTitle: Shaking table test of a mega steel structure
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to investigate the seismic performance for a mega steel structure, a model with a scale of 1:35 is adopted. Through the shaking table test, the model of isolated, prototype and energy dissipation structure under different earthquakes of 7 degree is discussed. Base on the test results, natural frequency, acceleration response, layers shear response, layers displacement angle and displacement response of model are analyzed and compared. The test results show that seismic performance and safety can be improved with isolated measure for irregular plane structure.

articleTitle: A compile method supporting multi-language of control engineering
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Focusing on resolving the defects of control engineering compiler, such as monolingual support, or the high redundance and large amounts of multi-language support compiler, the paper proposed an approach to compile 5 standard languages of IEC61131-3,which reduced the complexity of the compiler and increased the reuse of codes. By means of analyzing the IEC61131-3, the standard language model was constructed. Combining with the study on characteristics of different implementation stages of compiler principle, the paper demonstrated the reusability of compiler module with different languages, and designed the optimized compiler architecture.

articleTitle: Research of Continuous Variable Camshaft Timing system based on fuzzy-PID control method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the control requirements of high speed, accuracy and stability for Continuous Variable Camshaft Timing (CVCT) system, an approach is proposed to adjust PID parameters online and realize by hardware. It combines fuzzy controller with PID controller to realize the self-adjustment of the PID control parameters in which the phase error e and the phase error rate ec are as inputs and the PID controller parameters are as outputs based on fuzzy control rules. The FPGA is employed to implement the algorithm and guarantee that it is fast and reliable. Finally, the experiments are executed on CVCT Test Desk and the results show that the control method can satisfy the condition that the adjustment time of system is less than 400 ms and the overshoot is less than 3°when the phase error is in the range of [−15, 15] degree.

articleTitle: Research on CAD and CAE integration technology in driving axle design system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of mechanical elements design, calculation and analysis on the methods of traditional driving axle design, the Visual basic software development tools were adopted to develop the parameterization technology for the axles design. The integration technology for the computer aided design and computer aided engineering was discussed and developed to realize the elements parameterization and integration. The driving axle virtual design system was developed to realize the virtualization and integration for driving axle design and analysis.

articleTitle: Temperature and thermal stress analytical models of metal materials in heat treating
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the mathematical models have been established to describe temperature and stress distributions in an axis-symmetric metal specimen. The models can treat nonlinear problem caused by temperature dependent properties. An example has been given to compare the results calculated by the models with those calculated by finite element method (FEM). It is shown that the analytical models obtained have high accuracy.

articleTitle: Evaluation and analysis of land suitability based on matter element analysis and GIS technology: An case study at Dongbeigou small watershed of Pingquan county in the water resource area of Beijing and Tianjin
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Focusing on the problems of fragile ecological environment and increasing soil erosion in the water resource area of Beijing and Tianjin, land suitability evaluation is badly needed, which is also can be the guide for land development uses and modern agriculture construction. Taking the Dongbeigou small watershed in Pingquan county of Hebei province as the study area, matter element analysis method and GIS technology are carried out to appraise suitability evaluation for agriculture, forestry, and pasture. Results showed that the areas of land which was the most suitable for agriculture were 44.202 hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, while the better suitable were 85.95 hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>; The areas of land which was suitable for forestry were 1099.12 hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, accounting for 20.08% of the total areas; the areas which was suitable for pasture amounted for 24.84%; The areas of land which was difficult to use accounted for 15.5%. Per capita arable land was 1.775 mu in the Dongbeigou small watershed, and per capita grain possession was 424.33 kg in 2009. The cultivated land and food production were relatively abundant. The results agreeed with the actual fact, and it could support for environment construction and land development uses in Dongbeigou small watershed.

articleTitle: Luminescence characteristics for different compositions of organic matter in soil and sediment ozonation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The real-time monitoring of soil quality and marine environment needs fast and accurate determination of organic matter compositions, which is difficult to realize. Ozonation has been successfully used to determine the concentrations of organic matter, thus we'll explore the possibility of determining the compositions of organic matter by ozonation. The luminescence characteristics for different compositions of organic matter were studied after the soil and sediment organic matter were divided into lipids, acid soluble fractions (AS), and acid insoluble fractions (AIF). Results showed that 1) the luminescence characteristics for soils and sediments are highly correlated with both concentrations of AS and AIF; 2) the relationship between AS and the luminescence characteristics is different from that between AIF and the luminescence characteristics; 3) lipids, AS, and AIF have different luminescence characteristics, and their concentrations can explain the different luminescence characteristics among soils and sediments. The paper first illustrated why different soils and sediments have different ozonation luminescence characteristics, suggesting that ozonaiton can be used to determine organic matter compositions. These results make real-time monitoring of the soil quality and marine environment feasible.

articleTitle: A numerical simulation on mining pressure law of mechanized mining face in Chang Gou yu Mine
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The article took Chang Gou yu coal mine for example. Based on the scene investigation and the ore presses monitor, According to the geological conditions of Chang Gou yu coal mine,we made the numerical simulation of mining face. After analyzed the abutment pressure and it's coverage of the first caving, the old roof first weighting and the old roof periodic weighting, Combined with the mine pressure monitoring data and the mine pressure appear law of the mining face, the article can take some reference for safety, high production, and efficiency exploitation.

articleTitle: Digitized occlusal reconstruction for dental prostheses
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The aim of this study was to explore a method for automatically reconstructing the occlusal surface by CAD technology. A 3D graphic database of standard tooth crown (STC) was established from physical models. Referring to the contact rule, the occlusal surface of STC was partitioned into several functional regions, and the regions related with occlusal adjustment were further defined as some sets of discrete points. Additionally, geometrical marks were added to the database to embody dimensional contours and orientation of STC. Then an adaptive redesign methodology was developed to form occlusal surface: firstly, a STC similar to patient's anatomical characteristics was scaled and registered to the abutment teeth; secondly, the distances between the point sets and the antagonist were calculated to quantify the occluding relation; finally, the occlusal surface was reconstructed by local deformation. The program provided a novel method to automatically adjust the size and location of the restoration, avoid interpenetrations and create necessary contacts. The final occlusal surface fulfills the esthetic and morphologic criteria in clinical dentistry and meets the physiologic demands of occlusal and proximal contacts.

articleTitle: The calculation of shaping curve for step with minor width in Cross Wedge Rolling
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Deep study on shaping process of Narrow Inside Right-angle Step (NIRS) have been conducted, in order to improve the precision of shaping NIRS, and to solve practical problems are emerged from design of dies for Cross Wedge Rolling (CWR). According to actual deforming process of NIRS, its models in shaping process were given. Their volume functions were expressed by two related parameters, and were piecewise solved by programming. Then shaping curves of NIRS were solved. Compared with shaping curve of normal step, the features of NIRS have been analyzed. FEM simulation verified the correctness of this method.

articleTitle: Reflective cracking dynamic response of asphalt concrete under vehicle loading
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the mechanical response of reflective cracking in asphalt concrete pavement under dynamic vehicle loading is proposed. A finite element model is established in ANSYS, and, A half-sine dynamic loading is used to simulate the vehicle loading. And Finally, the dynamic response of the pavement reflective cracking is analyzed under different vehicle load, different crack length and time. The results indicate that the normal stress and maximum vertical deflection on the surface is periodic change with time, The influence for normal stress and maximum vertical deflection on the surface on account of crack length and overload is remarkable, whereas, the influence for pavement deflection on account of crack length is not remarkable.

articleTitle: Multivariable method to analyze velocity of seismic wave
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the author analyzes the factor of the velocity from time to depth, and points out the limitations of the traditional methods. Considering the influence of multi-dimensional speed, The paper gives conceptions of velocity component and its coefficient and composes a function to analyze velocity with multi-factors by using methods of multinomial imitate, Kriging and weighted average method in data fusion to contrapose these shortcomings. It is easier to calculate and materialize with discrete velocity component and its coefficient, and favorable to transform time to depth automatically and increases its precision also. Through the contrast of two exploration stages in the same district, good application effect has been proved.

articleTitle: Experimental study on ptc pile composite foundation with cap in treating expressway soft soil ground
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: When cement-soil piles are applied to treat deep soft soil foundation of expressway especially in bridge head section, it is often showed insufficient ability in solving bridge-head jumping problems. In order to increase the pile spacing and decrease cost, the cement-soil piles can be replaced by prestressed tenssion cememt pile(PTC) with cap, which can make full use of the high bearing capacity of the PTC pile.The cap makes the deformation law of the foundation much different from which without cap or cement-soil pile foundation. Based on field test pile and loading experiments, the composite foundation treated by PTC piles with different treatment depth and cushion style is studied. It includes the settlement law in different depth, the differential settlement between the pile and the soil, the contiuous settlement law along the embankment cross section. Experiment and analysis results indicate that, For the effect of the cap and the cushion, the deformation of the reinforced area are more integrated, the stab deformation of the pile with cap was less than 10mm, the pile-soil stress ratio were adjusted efficiently. The variation law of the settlement along cross section presented wave form with little range of the peak and valley values. The variation range of the differential settlement is less than 15mm. The settlement of the substratum can be calculated by the layer-wise summation method, which can meet the request of soft soil ground improvement to the expressway engineering.

articleTitle: Nonlinear analysis of the shear behavior of concrete beams pre-stressed with FRP tendons
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As a new structural material, FRP (fiber reinforced plastics) features light weight, high strength, corrosion resistance, etc., and have a bright future when used for a new type of pre stressing tendon in engineering structures. The horizontal shear strength of FRP tendon is relatively low, which will affect the shear strength of concrete beams pre-stressed with FRP tendons. This paper carried out nonlinear analysis of the shear behavior of concrete beams pre-stressed with FRP tendons based on ANSYS software, the effect of various parameters on shear behavior were detailed discussed. The results of finite element analysis showed that nonlinear analysis were in good accordance with the experimental results, which can well simulate the shear behavior of pre-stressed concrete beams with FRP tendons.

articleTitle: Nonlinear vibrations of the blade with varying rotating speed
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Nonlinear behaviors of thin-walled Euler-Bernoulli beams with varying rotating speed which are attached to a rigid hub are investigated. Centrifugal force, aerodynamic load and the perturbed angular speed due to the inconstant air velocity are considered. The nonlinear factors are involved in displacement-strain relationships. The nonlinear governing partial differential equations of high-speed rotating thin-walled beam are established by using Hamiltonian Principle. Then, the ordinary differential equations of the rotating thin-walled beam are obtained by employing Galekin's approach during which Galekin's modes satisfy corresponding boundary conditions. The four-dimensional nonlinear averaged equations are obtained by applying the method of multiple scales. In this paper, the case of 1∶1 internal resonance is only considered. The results of the numerical simulation show that there exits complicated nonlinear behaviors in thin-walled Euler-Bernoulli beams with varying rotating speed.

articleTitle: Dynamic behaviors analysis of concrete filled steel tube X-type arches bridge
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A large-span concrete-filled steel tube bridge is taken as the studying object. The natural vibration frequencies and modes of the bridge are calculated with the subspace method, the bridge deck structure is simulated by three different methods in the finite element models, and the comparative analysis of computed results from the three kinds of models has been carried out.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation on heat transfer and flow resistance characteristics of spirally fluted tubes
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A comparative experimental investigation was carried out for heat transfer and resistance characteristics of smooth tube and 9 spirally fluted tubes with various structural parameters. The results show that the heat transfer and flow resistance performances of spirally fluted tubes are better than smooth tube. The heat transfer coefficient of the spirally fluted tubes are as 2.46~3.08 times as the smooth tube's. The flow resistance coefficient of the fluted tubes are as 2.1~7 times as the plain tube. The correlations with relatively high precision have been obtained regarding heat transfer coefficient and resistance factor of the mentioned fluted tubes by adopting a multivariable linear regression method. This paper also analyzes the main influence factors of heat transfer and flow characteristics of spirally fluted tubes and points out that using small pitch and groove depth can obtain better heat transfer effect.

articleTitle: The controlling-study on the sensorless brushless DC motor and its application in a new type automated transmission
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Applying the principle of back-electromotive force(EMF), a sensorless brushless DC motor-driver was designed in this paper, and detailedly analyse the running-principle of the sensorless brushless DC motor, and then the motor-driver was used in a hydraulic pressure system of new type Dual Clutch Transmission. The experiment and testing-date indicated the motor-driver has a highly working-value.

articleTitle: On ADRC for photoelectrical stabilized platform
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper discusses the ADRC application in the photoelectrical platform for disturbance rejection. Firstly, model of stabilized platform system is established, in which uncertain external load disturbance and unmodelled dynamics are regarded as one integrated disturbance. Then, using ESO to observe and compensate this integrated disturbance, and using the compensation loop of active disturbance rejection control(ADRC) as the inner loop of traditional PID controller . The simulation results show that the anti-interference ability could be improved by the designing of ADRC with traditional PID control. The stable precision of visible axis could be well improved. Both the simulation and hardware implementation of the ADRC based digital control method on the platform show that the controller has good aspect to have good engineering function and prospect.

articleTitle: Foundation design on geographic information system of heating networking district heating in Urumqi
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper mainly introduced the basic design plan of taking technology of GIS used for heating pipelines district heating in Urumqi. It elaborates in detail the critical technology involving the system structure design, page planning, function planning, data organization, and the choice of GIS platform. Thus the theory and technical bases were provided to the further development of software and hardware in this paper. Simultaneously, the important instruction of technique also has been provided to district heating system.

articleTitle: CO2 removal from natural gas by hydrate formation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: High component of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> in natural gas is hazardous for the utilization of natural gas. Thus CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> must be removed from natural gas. As one of the new separation technology, hydrate formation has more advantages than original technology. It can be carried out under milder conditions and it is wild range applicable. Moreover, the gas regeneration rate is higher while the process is shorter. However, as the study time is short, hydrate formation has high energy consumption which makes it less commercially attractive. In this study, we show the broad prospect of the utilization of this technology and put forward the future research direction.

articleTitle: Data processing system based on CNC carpentry line trace mill
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to transform the traditional carpentry line trace mill into CNC, a new method was presented. This new method takes the technology of graphics interaction with DXF file, and can mill directly according to the workpiece surface shape data. CNC carpentry line trace mill data processing software in VC++6. 0 environment was developed which can realize arbitrary contour curves discretization and G-Code generation.The processing experiments prove that this system can simplify the machine operation, increase milling efficiency, improve quality effectively and reduce the production cost.

articleTitle: The investigation and control of a typical landslide along ZaMo road of Tibet
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Motuo is located in Tibet. It is the unique county without highway in China. Along ZaMo road are steep mountains with strong tectonic activity and seismic activity, broken rocks, plenty of rainfall. By calculating the stability coefficient, the stability coefficient of the K85 landslide was 1.03 in natural situation, which meant the slope was in creeping slip station. And saturation state was 0.95, meaning the slope was in unstable state. The stability coefficient was 0.82 in natural situation with effect of seismic intensity of IX degrees, which meant the slope was in unstable state. By contrast, recommend Anti-Slide Pikes in One Row, in combination of the Engineering of Water Drainage. While strengthening the monitoring, timely take appropriate emergency measures.

articleTitle: Research on several LEMP electric field measuring equipment's emendation devices
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to guarantee lightning electric field measuring equipment's veracity and relativity, electric field measuring equipment must be emendated before using.
