In this paper, analysised of the performance of bounded wave simulator, parallel plate electric field generator and homemade U-type emendation device when they were used to emendate lightning electric field measuring equipment. Analysised of electric field's uniformity in the bounded wave simulator's space under the lightning wave electric field excitation by Finite-Difference Time-Domain Method, and proved parallel plate electric field generator and U-type emendation device can emendate lightning electric field measuring equipment through test.

articleTitle: The theory and practice discussion of compiling flexible talents training scheme in engineering management
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: From the lofty mission of engineering management in 21st century, this article discussed the aim, significance, necessity and existing problems of compiling specialty talents' cultivation plan about engineering management, and mainly discussed the basic principles and basic framework, then evaluated the new training program according to the requirement of flexible education. At the same time it seems that the new training program has the reasonable curriculum, notices the application and design of teaching process, and also scientific distribution of time, the main course designs properly, it can adapt to the requirement of modern society developing for broad caliber and innovative talent in engineering management.

articleTitle: Design and evolution of variable topology parallel mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: First, considering the characteristics of parallel mechanisms themselves, variable topology mechanism theory was introduced. The definition, determine method and basic variable topology means of variable topology parallel mechanism were given. Also some basic mechanisms evaluation criteria were introduced. Then, taking 3-UPU mechanism as ideal mechanism and topology synthesis was carried out. The introduction of variable topology mechanism theory provided a theoretical basis and innovative approaches for the synthesis of parallel mechanisms.

articleTitle: The psychrophilic methanogens application in anaerobic biological treatment and research on cold-adapted mechanism
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Anaerobic digestion technology of organic waste is considered sustainable and optimum. However, the process of anaerobic digestion at mesophilic and thermophilic temperatures is well understood and applied, psychrophilic temperatures treatment has not been explored widely which could reduce operation cost considerably. This review states the research progress and cold-adapted mechanism of psychrophilic methanogens. Moreover, some new research theory and technology on psychrophilic methanogens were proposed. The application and prospect of anaerobic digestion at low temperature were also discussed.

articleTitle: Seismic evaluation and strengthening for a power-transmission frame
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Been used several years, one power-transmission frame's main transformer need to be transformed. For reasons of material, load and circumstance, different degree of damage appeared in the power-transmission frame, structural investigation and the structural synthetic seismic calculation were done to find the problem in structural system. Then some reasonable strengthening suggestions were put forward based on the analysis.

articleTitle: Study on the influence regulations of noise on the curvature mode in damage detections
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Curvature mode can be written as second-order differentials and can be obtained by displacement mode using the center differential principle. Noise may cause vibration mode monitoring error, which can be transmitted to curvature mode. In order to study the effect of noises on the curvature mode analysis, the vibration mode data obtained from the finite element analysis are added the different level noises. The results indicate that the curvature mode method can accurately judge out the stiffness damages which are greater than 10 percent before the noises are introduced to the vibration mode, when the vibration displacement error caused by noises is higher 5 percent, the careless mistakes are easy to occur. Based on the concept of function total differential, the error transmission formulas from vibration mode to the curvature mode are derived.

articleTitle: Research on the landscape of Terrace Land and discussion on the management pattern
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As a particular agricultural and vernacular landscape. Terrace land has been generated by long-time experiences accumulating in farming. It is a sustainable land use model, which is satisfy human living and survival needs. Based on the case study of Baiyangdian region, the research illustrate the structure, functions, values of the Terrace Land system evaluated by Ecological Services and the great ecological issue: plants spreads and swamping greatly in the basin. And based on landscape ecology, geographical information system and Relative Theory, the discussion is made to offer a set of management system for Terrace Land: 1) Analyze the regional Eco-hydrology in Baiyangdian basin ; 2) Research into the relationship between plants spreading and swamping; 3) establish the management system of Eco-hydrology and Terrace Land Patterns co-control on swamp vegetation swamping. At the end, the issue would be studied in a deep-going way in the future research.

articleTitle: Study on effect of chemical deicing salt on soil salinity along highways in Shaanxi
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Chemical deicing salt was one of the main ways for highway snow shovel, but its effect on soil and environment around also was paid more and more attention in recent time. Based on filed sampling and indoor analysis, effect of chemical deicing salt application after big snow in 2008 on soil was analyzed, and its damages was evaluated. Results indicated that along the road area, on the site of K51, K71, K91 and K108, salt content on central green belt was much higher than that on the road sides. Salt damages evaluation showed us that on these sites, such salt content had some restrictions on the plant growth; while it will not affect plant growth along the road sides as for its lower salt content.

articleTitle: Coupled stress and fluid flow analysis of earth dam after concrete core-wall reinforcement based on non-linear finite element method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Taken earth dam reinforcement engineering of DaShan reservoir as an example, considered the couple effect of seepage field and stress field and the contact effect between concrete core-wall and soil body, the elastic-plasticity finite element model (FEM) of concrete core-wall earth dam after reinforcement is set up. The concrete core-wall deformation and stress after reinforcement are calculated and analyzed. The results show that although the concrete core-wall reduces the saturation line height and increases dam seepage effects, but for stress, at the bottom of concrete core-wall the phenomenon of stress concentration is obvious because of the uncoordinated deformation between the soft soil and rigid concrete core-wall. The stress level of concrete core-wall is high and it is most likely damage area, while the stress is within the permissible compressive strength of concrete. The result can provide an important reference for this project on the dam safety monitoring and management.

articleTitle: Research on evaluation of groundwater resources and the problems by its development and use in Sanjiang low Plain
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Sanjiang low plain aquifer is mainly made up of sand, gravel lithology stone and sandy pebble, where the aquifer thickness of general areas is 100-200m, which forms the porosity of the thick aquifer system. Water balance method is used to calculate the groundwater recharge and discharge, which of two are 43.72 and 45.99 billion m3/a. So it is in negative balance; though the exploitation coefficient method and method of mathematical model. We can calculate groundwater withdrawal that is 31.6 million m3/a. The results showed that the groundwater resources in the region have slightly exploitation potential, but some cone of depressions have appeared in some places, such as JiaMusi city. Ecological environment also has begun to deteriorate, the wetland atrophy and vegetation degenerate. Therefore we must take positive countermeasures, such as reasonable development of water resources, the control agricultural water, the development of water-saving irrigation, perfecting supervision mechanism etc.

articleTitle: Study the relationship between the flow-ratio of air and solution (FRAS) and the dehumidify capability and optimize the FRAS in the solar dehumidification system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The technology of liquid desiccant and solar regeneration, is the key technical problems of evaporative cooling in high temperature and humidity region. Through the experimental measurement, study the relationship between the flow-ratio of air and solution and the dehumidify capability in different operating point of calcium chloride (CaCl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) and chloride lithium (LiCl) mixture liquids. Also analyze the effect of the heat capacity ratio (m ) and total thermal efficiency according the total thermal efficiency count formula. The conclusion is that not the more air flow, the better dehumidification efficiency, when the solution mass flow is consent. The flow-ratio of air and solution need be optimized. The dehumidification efficiency of mixture salt solution in the solar dehumidification system was improved from percentage of 32.5 to 51.7, according to the optimal the flow-ratio of air and solution. This research for improving the dehumidification efficiency of mixture salt solution in the solar dehumidification system provides the theory evidence.

articleTitle: Risk management in BOT projects of WTE plant
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper gives a systemic and comprehensive risk analysis of WTE plant BOT projects. The risk change curves of government and project owner in different periods are analyzed. Twelve key risks which impact on WTE plant BOT projects are identified. And all these risks are classified by government, project companies or allocated between the two parts according to risk management principle. At last, the strategies of risks allocation and precaution are presented for this kind of BOT projects, to provide a risk management framework for project participants, especially for local government.

articleTitle: Study on Jatropha oil as a promising renewable lube base oil for bio-lubricant
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Jatropha oil is a promising raw material for biodegradable lubricant since it is a non-edible vegetable oil produced from the seeds of the Jatropha curcas, a plant that can grow in marginal lands, and does not compete for the food production with human or for land with food. But there are few relative studies and reports so far. In this paper, samples of Jatropha curcas seeds are tested to investigate their biological characters and chemical components. The primary fatty acid composition and the main lubricating properties are determined by GC-MS and related Chinese Standards. Moreover, main lubricating characteristics of the mixture of different proportional Jatropha curcas oil and mineral oil are studied. Viscosity, acid number and oxidation stability of the mixed oil are found to be comparable with the mineral oil and the pour point reduced significantly.

articleTitle: The evaluation of the second-order pre-iteration Landweber algorithm based on the method of model-group
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to solve the poor real-time property in Landweber algorithm, a pre-iteration algorithm had been proposed by the researchers. But it is still lack of the study on this modified algorithm, especially to its second-order iterative form. In this article, this pre-iteration Landweber algorithm in second-order iterative formula will be evaluated based on the method of model-group, some parameters will be designed to do the quantitative analysis. The results show the second-order pre-iteration Landweber algorithm has a better convergence rate than it in first-order form, it also has a good ability to follow the change of reference model after an optimal number of iteration is found, the quality of the reconstructed images are better and suitable for practical application.

articleTitle: First-principle calculation of Ge-doped anatase TiO2
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Band structure of the Ge-doped anatase TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> has been analyzed using the full potential-linearized augmented plane wave method (FP-LAPW). We investigated the band structure of the Ge-doped anatase TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> using generalized gradient approximation (GGA) and local density approximation (LDA). Compared our calculated optimized structure of the Ge doped with the pure anatase TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, it can be concluded that the volume of the Ge-doped anatase become reduced. The calculated band structure prefers an indirect transition between valence and conduction band of the Ge-doped anatase TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>. The calculated results are in good agreement with the other calculated results.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on modernization elements of exhibition centers
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Analysis on crankshaft of 12V190 engine using 3-D FEA method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to simulate mutual effects between crankshaft and base, connecting rod and crankpin, the FEA software is applied to crankshaft's structural analysis. Based on the crankshaft model and reasonable contact set, the crankshaft is analyzed successfully. Results show that the way can be better applied for the engineering practice as a new thought for the crankshaft's intensity analysis and the crankshaft designed is safety under operating condition.

articleTitle: The application of time entropy of lift wavelet on ultrasonic signal detection
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: T Ultrasonic signal detection is one kind of the non-destructive testing methods, and it can be non-destructive inspection of the internal defects of materials or mechanical components. One of the difficulties of ultrasonic signal detection is the detection of the echo signal in the ultrasonic signal. Firstly, the basic principle of lifting wavelet transform and the theory of integer lifting wavelet transform of ultrasonic signal is introduced in this paper. Then the wavelet-time entropy algorithm is introduced and the numerical simulations are carried out to prove the feasibility of this algorithm in abnormal signal detection. An improved wavelet-time entropy algorithm is put forward in this paper. The high-frequency coefficients of wavelet transform are replaced by the low-frequency coefficients, and the optimal width of window is worked out for actual ultrasonic signal. The results show that this improved wavelettime entropy algorithm can effectively detect the echo signal in ultrasonic signal.

articleTitle: Modeling and analysis on cutting force in high speed milling aeronautic aluminum alloy
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a high speed milling test for aeronautic aluminum alloy 2A70 was carried out, and the cutting forces were measured. The least square method was used to make a regression analysis on testing data, and the experiential formulas for high speed milling were established. The influencing laws of cutting parameters on cutting force were educed, which can offer an important reference for optimizing cutting parameters.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation analysis on stability of tunnel under unsymmetrical pressure during excavation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on an actual freeway tunnel project, this paper applied the finite element analysis software MIDAS/GTS and layer structure method to analyze the stability of tunnel under unsymmetrical pressure during excavation. The analysis results showed that in the process of excavating lateral drift, due to the unsymmetrical pressure the most disadvantageous locations of surrounding rock occurred at the two sides of arch crown and invert, and the largest deformation occurred at the position of crown settlement and foot, so the special consolidation measures should be taken. The safety effect on the primary support was greater when the temporary support was removed, so the removal length of temporary support should be controlled strictly during construction.

articleTitle: Motion model and dredging accuracy of trailing suction hopper dredger
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Trailing suction hopper dredgers (TSHD) are widely-used in construction of channels and ports. Under deepwater and adverse circumstances, the dredging accuracy of trailing suction hopper dredger is an important issue to be solved in practice project. For predicting the motion of draghead and controlling overdepth and overwidth dredging, a mathematical model of motion for trailing suction hopper dredger-draghead system is developed, considering the manoeuvring forces of ship, wind force, wave force, current force and other hydrodynamic parameters, as well as the resistance of soil on the draghead, which is tested and verified by full-scale ship test measuring. The influence of water depth, wind, wave, current and soil on dredging accuracy are investigated under the manoeuvrings.

articleTitle: Microwave transmission properties of conductive slabs
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: For the purpose of investigating the potentiality of conductive materials, dissipative medium model was used to analyze and calculate the microwave transmission properties of multi-layer conductor samples. It seems from the calculation results that even 0.1 μm thin conductive slabs can dissipate 50% of the incident microwave energy. Further analysis on the dependence of sample reflection on conductivity, incident angle, sample thickness and microwave frequency, however, indicates that the effective reflection varies acutely with these factors, and low reflection can be obtained only under harsh conditions. In most cases, as these harsh conditions can nor be satisfied, the effective reflection of conductive slabs usually is much lower than many estimated values in references.

articleTitle: Topological optimization of the elastic member of dynamometer based on ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Finite Element Method (FEM) model was built and model analysis was executed for a thin-wall cylinder dynamometer with ANSYS, the natural frequencies and modal shapes of the dynamometer are obtained. The topological optimization was done with the variable-density method. The utilization rate of materials was improved, and the lower model frequencies were increased.

articleTitle: Rigid method for dispersion relation of plasma antenna
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The range for rationality of ideal boundary condition is discussed at length. Plasma antenna is always out of the range, but many studies based on this ideal boundary condition. So we use a more appropriate method to cope after rigid boundary conditions are derived. In some cases, the results tally with those by usual method, and in other cases, some conclusions are obtained which cannot get from the usual way but reasonable theoretically. The dispersion relation of plasma antenna is given finally.

articleTitle: Segmentation of a sonar image from a small underwater target using the improved fuzzy clustering algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper expatiates on the improved fuzzy c-means (FCM) clustering algorithm. In the algorithm, the membership values are determined via the improved method, and the number of the centers of FCM clustering are determined via the number of the peaks of the two-dimensional histogram on the gray-level values of pixels and gradient values of pixel neighborhoods. The application to segmentation of a sonar image of a small underwater target shows that the improved FCM clustering algorithm can segment the image into the shadow and echo regions of the target, and that the improved algorithm is more intelligent and timesaving than the traditionary FCM clustering algorithm.

articleTitle: Calculation of cross-section average flow velocity in vegetated compound channels
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The formulae of cross-section average flow velocity of main channel and floodplain in vegetated compound channels are derived by establishing horizontal force balance formula. The value of momentum transfer coefficient is chosen by relative flow depth. The experimental data of different density of floodplain vegetation in compound channels are applied. When the vegetation density m=0, series of no floodplain vegetation experimental date are taken to measure the formulae of cross section average velocity and find good agreement; when the vegetation density m>;0, the other series of experimental date measured in compound channels with floodplain vegetation are taken to evaluate the formulae and compare that with Liu peiqing method. The computed results show the formulae are more accurate than Liu peiqing method.

articleTitle: Enantiomeric separations of neonicotinoid insecticides on a Chirobiotic V column by high-performance liquid chromatography
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The enantiomeric separations of three neonicotinoid insecticides (compounds 1, 2, and 3 ) were performed on a Chirobiotic V chiral column by high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) under a new-polar mobile phase mode, using methanol and ethanol with triethylamine as the basic additive as the mobile phase. Compound 1 obtained no separation under all the mobile phase, while compound 2 and 3 were partially separated. Ethanol provides better chiral resolution than methanol, and triethylamine added in ethanol or methanol is in favour of enantiomeric separation for neonicotinoid insecticides. The main chiral recognition mechanism between these three neonicotinoid insecticides and vancomycin CSP might be the hydrogen-bonding interactions, steric interactions and poor ionization interactions.

articleTitle: Analyses on control of water demand in an urban independent lake
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Park lake water in urban is playing an important role in urban environment and residents' life. The research was aimed at a park lake located in the north of China. As an independent lake, without natural water to supplement, the lake water was evaporated to the air and osmosis to the groundwater rapidly. So, we need to know how much to be supplemented to keep the sightseeing effects. The test shows that water level of the lake goes down with the temperature, humidity, wind power, bottom structure of the lake. Water loss in spring and autumn are faster than that in summer, and the calculation shows that 6.9×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> was needed to supplement into the lake in order to keep the water level in a region, and that the supplementary will be 93% times of the water volume.

articleTitle: Simulation On ABS and TPMS merging system based on fuzzy PID control
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article expands the tire pressure monitoring system into the vehicle ABS controller. Based on the Matlab tool, the simulation model of the fusion system was established, and three different road conditions were simulated and analyzed. The simulation results showed that the road attachment coefficient has less effect on the tire longitudinal rigidity than the tire pressure, which is necessary to be monitored at real time especially during the vehicle braking process.

articleTitle: Research on simulation for fracture process of T-type adhesive bonded joint under peel load
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, T-type adhesively bonded joint peel test is served as simulation object, to explore a efficiently approach to model T-type adhesive bonded joint and to predict it's failure. Firstly, T-type adhesively bonded joint peel tests were conducted. Base on the measured data, load-displacement curve were plot. Secondly, on the basis of DYNA, a finite element model of T-type adhesive bonded joint was built. Works focus on how to use adhesive material model (MAT169)to model adhesive, and how to select the fracture parameters in model. Finally, this simulation approach was be validated by tests. The results show that adhesive material model (MAT169)can be used to model adhesive fracture and adhesive bonded joint separation efficiently. Through examine constitutive response of one solid element with MAT169, fracture parameters can be determined after some attempts and comparisons. Connecting between shell element and solid element can be implemented by increasing adhesive layer's thickness. It inevitably results in error which can be eliminated by adjusting elastic modulus of adhesive. However, more research works are needed to be done for predicting adhesive bonded joint's initial peel force.

articleTitle: Effects of soil condition on stolon growth of centipedegrass
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Five treatment groups i.e. Control, Intensity 1 (T1), Intensity 2 (T2), Intensity 3 (T3) and Intensity 4 (T4) were conducted through simulated trampling. Stolon density of Eremochloa ophiuroides was significantly affected by trampling (p<0.01). With the exception of T4, with an increase of growth days, the density of stolons gradually increased in length from Control to T3. Stolon density increased after moderate trampling disturbance of T1, and decreased gradually when over-trampling was done from T2 to T4.

articleTitle: A non-uniform beam element considering shear deformation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A new type of non-uniform beam element taking into account shear deformation has been proposed for the analysis of non-uniform members with large height-span ratios in engineering structures. The expressions of element stiffness matrix and equivalent node load matrix for the non-uniform beam element are firstly derived on the basis of force method. Furthermore, by adopting the numerical integration method, accurate formulae of non-uniformity coefficient of shear stress for rectangular hollow sections are obtained. Example results show that the presented beam element behaves high accuracy and high computational efficiency, and could be adopted in the mechanical analysis of structures composed of non-uniform members.

articleTitle: Analysis of status quo, problems and potential about waste heat recovery of NSP cement production lines' exhaust gas
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this thesis, we have introduced the features of exhaust gas waste heat resources from both domestic and foreign NSP Cement Production Lines, summarized the status quo and problems about the technology of the exhaust gas heat recovery, and by calculating we analyzed the potential of the low temperature exhaust gas which has been used by the waste heat boilers.

Author Keywords: pure low-temperature waste heat power generation
potential of low temperature exhaust gas

articleTitle: Study on simulation of Lean NOx Trap for lean burn gasoline engine
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The adsorption reduction mechanism and main chemical reactions were analyzed. After that, a Lean NOx Trap (LNT) model based on Simulink was constructed in this paper. Grounded on our calculation results, precisely control of the transition between rich and lean combustion mode was obtained. And also, the ratio of rich burn duration to lean burn duration had a significant effect on the NOx emissions of engines.

articleTitle: Passive automatic maximum wind energy tracking wind power generation system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper proposes a novel off-grid wind power generation system, comprising a double-winding permanent magnet synchronous generator, a three-phase controllable saturated reactor, two rectifiers, a battery and a load. The output power curve of the new system keeps in accordance with the maximum output power curve of the wind turbine, which makes the system track maximum wind energy automatically. A 300W prototype was manufactured. Experimental results show that the power output curve of the new system matches with the maximum output power curve of the wind turbine in a wide range of rotational speed. Compared with the traditional system, Wind energy utilization coefficient of the new system is improved greatly.

articleTitle: Analyze of the society right structure behind significant pollution incidents — Gas blowout accident in Kaixian county of Chongqing as an example
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Parties of the social rights in the structure of significant pollution incident are: the business as the perpetrators, government as managers, the public as the victims, the news media as evangelist and supervisor. In the pollution incident, the business behavior caused the pollution incidents and public loss, the public claimed the business to safeguard their legitimate rights and interests; the business behavior also caused the loss of government, which could punish the business by all means. The government right is from and given by the public. Public obtained information through the news media; media reports help the government improve public policy, the government constraints media reports to limit the scope and direction of media coverage.

Author Keywords: Gas Blowout Accident in Kaixian Count

articleTitle: Study on the ecological ethic in highway construction
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: During the period of "National Twelfth Five-Year Plan", China has entered an age of rapid development for Highway construction. It need to regulate the ethical relationship between people and ecological environment to tackle the problem of ecological damage caused by highway construction, so it is both inevitable and necessary to promote ecological ethic in highway construction. Based on the theory of environmental ethic, the importance of ecological ethic in highway construction is proposed in the paper. The concept of ecological aesthetics in highway construction is analyzed and the relationship of ecological ethic and ecological aesthetics is described. The detailed analysis of the connotation and main ideas of ecological ethic are made to promote balanced development of ecological security of highway construction and transportation economic development.

articleTitle: Design of anti-lock braking system for electric vehicles via short-circuit braking
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The slip ratio control problem in anti-lock braking system (ABS) is highly nonlinear and complicated. In this paper, a sliding mode controller is developed to generate appropriate torque for the driving motor of two-wheel electric vehicles that ensures optimality of the slip ratio for efficient vehicle brake. The design is based on a novel short-circuit braking mechanism to emulate the mechanical ABS for the traditional gas-powered vehicles.

articleTitle: The research on the multi-layer survivability
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Firstly, gave a brief comparison of the survivability technologies of IP layer and optical layer. Furthermore, through the close study of related researches in various multi-layer survivability of IP over Optical network, the conclusions of the consonant environment for various multi-layer survivability was drawn from the view of cost and availability. At the end of this paper, further framed the time model suitable for the fault recovery under the IP over Optical network architecture, and still classify the various faults under this network architecture, and even more set up the coordinative rule table of faults recovery for various environments. At last designed the multi-layer survivability algorithm according to the coordinative rule table under the unified control plane.

articleTitle: Φ3.2m×5.3m damp mill virtual prototype design and kinematic simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Apply digital design method in Φ3.2 m × 5.3 m damp mill design and manufacture process to found digital product model using Pro/ENGINEER software and use the technology which include interference check-up, digital simulation and engineering analysis to improve on or perfect design blue print, enhance product exploitation efficiency and product performance.

articleTitle: Waveform inversion of crosshole data based on acoustic wave equation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Waveform inversion of crosshole data based on acoustic wave equation is investigated in this paper. The inversion is set as an optimization problem with the Lagrange multiplier function. The Tikhonov regularization is adopted in objective function. The gradient of the objective function is generated by solving the adjoint equation of the forward problem with the finite difference method. In order to prevent the quasi-Newton method to trap in local optimal value, a suitable initial model is required. For comparison, the traveltime inversion or tomography is implemented which provide smooth features of the velocity model. Numerical computations are given which show the good ability of the new velocity inversion method.

articleTitle: Design of fuzzy-CMAC neural-network complex controller for gas mixing process
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The gas mixing pressuring and calorific value control of gas mixing process have the characteristics of strong coupling, nonlinear, uncertainty and large time-varying. If the calorific value of mixing gas is unstable in gas pressurization station, the quality and quantity of iron and steel production will be affected. In this paper, an complex decoupling control method of fuzzy-CMAC neural network is proposed according to the mixing gas pressure and calorific value decoupling control. the fuzzy decoupling controller is used to realize the initial adjustment of mixing gas and pressure, which has the characteristics of rapidity and anti-interference performance. The fine adjustment work of control process is completed by the secondary adjustment of CMAC-PID compound controller. The design of controller has the ability of parameter self-learning, and the simulation results show that this design scheme has a better dynamic performance than traditional PID scheme to verify the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: A hardware design of Steer-By-Wire system based on MC9S12XF512
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To meet the requirement of high transmission speed and reliability of distributed control system in Steer-By-Wire (SBW), a hardware design based on MC9S12XF512, which has a FlexRay module, featuring high transmission speed and deterministic transfer time, was put forward after analysis of SBW working principle. The hardware was developed and the interface design of motor drive, photoelectric encoder and FlexRay communication were introduced in detail.

articleTitle: Wire extension with Dual freedom PID control in pulsed MIG welding process of aluminum alloy
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Research work of wire extension control with Dual freedom PID controller in pulsed MIG welding process of aluminum alloy. In the condition of optimum parameters, the simulations were firstly completed by separately using Routine PID control and Dual freedom PID control, based on designing the wire speed of wire extension step response and gaining identification model. Based on the results of simulation using Matlab/Simulink, the experimental research on aluminum alloy pulsed MIG welding by using Dual freedom PID control was carried out in the real-time target environment with XPC Target. In the pulsed MIG welding process of aluminum alloy, the results prove that the Dual freedom PID control can bring higher precision and quicker response speed, efficiently control the stability of wire extension, and satisfy the stability of welding process.

articleTitle: Safety evaluation and feedback analysis of guide wall structure under flood discharge excitation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As an important part of flood discharge building, the discharge safety of guide wall is concerned because of its thin shape and long time flood discharge excitation. Due to the lack of full understanding of fluctuating loads, many domestic and international damage accidents of guide wall have happened during the flood discharge. Taking flood discharge loads as excitation, this paper carries out the prototype dynamic test of three gorges left guide wall and analyzes the regularities of distribution of the root-mean-square of dynamic displacement response on the guide wall in the length direction, gives the main vibration source of guide wall and the main results of numerical simulation, prototype vibration displacement and dynamic stress. At last, based on these results, the guide wall flood discharge safety assessment and feedback analysis are carried out.

articleTitle: Research of game-theoretic approach for aircraft ground deicing operation scheduling
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Aims at the plan and scheduling of aircraft deicing resources in large airports, the game-theoretic analysis method is adopted for the solution of deicing delay that based on the aircraft ground deicing process multi-agent modeling in this paper. The resources allocation method for airlines is proposed, and the algorithm of allocate deicing slots, bays and deicing priority is designed. Finally, Matlab software is used for simulating the multi-agent system. The domestic departures data of Beijing Capital International Airport is used for simulation experiments. The results show that the game model optimized by PF(Priority Fluctuating) outperforms the first come, first service scheduling strategy not only in total deicing delay, total number of aircrafts and the rate of aircraft delay, but also at deicing congested circumstance. A new strategy is proposed for the plan and scheduling of aircraft deicing resources.

articleTitle: Feature extraction of turbine abnormal vibration condition based on ICA
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Independent component analysis of a single measured mixing signal, that is single channel Independent component analysis (SCICA), has been widely used in feature extraction of a signal. In this paper we provide a example of using single channel ICA for extracting the feature of a abnormal running condition of a turbine from measured vibration signals, in order to show the effect of SCICA. The bearing vibration signals of the turbine are measured under two different running conditions. We choose one bearing vibration signal with clear abnormal information to test. The results show that the basic functions of SCICA have different characters for different turbine running condition and can be used as features. The results need further analyze to distinguish the different states.

articleTitle: Rare earth elements stratigraphic significance in Late Permian mudstones from Mount Huaying, Sichuan Province, China
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Rare earth elements (REEs) are good geological indicators. In order to understand REEs stratigraphic significance, REEs in Late Permian coal measure stratum from Mount Huaying, eastern Sichuan Province, China were studied. The results indicate that the contents of both light rare earth element (LREE) and REE are dramatic change in the boundary between Longtan Formation and Maokou Formation, which result from the gyration and discontinuity eruption of Emeishan basalt (REEs source and controlling factor of enrichment) and frequent transgression-regression during forming basin. The coal measure stratum could be subdivided and correlate, and the sea-level change could be under stand by studying REEs content variation in coal measure. The phenomena show that REEs, like fossils and rocks, can be used as indicators to subdivide and correlate strata. Although the other geochemical elements and geochemical methods are conducted to indicate and determine the stratigraphic boundary, only a few of reports about REEs have been published.

articleTitle: Experiment research on the composite material produced by waste residue from paper mill and recycle polyethylene
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The composite was prepared by injection molding of waste residue from paper mill and recycle polyethylene. In the composite, maleic anhydride grafted polyethylene (MAPE) was used as coupling agent. Influence of different weigh ratio of waste residue and MAPE on mechanical properties of the composites was studied. The test result was as follows: the weigh ratio of waste residue and MAPE coupling agent influenced evidently the interfacial compatibility. Flexual strength of the composite decreased significantly with the increasing ratio of waste residue and increased significantly with the increasing ratio of MAPE. Flexual strength of the composite filled waste residue was lower than that of the composite filled rice hull. Their rules of transformation were the same, so waste residue can be used to produce the composite like rice hull.

articleTitle: Disposal engineering research and application progress of poultry wastewater
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the status that the pollution of wastewater from livestock and poultry raising is going from bad to worse in China, some treatment technologies such as irrigation to farmland, natural treatment and industrialized treatment were reviewed. Considering the practical situation in China, it was suggested to currently prioritize irrigation to farmland and natural treatment. To establish databases of designing livestock wastewater treatment as well as to compile design specification were also suggested.

articleTitle: Removal of mixed volatile organic compounds using bipolar pulsed DBD
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The study on the decomposition of mixed volatile organic compounds (VOCs) has significance value for that the exhaust gas from manufactory is usually mixture of several kinds of VOCs. This experiment chose four kinds of VOCs (acetone, benzene, tetrachloroethylene and m-xylene) as the treatment objects to study the decomposition characteristics of mixed VOCs by the bipolar pulsed DBD (bipolar pulsed power introduced into dielectric barrier discharge reactor). The results indicated that the order of the removal efficiency of VOCs followed as m-xylene > tetrachloroethylene > benzene > acetone no matter treating single-compound or mixed VOCs. The decomposition characteristics of mixed components were different from that of single-compound because of the interaction effect in the mixture. Comparing with the result of treating single-compound, the removal efficiency of m-xylene only fell a little but the other three components fell a lot on the mixed VOCs treatment. In addition, when the capacitance of the pulse capacitor was at an appropriate range, more effective energy, higher level energetic electrons and active particles could be injected into the DBD reactor, which could enhance the removal efficiency and energy efficiency of the mixed VOCs.

articleTitle: The calculation of single-phase impedance current on heavily loaded long circuit of double end power
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the heavily loaded long circuit of double end power, the paper provided the computing technology of single phase ground short-circuit current when the influences of load were took into consideration. Through the embodiment, analyzed is the error of impedance current with two different conditions: neglecting load influences and including load influences. The results show that there are small errors, this is basically allowed in general engineering applications. But there are bigger error on the grounding phase impedance current positive sequence. It will influence seriously the setting of relay protection equipment and safe automatic equipments.

articleTitle: Fracture analysis for brake drum of the truck
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By the fracture analysis on HT250 brake drum, we think that the failure of brake drum in use process is due to internal slag in the bottom of brake drum in the casting process, Or because of brake drum in use process produce hot fatigue crack, which instability expansion leed to the fracture.

articleTitle: Effect of stirring power on semisolid A356 alloy slurry prepared by low superheat pouring
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Semisolid A356 alloy slurry is prepared by low super heat pouring and slightly electromagnetic stirring, and the effects of the stirring power on the semisolid slurry poured by low superheat pouring are studied. The results indicate that the slurry with particle-like primary phase is prepared by slightly electromagnetic stirring, and the stirring power has the obvious effect on the formation of the particle-like primary phase with finer size. The preparing parameters for the slurry containing particle-like primary phase with finer size are obtained.

articleTitle: Characteristic of pollution and sources apportionment of PM2.5 in NanChang city
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Five sampling areas which represent traffic center, industrial area, commercial area, residential area and the suburb were set in NanChang city to collect PM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</sub> samples in summer and winter of 2007. The data at various sampling areas illustrated that the daily average concentration of PM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</sub> in summer were lower than that in winter. In different areas the pollution severity order of PM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</sub> was traffic roads (worse than), industrial zone, commercial mixing zone, residential zone and suburbs. Distinct space-time distribution characteristics of element average concentration were shown in different functional areas. The element average concentration of urban areas was higher than that of the suburbs, while the element average concentration of the traffic roads and industrial zone was higher than that of the commercial mixing zone and residential zone. The results of source apportionment illustrated that soil dust, burnt dust, building dust, vehicle dust and metallurgical dust were the dominant emission sources of PM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</sub> in atmospheric environment of Nanchang. Whether the concentrations of PM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2.5</sub> reached the standard depends on soil dust, burnt dust and building dust, which become the emphasis of pollution control.

articleTitle: Optimal medical management of enterprise information resources
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to medical information, this article emphasizes the importance of medical information management, and further analyzes the status and medical problems, which puts forward the optimization of pharmaceutical enterprise information resource management solutions.

articleTitle: Emulational simulation of valve train based on rigid-flexible coupling model
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By adopting the idea of firstly building the entity model, then introducing it into ADAMS to build a multiple-rigid-body model, and at last replacing part of the components with the finite element model, the rigid-flexible coupling dynamic analysis model for the valve train of a certain type of diesel engine is set up. Meanwhile, the dynamic simulation analysis on the model is made, and the analysis result coincides with related test data, showing that precision of the model is higher. The analysis result can be made as the reference for the design improvement.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Design and implementation of the file system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of time domain and frequency domain test methods of electromagnetic shielding effectiveness of materials
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the shielding effectiveness of planar material was calculated by time and frequency domain simulation. The time domain method is to calculate time domain response of the material under the electromagnetic pulse; the frequency domain method is to calculate frequency domain response of the material under the continuous wave. By comparing time domain and frequency domain results, it is found that SE calculated by transient method is consistent with frequency domain SE, so the shielding characteristics of materials can be analyzed by narrowband pulse test. The conclusions can help us to study the EMC and EM protection of electronic devices and systems.

articleTitle: Design and dynamic simulation to virtual prototype of the fast hitching and unhitching device
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, basic requirement of hitching and unhitching device is analyzed. A new device for fast hitching and unhitching is designed, virtual prototype model of the device is built. By using Pro/Engineer and ADAMS software, dynamic analysis and simulation are carried out. Analysis and simulation result show that the parameters used on the virtual prototype are met the actual design parameters. Through testing methods verifies kinetic characteristic of physical prototype, influence of connect characteristic from −15° to +15° between tractor and four-wheel equipment and whether virtual prototype is compatible with the physical prototype. The result of simulation and experimentation indicates that parameter of motion and structure parameters are met motion requirement, virtual prototype is compatible with the physical prototype.

articleTitle: Research on hydrodynamic characteristic of supercavitating vehicle in vibrational state
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the Rayleigh-Plesset homogeneous hypothesis and the compressible Mixture multiphase model, numerical simulation of cavitation flow in the simple harmonic vibrational state of supercavitating vehicle enveloped with cavity was performed in moving coordinate system. The law of changes of the vehicle's hydrodynamic characteristic was analysed. Also, a comparative study of influence of vibration frequency and amplitude on the vehicle's hydrodynamic force coefficients was carried out. Results have showed that in the simple harmonic vibrational state, the vehicle's hydrodynamic force coefficients change periodically. The increment of vibration frequency and amplitude will cause drag force and lift force to increase, and intensify the amplitude fluctuation of drag coefficient and lift coefficient. The conclusion of this paper can afford theory basis for the further researching on trajectory performance and control method of supercavitating vehicle.

articleTitle: Calculation of human body respiration and metabolic heat and moisture in Mine Refuge Chamber
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: It is an effective way of emergency succor that providing trapped miners with a safe confined space when the mine accidents occur ,and the space keep the miners from danger. In order to make further study on the technology of life support in the mine confined space, in this paper series of tests. Tests showed oxygen consumption, carbon dioxide exhalation, metabolic heat and moisture, which provided the basis for the establishment of the environmental control and life protection system.

Author Keywords: Environmental control and life support system

articleTitle: The Ermi landslide mechanism analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In the construction of expressways in mountain areas, landslides often cause by cut-slope excavation. It leads to landslide treatment during the expressway construction. It is not only delay the project but also waste a lot of money. This paper takes the Ermi landslide as an example, analyzed the landslide from the aspects of the structural characteristics, the stability analysis and the treatments. The results show that the shear strength of the sliding surface and sliding body is low. As cut-slope excavating, the resistant of the slope body reduced Eventually the slope lost its stability and a landslide formed. In the stability analysis of the slope, the shear strength parameters of the sliding surface was determined by anti-analysis of one profile. Analyzing the stability of the three sliding surfaces respectively, the stability factors are 0.982-1.091 and less than the required 1.20 for this project. Therefore, proper treatments like reducing slope weight or resisting-piles are necessary. Study shows that the cost of reducing weight is 45% lower than resisting-piles. Hence, it is recommended that use the weight reducing method to control the Ermi landslide. This can be economic while meeting the safety requirement.

articleTitle: The 3-d numerical simulation analysis of internal forces and deformation which the large area long linear ultra deep excavation diaphragm wall is constructed used the covered back-digging method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In the urban construction, the number of ultra-deep excavation which is supported by underground continuous wall supporting system is increasing along with the use of many underground spaces. The covered back-digging combined with informational construction technology effectively control the deformation of underground continuous wall and excavation circumjacent environment. Based on the practical engineering field test data and three-dimensional numerical simulation calculation, we concluded variation pattern and relationship of the internal force and deformation which the large area long linear ultra deep excavation is constructed used the covered back-digging method.

articleTitle: Rock burst trend research and burst hazard assessment of complex structure coal seam in deep mining
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As a kind of common and very serious natural disasters, rock burst was greatly caused by large mining depth and geological structures. Based on the experimental study of dynamic damage time, elastic energy index, rock burst energy index of complex structure coal in deep well, the burst tendency results were obtained. Comprehensive index method was applied in rock burst hazard evaluation on conditions of specific geological and mining technology as a foundation of monitoring and management in rock burst.

articleTitle: Generalized function projective synchronization and tracking control of a class of hyperchaotic systems with unknown parameters and disturbance
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper investigates the function projective synchronization and tracking control of a class of hyperchaotic systems with unknown parameters and disturbance, and forms a novel kind of program called generalized tracking control function projective synchronization (GTCFPS). Based on the Lyapunov's stability theory, a robust adaptive control scheme is designed to acquire GTCFPS and parameter identification simultaneously. Numerical simulations are performed to demonstrate the analytical results.

articleTitle: Effect of heat treatment on thermal conductivity of 6063 aluminum alloy
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The effect of heat treatment on thermal conductivity of 6063 aluminum alloy was studied, and the mechanism of heat treatment(homogenizing, solution, aging treatment) of the alloy was discussed. The results indicate that homogenizing treatment is conducive to microscopic structure of the alloy, the microstructure is fine and the heat conductivity is high after homogenizing treatment technology at 560 °C for 6 hours. The thermal conductivity of alloy material declines as solution temperature rises, strength and thermal conductivity reach better coordination at 510 °C. Artificial aging can renovate the defect of structure effectively and enhance heat conductivity, with aging system at 200 °C for 6 hours its thermal conductivity is excellent.

articleTitle: The analyse of examples on sustainable development and building energy saving in Sweden
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Sweden, Situated in Northern Europe, Being an advanced industrial nation, a series ecological research achievementsand development plays a key role for Swedish sustainable growth for society at large. This paper introduces and analyses some examples about the ecological issues, such as: the Nodic ecolabel - "Swan" standards; sustainable policy of Green Party in Sweden, new energy saving house in new uptown of subway and standard teaching building saving energy techniques, demonstration ecological building in Lund University ecological landscape design etc. Comparing with Chinese ecological development situation, some personal technical measures and strategies advices are also put forward.

articleTitle: Thermocouple sensor non-linearity compensation based on orthogonal polynomial basis functions neural network
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a new method to compensate thermocouple sensor non-linearity based on orthogonal polynomial basis functions neural network. The artificial neural network module is used to realize Chebyshev artificial neural network. The mathematical model is established based on Chebyshev artificial neural network for non-linearity compensation. The principle and training algorithms of orthogonal polynomial basis functions neural network and neural network module are introduced. The results show that non-linearity compensation method has the advantages of high precision, good real time and strong robustness, etc. The maximum non-linearity error is 0.15%.

articleTitle: The study on 3D contact-friction pounding model based on OpenSEES
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The adjacent buildings and bridges could be destroyed to different extent, which resulted from earthquake pounding. This paper introduced different contact models and methods employed by researchers at home and abroad, and focused on the 3D contact-friction model of pounding considering tangential friction proposed by PING ZHU, moreover, not only to realize this numerical model based on OpenSEES which is open source software, but also to testify this model.

articleTitle: The forecast of ship speedability based on model test
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a group of the experimental results of resistance of the model ship.The experiment regarded the towing tank of Zhejiang Ocean University as its background, and make full use of the advanced resistance test technology and system. Next the experiment started with the fixed model and the test data are detail analyzed, thus getting the speedability details of the ship model.Furthermore this paper also compare the results of our experiment with that of No.708 Researching Institue and Jiangsu University of Science and Technology.By comparison, it fully proves that the towing tank experiment technology level of Zhejiang Ocean University for large-scale ship models is advanced and has a bright future development in marine trades.

articleTitle: Applications of underwater laser welding in nuclear power plant maintenance
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Nuclear power as an efficient, clean, safe and economical energy, is the inevitable choice for the future development of electric power. Nuclear power plants will have fatigue cracks and stress corrosion crack which need of welding repair after long-term running. To reduce the hazards of nuclear radiation on the welding operator and surrounding environment, underwater welding repair must be carried out. Because laser welding has the advantages of low heat input, easy to long distance transmission and the miniaturization of devices, making it becomes one of important means among the nuclear underwater welding repair. In this paper, application of underwater laser welding technology in the nuclear power plants maintenance are summarized.

articleTitle: Comprehensive evaluation of water resources carrying capacity in Huaibei City
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: An optimization model for calculating water resources carrying capacity was established in this paper and it was used to analyze water resources carrying capacity of different level years in huaibei city. Research shows that water carrying capacity in huaibei city is low. In order to meet needs by sustainable social and economic development, a number of measures adopted are suggested as follows: to increase utilizable water resources through engineering measures, and develop new water supply sources, as well as improve water use efficiency depending on technology reformation.

articleTitle: An automatic determination method based on color sensor at the end point of the titration
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Introduces an automatic determination method at the end of the titration, in which using the Large Power White-Light LED as a light source, with TCS3200 converting color light to frequency and 89C51 collecting the color information of the solution. The related circuits and flow charts are given.

articleTitle: Research on the method of measuring the inertia moment of engine
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Inertia moment of engine is a quite important parameter for power measuring without load,instantaneous speed calculating and in cylinder pressure reconstruction. In order to get this important parameter, a new method named instantaneous speed fluctuation comparison is brought out. The detail theory and approach is introduced. After experiment on the 6135 disel, the validity of the method is proved, and the error of the method is analyzed.

articleTitle: Research and application on soft soil foundation treatment by static-dynamic drainage consolidation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on soft soil foundation treatment, the design method and construction parameters of static-dynamic drainage consolidation to treat the soft soil foundation is discussed. Through the data analysis of test and experiment, the results show that the drainage consolidation method of combining static and dynamic is useful to treat soft soil foundation. This research results provide value references for similar engineering.

articleTitle: Study on microstructure and mechanical properties of aseismic reinforcement Nb microalloying steel
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the experimental analysis, the composition design and strengthening mechanism of the Nb microalloying rebar was mainly researched, then the effect of micro Nb on the microstructure and mechanical properties of carbon steels was discussed. The results have been shown that: The grain size could become smaller by Nb microalloying, therefore the strength and plasticity improved evidently, and the microstructure is composed of ferrite and pearlite. The micro Nb in steel could not only improve the mechanical properties but also reduce the cost. There are some practical value in environment protection and resources. The results of this experiment will have a greater role in guiding the actual production.

articleTitle: Mixed with lime powder on the performance test of autoclaved concrete
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, lime powder used as a concrete admixture, under the conditions in the autoclave process technology, adding lime powder on the compressive strength of concrete measured results show that the prestressed concrete pile to meet the conditions of autoclave curing production request, adding no more than 4% of the lime powder can significantly increase the strength of concrete.

articleTitle: Comparison of sub-models of Heat transfer in network model of fire
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Three sub-models of heat transfer across wall in network model of fire are analyzed. The software predictions with the three methods are compared with data of Japan one another by illustration. It shows that for three-node simple building, Both of half-infinite heat transfer sub-model and finite heat transfer sub-model agree well with the data of Japan, half-infinite heat transfer sub-model has a temperature deviation of less than 5% with finite heat transfer sub-model, While the method of heat insulation more than 40%.

articleTitle: Centrifuge modeling test of dynamic response and deformation law of concrete-faced rockfill dam under different input waves
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The study on dynamic response of CFRD is presented using 50g-t centrifuge shaking table in Tsinghua university subjected to sine wave and Parkfield earthquake wave. The experiment is conducted under the 50g condition. Acceleration time histories are recorded by acceleration transducer at different locations on the model and the deformation of the face-slab is also measured. The vibration response and deformation law of CFRD is studied by changing the waveform of input wave. The results show that the waveform of the input wave has considerable influence on the dynamic response of CFRD. The acceleration amplification effect, deformation of the dam, the stress and strain of the face slab subjected to Parkfield earthquake wave is greater than that of sine wave. The stress and the flexural torque in the middle and upper part of face slab is rather significant.

articleTitle: Object recognition and centroid detection based on machine vision
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Machine vision based on image processing, pattern recognition, computer technology and physiology, exploit computer simulation human brain to process, understanding, description visual the information extracted, is an important branch of artificial intelligence. This paper Proposes a object recognition and centroid detection method based on the machine vision, send the centroid of each extracted object to controller of the Mechanical arm in factory production line, which is used to sort and package the actual industrial production automatically .

articleTitle: Application of Proteus software in MCU teaching
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Proteus is a kind of powerful EDA simulation software. The large device library and the dynamic peripherals are the special advantage of this software. The virtual instrument brings great convenience to the simulation process Applied Proteus software in MCU teaching, the cost is reduced and the effect is improved. This paper introduces Proteus software application and practice method in theoretical and practical teaching about MCU.

articleTitle: Research on common problem about quality in the system of exterior wall insulation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces the classification and construction methods about the system of exterior wall insulation, analyze and compare the advantages and disadvantages between different construction methods, summarize the common problem about quality in the system of exterior wall insulation and propose methods to prevent the problem. Also give some useful references to construction on exterior wall insulation.

articleTitle: Summary and development of image reconstruction algorithm for ECT
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Image reconstruction algorithm is very critical for application of ECT in practical industries. The research on it has obtained great progress in recent years. This paper is a summary of image reconstruction algorithms for ECT, future possibilities on image reconstruction are also discussed.

articleTitle: Permeability test of pervious concrete in different rainfall
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Pervious concrete as an environment-friendly road pavement material in urban roads has been widely applied. By designing new permeability testing apparatus, simulated rainfall detection different rainfall pervious concrete permeability test methods on different rainfall on pervious concrete permeability. Research shows that: 1. A new kind device of permeability testing can accurately reflect the pervious concrete work status.2.The permeation which is measured by being simulated rainfall is lesser than invariable water head, and the deviations of these enlarged in the wake of the porosity's increasing.

articleTitle: A fingerprint image enhancement method based on Gabor filter
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Fingerprint enhancement plays a key role in the fingerprint identification system, and it directly influences the final accuracy of fingerprint identification. An improved fingerprint image enhancement method based on Gabor filter is presented and realized in this paper. In our method, after Fourier transforming transforms the fingerprint enhancement from spatial domain to frequency domain, the fingerprint images are enhanced by directional filter in frequency domain. The experimental results demonstrate that the improved method can enhance processing effects of fingerprint images, and has the advantages of better good processing effect and faster operating speed.

articleTitle: A nonlinear compensation method for Backlash transmission Backlash in Servo System
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The forming cause of transmission Backlash and the effect on system performance in Servo System are analyzed, and a simple and using easily nonlinear compensation method is proposed. The method can make the system maintain better performance and has guiding significance for production practice.

articleTitle: Experimental investigation on chaotic vibration of cantilever beam subjected to base in-plane excitation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The chaotic behavior of a flexible cantilever beam subjected to harmonic base in-plane excitation is investigated in this paper. The excitation frequencies and amplitudes which can lead to chaotic vibration of the beam are obtained. The experimental results indicate that chaotic vibration can occurs at two excitation frequencies in which one of the two frequencies is twice as large as the other one. However, the minimal excitation amplitudes are quite different at the two excitation frequencies, and the vibration responses after chaos have much in common.

articleTitle: A recent-biased clustering algorithm of data stream
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Previous data stream clustering algorithms not only computational speed is slow, but also data element of data stream is treated equally. In this paper, a recent-biased clustering algorithm of data stream based on tilted-time window is proposed. First, the algorithm segments sliding window equal in length to form no overlap data blocks. Then extract feature of every data block through Haar wavelet transform, and preserve detail feature of recent data by varying number of wavelet coefficients of data block, namely more recent data block, more wavelet coefficient preserved, and vice versa. Finally, by applying recent-biased distance of data stream, implements the recent-biased clustering algorithm of data stream based on tilted-time window. Remarkably faster computational speed and higher efficient have been achieved by this algorithm. The simulation results validate the efficiency of our algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on heavy metal contaminants in coal-mining area soil by gangue pile in the nature effloresce process at Cold and Arid Regions
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The study was conducted in a typical coal-mining industrial area in Gansu Province in Northwest China of Loess highland at Cold and Arid Regions. Gangue samples were collected from several mines and soil samples were collected nearly gangue pile from different coal mining region with a variety of mining history. According to the character of geology and topography at Cold and Arid Regions, gangue samples were incinerated, soil samples were treated with HCI-HNO3-HC1O4, then the contents of Cd, Co, Cr, Cu, Mn, Pb and Zn were determined by atomic absorption spectrophotometry and the dates were handed by SPSS 12.0 For Windows.
