From the total analysis, Single pollution index analysis and integrated pollution index analysis, several important conclusions can be obtained from this study. The results show that coal-mining soil has been contaminated from human activity of mining and heavy metals were accumulated in a way. Therefore, it is necessary that the mobility and environmental impact of element should be taken in account and further investigated in Cold and Arid Regions.

articleTitle: Fuzzy self-adaptive PID control in actuator control system of unmanned aerial vehicle
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to response speed slow, over regulation measurement great, transient time long and anti-interference ability low, actuator control system of unmanned aerial vehicle based on fuzzy self-adaptive PID control was designed. The three parameters of PID controller were adjusted adaptively on line by fuzzy self-adaptive PID control, which was designed by self-adaptive principle, fuzzy theory and traditional PID algorithm. Simulation result showed that after the parameters self-adaptive Fuzzy-PID controller being used, control system response speed quicken, over regulation measurement greatly reduced, transient time shorten, fluctuation times decrease and pressure governing precision advanced.

articleTitle: The integrated scheme of High-Definition Environmental-Protection Multimedia Intelligent Conference System
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: High-Definition Environmental-Protection Multimedia Intelligent Conference System is aiming at innovation and integration innovation. It is realized to control of network and integration from basic control to information display though the optical-transmission technology. Electronic meeting systems, high definition camera system, high definition display systems, video attendance-register meeting system, information release system, centralized-control meeting system, energy saving and environmental protection system, are integrated highly into Center Management System. Light control, scene control, sound management, camera call, signal switch, power control and other function are integrated into the Touch Screen by applying "model" One-Key operation in order to control easily, simplifying the operation steps greatly.

articleTitle: Profile-based 3D modeling of urban underground space
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: At present, the utilization of the urban underground space is not only an important component of the urban construction, but also a useful means to expand the development in many cities. Profile, as an important result map of the underground space exploration, plays a significant role in the 3D modeling in the urban underground space. To solve the current abstraction and inaccessibility of the information of the urban underground space, the paper puts forward the 3D modeling based on the existing 2D profile to construct the urban underground space, explores the process of 3D modeling and analyzes the correspondence and the connection constraints of the polygons of the profile section. At last, the connection arithmetic on the constrained section polygons is realized and the 3D modeling simulation is achieved.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of working performance for retaining structure with double-row piles
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: ABAQUS is adopted to simulate deep excavation of retaining structure with double-row piles. Along with the increase of excavation depth, the pile lateral displacement and internal force distribution of retaining structure with double-row piles are studied. Influence law of pile lateral displacement and internal force are analyzed which comes from some affected factors, such us retaining structure types, distance between two rows, pile spacing, soil strength between piles, crown beam stiffness.

articleTitle: An algorithm of channel estimation in All-phase OFDM system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we provide a new algorithm and a mathematical model of channel estimation, which are based on pseudo-random code and all-phase FFT in OFDM system. The Matlab simulations in the Channel Rayleigh and Channel Rician show that it can accurately estimate the change of channel very well in the fast time-varying channel. The algorithm can minimize the effect that channel noise gives to the receiving signal. And the algorithm can reduce the MSE and BER. It makes the system work better.

articleTitle: The situation and prospect of Led lighting using in building illumination design
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces the characteristics and advantages of LED lighting and analyzes the situation and prospect of LED lighting using in building illumination design. Many countries in the world are desire to improve and push the application of semiconductor illumination. LED lighting system should be the first priority to be considered in building illumination design. As an energy saving and environment protecting material, LED lighting has a bright future in building illumination, it will bring great environmental merit as well as economic value.

Author Keywords: Standards for lighting design of buildings

articleTitle: Adaptive control at launching using three loop autopilot
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to guarantee the precise initial flight trajectory, control the missile disturbance of large disturbance torque, three loop adaptive autopilot was researched. The characteristics of the projectile and three loop autopilot instruction formation characteristics were analysed. From equivalent pitching angle of lateral acceleration feedback loop, combined with the instruction of generalized error, autopilot structure was simplified, and three loop autopilot adaptive control law and stability were designed. The test data show that when disturbance torque was 600Nm, the attitude angle generalized error was −4.4°. In the time lasted about 15s, late trajectory accuracy was within 1.0°. Three loop autopilot adaptive control law was able to control the disturbance of initial trajectory and adapt to dynamic characteristics changes, control system stability. It was the initial trajectory accurate solution method of flight.

articleTitle: The study for the combination of SVG and TSC
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper proposed that we can control the thyristors switch the capacitors (TSC) to reduce the current that drawn from the grid by SVG, the amount of reactive power compensation can be reduced based on this basic theory.A control scheme for the system of reactive power compensation is shown in this paper. The artificial circuit built by Matlab/Simulink proves the feasibility of this experiment.

articleTitle: Optimization research of anchor block cavity thickness in pre-stressed pier
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The pre-stressed pier anchor block cavity thickness has been carried on optimized analysis. Three kinds of different cavity thickness have been calculated. The stress of pier neck and anchor block cavity surface have been analyze. Anchor block was similar to two deep beam after seting cavity. Tensile stress of upstream surface increased with the thickness of deep beams decreased under arc door force. Tensile stress of downstream surface increased with the thickness of deep beams reduced under anchor force. The result indicated that cavity thickness can't be set too large.

articleTitle: Analysis of flow field and sound field characteristic of 2D airfoil based on FLUENT
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Airfoil is one of the major components for wind turbine blades. 2D numerical simulation of the NACA4412 airfoil was carried out based on LES method by using FLUENT6.3 software. The main factors of large scale separation and vortex were found out by applying precision finite volume method and SIMPLE algorithm. According to the characteristic of the frequency spectrum of the noise signal and flow field, it was found that the frequency ranges of noise source between 330 Hz and 470 Hz by using FW-H acoustic model of FLUENT aeroacoustics software. It provided a reliable theoretical basis for the optimum design and noise reducing of wind turbine and airfoil.

articleTitle: Influencing factor and corresponding method of target drone dynamic stability
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The longitudinal motion equations were built by mathematical model of target drone movement. The longitudinal linearized equation was got by the linearization of longitudinal motion equations. The modality character was analysed by the solution. According to remolding motion, the effection on dynamic stability by flight speed, height and centroid position variation was researched and corresponding methods were obtained. That advanced the ability of target drone support and training flight security.

articleTitle: The stamping and mold design on stainless steel cover
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The stamping process analysis of stainless steel cover was made, its stamping process program was determined, the blanking and deep drawing composite mold was designed and the stamping equipment was selected. Different from general metal deep drawing, stainless steel is hard and sticky; it would have serious cold hardening in deep drawing, easy to produce mucosal. By taking reasonable deep drawing process measures, we have produced a high quality deep drawing products. Practice shows that the process program used was reasonable, mold design proper, equipment selection reliable and deep drawing process measures appropriate. The product quality and mold life have been increased, working conditions improved and good economic and social benefits achieved.

articleTitle: SVPWM control on 2-phased hybrid stepper motor
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The articles introduces the basic principle of space-vector pulse width modulation(SVPWM), and its arithmetic and fixed parameter is presented in detail, present a space-voltage vector pulse width modulation(SVPWM) method based on the 2-phased hybrid stepper motor driven by H bridge. The experiment is simulated by Matlab/Simulink in at last, the simulation result proved that the arithmetic used SVPWM to control the 2-phase hybrid stepper motor is feasible.

articleTitle: Design and simulation analysis of UART IP Core
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on mastering SOPC and Quartus II, designed UART IP Core, and an integrity design proposal is given out. The proposal is embedded in FPGA chip. The transmitter module, receiver module and baud rate generator are simulated and analyses. The experiments results show that the design method is compact and practical, and the circuit is stable, reliable, and strong flexibility.

articleTitle: Study of the cold-extruding tapping process of titanium alloy and the machine of compound vibration
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Titanium alloy has a high mechanical strength and small elastic modulus. While it's tapped, the springback of the work piece increases the tapping torque, the torsional stiffness is decreased with the flutes. The work hardening of titanium alloy is easy. Thus it is very difficult to tap small inside thread by cutting titanium alloy. Vibration press-working can diminish the forming force. In the compound vibration extruding tapping, the axial vibration can clear up the springback clamping force from both sides of the screw thread and reduce the extruding tapping torque. CNC technology is applied, In the new type of tapping machine with function of rotational vibration and axial vibration, Function of general tapping leading model is realized, which has met the demands of the new technique in vibration extruding tapping.

articleTitle: Fuzzy optimization of time-cost-quality for Dayawan water diversion project with FTOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the theory of fuzzy multi-object group decision and fuzzy technique for order preference by similarity to ideal solution (FTOPSIS), fuzzy optimization model of time-cost-quality for Dayawan water diversion engineering project is formed. Then, applying fuzzy multi-model network planning techniques and self-adaptive genetic algorithms, the most satisfied decision alternatives can be obtained.

articleTitle: Design of ECG monitoring system based on wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to satisfy the family needs of ECG monitor, this article proposed a design scheme of ECG monitoring system based on wireless sensor network. It constructed a WSN (wireless sensor network) by sensor node and coordinator node. The ECG data was transmitted from sensor node to coordinator node. Then the data would be transmitted by serial interface to PC. To facilitate operation and observation we had developed human-machine interface by the Labview software. The system can realize real-time ECG detection and wireless transmission. It is portable and user-friendly and will meet the family needs of portable ECG monitor.

articleTitle: The ecological analysis of a new round land use planning based on ecological footprint in Guangxi
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Ecological footprint analysis is an important method in solving the measurement problems of sustainable development. In this paper, based on the method of Guangxi in the years of ecological environment were analyzed. Using time series model and made future years of ecological footprint in total forecasts. By using grey prediction model predicted population growth, various types of land supply and consumption. The per capita ecological footprint and per capita ecological carrying capacity had been computed in Guangxi for years. Then, the paper calculated ecological footprint and ecological carrying capacity in planning target years. Finally a new round of Guangxi land use planning of ecological evaluation got in this research from the comparison of results.

Author Keywords: a new round of land use planning

articleTitle: The virtual assembly and motion simulation of belt Conveyor basing on SolidWorks
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The article introduces how to achieve the virtual assembly and motion simulation of belt Conveyor with SolidWorks Motion plugin to make animation, basing on the assembly design of belt Conveyor with SolidWorks. The animation is intuitive and vivid. It facilitates multi-media teaching and stimulates student' interest in study. And it does great help for the students' understanding and obtaining good teaching effect. The animation also provides good ideas for the making of virtual teaching model in mechanical engineering profession.

articleTitle: Research on kinematics and simulation of a three-DOF parallel manipulator
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A three-DOF parallel manipulator was presented in this paper, which is constituted with two platforms and three legs. The position transformational matrix was deduced and the normal and inverse pose solutions to the manipulator were analyzed. Then the kinematic Jacobian matrix and Hessian matrix were derived by the method of influence coefficient. The kinematics simulation of the mechanism was carried out and the result shows it has poor coupling on the directions of three movements, which is appropriate for leveling a platform.

articleTitle: Research on divergence phenomenon and rejection method of Kalman filter on discrete system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Analysis the reason of divergence phenomenon for Kalman filter based on balloon height problem. Put forward a corresponding solution for the research outcome and devote it into practical application. Get the expectation value by derivation.

articleTitle: Uneven cloud and fog removing for satellite remote sensing image
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Haze is an important influence factor of visible light RS data's obtaining and using. Based on dark channel prior and haze image model, this paper studies the dehaze technology from a single satellite RS image. Aim at the characteristic of uneven cloud in satellite RS image and the problem of the unreasonable estimate for airlight in dehaze method, this paper designed a new method for airlight computing, which did not reduce the image definition in clear area. This method joined the information of cloud density, and the result have no over processing and ill-processing problem. At last, using medium-resolution image and high-resolution image to make system experiment, the result is effective.

articleTitle: Using cluster technology for establishing meteorological communication system based on shared memory
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: National meteorological communication system is the main project in CMA. For improving system credibility, the system uses the load balance technology to build cluster system. The communication servers make use of cluster technology to ensure that all of the servers in the cluster system can share the storage. In this article, cluster and cluster file system are introduced. Future more, the architecture of National meteorological communication system is analyzed based on cluster, and at last we present the scheme of establishing meteorological communication system based on shared memory.

articleTitle: Aproximate solution of seismic bearing capacity of composite foundation under earthquake action
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The ground slope face supposed Prantle's slope face. the computation of static earth pressure is enlarged seismic earth pressure. By employing pseudo-static approach and the method of limit equilibrium, the seismic bearing capacity of strip foundation on the composite foundation is derived. The computing methods of the seismic bearing capacity of the composite foundation on layering ground, rectangular foundation and circular foundation are discussed.The effect factors of seismic bearing capacity coefficients of the seismic bearing capacity are analysed. The basic is supplied for practical use in geotechnical engineering.

articleTitle: Experimental study on fractal characterization in damages crack of coral aggregate
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As a new branch of mathematics, Fractal Geometry has been widely used in civil engineering field. This study investigated its relationship between internal fractal dimension of aggregate fracture and surface porosity after destruction of coral aggregate concrete under pressure, cutting reveals the micro level concrete aggregate injury characteristics.

articleTitle: Experimental study on heat pump integrating air conditioner and water heater with heat recovery of shower waste water
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to save energy, a type of heat pump integrating air conditioner and water heater is designed and fabricated in our laboratory. By effectively recovering heat from shower waste water, it can supply enough hot water for bath and meet the requirement of personal air conditioning after bath. Experiments and analysis show that when the temperatures of room, city water and shower waste water are 22∼23°C, 20°C and 31∼34°C, respectively, it can supply hot water at temperature of 42.6 ∼ 43.4°C with flow rate of 4.72 ∼ 5.27L/min, and supply conditioned air at temperature of 12.3 ∼ 14.7°C with corresponding cooling capacity of 520∼690W for personal air conditioning. On the experiment conditions, the measured coefficient of heating performance (COPh) of the heat pump varies in the range of 4.57∼5.38, which is perfect and attractive. Based on the experiments and analysis, some suggestions about improving the overall performance of the heat pump are also mentioned in briefly.

articleTitle: Research on the calculation method and dynamic modeling of traction-battery SOC for electric vehicle
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In view of the fact at home or abroad that it is difficult to achieve the accurate quantitative measurement and the analysis of dynamic change of traction-battery SOC when the EV moving, the paper has build real-time calculation model of traction-battery SOC in EV based on temperature, voltage and electric current, had battery capacity on the different condition converted into one available battery capacity on a specific temperature condition, gotten the battery SOC more accurate compared to the traditional methods, and avoided battery capacity estimate error and calculated amount that result from the battery SOC nonlinear change in the real situation. Besides, it has provided the theory basis and the testing method for the drive-battery's management and the observation system.

articleTitle: Analysis and simulation for Vector Control VVVF System
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on Matlab/Simulink, Vector Control VWF System with Speed and flux feedback is proposed for asynchronous motor. It consists of asynchronous motor and current delay-loop PWM inverter, including speed regulator (ASR), flux observer and flux calculator etc. Furthermore, the design and parameters regulation for speed regulator (ASR) is realized by means of engineering design method of DC speed control system. At same time adapted flux feedback, the dynamic characteristics for Vector-control VWF System is improved. Simulation results show the system has batter dynamic and static performances.

articleTitle: Simulation and optimization design of subway station foundation construction
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the excavation work of deep foundation pit for Qingdao subway is proposed. By construction numerical analysis, the characteristics of internal force of bracing system and soil horizontal displacement are obtained. Through these analyses, the law of horizontal displacement in ambient soil is obtained, and the measures considering the construction factors can be adopted for the support structure design and displacement controlling.

articleTitle: The application of common DC bus-bar in variable frequency AC speed-adjusting system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: When centrifuge is working, reclaim energy is produced in screw motor. It often bring on system trouble of variable frequency AC speed-adjusting. Reclaim energy can be reclaimed and the capability of centrifuge can be improved, adoptting the technic of common DC bus-bar.

articleTitle: Studies of fire prevention issues in exterior wall thermal insulation system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As external thermal insulation system has been widely employed in energy conservation of buildings in China, fire disasters have arisen in some places due to the use of the organic materials in external thermal insulation, which caused serious consequences of injuries, mortality and economic losses. Based on several typical cases of fires caused by the construction and employment of external thermal insulation materials, this paper is intended to analyse the safety of external thermal insulation system and explore with great detail the fire prevention countermeasures of external thermal insulation.

articleTitle: The meshing force simulation of Synchronous Gear Pump
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Base on the comprehensive analysis of the structure and existing problems of gear pump, the paper provided the structure principle of synchronous gear pump. The discussions focus on the working principle, construction features and mesh-force simulation of the gear pump. The research indicates that the new pump has such advantages as lower noise, better distributed flow and a high work pressure. It can be widely used in hydraulic system.

articleTitle: Research and application based on PLC in electrical drainage stations' computer monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Electrical drainage stations are mainly for the city's flood controlling and drainage. This paper using IFIX 3.5 upper PC configuration monitoring software as platform , with Siemens PLC as control core, constructed a two-level control layer. Provided a feasible scheme for electrical drainage stations' network management and information integration, realized the whole monitoring and control of electrical drainage stations, guaranteed the reliable and real time date communication for monitoring system.

articleTitle: Study on key techniques of control system for tread extruder production line
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces the key techniques of control system for tread production line based on the totally-distributed control structure using fieldbus, industry Ethernet and PLC. Mainly presents the technology process, control system configuration, control strategy, and describes the intelligent adjust algorithm as well.

articleTitle: Research on automobile intelligent anti-collision system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper focus on resolving the serious traffic accident of vehicle rear-end, base on laser radar, microwave radar, machine vision, ultrasonic sensors technologies, multi-sensor information fusion (MSIF) was used in automobile intelligent anti-collision system, the related technical challenges was explored and analyzed, put forward a feasible project of intelligent anti-collision system. This system make automobile can detect the front vehicles form long distance in bad weather environment, determine whether comply with safe distance requirement, and control the corresponding actuators, prevent the collision accident.

articleTitle: Application of pinch technology for energy conservation in pharmaceutical factory
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this work the application of pinch technology in a batch pharmaceutical process is presented. Pinch method is a systematic technique for design, optimization and retrofit of energy recovery system. The analysis results show the effectiveness of pinch technology for saving energy consumption in the pharmaceutical factory.

articleTitle: Study on dynamic mechanism and analysis of rural regional features
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the advance of modernization, the rural regional features is disappearing increasingly. Based on the analysis the factors and dynamic mechanism of rural regional features,the paper explores some ideas about the conservation and development of regional features, and will prevent the process of the worsening situation.

articleTitle: Research on high-performance control methods of positioning for AC motor
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With extensive development of AC motor control and speed control, high-performance motor control technology provides good protection for AC motor positioning. This paper designs the AC motor positioning system according to DTC and Fuzzy control strategies to achieve the accurate stopping on given angular position. Simulation results show the scheme is feasible.

articleTitle: Structural damage identification based on information fusion technology
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of structural damage identification, information fusion technology is introduced into structural damage identification. Firstly, the stiffness matrix damage factor iterative method and modal strain energy method are used to identify the structural damage, and give the decision vectors respectively. Then, the decision vectors are imported into the D-S evidence theory formula or the Bayes theory formula, the damage probability of every element would be obtained and the damage location would be determined finally. Numerical simulation of plane truss and model experiments of offshore platform show that the results of structural damage identification are more accurate and reliable after the information fusion techniques is used.

articleTitle: Measuring soil moisture and designing a automatic watering system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: We measure the soil moisture by a Resistance-frequency converter circuit. By this means, we design an automatic watering system. It can water the flowers automatically by monitoring the soil moisture.

articleTitle: Study on environmental geological problems in anqing copper and flood control
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Because of rich surface water and groundwater in copper, environmental geological problems highlighted. High-pressure water, ground subsidence serious, large displacement of mine and high amount of sediment in water were existed in mine. Underground mine water channel, mine water supply conditions, contact with water and the formation mechanism of surface subsidence were analyzed. Using a series of engineering measures to control the environmental geological problems such as use of pipe backfill grouting to manage surface hole collapse, supported by rotating pile of artificial canals to flood during the rainy season leads to collapse area, static pressure in the collapse area grouting, troubled waters of the main points of plugging underground. The surface water management projects to prevent further occurrence of karst collapse, so the mine discharge and sediment concentration during the rainy season greatly reduced.

articleTitle: A study on the wrong way and countermeasure in the development of green building
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on analysis the wrong way in the development of green building at present in China, probing the restrictive factors of the promotion and application of green technologies, and presenting the countermeasures such as: focus on the ecological value; design in both passive environmental control and positive green technologies; build up a society with general consciousness of green idea and public participation etc.

articleTitle: The green mining of coal resource
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper put forward the concept of green mining of coal mine, expounds the connotation and technique system of it. The theoretical basis of green mining is that the law of after mining the key strata in movement formed abscission layer and joint fractures, the seepage rule of the gas and groundwater in broken rock . The main contents of green mining technology include: water mining, mining under buildings and abscission layer grouting reduce sink, strip and filling mining, simultaneous mining of coal and gas, the underground processing of roadway supporting and part of coal gangue, underground gasification, etc.

articleTitle: Measurement and allocation system for railway bearing
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Traditional railway bearing inner diameter measuring tool was diameter micrometer. This method could not ensure the high precision, the author designed a system which is based on the pneumatic measurement principle and could improve the traditional method. The overall structure of this system is described, then the design principle and method of mechanical and electrical parts are discussed, and the flow chart of program and allocation algorithm are presented. The system can automatically calibrate, and orient, and measure, and allocate, manual measurement error is reduced and product assembly quality is improved.

articleTitle: Elastic wave band gaps of a one dimensional rod phononic crystal with two inside-period structures
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the elastic wave band gaps of a new 1D rod phononic crystal with two inside-period structures were theoretically investigated by lumped-mass method. Calculation revealed that the large band gaps are easier to be obtained than that of 1D simple lattice phononic crystal. The band gaps become wider and the pass band filtering properties become more perfect by reducing the lattice constant. In addition, the band gaps can be effectively adjusted through varying the two component ratios of inside-period, and the widest band gaps appear at the two component ratios are large than one, but the multi-channel narrow pass band filtering properties are very obvious when the two component ratios are less than one.

articleTitle: Research on soil improvement for waste rock piles remediation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: We used the sludge in domestic sewage treatment plant to improve the soil's properties. Firstly, we analyzed the exploitability of soil, and then added the sludge to the soil. The sludge dose is 0, 10%, 20%, 30% and 40% and 20% sludge dosage is the optimized value for the planting ryegrass.

articleTitle: Comments on large-signal based modeling methods of DC/DC converter
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Due to linear approximattion large-signal-based modelling methods for DC/DC converters have high accuracy, under which the performance of system stability can be analyzed completely and better control parameters or control scheme can be obtained resultingly. With some valuable conclusions and prospects followed, detailed comments on several typical large-signal-based modelling methods are presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Based on Pro / MECHANICA structural analysis of diesel engine connecting rod
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Connecting rod is one of the important parts of diesel engine, connecting rod pass the cylinder combustion pressure to the crankshaft and external work, in a very short period of time the connecting rod will undertake a different alternating load, so the strength and fatigue situation has been the focused by researchers at home and abroad. In this paper, Pro/MECHANICA finite element analysis software is used to the structural analysis of the 240 diesel engine connecting rod, the strength and fatigue life of this type of connecting rod are the main analysis in this paper.

articleTitle: Luis Barragan and regionalism architecture
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: On the impact of the modern building, this article discusses the meaning and the characteristics of regionalism. It analyzes the works of the Mexican architect Luis Barragan which focus on the background, the natural conditions, the sites, the colors, and the traditional culture to enable people to understand him better. As Barragan has developed a unique regional style, his architectural practice and theories may be a reference to Chinese architects who are in the exploration of developing a Chinese regional style.

articleTitle: Research on the software system of measurement on urban residential areas night light
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The article refer to the problems in which measurement about urban residential areas lighting, on the basis of collecting related data and results in the field, and adopt the methods of intersecting architecture, urban planning, computers, developing a suit of "measurement software system of urban residential areas lighting based on a platform for remote control vehicle". The system be specifically developed in line with the lighting test hardware and can programmed on the testing platform for control. It can exactly and efficiently detect and analyze parameters such as illumination and brightness, and it can supply technology endorsement on discovery for developing lighting standards of urban residential.

articleTitle: Study on local scour at bridge abutment of Mai Gaiti Bridge in Xinjiang with extension method of series models
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The Mai Gaiti reach of Ye Erqiang River is typical broad-shallow and shifting channels in Xinjiang. Its' oblique flow usually causes the left abutment's washout. In this paper, series of river engineering model was developed for estimating local scour of the left abutment of Mai Gaiti Bridge. Experiment results show that the depth of scour is 5.43m and the oblique flow discharge is 2.7(m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/s.m) which's surface velocity is 1.76(m/s) while the left abutment is destroyed.

Author Keywords: wide and shallow wandering reach in Xinjiang

articleTitle: Study on photocatalytic degradation of dibutyl phthalate in aqueous solution by means of photo-Fenton technology
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The degradation of dibutyl phthalate simulated wastewater using Fenton reagent coupled with photocatalysis had been investigated. The effect of various factors, such as photocatalyst dosage, initial substrate concentration, pH, Fe<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> concentration and H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> concentration on the photocatalytic degradation of dibutyl phthalate was investigated. The results showed that the degradation efficiency of DBP reached 88.6% under the condition of the initial concentration of 10 mg-L<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>, initial pH of 6.5, Fe<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>dosage of 1.0mmol / L, H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> dosage of 0.3 mL, the amount of catalyst 0.05g, and reaction time of lh simultaneously, there is a synergistic effect with the Fenton system while adding catalyst and UV light.

articleTitle: The numerical simulation of the spreading of oil spills
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The oil spills at sea will probably occurred in the port and paraic zone. They're serious danger to the marine environment and it will hold back the economic development. So, it's important to study the oil spills reclamation works with numerical simulation. This paper simulated the diffusing of oil-spill in the condition of clam air moderate wind and strong breeze in LvSi port. And, it will have great Significance in making the prevention measures, when the engineering finished.

articleTitle: Vector control of permanent magnet synchronous motor based on matrix converter
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A matrix converter (MC) based vector control of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) with current hysteresis control is designed. Signals of current hysteresis controller and selection of input voltages are analyzed in detail. How to decide on or off of power switch of matrix converter under current hysteresis control is also deduced in this paper. Finally, simulating model of the designed system is built up. Results of simulation show that the matrix converter based vector control of PMSM has the quality of feasibility and efficiency, which brings out theoretical foundations of experimental prototype.

articleTitle: Research and upgrading based on SLC500 PLC on jigger control system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Jigging coal running is a widely used way in coal running areas at present. But the actual way to ensure the quality of refined coal is based on it's low reclaiming rate. logical control and conventional PID are the most common methods to control jiggers in inner land. Taking TDK jigger of Coal Washery in HeiDaiGou Junggar Energy Co. Ltd. as studying object and based on the analysis of the discharging system, the method of NC air valve control, Auto-air control and Visualization are provided in this paper. Based on analyzing the way of improving the air-valves' control precision, an optimizing control algorithm is adopted in the locale. The locale application shows that the improved control method of air valves works reliably, The jigger stratification state is more stable and the quality and quantity of the refined coal are ensured, which brings considerable benefit to the coal mine.

articleTitle: Research on newly silicone-acrylic emulsion for earthen sites consolidation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Silicone-acrylic emulsion have broad prospects in earthen sites consolidation. In order to improve the length of penetration, the newly silicone-acrylic emulsion for earthen sites consolidation is studied based on improving silane contents, and direct shear test, resistance to water test and corrosion resistance test are done on the plain soil and sample consolidated by new silicone-acrylic emulsion. The results show the newly silicone-acrylic emulsion improved soil Shear resistance, and the Water-resistance and Corrosion Resistance have got larger improvement than silicone-acrylic emulsion, and penetration homogeneity has got improvement too.

articleTitle: The study on the effect of commercial space under the plan and construction of rail transport in the mountainous cities
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Rail transportation is becoming the main form of public transport in cities, as a high capacity, fast, on-time traffic, it's huge crowd gathered effect and specific corridor, give the city a tremendous impact on the development of commercial space. Through depth study of light rail on the 2nd elevated railway construction in Chongqing, the writer study the evolution of commercial space, and find it bring the “point and line” changes on commercial space, while the construction of the commercial space hierarchies, differentiation, characteristics could be a better play to rail traffic on the promotion of the role of commercial space.

articleTitle: Study on the relationship between rural road development and cultural change in the sociological vision
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: On the basis of review of cultural change theories, the paper establishes a set of factors of rural cultural change. Founded by the theory of the traffic sociology, the paper takes the factors as medium, and analyzes the relationship between rural road development and cultural change. Finally, the result of study is tested empirically.

Author Keywords: interaction between urban and rural areas

articleTitle: Risk assessment of ground settlement induced by construction dewatering of Taizhou Bridge anchorage caisson foundation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In view of the risk of ground settlement induced by construction dewatering of Taizhou Bridge anchorage caisson foundation, the thesis tries to determine relative weights of various settlement-inducing factors on assessment objectives by employing an analytic hierarchical process. Another the multi-level comprehensive assessment is then applied by a comprehensive fuzzy evaluation method, so as to establish a scientific risk assessment system of ground settlement induced by construction dewatering of Taizhou Bridge anchorage caisson foundation..

articleTitle: The essence of Toyota system in system theory
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: From the systems theory as a starting point, This article accurately based on the results of prior studies, and explored the essence of the Toyota system. Among the literature, researchers enrich content of the Toyota production system theory in the field of knowledge, but from the viewpoint of the whole system, literatures of Toyota system are slightly less. From the manufacturing system (including the development of subsystems, production subsystem, and supply subsystem etc.) as focus, this paper analyzes the elements of the Toyota system (subsystem) and the relationship between the elements, at the same time describes the evolution of the Toyota System and their competitiveness, in order to put forward the essence of the Toyota system.

articleTitle: The hot state test research of nozzle character on secondary cooling zone of slab continuous casting process
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The secondary cooling of slab continuous casting is very important for the quality of slab. The test based on unsteady state heat conduction. In heating matal samples heated to the actual temperature of secondary cooling casting, we simulated the influence of nozzle qualities to billet cooling process. According to the actual production layout of secondary cooling nozzle, we study a single nozzle, double nozzles forced cooling of billet heat transfer coefficient experiment. By testing different types of nozzles to get the heat transfer coefficient in different pressures, and the different effects between single-nozzle and double nozzle. The results of the experiment are shoen that the test of the nozzle thermal performance provide proof for nozzle layout of secondary cooling and optimizing secondary water cooling system.

articleTitle: Application of projection pursuit regression method in the confirmation of liquefaction grade of sand soil
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on projection pursuit regression method, this paper had a analysis on liquefaction grade of sand soil. Taking epicenter distance, effective pressure overlaying, standard penetration test, water table, circular shearing strength ratio as independent variables, and liquefaction grade of sand soil as dependent variable, the confirmation model of liquefaction grade of sand soil was obtained. It was found that, the confirmation value of liquefaction grade of sand soil was consistent with actual measurement value of liquefaction grade of sand soil for 32 groups of independent variables training model and 4 groups of independent variables validating model. The following conclusion can be drawn that, the prediction model is accurate and credible, and the projection pursuit regression method is a eximious method, and it is worthy to spread its application in the prediction of liquefaction grade of sand soil.

articleTitle: Research on fatigue mechanism and cracks propagation speed of the drill pipes used in coalmine
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to the practical problems encountered in coalmine drilling, a detailed analysis of the loads in the drilling process and fatigue mechanism has been done. Based on the above, the paper have studied the cracks propagation speed of the dill pipes used in coalmine, and proposed the measures for improving the fatigue life.

articleTitle: The path of the development of low-carbon economy in Nanchong
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As the leading economy, industrial development in Nanchong is faced with resource, environmental, economic and social pressure from all sides. The low-carbon economy is pointing out the direction for the healthy and sustainable development of Nanchong. This article firstly analyzes the necessity of its low carbon economy, according to the actual national economic development of Nanchong. Secondly, it analyzes the problems of low-carbon economy development in Nanchong, and further it elaborates the feasibility of low-carbon economy road. Finally, from the macro and micro perspective, this paper puts forward a specific low-carbon path to three major industries in Nanchong.

articleTitle: Research on reclamation and reuse of disuse automobile
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The faster development of automobile industry, the grimmer situation of disuse automobile reclamation. The actuality of disuse automobile reclamation is analyzed. Reclamation and utilizing of metal material, plastic and rubber materials for automobile are researched in detail on the objective of environment protection and economizing resources. Finally a series of countermeasures about disuse mobile reclamation are put forward according to china's actuality.

articleTitle: Comparison of response spectra in forward and backward directions in the Wenchuan earthquake
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: We compare the response spectra between forward and backward direction, and the contour maps of response spectra at certain natural periods. Results indicate: (1) the response spectra in the forward direction is higher than that of the backward direction. For natural period smaller that 2 second, the average response spectra in forward direction is about two times that of the backward direction; for natural period larger than 2 second, the maximum forward-backward average response spectra ration reaches about 4. (2) The long period ground motion is much more sensitive to the directivity effect. (3) The attenuation of amplitude of response spectra in the forward direction is slower than that of the backward direction.

articleTitle: Simulant study about input/output characterization of highly nonlinear multivariable systems
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a software in the MATLAB environment for input/output characterization of highly nonlinear multivariable systems. The software is based on obtaining the sinusoidal-input describing function (SIDF) models of the nonlinear multivariable plant. The mathematical development of the input/output characterization approach is outlined, and the code of the nucleus of the characterization software is given. The method and the associated software have no restriction on nonlinearity type, configuration, and arrangement, system order as well as the number of inputs and outputs; the only requirement is that system output(s) for sinusoidal input(s) must be obtainable or available by either simulation or experiments. The software has a variety of applications in such industries as robotics, aerospace, automotive, and chemical processes.

articleTitle: Study on locally rennovation of mezzanine in R. C. structure
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Nowadays more and more buildings, especially the malls and factories, need to be reconstructed to meet the new usages with the development of the city. In many cases of the retrofit, a new floor could be inserted to get larger space. According to the actual condition of a project, the issues of the safety of the structure after storey-adding are introduced in this paper. Finally, suggestions on the storey-adding R. C structure are presented, providing references for the similar engineering.

articleTitle: The implicit method of solving common fault failure with GO-FLOW methodology
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Industrial safety plays an important part both on country economy and the people's livelihood, so it is quite essential to assess the safety of industry system. The GO-FLOW methodology is a new reliability analysis of engineering system with high efficiency, while common fault failure plays a significant part especially for the systems with high redundancy. This paper based on introducing the theory of GO-FLOW methodology briefly which is focus on the success probability of the system introduces the implicit method to GO-FLOW methodology, at the same time providing an example to illustrate it, and also expending the field for GO-FLOW methodology with concision solution for reliability analysis of engineering system in common fault failure.

articleTitle: The Review and Prospect of green space planning
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper summarizes the development tendency of global theoretic researches on green space planning. From the results, it can be concluded that green planning theory, ecology, as well as information technology have a tendency to combine with each other recently. In comparison with the counterparts of other countries, the main shortage of theoretical research on green space in China is the poor layout structure and insufficient subject intersecting. From the point of ecological view, it seems that recent domestic researches have been paid more attention to the ecological benefits, community structure, etc. However, the general research on urban and regional biotopverbundsystem and biodiversity conservation is rarely reported. The application of RS and GIS are basically used in monitoring the current situation of green space. The research of GIS should be strengthened in many aspects, such as analyzing, decision-making. In the future, we should carry on the theoretical research of green space planning according to diverse regional characteristics and urban space function, and strengthen the research on regional green space planning. In the same way, more research for green space planning in national land from the point of biodiversity conservation should be taken into account.

articleTitle: Research on curvature ratio upon working properties of Linear Motion Guides
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The working properties is detail anglicized and studied on linear motion guides (LMD), in different curvature ratio of ball diameter and radius of ring of guide rail and slider of LMG in the paper. LMG's mechanics model is built. ABAQUS soft is applied to numerical modeling and calculating. The rigidity curves of LMG are gained in different of curvature ratio and loads. The study has some reference value for design of structure and parameters.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of dynamic ice action on cross-sea bridge foundation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Using explicit dynamic analysis software ANSYS/LSDYNA, the paper implements the numerical simulations of interaction processes between sea ice and cross-sea bridge foundation according to the condition of sea ice in Qing-Dao Gulf. The simulated developments of cracks in ice is consistent with those of full scale experiments and theoretical analysis, as well as ice force and displacement responses of foundation. By analyzing the simulation results, it is found that the displacement responses are not sensitive to the variations of ice velocity. The ice force is approximately linear inverse proportion to the ice velocity.

articleTitle: An adaptive design for high speed space-time block code
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: An adaptive high speed design method for STBC is proposed to improve the performance of space-time block code (STBC) in the Multiple Input Multiple Output (MIMO) system. By using the proposed design method, the transmitter can change the coding rate adaptively through the close-loop feedback channel such that the system has a superior effective channel throughput. In addition, compared with the fixed rate coding method, the proposed method can make better use of the antenna's diversity and have a better system performance.

articleTitle: The design and parameter setting methods for M-type fuzzy controller
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: On the basis of analyzing the principle and characteristic of M-type fuzzy controller, this paper proposes the design procedure and methods of M-type fuzzy controller as well as control rules of M-type fuzzy controller. And it puts forward methods of weighting factor setting for M-type fuzzy controller according to the different control plants. It discusses that M parameter affects system performance in detail, and indicates that M1, M2 and M3 have function of wide, fine and precision adjusting system performance respectively, which is similar to proportion, integral and differential coefficient of PID controller. Dynamic system simulation proves the superiority of the M-type fuzzy control.

articleTitle: Study on photoelectrocatalysis humic acid of TiO2 films using micro-arc oxidation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This Titanium oxide (TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) films were formed on the titanium surface by micro-arc oxidation(MAO) in Na<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>PO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> solution. Then the titanium oxide coatings were treated by Fe(NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> aqueous to improve the activity. The structures of titanium oxide films before and after surface Fe(NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> treatment were characterized by SEM,EDX.The photocatalytic ability of titanium oxide films were evaluated by photocatalytic degradation of humic acid aqueous solution. Using the TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> films as working electrode, the titanium as counter electrode and with the UV lamp,the electro-assisted photocatalytic reactor was built.The results show that the photocatalytic activity of the titanium oxide films was enhanced after Fe (NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> treatment, the humic acid concentration of lOmg/L, pH is 3, Na<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> electrolyte concentration is 0.5mol/L. The photoelectric degradation of humic acid is increased from 17.7% to 27.1% by the photoelectrocatalysis and Fe (NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> treatment TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/Ti film photoelectric degradation increased to 37.2%.

articleTitle: An automatic testing system for thermal batteries
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: An automatic testing system for thermal batteries based on LabVIEW is introduced in this paper. Full artomatic testing process is realized and the system has high precision, high speed and good adaptability in different type of thermal batteries.

articleTitle: Research and development for brake test-bed based on electrical inertia simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to software and hardware requirements of brake test-bed structure, this paper introduced overall plan and main parameters selecting method of related equipments, provided control strategy for variable electrical inertia. Authors had established automobile brake test-bed which is based on electrical inertia simulation technology, and had completed the simulation test and result analysis. The analysis results indicate that the margin between simulation of brake process and actual braking process is small, electrical inertia could simulate mechanical inertia. Applying the electrical inertia simulation technology could simplify structure of the traditional mechanical inertia test-bed which formerly is complicated, could expand the measuring scope and measuring accuracy of the test-bed, and could provide tools and platform for the brake performance test and experiment teaching.

articleTitle: Kinematic and dynamic optimizations of the redundant manipulator via local degrees of freedom
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to conquer the difficulty of simultaneous optimizations on kinematic and dynamic indices of the redundant manipulator, a new type of redundant manipulator with local degrees of freedom is proposed. Redundant degrees of freedom are used to optimize kinematic index, and local degrees of freedom are used to optimize dynamic index. The corresponding optimization method is suggested. As a result, the kinematic and dynamic indices of the redundant manipulator can be optimized simultaneousely. Some simulations are carried out, and the optimization method is verified to be effective.

articleTitle: Stability analysis of soil slope during rapid drawdown of water level
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The principles of limit equilibrium methods (LEM) and shear strength reduction technique (SSRFEM )are introduced on stability analysis of soil slope under Seepage. The finite element model under Coupled Deformation and Seepage Fields is established, which takes into account the effect of plastic deformation, saturation and void ratio on the properties of soil materials, the soil-water characteristic curve and the extended Mohr-Coulomb failure criterion. one typical soil slope is simulated during rapid drawdown of water level. The results show that seepage raises the critical slip surfaces, and critical slip surfaces, saturation lines and safety factors by two ways are very close. In addition, by analyzing, it can be concluded that the SSRFEM is more suitable for evaluating global stability of slopes than LEM.

articleTitle: Segmentation of liver tumor with local C-V level set
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we proposes a local C-V level set algorithm integrated with local OTSU method for the segmentation of liver lesion. We first construct a local liver lesion image, then pre-segment the lesion with OTSU method to get the initial contour, finally evolve the active contour with local C-V level set method to get the final contour of lesion. Experiments showed this method can extract liver tumor efficiently.

articleTitle: Design of information management system for regional cleaner production based on B/S structure
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Regional cleaner production is an important embodiment of circular economy in regional level. B/S structure is defined as a new network management information system platform on the basis of the web technology. This paper attempts to explore the design of information management system on regional cleaner production. There are 4 functional modules, including user management, management of cleaner production information in enterprises and industries, and information announcements. The information management system on regional cleaner production combines information management of cleaner production in regional industries with that in enterprises, in order to possess the functions of aiding the adjustment of regional industry structure, cleaner production audits in enterprises, and continuous cleaner production. This system is an effective tool for information management on regional cleaner production and decision aids, as well as exerts a key role in promoting the construction of circular economy.

articleTitle: On self-diagnosis technique of wear in auto cylinder-piston system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper described the testing technique and hardware for self-diagnosis of wear in cylinder-piston system by measuring compression pressure in cylinder, developed a program to simulate with computer, and brought forward the detail for this testing system.

articleTitle: Optimization design of testing center logistics on SLP
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Logistics efficiency plays an important role in the optimization of production system. Therefore, in this paper, the method of SLP is applied for this optimization purpose. In the systematic layout planning example of testing center, the related graphics are used to illuminate the logistics and non-logistics relationships. Integrating the two relationships, three comparative projects could be obtained. After analyzing the three projects with logistics efficiency, facilitation services, easy to implement automated, management conveniences, project expansibility, appearance and 5S implementation etc, a best blue print is proposed, which can improve logistics efficiency and achieve production system optimization.

articleTitle: Study on Bluetooth technology and its access to BACnet
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Bluetooth technology is now widely used in wireless application systems; however, wireless access service is not involved in BACnet. This paper proposes a design of Bluetooth/BACnet gateway after analyzing the architecture of Bluetooth and BACnet, and gives the implementation of the gateway based on MCU LPC2210(ARM7).

articleTitle: Construction and installation technique of large-scale top-bearing bucket foundation for offshore wind turbine
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The first offshore wind turbine with the large-scale top-bearing (LSBTB) bucket foundation has been established in Qidong sea area of Jiangsu Province. The critical technique of large-scale bucket-top-bearing bucket foundation includes construction technique, self-floating towing technique, penetration technique with adjusting of horizontal levelness, and removability technique. The prefabrication of LSBTB bucket foundation is in onshore construction base such as wharfs or dock yards; transportation of foundation is towing from the dock yard to the appointed site. The prefabrication of LSBTB bucket foundation needs about two months. And the installation of foundation needs about two hours or so on site. After the proposed technique is industrialized, the cost will be 30%-50% lower than that of existing relevant technique.

articleTitle: Advanced treatment of molasses alcohol wastewater using Fenton-like reagent
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By means of single-factor experiment method, Fenton-like reagent was applied to treat molasses alcohol wastewater. The results showed that optimal processing parameters are, the initial pH=6.0, FeCl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>·6H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O for 1000g/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, 3%H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> for 6.7L/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>, stirring time for 5min. At the optimal condition, color and COD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Cr</sub> removal rates are 92.76% and 75.53%.

articleTitle: Similar simulation experimental investigation on the deformation and failure character of the stope pillar of gently inclined and medium thick phosphate rock under pillar and room caving
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the gently inclined medium thick phosphate rock of the deep part of the east mining section of +2150 level of Jinning-Six mine of Yunnan phosphate Co., Ltd, the similar material physical model simulation experiment of the stability of stope pillars under room and pillar mining was carried out by the mine pressure plane stress modeling experimental frame of college of resource and environmental sciences. Based on the experimental results, the deformation and failure changing law of the above roof, surrounding rock mass and stope pillar during the mining along the strike direction of phosphate were investigated. The experimental results showed: (1) With the increasing of the scope of mined-out area, the fwassure zone and separation layer zone of the roof in the original mined-out area of the stope were pressed compact step by step. And when the space range of the mined-out area reached some scale, the deformation of the fwassure zone and separation layer zone of the roof in the original mined-out drived to stabilwasation, and the sustain action of it to the gravity fore of the overlying strata was reexternalization. (2) After the mining, the subsidence region of the overlying strata of the stope mainly concentrated the roof and surrounding rock mass which beside the mined-out area, the position of the maximum subsidence point was in the center zone of the excavation space, with the increasing of the dwastance from the center of the stope along the trend and normal of the ore body, the subsidence value of the overlying strata of the stope was monotone decreasing. With the increasing of the region of the excavation space, the mining influence region and the mining influence degree of the overlaying strata of the stope gradually increased. And the corresponding position of the maximum subsidence zone dynamically forward leaded, the final subsidence curve of the overlying strata was a bowl shaped curve. (3)The deformation and failure characteristics of the overlying strata of the stope roof was obviously divided into three stages under the room and pillar caving, the overlying strata of stope could be divided into caving zone, fractured transfixion zone and micro-fractured loose zone. When the excavation the ore body of the rooms was completely finished, it recovered the individual stope pillars in the experiment, and the remain stope pillars suddenly appeared integrity-large-scale sloughing control and unstable failure, which presenting obviouse "domino effect". The related research results could provide theoretical guidance and suggestions concerning the underground mining for the phosphate rock of the deep part of the east mining section of of Jinning-Six mine of Yunnan phosphate Co., Ltd and similar condition mine.

Author Keywords: gently inclined and medium thick phosphate rock
the the deformation and failure character of pillar
similar material physical model simulation experiment

articleTitle: The prediction of SOC based on multiple dimensioned Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Traditional method of estimating the residual energy of the battery is based on precise mathematical model which is depended on a large number of modeling assumptions and empirical parameters, so the model accuracy is limited. To improve the accuracy of SOC estimates, use multiple dimensioned Support Vector Machine to achieve the estimates of residual energy of the battery which the Scaling Kernel Function adopts the improved Levenberg-Marquardt (LM) algorithm to optimize data samples under different conditions, achieving the prediction of residual energy of a certain state of the battery during charging and discharging. Experimental results show that the proposed method can make the battery SOC estimates easily and quickly, predict accurately with high practicality.

articleTitle: The research of stability performance of 4WD vehicles basing on electric wheels torque control
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: For the drive torque can be controlled independently in a four in-wheel-motor drive vehicle, in order to improve vehicle handling and stability, based on the yaw control strategy, the new control strategy has been proposed that the driving torque of inner and outer wheels were changed in the same range at the same time while turning. A four-wheel- driving vehicle model is built in Adams/View, and conducted a joint simulation with Simulink. The results show that during the angle step input response, increased the inner torque is much better than reduce the inner torque or same inner and outer torque. In contrast to same inner and outer drive torque, increasing the inside of drive torque, the maximum overshoot of yaw rate is reduced of 5.73%, the smallest overshoot of yaw rate is decreased 1.88%, the convergence time is cut down 10.59%. It shows that the use of electric wheel technology with appropriate control strategy can greatly improve the car's handling and stability.

articleTitle: Performance research of increasing-friction herringbone driving roller based on finite element analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Belt conveyor is one of the main powder material conveying equipments. Roller which bears complex load is the main part. In this paper the way to improve driving force for transmission device is analyzed, and the stress of herringbone driving roller is studied using Ansys software, with this method finding out the distribution of stress and deformation for driving roller in load, which provides qualitative and quantitative data of surface technologies for herringbone pattern driving roller in engineering applications.

articleTitle: Determination of the main sliding direction of space rock landslide
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Determining the main sliding direction is not only an important content in researches but also a significant basis for the stability analysis and treatment design. It depends on the landslide landform and the displacement vector at present. The main sliding direction and chief sliding profile of a landslide in the upper and middle reaches of the Yellow River were determined from landslide landform. Displacement situation of the landslide was monitored by arranging displacement monitoring points on the chief sliding profile. The results showed that the displacement direction was different from the main sliding direction determined from landslide landform.
