Through comprehensive analysis of the landslide formation and mechanism, it is found that the landslide was constituted by spacial wedges with the two sliding planes, whose main sliding direction is the line of interaction. With the scouring of the Yellow River, the frontal part of the landslide is retreated continuously and the formation of ridge-like, which caused the deviation. The determination of the main sliding direction of space rock landslides more reasonably needs comprehensive analysis of landslide landform and mechanism.

articleTitle: A precision carbon fiber hexapod for the installation of an optical telescope
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A carbon fiber hexapod was used to install an optical telescope on the payload instrument module of a satellite. In order to reduce distortion stresses, titanium alloy brackets with flexure sections were employed to connect the end fittings of the carbon fiber struts. The design, fabrication and assembling of the carbon fiber hexapod were discussed. The developed hexapod passed the qualified level vibration test. The test results show that the hexapod could reduce vibration response in high frequency.

articleTitle: Study on effect of elasticity on the mattress comfort with objective and subjective methods
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Using different elasticity coefficients, comfort of bed was studied through experiments of the body pressure distribution and the subjective evaluation based on Ergonomics. It was concluded that different elasticity coefficients bed are different on human comfort, of which medium elasticity coefficients bed is the best; subjective evaluation and objective experimental results prove complementary.

articleTitle: Measurement and repair of structural body damage to cars in collisions
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper provides an analysis of the ideal characteristics and the types of deformation on car body structures during front-on and side-on collisions, the structural dimensions of car bodies need to be recovered to repair collided cars that suffer from structural damage to ensure car safety and reliability following repair. Proposal of the processes, principles and methods of car body repair by utilizing multi-purpose fixtures and clamps, accurate 3D measurement system for car bodies, and a multi-directional pulling device, to improve the precision of repair to collided cars, thus reducing reworking rates.

articleTitle: Analysis and mitigation of progressive collapse for steel truss girders
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Progressive collapse occurs to a structure when an initial local failure that is produced by accidental circumstances triggers a disproportionate damage. In the past 40 years, accidents owning to progressive collapse took place frequently, which were paid more and more attentions. In this paper, progressive collapse analysis was performed on a steel truss girder. The Alternate Path method, combined with the finite element method, was used on the mechanisms of progressive collapse for the system. Changes of internal forces were discussed in the system when an upper or lower chord or web member at different location failed respectively. Suggestions to prevent progressive collapse were proposed for the truss. The results show that chord members in end span are important to resisting progressive collapse while chord members at midspan and diagonal web members at end-span are susceptible to progressive collapse. Failures of these members will cause significant redistribution of forces, and progressive collapse will probably occur in the remaining structure. A promotion of ductility, redundancy of the structural system, e.g. set-up strengthen gusset plate will increase the structural resistibility to progressive collapse.

articleTitle: The method of vibration Fault Detection and diagnosis in rotor systems based on Hilbert-Huang Transform
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The paper presents a new promising time-frequency analysis method with Hilbert-Huang Transform (HHT) for vibration Fault Detection and Diagnosis (FDD) in rotor systems. An application of HHT on a structured simulation signal is proposed aiming to give the advantages of HHT by compared with wavelet analysis. The analysis on the experimental vibration signals from a single-span-two-disc test rig of rotor systems are made by applying HHT. The results show that the HHT is effective and accurate for vibration fault detection and diagnosis of rotor systems.

articleTitle: The research for the stationkeeping system and the mooring system for deep-water drilling device
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Stationkeeping system of deep-water drilling device is essential for offshore drilling; the choice of positioning methods is related to the security, stability and engineering costs of the drilling. Mooring positioning system is commonly used in deepwater drilling device. How to choose the positioning means of deepwater drilling device and taut-wire mooring system which is suitable for deep-water drilling equipment as well as its characteristics are mainly introduced in this paper. In addition two kinds of new anchor widely used in mooring system of deep-water drilling device are introduced: suction anchor and vertically loaded anchor (VIA). This paper researches mooring system of a semi-submersible drilling unit and design process, analysis method are also introduced. Eventually combining the current status of deep-water drilling device and development trends of mooring system for deep-water drilling device, some suggestions are given.

articleTitle: The research of license plate character recognition based on BP network trained by chaos particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces the current research actuality. To the question of traditional BP neural network's low convergence rate and easily get into minimum, low recognition rate, low efficiency and such problems, so we bring the chaos thoughts to the particle swarm optimization algorithm. Considering the chaos researching with strong local search ability and strong ability of meticulous search, we use chaos particle swarm optimization train the BP neural network and make the BP algorithm jump out of local optimal, improving the BP network's convergence rate and recognition rate. Through setting the appropriate BP network's neuron nodes number, it make the license plate recognition best achieved. Through MATLAB simulation experiment and the results show that this method compared to other license plate recognition methods is better and has a wide application prospect.

articleTitle: Crashworthiness design optimization of S-rail
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The passenger vehicle rail is a major energy-absorbing member in the vehicle structure. Many longitudinal rails of vehicle frame have S-shaped structures. Design of such components is crucial in the automotive industry to ensure the vehicle structural integrity and the occupant safety during the vehicle impacts. Optimum crashworthiness design of the vehicle rail structure is one of the crucial tasks in designing crashworthy vehicles. In this paper, an efficient design optimization methodology is presented and utilized to obtain optimum crashworthiness design of the S-rail structures. The methodology adopted in this research makes use of Design of Experiments based approximation methods, numerical optimization algorithms and structural analysis software. The design optimization approach has been devoted to structural impact applications. The nonlinear explicit Finite Element code PAM-CRASH was used to conduct the rail impact problems and generate the energy functions to be maximized. Several design parameters have been proposed and used to optimize the rail structure. The results indicated the promising capabilities of the developed methodology for design optimization of the energy absorbing rails in automotive industry.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of surrounding rock activity and mining pressure regularity in Haoda mine fully mechanized working face
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article according to the overburden rock structural features and the geological conditions of HaoDa coal mine, based on the scene investigation and study and the ore presses the monitor, after the numerical simulation of mining face and roadway, surrounding rock stress and deformation were analyzed during mining, According to the data of the ore presses the monitor, mastering the mine pressure appear law, which can for safely, efficiently and reasonably in the coal mining provides the basis.

articleTitle: Study on friction compensation for gun control system of tank based on ADRC
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper discusses the problem of friction disturbance compensation of tank gun servo system. For the friction uncertainties and non-model dynamics in tank azimuth gun control system, the azimuth Gun Control system model and friction model are established firstly, then considering them as a composite disturbance, and then, extended states observer (ESO), a new observer is proposed to observe and compensate this composite disturbance, and using the compensation loop of active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) as the inner loop of traditional PID controller. Finally, the simulation results show that the anti-interference ability could be improved by the designing of ADRC with traditional PID control, which has the feature of “passive anti-interference” and “active anti-interference”. The stable precision of visible axis and low speed feature could be well improved.

articleTitle: Persulfate oxidation activated by peroxide with and without iron for remediation of soil contaminated by heavy fuel oil
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Laboratory and pilot-scale experiments were used to evaluate and optimize the chemical oxidation process at a power plant in Penghu County, Taiwan. Prior to pilot test, bench-scale tests were performed in the laboratory and analytical results indicated that persulfate oxidation achieved 90% removal of fuel oil while Fenton-like oxidation achieved only 41% removal of fuel oil within three days of testing period. Persulfate oxidation coupled with Fenton-like reaction was then used in a pilot test to treat the contaminated soil onsite. The Fenton-like reaction served the first stage of oxidation which formed hydroxyl radicals to break down fuel oil. The excess ferrous ions and heat resulted from Fenton's reaction would then activate persulfate oxidation which, in turn, produced sulfate radicals for continual brake-down of fuel oil. Result of soil pilot test indicated that the concentration of fuel oil was reduced to below the regulated standard within one week. Of the treated soil, there are 71.7% of fuel oil oxidized by chemical oxidation, 23.5% of fuel oil recovered as free product, and 4.8% of fuel oil remained in soil. Because the soil onsite was rich in heavy metals, leachate collected from the treatment cells was identified to contain heavy metals as nickel and chromium at concentrations exceeding the regulatory standards and could pose threat of secondary contamination to ambient environment if in-situ soil persulfate oxidation was implemented.

articleTitle: Mechanical forces and magnetic field simulation of transformer with finite element method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The ability to resist short-circuit power and the design of transformer have been receiving all the attention. Transformer Industry standard has asked the transformer should be able to withstand the damage that caused by the short circuit for years.These requirements is essential to avoid the unbearable loss that caused by system failures Calculation of the Large magnetic flux leakage and short circuit forces is very important in power transformer design.The main goal in this paper is accomplished by using 2-D axisymmetric models utilizing the finite element methods. The flux leakage not only cause the additional loss,but also create heating and force to the internal components of transformer,all this cause very damage to the transformer,so we analysised the leakage magnetic field and the force of transformer that under short-circuit state, to determine how to ensure the dynamic stability of the transformer.

articleTitle: Application of fuzzy and binary algorithm to regulation of load in locomotive load test
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The purpose of locomotive load test is to examine and adjust the capability of locomotive often in its non-driving state, and it is a kind of important standard and means to estimate the quality of repairing locomotive in railway locomotive depot. There are two ways of load test at present. One is the water-resistor load test, the other is the dry resistor load test. Because the dry resistor-load test means does not pollute the environment and needs area less, its developing foreground is immense. To solve the difficulty that the current cannot be freely regulated continuously, for the first time, the model of weightier resistor network in digital circuit is applied to the locomotive dry resistor-load test system, which solves the problem of dry resistor-load test theoretically. It is proved by theory and test that the precision of dry resistor means can meet the request of locomotives constant power load test and reach the standard of water-resistor, so it can serve the application of the dry resistor-load test system. During the locomotive load test, the load of locomotive may be regulated so that the locomotive can be adapted run on all kinds of actual work state. According to the characteristic of weightier resistor, the control arithmetic, which is made up of fuzzy algorithm and binary algorithm, realizes the fast and exact regulation on locomotive load. This paper introduces how to apply fuzzy and binary algorithm to regulate the dry resistor-load and explains the realization of the fuzzy and binary algorithm.

articleTitle: Application of chaos in sonar detection
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Chaos research is the industry's hot.This article analyzes the current possible applications of chaos in sonar detection. Two methods are proved the feasibility in sonar detection: using Holmes-type Duffing oscillator for simulation of weak signal detection on account of Chaotic sensitivity to initial conditions; to detect the transient signal according to the sudden changes of prediction error in chaotic background. New ways are provided to improve the abilities of sonar detection and target identification.

articleTitle: Dynamically reconfigurable modular design of a new type of mobile manipulator joint system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With mobile manipulator forearm joint as the research object, a new type of dynamically reconfigurable modular joint system is designed for mobile manipulator joint system on bearing capacity, the structure arrangement, etc. Through the design of joint module mechanical interface and driver interface, mobile manipulator can change configuration and performance to complete different tasks according to actual needs, which has good flexibility and expansibility, saves the design cycle and reduces production cost.

articleTitle: Automatic control method research on pendulum speed of roadheader's cutting arm
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: When the situation, the hardness of coal and rock changes repidly (such as the existence of inter-band), appears, it's difficult to change cutting arm's pendulum speed timely and effectively by manual control, then the life of cutting head cutter and cutting motor will be affected seriously. By analyzing the relationship between v (the cutting arm swing speed),I (the motor current) and f (the hardness of coal and rock), this paper proposes PID-based automatic control strategy of cutting arm's pendulum speed and control precision made in accordance with relevant standards and regulations, aiming to replace artificial manipulation, protect the cutting head cutter and cutting motor and make the cutting motor be always loaded with the purpose of the work of constant power.

articleTitle: The analysis on the powerful devices in pulsed power supplies
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In the capacitor-based pulsed power supplies (PPS), the tabulate thyristor combination is usually used as the powerful discharge switch, and tabulate rectifier diode combination as the crowbar diode. Based on discuss of the discharge process of the PPS, emphasize on analysis of the invalidation example of the powerful devices then the method how to choose parameters of the powerful devices in PPS was given. The results of experiments on the multiple modules show that the parameter choice method is practical and valuable.

articleTitle: Decision-making of planning quantities based on discrete random qualified rate and rework success rate
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In Make-to-Order and Manual Operation System(MTO/MOS), product quality closely relats to worker skills, work attitude, work status, incentive and punishment mechanisms. While facing to disturbances of emergency orders insertion, equipment failure, loss of workers, the quality of the product are neglectly affected and the qualified rate changes Severely. In order to meet orders demands and control costs, it should rework about the nonconforming products. Due to the random disturbances of production systems, the successful rate about rework changes in scope. Considering the distribution of discrete random about the qualified rate and rework successful rate, how to make decisions of optimal planning production quantities. The results show that, in order to make the costs as smally as possible, it should enhance the control of relevant cost, minimize the random disturbances about the process of original production and rework and increase the ligibility rate and rework successful rate.

articleTitle: Research on fractal trait of surface topography of tangential turn-milling
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Through measuring and calculating the related parameters of surface profile machined by Tangential Turn-milling, the fractal dimension of the surface machined in different feeding and ratio of revolution is got. Results show that fractal trait can express the information of surface texture. With the increase of feeding, fractal dimension of workpiece surface reduces and the structure of surface texture becomes thin. And with the increase of ratio of revolution, fractal dimension of workpiece surface increases, the structure of surface texture becomes dense, and the lower texture height is obtained.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Theory and experimental study on soft rock roadway blasting destressing in deep mine
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Densification of graphite/copper compound powders
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: For graphite/copper composite, poor wettability between carbon and copper restricts its improvement of density and property. Intrinsic characteristics of sintering expansion for its sintering billets, the process of powder compacting followed by vacuum hot pressed sintering and hot extrusion had been utilized to densitify the compound powders. Relation curves of pressed compacts prepared by mechanical milling graphite/copper compound powders about relative density vs. compacting pressure had been achieved at room temperature. Cold compactability of these powders had been investigated. Effects of processing parameters on sintering pre-densification of milling graphite/copper powder pressed compacts and hot extrusion of sintering billets had also been studied. Sintering billets or microstructures of graphite/copper composite had been analyzed with scanning electron microscope (SEM) and field emission scanning electron microscope (FESEM). The results show that pressed compacts with better quality can be obtained when compacting pressure and dwell time is 700MPa and 30s respectively. Sintering at 48MPa-hot-pressure, 600 °C holding for lh, and extrusion at 750°C is the rational processing parameters for vacuum hot pressed sintering and hot extrusion respectively. The problem of difficult to densification for mechanical milling compound powders had been overcome by this technical process, and composites with near full densification had been obtained.

articleTitle: Research of data mining of clustering analysis based on improved genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Traditional K-Means algorithm is sensitive to the initial centers and easy to get stuck at locally optimal value.This paper presents a new improved genetic algorithm by means of operations of adaptive crossover and adaptive mutation. Experimental results demonstrate that the algorithm has greater global searching capability and can get better clustering.

articleTitle: Remote distributed control and management system for power devices based on GPRS
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces the design plan of a distributed control and management system for power devices, and puts emphasis on the hardware compositon and working principle of the system. The system is divided into two parts: field devices and monitoring center. The fomer uses ARM to collect data and control MC35, a module of GPRS; the later uses Browser/Server to realize centralized management of remote devices. The combination of GPRS and Internet has realized the remote distributed control of power devices.

articleTitle: A design of intelligent electromotor protective device based on simplified thermal effect model
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Owing to the different fault features of the asynchronous motor while starting and running, according to the protective principles of inverse-time over-current about asynchronous motor an electromotor protective method which uses simplified thermal effect model is given. With the technology of single-chip microcomputer, we have designed an electromotor protective device with all function .We are expected to explain the protective principles, introduce the functions and the structures of hardware. The main technology of "heat-accumulation" and "heat -emission" is discussed in detail. The device is characteristic of high integration, strong anti-interference, easy to use, etc. The device has been put into operation , and the practice shows that its performance is excellent.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study on V-I characteristic of carbon fiber
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Strategies to reduce carbon emissions of urban passenger transport
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the accelerated process of urbanization, transportation, rising demand, China has become the world's largest emitter of carbon dioxide, transport development and energy shortages, environmental pollution, conflicts between the increasingly prominent, a State Council for the transportation of energy saving One of the key industries. In this paper, based on the specific scope of the study, analysis of urban development and carbon dioxide emissions passenger status, analysis of carbon emission factors, urban passenger. Finally, coping strategies to reduce carbon emissions.

articleTitle: A water-level controller for greenhouse sump tank
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A water-level controller has been developed on hysteresis effect. In a greenhouse the sump tank is often located underground. Water levels are monitored with a high and low alarm. The sump pump is turned off and on according to the water levels. In a general way the sump pump is turned off and on by floats in the tank. Floats may be corroded and wear out prematurely because of the bad condition in the tank. In our project a controller for bad conditions is designed. A low-voltage electronic circuit that senses upper and lower water levels is used for alarms and sump pump activation. Since the electronic sensor has no moving mechanical parts, it eliminates problems with corrosion and wear and tear. It is cheaper and more durable than float system and can be used treatment of greenhouse recirculation water and the irrigation system in a greenhouse.

articleTitle: Water environment evaluation based on fuzzy comprehensive method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: There are a lot of factors to influence water environment evaluation. The mutual-effect is very complex. In order to reflect clearly the effects of different factors in water environment evaluation, the paper adopted fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method to deal with water environment. It is shown from study results that the fuzzy comprehensive method has good dependability for water environment evaluation. The method can calculate the main pollutants, provide data for reasonable water environment management and play reference role in other methods used in water environment evaluation.

articleTitle: Design 6-DOF fatigue life test system for vehicle driver seat
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Vibration fatigue test system for vehicle driver seat is developed to aim at fatigue failure driver seat. The implement structure and control technology of synchronal record and representation of motion and video are introduced in this paper. The method of synchronization display of motion and video by wired communication is developed. The six degree of freedom hydraulic-servo motion base as an experimental research device is applied to test vibration fatigue of vehicle driver seat. The results of experiment verified its feasibility to develop a new product test of vehicle driver seat.

articleTitle: The study on hot test and thermal stress and distortion of cast copper staves with buried copper pipe
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to meet the needs of prolonging the blast furnace life, a buried copper pipe cast copper stave with higher performance and low cost was developed. The cast copper stave was first systemically studied in this paper, including hot test and Hangzhou Steel's No.2 BF industry test results. Using numerical simulation method, the effect of furnace temperature, edge contact pressure on thermal stress and thermal deformation of the cast copper staves was researched. The hot test results indicate the maximum heat flux of the cast copper stave is 180kW/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, even in a short time, it can reach 250kW/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Its cooling capacity is equivalent with rolled copper staves. The calculation results of heat stress indicate that the cast copper staves will not generate fatigue crack under high heat loading. The industry test results show the cast copper staves maintain a more stable accretion layer. Because the advantage with higher cooling capacity, special pathway orientation of cooling channel and low cost for the cast copper staves, it has an extensive application for future.

articleTitle: Drawing management system design based on ObjectARX.Net
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The writers designed the drawings management system which based on ObjectARX.Net technology, and on using PDM management process analyzed users' needs of enterprise drawing management. The designed system contained drawings database, server and client programs. And for different clients it realized functions like, design drawings, review, storage, release, query, browsing.

articleTitle: Dynamic modeling and dynamic characteristic analysis of bonding wire
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Tensile force and transmission stability of wire deeply affect the quality of wire bonding. In order to solve the problems of unstable transmission tensile force and excess vibration of wire in the automatic wire bonder, the impact of bonding wire states on the quality of wire bonding is analyzed. Besides, the fluid solid coupling dynamical model and simulation system are built using finite element method, and the motion states and dynamic characteristics of bonding wire in the wire feed system are studied. Via modal and transient response analysis, the influence on the motion states and complex dynamics behavior of bonding wire due to the change and vibration of tensile force are investigated. The tensile force and vibration characteristics of bonding wire have enormous effect on stable transmission of wire. This paper provides theoretical basis for the tensile force control of bonding wire.

articleTitle: Analytical solution of the roof safe thickness of the mined-out areas under dynamic loading
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: During the process of mining in Antaibao Surface Mine, it is a key technical problem to scientifically and rationally determine the roof safe thickness of the mined-out areas. Based on Reissner theory, the conceptual model of roof of the mined-out areas in Antaibao Surface Mine was proposed considering construction dynamic loading. Then the analytical solutions for the deflection and bending moment were derived under the concentrated harmonic loading. The design formula of the roof safe thickness was derived by taking the tensile strength criterion as the constrain condition, and it was verified by practical engineering. The computing method of roof safe thickness could be the references and guidance to the similar engineering practice.

articleTitle: Influence of hydraulic turbine operation modes on the hydraulic vibration of pressurized conveyance system in hydropower station
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The calculation formulas of hydraulic impedance of turbine are derived under tow turbine operation modes: one is constant guide vane opening and constant speed, the other is constant output and constant speed. The differences of hydraulic impedance between the tow operation modes are studied, and the effects on the hydraulic vibration characteristics of pressurized conveyance system in hydropower station is disused through theoretical analysis and numerical calculation. The investigation shows that the positive or negative of the attenuation factors of system depends on the positive or negative of the hydraulic impedance of turbine, and the parity of the frequencies of the system depends on the hydraulic impedance of turbine, too.

articleTitle: Dynamic node routing and clustering of wireless sensor for mobile nodes in Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Internet of Things involves many key technologies, one of which is wireless sensor networks. Based on the classical LEACH clustering algorithm combined with the characteristics of hybrid network topology and for saving node energy consumption and node mobility, this paper puts forward a new improved LEACH routing algorithms-Mobile Node selected cluster method and dynamic node routing algorithms (Dynamic Node Routing, DNR), the algorithm can be well applied to mobile wireless sensor network, meanwhile, the algorithm can obtain better viability and dynamic. The simulation results show the effectiveness and feasibility of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on the data checking of digital definition of mechanical products
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The digital definition of mechanical products is the precondition and foundation for the digital design and digital manufacturing, and also the efficient means for enterprises to reduce cost and promote core competition ability. Currently the research on the related technology of the digital definition of mechanical products is becoming a new focus in the field. In this paper, the rule-based data checking of digital definition of mechanical products is proposed on the platform of UGNX software. On the basis of identifying the data of digital definition of mechanical products, the data of digital definition are described into different rules in UG/KF language, and the rules are verified to check if the data of digital definition are accorded with data standards. Finally an application example is given to prove the validity of the method.

articleTitle: Research on the simulation of cascade utilization of engines' waste heat based on TEG and ORC
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A novel system combined thermoelectric generators (TEG) with organic Rankine cycle (ORC) systems was designed for cascade utilization of the waste heat of engines. R113 is used as the working fluid in the ORC system which is coupling with the TEG devices, and the simulation of system performance was carried out under different system parameters when R113 worked under subcritical conditions, so the optimization of parameters of both TEG and ORC can be achieved. The results show that, the overall system efficiency of the combined TEG-ORC system increase significantly compared with the traditional ORC. Under the fixed ORC working parameters, there is a maximum efficiency point within the Tη range studied, and efficiency will increase monotonically in a small scale as the Tc decreases, and the larger the high-temperature-side UA is, the higher the maximum efficiency point of the system achieves. While under the fixed ORC working parameters, thermal efficiency of the system is much higher due to its higher evaporator pressure and lower condenser pressure. Compared with the conventional ORC system, additional 2.61kW output can be provided by the TEG, and it can lower the external input to support the system and make a considerable contribution to the overall system efficiency.

articleTitle: Interface stress distribution law of SMW method section steel-cemented soil
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on equal cross area simplification of SMW method single pile section, SMW method section steel-cemented soil interface stress analysis model was built. By analyzing theory of cemented soil pile-section steel interface shear stress, distribution law of interface shear stress was deduced. Change rules of different axial load and cemented soil elastic parameters on interface shear stress were also analyzed contrastively. The larger axial load got, the greater peak value of surface shear stress was; The greater cemented soil modulus got, the smaller distribution range of surface shear stress was and the closer to ground surface peak position of surface shear stress got.

articleTitle: Thermal properties and degradation of Phenolic Resin/Zn composite films
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Abstract-The composite films of Phenolic Resin/Zn were prepared. Zn was used as the foaming agent. The mixtures of 4 wt% curing agent hexamethylenetramine (HMTA) and 1-7 wt% Zn were added during the thermosetting phenolic resin curing process. Thus, the porous materials were produced. Meanwhile, the composite films of Phenolic Resin/Zn were obtained from porous material surface. The thermal properties were investigated by Differential Scanning Calorimetric and Thermogravimetry, and the kinetic parameters of thermal degradation were calculated by Kissinger method. The results show that the heat resistances of Phenolic Resin/Zn composite films are obviously improved compared with pure phenolic resin. Moreover, the composite film containing 5 wt% Zn presents higher glass transition temperature (T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</sub>), decomposition temperature (T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d</sub>) and activation energy compared with other compositions.

articleTitle: Traffic flow detection method based on fusion of frames differencing and background differencing
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Study optimization of traffic flow accuracy detection problem. For moving targets' speed and external environment are the main factors of influencing traffic flow detection. It is easy to cause undetection and misjudgment of traffic flow detection. In order to overcome traditional frame differencing method and background differencing's inadequation when using singlely, an intelligent traffic detection method based on fusion of the frame differencing method and background differencing method is proposed by existing algorithm in this passage. This method firstly use frame differencing method priorityly, background differencing method complementary. Then use an iteration threshold segmentation method to filter out the noise and the background image is updated real-time. Completed multi-lanes traffic detection, got many groups of data and calculated accuracy. The simulation experiment shows that this method can improve the accuracy of detection effectively, it is simple and feasible.

articleTitle: Survey of signal processing methods and research on vibrating screen fault diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Vibration signal processing is the foundation of the machinery status monitor and fault diagnosis. Methods for stationary signals and non-stationary signals processing are summarized in this paper. Moreover, a new 3-DOF model of vibrating screen for its fault diagnosis, as well as its dynamic analysis, is presented to more entirely describe the fault characteristic. When the device is excited by a harmonic force, time response of the vibrating screen with one spring failing and no spring failing are compared to show the difference. Finally, methods of signal processing for vibrating screen fault diagnosis are pointed out, which is worth further study.

articleTitle: The application of Improved Quantum Genetic Algorithm to beam forming of adaptive array of smart antennas
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article introduced the traditional genetic algorithm and quantum genetic algorithm at first. On the basis of the two algorithms, an improved genetic algorithm is proposed to handle array beamforming optimization problems. The results of simulation show that the improved genetic algorithm is effective and satisfactory in resolving the problem of beam forming of adaptive array of smart antennas.

articleTitle: Modification of four-point bending test control system and development of laboratory asphalt mix fatigue prediction model
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the four-point bending beam fatigue test control system was modified after analyzing the factors affecting the accuracy of test results. Subsequently, a fractional factorial experimental design method named "uniform design" was applied on the development of laboratory asphalt mixture fatigue prediction model. The regression models expressing the relationships between the influence factors and initial flexural stiffness and fatigue life were established. It is pointed that the clamp load will significantly influence the four point bending fatigue test results. A changeable clamp load is also recommended in laboratory asphalt mix fatigue test. The regression results indicate that the consideration of asphalt content and air void in the asphalt fatigue prediction model is necessary.

articleTitle: The algorithm design of wavelet image fusion based on M interest operator on the determined condition
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: It has been a hotspot that a seamless smooth digital panoramic image can be formed by several images for the researches on computer vision, image processing and computer graphics. According to the limitation of the application system condition, especially in scenes with limited system resources, a concrete integration technical plan and the implementation algorithm have been put forward, on which the the Moravec operator, wavelet transformation is based and the algorithmic operation and the feasible design are considered. In the meantime, the splicing effect, the boundary condition and basic factors of the classical algorithm in the application field are considered compromisingly.

articleTitle: Damage detection based-propagation of the longitudinal guided wave in a bimetal composite pipe
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The aim of this paper is to investigate the damage detection based on the propagation of the guided wave in the bimetal composite pipes, which can identify damage locations in both axis-direction and circumference-direction. The feasibility of the method is showed by numerical illustration using FEM code ANSYS. Firstly, mode analysis is used to evaluate the guided wave mode and its structure, which can provide the basis of the mode selection in measurements scheme. And then, the guided wave propagation in a damaged pipe is computed by transient analysis. Sixteen nodes around the pipe wall, as probes, are used to record the guided wave signal. When Pseudo Margenau-Hill distribution (PMHD) for each signal is carried out, three types of modes could be found, which are lead mode, excited mode and lag mode in sequences. Based on the results, the arrived time of the exited mode could be used to locate damage in axis-direction, and the energy distribution around the pipe of lag mode is consistent with the damage in circumference-direction. The simulation illustrated the possibility of detecting damage location in both axis-direction and circumference-direction only depending on longitudinal ultrasonic guided waves.

articleTitle: Invasive PLA microneedle fabrication applied to drug delivery system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This study fabricated a novel biodegradable polymer microneedle patch. First, a master microneedle array was fabricated using the micro electro-mechainal system (MEMS) process. Polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) was then utilized to fabricate the microneedle mold. Finally, the biodegradable polymer polylactic acid (PLA) microneedle patch was fabricated by micro hot embossing. The Taguchi method was applied to identify the optimal process parameters for micro hot embossing the PLA microneedle. The sizes of the original microneedle and that of the PLA microneedle were compared, through the transfor by PDMS mold. Next, a numerical simulation and the skin puncture test were used to confirm the PLA microneedle patch fabrication using the optimal process parameters. During numerical simulations, this study used dynamic finite element software (ANSYS/LS-DYNA) to simulate the process of the PLA microneedle being inserted into skin. Based on the mechanical properties of different skin layers and the material failure criterion, insertion force and stress variation during PLA microneedle insertion into skin were determined. In a skin puncture experiment, transepidermal water loss (TEWL) was measured to determine whether the PLA microneedle damaged the stratum corneum and decreased the water protection capacity of skin.

articleTitle: Noise pollution measurement and analysis of Wuhan-Guangzhou express railway train interior and exterior
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By measurement and analysis of the noise along Wuhan-Guangzhou express railway, conclusions as follows can be educed: during the measurement, noise in the railway passenger coach go beyond GB/T12816-2006, and some go beyond severly(more than 11.65dB(A)); noise on the boundary alongside express railway line measure up to GB12525-90; in 2 noise environment functional area, day-time noise measure up to GB3096-2008 hardly on the boundary of functional area, night-time noise go beyond the limit generally, night-time burst noise go beyond the limit severly (more than 18.4 dB(A)); the more train density, the more noise pollution along express railway, in 2 noise environment functional area, whether the day-time noise can measure up to GB3096-2008 has been a question, and along with the delay of train finishing business, night-time noise go beyond the limit more.

articleTitle: Maximal linear range of linear transformer analysis using maple & 1stopt
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The output voltage of a linear transformer is considered to be proportional to the rotor's rotational angle (in radians) in a certain range. In the case of primary and secondary side complete compensation for quadrature armature reaction, the linear transformer's maximum linear range is considered to extend − 60 degrees to 60 degrees if only if the turn ratio equals 0.54 in the circumstance that the linear error is controlled within 0.1%. But it is not the case when checking the linear error formula using the optimum parameters. In this paper, the numerical analysis combining figure demostration was applied to obtain the accurate solution using maple® and 1stopt®. The paper's optimization is instructive for the linear transformer is highly accurate device in the servo system, and provides a feasible mathematic method to dealing with this kind optimal problem.

articleTitle: Research on the thermal simulation experiment of AZ80A magnesium alloy
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By the compression tests on a Gleeble-1500 thermo-mechanical simulator to study on the mechanics and the DRX behaviours of AZ80A magnesium alloy in the temperature between 593K and 683K and strain rates between 0.01 s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> and 10s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup>. The activation energy of AZ80A Magnesium Alloy in the deformation condition is 201.78×103 J/mol, and the relationship can be described by the Zener-Hollomon parameter in the hyperbolic sine type equation. The critical conditions of DRX for AZ80A magnesium alloy are established by the flow stress curves from the isotermal compression tests. By metallographic analysis, it is found that the DRX grain size is dependent on the dimensionless parameter Z/A, and it can be expressed by a power function.

articleTitle: Fast tuning algorithm of HF-VHF antenna tuner based on neighbor searching
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The structure of matching network and the essence of tuning algorithm in antenna tuner are introduced, and the heuristic algorithm called neighbor searching algorithm is proposed to solve the NP-Hard problem. Then the iteration steps of neighbor searching algorithm with variable step size is described in detail which are applied to antenna tuner, and the algorithm is improved by the relations among the values of the component group, so the searching space is reduced and tuning speed is accelerated. At last the tuning algorithm is simulated with a 2.4m tactical HF-VHF whip antenna and the validity of algorithm is vertified. The performances of the tuning algorithm in different frequency band are analyzed.

articleTitle: The angular velocity estimation principal of α-β-γ filter based on high sampling rate
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to get angular velocity of stabilization servo mechanism from angular position sensors, α-β-γ filter based on high sampling rate was established, the principle of steady and transient tracking filter differential were proved. With the hypothesis of constant acceleration, three-dimensional Kalman filter was simplified; α-β-γ filter and its angular velocity transfer function were predigested. Combing with optimum parameters, the effect of α and sample rate on filter nature frequency were evaluated. According to the requirements of stabilization platform, the frequency characteristics of angular velocity transfer function were analyzed, and the filter parameters were designed. The results show that when the spectrum of input signal was lower than 6rad/s, parameters α was 0.02, and sampling period were 0.08ms and 0.1ms respectively, the filter can realize differential exactly, when the spectrum was 9rad/s, the precision was no less than 1.1%, the phase leading of angular position was no less than 70°, the natural frequency should be higher than the cut-off frequency of stabilization platform was two or three times. In the engineering of electro-optical stabilization servo mechanism, α-β-γ filter has properties of tracking differential, and reached the requirement of platform angular velocity estimation. Also it is one of the effective methods to get angular velocity from angular position sensors.

articleTitle: Rainfall-runoff forecast method based on GIS
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Firstly, the different factors in the hydrological process and information treatment were analyzed. Secondly, application of the neural networks model with the basis of genetic Algorithms were studied. Thirdly, based on GIS map, the basin rainfall runoff forecast method was put forward. Through GIS rainfall information treatment, the precision of input datum to the rainfall runoff model was improved. Finally, through example analysis, the dependability and efficiency of the method application in rainfall runoff forecast was examined.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of a hydro-pneumatic spring based on internal characteristics
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Firstly, a hydraulic model was carried out based on the structure of a certain hydro-pneumatic spring. Furthermore, with the distortion being involved, the dynamics model with the consideration of the distortion was built in Matlab/Simulink. Finally, the validity and accuracy of the model was evaluated through the comparison between the simulation output and the experiment data. The result shows this dynamics model has very high accuracy and could precisely express the characteristics of the hydro-pneumatic spring. It can also offer a reference and basis for the hydro-pneumatic spring analysis.

articleTitle: Application of fuzzy analytic hierarchy process in the selection of highway route program
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To establish a scientific and comprehensive highway route program assessment index system, this paper uses the indicators such as technology, economy, socio-politics and environment to build hierarchical analysis structure model; and introduce fuzzy AHP (analytic hierarchy process) into the entire evaluation process of highway site program selection; this approach overcomes the defects of traditional AHP in the application process such as subjectivity, one-sidedness and inaccuracy; and through example shows fuzzy AHP is indeed an effective approach conductive to achieve the optimization of highway site selection decision program.

articleTitle: BAF using large-size lightweight ceramic filter media for pretreatment of micro-polluted raw water
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: On account of the features of micro-polluted raw water, biological aerated filter (BAF) using large-size lightweight ceramic filter media as pretreatment simplifies the BAF process and increases filtration rate greatly. NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>-N in effluent of BAF was lower than 0.5mg/L, which meets the Sanitary standard for drinking water (GB5749-2006) directly. This BAF is equipped with both up-flow and down-flow backwash systems, there is no need to set a extra grit chamber. Turbidity removal was 1/3 as high as ordinary BAF. The head loss of BAF was below 0.6m after 24 h running, varying less than 0.1 m after backwash. Thus, it is possible for multiple filters sharing a centralized aeration system to achieve uniform aeration. Since lack of time for biochemical action, the COD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Mn</sub> removal rate of BAF for pretreatment of micro-polluted raw water is low. COD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Mn</sub> in raw water was 0.89-5.6mg/L, 0.61-4.3mg/L in BAF effluent, and the average removal rate was 18.9%. Meanwhile, the effluent of BAF, carrying rich microbes and DO, enhanced the biological effect of removing COD<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Mn</sub> in the conventional process.

articleTitle: The effect of alkali-saline stress on the growth of rhizome of Aneurolepidium chinense
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the effects of different alkali-saline stress on the total rhizome length, new rhizome length and root density of Aneurolepidium chinense were studied. The result shows that rhizome showed higher values in rhizome increase under proper alkali-saline stress intensity (A2), and lower values under higher alkali-saline stress (A3-A5). Heavy stress obviously affected the density of the underground modules than that of the aboveground. The effect of alkali-saline stress on rhizome diameter was not significant.

articleTitle: Analysis and evaluation to park green spaces status of Wuhan main city in China
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Associated with relative theory and methods of urban green space system, this paper analyzed some existing problems of Wuhan main city's park green spaces status through the statistical data, questionnaire survey and spot investigation, and final put forward the strategies and countermeasures to these problems.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Virtual green manufacturing and its application in manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: A cross four-order cumulants based harmonic retrieval TLS-ESPRIT method in the estimation of harmonic parameters
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A cross four-order cumulant expression is derived from complex-valued and real-valued random harmonic signal in the context of hybrid colored noise. Based on this expression, a TLS-ESPRIT retrieval method is proposed and used to jointly estimate harmonic frequency, mutual power and phase difference. Theoretical analysis and digital simulation studies have shown that the proposed method can restrain the Gaussian colored noise and/or the unrelated non-Gaussian colored noise between the channels with high frequency resolution and stability in the estimation of harmonic parameters.

articleTitle: Study on the effects of the bent-height on the seismic performance of the aqueduct-water coupling structure
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper the single bent- aqueduct structure is numerical anglicized by finite element method, the effects of the change of bent-height on the seismic response of the aqueduct - coupling structure were studied, and some significant results were obtained.

articleTitle: Simplified seismic design and analysis of structures with nonlinear fluid viscous dampers
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a simplified seismic design and analysis method for buildings equipped with nonlinear fluid viscous dampers (FVD). The design procedure for building incorporating nonlinear FVD is proposed based on Chinese design response spectrum, in which the damping coefficient of damper is determined according to the principle that the horizontal component of the damper force is proportional to the corresponding interstory drift demand. The application of the simple procedure is illustrated using an example. It is demonstrated that the presented method is effective and straightforward for design of buildings with nonlinear FVD, particularly at the stage of preliminary design.

articleTitle: Research on calculation of transport resistance of piping dense paste
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Due to large calculation errors in engineering applications and lack of necessary theory of the pipeline transport resistance of dense paste, research on the composition of the resistance was conducted, and a calculation model was presented. Comparison between the calculated results by the model and the test results of transporting coal slime in Dongpang Coal Mine Power Plant showed the model has a very high accuracy when estimating the transport resistance, which is denoted as the pipe pressure loss. It showed that the model can meet the needs of theoretical research and engineering applications.

articleTitle: The crosscut production line control system based on PROFIBUS-DP Bus
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The basic structure of steel plate crosscut production line is presented ; PROFIBUS-DP network technology is adopted as realizing method of control system, which is a developing direction of industry automation control technology today, selecting S7-300 CPU315-2DP as the control center, TP270(Touch Panel) as man-machine interactive equipment and IMOREG DC Master(6RA70) as performance equipment. All these can lift technical advancement, reliability and crosscut precision; it has created great economic and social benefit for enterprise.

articleTitle: Numerical implementation of pressure-dependent elasto-plastic cosserat continuum model in ABAQUS
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The subroutine UEL embedded in commercial FEM software ABAQUS is utilized to develop a user element based on the material of pressure-dependent elasto-plastic cosserat continuum model. The user element adopt plane eight-node isoparametric unit which include three degree of freedom(two translation and one rotation) at each node, the Drucker-Prager material model with associate flow rule is used, the stress integration algorithm is four-order Runge-Kutta method. The user element is used to analysis the influence of mesh density and the material characteristic length on the material localization. The results show that the thickness of shear band and the equivalent plastic strain are independent of mesh density, with the increase of the material characteristic length, the thickness of shear band and the equivalent plastic strain decrease constantly.

articleTitle: Novel large negative dispersion photonic crystal fiber for dispersion compensation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A novel large negative dispersion photonic crystal Fiber (PCF) with dual-core structure is proposed. A new outer core is formed by replacing or filling the 3rd ring air-holes around the inner core with high refractive index material. The dispersion property is investigated numerically and the results show that large negative dispersion above an order of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> can be obtained over a wide wavelength range, and the peak value and its wavelength can be well tuned by varying the diameter, the relative lattice constant, and the refractive index of filled material. It can be used as novel dispersion compensation PCF.

articleTitle: The CST design method of matching both European and American crash regulations
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To satisfy Collision safety requirements formuled by both FMVSS208 and ECE R94 for vehicles fixing CST, take metro as the research object, which mass is 0.8 tons, using universal principles of particle kinematics and dynamics, and obtain the CST-ideal energy absorption curve which can satisfy both FMVSS208 and ECE R94. To make sure that the designed CST can obtain ideal energy absorption curve, having optimized the practical structure and optimal parameters by orthogonal optimization, based on VPG and LS-DYNA software platform.

articleTitle: Resource and environmental pressure and carrying capacity of regional economies
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on ecological footprint and material flow analysis indicators, a model has been developed to reflect the aggregate environmental pressure and the carrying capacity of a regional economy. The model was applied to calculate the environmental pressure and carrying capacity of Shenyang in the period of 1991-2005. Results show that, of the total ecological footprint of Shenyang, 66%-80% came from carbon footprint and 20%-34% from direct footprint. The carbon footprint increased rapidly after 2000 at an average annual rate of 15.2%, higher than the GDP growth rate (13.76%) in the same period. Therefore, the principal issue of Shenyang's environmental pressure is carbon emission. The direct ecological overload increased steadily at an average annual rate of 6.3% while the carbon overload increased rapidly after 1998 at an average annual rate of 20.8%, reached 15 million global hectares in 2005. This indicates that there exists a huge gap between the carbon absorption capacity and carbon emission in Shenyang and it is rapidly enlarging.

articleTitle: Analysis on the static property of BZZ5 full hydraulic steering device
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Full hydraulic steering device is one of the core components of steering system. Its performance directly affects the working conditions of the entire steering system. The mathematical model of static full hydraulic steering gear is built by taking BZZ5 full hydraulic steering device as a example, Matlab/Simulink simulation software is used for simulation of its static characteristics and analyzing the flow characteristics, pressure characteristics and flow-pressure characteristics of the steering, aiming at the affects of its structural parameters on the hydraulic steering gear.

articleTitle: Research on the dynamic characteristics of the dynamic track stabilizer side searing
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The dynamic characteristics of side bearing are one of the key factors for further study on the overall behaviour of the dynamic track stabilizer. The constitutive parameters of rubber spring were determined by the static experiment. Based on the parameters, the finite element model of side bearing was built and the reliability of side bearing model was verified by experiment. The vertical dynamic characteristics of side bearing were studied on the base of LS-DYNA. According to the analytical results, the dynamic characteristics of the side bearing spring constants and its internal damping are nonlinear under different compound of loads and frequencies. The conclusion can provide a theoretical basis to the optimal design of the side searing.

articleTitle: Research on the compensation of reactive power for wind farms on simulated Annealing's Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to solve the problem of voltage stability in the power system including wind farms,a method that assembling SVC at the connection point and applying Simulated Annealing's Particle Swarm Optimization (SAPSO)Algorithm to optimize the reactive power compensation capacity is given. The processing of the wind farm node reflects its character accurately. The model's objective function is to let the voltage of connection point close to 1 p.u.. Under the difference of wind speed, combining the calculation of the power flow and the algorithm of SAPSO, the best reactive power compensation capacity is figured out. With the computing result, this method can reduce the number of iterations, realize the global optimization, and the voltage of the power system can be restricted within regular range.

Author Keywords: Simulated Annealing's Particle Swarm Optimization(SAPSO) Algorithm

articleTitle: Simulation research and programming of torque fluctuation of automotive steering system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The reason of steering torque fluctuation and its solution are investigated based on simulation software ADAMS and the practical problem of a specific Geely's vehicle in this paper. The above process is programmed into useful software in combination with the previous experience. Also the automatic optimization of steering system can be achieved in order to eliminate torque fluctuation at the early stage of automotive design.

articleTitle: Analytical method for steady temperature and thermal stresses of a FGM hollow cylinder with temperature-dependent material properties
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper presents the analytical calculation models of steady temperature and thermal stresses in a functionally graded material (FGM) hollow cylinder with temperature-dependent properties. The constitutive material properties are assumed exponentially variable along thickness direction. An example has been given to check the influence of temperature dependent properties. Results show obviously that when the properties are temperature dependent, the stresses have distinct difference with those calculated with constant properties.

articleTitle: The multiband microstrip patch antenna based on LTCC
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A multiband microstrip patch antenna worked at BD (1.268 GHz), GPS (1.575 GHz), GLONASS(1.602 GHz) is designed by LTCC technology. A power divider matching network printed on the back with LTCC technology is used for the antenna to match the impedance. Prototype of the proposed antenna has been constructed and tested based on the calculated results of HFSS. The test results show that the antenna has a matching multiband (1.268 GHz, 1.575 GHz, 1.602 GHz). Besides, the antenna has a integrated structure and a high stability, with a Low profile (5 mm).

articleTitle: Approximate formula of the lowest-order TM mode of a pentagonal waveguide family
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on two inequalities, the upper and lower bounds of the cutoff wavenumber of the lowest-order TM mode of a pentagonal waveguide family are derived. By means of taking the geometric mean value, an approximate formula to calculate the cutoff wavenumber of the lowest-order TM mode of a pentagonal waveguide family is developed. It is the function of the cross section geometric parameters of the pentagonal waveguide. Comparisons between the results obtained by the approximate formula and the available numerical published data fully validate accuracy of the approximate formula.

articleTitle: Experimental study of garden waste and vegetable waste co-composting
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Three kinds of aeration modes were carried out in windrow, to investigate the effects of aeration modes on the co-composting of garden waste and vegetable waste. The composting parameters such as temperature, oxygen concentration, volatile organic compounds, ratio of organic carbon to total nitrogen (C/N) and oxygen concentration showed that oxygen-dependent and intermittent ventilation composting products were stabilized after 42 days of co-composting. And the days of temperature above 55□ were 7d, 9d, respectively, meeting the requirements to kill pathogens. However, the index results of natural ventilation showed that the compost is not fully maturity. This shows that co-composting of garden waste and vegetable waste by aerobic composting of ventilation control in windrow can get quality compost by optimizing composting process during 42 days. Composting can decrease non-point resource of organic solid waste by recycling nutrition to soil and improve fertility of soil.

articleTitle: The analysis of friction welding process of turbocharger impeller and the shaft
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The paper discusses the turbocharger turbine impeller and shaft welding process .It Includes the preparation of the workpiece before welding. The paper describes the contact surface of the friction torque and clamping the initial thrust of the shaft. Reduce the initial phase of the friction can increase the thrust axis of clamping reliability. Displacement of the shaft should be considered in the friction thrust and friction on the set time. This paper gives the K213 and K418 the contact surface pressure and friction time advancing in the friction. The paper discusses the impeller and the shaft axis, the axis line and the wheel clamping coaxial positioning requirements and implementation methods in the friction welding.

articleTitle: Some issues in research on block preconditioning for coupled Biot's linear system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the recent developments of block preconditioning, a computational framework of block preconditioners is established for the coupled Biot's linear system of equation. Within the computational framework, some issues which may significantly influence the performance of preconditioned Krylov subspace iterative method are discussed. Firstly, the issue about which scheme (i.e. a fully iterative scheme or a combined scheme) should be used for large-scale Biot's linear system is raised and discussed. Next, when developing block preconditioners it is suggested that the recent or future efforts should be devoted to the practical nonlinear consolidation analysis in which significant material property contrast may be frequently encountered. The issues addressed are believed to be essential for fast iterative solutions of large-scale coupled Biot's linear systems from practical point of view.

articleTitle: An passive terminal simulator of IEC 60870-5-104 protocol using ACE framework
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The passive terminal simulator of IEC 60870-5-104 protocol is important for developing and validating the protocol master terminal. But there is indeed a phenomenon now that the simulator is implemented with traditional technology and it is not a complete entity usually because economic benefit can't be directly produced by it. Here a simulator is presented by us and it is mainly composed by a protocol service module, a data simulating module and a GUI module and there are some interfaces among the modules for their interconnection. The protocol service module is the key component for the simulator and it is developed using ACE Framework technology. The software system of the protocol service module is made of main thread and service thread and events are detected by the main thread, such as IO events, timer and the asynchronous notification events which are handled by recalling the function in the event processor when they appear. The running way of main thread framework are copied by all service threads, for which the simulator software is pithy, cross-platform, efficient and reliable. The data types of the protocol are analoged and managed by the data simulating module and Qt technology is used for developing GUI of the simulator.

articleTitle: Simulation and test research on merge concreting at mass-concrete base slab of Nuclear Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: For controlling construction crack, delamination or subregion is adopted normally for mass concrete construction, but still fail to prevent the emergence of cracks. The merge concreting of Nuclear Power Plant slab based on the finite element analysis and strain & temperature-controlled test makes no visible cracks in the construction. In this paper the finite element model of merge concreting of a CPR1000 Nuclear Power Plant Raft is established, and through the strain emulation analysis the conservation technical indicators & temperature-controlling indicators which can effectively control stress or strain are proposed. And also the full-scale strain-controlling test is carried out. All these show that it's very feasible and necessary to guide construction in finite element method and strain-controlled test, which can be supplied for test reference and theoretics base to similar slab construction.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The design of traffic lights fuzzy controller based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research development of treatment and repairing technology of polluted river
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In the paper the repairing and treatment technology of polluted river was summarized, which were chemical, physical and bioremediation technologies. Chemical techniques include chemical alga-killing, heavy-metal fixer. Physical techniques include artificial aeration, polluted watercourse flushing, sediment dredging. Bioremediation techniques include microorganism strengthen, plant strengthening, bio-film process. These techniques are briefly included and evaluated. The future developments of these technologies are prospected.

articleTitle: Influence of droplet diameter on vortex flow meter in steam flow measurement
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As an important secondary energy, steam is widely used in engineering for its role of heat transfer and mechanical transmission. But steam is a complex medium, its state easily changes as the working condition changes, thus causes measurement error. Based on the present situation, a theoretical analysis has been made on vortex flow meter, which proved that the error was related to steam dryness. Numerical simulations were made to verity that measuring accuracy was related to the droplet diameter condensed out from the steam.

articleTitle: Simulation research on the performance of IR-UWB rake receivers
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the Rake receiver techniques of the IR-UWB system are introduced. The modulation model of the receiver base on the IEEE802.15.4a channel model is designed and the performance of the Rake receiver in different environments are simulated. The results reveal that the environments have obvious influence on the IR-UWB Rake receiver. With the same multipath components(MPCs) numbers, the performance of the Selective-Rake better than the Partial-Rake in the same conditions. In the design of the UWB rake receivers, the using environment, system performance and structure complexity should be considered integrately.

articleTitle: The research of natural environment capacity under Henan industrialization and urbanization
