publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A city is the carrier of intensive allocation of resources. In this paper, which the environmental capacity concept, composition, structure and the impact factor of urban environment are analyzed. In the industrialization and urbanization process of Henan Province, the content of the urbanization and industrialization is analyzed. From Henan industrialization and urbanization, the problems such as the energy saving and reducing consumption of departure are proposed. The carrying capacity of the city, the problems of environmental capacity are discussed, and a series of solutions are proposed.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation on air-flow field in the milling chamber of hammer mill
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A new model hammer mill was developed by Inner Mongolia Agricultural University of China, in which material can be milled circularly and there is no material-circulation-layer effect. In order to improve the working efficiency of the new model hammer mill, the 3-D air-flow field in the mill was numerically simulated and analyzed in computation fluid dynamics (CFD) software Fluent 6.3.Then the simulated results of air flow velocities were compared with that obtained by tests to validate the results of the numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Separation efficiency research on oil-water coalescence using Frequency pulse electromagnetic waves technology
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: High oily wastewater emulsification degree, Strong stability, Water-oil separation difficult and sewage oil content out of limits are common problem in Daqing oilfield asp flooding recovery liquid. Frequency pulse oil-water coalescence technology is first applied to process oilfield coalescence and separation in Daqing oilfield produced water disposal. Oil removal efficiency is increase to 30% by Frequency pulse oil-water coalescence device before oil removal tank. Frequency pulse oil-water coalescence device accelerates oil bead clustering and separation by molecular polarization and electromagnetic pulse concussion role. The technology is of great significance for discharging standard of oily sewage and oil recycle.

articleTitle: Study on dynamic optimum design of tower crane structure
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The static analysis and the modal analysis of a tower crane structure were completed. To improve the dynamic performance of tower crane, the key modal frequencies were taken as the optimization objective. Sensitivity analysis was done for structural parameters to decide the dynamic optimum design variables. The constraints to the model included the mass, strengths and stiffness of the structure. Then the dynamic optimum design of tower crane structure was performed by finite element analysis (FEA) software ANSYS. The optimization design of the structure was obtained accordingly. The optimum result showed that the dynamic property of tower crane is improved effectively, and the comprehensive performance of the structure is strengthened.

articleTitle: Disturbance observer enhanced model predictive control with experimental studies
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A disturbance observer enhanced model predictive control approach is addressed in this paper for the typical industrial process control systems. The proposed method is applied to a practical level tank system subject to severe disturbances. Both simulation and experimental results show that the proposed method significantly improves the disturbance attenuation property of the model predictive control scheme.

articleTitle: Mechanism of assessing moisture in transformer insulation by return voltage method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Water of oil paper insulation in transformer will accelerate its insulation ageing, which is the key factor for its failures. Therefore, it is necessary to estimate water content of solid insulation for guaranteeing a safety and reliable operation of power transformers. The microstructure of insulation molecules can be varied by water, which affects the conductivity and polarization properties. Return voltage measurement based on dielectric response theory can detect variation of dielectric properties of insulation material. The paper analyze dielectric response properties of oil-paper transformer in detail, and describes the relationship between water content and polarization characteristic quantities, finally, reveals the mechanism of diagnosing moisture content of solid insulation in transformer using return voltage measurement. The moisture content have a great influence on polarization characteristic quantities, especially, the relaxation time is an important characteristic quantities for assessing solid insulation condition.

articleTitle: A quantificational study on the radial velocity of fluid in Hydrocyclone
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This research conducted a quantificational research on the radial velocity of fluid in Hydrocyclone based on the contrastive study of laser testing and numerical simulation combined technology. The hydrocyclone radial velocity approximate formula is put forward through the quantificational contrastive analysis for both fluid radial velocity and flux at different planes in Hydrocyclone. From comparison, it is indicated that the radial velocity obtained from the approximate formula put forward in this project is more practical and useful to the actual flow field in Hydrocyclone than that of "direct averaged calculation method" commonly accepted at present. The analysis result provides a new theoretical foundation for flow field analysis in hydrocyclone and process parameter design.This electronic document is a "live" template. The various components of your paper [title, text, heads, etc.] are already defined on the style sheet, as illustrated by the portions given in this document.

articleTitle: The study on modal analysis theory and measurement method for transmission towers
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The modal experiment analysis of large structure is effective method of structure health evaluation in new century. Nowadays, the modal experiment data of transmitter tower is few, and moreover the modal experiment of whole transmission tower is nearly blank. This paper study and provide the modal experiment method of whole transmission tower which be stationary reference point and mobile measure point based on environmental exciting. And to apply this method to measure the preceding six orders natural frequency and modes shapes of the whole 500 kV transmission tower. Furthermore, by modal experiment and finite element analysis, the modal of diaphragm of this tower prematurely appears in the low frequency region which is adverse to structure security. So, the structure of diaphragm was optimized to strengthen the stiffness and amend the local vibration of diaphragm.

articleTitle: 58SiMn metallographic analysis and mechanical properties in the waste heat recovery system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: There are large quantities of heat produced in the machining process of cartridge type structures(58SiMn steel) is wasted, it is necessary to recycle and make use of these heat from the perspective of environmental protection and energy saving. In this paper the waste heat recovery system that based on heating pump were analyzed, including the system composition, working principle, the thermal parameters, etc. Much influence to the technology, properties and material of the cartridge type structures were brought because of the building up of the waste heat recovery system. In order to satisfy the service property of the cartridge type structures, the metallographic analysis method were established after the processes changes with the seasons that the cylinder parts was measured on the spot. Type of tube was conducted for different temperatures (750°C–850°C) through the heating time 2min to a stable metallographic holding time of 10min, after that, the metallographic microstructure of the samples was observed. finally, the changing of the samples before and after heat treatment were compared and analyzed. Based on the analysis, the results have proved that the mechanical property of the cartridge type structures will not to be brought down after 970 °C in the waste heat recovery system. This research shows that waste heat recovery system which is used in the production of the cartridge type structures is effective.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Turbocharger turbine shaft critical speed calculation and analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Gear fault diagnosis of wind turbine generator system based on lifting wavelet- zooming envelope analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the gearbox fault characteristic of wind turbine generator system, a new synthetical diagnosis method is put forward. In this method, the signal firstly is transformed using lifting wavelet, and the transformation result is analyzed by using FFT, FFT-FS zooming and envelope spectrum. At last, the vibration signals on an experiment platform are tested using this method. The result shows that the method is more effective than traditional methods.

articleTitle: Multi-points synchronous measurement of pressure used in burst and leakage monitoring along the water transmission pipeline
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: When bursted, the flow can reach hundreds to thousands of cubic meters within a few minutes on large-scale pipelines whose water supply capacity is 5-10 m3/s. It could trigger secondary disasters in the densely populated areas. But the accident is hard to be monitored and be found, because the leakage flow is often only 1% to 5% of the water supply capacity. This paper presents the synchronous measurement for the burst and leakage monitoring along the pipelines. The research found that it can alarm timely in 3min ~ 5min and provide key information such as detonation location and the amount of the explosion leakage. The method has been applied to Xijiang River Diversion Project in China and the water supply capacity is 3.5 million m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/d(40.5m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/s).

articleTitle: The speciation of phosphorus in the sand particles in Western Inner Mongolia
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this study, the SEDEX analytical method was used to study the speciation of phosphorus in the sands of Western Inner Mongolia. The bio-availability of phosphorus in sands were calculated. Furthermore, the possible impacts of phosphorus from the sands and marine ecosystem were also discussed. We reached the following conclusions: P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">au</inf> was the main content of phosphorus in the western desert of Inner Mongolia with an average of 518.89µg·g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−</sup>. Next to phosphorus was P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">det</inf> with an average of 162.50µg·g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−</sup>, the other three P which were likely used by species totaled 104.22µg·g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−</sup>, accounting for 13.27%. The average of P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ex</inf> was 17.93µg·g<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−</sup>, accounting for 2.28%, The contents of TP, P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">det</inf> and P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">org</inf> were in reverse proportion to the size of particles, that is, the smaller of the grain size, the higher the carried P from the remote Inner Mongolia to East China Sea and the Pacific, remote transport P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">Fe</inf> phosphorus present high contents in sands with larger grain size. The contents of exchangeable phosphorus and Fe-bound phosphorus are high at Qubqi and Ulan Buh desert, which are lower at Tengger, Badain Jaran desert. However, the specially condition is found for Ca-bound, residual and organic-bound phosphorus that their contents are higher at Tengger, Badain Jaran desert, which are lower at Qubqi and Ulan Buh desert.

articleTitle: Distributed kernel Fisher discriminant analysis for radar image recognition
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, an extension of kernel Fisher discriminant (KFD), namely, distributed KFD (DKFD), is proposed for multi-class cases. Unlike the generalized discriminant analysis (GDA) which deals with all classes synchronously, DKFD uses a cost—normalized KFD for two-class problems and thereby covers the whole system by the KFD units. Based on DKFD, three new models, i.e., active DKFD (A-DKFD), passive DKFD (P-DKFD) and global DKFD (G-DKFD), are proposed for classification. Theoretically analysis and experimental results on radar HRRP databases indicate as follows. Firstly, compared with GDA, DKFD not only needs less computation time and space, but also is more convenient for multi-class cases and distributed computing. Secondly, in terms of recognition performance, the three proposed models, especially G-DKFD, surprisingly outperform GDA in general.

articleTitle: Study on the mathematical model and primary frequency regulation characteristics of combined cycle plants
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Combined cycle plants have significant impact on the primary frequency regulation stability of a power system. Because of the complexity and non-linearity of combined cycle plants, the modeling is very challenging. It is important to propose a simplified mathematical model for studying primary frequency regulation characteristics of combined cycle plants. In this paper, an appropriately simplified model is proposed based on classical model of a combined cycle plant. This model is suitable for power system analysis on primary frequency regulation stability. Parameters of the proposed model are identified by a method based on genetic algorithm. With all parameters identified, this dynamic model is applied to simulate a real 400MW combined cycle plant. The simulated results and the measured responses are in favorable agreements, indicating the feasibility of the proposed model. The results may be helpful for further studies on the primary frequency regulation of combined cycle plants.

articleTitle: GPS location data reducing based on turning point judgment method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The paper use the characteristics of complicated description of GPS locating data, and advances the method of turning point judgment to delineate the track. In and for consideration of precision, and through the analysis of measured data, the method of simplify by using the turning point to locate is feasible, meanwhile the combined judgment is more accurate than method of point-to-point, and has higher compression ratio.

articleTitle: Study on hazard source evaluation in construction sites with modified LEC method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: LEC method is suit for all kinds of working conditions for it being simple and convenient. But the credibility of evaluation conclusion by LEC is low because the method is affected by subjective factors easily and is difficult to assign. In the paper, the LEC method is modified and improved after C is decided into five factors based on the composition of accident lose in construction sites and factors are given weights. The example application shows that the evaluation conclusion with modified LEC method coincides with the actual situation, so it can be used to evaluate the hazard source in construction sites.

articleTitle: Internet-based platform for power system simulating and planning
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Power system simulation and plan are considered as essential tools for design, operation and control of power systems. The existing software for power system simulating and planning is essentially desktop application, which limits its application power. Due to the worldwide expansion of interest in Internet in the past few years, an Internet-based application development has appeared in some technical fields. A great progress on the Internet technique makes it easy to implement the Web-based system. In this paper a process is described for implementing the Internet-based simulation and plan platform of power systems. The platform supports some necessary calculation or analysis methods of the power system simulation and plan, such as load flow calculation, short circuit calculation, harmonic analysis, load forecasting, plan optimization of electric networks, and economic analysis. The cookies in the client-side and the session state objects in server-side are used for data exchanging between Web pages. Both XML documents and databases are supported for interchanging input data and results between Web servers and clients. The structure of XML and the way to construct the Web services are discussed. The development environment of the platform is analyzed.

articleTitle: The practice on thermal stress and crack control in mass concrete base plate of large water conveyance pump station
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The mass concrete structures usually generate surface and through cracks due to the variation of temperature and moisture, also the shrinkage and foundation restraint, then affect the use of whole building. Based on the monitored data of a thick concrete base plate in a deep foundation of Shanghai Qingcaosha Raw Water Engineering, expounds the classification and mechanism of temperature cracks and use the practical calculating method calculate the self-restraining stress and outer restraining stress, the results of comparative test data to prove safe and reliable. At last, some suggestions were put forward for the control of temperature stress for mass concrete of base plate.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of fuel oil system for diesel engines based on wavelet neutral network
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the non-stationary and time-varying characteristics of the diesel engine's fuel pressure wave signals, a method of extracting fault characteristic vectors by the energy of wavelet packet over the signals is presented. The nonlinear of neutral network makes fault diagnosis easier. According to the energy fault features and the kinds of faults, the network is constructed. The result of the simulation shows that this method can be used to classify faults of fuel oil system, and it is entirely practicable and reliable in the diesel fault diagnosis. In addition, it can also be applied to the faults diagnosis of other equipments.

articleTitle: Short-term load forecasting based on wavelet transform and BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of short-term electric power load forecasting, we use DB wavelet and the BP neural network method for short-term power load forecasting. Firstly, the load sequence was decomposed into different sub-sequences by using the wavelet transform, high-frequency son sequence and low frequency son sequence Then, these sub-sequences were forecasted by neural networks .Finally, the load forecasting sequence was obtained by the reconstruction of the forecasted results from the sub-sequences. In the example we use hebei baoding area 's historical load data, and we compare the algorithm with BP neural network method. The simulation results show that the proposed method possesses high forecasting accuracy.

articleTitle: Experimental studies on a CCHP system based on a micro-turbine
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Nowadays, the diversity of terminal energy demand makes the distributed energy system (DES) characterized by energy stepwise usage become a highly potential energy-saving method. DES systems are fully developed in foreign countries but just in primary stage in China. This paper reveals some experimental results of a combined cooling, heating and power (CCHP) system, which mainly consists of a 100 kW micro turbine and an absorption chiller. The results of testing in winter showed that the electrical efficiency varied from 20%~29% and the total efficiency was from 65%~80% while power output changed from 40 kW to HOkW; the data in summer indicated that the electrical efficiency varied from 18%~26% and the total efficiency was from 60%~65% while power output ranged from 35 kW to 75 kW. Also, the transient pollutant emissions were studied and the experimental results showed that pollutant emissions of micro-turbine startup had significant impacts on total pollutant emissions, especially for CO.

articleTitle: The study on the TERCOM mismatch diagnostic based on detecting the extreme value of similarity
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Recently, the geomagnetic matching underwater navigation system has become the focus point of studies home and abroad. As the typical navigation algorithm TERCOM plays an important role in this system. However, due to the INS error, the algorithm mechanism and background field distribution and so on various effects, the stability of TERCOM is not high. Therefore, a TERCOM mismatch diagnostic method which is based on detecting the extreme value of similarity is study in detail in this paper. After the test, the advantages of the new algorithm are proved.

articleTitle: A H-type microstrip slot antenna in Ku-band using LTCC technology with multiple layer substrates
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A small size broadband microstrip patch antenna for 14.0GHz radar application with multiple substrates had been fabricated using LTCC technology. A combination of a relatively low dielectric constant LTCC substrate and a relatively high dielectric constant LTCC substrate had been incorporated to reduce the effect of trade-off relationship between antenna size and bandwidth. The antenna concept was based on aperture-fed patch with two slots. The proposed antenna by simulation could achieve 5.83dB absolute gain of 14GHz and the bandwidth of 10dB return loss in 420MHz. Compared with traditional microstrip antenna with rectangular patch and single material of substrate, the antenna could indeed reduce the size of the antenna and increase the bandwidth of the antenna significantly.

articleTitle: Study on grinding force of grind-hardening based on orthogonal experimental method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: On the basis of orthogonal experiment method, the grind-hardening of 65Mn steel had been carried out on a conventional surface grinder with alumina grinding wheel, the influence of depth of cut a<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</inf>, table speed v<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">w</inf>, grinding mode g<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</inf>, and interaction between depth of cut and table speed av on grinding force were investigated. The results show that, all factors influencing the mean value of tangential grinding force F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">mt</inf> are insignificant factor and av can be regarded as abandoned factor, in addition the significance ratio from most to least as followed: v<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">w</inf> > a<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</inf> > g<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</inf> > a<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">v</inf>; all factors influencing the mean value of normal grinding force F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">mn</inf> are significant factor, in addition the significance ratio from most to least as followed: a<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</inf> > v<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">w</inf> > g<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</inf> > av. Relatively smaller grinding force and completely grind-hardened layer workpiece can be obtained when using grinding conditions that the a<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</inf> = 0.2mm, the v<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">w</inf> = 0.2m/min, and the g<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</inf>=up grinding + down grinding in practical applications.

articleTitle: Study on the new joining technology of aluminum alloy / Q235 steel dissimilar metal by the longitudinal electromagnetic hybrid TIG welding-brazing method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A new longitudinal electromagnetic hybrid TIG welding-brazing method is adapted to aluminum alloy / low carbon steel dissimilar metals joining experiments. The microstructure and element diffusion are analyzed in the arc fusion-brazing welding joint. As a result that the aluminum alloy / low carbon steel dissimilar metals complete a tight TIG welding-brazing joint by the longitudinal electromagnetic controlling. The second phase particles distribute uniformly in the welding seam. And the size of grain is much smaller than that of normal TIG - brazing welding seam. Both of Fe and Al elements are less diffused on the aluminum alloy / low carbon steel dissimilar metals interface. But Si element has a relatively high percentage on the welding interface, and the diffusion distance of Si element is very short in the welding seam. So the longitudinal electromagnetic hybrid TIG welding-brazing method can be adopted to achieve a high-quality welding joint of aluminum alloy / low carbon steel dissimilar metals.

articleTitle: Mathematical model and analysis on cycloid planetary gear
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Cycloid planetary gear plays an important role in precision transmission. Accuracy control of transmission is an extra crucial requirement for design and manufacture. Firstly presented a mathematical approach for precision analysis on cycloid gear, it enable predict mesh stiffness, backlash and angular transmission error with consideration of manufacture tolerance, elastic deformation in cycloid gear. Secondly, the solution was developed for angular transmission error analysis in K-H-V reducer, in which includes effect from bearing (stiffness and initial mounting conditions), crank shaft (offset error and flexibility). Finally, experimental study was conducted for validation which showed good agreement with simulation.

articleTitle: Research on the pose error elimination control method for boom-type roadheader
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the roadheader pose error detection system successfully developed, This paper studies the roadheader pose error elimination control method. By analyzing the way of pose error appearance and drafting principle of control strategy, this paper proposes the pose error control method for boom-type roadheader and the specific control mode basing on the actual investigation. The research of related hardware control system is completed. The control method can be applied to the current coal roadway excavation work and lay foundation for the realization of automatic directional tunneling and excavation remote control.

articleTitle: A new kind of unidirectional waveguides
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Unidirectional waveguides play a very important role in integrated optical circuit, especially nanophotonics. The dispersive relations of a gyrotropic material are studied in detail. We take advantage of the surface modes, which break the time reversal symmetry, to design one-way waveguides.

articleTitle: Analyzing sustainable development model of Wuhan“1+8” city cluster area from some complex scientific management views
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Development strategies in the central China has brought unprecedented opportunities and challenges for Wuhan city circle of development. In order to investigate the sustainable development modal of Wuhan “1+8” city cluster area, this paper analyzes the development of Wuhan “1+8” city cluster area by using three theoretic views (i.e. system view, non-additive law, and utility maximization law) based on the holistic views of complex scientific management community. Finally, this paper proposes a development model for integrating “1+8” city cluster areas into a powerful development engine of central China.

articleTitle: Study of the virtual reality smart simulation campus Based on Vega
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the platform was the software of the real-time scenes of driver------Vega. As an example to the Huang Dao Campus of Shandong University of Science and Technology, this paper elaborated the method of developing a smart system based on Vega API. It focused on the optimization technology of 3d scene model data and fidelity during the construction of three dimensional scene and the way of setting the scene parameters quickly based on Vega/Lynx. Finally, the system realizes interactive roaming of smart campus environmental effects and three dimensional applications.

articleTitle: Experimental analysis of pinhole on electrolytic copper foil and its prevention
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Pinhole is one of the major defects of copper foils, which affects both of the mechanical performances and the physical properties greatly. It was deduced that the pinholes were formed because the lead anode dissolved in CuSO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>-H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> electrolyte. In this paper, the copper foil samples were electrodeposited on a titanium cathode and a lead anode in CuSO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>-H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> electrolyte system with different additions of the suspended state lead sulfate (PbSO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>) and hydroxyethyl cellulose (HEC), in which the other electro-deposition parameters were according with the manufacture line. The results show that PbSO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> in electrolyte is the reason leading to pinhole formation on copper foils. The addition of HEC in the electrolyte can prevent the formation of pinhole and promote fine crystallization, accordingly it improves the mechanical properties of copper foil.

articleTitle: The benefit models of new energy vehicles on industry value chain
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Facing the challenge of environment crisis and energy crisis, it is important strategy choice for China to develop new energy vehicle. This paper analyzes the value chain format of new energy vehicle, and emphasize that the strategies to build the benefit models are exact value chain positioning, optimizing resource integration and consumer-oriented channels.

articleTitle: Control strategy and thermal management system research of fuel cell engine in sub-freezing
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The control strategy of fuel cell engine included turnoff and starting was researched in subfreezing, and The flow chart of turnoff and starting was formulated. The thermal management system of fuel cell engine was designed in subfreezing. Periodic and nonperiodic staring and running of fuel cell automotive was studied in subfreezing. The conclusion that solved the cold start problem of fuel cell automotive by managing its energy and considering synthetically the control strategy of turnoff and starting of fuel cell engine.

articleTitle: Microbial degradation and utilization of lignocellulosic biomass pyrolysis oil
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The pyrolysis oil from lignocellulosic biomass as a renewable resource has been exploited and utilized. Microbial degradation of the pyrolysis oil by several fungi strains was investigated. The results showed that Trichoderma viride, Aspergillus niger, Trichoderma harzianum, Penicillium oxalium and Phanerochaete chrysosporium could grow well using the pyrolysis oil as carbon source, while the growth of plant pathogen Cladosporium cucumerinum and Botrytis cinerea was inhibit by the pyrolysis oil. HPLC analysis showed that some water-soluble compounds in pyrolysis oil are biodegradable.

articleTitle: The research of processing valve train dynamic data based on the wavelet packet analysis method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: It's often using digital filtering method to eliminate the interfering signal presently, but this method is difficult to determine the frequency range of interfering signal, it can't distinguish interfering signal from real signal, and can't totally eliminate the distinguish signal on the condition of not affecting real signal. According that different segment of every cycle dynamic data has different frequency response characteristics; this paper proposes a method using both FFT analysis of different segment and wavelet packet analysis together. First, do wavelet analysis of the dynamic data to eliminate the white noise as a pretreatment, then divide the dynamic data of one cycle into different segments basing on different segments having different frequency response characteristics, do FFT analysis of each segment to determine the frequency range of the interfering signal, use method of wavelet packet analysis and reconstruction to eliminate the interfering signal. This method shows a good result: Comparing with common using digital filtering method, this method improves 1.02 percent of the dynamic data accuracy, decrees 12 percent of valve speed distortion which is obtain from the integral of dynamic acceleration data, improve 7.71 percent of valve load speed accuracy. It provides new ideas to process valve train dynamic data.

articleTitle: The automatic control system based on PLC in concrete's grouting and vibrating project
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the problems in hydraulic engineering construction and requirements of the concrete control system, combined with research status, the concrete vibrated and injected automatic control system with PLC is designed. The paper introduces configurations and principles of the control system which is based on PLC and HMI. This system is convenient to mount and maintain, stable to work, reliable to operate and precise to control. The system has abundant functions and kind interface between users and the machinery, which has a good prospect.

articleTitle: A pilot study of ultrafiltration pretreatment for seawater reverse osmosis desalination in Bohai Bay
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The paper proves the feasibility of using the ultrafiltration combined with reverse osmosis to desalt sea water in Bohai Bay over four-month pilot running. The results show that the influent quality is not influenced by the UF effluent quality and the optimum operational parameters are the flux 62.5 L/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>·h, the quality of UF permeate was excellent, with turbidity measured below 0.13 NTU and 94% of the SDI15 below 3.0. The ultrafiltration membrane could feed water into the reverse osmosis systems sequentially and steadily, and the salt rejection of reverse osmosis membrane was above 99.1% and stable during the experimental time. Therefore, this method can be used to provide clean materials for multipurpose development of the seawater due to being simple process and low-cost investment.

articleTitle: Fuzzy supervision control of the internal dynamics of 80MN titanium-alloy forging hydraulic press
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To solve the problem about the stability of the internal dynamics in the feedback linearization control of 80MN titanium-alloy forging hydraulic press, according to the characteristics of the structure of the system, a supervision controller is designed with fuzzy control method. By the mixed control with feedback linearization and fuzzy supervision, the tracking accuracy of the output of the system is not only ensured, but also the internal dynamics of the system are ensured to be controlled within a limited range in the tracking process of the output. The result of the system simulation shows the method is very valid.

articleTitle: Experimental study on the seismic behavior of reinforced concrete short columns with high-strength longitudinal reinforcements
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on low cyclic loading experimental study on the seismic behavior of 3 high-strength reinforced concrete(HSRC) Rectangular Short columns with high axial compression ratios, high strength longitudinal reinforcements and transverse reinforcements, their failure mechanism, hysteretic behavior were discussed. The effects of axial compression ratios, transverse reinforcement strength on the hysteretic curves, skeleton curves, rigidity, bearing capacity and ductility of specimens were analyzed. The main results are as follows : HRB400 high strength stirrups are effective to improve the seismic capacity of high strength concrete short columns. On the same conditions of the longitudinal reinforcements ratio, the shear span ratio and transverse reinforcement strength, using high-strength transverse reinforcement can effectively improve the ductility indexes, energy performance and seismic behavior of concrete short columns under high axial compression ratio.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A micro-grid reactive voltage collaborative control system configuring DSTATCOM
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The design of multi-channel data acquisition system based on virtual instrument technology
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By using the virtual instrument technology and basing on the development design platforms in LabVIEW2009 software, controlled Altai PCI8053 data acquisition card which completed the data acquisition system. The system is able to complete output voltage signal acquisition and processing of the laser displacement sensors, pressure sensors, temperature sensors and other sensor. It's designed to be simple, convenient and general expansion of data transmission efficiency.

articleTitle: Elastic flexural-torsional buckling behavior of pre-twisted bar under axial pressure
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to deformation features of pre-twisted bar, its elastic bending and torsion buckling equation is deduced. The equation indicates that the bending buckling deformations in two main bending directions are coupled with each other, and bending and twist buckling deformations are also coupled with each other because the cross-section shear center does not coincide with the shape center. However, for pre-twisted bar with dual-axis symmetry cross-section, bending buckling deformations are independent of the twist buckling deformation. At the same time, finite element analysis of pre-twisted bar with different pre-twisted angle is put up, which points out that the assumption in literature [7] about a plane elastic bending buckling deformation curve is not correct, and the curve deviates more from a plane one as the pre-twisting angle increases. Finally, the finite element parameters analysis is carried out on the relationships between elastic bending buckling critical capacity with pre-twisted angle and with bending rigidity ratio. The existence of the pre-twisted angle leads to "resistance" effect of the stronger axis on buckling deformation in the direction of other axis enhances the elastic bending buckling critical capacity. The "resistance" is getting stronger and the elastic buckling capacity higher as the cross section bending rigidity ratio increases.

articleTitle: Power flow analysis of a grid-connected high-voltage microgrid with various distributed resources
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper aims to analyze the power flow of a grid-connected 11.4 kV high-voltage microgrid (MG) with various distributed resources (DRs). First, related papers and technological reports were extensively surveyed. Accordingly, five different types of DRs and their controllable loads were considered for integration into two 11.4 kV primary feeders. These DRs include two 1.5 MW diesel engine generators, two 1.79 MW gas turbine generators, two 1.0 MW fuel cell generation systems, a 1.5 MW wind turbine generator, and a 0.5 MW photovoltaic generation system. Second, using the Newton-Raphson method, we developed a sequential power flow program in Matlab environment and verified its accuracy. Finally, the program was used to simulate and analyze the power flow of an MG for one 24-hour period under the grid-connected operating mode. The outcomes of this paper should prove helpful for distributed engineers to further understand the behaviors and characteristics of high-voltage MGs.

articleTitle: Fatigue performance of large stone asphalt mixtures for cement replacing mineral filler
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To identify the effect of fatigue performance of large stone asphalt mixes (LSAM) for cement replacing mineral filler, first of all, 5 kinds of cement dosages, which is 20%, 40%, 60% 80% 100% were designed, and then tensile splitting fatigue strength tests were done on MTS. Results show that after using cement replacing mineral filler, the optimal asphalt amount has no change, and there is no obvious difference for the splitting fatigue properties of LSAM, so it is feasible for using cement to replace mineral filler for large stone asphalt mixes.

articleTitle: Analyse on the characteristic of cooling load in light weight PCM building
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Calculates the envelope thermal characteristics of the Phase Change Material (PCM) lightweight building fabrics, such as the thermal inertia index, storage heat coefficient, delay time and attenuation ratio, ect. Comparing with the common lightweight building fabric the envelope thermal characteristics of the PCM lightweight building fabrics has been improved preferably. The thermal inertia index, attenuation ratio and delay time of PCM components are respectively the 3.75, 14 and 10 times as the one of the common building fabrics. So ,it will be less cooling load in the PCM lightweight building than the common lightweight building. Then combining the nighttime ventilation we carries through the contrast experiments between light weight PCM wall and ordinary building in chongqing summer, the results show that the electricity consumption in light weight PCM wall room be 32.5% less than the one in ordinary room, the results also show that outdoor temperature have great effect on the energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Adaptive bit loading algorithm of shortwave broadband OFDM system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A kind of adaptive bit loading algorithm is proposed in this paper that is suitable for shortwave broadband orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) system. This algorithm is based on Fischer's algorithm and improves it. A fixed transmit rate and a fixed total transmit power is assumed in this algorithm. As the assumption, the new algorithm can achieve the optimum performance of bit error rate (BER) on shortwave broadband channel. The simulated results show that the performance of the new algorithm is close to Chow's algorithm, but much simpler. Therefore the new algorithm is applicable to engineering realization.

articleTitle: Enhance spectral efficiency using MEBPSK modulation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: EBPSK based UNB modulation is developed to improve spectral efficiency, and in order to explore the potential performance of EBPSK modulation, MEBPSK modulation is proposed in the article. First, EBPSK modulation is introduced briefly as the base of MEBPSK Second, MEBPSK modulation is presented, waveform generating method and realization of the modulation are given in the form of expression, including its coding and decoding progress, and PSD for MEBPSK is shown through simulation, whose characteristics are analyzed and compared to that of EBPSK Then, a kind of filter is discussed which is used in the realization of MEBPSK modulation method. At last, different simulation is done based on the study above, BER performance of EBPSK and MEBPSK is achieved and analyzed by comparing. An excellent demodulation performance is achieved using MEBPSK modulation with much narrower filter besides and a multiple fold data rate can be transferred.

articleTitle: Experimental study on cyclone separator
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the development of economy, the township enterprise sprung up, environmental problems become increasingly severe. The counterpart to the State provisions of dust emission index increased, the demand of common cyclone separator is higher and higher. Therefore, how to improve the cyclone separator dust removal efficiency, reduce their resistance, is always the focus. But as the current usage look, common cyclone separator's structure is too old and equipment performance is not ideal. So it's very important to transform equipment under lack of funds and equipment limited conditions in township enterprises. Transforming two aspects about common cyclone separator aiming at it is deficiencies. Respectively from exhaust pipe structure improvement and exhausted filter material improvement. Experiments showed that the separation efficiency was improved.

articleTitle: Prediction model of water consumption using least square support vector machines optimized by hybrid intelligent algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Accurate forecasting of water consumption has been one of the most important issues in water supply system. Because of the high generalization performance and the ability to model non-linear relationships, least square support vector machines(LS-SVM) has been successfully employed to solve water consumption forecasting problems over the past few years. However, the practical use of LS-SVM is limited due to its set of parameters to be defined by the user. For this reason, this paper presents a LS-SVM parameter optimization approach based on genetic algorithms and particle swarm optimization (hybrid intelligent algorithm). It makes use of PSO algorithm characteristics such as parallel property and the global convergence performance to avoid the local optimum, and uses the evolution idea of genetic algorithm such as crossover and mutation operations to improve the speed of searching for the global optimization. At the same time, a deterministic searching algorithm is embedded to improve its optimization performance. The application in water consumption forecasting showed, this LS-SVM optimized by hybrid intelligent algorithm achieved better forecasting result.

articleTitle: Design of Brain Emotional Learning model based hydraulic servo system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A new control strategy based on brain emotion learning model (BEL) is used to control the time-variability system of the tradition hydraulic servo. The emotional learning process plays an effective role in Amygdale-Orbitofrontal (A-O) mammalians brain, which is the calculating model for simulation emotional learning process of the brain. This article is to design a new intelligent controller based on brain emotion learning model and use the intelligent controller in the hydraulic servo system. The results of the simulation slow that the ability of BELBIC in controlling hydraulic servo system has quick reaction and good adaptive capacity.

articleTitle: Developing of data recorder of using USB flash disk as storage media
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The design of data recorder, which is controlled by a MCU and uses USB flash disk as data storage media, is introduced in this paper. Hardware composition is discussed and software function is described. Measurement error treatment is also discussed. Way of connection for different transducers is also included.

articleTitle: Image processing algorithm of weld seam based on crawling robot By Binocular Vision
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By Binocular Vision way, this paper aimed to research welding image process of weld seam based on crawling robot. It built a developed suitable tracking control policy and software flatform. Some filters have been studied, such as mean filter, median filter, homomorphic filter. A cascade algorithm composed by medium value filter and homomorphic filter was used to welding image de-noising, which had been proved effective. Besides, an adaptive threshold arithmetic for segmented image was put forward, which had a good robustness, namely cascade OTSU(Maximum Classes Square Error). Al-alloy butter plate welding experiment proved that welding torch could track seam well.

articleTitle: CFD simulation of separation of two-phase flows systems
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The FLUENT code is employed to perform numerical simulation of two-phase systems. The results of computations made for three-dimensional domain of an oil-water system gravitational separation device are presented. The Virtual Reality option of FLUENT was used for pre- and post-processing, which made it possible to set an adequate geometry and sources for the sedimentation problem and to analyze the results after the problem was solved using FLUENT. A built-in option of LVEL turbulence model was used. The fields of pressure, phase volume fractions and velocities are obtained. Residence time distribution is obtained by means of computing scalar tracer concentration distribution after its impulse injection into the inlet.

articleTitle: The network nodes design of gas wireless sensor monitor
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article describes the toxic, flammable software and hardware design methods of gases wireless monitoring network nodes based on sensor array. By collecting signals with gases sensors and receiving and emitting data with wireless sensors network, we can measure the gas concentrations. We describe the toxic and flammable gas concentration measuring circuit and illustrate the theory. We choose the Atmega128 processor to fulfill the hardware design of wireless sensor network nodes, at the same time we select C language to accomplish ZigBee protocol. This system is suitable for detecting of the toxic or flammable gas, and it is easy to integrate with following equipment and controlled. It is beneficial to protect our life and property.

articleTitle: A hybrid based GA and HS algorithms in blocking flow shop scheduling problems
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper is concerned with solving the blocking flow shop scheduling problem based Harmony Search and GA for better result. The largest position value (LPV) rule is used to convert continuous harmony vectors into job permutations and an efficient initialization scheme based on a variant of the NEH heuristic, called NEHPWT, is used to construct the initial harmony memory with certain quality and diversity. In the hybrid, HS and GA is employed to solve the blocking flow shop scheduling problems, whereas a local search algorithm based on an insert neighborhood is embedded to enhance the local exploitation ability. The result shows that the hybrid algorithm is better than HS algorithm.

articleTitle: Study of blend films from methacryloyl guar gum and sodium alginate
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Films were prepared by the casting method using sodium alginate (SA) and methacryloyl guar gum (MAG) in different ratios. The concentration of SA ranged from 0% to 50% (v/v). Water vapor transmission rate and oxygen permeability of the films were investigated. Films were evaluated for mechanical and antibacterial properties. The water vapor transmission rate did not change significantly upon addition of SA. Films containing 15% (v/v) SA showed very low oxygen permeability, good tensile and puncture strength. The antimicrobial activity of films containing 15% (v/v) SA was comparable to MAG films against Escherichia coli and Staphylococcus aureus. Composite films obtained from SA and MAG may reduce environmental problems associated with synthetic packaging.

articleTitle: The design of the yaw control system for the MW generation set of wind power based on soft PLC
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Wind energy is a kind of green energy. Wind power will fleetly develop in China, too. The technology for yaw system hasn't been developed for a long time. Therefore, on this subject, the related research and design is reported in this thesis. Master controller uses the German Beckhoff soft PLC in the design process, yaw motor controller selects Siemens G120 frequency converter to reduce the yaw system vibration in harsh environments.TwinCAT programming software using the four parts of the yaw system: automatic yaw, automatic Cable release ,automatic lubrication, artificial yaw program is written.Finally,the software is compiled in the personal computer and downloaded to soft PLC. In online mode, the yaw system is monitored by the real-time visual picture of TwinCAT and shows good control effect in various states.

articleTitle: Application of two fuzzy c-means clustering algorithms in segmenting the sonar image from a small underwater target into multi-regions
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper expatiates on two image segmentation methods based on the improved fuzzy c-means (FCM) clustering algorithms. In the first method named as the method based on the two-dimensional histogram, each clustering sample is a two-dimensional vector structured the gray-level value of each pixel and mean value of each pixel neighborhood. In the second method named as the method considering pixel spatial information, clustering objective function, clustering center and membership function are modified by means of pixel spatial information. Both the first method and the second method take into account pixel spatial information by means of different techniques. The application to segmentation of a sonar image of a small underwater target shows that the first method is as effective as the second method.

articleTitle: Simulation and design of broadband circular polarization stacked patch antenna in LTCC technology
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A broadband circularly-polarized (CP) stacked patch antenna to be realized in LTCC (low temperature co-fired ceramic) technology was presented. The proposed antenna was composed of the two-layer stacked patch and LTCC substrate .It was shown that the wide bandwidth was caused by a two-frequency resonance. The CP operation was obtained by cutting corners. Based on the simulation of the proposed antenna, it obtained the impedance bandwidth of 36 MHz (for S11 <; -10 dB) and the gain of 5.69 dBi at 1.27 GHz. Details of the design and characteristics of the proposed antenna were presented and discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: The development of smart power distribution system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Focus on the smart grid has brought renew interest in enhancement of power distribution network. This paper analyses several trends in smart distribution system for the use of technology, performance and configuration. The radial, looped, and networked primary and secondary system have been comparing. It is discussed that operation and evaluation performance of distribution, such as voltage regulation, efficiency, reliability, power quality, operation under faulted conditions. Finally, the development of smart distribution networks is promoted by internet of thins, power electronics, delivery equipment, advanced measurement system.

articleTitle: The research on the new boiler water level automatic control system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The boiler's drum water level is a material balance indicator between which are the output of steam and water supply. It is a parameter of both the security and the quality. Some questions in the existing automatic control system of the boiler of water level are the low-control accuracy, the poor dynamic characteristics, the weak anti-interference ability and the high energy expenditure, etc. This article describes a new way of boiler of water level of automatic control system for the robustness. We design a new measuring devices of drum water level measuring devices and constitute a single closed-loop control system combined with the technology of frequency conversion. We also give a practical example to illustrate the its actual effect.

articleTitle: The research of speed control system based on intelligent PID controller to mine local ventilator
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According the feature of mine local ventilator, the paper proposes a kind of control method combining fuzzy neural network (FNN), genetic algorithm (GA) and PID control to local fan. The GA is used to optimize central value and width of the FNN's membership function, and the BP algorithm is used to optimize the connection coefficients. The experiment shows that the system can adjust automatically fan's speed according to variation of gas concentration. Compared with conventional PID controllers, this method has obvious advantages. The design of PID controller and speed control of frequency converter can be made with TMS320F2407 DSP system.

articleTitle: Impacts of seawater desalination on environment
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As the technology of seawater desalination develops very fast in recent years, it has become an effective way to solve the problem of freshwater shortage. However, this may cause many problems, such as land occupation, noisy pollution, environmental issues caused by energy consumption, discharge of brine, higher temperature seawater and chemicals. In this paper, the progress of seawater desalination all over the world was described. The impacts of seawater desalination on marine environment was reviewed, especially the impacts on seawater quality and marine organisms of brine discharge with high temperature, high salinity, and chemical pollutants. Countermeasures are proposed to prevent or decrease the impacts mentioned above.

articleTitle: Study on principle and technology of position and attitude parameters measurement system for roadheader
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The roadheader is one of the most important equipments for efficient production of coal mining. How to get all of the position and attitude parameters of a roadheader to achieve automatic directional excavation efficiently, and realize the fast-excavation and remote visualization, has always been a technical problem of coal mining and coal tunnel excavation. In this paper, we give an effective new means of position and attitude parameters measurement and a measurement system for roadheaders in the coal tunnel. Based on this means of position and attitude parameters measurement and measurement system , we also has established a mathematical relationship between the position and attitude parameters, and has gave the formulas to get all of the position and attitude parameters of a roadheader. This new means of position and attitude parameters measurement and a measurement system can get position and attitude parameters of a roadheader efficiently and exactly, and lay a solid foundation for achieving automatic directional excavation of roadheaders.

Author Keywords: parameters measurement of position and attitude

articleTitle: Discussion on the implementing approach of unsaturated matric suction in the slice methods
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The study of slope stability is one of the traditional and eternal issues in Geotechnical Engineering. There are a lot of previous achievements on stability of unsaturated soil slope are reviewed in this paper. Firstly, the influence of matric suction impacted on the strength of unsaturated soil is summarized. Secondly, the different treatments of matric suction in some commonly used slice methods such as the Sweden slice method, the simplified Bishop's slice method and the Janbu's slice method are analyzed based on the Bishop's unsaturated strength theory and Fredlund's unsaturated strength theory respectively. Finally, the advantages and disadvantages of these methods in application on the stability analyses of unsaturated soil slope are also discussed. Though these developed and modified slice methods may consider the matric suction in sliding zone, it still can be concluded that these slice methods have to neglect the other matric suction outside of the slip surface, which lead to underestimating the influence of the matric suction in the stability analyses of unsaturated soil slope in fact.

articleTitle: Design of urban and rural water resources information management system based on Delphi
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Urban and rural water resources management is the basis for water resources management that can promote the sustainable utilization of water resources, and bring economic and ecological benefits. The water managers need to be better informed about amounts of water users, water source types and the quantity of water supply, water use, loss, and drainage of different administrative regions and of different industry categories. The urban and rural water resources information management system was designed to aid in integrated management of such information. This system structures a three-tier client/server (C/S) architecture, with five modules of data entry, data query, statistical charts, report management and system management, enabling the water managers to be better informed for managements and decisions. This system has reusability, flexibility and universality, and extensibility for its more functions to be further developed.

articleTitle: Effect of CaO additive on formation of PM2.5 under O2/CO2 atmosphere during coal combustion
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Abstract-The influence of CaO additive on the emission characteristics of PM2.5 (particulates with aerodynamic diameter less than 2.5μm) was studied with a tube furnace. The combustion tests were carried out at 1123K under O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> atmosphere. The PM2.5 generated from coal combustion was collected and analyzed with an Electrical Low Pressure Impactor (ELPI). The results indicate that CaO is an important factor for the formation of PM25 during coal combustion under O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>/CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> atmosphere. The number and mass concentrations of PMι diminish, but the number and mass concentrations of PMι.ι.δ enhance slightly after CaO is added. The size distributions of PM25 are similar, which display two peaks around 0.2μm and 2.0μm, respectively. With increasing the additive weight ratio of CaO, the concentrations of S, Pb, Cu, Na and K decrease. The submicron-size ash particles smaller than 0.317μm are formed via nucleation of vaporized ash components, and the supermicron-size ash particles are formed by coagulation and coalescence of the submicron-size ash, and fragmentation and coalescence of mineral matter.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Tire pressure monitoring system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research and experiment on the drive frequency control of the MEMS gyroscope
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to realize the precise control for the drive frequency of the micro electromechanical system (MEMS) gyroscope, a frequency control scheme based on phase locked loop (PLL) was proposed in the article. The working principle of the MEMS gyroscope was analyzed which pointed out the importance of the drive frequency. The frequency control process with PLL was deduced which showed that the drive frequency can strictly trace the inherent frequency of the MEMS gyroscope. Based on the analysis, the circuit was designed and an experiment was done. The result indicates that the frequency is able to follow the inherent frequency in time and the control precision is 0.62 ppm, which is 0.09% of the self-excited drive control scheme. Therefore, the frequency control scheme is feasible and reliable.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic field models' building and simulation in workpiece of inductive disassembling of bearing inner race
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on researching the shaft bearing replacer, this paper built the models of electromagnetic field and eddy current density in bearing inner race being induction heating. The regularities distribution of the electromagnetic field and eddy current density had been simulated by the software Matlab, the results of simulation not only proved the existence skin effect but also provided theory evidence for designing and researching of the shaft bearing replacer. The correctness of the models and simulation had been verified indirectly by testing the temperature on different isothermal surface of the bearing inner race.

articleTitle: New stopping criteria for turbo decoder
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a new stopping criteria for turbo decoder. In this new stopping criteria, using the coding constrain of turbo code and hard-decision-aided (HDA) algorithm together, we can reduce the frame error rate and undetected frame error rate. A Genie scheme is included as the limit of all possible stopping criteria.

articleTitle: A novel design of an Electric Vehicle with lateral moving and in situ steering
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper is to present a novel design of Electric Vehicle (EV) driven by hub motors. This new EV has an independent suspension and four-wheel steering to move transversely and steer in situ.

articleTitle: Cold rolling force prediction for copper strip based on applications of GA and BPNN
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper focus on the cold rolling force prediction for copper strip based on BPNN and Genetic Algorithm. Analysis and comparison with the precision based on Bland-Ford formula, the results show that the new rolling force prediction had higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Mechanical design and kinematic analysis of a new kind of palletizing robot
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Problems about mechanical design and kinemetic analysis are researched. The research proposes a detailed algorithm about mechanical design and tests the algorithm through data which is collected via experiments. This paper also calculates the working space of robot through those data and simulates the working space via soft Matlab. The results of the simulation are the same as the pratical working results. The conclusion of this paper is significant to the thoretical research and engineer exploitation of industrical robot.

articleTitle: Avalanche effect performance test on AES algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The avalanche effect is an important performance that any block cipher must have. With the AES algorithm program and experiments, we fully test and research the avalanche effect performance of the AES algorithm, and give the changed cipher bit numbers when respectively changing every bit of the plaintext and key in turn. The test results show that the AES algorithm has very good avalanche effect Performance indeed.

articleTitle: Study on the environmental risk communication model for trans-boundary water pollution based on multi-agent
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the risk communication and emergency disposal capacity of trans-boundary water pollutions, a river basin risk communication model has been developed based on Multi-Agent, combined with WebGIS technology, which coordinate the relationship among government departments, the related enterprises and the general public. By the cooperation of the distributed agents, the risk information of trans-boundary water pollutions was communicated and published rapidly and effectively, leads to quick action in the state of emergency, realize the effective risk communication and decision making.

articleTitle: An avoiding obstacle algorithm of mobile robot under complex unknown environments
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The motion characteristic of mobile robot has been analysed and the movement of mobile robot under complex unknown environments has been summaried in this paper. Furthermore, an avoiding obstacle algorithm of mobile robot based on fuzzy MIMO control has been developed, which can make the mobile robot avoid obstacle efficiently. What's more, by using this algorithm, the robot can give a rough preview of local shape of obstacle, and thereby make itself maintain outside the safe distance with obstacle. Experiments show that the algorithm can reduce some unnecessary deadlocks, and improves the practicability and reliability of avoidance, which demonstrates the effectiveness of the presented avoiding algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on improvement in aerodynamic performance of Vertical Axis Wind Turbine using Gurney flap
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on Spalart-Allmaras turbulence model, numerical simulation on NACA0015 airfoil with Gurney flap is carried out in this paper. Then the double Disks multiple stream tube model is introduced to predict aerodynamic performance of VAWT of NACA0015 airfoil with Gurney flap. Results show that the Gurney flap can improve the lift coefficient of the airfoil and the height of the flap plays an important role. At the same time, output power of the wind turbine with Gurney flap increases compared with wind turbine without flap, and range of tip speed ratio to increase the wind power efficient broaden, which is useful for control and adjustment of wind turbine.

articleTitle: Study on stress and strain and characteristics of acoustic emission in the process of rock failure
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Through the characteristics of the acoustic emission parameters and the characteristics of time process in rock stress test, it explored the characteristics of time in the whole process of rock deformation until failure, found the relations of rocks stress-strain and energy parameters of acoustic emission between stress and time in the whole process of rock failure. Through the relations of the comparative we can find that, the rate of acoustic emission and the energy parameters of acoustic emission have direct relations in the process of loading different rocks, but the size of the stress have not direct relations with the rate of acoustic emission and the energy parameters of acoustic emission. Finally find the rule of the change between the curve of stress-strain and the characteristics of acoustic emission in different rocks through the granite and limestone compression test.

articleTitle: The application of improved Apriori algorithm in continuous Speech Recognition
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In continuous Speech Recognition ,for the problem of recognizing speaker's voice completely and accurately is difficult ,and could not understand the meaning even if the machine could identify the voice completely .The improved algorithm is proposed innovatively based on association logic Apriori algorithm .The algorithm divide database into correlated partitions and locate the voice condition in certain association rules specifically according to the character of input voice signal ,thus the efficiency of continuous voice identification and the humanistic of machine is improved ,the drawback of research only on acoustic model is broken.

articleTitle: Kinetic study of the isomerization for endotetrahydrodicyclopentadiene over AlCl3 catalyst
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
