abstract: In order to avoid the casualties when the underground engineering services vehicles overturned, and improve vehicles' reliability and car safety at work, it is necessary for the cabs to use the roll-over protective structure (ROPS). It requires that the ROPS should have sufficient lateral stiffness to prevent deformation, while also can absorb some energy. The nonlinear finite element model of the FW-6 services vehicle's roller safety-cab ROPS was established with the elastic-plastic theory and the finite element nonlinear analysis method. And the lateral, vertical and longitudinal load forces were loaded to the model step-by-step. The results indicated that the energy absorption as the cab's deformation had achieved the international requirement, and the ROPS structural component did not trespass into deflection-limiting volume (DLV). It met the requirements of ISO 3471 and ISO 3164. This method provides some reference for the design of underground vehicle's safety cab.

articleTitle: Based on the battery voltage signal detection engine starting process
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Automobile engine starting process of automatic detection is a research engine automatically start and extinction of the key. This paper according to the engine start-up battery voltage variation curve feature, through the inspection engine starting process voltage signal change, use of operational amplifier road 4 comparator will battery voltage and standard VCC + 5 V voltage comparison, judge whether engine start-up success. The method is simple, direct and effective characteristics, to realize the automatic startup system the research provide reliable way.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The calculation of uphill belt conveyer catcher
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: The influence of clip bottles on top-coal's falling and release properties
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Because of the significant influence of clip bottles on top-coal's falling and release properties, in order to improve the recovery rate, the authors analyze the influencing mechanism and process from the aspects like the clip bottles lithology, the development degree of joints and fissures, the clip bottles layer position, the clip bottles layer thickness, ect. And put forward measures to handle clip bottles layer accordingly to increase the top-coal's property of falling and release. Through the study of these influence factors conducive to actual production of improving top coal caving resources recovery, we can make mine production achieve better economic benefits.

articleTitle: Design and analysis on the main frame of Marine Tensioner
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The main frame is a part of Marine Tensioner, which is used on the ship of laying oil pipeline in deep sea. The structural strength of the main frame must meet the requirements of Marine Tensioner, because its working load is larger. Analyzing the structural strength of the main frame is the key of assurance the reliability of Marine Tensioner. In the article, the structure of the main frame is described, and its strength is calculated with Ansys software. By the calculated result, the key positions of stress concentration in the main frame have been strengthened.

articleTitle: The pile foundation of high-rise buildings treatment depth optimization in covered karst areas
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The Karst under the Quaternary system overburden is called covered karst, which is hidden. The foundation of the high-rise buildings on the covered karst using socketed pile has to be handled in order to satisfy bearing capacity and deformation. So, the treatment depth becomes one of the critical questions. Choosing the optimal treatment depth can both satisfy the need of engineering construction and shorten the construction period as well as save the cost. Taking the covered karst area in TangShan for example in the text, basing on the characteristic of the covered karst, we calculate and analyze the foundation deformation of the different treatment depth on the load of the high-rise buildings. After this, we check the roof stability in the covered karst area. Finally, we can say that the optimal treatment depth is 7m in the covered karst area. In this way, we can provide the reliable basis for similar construction engineerings in the covered karst areas.

articleTitle: Equilibrium between spontaneous polarization, piezoelectric polarization and crystal defects for blue LEDs on sapphire substrate
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: High power InGaN-based blue LEDs have been commercialized despite the presence of a high dislocation density in the heteroepitaxial structures. Traditional trial-and-error techniques are very inefficient for improving the process of MOVCD. We analyze the relationship between spontaneous, piezoelectric polarization and crystal defaults by adjusting screening values. The simulation results shows to improve characteristics of blue LEDs on sapphire substrate, interfacial charges for piezoelectric and polarization should get equilibrium with crystal defects. And it may be the real lighting mechanism for InGaN-based blue LEDs with high dislocation density.

articleTitle: Application of Attribute Recognition Theoretical Model on Dam Severity Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In China, there are thousands of dangerous dams with different deficiencies which are still posing serious threats to downstream public. Facing contradictions between limited resources and large number of dangerous dams to be reinforced, and the need to find out a proper method which can be applied to evaluate the severity of those dams is becoming more and more urgent. Since appraising the severity of dangerous dam is an issue of multi-attributes recognition, a multi-attributes index system based on available dam safety appraisal technology is built, and then Attribute Recognition Theory (ART) is applied to build up an Attribute Recognition Theoretical Model on Dam Severity Evaluation (ARTMDSE) to evaluate the severity of dangerous dams. ARTMDSA is applied on a group of 7 dams and the process and framework of it are introduced. Results of case study show that: first, the method is easy to operate; secondly, evaluation model is available for describing and measuring the severity of every dangerous dam within a group of dams. The results can be taken as technical basis for safety management of a group of dams, especially can be used to determine the sequence of rehabilitation program for dangerous dams.

articleTitle: Vibration analysis of multi-DIM vibration absorber based on parallel mechanism
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: An originality multi-DIM vibration absorption device with single-layer is presented It uses the parallel mechanism as the main mechanism, associating elastic damping system with the primary component of mechanism. So energy absorption and power adaptive balance can be realized. The vibration analysis of multi-DIM vibration absorber system is done using Lagrange equation. Due to the mass matrix M and the stiffness matrix K of system are the function of the mechanism's position, so it is a complex nonlinear system. It's very difficult to solve exactly for the system. But the natural frequency and modal of system are obtained approximately for the micro-vibration system that the elastic potential energy is more than the gravity potential energy, because the mass matrix M and the stiffness matrix K of the equilibrium location are constant matrix. The calculated result is near to its simulation, so the method can reflect the system's vibration characteristics under the equilibrium state.

articleTitle: Thermal-mechanical coupling finite element analysis of laser cladding process Part II: Strain-stress field
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A finite element model for analyzing the strain-stress field of laser cladding process was built and the process with powder feeding was analyzed with the model. Temperature variation during cladding described in Part I was applied as "body force" loads in the strain-stress analysis. The analysis result shows that, by the end of cladding, the clad layer is in tension stress and the stress values are varied in directions. The tension stress along the cladding direction is the maximum one, which causes the cracking in clayed layer. Increasing the preheating temperature of substrate is an effective way to avoid the crack generation.

articleTitle: Study on the influence of parabolic-trough solar concentrator under snow load
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The parabolic-trough solar concentrator is the key component in parabolic-trough solar thermal power plants. The parabolic-trough solar concentrator is designed in this paper. It was analyzed under operational condition and under snow load. The model of the coefficient of accumulated snow with the different rotational angle is established. The coefficient was calculated with the model for a parabolic-trough solar system in Nanjing China. And the optimal position is gotten by the analysis of the coefficient. Finally, the equivalent stress and the deformation of the concentrator were simulated under the operational position and under snow load. The concentrator meets the design requirements of the stress and the deformation. As a result, the optimal position for avoiding snow is right by the contrast to the waiting position. The proposed concentrator model of accumulated snow will lay a solid foundation for designing the parabolic-trough solar concentrator.

articleTitle: Research on the evaluation of air conditioning of the solar energy or the wind energy-ground source heat pump based on the cost year-end value
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This dissertation analyzed and evaluated air conditioning of ground source heat pump, air conditioning of the solar energy-ground source energy-ground source heat pump and air conditioning of the wind energy-ground source heat pump from the angle of technology and economy. First, it is analyzed that the operating principle, technical specialty and problems of air conditioning of ground source heat pump; Then, as an auxiliary heat source, solar and wind energy can solve problems of air conditioning of ground source heat pump in the running. Finally, with a civil dwelling in Urumqi as an engineering example, a comparative calculation is made of the air conditioning of ground-source heat pump plan, air conditioning of the solar energy-ground source energy-ground source heat pump plan and air conditioning of the wind energy-ground source heat pump plan. The initial investment, the annual operation cost, the annual maintenance cost, the cost year-end value and the life cycle cost (LCC) of three plans are given. The results indicated that the civil dwelling of air conditioning of solar or wind energy-ground source heat pump plan has the distinct economic advantages as an auxiliary heat source.

articleTitle: Study on adsorption of molasses effluent by activated carbon
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Adsorption of molasses effluent by activated carbon (AC) was investigated in this study. The effect of AC type on decolorization rates was compared and influential factors such absorbent doses, initial pH, adsorption time and temperature were evaluated. The results shows that the decolorization capacity is in the order of powered activated carbon (PAC) >; granular activated carbon (GAC) >; cylindrical activated carbon (CAC). The optimum dosage was 2 g/L for PAC and 20 g/L for GAC. The optimal operation parameters were set as: initial pH lower than 5, adsorption time in the range of 90-120 min and adsorption temperature lower than 40 oC Adsorption of molasses effluent using PAC and GAC fit Langmuir and Freundlich adsorption isotherms, respectively. The equilibrium adsorption capacity of organics present in the molasses effluent using PAC amounted to 300 mg/g.

articleTitle: Assessment of the load-carrying capacity of the concrete pier subjected to the freeze-thaw cycles
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the situation that the concrete piers in the northern area and most of the southern area of our country are affected by the damage of the freeze-thaw cycle in varying degrees, this paper has studied the assessment of load-carrying capacity of concrete piers under freeze-thaw condition. In this paper, based on the mechanism of freeze-thaw process, several factors affecting the freeze resistance of concrete were considered, and a regression model considering the interaction of freeze-thaw and loads was established according to experimental data. When the load-carrying capacity of pier after freeze-thaw cycles is analyzed, a whole new concept the effective depth of the freeze-thaw has been introduced into the analyzing, and it also considers of the area of cross section reducing, which results in the stress concentration. It calculates the maximal stress by using the limit state design method, finally judges its rank of damage.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: An improved securities network traffic management scheme
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Research on microstructure in semisolid A356-Sc alloy
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Semisolid A356-Sc alloy slurry is prepared by low superheat pouring. The effects of Sc on microstructure in semisolid A356 alloy are researched. The results indicate that the slurry with particle- and rosette-like α-Al grains can be prepared by low superheat pouring. The size and morphology of the α-Al grain in the slurry are markedly improved by Sc. The refining mechanism of Sc on the morphology and size of the α-Al grain in semisolid A356 alloy is delved. The eutectic reaction of Al-Sc binary alloy provides the effective nuclei for formation of the α-Al grains in semisolid A356 alloy.

articleTitle: The application of compressive sensing based on wavelet in the reconstruction of ultrasonic medical image
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Compressive sensing based on wavelet is applied to ultrasonic medical image. Structured random measurement matrix (SRM) is chosen as measurement matrices to reduce computation. The image is sparsely represented in the wavelet transform space. Finally, Gradient Projection for Sparse Reconstruction (GPSR) is used to reconstruct the image. The experiments show that the ultrasonic medical images could be reconstructed well, which proves our approach is practicable to in the reconstruction of the ultrasonic medical image.

articleTitle: Model to forecast the popularity of electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Electric vehicle (EV) is getting more and more popular and characters of environment-friendly and fuel-saving serve as the mean course for its expanding. In order to predict the performance of EVs in the near future, a model is presented to simulate the car market - the main ‘battle field’ of electrification of transportation. Two complementary and reciprocal factors are concentrated in our model - consumers and manufacturers, whose decisions will be influenced by prices, maintenance costs, production costs, market demand and supply. To evaluate our model, we assume a virtual country with ten thousand cars. Using our model to simulate the recursive progress of electrification, then the simulations shows the virtual market will be taken by EVs gradually. After that, our model is used to analyze energy saving during the electrification of transportation and the factors changing are also discussed to present their affection of the electrifying progress.

articleTitle: Nonlinear numerical analysis of asphalt concrete pavement structure on settlement
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By the nonlinear finite element software MSC.MARC, this paper shows the numerical analysis on asphalt concrete pavement settlement owing to the buried pipes with 1m in diameter under the circumstances of different depths and different backfill Elastic modulus. On the hypothesis of the D-P nonlinear model of the pavement foundation and plane strain state, it can be found that the backfill Elastic modulus and the depths affect the pavement properties. The deeper the pipe is, the bigger the pavement surface settlement is for small backfill elastic modulus. The deeper the pipe is, the smaller the pavement surface settlement is for big backfill elastic modulus. The improvement of the compositive pavement foundation Elastic modulus can lower its deflection efficiently.

articleTitle: Modeling the region manufacturing innovation ability with ICA and DEA
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In recent years, evaluating the region manufacturing innovation Ability has gained a renewed interest in both growth economists and trade economists. In this work, a two-stage architecture constructed by combining independent component analysis (ICA) and the data envelopment analysis (DEA) is proposed for evolution region manufacturing innovation. In the first stage, ICA is used as feature extraction. In the second stage, DEA is used to evolution region manufacturing innovation efficiency. By examining the region manufacturing innovation data, it is shown that the proposed method achieves is effective and feasible. And it provides a better estimate tool for the region manufacturing innovation activity. It also provides a novel way for the evolution design of the other engineering.

articleTitle: Chaos identification of tractor vibration signals with numerical methods
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The conventional methods on studying the tractor vibration characteristics were based on spectrum analysis. Spectrum analysis is efficient to the linear system. The tractor is a complicated nonlinear system, so studying the tractor vibration characteristics using linear methods is imperfection. In this paper, the nonlinear method was applied to study the tractor vibration characteristics. The numerical methods of chaos identification were analyzed and the corresponding software was designed with MATLAB. The time series of tractor vibrations in different excitation frequencies were analyzed. The correlation dimensions and the Largest Lyapunov exponents of different excitations were calculated. The results illustrated that the tractor vibration included chaotic vibration. It is useful for illustrating and evaluating the vibration characteristics of tractor and diagnosing tractor malfunction with chaotic characteristic.

articleTitle: Instability analysis of fluid and elastic panel system based on the differential quadrature method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the differential quadrature (DQ) method, a new algorithm for the instability analysis of fluid and elastic panel system is presented in this paper. The governing equations of both subsonic compressible airflow and two-dimensional elastic panel are discretized using the differential quadrature method at the same grid points. The coupled fluid-panel equation is analyzed by using eigenvalue theory and the instability characteristics of panels with differential boundary conditions are given. The results show: the elastic panel which is simply support or clamped at both ends undergoes divergence but not flutter; this algorithm has the advantages of producing highly accurate solutions with minimal computational effort.

articleTitle: Theoretical model of electromagnetic separation in circular current and experimental study
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on classical electromagnetic theory, the electromagnetic separation calculation model and the formula of electromagnetic body force have been established. Theoretical results indicated that the frequency, current density and electric conductivity can influence the effect of electromagnetic separation. The effects of electromagnetic body force on the microstructure of Al-Si alloy were given in detail using the formula of electromagnetic pressure. It can be found that non metallic inclusions of Si phase tend to aggregate on the surface under the electromagnetic body force.

articleTitle: Retrospect and prospect to the research on faults diagnosis of rotating machinery in noninertial reference frames
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the retrospect to the development history of faults diagnosis of rotating machinery located in noninertial reference frames, this paper summarized the research achievements, the development actualities and the prospect of rotor system, especially in the areas of dynamic modeling and analyzing, bearing dynamics, stability analysis, fault inspection and diagnosis, nonlinear vibration, bifurcation and chaos. The dynamical characteristics of multiple faults in above systems are different with those in rotor systems situated in inertial systems. The new research directions in cross subjects are suggested.

articleTitle: Investigation and analysis of existing building use and maintenance
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the mode of “general investigation, key measurement and comprehensive evaluation of the feasibility”, through ensus and key-point investigation of 1615 existing buildings of different phases, different structure type, different use function, full investigation and statistical classification and analysis of different building types were made from the aspect of function, structural safety, fire safety, energy conservation and other aspects of building use and maintenance. Finally, from technical and management view, proposed suggestions of existing building use and maintenance.

articleTitle: Evolution of high concentration particle diffusion and coagulation in planar jet flow
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: High concentration particles with ultrafine diameter (d<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">p</sub>,=100nm) diffusion and coagulation in planar jet flow were simulated. The initial particle volume fraction is 10%. The Large Eddy Simulation (LES) was adopted to calculate the flow field. The Taylor-series expansion method of moments (TEMOM) model was used to transform and close the particle General Dynamic Equation (GDE) which can simulate the particle evolution. The results show that particle number concentration decreases rapidly as particle sprayed into flow field. At the upstream, the main effect of jet flow is carrying particles to downstream, but at the downstream, the particle coagulation is more obvious, so we can find the maximum particle size here.

articleTitle: Blasting and controlling technique of danger rock mass at Wuzhaoguan on Yichang-Wanzhou Railway
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Blasting and controlling technique of isolated and steep rock slope, differing from common blasting, have the special complexity. While, in the course of blasting design and implementation, the rock geology characteristic and environment should be sufficiently realized, and the scheme of blasting and valid protection measures should be established. According to the structural characteristic of rock slope and environment of danger rock mass at Wuzhaoguan on Yichang-Wanzhou Railway , this paper introduces the principle of controlled b lasting and the scheme of blasting and loose blasting. Some technique measures of how to control blasting flying rock and rolling stone are introduced. The methods above are used in realistic engineering and ideal result is obtained.

articleTitle: Effects of grazing intensity on the small-scale pattern in a Dactylis glomerata-Trifolium sward
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Effects of grazing, cutting and decapitating on grass populations on the artificial grassland in the in subtropical region of China were studied. The results showed that moderate grazing and cutting could increase the adaptability of Dactylis glomerata and Lolium prenne due to decapitating. Decapitating could reduce the apical dominance and reproductive growth of grass, so the ecological effects grazing and cutting on grass could be realized by decapitating, and the population density, caloric value and energy accumulation of D. glomerata and L. prenne increased obviously. Apical dominance of grasses could lower the population density, energy accumulation and intra population competitive ability.

articleTitle: A co-simulation of seam tracking system based on ADAMS and SIMULINK
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As a hotspot in the field of welding, intelligent seam tracking techniques could improve the flexibility of the equipment dramatically, better the working condition, cut the manufacturing cost. A co-simulation was implemented on a set of binocular autonomous welding system in the laboratory using the powerful virtual Prototype software ADAMS and controlling software SIMULINK Factors like control period, welding speed and seam slope are taken into consideration. To keep the maximum tracking error under 0.5mm while tracking a curved sine seam, optimum values for control period and welding speed are obtained respectively. The Co-simulation result provides a lot of valuable data for the mechanical and control design of the experimental system, thus improving design quality and efficiency.

articleTitle: An experimental study on the influence of curing temperature on autogenous shrinkage of high strength/performance concrete
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper focus on the behavior of autogenous shrinkage of high strength/performance concrete with water cement ratio of 0.3 and slump flow of 500mm based on the experiment under 4 different curing temperatures (10°C, 20°C, 28°C, 35°C). The influence of curing temperature on autogenous shrinkage strain and strain rate was discussed; the usability of evaluation on the influence of curing temperature based on the concept of equivalent age was investigated. The results showed that the amount and rate of autogenous shrinkage strain both increase with the rising of curing temperature; the equivalent age has a better applicability to evaluating the influence of curing temperature on autogenous shrinkage of HSC/HPC which is cured in higher temperature than in lower temperature.

articleTitle: Study on Safe Rock Pillar Thickness and gas source control with short distance protective layer extraction
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Rational thickness of safe rock pillar and effective measures of controlling gas are the key to achieve safe and fast tunnel excavation in short distance protective layer. Combined with gas-geology condition in 5th Mine in Pingdingshan Tian'An Coal Mining Corporation, a numerical model of safe rock pillar thickness is established by FLAC<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3D</sup> software to simulate distribution law of tensile stress and vertical displacement at the protective layer floor with different gas pressure and rock pillar thickness. Simulation results show that when safe rock pillar thickness between protective layer and protected layer is shorter than 5.0m, the protected layer will be in coal-gas outburst potential. Based on these results, the effective measures are taken to detect gas coal layer and geological structure to prevent the gas outburst of protected layer. The method of gas sources control is proposed through measuring and analyzing gas emission sources during tunnel excavation process. Field test results show that measures are safe and effective in fast driving. So the methods could be used in controlling gas outbursts under the similar conditions.

articleTitle: Parametric CNC programming of reconfigurable machine tools based on remanufacturing
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Btcaust of the particularity of its techniques, the remanufacturing parts and ordinary parts are very different from their machining and program method. Due to the CNC software of reconfigurable machine tools is expandable, the parametric CNC programming method is researched. Parametric CNC programming modules is sorted based on typical parts and machining techniques, which is used on CNC system of reconfigurable machine tools. As a result, the fast programming and local-scale repair of remanufacturing parts are resolved.

articleTitle: Study on the comparation of the removal of nickel in wastewater with different absorption materials
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Taking activated carbon, tourmaline, NSUL-1, UERW-1 for the test object, we have a study on specific adsorption of different absorption materials. The study shows the influence of the material quantity, pH, adsorption equilibrium time on the removal of nickel in wastewater. The results showed that the adsorption capacity of the adsorption materials with different conditions is different. For the wastewater with nickel ion concentration of 100mg/L, compared with the same quantity of the materials (30g/L), UERW-1 had the best treatment efficiency, removal rate reaching 99.8%; the most applicable pH of the four materials are 7, that is the neutrality; tourmaline has the highest absorption rate, and its adsorption equilibrium time is about 1 hour with the removal rate of 62%. To conclude, different absorption materials have different treatment efficiency in various kinds of conditions with its own property and advantages. Choosing the suitable material based on its property in the practical application can achieve the best effect.

articleTitle: A study of driving cycles synthesis methodology based on the wireless remote data collection1
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Hybrid electric vehicle powertrain control is often simplified by classifying the driving cycle and altering the control strategy based on how the cycle is classified. However, most driving cycle classifications have deficiencies. Taking into account these deficiencies, a new method of segmenting the driving cycle into dynamic clusters, namely the mean δ cluster method, is proposed. This method is based on collecting data using a wireless remote data collection system. Through this method, driving cycle segments are clustered and the driving cycle is constructed based on the real driving route. This study shows that the constructed driving cycle has the same characteristics as the database of driving segments, and the mean δ cluster method can be used as a method to synthesis driving cycles.

articleTitle: Analysis on evolutionary process of Liaohe Delta wetlands based on geographic information system (GIS) and remote sensing (RS)
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the interpretation and analysis of 1978, 1988, 1998 and 2008 remote sensing images, evolutionary process during different periods of Suaeda heteroptera and reed wetlands in Liaohe Delta was discussed. Results showed that, although areas of Suaeda heteroptera and reed wetlands during 1978-1988 were increased, their areas were abbreviated from 1978 to 2008 in the mass. The area degeneration of Suaeda heteroptera was mainly affected by human activities, such as aquaculture, exploitation of paddy field and sea level rise caused by climate change. Areas of reed wetlands were degenerated which had the evolutionary trend to paddy fields, built up areas (such as roads, oil wells and residential areas) and dry farmlands. Nonetheless, because of the artificial management and implement of protection policy, the degeneration of reed areas become less in recent years.

articleTitle: Design of an experimental system for cryogenic compact exchanger
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Heat exchanger is one of the most important devices in thermal system. An experimental system is developed for testing the heat-exchange performance of cryogenic compact exchangers. This system mainly consists of a regenerator, a cold box, a liquid nitrogen dewar, two cryogenic transfer lines and other devices. The features of the main components are described in this paper. A measurement system based on PC is developed for this system. All of these make this system more reliable, convenient, and energy-saving.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Water conservancy monitoring system based on wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research of an integration model combining Rough Set with extension theory for fault diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Considering the poor accuracy of extension theory using in fault diagnosis field, a method of combining rough set and extension theory is presented. The method use historical test data firstly to construct the attribute sets and decision-making sets for fault diagnosis, then using rough sets reduce the attribute sets, and calculating the important degree of each condition attribute for decision-making to get its objective weight. Using the reduction information construct the matter-element model, the fault pattern is judged by the weighted relevance degree of the unknown object with each fault pattern in data set of reduction attribution with the relevance function in extension theory. Experiment result indicates that Rough Set based extensional fault diagnose method can effectively determine the best features of parameters describing the fault, distinguish the importance of different parameters, improve the accurate of extension diagnose algorithm, and can play significant performance in practice.

articleTitle: Shallow reinforcement effect of plant roots on construction stability of shallow tunnel
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Shallow roots of plant have reinforcement function. It can improve shear strength of soil mainly by increasing cohesion of root and soil composite. Considering shallow reinforcement influence of plant roots, it can be concluded based on 3D numerical simulation and comparative study that shallow reinforcement effect of plant roots on construction stability of shallow tunnel in weak rock mass mainly includes diminishing vault subsidence and surface settlement, greatly increasing the tensile capacity of surface shallow soil, and reducing damage scope of surface shallow soil. Shallow reinforcement effect of plant roots is optimal for construction stability of shallow tunnel in weak rock mass when embedded depth of tunnel is within influencing depth of plant roots, that is, 1-2m. It is not sensitive for shallow reinforcement effect on strength of initial support in the range of reasonable parameters of initial support.

articleTitle: A determination method of position,attitude and velocity based on inertial/magnetic for human movement
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Inertial/Magnetic tracking technology had been publicly investigated, but most of the methods were based on the assumption that acceleration of the body segment in the global system was quite small to be neglected, and they couldn't figure out the velocity and location accurately. However micro compass was easily disturbed by external magnetic environment which seriously effected calculation of heading. So the states of acceleration and disturbance of ferromagnetic were introduced based on the traditional error equation, and the attitude was solved by kalman filter error equations. The sphere surface dynamic model which got the joint as center and length of segment as radius was established through analyzing the movement of human. According to the attitude and dynamic model, the position and velocity in moving was calculated real time. Finally, the experiment shows that the method proposed in this paper is effective.

articleTitle: Application and research on construction control of bridges on the basis of Artificial Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The paper studies some problems for actual construction process of Xinchang electric-factory bridge in Nanchang. The paper analyses the parameters of construction control, with the aim of introducing the theory of Artificial Neural Network (ANN), which is the most modern prediction theory, into long span prestressed concrete girder bridge construction control.

articleTitle: Time lag effect in forecasting the amount of construction land
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper starts with the geographical lag effect, and then demonstrates the limitation of traditional methods about the forecasting of construction land. Through adopting the related software to verify unary regression and multiple regressions in non lag, one year lag, two year lag and three year lag conditions, and see the other social and economic and casual factors as stochastic disturbance. So we can exclude the worse test value conditions, which reflect the degree of lag and its state. This research used the construction land and social and economic data of Huangpi district, Wuhan City from 1987 to 2004 to analyze the lag effect in land forecast. The experiment result shows us the construction land lags the social and economic development level, which actually existing objectively. We should consider the influence coming from time lag effect when we forecast the amount of construction land. The research area' amount of construction land lag social and economic level approximately 1-2 years. The forecast result which is under lag effect eliminates the bad effects more.

articleTitle: A review on remediation of uranium-contanated environment
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A mass of uranium moved into environment due to action of uranium mining and milling, nuclear power manufacture, fuel fabrication and storage of used fuel. Remediation of uranium contamination has become a hot topic with its hazard to ecosystem increasing. Researches on remediation of uranium-contanated environment were reviewed with special focus on chemical-biochemical precipitation remediation method, oxidation-reduce remediation method, and phytoremediation methode, which have attract a lot of interest. The disadvantage of these remediation methods, and more promising methods in practice was pointed.

articleTitle: Effectivencess evaluation of artillery based on grey target theory
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Method of artillery effectiveness valuation was introduced. According to the theory of grey systems, the patterns of alternative schemes are formed with the fourteen performance indices, which reflect the artillery effectiveness best, and the standard mode of these index series is derived according to the grey target theory. The weighting of every indices was determined by Shannon information entropy, thereby the calculation formula of approaching degree was updated. The good or bad effectiveness of artillery effectiveness can be distinguished by solving the approaching degree of patterns for their standard ones and making the queue of approaching degrees in the light of their values. It is found from the evaluation of three artilleries of 122mm that the method gives the same conclusion as that from conventional method and. Therefore, the method is proved to be valid.

articleTitle: Electronic cash protocol with anonymity withdrawal under a third party supervision
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Attributes of an electronic cash system which is brought up in paper are analyzed. The system based on limited blind signature is pointed out that it isn't satisfied with atomicity. At the same time this system also doesn't meet the fair anonymity in some degree. These defects are improved by imposing a trustable third trust part(TTP)to control the whole transaction. Then a new electronic cash protocol is brought up. And a signed user's identity information is embedded by TTP in cash, thus user's anonymity will be withdrawn by TTP when he breaks the law. So the safety of transaction is ensured.

articleTitle: Study on the technology of quadric surface extracting base on least square method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper studies quadric surface extracting direct focus on scattered points clouds data. Firstly, the points clouds data of single style are distinguished from curved surface. Then, using the geometric parameter equation of the different style quadric surface, the technology of quadric surface extracting base on least square method have been implemented. The study results show that the computational accuracy of linear least square method is highest for the normal data or few noise data, and the computational accuracy of nolinear least squares method is lowest, but the computing power of the nolinear least squares method must be higher than the linear least squares method. The least squares method is sensitive to the noise data, along with the noise data increases, the precision of extracting result could come under certain influence, but the computing power is high. The research result have important guiding sense to apply the least squares method to extract quadratic surface technology for actual project application.

articleTitle: Effect of irrigation and fertilization methods on yield and fruit quality of film-mulched watermelon in greenhouse
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To probe appropriate methods of irrigation and fertilization for film-mulched watermelon in greenhouse, an experiment was conducted with 3 treatments to compare the growth, the use of irrigation water and fertilizers, fruit yield and quality of watermelon. These 3 treaments were border irrigation & water-flush fertilization(BF), drip fertigation(DF) and micro-sprinkling hose fetigation(MF). The results showed that (1) DF and MF treatments accelerated the growth of seedling during the stage of Fruit setting and harvest end compared with BF treatment; (2) DF and MF treatments used much less irrigation water and fertilizers amount and keeped high yield, then increased WUE by 65.41% and 61.63%, raised PEP<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">N</sub> by 45.43% and 42.10%, respectively; (3) moreover,the quality of watermelon fruit was improved with greatly increased content of Vc and soluble sugar.

articleTitle: Research on correlation of sudden failure of aircraft with human-machine-environment
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Research on the correlation of the sudden failure of aircraft with the human-machine-environment has important meaning to know the sudden failure mechanism of aircraft and reduce or eliminate the disaster accidents. In this paper, the feature on sudden failure of aircraft, the forming reason of sudden failure, the spreading way of sudden failure and correlation on sudden failure of aircraft with human-machine environment are researched. At the same time, the relationship model on sudden failure of aircraft with human-machine environment is established, and monitoring module on aero engine in-flight shutdown is designed and it is simulated. Results show that sudden failure of aircraft is a synthetic action result on various factors with human-machine-environment, and it has an evolvement process from gradient to catastrophe and from slight to abrupt. If only the evolvement information of sudden failure can be caught in time and the correspondent measure can be adopted, the emergent fault may prevent and disastrous trouble may reduce.

articleTitle: Investigate display means and spatial strategy of cultural heritage in Ruins Park
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The Ruins Park in the protection of cultural heritage content is experiencing physical form by the change to non-material form, and a corresponding shift in the display means of cultural heritage along, the article attempts to explore new display techniques and three spatial strategy of the cultural heritage under the influence of Ideological trend to provide a reference for the future.

articleTitle: Application research of urban traffic pattern decision-making to the medium-sized & small cities in Anhui province based on fuzzy clustering method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Aimed at the medium-sized & small urban traffic development pattern in Anhui province,Firstly,the authors classify quantitatively the 17 cities in Anhui province based on fuzzy clustering method,then selecting the metropolitan, large urban,medium-sized city,small city in Anhui province; Secondly, study on emphatically the medium-sized & small urban traffic development pattern in Anhui province, also put forward some related recommendation so as to be consulted.

articleTitle: The erosion hazards of red soil platform coast of Fujian province and its mechanism
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The distribution of red soil platform mainly located in the south of Minjiang River and the Pingtan Island in Fujian province and appears in NE-SW strike. The erosion statuses of typical red soil platform coast in Pingtan Island, Xinghua Bay, Meizhou Bay and Quanzhou Bay have been introduced. The erosion mechanism and causes have been studied. And several recommendations have been made on the prevention of red soil platform coast erosion.

articleTitle: A framework of early warning and emergency systems for highway natural disasters
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The recent frequency of major geological disasters caused major concern about the construction of systems for early warning and emergency for highway natural hazards. This paper presents a conceptual framework of such a system based on remote sensing technology through aerospace, aviation and ground monitoring. The system consists of three main components: highway geological disasters sub-system, highway meteorological and hydrological disasters sub-system, and highway ecological environment disasters sub-system.

articleTitle: On M-type fuzzy controller and simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to the characteristic of PID control and fuzzy controller, M-type fuzzy controller is proposed in this paper. This controller is essentially one kind of three-dimensional fuzzy controller with adjustment factors and better than the traditional three-dimensional fuzzy controller. The problems of overfull dimension numbers are avoided when designing three-dimensional fuzzy controller. Simultaneously for the use of the accumulation, which carries on the integral to the deviation, M-type fuzzy controller can eliminate the static difference of system and increases system's stable state precision. Dynamic system simulation proves the superiority of the M-type fuzzy controller.

articleTitle: Study on green business process management system of small and medium real estate enterprise
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This text analyses the present management of small and medium real estate enterprise, puts forth that green business process management is key guarantee of low-carbon age of real estate enterprise, amplifies closed-loop green business process management system of taking new technology and new material as catalyst, regarding customer as the centre, taking low-carbon as object.

articleTitle: Research on manufacturing of a new bevel gear based on the three-axis CNC bevel gear machine
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the Free-form CNC bevel gear milling machine, the module of generated tooth surface was built, which was expressed by the functions of the rotary angle of work-piece gear, and the manufacturing theory about a new type of bevel gear was researched, which made a meaningful searching in the fields.

articleTitle: Exploration and innovation of the construction for automobile structure
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: “Automobile Structure” was an important course for the kind of automobile majors. Through questionnaire surveys, it summed up the traits in the construction of “Automobile Structure” course, and analysis the major problems. Combining with the needs of Quality Project, it brought out strategies in teaching methods, practice, examination and so on, the above provides references for carrying out Quality Project effectively.

articleTitle: Technique to deal with the frequency dependent character of viscoelastic material basing on ANSYS modal analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: It is always difficult to model the viscoelastic damping material accurately in a dynamics analysis, because the frequency has great influences on characters of the viscoelastic damping materials. This paper presents an iteration control program based on QR damping modal extraction method in ANSYS for calculating the structure modal damping ratio more accurately.

articleTitle: Environmental impact of lighting project on wetland on the edge of the city
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Due to rapid urbanization explanation and damaging human activities, the wetland resources in China have been destroyed and polluted widely and terribly, especially the wetland on the edge of the city. The illuminating engineering is one of the pollutants. At present, there is no rational evaluation system in lighting field can provide a set of methods to estimate environmental impact of lighting project on wetland on the edge of the city. This article indicates the necessity of estimating the influence of the lighting project on the wetland on the edge of the city, and provides the approach and frame based on the protection of diversity of ecosystem.

Author Keywords: wetland on the edge of the city

articleTitle: Land consolidation environmental influence retrospective evaluation of Guangxi
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper had the retrospective assessment of land consolidation project implementation ecological effects in Guangxi for the past few years. Firstly this paper summarized the differences of implementation situation of land arrangements, including the land smooth, the land development and land reclamation, simultaneously drew the spatial distribution of the situation. Then, typical cases had been analysed with natural landscape and environmental indexes, and the method of value evaluation in ecosystem service. To overcome those adverse impacts of ecological, the paper gave some advises on ecology protection and construction.

articleTitle: A new measurement of high-frequency voltage
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Generally, a special device is required for high frequency voltage measurement. This paper is to introduce a simple new device for the measurement which can be applied to exactly measure the comparatively low high-frequency voltage and any high-frequency voltage of any wave shape even when there is not a special device.

articleTitle: Error sources analysis and optimizing for online detection system of automobile air flowmeter
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the basic working principle of the system were introduced, affecting the test results of the error factors are analyzed and corresponding optimizing programs were proposed. By comparing the experimental data before and after Optimizing, it was found that, after optimizing, flow control accuracy and stability of the system has been further improved, the system's error detection accuracy and stability of the repeatability have got more obvious improvement.

articleTitle: A study on the POD curve and initial crack size of steel truss bridge
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Full-scale Tests of steel truss bridge components are made to study the effect of paint, the inspectors and testing process on the results of fatigue crack detection, for the uncertainty and omission existing in measured flaw size. The POD (probability of detection) curve is provided for the flaw detection in steel-truss bridges, the reliability model obtaining initial flaw size is established, which takes the POD curve and inspection deviations into account, and the formula provided can be used to evaluate the initial flaw size when predicting the residual life of steel truss bridge applying damage tolerance method.

articleTitle: CAD/CAE application in centering EDM machine design
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The centering EDM machine can be completed online centering hole processing. Traveling by the high speed line feed mechanism, low speed line feed mechanism, rotating body, lifting body, auto body for baseball, Swing components, such as buffer baffle. The advantage of this approach is: a small device, processing consistency, and efficient processing, process automation, and effective in the elimination round billet rolling wear puncher into a capillary formed by the iron handle. In order to design the machine, the CAD/CAE technology, basing on the conception of global structure, dwelling on selecting motor, 3D modeling with solidworks, dynamic simulation with cosmosmotion, and analysis the key parts using finite element method were presented.

articleTitle: Study of working properties of pile with branch plates based on Abaqus
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the Abaqus software, the working properties of pile with branch plates were studied. To solve this problem and considering the no-linear contact between pile and soil, elastic-plastic of soil, initial stress state. The results show that the axial force of pile body had mutations at upper and lower of the branch plates, when the pile with branch plates bearing capacity to the limit, the lower slope of branch plate bore great contact pressure, the upper slope of branch plate and soil produced a separate, the plastic strain occurred in the bottom of the branch plate and the pile body.

articleTitle: Control for the lateral vibration of footbridges induced by pedestrians
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a nonlinear analysis for the motion of equations proposed by Nakamura [8] to predict the lateral vibration induced by pedestrians on footbridges, in which the influence of crowd on the footbridge is considered as a velocity feedback with a time delay to it. The relationship between the lateral vibration of footbridge and the coefficients in Nakamura's model, including the rate of a pedestrian's lateral force, pedestrian density, rate of synchronized pedestrians, and pedestrians' attitude to large vibration amplitude, is revealed. The influence of time delay on the dynamics of the footbridge is discussed. Our results show that time delay always prevents the lateral vibration of the footbridge, which is demonstrated by the numerical simulations.

articleTitle: The general MIPML absorbing boundary condition for frequency-dispersive media in FDTD analyses
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Material independent perfectly matched layer (MIPML) is extended to the case of dispersive media, the impedance matched condition and the reflectionless conditions are proved at the same time. The setting and calculating methods of the general MIPML absorbing boundary for frequency-dispersive media is given by combining MIPML with Shift Operator Finite-Difference Time-Domain method. The characteristics of our absorbing boundary condition are tested. The computed results illustrated the generality and the feasibility of the scheme.

articleTitle: The application and research about P control chart in leak detection process
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Considering leak detection process, dynamic quality control is implementation by using P control chart. Quality management mode that predicts, controls and improves the quality of production is established by rejecting assignable causes immediately and obtaining in-control status. The effectiveness has been proved by theory and practice: P control chart is a monitoring windows for company leaders and quality management personnel, and this is beneficial to optimizing production conditions and improving the product quality.

articleTitle: Cellular automation method on analysis of temperature field for milling insert with wave-edge
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: For the sake of solving calculating problem of unsteady temperature field on the milling insert during milling, the temperature field evolution rule and analytic method based on principle of cellular automation (CA) was put forward. The local rule of cellular automation for temperature field of milling insert was deduced and the model of cellular automation was built according to heat transfer theory and finite difference method. The boundary problem was dealt with availably. The numerical-value result of temperature field was obtained by temperature field analysis based on principle of cellular automation. By comparing with the result of finite element method (FEM) analysis, the effectiveness of this method was testified. The analytic method and thought of temperature field based on principle of cellular automation have provided an analytic way with flexibility for the structural design of milling insert under the coupling action of force field and heat field.

articleTitle: The operational ways to preserve traditional block in growing city
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of urbanization, how to deal with the historical buildings has been a general issue. The key is to well treat the balance between the development and reservation, and the balance between the shape and the functionality while keeping the original scenario. A complete series of preservation measures should be established and implemented so that an elegant, harmonious and highly efficient city can be achieved. This paper takes the Xiaohezhi Street as an example. The detailed protection methods have been discussed in terms of the plan and design of the preservation of the historical building.

articleTitle: Research on order tracking and Teager-Huang transform based gear crack fault diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The order tracking technique and Teager-Huang transform (THT) approach are presented and applied effectively to gearbox fault diagnosis during run-up. This new approach is based on order tracking and Teager-Huang transform technique. The angle domain stationary signal is first obtained by resampling of the vibration signal that has been sampled in the time domain. Then the angle domain signal is decomposed in intrinsic oscillation modes, using Empirical Mode Decomposition (EMD). Thirdly, the Teager Kaiser Energy Operator (TKEO) technique is applied to each intrinsic mode function (IMF). The TKEO can track the modulation energy and estimate the instantaneous amplitude and instantaneous frequency. In the end, the time-frequency distribution can be obtained. Therefore, the character of the gear faults can be recognized according to the time-frequency distribution. The experimental results show that order tracking and Teager-Huang transform can effectively diagnose the faults of gear crack.

articleTitle: Calculation of additional pollutant gas emissions and their social cost from transport congestion
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As main part of the external benefit of urban transport congestion, the disposal cost of additional pollutant gases from motor vehicle grows sharply with urban transport congestion getting worse. Based on the definition research scope, this paper presented the emission factors of pollutant gases under congestion situation, and established congestion related additional pollutant gas emission calculation model. Using the model, taking one metropolitan in Northern China, combining with the statistical data including miles travelled by the motor vehicles in 2009, emission volumes of the three main pollutant gases containing CO, NO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> and HC were calculated. And also, the social cost of disposing these pollutant gases was estimated. The work done in this paper can be used as reference in treating traffic congestion and transport related environment pollution for decision making sections.

articleTitle: Visual evaluation system for straightness error based on LabVIEW
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Because of exiting inefficient and incomplete functional problems in traditional straightness error evaluation, Error measure and evaluation system based on virtual instrument was designed. Two endpoint link line, least-squares algorithm and minimum zone algorithm methods for evaluation straightness error were programmed by means of LabVIEW8.5, the corresponding data processing algorithms and program charts were given. Through experiments the validity of this software was proved, This software can realize visual evaluation.

articleTitle: A study on the park utilization status and park user's behavioral characteristics a case of Shanghai Zhongshan park
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper analyses park utilization status through Person investigation and aims to classify these complex characteristics into types by cluster. we divide into seven types and explain this type characteristics.

articleTitle: The implementation of GLOBE based WMS
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: People get a great deal of geographic information from multifarious sensor. These data have different format and distributing place. As a result, they can't be integrated seamlessly. For fully use of these data, take World Wind WMS and World Wind JAVA as the web server and client side, take GLOBE and NASA's Blue marble as the elevation data and terrain texture, create three dimension elevation model, which would provide reference for the integration of multi-source data with WMS.

articleTitle: Research on green life cycle of mechanical product based on environment and resource
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The concept of green product is introduced. Green technologies of mechanical product in life cycle are researched in green design, green manufactory, green maintenance and green handle. The content, features, key technologies, quota evaluate system, idea and tactics of green product are discussed.

articleTitle: Closed-loop data flow in CAX chains and application
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The mind of closed-loop data flow in CAD/CAM/CNC chains are presents in this paper, it was used in automatic programming system based on customization of AutoCAD for CNC lathe which have double tool carriers. The way of closed loop data flow in CAD/CAM/CNC chains and it's implement method are analyzed in detail.

articleTitle: Experiment study on beam-column joints strengthened by gluing steels
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This thesis introduces detailed the experiment of beam-column joints strengthened by gluing steels suffered low frequency cyclic load about the experiment design, the experiment process and results. Through analyzing the failure forms, hysteretic curves and the strain of bars, concrete and steels of four full-scale samples, we draws the conclusion of the bonding steels have improved the carrying capacity and the ductility of joints sticky-steel.

articleTitle: A study of using Fenton-like to enhance mass transfer during deep oxidative desulfurization
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The oxidative desulfurization of model diesel fuel via H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>-HCOOH by Ultrasonic oxidation and changing stirring speed was studied, and comparing the results of two different ways. The results showed Ultrasonic frequency is 28KHz, ultrasonic power is 800W, water bath and standard atmospheric pressure, V (Diesel) / V (H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>O<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) / V (HCOOH) = 50:1:10, ultrasonic-assisted oxidation for half an hour, the desulfurization rate can reach 98%; after reacting for 1.5h, the desulfurization efficiency can be 98%, when reacting at 40°C, atmospheric pressure and Stirring speed at 1000 rpm. By comparing the results of two methods reacting for 0.5h, ultrasonic desulfurization is better than Stirring speed 1000 rpm in a short time, but in general there is no significant advantage.

articleTitle: Research of modular machine tool design system rapidly base Group Technology
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The paper brings forward primary principle and design method for mechanical products based Group Technology. The method is practiced in modular machine tool rapid design. It applies GT to 3D design of products. Parts and components of products are sorted and formed design families according as criterion of draw out design comparability. Example models are build for different design families. These example models can collect all function factors of the design families. The models can be deal with enterprise criterion. Example stocks of 3D models with GT codes are build. New design can create after the stocks are searched and edit by designer. The way can enhance efficiency and quality.

articleTitle: Research on refining algorithm of information with equality constraints
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: An algorithm to refine the information with equality constraints, based on the theories of parameter adjustment with conditions and generalized adjustment, is proposed in this paper. With our algorithm, for given vector estimation, covariance matrix and the corresponding equality constraints, more accurate estimation and covariance matrix of the vectors can be obtained after simple matrix operation. As shown in the numerical calculation, our algorithm is simple and easy to perform and the results are reliable.

articleTitle: A simple method of measuring for building-shielding-efficiency
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to the analyses and understand of the character of lightning current, we designed the testing method to measure the building's shielding efficiency by the exist equipments.

articleTitle: Amplitude-comparison monolulse for CWRadar low-altitude target elevation off-line measurement
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Phase-comparison monolulse was adopted in CWradar system,In the presence of sea-surface multi-path CW radar measure a low elevation target is difficulty, and its precision can't satisfy the requirement of ballistic trajectory measurement in shooting range. The bias compensation algorithm of Amplitude-comparison monopulse had been calculated the elevation of low-altitude after measurement from the deposited video frequency signal by the CWradar system. The results indicate this method is effective and feasible in the off-line elevation extraction and it can improve the precision of elevation measurement.

articleTitle: Finite element analysis of large mirror based contact theory
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper describe the finite element analysis of large mirror based on contact theory. After several modules' computing author compared the calculated Result and test result, and make a conclusion that contact analyzing is more accurate than linear analysis for large mirror.

articleTitle: Fuzzy control and simulation for double inverted pendulum based on information fusion technology
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, through mathematic model for double inverted pendulum is built and analyzed, linear control technology is integrated with fuzzy control technology based on information fusion technology. On the one hand, design method using linear control technology and experience data are referenced for design of fuzzy controller. On the other hand, using robust of fuzzy control technology improves control quality, so as to simplify design process for controller of nonlinear, coupling, variable and natural unsteadiness system, and to realize fuzzy control for double inverted pendulum and achieve good output characters. The simulation results show that the method is effective and available.

articleTitle: The research and strategy on urban public transportation with game theory
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: From the economy attribute of urban public transportation service, the text analyzes the relationship between the service supply and public goods property. And it uses the game theory to discus that the urban public transportation service may be facing the supply shortage and the resource abuse, and find out the solution. Combining the current situation of the supply of urban public transportation service, some countermeasures and suggestions are put forward.

articleTitle: A study on failure model and mechanism of SFRC torsion member
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the torsional tests to steel fiber concrete structures of different fiber volume fraction, this article did an analysis of the effect to failure model samples with different volume of steel fiber, and explored the incorporation of the torsion mechanism in the failure steel fiber. The tests results showed that: The incorporation of the steel of fiber significantly improved the mechanical properties of the steel fiber concrete, and it can reinforce limits of the torsion component cracking and ultimate torque.

articleTitle: The improvement of side-scan sonar's towfish
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Since our first side-scan sonar was used more than twenty years. With more and more users and the using times grown up, We found something was not very convenient during using. So we have made some change in the design along with the users experience. This article introduce the improvement of the side-scan sonar's towfish.

articleTitle: Computerized design and simulation of a high-ratio compound gearing
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A novel high-ratio compound gearing which combines the worm gearing with Spiroid gearing is proposed. It is a type of spatial planetary worm gearing, and consists of the centre worm, planetary gear sets, the planetary carrier and the face worm gear. The construction figures of the compound gearing are given, and the design simulation based on SolidWorks is done in the paper. The new gearing can be considered to be used in communication, aerospace, military field, heavy-duty machines, industry automation and other civil machinery.

articleTitle: Optimizations of contract incentives and duration for construction programme management
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Considering expected operating income, opportunity income, reputation income and others, a Steckelberg decision model was formed from the double viewpoints of the programme owners and multi-contractor. In the model, contract incentives and duration of construction programme were optimized by searching Nash equilibrium. Finally, a case is computed to verify effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: Contact boundary of vibrating rotary forging deformation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As complexity of vibrating rotary forging kinematic relation and its deforming process, contact boundary ascertained was function as analyzing deformation during the rotary forging. According to formative geometrical contact area shape between rotary die and workpiece, the contact boundary was divided into original area and additional area, a geometrical resolution boundary of rotary forging contact area was built by separated computing the two parts area. Then a simulation contact boundary was gained by MATLAB, and the simulation result is well consistence with practical boundary, and these study can provide premise conditions for the vibrating rotary forging deformation process numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Estimating parameters of modified upgrade version three-parameters NHPP model
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Ohba NHPP models are wide used to discuss the software reliability. Xie Min presented a new three-parameters NHPP model about upgrade version. We modify the model, present the necessary & sufficient conditions for the likelihood estimates to be finite, positive, and unique. Results are given for ungrouped failure data, and apply these results to original Ohba model easily.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of teaching 《 The programming and processing of part 》 (NC)
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By analyzing the training objectives of CNC technology professionals, We determine the core position of the courses in the professional. In this thesis, We introduce a new model of teaching in curriculum reform. Give the ideas and basis of project settings. Describe the teaching process of task-driven new model and the results achieved with Six-step teaching program.

articleTitle: A structured model for natural soft clay
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Natural soft clays in geotechnical engineering always show some structured behaviors, which are characterized by the softening stress-strain relationship.
