However, the Modified Camclay model, which is built on the basis of remolded soils, cannot capture such kind of structured characteristics. Two parameters of the Modified Camclay model are modified due to the difference between the slopes of the one dimensional compression curve and the failure line of natural structured soft clay and those of remolded soft clay. Changing laws of both the slope of the one-dimensional compression curve and the slope of the failure line is proposed to improve the Modified Camclay model to be able to simulate the softening stress-strain relationship of natural structured soft clay. This improved model is proved to be able to capture the structured behaviors of natural soft clay well by the comparisons between the simulation curves and the experimental curves of the triaxial tests on natural Osaka clay and Bothkennar clay.

articleTitle: Phase-out factor with particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A brief discussion of PSO from 1995 to the development process, analysis of the particle swarm algorithm improvement strategy, the paper used by introducing a phase-out factor, proposed a new particle swarm out strategy, forming a WPSO law, and with the traditional PSO was compared using the optimization function experiments to compare the results show that, WPSO value in the optimization better than the PSO.

articleTitle: Application of ecological retaining wall in slope engineering
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The ecological construction, environmental protection and energy conservation of modern slope engineering are concerned. Through the analysis and comparison of traditional and new retaining wall in slope engineering, the author proposes that new technological retaining wall should have multifunction, and can reflect ecological ideas and green tendency. Then the technological characteristics and advantages of ecological retaining wall are explained and analyzed. Lastly the investigation of ecological retaining wall in applied engineering is supplied.

articleTitle: AGV trajectory track using nonlinear model predictive
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Automated guided vehicle (AGV) system is widely used in manufacturing industry, port and dock as a material conveying robot in logistics system. AGV is flexible and intellectualized. But there are many factors make error during AGV implementing given route. This paper applies predictive control theory to solve implement control problem. A proportional integral gain self-adaptive regulator is designed. With the implement controller, AGV can perform given route well.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of entropy generation of externally sweeping across tube hanks
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Using heat and flow governing equation, taking forced-convection heat transfer of in-line hank of tubes as research object, the paper analyzed the entropy generation distribution and discussed the entropy generation's changing relationship with the Re from 1.0×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> to 10×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup> and the S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>/d (S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/d) from 1.25 to 2.0. The results indicated that: the entropy generation mainly generated near the surface of the hank of tubes; The area weighted average equation varies with Re in exponent function, and Re is the major impact factor of equation with increase of Re, The area weighted average of Irreversible entropy generation flow equation diminished. The proportion of the area weighted average of heat transfer entropy generation equation in equation rising rapidly, when Re > 4.0×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sup>, the heat and entropy production can be ignored.

articleTitle: Research on prestressed CFRP alarm sensors
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the development of the society, structure health monitoring has become a hot research topic. In order to detect the damages located at the position where the displacement mode is unsensitive, the alarm sensors are developed. In this paper, prestressed CFRP alarm sensors have been manufactured and tested, which utilized the electrical conductive capability and piezoresistive capability of CFRP to monitor the structure status. The experiments show that prestressed CFRP alarm sensors are more sensitive in the low strain region, as they are able to reduce the strain when the electrical resistance abrupt changed.

articleTitle: A variational inequality model for supply chain
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Various types of supply chain model mainly concerns the profit of manufacturers, suppliers and customers. The manufacturers as well as the distributors are assumed to be multicriteria decision-makers and concerned not only with profit maximization but also with risk minimization. A variational inequality of the supply chain model is provided, and the validity of the model is proved, the algorithm of the variational inequality is provided. Data experiments illustrate the effect of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Optimization of resources-constrained schedule for programme based on critical chain
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Optimization of resource and schedule is important to programme management. The Optimization model of resource and schedule for resources-constrained programme is formed based on critical chain, and the corresponding genetic algorithms is designed for the model. In the model, Logical relations between projects and activities, relations between multi-mode execution of activity and allotted resources are considered. Finally, a case is computed to verify effectiveness of the model and feasibility of the solution method.

articleTitle: Gap status identification and control of wire electrochemical micromachining
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Wrie electrochemical micromachining (WEMM) is an electrochemical dissolution micro process using a micro wire electrode. The process can remove electrically conductive materials with the transferring of ions, so that high precision is achievable. The short-circuit worsened the machining stability. The two types of short-circuit in WEMM: clogging short-circuit and unavoidable short-circuit was analyzed, and the gap status in WEMM was identificated. The method of punitive function was used to optimize the velocity of feed forward, and the strategy of servo-control system were designed. The experiment shows that the method of gap control can improve the mahining stability.

articleTitle: The research of Lightning Protect for aerocraft electro-equipments
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The safety of the aircraft severely affected by lightning, lightning protection is the electro-equipment of aircraft need to be resolved a problem. In this paper,based on the the lightning induced transient susceptibility requirements of RATC/DO-160F, lightning induced pin injection test as an example, introduced the product interface circuit protection method. According to the signal characteristics of the signal transmission line and lightning induction test level, select the appropriate lightning protection devices; for the circuit's input and output ports, using a variety of protection circuits, the effectiveness of the protection circuit verified by comparing simulation and experiment result.

articleTitle: On the application of spatial information technologies for highway environmental protection
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper reviews the theory and application of spatial information technologies for highway environment protection. More specifically, this paper focuses on the following four areas based on the spatial information technologies: monitoring and supervision of highway environment, integrated management and evaluation of highway environment, simulation and emulation of highway environment, monitoring and early warning of highway environment.

articleTitle: Construction of the vehicle maintenance material precision support model
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to meet the needs of vehicle maintenance material precision support in the right moment, at the right place and in the appropriate amount, the thesis sets up three dynamic models which include the time-model, the Carrying-capacity-model and the Comprehensive-model, also buildes algorithm of these models. In this way, the assistant-decision basises of vehicle maintenance material precision support can be produred and provided.

articleTitle: Participatory community planning approach in reconstruction of urban and rural communities
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the analysis of the importance and necessarity of public participation, this paper recommend to combine urban planning with community planning, using participatory community planning approach to encourage the organized participation of community inhabitants and to improve their living conditions. The action process of participatory community planning and policy suggestions have been analyzed and discussed in details.

articleTitle: Experimental Studies on the shear behavior of the PU material in the concrete's slot
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Experimental studies on the shear capacity of the adhesion by the water-soluble polyurethane and concrete slot, which gets the relationship between vertical stress and shear stress. According to the sample, analyzed the patterns of damage and provided a reference for the actual and theoretical foundation, and solved the main Faced Rock-fill Dam of the slot (Peripheral joint, Expansion joint).

articleTitle: Experiment and analysis of the biological filter by falling water aeration
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Experiments of of the biological filter by falling water aeration show that the removal rate of CODcr is 66.9%, of NH<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>-N is 64.5%, of TP is 48%.The ideal effect can be obtained if the water is 100% circulation processing. Combination process around the core that is biological filter by falling water aeration should be good for mountain town water pollution control by this paper.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis on fault identification of structure by magnetic impedance analysis method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The strategy and application of urban design in Paris
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the understanding and awareness of urban design in Paris, this paper summarized the main strategy of urban design in Paris. Though the analysis of the left bank area, we further examined the application of these design strategies. We hope our research can play a reference role in the current urban design study.

articleTitle: Precision analysis and simulation research on control system of ballistic missile
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces the simulation method of the ballistic missile control system for precision analysis, analyzes the influence mechanism of the ballistic missile control system error on the missiles's impact point, constructs simulation model to control the system accuracy, and on the basis carries out the simulation calculation of the model and analyzes the result.

articleTitle: Analizing the effect of high-speed railway on urban and regional development
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the three spatial impacts, such as polarization effects, complementary effects and networking effects which high-speed railway brings to urban and regional development. In the meantime, the impact mechanism is explored based on the development stage of high-speed railway. In the end, urban and regional development policies are put forward under the circumstance of Chinese high-speed railway times.

articleTitle: Study on the Forming condition of human debris flows and its prevention
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: More and more debris flows were caused by human activities. Firstly its definition of human debris flows was set up, the correlation between the two objects was analyzed. It think that human activities destroy the ecological environment so that had effect on the Forming condition and the development of the human debris flows through the following three ways: changing the natural terrain, providing loose solid materials and hydrodynamic. In the end some prevention measures were put forward on the basis of the control status of the debris flows.

articleTitle: The study of targeting location of Qiqihar Nianzishan District tourism planning based on grounded theory
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The targeting location is the premise and basis of urban tourism plan. It's accuracy and science directly affects the further development of tourism planning, this paper used grounded theory methods and made a careful record and collated of the information about the Qiqihar Nianzishan District. Finally, this article proposes the its tourism planning 's targeting location and proved that it is correct by verifying basic information.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation research in soft rock mine of goaf caving height
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: After long-term sedimentary structure effect, the coal face roof rock itself appeares various fractures and after mining the coal, owing to mine pressure appeared, part of goaf overburden rock gradually become distortion,delamination even fall. Due to the collapse of roofs, formation of air disasters are related to the caving height. Therefore, study the caving height is a key factor of realizing mine safe and effective production. This paper bases on the background of One Mine, using UDEC to study 5-3s soft rock mine working face of goaf caving height, first weighting interval and cycle weighting interval. By analyzing the simulation results, it reflects the relationship between advancing degree of working face and the goaf caving height. The conclusion provides a reference for resolving the problem of mine roof collapse in similar mine.

articleTitle: Inversion and virtual assembly of topological unit
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Topological graph based on the functional fractionation was analyzed, proposed the theory of topologic graph map, and the graphics information extraction work was realized by computer. Analyzed the inversion method about basic unit of topological graph, the inversion maps' library were showed. By using the software of visual basic 6.0, developed a human-computer interaction interface for basic unit. The epicyclic gear trains' virtual assembly works were finally achieved.

articleTitle: An improved control method of maximum power point tracking of photovoltaic system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Photovoltaic cells has a unique maximum power point under given condition of certain environment temperature and sunshine intensity. The paper first analyzes the advantages and disadvantages of traditional mountain climbing and three dots algorithm, then proposes a varied step size three dots mountain climbing algorithm based on the two, and simulates them by MATLAB. The results shows that this algorithm can effectively over come the disadvantages of the two control algorithms with better dynamic performance and steady precision.

articleTitle: Simulative analysis of the influence on metro dynamic response by track curve radius
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Curve radius is one of the most remarkable factors that take effects on the travelling comfort and safety of urban rail transit metro. The article , on the basis of the measured data by track inspection car from the 3.rd line of Shanghai urban rail transit, taking superelevation, track irregularity and velocity of metro from different sectors who have distinct curve radiuses for consideration, compares and analyzes the influence on metro dynamic response by track curve radiuses by establishing and confirming ADAMS simulative metro model, which may provide certain references to relevant track design and maintenance departments.

articleTitle: Study on the tension in the geomembrane due to compaction work
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The simulation experiment and analysis were conducted to evaluate the tension in the geomembrane which was installed on the bottom and side slope of a waste landfill. Firstly, the friction angle and adhesion were obtained between non-woven geotextile and sand, HDPE geomembrane by direct shear experiments. Secondly, the tension in the geomembrane was measured by filling in the small landfill. The results showed the tension in the geomembrane became larger with the increase of the height of sand. The tension in the geomembrane are analyzed by the limit equilibrium and FEM, the calculation by the limit equilibrium are far larger than the experimental values; the calculation by the FEM are as similar as the experimental values.

articleTitle: The design of the emperature and humidity supervisory monitor system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This design based on SOPC platform which uses Nios II embedded processor. The design of hardware system is responsible fur addition of IP core and configuration of FPGA. The design of software system implements drivers and application program. Temperature and humidity control system consists of sensors, transistors and transmission of three parts. The system sensor module Mega8 data collection, through the host controller reads the Mega8 collected information.

articleTitle: The FEM analysis of sliding column for inverted turning and milling machining center
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper uses three-dimensional design software PRO/E to create the model of the sliding column, and then carries on static analysis and modal analysis for the sliding column, which includes the ribs or not, in the ANSYS software. The deformations, the vibration frequencies and the amplitudes of the sliding column model in two states are obtained. By comparison of these results in two states, the theoretical basis how the ribs strengthen the sliding column are generalized.

articleTitle: Coal seam hard roof deep hole blasting relief technology and optimization
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Blasting pressure release of roof deep hole in the fully-mechanized face interconnection can shorten the first collapse step distance of roof, to avoid rock burst disasters that may caused a large area of roof collapse. Based on the actual geological condition of 6303 working face interconnection in Jining No.3 Coal Mine, from the rock blasting mechanism, this article proposes the two schemes of blasting pressure release of roof interconnection. By using of Ansys-dyna finite dynamic analysis software, this paper simulates blasting effect to the two schemes of deep hole blasting. With the analysis of numerical simulation results, we achieve parameter optimization and obtain the best blasting scheme.

articleTitle: The study of parameters in the construction technology of Lime-treated expansive soils
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Expansive soil is high plastic clay that has properties of dilatability, much fissure and over consolidation, which mainly consists of montmorillonite that is a strongly hydrophilic clay miner and illite. As Chinese territory is vast and wide, there are a lot of expansive soils, especially in the south-eastern coastal areas. And the regional feature virtually constrained the development of our traffic infrastructure construction seriously. Based on subgrade field testing, this paper carry out a deep study on soil moisture content, particle fineness and containing ash rate which are the main control parameters of Lime-treated expansive soil. Results of this study have sound theoretic and practical significance to improve our construction technology of Lime-treated expansive soil.

articleTitle: Study on 3D node location algorithm for wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The wireless sensor network node localization algorithms are studied more and more at present, but most are based on two-dimensional localization algorithm for three dimensional localization of too few. Based on the researches on the classic two-dimensional localization algorithm, and the trilateration was extended to three-dimensional localization algorithm. Error analysis of this algorithm was revealed in the classic two-dimensional and three-dimensional environment, and the node localization error with a linear relationship between average nodes ranging error was found.

articleTitle: Analyses of construction promotion differentiation of grid structure for Swimming and Diving Hall in Qingdao Sports Center
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The Swimming and Diving Hall in Qingdao Sports Center is constructed for the 11th National Games in China. As a complex grid structure with a long-span steel roof, its construction is difficult to control. The pulling haulm to promotion method is employed in the construction of this grid structure. In this paper, the adjacent pulling haulm promotion differences and the ascent of the whole pulling haulm promotion differences for this grid structure in the process of ascension are analyzed using finite element numerical analysis in detail. Research results show that the influences of promotion differences for this type of grid structure's stress are bigger, suggested that the grids adjacent pulling haulm promotion differences should be controlled within 1cm, the whole shell promotion differences should be controlled within 5cm.

articleTitle: An immune based method for harmful network text information discovery
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Inspired from immune sytstem, an immune based method for harmful network text information discovery is presented. In the presented method, the network text informations are treated as antigens, where the lymphocytes are processed as the harmful network text information detectors. The training process of detectors is implemented by simulating the marrow model of human immune system, and the learning ability of detectors is provided by simulating the lifecycle of lymphocytes. Therefore, the harmful network text information detection is thus presented by simulating the immune surveillance of human immune system.

articleTitle: Finite element analysis of a half-through reinforced concrete tied-arch bridge based on FEM program ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Shihe bridge in Xinyang city built in 1997 is a a half through reinforced concrete tied-arch bridge. In order to test and evaluate the loading character, the static and dynamic analysis is performed, the experimental measurement is also performed in January, 2004. In this paper, the structure is analyzed through FEM, the computed result is compared with the measured result. Through the comparison, the conclusion can be drawn that the global strength and rigidity of the bridge can meet the demand of normal use, the loading capacity adds up to the design requirement.

articleTitle: Path stability analysis on shape adjustments for adaptive cable domes
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to reach the optimum shape in adaptive cable domes the paths satisfying geometric stability are essential. Based on the theory of geometric stability for tensegrity structures, a novel approach which can determine geometric stable paths for shape adjustments is presented utilizing the symmetry of the structures. The research manifests more symmetrical planes without joints in during shape adjustments will increase the possibilities of satisfying geometric stability. Furthermore, an example study is performed and the results validate the proposed predictions.

articleTitle: Manufacturing of bionic functional surface based on the replication of biological surface morphology
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Direct replication of biological surface morphology to form bionic functional surface with high precision in morphology and approximation in function is a new attempt on the manufacturing of bionic functional surface directly using natural creatures. The bio-replicated forming was proposed. Taking shark skin as representative of the non-smooth biological surface, and the micro-embossing as the structure transfer method, the large-area replication of the outward morphology on shark skins was demonstrated. Experimental results on replication precision and resistance test in water tunnel indicates that the bio-replicated forming shows good fidelity both in morphology and function, in the direct replication of the low-resistance biological surface morphology.

articleTitle: Analysis of Chinese urban skyline night view's design elements
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the deepening process of Chinese urbanization, it becomes a worthy research topic how to get a night urban skyline view with good effects through design means. The main purpose of this article is to provide some references and ideas for night skyline planning and design by analyzing urban night skyline's design elements.

articleTitle: Prediction of silt soil subgrade moisture content based on unsaturated seepage theory
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to study the distribution of water in silt soil subgrade, this paper establish finite element model based on unsaturated seepage theory to research the groundwater level, rainfall, evaporation factors influencing on the moisture content of subgrade and side slope materials. The results show that: the moisture content of subgrade exponential growth with the water table. Continuous evaporation or rainfall influence the subgrade slope with the depth of 0.2-0.6m; finite element model based on unsaturated seepage theory can predict the water content in subgrade accurately and meet the project construction need.

articleTitle: Study for technics of friction stitch welding
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Friction stitch welding is a kind of new connection technology. It is fall short of 20 years after TWI brought forward the concept. The weld seam of friction stitch welding is composed with a series of FHPP. Shielding gas flux, feed speed, rotation speed, welding pressure, shape of bar and hole, heating temperature are the primary parameters which can influent the welding quality. The molding mechanism of friction stitch welding is different form direct drive friction welding, friction surfacing and inertia drive friction welding. In order to learn the influence of welding parameters for friction stitch welding quality, a series of FHPP and stitch molding experiment have been carried out.

articleTitle: Study on adaptive filtering detection for the rotor bar breaking of 3-phase asynchronous motor
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The number of the bar breaking increases gradually, if we can not detect the bar breaking immediately. It may lead to accidents, and also cause great economic losses when the squirrel cage asynchronous motors have a rotor bar breaking fault. Therefore it is helpful to scence organization, arranging maintenance and avoiding the shutdown if we have early detection for the bar breaking. This article studied the daptive filtering diagnosis of the rotor bar breaking of the squirrel cage asynchronous motors, and carried on the analysis to the LMS adaptive algorithm according to adaptive principle. Finally, it diagnosed and analyzed the rotor bar breaking of the squirrel cage asynchronous motors by the principle of adaptive filtering.

articleTitle: Design of coal blending automation control system for coke-making
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the automated level and measuring precision of coal blending automatic control system for coke-making, a scheme of Distributed Control System(DCS) which is made up of the PLC and configuration software is used in this paper. Its hardware and software platform is introduced and the calibration software based on LabView is designed. The system has features of flexible high-performance, simple operation and stable work. The final test of the entire system meets the requirements.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influence factors for Weigh-in-motion
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The precision of the weigh-in-motion is a very important factor for WIM system in the practice of WIM technology. To improve the precision of WIM, The mathematic model for dynamic weighing technique is established in this paper, followed by WIM practice emphasized in investigating some key factors such as vehicle runs, vehicle speed and temperature to three types of WIM sensors to validate the influence of different behavior to WIM test. Some advices about how to improve the precision are also given. A way to calibrate the mathematic model for WIM system is given in the end of the paper.

articleTitle: Reach on dynamic mechanism of land intensive use for highway construction
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The urgency and the characteristics for Chinese highway construction were discussed. The market mechanism, the government leading mechanism, planning mechanism, public participation mechanism, technology innovation mechanism and evaluation mechanism for land intensive use were researched, then put forward that highway construction land use should paid use according to the market price; the local government should establish the accountability for decision-making behavior in the highway construction; planning the construction scale reasonably, making scheme comparis on land use as the major indexes in the process of highway construction planning; implementing public participation mechanism in the whole process of highway construction; the government should provide policy support and establishing sharing mechanism, promotion land intensive use technology; constructing the evaluation system of economical and intensive land use for land use, to promoting the overall level of Chinese highway construction land use.

articleTitle: Analysis of the reputation effects of construction corporations based on reputation effects model in agent market
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To solve the moral hazard problems arising from the information asymmetry in construction market, analyze the role that the corporate reputation of construction firms can play, and prove it using "Reputation effects model in agent market" in information economics. Then in consideration of the model and the actual situation of the construction market in China, make a further analysis on the key issues to make the reputation effects of construction firms function properly. Some related advice are given in the end.

articleTitle: Study on the wind vibration response of the glass curtain wall considering the turbulent wind
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Due to the applicable installation height, small mass, flexible characteristic, large span, and small damp, the glass curtain wall could easily result in vibration with the wind effect. The main factor is the turbulence among the cause effects. Combining the structural dynamic theory, and considering the characteristic of the glass curtain wall, a wind effect calculation formula is set up considering the turbulent wind that is resulted by the 1st vibration type. Hope to provide some reference for similar designs.

articleTitle: Research on the influence of soft interlayer to composite foundation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The influence of soft interlayer to composite foundation is researched through FEM analysis in the paper. From the result of study, we can see that the soft interlayer is more thick, the stress in the pile of composite foundation is more strong; the soft interlayer can amplify the pile shaft friction resistance; the law of the soft interlayer influence the subsidiary stress in soil between piles is corresponding to the transmit law of the soft interlayer influence the pile shaft friction resistance; the distance between the soft interlayer and the foundation bottom in back-up coat influence the foundation subsidence poorly; the thickness of soft interlayer influence the transformation isoline of composite foundation poorly in depth, but influence obviously in width.

articleTitle: Analysis on periodic response of vertical impact damper system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, motion equation of vertical impact damping system is established. Both parameters domain of stable periodic response and corresponding vibration reducing effect are attained by numerical simulation under pre-assigned excitation parameters and structural parameters. Evolving approach of transition from period doubling bifurcation to chaos of vertical impact damping system is revealed.

articleTitle: Relationship between bed and wall roughness coefficient of uniform flow in smooth flume
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the friction partition theory (Einstein 1942) and affections of breadth depth ratio on roughness(Knight 2002), the relationship between bed and wall roughness coefficient is researched though 28m flume experiment. The measured water level agree with the calculated one which supposed n = n<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">b</inf> = n<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">w</inf>. And it proves that bed roughness coefficient equal to wall roughness coefficient while the rectangle flume is made of same material in acceptable precision.

articleTitle: Research of Energy Optimization Dispatching Model in EMS of iron and steel enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the development of global economy, energy situation has been more and more severe. The shortage of energy will no doubt be one of the bottlenecks, which restricts the social progress. Iron and steel industry is an important energy intensive industry, whose use of energy plays an important role in the national energy situation. Therefore, energy optimization is a serious topic for the iron and steel enterprises. Systematic energy conservation has been becoming one of the most popular measures for iron and steel enterprises, of which EMS is an essential one. Therefore, this paper raises the research of the construction of Optimization Dispatching Model to solve the problem of optimal use of energy, which can achieve the energy saving and environmental protection for the industry.

articleTitle: Research on CAD/CAM technology of high-order elliptical gears
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Aimed at the complexity of non-circular gears design and manufacturing process, according to the principles of gear connection, the pitch curve mathematical model of high-order elliptical gears is established. The pitch curve meshing characteristic and transmission ratio of high-order elliptical gears is calculated and analyzed using MATLAB software. Based on the converting tooth profile method, the gear tooth profile parameterized design, CAD graphics drawing, three-dimensional modeling, machining simulation and CNC programming of high order elliptical gears are studied with CAXA software. The processing experiments using CNC wire-cut machine prove the validity and practicability of the method. This electronic document is a "live" template. The various components of your paper [title, text, heads, etc.] are already defined on the style sheet, as illustrated by the portions given in this document.

articleTitle: Test analysis of metallic material's elasto-plastic properties and macroscopic fracture criterion
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on series of actual tests, such as tension-torsion tests on cast iron, compact tension-shear mixed mode fracture tests on aluminum alloy and routine failure tests on alloy steel, several different fracture modes have been summarized in this paper. For a kind of metallic material, under influences of the material itself, such as crystal boundary, inclusion and second phase participle, along with the descending of the stress triaxiality Rσ several different fracture modes may be emerged in order. These fracture modes are quasi-cleavage fracture, traction fracture with voids, shear fracture with voids and plastic shear fracture. For different fracture mechanisms, based on theoretical analysis and corresponding actual measurement, metallic material's fracture criterion has been obtained separately. The fracture criterion can reflect macroscopic fracture phenomenon and microscopic fracture mechanism, and also comply with the fracture nature. It is a better supplement to the deficiency of fracture mechanics in explaining fracture test results of metallic materials. And it is also a better amendment to traditional strength theory for brittle fracture in solving materials' fracture problems in complex stress states.

articleTitle: Rapid reproduction technology system of Rhododendron dauricum — Selection of medium and explant
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A rapid reproduction method of Rhododendron dauricum was studied in this paper.The result shows as follows: the basic medium is WPM; the optimal sterilization of explants is with 1.5-2cm long stem or apex; the best surface sterilants is 70% alcohol 30s and 0.1%HgCl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> 10 min; the best season for picking the experiment material is between the middle of March and May.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of directly facing the torque ripple compensation method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to two-phase conduction state of the motor's three-phase six-star mode, the paper discusses and concludes the current commutation torque ripples generated by the mechanism. Being different from traditional parameter selection difficulties and torque ripple being not easy to control shortcomings to eliminate torque ripple methods, the paper proposes the compensation method for direct torque ripple. The paper builds in the mathematical model of torque ripple compensation in HPWM-LON modulation mode, and carries out modeling and simulation based on PSPICE. The simulation results show that the compensation method for direct torque ripple has good results, and has a very high value for study.

articleTitle: Experiment research on decision of spontaneous combustion zone in goaf on fully mechanized coal face
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By arranging sampling tube in goaf of mine, we measured the gas and obtained the corresponding data. Then according to the application of Fluent numerical simulation technology based on the measured data, the spontaneous combustion zones in goal of fully-mechanized coalface was determined; thereby it provide scientific basis for the work of fire prevention and extinguishing in goal.

articleTitle: Experimental study on the friction and wear performance of new dual friction materials
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Three types of palygorskites and three types of NBR-modified phenolic resin are compressed respectively into new dual friction materials by material testing machine. Their friction, wear and impact resistance performances are studied experimentally. The results show that modified friction materials have better performance than unmodified phenolic resin materials. But compared with NBR-modified phenolic resin, the friction and wearing performances of dual friction material compressed by palygorskites by Al-Zr coupling agent and modified phenolic resin by Al<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> nanoparticles decrease a little bit and the mixed modified material by XD-172 has better effect only in low temperature stage.

articleTitle: Mechanical properties of clay under large shear displacement conditions
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By employing a ring shear apparatus, shear tests were conducted to examine the mechanical properties of clay under large shear displacement conditions. Based on the test results, the effects of stress history and shear speed on the shear resistance of over-consolidated silty clay were studied. The following results were found: (1) The variation of shear strength is related with the preconsolidation history and the shear speed. (2) With shear speed increasing, the peak strength and the strength reduction after peak value become greater. The faster shear tests are more favorable to the slip surface formation that leads to the ultimate stable shear strengths. (3) The variations of shear resistance in the fast shear ring shear tests are mainly due to the structural changes in the shear zone, while the influence of pore water during fast shearing is negligible.

articleTitle: Discussion about the semi-active control for the electro-magnetism suspension and simulating to verify
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The principle of the electro-magnetism suspension with semi-active control mode was introduced and three semi-active control schemes were presented. Basing on comparing three methods, the optimal semi-active control scheme, which included a rectifier with no control and a PWM chopper in the bus for adjusting the power of the load, was get and was simulated in MATLAB to verify. The result indicated that load current, load voltage and the output power absorbed by the electro-magnetism suspension was going up with the increasing of the semi-control switch's circle ratio. It testified that optimum one could be realized the semi -active control aim to control damper power absorbed by the semi-active electro-magnetism suspension fully and consequently verified the feasibility of the control method proposed in the paper.

articleTitle: Reliability evaluation of ground source heat pump in interval parameters of stochastic model
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The paper establishes reliability evaluation model of random variable parameters with interval changes of ground source heat pump (GSHP) according reliability design method to GSHP based on stochastic analysis of thermal resistance inside borehole, the geotechnical thermal resistance outside borehole of the GSHP. Practical projects show that small deviation of radom variable parameters leads great influence on evaluation results. To take 5% deviation as an example,calculation results show that the max failure probability is 521375 times of the min failure probability. Therfore the advance of backfilled material thermodynamic properties and geotechnical thermodynamic properties outside borehole testing technology have infinite influence on GSHP reliability.

articleTitle: Node rigidity research of concrete filled steel tubular column to steel beam
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article is about the finite element analysis of the connection between steel beam and concrete filled steel tubular. using the structure finite element analysis software ANSYS9.0, It was conducted the study of the mechanical behavior of steel beam to CFST column. Bashed on many experiments, A finite element study on the joint was made by using ANSYS9.0. And results were compared to of experiment and the analysis of finite element. Carry on the applicability and evaluation of the model and the analysis to the applicability of this node, It is testified that the non-linear finite element analysis method is correct and feasible. and some advice of improving its structure was put forward.

articleTitle: Experimental study on anaerobic fermentation of high concentrated cow dung mixed with wheat straw
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: High concentration of anaerobic fermentation with wheat straw and cow dung as inoculums were conducted for investigating the variation of interrelated index, such as pH, VFAs, TOC, TN and the variation of internal morphology of wheat straw.The results showed that the high concentration of anaerobic fermentation reactor run steady, pH decreased and then increased over time, eventually stabilized at 6.0-7.0.The content of acetic acid increased over time, while the contents of propionic acid, butyric acid and valeric acid increased and then decreased over time. With the process of the fermentation, acetic acid and butyric acid took advantage in the reactor, propionic acid accumulation did not appear. The content of TOC increased, while TN decreased over time. 120d later, C/N reached 15:1, in favor to the follow-up fermentation process. The photographs screened by Scanning Electron Microscope(SEM) indicated that the wheat straw degradated validly and quickly.

articleTitle: The application of the fuzzy control algorithm in the automatic track following robot
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The key problem to realize the automatic control track follower is how to detect the routine condition according to the signal getting from the sensors. Because the road condition is very complex and there are too many parameters that this system cannot be described by exact mathematical modules, the traditional algorithm cannot realize the road condition well. The fuzzy control algorithm has no need to build complex mathematical models and can tackle complex conditions with large numbers of variables. So the fuzzy control algorithm can better deal with the information coming from the sensor and exactly realize the routine condition with a higher processing speed.

articleTitle: Numerical analysis of rogue wave generation with boundary damping effects
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper a numerical wave flume is established for simulating deepwater wave train, which is based on fourth-order nonlinear Schroedinger equation and pseudo-spectral numerical method, and a linear dissipative term introduced to take into account the boundary damping effects of physical model test. Numerical simulation is carried out from Benjamin-Feir instability, and complex wave packet including one carrier wave and one pair of sideband perturbations is adapted as the initial condition, which is changed to simulate the rogue wave generation in deep water. Energy transformation is studied in the process of rogue wave generation, and the numerical results show that the model can give some good simulation results.

articleTitle: Novel iterative detection of MC-CDMA with two sets of orthogonal spreading sequences
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we introduce a Multi-Carrier Code-Division Multiple Access(MC-CDMA) system, which has two sets of orthogonal spreading sequences and use iterative detection. The number of the users it can accommodate is greater than the spreading factor N. Each of the available orthogonal spreading sequences of length N is assigned to one of the first N users which employ a common Pseudo-Noise (PN) scrambling sequence. When the number of users K exceeds N, say K = N + M with M < N, the M additional users reuse M of those orthogonal spreading sequences but in combination with another PN scrambling sequence. An iterative multistage detection technique is used to cancel the interference between the two sets of users when K>N. The proposed technique thus accommodates N users without any mutual interference and a number of additional users whit little signal-to-noise ratio penalty.

articleTitle: Effect analysis after prohibition of pumping groundwater in Su-Xi-Chang area of China
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Over-exploitation of groundwater has existed before 2000 in Su-Xi-Chang area. From the start of 2000, the program about prohibition of pumping groundwater was implemented stage by stage by Jiangsu provincial government, and the prohibition program was first conducted in over-exploitation area. By the end of 2005, an overall prohibition of pumping groundwater in Su-Xi-Chang was realized and the velocity of land subsidence was slowing down and groundwater table was recovered gradually. According to systematic subsidence monitoring data and observed groundwater table data in the study area in the recent years, the change laws of groundwater table and land subsidence are analyzed before and after prohibition of pumping groundwater, which show there are the tight relationship between recovery of groundwater table and the decrease of land subsidence. Simultaneously, the geological environmental effects were evaluated after prohibition of pumping groundwater. Some countermeasures and proposals are provided for geological environmental protection in the study area.

articleTitle: Fatigue test of carbon fiber used in repair and reinforcement on crack
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: More and more attention are paid to using carbon fiber compound materials in maintenance and repair of offshore structure. In this paper, we focus on a test of carbon fiber used in repair and reinforcement on crack. This will be followed by a description of the experiment. Two kinds of specimens are provided for the test which are cut in different crack. One kind of specimens are unwrapped, the other kind of them are strengthen by carbon fiber. For the sake of contrast, the same crack are cut in specimens of unwrapped and strengthen. Infrared photography instrument and acoustic emission instrument are used for test data acquisition and processing. Details on the test are discussed in later and some interesting results of the reinforcement of carbon fiber are obtained‥

articleTitle: The correlation influence factors analysis in the initial dosage of insulin therapy of diabetes
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, based on the raw data from the patients in hospital, data are analyzed with the correlation analysis, multiple regression analysis, stepwise regression and so on. the correlation relationship between the initial insulin dosage of diabetes patients and sexuality, age, body high, weight, diet intake, amount of exercise, blood sugar, urine glucose, urine protein, blood creatinine, concurrent infection et al. are studied, and by stepwise regression analysis, and the relation formulate between Insulin dosage and its key influence factors: blood sugar and urine protein are derived, which may give some guide to clinical medical treatment.

articleTitle: Furnace thermal calculation of 300MW boiler by oxy-fuel combustion
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Oxy-fuel combustion is a technology which can effectively reduce CO2 emissions from new combustion technology, into the furnace of the ratio of CO2 and O2 is needed to change. This thesis describes the significance of the oxygen rich combustion, the main effect of basic principles, and to 300 MW coal-fired boiler as an example of the oxygen-rich atmosphere of the furnace heat calculation. The main topics of research method is the use of existing boiler furnace method of calculating export through the furnace flue gas temperature of the atmosphere calculated under the different values and different temperatures to compare, compare and draw conclusions. In the calculation of different atmosphere when calculated using excel programming. The results showed that, oxygen-enriched air under the burning and burning than heating surface layout will be changed into the furnace when the ratio of O2 and the CO2 increase, the theory of combustion chamber temperature with oxygen and carbon dioxide The ratio of the size of the increase, the theory of combustion chamber temperature is rising gradually, and the great changes in the rate. The radiation-furnace heat is gradually increasing, in the design to increase the proportion of heating surface radiation, thus effectively reducing the size of boiler unit, reduce floor space.

articleTitle: Decoupling research on a car suspension using principal coordinate of oscillation equations
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Under research on principal coordinate of oscillation equations of multiple-degree-of-freedoms, if the relation between sprung mass of a whole car suspension and four sprung masses supported by four wheel systems is determined, the mass distribution coefficient in automotive theory would be enriched. In this paper, based on vertical and lateral excitations under the wheels, a traditional car model with fifteen degree of freedoms is adopted as research background. With the help of force analysis of sprung mass in space and investigations on vertical, lateral, pitch angle, roll angle and yaw angle motions, the principal coordinate equations of a whole car from vertical and lateral sides are obtained. The ratio relations of coupling dynamics between a whole suspension and four quarter suspensions are deduced and achieved. The results obtained in this paper found the theoretical basis for future studies on vibration control of suspension system, steering and running stability in vehicle field.

articleTitle: Research on the client-side cache technology of the intelligent network disk storage system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Intelligent network disk (IND) storage system is a novel network storage system, in this storage system, the increasing number of clients and the probability of non-contiguous data access will reduce the hit rate of limited cache and lower the performance of storage system. This paper presents a client-side cache model of IND storage system, and introduces a strategy of page swapping to protect single copy based on LRU. The experiment shows that method above can effectively reduce the negative influence of the increasing number of clients and improve the performance of IND storage system.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of high-accuracy FOG-IMU
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Aimed at the need of high-resolution SAR motion compensation, a high-accuracy FOG-IMU, which includes a high-precision and low-ripple power module, a high-precision signal acquisition module based on FPGA and the related algorithm, is designed and realized, and then integrated into POS. A lot of tests show that the system is stable and reliable. And the applications of POS in the motion compensation of SAR imaging demonstrate the high precision of the system.

articleTitle: The quantified board models of fine-grained soil layer subsidence caused by pit dewatering
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the ground settlement calculation method recommended by the Chinese national Standards(GB 50307-1999), according to the type of soil and soil physical properties (characteristics of porosity ratio, plastic limit, compression modulus), soil layer thickness and water drawdown, the ground settlement quantified board models are established. The established models provide a fast, direct ,simple and useful method and tool for land subsidence calculation in engineering construction.

articleTitle: The critical technics of construction of group piles foundation of Sutong Bridge
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The construction situation of Sutong Bridge is complicated and difficult. The pier foundation of main tower of this bridge is the largest scale group piles/bearing platform of world. In this article, the plan of construction and the critical technics of this group piles foundation are discussed.

articleTitle: Research on the strengthening method of long span two-way curved arch bridges
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the reasons for diseases of long span two way curved arch bridges is analysis and the strengthening methods are illustrated; Research is make on this case and some new materials is used into the strengthening of the bridges; After the strengthening works finished, the efforts is evaluated.

articleTitle: Extraction on polysaccharide of Camellia Cake by response surface methodolog
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To extract polysaccharide of Camellia Cake, cellulase-assist method was used. The extraction conditions were: temperature 50°C; time 3h; adding amount of cellulase 0.35%. The extract rate of camellia cakes polysaccharide is 26.62%, The adequacy of this model was confirmed.

articleTitle: Research on Fingerprint image preprocessing and thinning
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In the modern age, people enjoy the advantages coming from the information technology. At the same time, all kinds of problems of information security appear. Fingerprint recognition technology more practical as the current biometric technology has become a hot research at home and abroad. Traditional PC-based fingerprint identification system as poor mobility, the disadvantages limit its power in the civilian areas of application and promotion. Therefore, the development of low power, high performance, mobility and strong embedded fingerprint identification system has real practical significance and wide application prospects.

articleTitle: Bus vehicle status analysis in China
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper analyses the current bus vehicle status in China, including vehicle age, bus company size, emissions standards, fuel type and bus vehicles' distribution of the country. The analysis results show that nearly one fifth vehicles are more than 8 years old; and generally the size of bus companies is small; and high emission vehicles account for a large proportion of all vehicles (80.1%), and recent 2 years high-emission vehicles still enter the bus operating market; moreover, most of the vehicles use gasoline (16.65%) and diesel (69.3%), clean fuel vehicles, such as compressed natural gas (CNG) and liquefied petroleum gas (LPG), are at a very low percentage; the bus vehicles ownership is at different level in different provinces, the western region is clear behind the eastern. In order to reduce energy consumption and emission, several policy recommendations had been proposed.

articleTitle: A study on construction contract management the establishment of Contract Management System
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Construction industry has been regarded as the locomotive of Taiwan's business in 1970. Because there are inherent limitations, construction has gradually become a more backward industry. Taiwan joined the WTO in 2001, construction firms need to improve management and implementation of physical fitness to cope with the impact of open markets. In order to comply with the fairness and avoid unnecessary disputes, construction companies have sub-item contracts with sub-constructors. Subcontracting disputes happen for construction industry since there are lack of professional attainment. This study integrates the structure of subcontract documents. This sub-item contract template have been established through the help of legal advisers from Construction Association to review these documentation. Database is applied to store frequently used variables. When parser reads these keywords, the values stored in database are fetched and inserted into output file to compile a new complete contact fitting specific condition. These documents are stored in a directory based on the hierarchy of company, project and sub-item. This Contract Management System can help the construction industry to facilitate a clear, flexible, detailed sub-contract management, improve administrating capabilities, reduce cost and time consuming, avoid sub-contracting disputes, increase competitiveness and ensure sustainable operation.

articleTitle: The environment control of the coal mining collapse
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The collapse is a serious problem for the mining area in China. In order to improve the environment of mining area, this paper analyzes the presence of collapse area in Hebei province. This paper analyzes a series of environmental problems about mining area. And this paper gives some good way of restoring the mining area.

articleTitle: Road corrugated steel pipe culvert applying and strain measuring with fiber grating test technology
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Compared to traditional reinforced concrete culverts, corrugated steel pipe culvert has many unique advantages, and it is widely used in road construction engineering around the entire world. Two corrugated steel pipe culverts were choose in north connection project of Nanjing Fourth Highway Bridge on Yangtse River. From testing the strain conditions of corrugated steel pipe culverst under different soil fill height by setting fiber bragg grating(FBG) sensor in the inner or outer of corrugated steel pipe culverts, we could get its mechanical properties. When the fill height was changed, the strain values of all test points set on the culverts changed, particularly in the top and bottom test points of the culvert increased significantly, which show that corrugated steel pipe culvert has the capacity of larger deformation. So In the soft soil area, using its good ductility can solve the problem of uneven settlement.

articleTitle: Analysis and study of the crushing mechanism of the MPS vertical roller mill
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the analysis of the crushing characteristics of the vertical roller mill, this paper studies the methods of crushing the materials, calculates the relative parameters for the single particle crushing-the largest clamp angle and the particle diameter, analyzes the force of friction between the roller and the material layer as well as the influence of the particle size on the clamp angle. Combined with the position curve of the roller's movement measured at the work site, introduces the concept of the crushing mechanism of material layer, further studies the three stages of the crushing process of the vertical roller mill and analyzes the influences on the mill running caused by different movement position of 3 rollers and the uneven force acted on them.

articleTitle: Flight control system design for miniature unmmaned helicopter based on PowerPC
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a novel design of flight control system for miniature unmanned helicopter based on PowerPC. The structure is compact, multi-serial communication is credible, and the interface is flexible. An important design about security which makes change between telecontrol device and flight control system is offered. At the end of the paper, the result of Hardware in the loop simulation experimentation is given, and the result shows the flight control system is multifunctional and reliable.

articleTitle: Research on modularity fitness degree of mechanical product
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Modularity fitness degree of mechanical product was systematic analysed and researched because the research of determining whether mechanical product is suitable for modular lacked. Factors which influenced modularity fitness degree of mechanical product was analysed and summarized. Modified Delphi method was applied to estimate the weight of factors of modularity fitness degree of mechanical product. Mathematical model which was used to evaluate modularity fitness degree of mechanical product was built. Lastly, transportable oil equipment was used to illustrate evaluation protocols of modularity fitness degree of mechanical product.

articleTitle: Analysis on hydrodynamic characteristic and cavity form of high-speed projectile with small angle of attack
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the Rayleigh-Plesset homogeneous hypothesis and the compressible mixture multiphase model, three-dimensional CFD numerical calculation model of high-speed projectile under water was built. Compared with the empirical formula, the consistency between it and results from model on the conditions of zero-angle attack and fixed cavitation number is good. Therefore, the validity of numerical method and preferences was verified. According to the built model, the hydrodynamic characteristics of supercavitating flow in angle of attack within 2 and cavity form were studied in computational simulation way. Thus, the law of effect of angle of attack on cavity form was obtained. Results have showed that the hydrodynamic characteristic of projectile has different trends with different angles of attack value. The results of this paper can provide theory basis for the further researching on trajectory performance of high-speed projectiles.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of acoustic wave field of seafloor sediments based on Biot model
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the Biot model, Acoustic wave field of seafloor sediments are calculated and analyzed by means of finite-difference numerical simulation. According to the results, Porosity(Ø) and permeability(К) both have important influence on wave field of marine sediment. As Ø increases, velocity and amplitude of the fast wave decrease, but velocity of the slow wave increases. As К decreases, the amplitude of the slow wave decreases. In addition to reflection and transmission characteristics, the transform features of wave appear on the interface of two sedimentary layers of marine sediments. On the interface, the fast wave is transformed into the shear and the slow wave. The shear wave is transformed into the fast wave. The slow wave is transformed into the shear and the fast wave. Extraordinarily, the fast wave which transformed from the slow wave has identical properties with the usual fast wave such as a little velocity dispersion and attenuation.

articleTitle: Multi-integral identification based on Feature-Data
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To solve the parameters' identification of Multi-Order system with pure delay unit, the algorithm based on the multiple integrations of the Feature-Data is presented. With the data of the stepping response, the System's Feature-Data can be obtained according to the criterion of the Least-Square-Method and the minimum error of some parameters identified redundantly, and with the Multi-Integrations' value of the feature-data, the equations are established, the parameters can be identified consequently.

Author Keywords: Multi-Order System with Pure Delay Unit

articleTitle: Research on hydrogen and oxygen isotope of leakage in branch construction tunnel of Tianhuangping Pumped-storage Station
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The leakage occurs frequently and relatively centralized in the water-carriage system under the action of the high water head pressure since Tianhuangping Pumped-storage Station operated. The stability of the surrounding bedrock leakage under the long-term action of the high water head pressure receives much concern. This paper studies the water leakage in the branch construction tunnel in the water-carriage system of THP Station by the hydrogen and oxygen isotope analysis method combined with the inorganic hydrochemistry analysis method. The results shows that the value of δ D in the leakage water has obvious zonality and then is grouped in four types. What's more, the concentration of the δ <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">18</sup>O is relatively enriched, mainly produced from the isotopic fractionation caused by the interaction of the calcium hydroxide and soft water in the bulkhead concrete of the branch construction tunnel.

articleTitle: Clustering analysis of space reconnaissance intelligent service requirements in presence of military values
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a structural model is built for space reconnaissance intelligent service requirements evaluation. Then employing AHP method to evaluate military values of service requirements. Considering military values constraints and based on DBSCAN algorithm, this paper proposed a new clustering analysis algorithm which could handle the problem of identifying isolate or low density but high values requirement with noise. Considering characters of space reconnaissance and characters of service requirements, the formula is given to select the values of Eps and MinPts. Experimental result confirms that the new proposed algorithm not only has the advantages of DBSCAN, but also takes advantage of the constraint military values to make the results more reasonable than traditional ways and is according to the characters of space reconnaissance.

articleTitle: On the concept planning for the central China international industrial materials city of Nanchang
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: From the point of view as regional analysis, industry layout and concept planning, and learn form the theory of biology to research the urban design for the Central China International Industrial Materials City of Nanchang. At the same time, provide the reference and cases to the other similar projects.

articleTitle: Same pressure of two-point clamping device based on permanent force increasing lever - symmetrical toggle mechanism driven by pneumatic muscle
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Utilizing pneumatic muscle instead of the traditional rigid pneumatic cylinder, the pneumatic muscle has many outstanding advantages such as small ratio between output force and diameter, small ratio between output force and weight. In this paper, two different diameters pneumatic muscle, combined with the permanent force increasing lever-symmetrical toggle force-amplified mechanism, a new type of clamping device has been innovated. The large-diameter pneumatic muscle will be used for the working stroke of the pressure travel, while the small-diameter pneumatic muscle will be used for the return travel. The tension of the pneumatic muscle will decrease with the increases of the contraction, the force-amplified coefficient of the force lever- toggle mechanism will increase with the decrease of the pressure angle, which is taken full account of this complementary relationship between them. So the output force curve of the press is improved smoothly. The working principle of the system is analyzed and mechanics calculating formulae are given. The clamping device was most used such as: the workpiece size is big, long distance of two pressure head, two pressure head need the same clamping force.

articleTitle: Simulation of liquid level maintain device of explosion-suppression water bag for mine
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The thesis introduces liquid level maintain device of explosion-suppression water bag. It realizes intellectual water replenishing and automatic water-break.of explosion-suppression water bag. It also solves the problems of artificial recharging. The thesis uses MATLAB/Simmechanics tool box to do dynamic simulation. Structure the system model based on simplified sketch of mechanism. Run the simulation model to get final data and import to MATLAB and Simulink for subsequent treatment. It proves that the device can meet the liquid level maintain function that the water inlet opens in the condition of the liquid level being below normal value and the water inlet closes in the condition of being normal value. Using simmechanics to do system simulation provides a solution method for following design, which also cuts greatly the design cycle.

articleTitle: Law and prediction model of smoke backflow distances under fire of railway tunnel
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Taking shiziyang tunnel as background, the numerical simulation was carried on different fire source power, ventilation wind velocity and different slope tunnel model. The change law of backflow distances of smoke of the tunnel was analyzed, and the data of imitation was fitted. The result indicates that the relations between backflow distances of smoke and natural logarithm of different to ventilation wind velocity, different fire source power are changing in line with straight line, increasing or decreasing. The impact from slope on backflow distances of smoke has something to do with ventilation wind velocity, on which there is a critical point, under the same situation, while ventilation wind velocity is greater than critical point, backflow distances of smoke are longer, in contrast, the smaller it is, the shorter the distance is. And then, relational expression between backflow distances of smoke and relevant parameters was obtained through dimensional analysis, backflow distances of smoke model was built by combining its change law and backflow distances of smoke formula is built through fitting data. The formulas' rationality and advantage are analyzed.

articleTitle: Experiment study on loess filling material improvement for the embankment of Zhengzhou - Xi'an railway passenger line
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
