abstract: With the usage for Zhengzhou-xi'an railway passenger line. The chemical and physical properties of typical loess, the granulometric composition, The variation of liquid and plastic limit, compaction characteristics, strength and its major influencing factors of improved-loess were studied in lab. Through experiments some results were obtained. The Results show that plasticity index of the improved-loess decreases after improvement, at the same time, its hydrophilicity weakened. As the variation of admixture kind, the optimum water content increases a bit, however, the maximum dry density decreases, and the changes of lime improved-loess is more obvious than cement, improved-loess. Other lime-improved loess or cementimproved loess, their strength increases with the curing time, at the increasing strength, the amplification of cohesion is superior to internal friction angle'. The chemical and physical properties of typical loess and its water-resistance were obviously improved through improving properties by chemical method, this would provide useful data and references for the usage of filling of subgrade in the railway passenger line and similar engineerings.

articleTitle: Carrying capacity of “embodied energy spot” on Urban square by the pulsing control mechanism
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The square is the urban hot spot, not only the residential public life important place, but also being the superintendent's management issue. This article tries to introduce the energy concept. Take the most characteristic "Ximending" square of Taipei as the example. After photographing the pedestrian path, establishes the compression percentage, presents the carrying capacity by the immediate vision image. Then using the programming language to constructs an immediate demonstration as the interface. The results may dynamic carry on the immediate analysis, aims at the "energy embodied spot", which simulation obviously builds up to carry on the replacement by "the feedback loops". And so we can discusses how to seek balanced in the dynamic energy between embodied and dispersion. The mechanism manifests pulsed condition, will contributing the square's peaceful and comfortable feeling, and creation the charming city life at the same time.

articleTitle: Establishment and implementation of large-scale heating networking district heating economic operations model
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper, the large-scale heat network is now commonly used outdoor mechanical circulating hot water heating-supply tube net. Hydraulic regime was analyzed in district heating system at first, and then established hydraulic calculation model basing on the fact of operation. At the same time thermal condition was also brought and thermal calculation model was established from the node thermal balance standpoint. Combined the hydraulic calculation module with the thermal calculation module and other optimization or search modules, a general calculation model is designed for both radiate network and loop-network, which not only simulates the practical condition, but also offers the data of ideal condition. This model is proved to be correct, helpful, energy saving and economical in adjustment of district heating system.

articleTitle: Virtual prototype design and experimental study on a patented double-ring-plate gear reducer
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The virtual prototype design for a patented double-ring-plate gear reducer (DRPGR) is proposed and some experimental tests are conducted. The modification coefficients of internal gearing in DRPGR are calculated with the closed-graph method followed by the determination of geometries and structure of the reducer. With virtual prototype technologies, a three dimensional solid model and two finite element model of DRPGR are developed, respectively. Based on the proposed models, a loaded tooth contact analysis (LTCA) and a modal analysis (MA) are conducted sequentially to predict stresses and natural frequencies of DRPGR. The LTCA reveals the stresses of internal gearing in DRPGR are much lower than permissible ones at rated output torque due to multi-mesh phenomenon. The MA indicates that the first order natural frequency of DRPGR is far away from resonance frequency. Following the proposed virtual prototype design rules, an experimental prototype of DRPGR is manufactured and tested. The experiments results agree well with the simulations of the proposed virtual prototype design.

articleTitle: Analysis of energy saving and emission reduction in coal industry
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Coal is very important energy. To study energy conservation and emission reduction of coal industry in national economy development has practical value. The paper analyzes coal industry domestic situation and current energy consumption and industry waste discharge conditions, discusses and analyzes specific measures of energy saving and emission reduction such as improvement of recovery ratio, comprehensive utilization of coal waste and improvement of coal mining machinery. Study of coal industry, energy conservation and emission reduction has some reference value.

articleTitle: Simulation on performance of rubber isolator based on ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the performance of rubber isolator, a new rubber isolator is studied and analyzed. The mechanics constant is obtained by test, which is the parameter for mooney-revlin function of strain energy density. Two finite element model of rubber isolator are built, and the static characteristics are studied. The finite element model is verified by comparing the results of simulation and test. The plane is simulated for flexible base, and the performance of two rubber isolators is simulated based on vibration level difference. The results show that ameliorated rubber isolator has more excellent performance. The simulation results are significative for design of rubber isolator.

articleTitle: Simulation study of two-phase gas-liquid flow capacitance-cross-correlation flow velocity measurement based on MATLAB
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper takes the gas-liquid two-phase flow cross correlation measurement system as the research object, and adopts the method of computer simulation, researches the measuring mechanism of capacitance-cross-correlation velocity consisted by capacitance sensor on the base of the discrete phase concentration. The relationship between capacitance sensor and the discrete phase concentration is analyzed by using ANSYS. By using Monte-Carlo method, the gas-liquid two-phase flow model is established; and this paper also makes research that "solidified flow chart-type", "non-solidified flow chart-type" and the distribution of discrete phase concentration, particle size and velocity influence on cross-correlation measurement system.

articleTitle: Experimental study of mechanical performance of a new-style roof
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A new-style roof called " Yun Din" has been sucessfully used in building workers and staff members canteen of Wuhu branch of Changjiang shiping management bureau , however the research on the new spatial structure has not been conducted up to now. Based on analysis of the structural characteristics of the new roof , the constitutive law of the roof structure is put forward, and the experimental research is made to well study the mechanical properties and failure mechanism of the roof structure on the basis of the experimental results. It is concluded that load bearing capability of the structural system is well and the internal forces is well-distributed. It is shown from the experimental results that failure positions of the structure are almost found on interface region above the sixth floor for coming unglued, so the binding strength on these positions should be improved. Simultaneously, it should be noted that the horizontal thrust applied to the roof structure is very small under vertical loads, which is extremely beneficial to minish stress of supporting members on the periphery of the roof.

articleTitle: Effects of soil condition on the population dynamics of rhizome on Aneurolepidum chinense
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the yield experiment carried out on the steppe of the Western part of Jinlin Province, this article analyzed the effects of fertilization on the population dynamics of rhizomes on Aneurolepidum chinense. The results showed that the density of the rhizome and root increased significantly after fertilization, and the root density, biomass, and the old stolon density in treatment NPK were higher than that in the other treatments. Applying K promoted the growth of the new rhizome.

articleTitle: A simplified method for vertical bearing capacity of bucket foundation breakwater under wave load
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The bucket foundation breakwater is a new type of structure applied in port and coastal engineering, the stability of which is sustained by the bucket foundation penetrated in soft soil. The calculation of vertical bearing capacity of the bucket foundation under horizontal wave load is the important content of examination for structure stability. Considering the structure's geometry and force characteristics, a simplified method for vertical bearing capacity calculation, based on classical bearing capacity theories, was established. The model is simple and convenient to be used. According to the project of extending breakwaters in Tianjin Port, the vertical bearing capacity of the bucket foundation breakwater was checked. The results showed that the vertical bearing capacity failure modes of bucket foundation breakwater in soft soil belonged to local failure or punching shear failure. When the height of the bucket was 8 to 10 m, the vertical bearing capacity of the bucket foundation breakwater, calculated by a variety of classical bearing capacity calculation formulas, had a high degree of stability, and the results were consistent basically.

articleTitle: A kind of control method and application of the sluice gate on the Lower Yellow River
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As the changing of the climate, a lot of places on the Lower Yellow River have to face the water shortage problems and the water resources become more and more important. How to use the Yellow River water better and realize the aim at adjusting the water together and managing the river scientifically is become a subject under the urgent need. For many reasons, the conventional PID control is difficult to satisfy the control demands of the sluice gate, this paper takes the sluice gate of Doufuwo as the target object, apply the principle of fuzzy adaptive control to the project of getting water from the Yellow River through the sluice gate, After the verifying of the practice, this strategy control method can ensure utilize of the Yellow River reasonably and effectively.

articleTitle: Analysis of strength reduction factor of RC frames
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The strength reduction factor is the key factor in determining design seismic force. The ductility reduction factor, overstrength factor and strength reduction factor of RC frames designed according to current Chinese seismic code are calculated. A method for calculating the ductility reduction factor are proposed based on capacity spectrum method. Nine RC frames with different heights and design seismic zones are calculated using pushover methods. It is concluded that the structures with higher design seismic level have lower reserve strength when they have the same heights, while the reserve strength will decreased with the increasing heights in the same design seismic level. The current Chinese seismic code are evaluated and some advices are proposed for its future modification.

articleTitle: Study on smoke control efficiency in ultra-long railway tunnel under fire condition
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Proper smoke control design is an important aspect in the operating security of ultra-long railway tunnels. Taihang Mountain Tunnel on Shijiazhuang-Taiyuan Passenger Specified Railway is investigated as a typical case. The numerical model representing the smoke control design and fire scenarios is set up, based on which the smoke motion and the efficiency of different smoke control plans under several fire conditions are simulated. By comparing the results, it could be drawn that the huge sectional area of the tunnel is capable of cumulating a great quantity of smoke, and effect of axial flow fan is relatively minor, while the longitudinal air flow driven by jet fan could efficiently damp the spread of smoke. Some specific phenomenons that deserve attention in the design and operation of such tunnels are also raised in this paper.

articleTitle: The rebuilt of loft and the reuse of old industrial buildings
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The commercialization of LOFT solves the major problem of capital source that occurred in the former process of historic building reconstruction. At the same time, the spatial characteristics of LOFT marked by strong senses of nature, authenticity, and romance help us to see the possibility of the potential development concerned with buildings' self-growth and city's organic renewal. This article explores the reasons of why LOFT culture was being created and chronicles its development history. Besides, combined with certain architectural cases, this article analyzes the influences on residential buildings and commercial buildings exerted by LOFT in terms of its spatial patterns, formal styles, and commercial values.

articleTitle: Performance of systematic RA code in long haul optical fiber communication system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The systematic repeat-accumulate (RA) code is constituted by a repeater, an interleaver, a combiner and an accumulator. Under the sum-product decoding on the Tanner graph of the code, the performance of RA codes with random interleaver is affected by short cycles of parity-check matrix. In this paper, we present combinatorial design of interleaver. The RA code with new interleaver can produce very high code rate and its parity-check matrix is free of 4-cycles. Thus the codes are likely to be used in long haul optical fiber communication system. We analyze the performance of the systematic RA code in three optical fiber transmission models. Simulation results show that RA codes with combinatorial interleaver have better performance than that of the code with random interleaver in fiber communication system. The decoder based on Chi-square also has better performance than of the decoder based on Gaussian models

articleTitle: A study on Relaxation Camp Facility Management
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Information management became the tidal for most occupations. An effective management system to integrate related information for relaxation camp can provide effectiveness from different phases. This can enhance the farm value, feedback with ecology care, and significantly assist for long-term development. In "Medium-range Construction Plan for Important Sightseeing Scenic Spot", the Ministry of Communications Sightseeing Bureau in Taiwan indicated government only emphasizes on hardware demand and neglects the management and operation need. The major sightseeing scenic spots are lack support of management software. An integrated management system can significantly help the promotion of the sightseeing industry. In this study, ER Model, database, SQL Server, Visual Studio, and Windows environment are used to develop "Relaxation Camp Facility Management System". The system integrates related information such as recreation facility, business model, livestock product, experience item, and service space. The related information of relaxation camp is combined in the system that provides tourist to inquire from the website for assistance. This makes the leisure industry concerns agriculture content, marketing and management domain. Besides building pleasant environment, the system can create extra values for farms. Through the help of this system, farm personnel can engage in the farm plan design, provides appropriate related information, and propose the right direction for relaxation camp development.

articleTitle: Application of A/O+ refined diatomite strengthening process to treat sewage in small-sized cities and towns
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this article, the theory characteristics of A/O+ refined diatomite strengthening process to sewage treatment are analyzed, and practical application are summarized. Engineering practice and data show that this process has characteristics of low investment, low operation cost, less land occupation and the treated wastewater to achieve stability. The effluent water quality reaches the first B grade discharge standard. It is suitable for the wastewater treatment in small Small-sized Cities and Towns in China.

articleTitle: Study on the effect of fracture characteristics to ultra-low permeability reservoirs development
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A mathematical model was derived for flow in ultra-low permeability reservoir with hydraulic fracturing, including three coupling sections: low-velocity non-Darcy flow in matrix, flow in elliptical area around fractures and nonlinear flow in fractures. Based on data from test areas, the effects on hydraulic fracturing development of artificial fracture length, flow conductivity, and angle to development effect were clarified by numerical simulations. According to fracture characteristics and production data of test areas, effect of natural fracture pattern, and degree of fracture development on developing ultra-low permeability reservoir was studied. Analysis results show that optimal values of half-length of artificial fracture are 70m~85m, flow conductivity 30D.cm~40D.cm and fracture angle 0~25 degrees.

articleTitle: Thermal-mechanical coupling finite element analysis of laser cladding process Part I: Temperature field
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Laser cladding consists of covering a substrate surface with a coating of a different nature. As a complex thermal mechanical process, laser cladding is not quite understood yet. In this study, a finite element model for analyzing the temperature field was built and the laser cladding process with powder feeding was analyzed with the model. The analysis results show that the maximum temperature at the melting pool during cladding is directly proportional to the laser power and preheated temperature. The maximum cooling rate at the melting pool is inversely proportional to them. Increasing the preheated temperature can decrease the cooling rate of the clayed layer effectively. Increasing the laser power can also decrease the cooling rate, but the effect is not obvious.

articleTitle: Preparation of novel materials for set piece tube
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this study, novel materials for set piece tube was prepared based on rice hull (wastepaper) and clay (loess). CMC (carboxymethyl cellulose), starch and polyvinyl alcohol were used as binder. The samples were shaped by pressing method with pressure lOMPa, and dried at 80 °C .After cooling, curing composition can be prepared by a new set piece tube Compression strength of the composite was higher than lOMPa. Flexural strength was up to 5.28MPa and tensile strength 2.15MPa. The density of the composite was 0.81g/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>. The novel materials could be applied as substitution for traditional paper tube. Solid Waste of rice hull and wastepaper could be utilized and natural resources consumption was reduced. Furthermore, natural degradation property of this kind of novel materials means low pollution, low carbon and low price.

articleTitle: Wavelet Neural Network based fault detection method in power system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Wavelet Neural Network combined the advantages of wavelet transform and neural network, It is a knowledge-based fault diagnosis method It doesn't need accurate mathematical model, both have good time-frequency localization properties and better self-learning ability and fault tolerance. This article describes the natural network in power system fault detection, the simulation results show that, compared with the traditional artificial neural network, the wavelet neural network has the characteristics of fast convergence. So wavelet neural network can be applied to power system fault detection.

articleTitle: Study on the evaporation of High Salinity Oily Water
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: High Salinity Oily Water is difficult to treat in oil field. In this paper, we consider feasibility measures about high salinity sewage using spontaneous evaporation. Calculation formula of natural water evaporation, basic form and parameters of evaporation tank are deduced by effect factor of evaporation. We suggest to use solar-cell panel as supporting measures to increase evaporating capacity and decrease energy consumption, However, spontaneous evaporation and auxiliary solar are a new kinds of environmental protection treatment method to save energy.

articleTitle: Research of VOC pollution of non-metallic components in a vehicle
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The health, comfort and safety of a passenger are closely related to the air quality in a vehicle. In this paper, the research is performed to reduce VOC pollution inside the vehicle. The influence of VOC content of parts such as rubber, plastic, foaming on interior air quality is introduced. Moreover, the VOC pollution of parts, such as weather strip, central console and seat, is analyzed and solutions are presented accordingly. The improved effects are also described to ensure that the passenger is safe and healthy when driving a car.

articleTitle: Simulation of flow around open storage pile based on low Reynolds number turbulence model
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Air flow field around open storage pile is a matter of flow around square cylinder. Prediction of wind flow over storage pile plays a dominant role in the evaluation of its environmental impact. Numerical simulation of flow around square cylinder has been widely recognized as a powerful tool in determining air flow field. This paper introduces the application of the numerical simulation in the research of flow around an open storage pile, applies four types of low-Reynolds number turbulence model to research the unsteady air flow field around an open storage pile. Result shows that YS model achieved a better conclusion than the other three low-Reynolds number turbulence models in flow pattern of different phase and time average accuracy as it more close to the experiment results and large eddy simulation. In addition, the calculation results using YS low-Reynolds number turbulence model is more close to experiment results in determination of drag coefficient and lift coefficient. This paper will be an essential basis for practical applications.

articleTitle: Research on soil wetted front of gutter under water conservation in arbor-shrub-hedge-gutter
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Water conservation in arbor-shrub-hedge-gutter is a new method of controlling soil erosion and water conservation. A series of indoor experiments about the soil moisture movement of gutter on the condition of water conservation in arbor-shrub-hedge-gutter were conducted . The experimental results indicated that that advancing distance of horizontal and vertical wetting front increase according with the infiltration time, the advancing speed of wetting front decrease while the infiltration time increases, and the relationship between the advancing distance of horizontal and vertical wetting front and the infiltration time appears obviously logarithmic relationship. The above results will offer reference for defining technical element of water conservation in arbor-shrub-hedge-gutter.

articleTitle: A high-resolution time-to-digital converter based on the relationship of time-space
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Time to digital converter (TDC) with high resolution is in great demand at present. Transmission delay and its application in a Time to digital technology are studied in this paper. A TDC prototype, mainly contains buffers, delay line and coincidence detection circuit, is designed by this technology. The prototype has a resolution better than 250 ps and a digital range better than 5 ns. The quantization error, integral nonlinearity error and random error of the prototype is analyzed in this paper. Furthermore, technologies for enlarging measurement range and making a TDC has a gapless measurement ability is developed and a new TDC which using the microstrip on a printed-circuit-board as delay line is realized with 500ps single shot precision and 21s measurement rang.

articleTitle: A case of hotel reclaimed water treatment project
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: It was investigated and discussed of an engineering case about process and operation of hotel sewage treatment system in this paper. It can be used for reference to other wastewater treatment and reuse.

articleTitle: Strengthening the construction and protection of ecological environment and maintaining the social stability and environmental security
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The economic development is inseparable from the good ecological environment and the beautiful ecological environment is the basis for speeding up the economic development. However, the adverse environment can make the economy unsustainable. At present, the Chinese economy is growing and the contradiction between environmental protection and economic development is urgent. We don't have enough resources to support the economic growth method with high consumption and high pollution. This paper has summed up the existing problems and reasons of Chinese environmental protection and put forward the principles of environmental construction and protection. At the same time, it has also analyzed and proposed some effective methods and measures for solving these environmental problems.

articleTitle: SiCp/Cu composites prepared by the dual-directional extrusion process of floating die
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: SiCp/Cu composites were fabricated by the dual directional extrusion process of the floating die. The microstructure, wear behavior and conductivity of SiCp/Cu composites were studied by optical microscope, abrasion test and current conductivity instrument. The results show that the SiCp/Cu composites with SiC particle distributed uniformly can be obtained, and the conductivity of composites decreased with the increasing of concentration of SiC particles, the wear resistance behavior of SiCp/Cu composites is evidently better than Cu with the increasing of concentration of SiC particles, the wearing mechanism of composites is a synthetically combined function of micro-cutting wearing and surface peeling off and grain wearing.

articleTitle: Research on preparation and properties of rapid adhesive for bonding raised pavement markers
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The purpose of this study is to develop an environment-friendly solvent-free rapid adhesive for bonding raised pavement markers. This adhesive is composed of two components, the main agent without solvent and curing agent. Firstly, the film forming substance of the main agent is prepared by polyurethane/epoxy resin IPN composite. Secondly, the main agent is composed of the film forming substance, pigment, filler and additives. Through compression-shear strength test, pull-off test and compression test, and so on, comprehensive properties of the adhesive are systematically researched. The results show that compression-shear strength, adhesive bond strength, compression strength, anti-cracking performance at low temperature and weathering resistance of this adhesive are excellent under the optimum formula, and that the adhesive also has the characteristics of rapid construction (60 minutes after construction open to traffic) in low temperature (-10°C), which makes this adhesive especially suitable for rapidly bonding raised pavement markers of road in cold regions.

articleTitle: Research of security analysis based on subjective Bayesian Networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Considering the uncertainties of evidence, regulation and reasoning in the security analysis of complex equipments, this paper made use of the theory of subjective Bayes methods, introduced the odds function, made an subsection inter- polateing transaction of the conditional probability function, represented the data in a uniform framework with the Bayesian Networks and gained a rule of how to express the uncertain information in an accurate way. The result of the example showed the arithmetic is more accurate.

articleTitle: Experimental study of thermal comfort for direct radiant floor heating system utilizing R22
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper presents experimental study for direct radiant floor heating system with air-source heat pump utilizing R22. An experimental platform was established, and thermal comfort of the heating system was analyzed from floor temperature, vertical temperature field, relative humidity, operation temperature and average radiation temperature, radiation asymmetry, PMV (Predicted Mean Vote) and PPD (Predicted Percent Dissatisfied). It shows that the indoor heat load can be well met as the output capacity of ASHP runs at 30%. When the heating system steadily runs, thermal comfort is very perfect. Finally calculating the values of PMV and PPD index, the results point out that PMV is about -0.7 ~ -0.17, and PPD is 5.58%~15.49% which could well meet the requirements of thermal comfort in China (PPD =≤ 20%, -1.5 <;PMV<;+1.2).

articleTitle: Extend UDDI using ontology for automated service composition
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Current Web Service systems are based on “central” UDDI servers and syntactic description of Web Services, which are fragile and unscalable, and do not support Semantic Web Services. It is necessary to replace this UDDI structure with a new one. P2P is such an infrastructure, which allows the sharing of resources and services by direct interaction between equal nodes. Therefore, a discovery framework in p2p environment is proposed to replace traditional UDDI, by distributing the functions of the UDDI among all the peers in the P2P network. At the same time, An ontology-based mechanism is designed, which guaranteeing every service would be registered on a specific peer in the CAN-based P2P network, according to the service's ontology. By replacing the UDDI, our system improves the scalability and stability of the SWS system, and realizes an efficient ontology-based publishing and discovery of Semantic Web Services.

articleTitle: A sort of control algorithm of PMSM based on the flux and the rapid control prototype development
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: For the control of PMSM in electric drive armored vehicle, the control algorithms are usually different for permanent torque control and flux-weakening control, and the structure is complicated and the speed changes unsmoothly. In this paper, a kind of stator current orientation control algorithm based on flux was provided, and the optimization algorithm on torque control was designed by Matlab. The RCP simulation platform based on dSPACE was built, and the real-time simulation was carried out. The simulation results show that this control algorithm is effective in smoothing the speed between permanent torque control area and flux-weakening control area.

articleTitle: Distributed beamforming for source localization in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Wireless sensor networks (WSNs) have been widely studied in a lot of areas recently. In this paper, we present a method to examine the validity of distributed beamforming for source location in WSNs, by considering the effect of position errors, element failure, and environment noise, which often occur in practice. Computer simulation results show that even though the three errors exist, the direction of a sensor can still be estimated through the beampattern based on distributed beamforming (BF). The benefit of the distributed BF is that almost no additional hardware is required, which guarantees the sensors to be small and low-cost.

articleTitle: The design and implement of micro autopilot system for low-altitude mapping of MAV
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To improve the precision issues of navigation measurements, flight tracking control and aerial stable platform control for the low-altitude mapping of MAV (Micro Aerial Vehicle), a flight autopilot was designed. The embedded system based on high-speed microcontroller and DSP was utilized, to realize the complex algorithms of navigation and control. The data fusion algorithms on MIMU (Micro Inertial Measurement Unit) and dual GPS module were utilized, to achieve high-precision measurement of navigation information such as attitude, heading, position. The advanced PID controllers were designed to improve the accuracy of the flight tracking control. Through the aeroboat experiment, the navigation precision for designed autopilot was compared with high-precision POS (Position and Orientation System). Through the flight experiment for MAV, high-precision tracking control was achieved, and the high-precision attitude and heading were provided for the aerial platform. The experimental results show that the autopilot can basically satisfy the requirements of low-altitude stable mapping of MAV.

articleTitle: Research and application on ground prevention technique of saturated silt sandy soil
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the saturated soft soil foundation treatment, the engineering geological characteristic of site is analyzed and the drainage consolidation method of combining static and dynamic to treat the soft soil foundation is put forward. On the basis of the tests, the saturated silt sandy soil ground prevention technique is adopted. The reinforcing mechanism, design method and construction technique are discussed. Through the data analysis of test, the results show that this technology is useful to treat large scale soft soil foundation. This research results provide valuable references for similar engineering.

articleTitle: Numerical analysis of pile foundation in huge coal silo
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Composite foundation consisting of prestressed concrete pipe pile, slab, gravel cushion and soil is used in the ground treatment of coal storage silo with big diameter. It can spread most of load to the deep soil, reducing settlement and horizontal deformation of the soil. Consequently it reduces the impact on the piles of silo structure. In this paper finite element method is used to analyze the foundation. First the factors have been analyzed that have the effect on pile-soil load sharing ratio. Second the finite element model of filling pile and pipe pile foundation has been constituted and analyzed. The results indicate that pile-soil load sharing ratio increases with cap size, gravel cushion thickness and improvement of mechanical parameters of gravel cushion.

articleTitle: Experimental study on interface friction characteristics between geosynthetics and fill materials by pull out tests
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Interface friction characteristics between geosynthetics and fill materials is an important factor to determined slope stability and tension characteristics in components of liner system in landfill, so it is essential to study the interface friction characteristics. The investigation about the interface friction characteristics of 3 kinds of geosynthetics with sand and clay were presented by pull out tests. Experimental results show: (1) Shear stress pear strength and its shear displacement are increase by the normal stress is increase. (2) Friction coefficient between geosynthetics and clay is bigger than geosynthetics and sand; (3) Friction coefficient between 3 kinds of geosynthetics and sand are arranged from high to low: geotextile, EPDM geomembrane, HDPE geomembrane; (4) The geotextiles are installed on the above and down of the HDPE geomembrane, the friction coefficient of the interface is smaller than the geotextile is installed on the above of HDPE geomembrane and the geotextile is installed on the down the HDPE geomembrane.

articleTitle: Freeport communication protocol for S7-200 Programmable Controllers
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency of data communication between S7-200 Programmable Controllers, a simple communication protocol is created with Freeport Mode. According to the test conducted on LabVIEW platform, the protocol is proved to be capable of improving the communication efficiency when sampling rate required is comparatively high and when the number of nodes within the network is limited.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation on the heating process of regenerative heating furnace affected by buoyancy force
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: On the basis of wholly analyzing the mechanism of the heat transfer in the 1880 regenerative furnace, the physical and mathematical 3-D model was set up to describe the heat transfer and combustion in the furnace, and the CFD software was used to simulate the whole combusting process. Lastly, the flow profile and the temperature field were calculated under the condition of whether to consider the buoyancy force. Comparative analysis revealed the combustion and heating process in the furnace were not affected by the buoyancy force. The research precise can be satisfied for the engineering application with no view of the buoyancy force.

articleTitle: Classification algorithm based on rough set and support vector data description
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: When training the high-dimension and large-sample objectives, the support vector data description (SVDD) may encounter the curse of dimensionality and may result in large time cost. In order to solve these problems, this paper presents a novel classification algorithm based on rough set and support vector data description (RS-SVDD) by combining the support vector machine (SVM) algorithm with the data processing function of a rough set. In this algorithm, data sets are attribute reduced according to the attribute significance, and some class boundary sets are formed by using rough boundary set as the training subsets of SVDD algorithm. Thus, the dimension and scale of the training set become less than both of the original sets, which helps to improve the performance of the algorithm. Experimental results indicate that the proposed RS-SVDD algorithm minimizes the structural risk and is superior to the SVDD algorithm in its performance.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of automated smart car system based on camera
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we have designed and implemented an automated smart car system based on camera. With the Freescale MC9S12XS128 microprocessor as its control centre, the system is consisted of both Software and Hardware. At first, the system extracts the horizontal signal and vertical signal from the camera video signal through the LM1881 external circuit, and then the MCU acquires the real time road images by capturing the horizontal and vertical interrupt signal. Combined with the continuity character of the road, the leading line position in the image can be extracted by edge detection algorithm, and then accomplish the steering and speed control of the smart car by PID algorithm. In addition, by adding the Beam Splitter at the input terminal of the camera, the system effectively lessens the impact from illumination to image formation. The system has also introduced speed measuring module to supply effective real time feedback for PID control algorithm. According to tests carried on specialized racing tracks, the system possesses great robustness and feasibility with great market prospect on a long view.

articleTitle: Optimization model of equipment maintenance
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: For the equipment incomplete preventive maintenance in a finite time interval, this paper studies on the equipment maintenance time optimization problem. Focusing on equipments with reduced failure rates, the paper aims to optimize the objective function by minimizing total maintenance costs, establish the dynamic optimization model with consideration of equipment warranty period and resale value, and design algorithms for model solutions. Example analysis shows that in the incomplete maintenance case for failure rate reduction devices, it can result in a better expectation of total maintenance costs to perform preventive maintenance during the warranty period.

articleTitle: Evaluation of steel truss construction scheme based on Vague sets
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Influenced by the period, cost, construction technique and quality, safety civilized construction, the reasonable selection of the construction scheme of large span steel truss is made with strong fuzziness and uncertainty. And at present there is no unified method of how to effectively evaluate the energy-saving residential design scheme. The evaluation of applying the fuzzy theory of Vague sets to the construction scheme of steel trusses is puts forward in this paper. On the basis of the description of the concept and the algorithm implementation of the method, the evaluation system of the construction plan was established, and the weight coefficient of each index was introduced. The effective application and the plan optimization process of that method were analyzed by using examples.

articleTitle: Design and optimization for gating system of bearing base molding
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the best gate location of the thin-walled part bearing base was chosen by using Moldflow software. Two types of gating systems, namely, point gate and disk-shaped gate were designed. By comparing with the analysis of filling, tempe rapture at flow front, volume shrinkage and weld lines of two different gating systems, the better gating system is determined. Type of gate is disk-shaped gate, which provides the basis for the entire mold design. Simulation method improves not only the efficiency of testing mold, but also quality of product.

articleTitle: The research on evaluation system for equipment manufactures
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Base on investigation and theory research, the evaluation system for equipment manufacturing enterprises has been established elementarily. In this work, the weight sub-system is discussed emphatically. An approach for inputting and calculating weight fuzzily was designed, the strategy and arithmetic for weight-regression and weight-distribution, which accord with sample characteristic, was also proposed.

articleTitle: Simulation of MR semi-active control of tracked vehicles based on road multi-input excitation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: For verifying MR semi-active control result based on LQR(linear quadratic regulator) algorithm, the author simulates the curves of displacement, acceleration, angular displacement and angular acceleration of tracked vehicle body after inputting the road excitation into five road wheels. Firstly,7 degree-of-freedom vehicle model and state equation are established under the condition of road multi-disturbance. Then, semi-active controllable forces are obtained by using LQR algorithm and Hrovat strategy. Optimal index and weighed coefficient are put forward in order to reducing the ride comfort. Finally, by simulating the road excitation of different velocity, the effect of semi-active and no control are compared and analyzed.

articleTitle: Finite element simulation system for hot rolled H-beam in finish rolling process
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In the finish rolling process, the internal information of H-beam is not visible. To address this issue, a finite element simulation system for hot rolled H-beam has been developed based on ABAQUS. The system with re-meshing technique to achieve continuous rolling, which could automatically simulate the rolling process to avoid the cumbersome work in pre-processing, and analyze the distribution of temperature, stress and strain in rolling for every pass, is proposed. The accuracy of the system is verified through comparative result of finite element simulation and field data collected by infrared thermometer for H400×200. The system can be used to optimize rolling process and develop new H-beam types.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of low-cost scissors gate control system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A low-cost scissors gate control system was achieved in this paper, which has many front controllers based on real-time operating system of free FreeRTOS, open-source uIP, and ARM Cortex-M3 MCU. This system realized a ID interface by using rfid technology or two-dimensional codes. Also TCP/IP data channel, gate control, information management and so on were carried out in this system. Moreover this paper described the implementation of the system. According to the actual situations, it indicated that this system runned reliably and stably.

articleTitle: Characteristic and Metabolic pathways of 2,6-Di-tert-butylphenol degradation by Alcaligenes F-3-4
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: An aerobic bacterial strain Alcaligenes F-3-4 was isolated from an acrylic fiber wastewater. This strain was able to degrade 2,6-di-tert-butylphenol. The bacterium growth and 2,6-DTBP degradation was determined. Result showed, the lag period was extended when increasing the concentration of 2,6-DTBP. At 37°C and at log period, the degrading rate for 100.0 mg/L 2,6-DTBP could reach 86% within 12 d. Metabolic pathways of 2,6-DTBP degradation by Alcaligenes F-3-4 was studied. The results showed that the intermediate products are acetic acid, pyruvic acid, isobutyric acid, and so on. Identified metabolites and catabolic enzymes illustrate that the used bacterial strain attacks the benzene skeleton at the 2,3- position, and it also demethylates 2,6-DTBP. Metabolic pathways of degradation of 2,6-DTBP are proposed.

articleTitle: Acquisition method research of parallel stereo binocular vision based on linear laser scanning
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to acquire the data of the object in reverse engineering, the parallel binocular stereo vision acquisition system is built based on the linear laser scanning. Two cameras are placed parallel, simultaneously acquire the light strips of laser light on the object. By means of preprocessing the image, distiling the laser light strips, refining the light strips and matching the image, the three-dimensional coordinates of light stripes are calculated using vision disparity of the image, and finally all three-dimensional point cloud obtained in various locations of light strips is displayed in the same world coordinates.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The growth risk identification method of small and medium real estate brokerage business
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Route and countermeasures for the establishment of ecological cultural tourism environment
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Tourism brings certain negative influence to the environment and ecology, so it's a very hard task to protect the resources of tourism ecological environment. The establishment of ecological cultural tourism environment is a very important subject for us. The tourism ecological environment has certain development across the globe, and our tourism environment needs further improving. In the paper, it analyzes the root of ecological tourism environment deterioration and the objective of ecological tourism, and puts forward the route and countermeasures for the establishment of ecological and cultural tourism environment through analysis. It states that both development and protection of natural ecological tourism environment and humanistic ecological tourism environment shall be executed, both size and speed of the development shall be controlled and both development and protection are important; the historical context shall be passed and national folk customs shall be relied on; the ecological civilization construction shall be strengthened and the concept of sustainable environment development shall be initiated for the purpose of environment protection and protection of human natural landscape and cultural heritage.

articleTitle: Global dynamics of a functionally graded material rectangular plate
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Global dynamics of a simply supported functionally graded materials (FGM) rectangular plate are studied using the extended Melnikov method for the first time. The FGM plate is subjected to the transversal and in-plane excitations. Material properties are assumed to be temperature-dependent. A two-degree-of-freedom nonlinear system governing equations of motion for the FGM rectangular plate is derived using the Hamilton's principle and the Galerkin's method. The averaged equations are obtained by the method of multiple scales. After transforming the averaged equations into a standard form, the extended Melnikov method is employed to show the existence of multi-pulse chaotic dynamics. Numerical simulations illustrate that there exist chaotic responses for the FGM rectangular plate.

articleTitle: Research on state estimation of regional power grid based on improved least squares method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Fundamental principle and function of state estimation software in regional power system are described in this paper. The weighted least square method based on fixed Jacobian matrix combined with the orthogonal transform is used for algorithm. A good stability in computing value and computing speed can be obtained by using the algorithm. The method of state forecast combined with standard residuals is used for detecting bad data to ensure estimation accuracy.

articleTitle: Chinese Ancient Ruler Research
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As part of the study of Chinese classical architectural aesthetics, first, the paper gives a brief review of China's ancient ruler with conversion relations for the Protection of Ancient Building. Then the analysis of existing problems is given out, that summary list of official history records the conversion relations. Based on these, the new conversion relationships between ancient ruler and the present one are recommended.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Cloud computing based on internet of things
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The passenger door system and its control principle on Shenzhen Metro Line 2
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper mainly describes the types of the metro passenger car doors, making an introduction of the structure and the control principles on passenger car doors of Shenzhen Metro NO. Line 2.

articleTitle: The research of insulation failure on signals transmission in electrical connector
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The degradation of insulation materials of the multi contacts electrical connector often resulted in malfunction of the electronic system in harsh environment, due to which, we put up a model for the electrical connector with degraded insulation and the simulation for the model was also investigated. It was found that a current leakage channel was formed because of the degradation of the insulation which reduced the resistance of the insulation materials markedly. Through the channel the signals between the two contacts affected each other , the result of which was that the signals turned to be the mixed one of the signals in different contacts, and as the resistance of the insulation materials reduced , the signal is distorted badly and badly.

articleTitle: Principles of an in-process monitoring system for precision grinding machine
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Monitoring system is an economic and effective method for quality control in automatic manufacturing. The complexity of the grinding process asks higher requests on the monitoring system compared with conventional ones widely used in heavy industry. The paper is dedicated to monitoring techniques in precision grinding. Existing monitoring methods centering round single grinding process quantity are talked about. Multi-sensor fusion is the only way to improve monitoring reliability. Under the frame of the intelligence grinding system, a two-layer in-process monitoring system for precision grinding machine is brought forward to realize quality control, machine healthy maintenance, wheel life expiration judgment and parameters optimization.

articleTitle: Layout design for high strength steel automotive structural parts based on UG-PDW
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The automotive installation soleplate part researched in this paper is made by the high strength steel. It has a very complex shape and is difficult to be deformed. The forming processes of the installation soleplate part include blanking, deep drawing, local forming and bending, etc. To obtain the reasonable strip layout design and the multi-position progressive die with the characteristics of high precision, high efficiency and long-life, the Progressive Die Wizard (PDW) module of UG NX was adopted, and the formability of the installation soleplate part was analyzed in detail by the one-step inverse forming analysis method. The advantages and disadvantages of the single-row and double-row layout patterns was compared and analyzed, and the double-row layout with intermediate carrier was finally designed. The results show that the high material utilization of workpiece and more uniform load of die can be obtained by the double-row layout with intermediate carrier, which is more suitable for the mass production. The progressive die with 13 positions was manufactured accordingly and used for the practical production. An annual production output of one million parts of was achieved.

articleTitle: The frequency scaling ratio factor of rain attenuation in Ka waveband along earth-space path in China
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Utilizing the parameters of 58 typical earth- stations within China and ITU-R rain attenuation model, the rain attenuation and rain attenuation ratio at different frequencies in Ka waveband of 58 earth- stations along earth-space paths are calculated. The expression of the rain attenuation frequency scaling ratio factor in Ka waveband is obtained using the numerical method. Its prediction results are better than that of ITU-R in China.

articleTitle: Track gauge dynamic measurement based on 2d laser displacement sensor
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Track irregularities can cause deterioation of riding comfort and derailment.Track gauge variation is one of the basic track irregularities. Track Recording Car is an automated track inspection vehicle on a rail transport system used to test several geometric parameters of the track. Track geomeotry parameters generally measured include position, speed, gauge, alignment, crosslevel, curvature and so on. This paper presents a novel technique for the measurement of track gauge variation, a new measurement system was introduced and been in assembled on a new type underground track recoring car.

articleTitle: Impact analysis on pedestrian traffic flow in weave area of building
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Simulation is an effective method to study pedestrian flow. In order to analyze the impact of weave area of building on pedestrian flow, taking advantage of simulation platform based on minimum cost algorithm to simulate uni-direction pedestrian flow and weave pedestrian flow at 60°, 90° and 120° in building. Volume, density, velocity and other feature parameters were obtained through simulation platform. Taking the capacity and journey time of uni-direction pedestrian flow and weave pedestrian flow to compare, the results showed that the capacity of weave area of pedesrian flow at 90° decreases most, and the delay of weave area of pedestrian flow at 120° is max.

articleTitle: Research on indirect lighting protection for military power supply
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to lightning protection characteristics and the existing problems of military power supply, the electromagnetic transient model of key part in lighting protection such as generator, control unit and cables based on PSCAD/EMTDC power simulation software is established. The dispersed- continuous separation modeling method of electronic power device in military power supply is suggested. The indirect lightning protection for military power system is presented. It is mainly through installing SPD on the ports of electric supply line, power supply line and signal line, shielding and filtering for protection of indirect lightning. Finally, the lighting protection module device that is in high probability and security is developed and indirect lighting protection and all weather flight ability of military power supply is improved.

articleTitle: Optimization study of automatic transmission power shift schedule
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Presented in this paper is the shift points determining method of the power shift schedule when the traction power curve does not intersect under the adjacent shift of the same throttle. Established the transmission system mathematics model. Built a software in-the-loop simulation platform with Matlab/Simulink, and simulate the process of the vehicle continuous upshift. The simulation results showed that the power shift schedule can improve the power of vehicles. At the same time, its speed is much higher than the speed which is the traditional power shift schedule to reach.

articleTitle: Relay node selection and game theory-based power allocation in the cooperative networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Efficient allocation of resources plays a vital role in cooperative communications. Based on the multiple distributed amplify-and forward relays network model, this paper proposes a relay node selection method and game theory-based power control scheme. Mathematical analysis proves the existence of Nash equilibrium. The proposed methods take both the relay node selection and power allocation into account. Simulation results show that the methods have low complexity and fast convergence. With power control according to the channel sate information (CSI), power assumption of both the source and relay can be effectively reduced while increasing the capacity of the destination node.

articleTitle: Research progress of a GIS-based DRASTIC model
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the mature development of Geographic Information System (GIS) and wide use of the DRASTIC (Depth to water, Net recharge, Aquifer media, Soil media, Topography, Impact of the vadose zone and hydraulic Conductivity) model, a GIS-based DRASTIC model has been a main method in groundwater vulnerability assessment. This paper gives an overview of the characteristics of the GIS-based DRASTIC model, analyses the research advances of improved model at home and abroad, including reasonable adjustment of evaluation indices, the coupling of the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) and the fuzzy mathematics theory, and discusses the trends of further research as well.

articleTitle: Anti-jamming communication decision engine based on Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To improve the scientific and efficiency of anti-jamming communication system, this paper design an in anti-jamming communication decision engine based on Particle Swarm Optimization for multiple parameters selecting adaptively. The procedure of the proposed method is presented. Simulation is made in six models, the results show that the decision engine can make the parameters select adaptively, which also enhances the constringency speed than those by Genetic Algorithm.

articleTitle: Inversion of geomagnetic north-pole using GPS signal and Klobuchar ionospheric algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the influence of ionosphere on geomagnetic field, this paper tried to estimate the position of geomagnetic north-pole in geographic coordinates, via using GPS signal and Klobuchar model, and established the corresponding mathematical model. It is verified that the method is feasible by theoretical analysis and simulated data. and that the improved regional Klobuchar model and the perfection of the algorithm are in favor of the reliability and accuracy of the estimation of geomagnetic north pole.

articleTitle: The study on the Effect of virtual current distribution in an electromagnetic flow meter with bubble
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Electromagnetic flow meters are widely used in multiphase flow measurements in recent years. In this paper, a simulation model is established to study the Effects of virtual current distribution in an Electromagnetic Flow Meter which exist a spherical non-conductive body in the Fluid by using ANSYS. Furthermore, the characteristics of virtual current distribution and the flow meter errors by changes the size of bubble are discussed. For application, the results provide a possible way to estimate errors of the flow meter caused by multiphase flow.

articleTitle: Study on micro-polluted raw water treatment by rectangular biological sedimentation tanks
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Two reactors simulated rectangular sedimentation tank were used to treat micro-polluted raw water under same conditions. The reactor No.l simulated rectangular sedimentation tank and rectangular biological sedimentation tank was simulated by the reactor No.2, in which three dimensional elastic fillers were hanged. The process of biofilm developing in the reactor No.2 was researched to determine the optimal retention time of the reactor No.2. After determine the best retention time, comparing ammonia, CODMn, turbidity and other water quality indicators in the two reactors that operated steadily was used to compare the treatment effect of organic. Then, the factors that affect the removal of ammonia were analyzed. The results show that the reactor No.2 could hang the biofilm naturally and successfully and its optimal retention time is 1.5h. In the process of stable operation, the removal rates of ammonia, CODMn, turbidity in the reactor No.2 are 30.07%, 21.78% and 76.76% respectively that are all above the reactor No.1. So hanging the biofilm in the rectangular sedimentation tanks to treat micro-polluted raw water has a certain research value.

articleTitle: Registration method for scattered cloud data based on feature points
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Registration of scattered cloud data is an important topic in model construction. Firstly, local geometric characteristic of point clouds is expressed by point feature. Then, coarse registration is implemented based on feature points selected. By reducing search scope of matching points and accelerating search speed based on k-d tree, the conventional ICP algorithm is improved. Experiment results show that it is valid.

articleTitle: Ductility performance of reinforced concrete frame structure with specially shaped columns
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Expounded research techniques and influencing factors of reinforced concrete's ductility are studied in detailed. The constitutive relationship is selected between concrete and reinforce during simulation and analysis, a Three-ply reinforced concrete frame structure with specially shaped columns is simulated by finite elements program of ANSYS. The results of simulated approached to experimental dates. Which mean that use ANSYS program simulated ductility performance of reinforced concrete frame structure with specially shaped columns under reversed cyclic load is feasible. The simulation reflected the ductility of reinforced concrete frame structure, in which from load-on till destruction, is perfectly. Compared to other parts, bearing is the weak point of the framework, strengthening the bearing parts is the key to improve the bearing capacity of the whole project. In order to meet the engineering requirements, increasing the bearing cross-section dimensions, the reinforcement of the bearings and other measures can strengthen the shear capacity of the bearings.

Author Keywords: frame structure with specially shaped columns

articleTitle: Motion analysis of conjugate side about opposed biconical cone screw high-pressure seawater hydraulic pump
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to study the movement principle about the conjugate side of a new type opposed biconical cone screw high-pressure seawater hydraulic pump, motion analysis of the opposed biconical cone screw high-pressure seawater hydraulic pump is carried out by the establishment of surface equation, the surface and the solid model about the cone screw and bush which are the main components of the seawater hydraulic pump. Analysis show that the curves of the section central point's displacement, velocity and acceleration about the screw in each axis component are the periodic curves, the period of the curves in two axis of the end is the time which the screw runs around, the period of the curves in axial direction is the time which the screw runs a half cycle, the trajectory about the section central point of the screw is "lip curve" ; the curves of the each point on exterior surface about the screw in each axis component are sine or cosine curves, the cycle of the curves in two axis of the end is the time which the screw runs around, the cycle of the curves in axial direction is the time which the screw runs a half cycle, the trajectories about the different exterior surface point of the screw is different size oval.

articleTitle: Study on the emergency system engineering construction scheme for the urban water supply in Dongguan city
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: China is a country short of water resources, what's more, kinds of pollution accidents occur constantly. Water pollution not only influences the security of urban water supply , but also brings with huge economic loss. So optimizing the emergency water supply has been an important problem to be solved urgently. This paper takes Dongguan city as a instance to study the engineering construction of urban emergency water supply system, analyze practical means for the emergency water supply, and construct the cost model of the emergency water supply. The aim is to find a economical and advisable emergency water treatment scheme and provide a guidance for the emergency water supply system.

articleTitle: The experimental study on biomass gasification characteristic by the influence of fluidized bed reaction temperature
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on self-built fluidized bed biomass gasifier bench in Laboratory, carried out on the test of atmospheric gasification on the sawdust with air of the atmospheric pressure. Analysised the component, production rate, calorific value, carbon conversion rate and gasification efficiency of the biomass gas, then concluded the variation of those indicators according to the curve drawn by the experimental data. It is a reference for engineering application.

articleTitle: Research on effect of simultaneous nitrification denitrification under step-feed with three-stage catching bed reactor
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Three-stage catching bed reactor was used to treat domestic wastewater from residential area through the step feed in order to get high efficiency of simultaneous nitrification denitrification(SND). The effect of 3 influent flow rate distribution ratios (λ) on the removal of COD NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N and TN was investigated under the conditions of hydraulic retention time (HRT) =8h, DO=1.0~2.0mg/L and sludge reflux rate of 100%. The removal efficiency of TN and NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup>-N reached at 70.9%-. 96.4% separately when λ was 3 : 4 : 3; When λ was controlled in 4 : 3 : 3; 62.7% of average TN removal rate was obtained and the removal efficiency of NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> -N was 95.8%; When λ was adjusted to 5 : 3 : 2 , the removal efficiency of TN decreased to 58.5% .However, nitrification is still very good, 90.6% of average NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">+</sup> -N removal rate was achieved. And more than 90% of average COD removal rate was obtained under the three projects of flow rate distribution.

articleTitle: Interfacial debonding stress in cracked RC beams strengthened with CFRP
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Analytic analysis is applied for interfacial stress in cracked RC beams strengthened with CFRP, and analytic solutions to debongding stress distribution are obtained on the basis of differential equations of the interfacial stresses of composite plate. Through instance calculation, influence on debonding stress distribution by anchorage length and the same area of CFRP plate with different widthes and thicknesses are studied, shear-debonding interaction is also estimated, which may provide some theoretic guidance for design and construction for CFRP-strengthened concrete structure.

articleTitle: Energy consumption and GDP growth in Beijing: Cointegration and causality analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The Johansen cointegration technique and the vector correction model (VECM) are used to examine the causal relationship between energy consumption (LEC) and gross domestic product (LGDP) for Beijing during the period of 1980 to 2008. Results indicate that LEC and LGDP for Beijing are related by one cointegrating vector and there is a long-run unidirectional causal relationship from GDP to energy consumption. The finding has significant implications from the point of view of energy conservation, emission reduction and economic development.

articleTitle: Assessment on the value of ecosystem service of important protected area for water supply of city
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Objective assessment on the value of ecosystem service of protected area for water supply is very important to eco environmental protection of protected area for water supply, comprehensive management of water resources and eco compensation. The article structured a assessment system based on the classify of ecosystem service of protected area for water supply, which consisted of five values of ecosystem services: food production, gas adjustment, climate adjustment, hydrology adjustment and waste disposure, and quantifying assessed these values taking the Yunlong Reservoir of Kunming as a example. The result showed that the total value of ecosystem service of protected area for water supply is 6.139 hundreds of million, including direct use value is 0.191 hundreds of million and indirect use value is 5.948 hundred millions; adjustment service value is greater than supply service value, and the former is 31 times to the latter; the service value of forest ecosystem is 4.806 hundreds of million, and occupying 80% of the total value of study area, the service value of water area ecosystem is 1.009 hundreds of million, occupying 16.44%, and farmland only occupying 5.28%; the value of hydrology adjustment is the highest, the value of gas adjustment is close to the one of climate adjustment, the one of waste disposure takes second place and the one of food production is the lowest. In addition, the study thinks that the assessment method of ecosystem service of protected area for water supply is feasible, and combining with the types of land can make the research result having reality significance and guiding. But the research only assessed the value of current situation, and the further study should focus on the change value and space influence of ecosystem service.

Author Keywords: Assessment on the value of ecosystem service
The ecosystem of protected area for water supply
Protecter area for drinking water supply of city

articleTitle: Effect of the pH values on growth of Microcystis aeruginosa
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Growth of Microcystis aeruginosa at different initial pH values was studied under acidic or basic culture condition, and to probe the growth speed, the pH values, nitrogen, phosphorus and UV 254 in the residual medium.
