Using the membership functions theory in fuzzy mathematic, membership functions was established for evaluating indicators in two levels of the evaluation model and durability was evaluated by two level fuzzy overall evaluation models. Project example indicates that assessment result coincides with the actual situation and the method is feasible and acceptable.

articleTitle: Study on automatic assembly technology for complicated gear trains based on topological unit
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: First the concept of topological unit was given in this paper. Five forms were proposed for compound complex topological graphs by using topology unit. Developed a drawing interface for human-computer interaction, this interface finished the work of graph drawing; graphic changes; split the complex topological graph; and the function of automatic assembly of epicyclic gear trains. Second, new methods of topological inversion were given, which facilitated the expression of the topology of computer information extraction. Finally, the series combination of topological elements as an example, an assembly process of epicyclic gear trains was given.

articleTitle: Test of post-fire bearing capacity of the circular steel tube with different coating
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to look into the post-fire bearing capacity of the steel tabular columns protected with different materials, the fire test was conducted for a set of circular steel tubes protected with different materials such as gypsum fireproof panel, bamboo plywood and the ordinary lumber core plywood, and the steel tube without any protective material. The axial compressive bearing capacity of the specimens after exposure to fire are tested and analyzed. The test results show that the post-fire bearing capacity of the steel tubes protected with different materials varies evidently, and the maximum value of response temperature has the greatest effect. Finally comparison of the test result and the result given with existing rule is made, and the computational formula of post-fire bearing capacity of the steel tabular short column is put forward by imitation.

articleTitle: Mechanics-action analysis and research about wheelset dismantler in pressed conditions
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Process flow of wheelset dismantler and the necessity of mechanics analysis about it are described in this paper. The mechanics-action of wheelset dismantler's connected beam in press-fit condition is analysed using universal finite element software ANSYS, connected beaam stresses and deformations are calculated and compared each other. The results indicate that the maximum stress of connected beam in the press-fit condition is all less than the yield stress, and it also proves that strength and stiffness of connected meet the strength and precision of wheelset press-fit.

articleTitle: The role of the ancient capital of Luoyang in the development of space form factors
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: China's ancient capitals formed unique urban space form system in the long historical development, the most representative among which, was metropolis space constrainted strongly by orthodox etiquette thoughts. As the capital of thirteen dynasties, Luoyang is the most representative in metropolis space, as its evolution process reflects all the features from early to mid stage of China's ancient capital city space form. By analyzing the development during the important periods of Luoyang through researching literature materials, it can be concluded that with constantly improving of etiquette thoughts, its space form improved ceaselessly and eventually comes to the metropolis space form marked by Chinese monarchy rules characteristics. Thus it can be clearly understood the development and change rules of metropolis space form, which can provide important reference for research in China's ancient capitals space form in later period.

articleTitle: The combined model of reliability analysis for stability in gravity dam
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In these factor which influence the stability of gravity dam,the random factor and the bounded factor of uncertainty often exist at the same time, the situation which can not be adapt if we introduce to single analysis model. So we proposed the ideas and methods that build the analysis model which combine the probability with non-probability to evaluation of stable reliability for gravity dam. And using the combined model evaluate the stable reliability of a gravity dam,which demonstrate that the combined model can better adapted evaluation of stable reliability for gravity dam than another model.

articleTitle: Impact force analysis for ship-bridge collisions
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The impact force during ship-bridge collision based on quasi-static mechanics and impact dynamic are analyzed and compared. How the wave propagation and the dynamic behavior of materials influence the impact force are studied from the view point of stress wave propagation.

articleTitle: Design of monitor program based on status analysis for intelligent blood glucose meter
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a method of monitor program design based on status analysis , by taking the portable blood glucose meter for example. And the process of monitor program design are given. For monitor program design of one-key multifunction system, the method is really realized multifunction and is more keeping with needs of field measurement.

articleTitle: Remote control system for LED lighting based on CAN bus
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Introducing a design method of remote control system for LED lighting based on CAN bus. In this system, the master node can remote monitor several slave nodes by CAN communication and will analysis the running parameters and monitor the current state of the slave node. It is very reliable and effective for suppressing interference. It is easy to connect a new CAN node.

articleTitle: Analysis on surrounding rock stress in highway tunnel construction
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to actual engineering of a highway neighborhood tunnel, The surrounding rock stress field monitoring of bench cut method has done and the field monitoring data has been compared with numerical simulation results. The result shows: The surrounding rock stress release with time in excavation, every construction step can effect the stress of surrounding rock and lining. The construction of excavation and the secondary can disturb the surrounding rock stress near another tunnel in neighborhood tunnel. After the completion of secondary lining, the stress of primary lining have decreased and secondary lining receives apart of surrounding pressure.

articleTitle: Research on the removal of algae by inorganic-organic compound modified bentonite
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By the new environment-friendly surfactant (C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</inf> Alkyl glucoside quaternary ammonium) and inorganic modifier (aluminum chloride) modified bentonite, study on the removal of algae with the dosage of organic and inorganic modifier, the concentration of modified bentonite and pH value. The result shows the modified bentonite provides a good condition in the removal of algae after the modified bentonite has been greatly improved in the structure and performance. Under the AlCl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> · 6H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O dosage of 4mmol/g, organic modifier dosage of 8mmol/g, modified bentonite concentration of 250mg/L and pH value of 6 to7, the effect on removal of algae will reach best.

articleTitle: Study on atomization and evaporation property of biodiesel
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The No.0 diesel was selected to mix with biodiesel made by rough soybean oil in ten different proportions to form the mixed fuels. Their flash point, distillation temperature, kinematic viscosity and density were tested. On the basis of atomization quality evaluation for fuel, the comparison among biodiesel/diesel blend fuel was analyzed by using high resolving power digital camera. This paper calculated droplet size distribution, cumulative droplet size distribution based on volume and mean diameter. The results indicate that the evaporation property indexes of biodiesel are worse than those of diesel. When biodiesel mixed ratio increases, mean diameters of the fuel droplet of spray increase, curves of fuel droplet size number distribution and cumulative droplet size distribution based on volume move toward larger diameters. It shows that the higher the biodiesel mixed ratio is, the worse the atomization quality is.

articleTitle: Simulation of prestressed concrete channel quality test by different electric heating method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Due to lack of effective detection method, channel quality accidents of post-tensioned concrete construction cannot be discovered on time. An infrared detection principle based on electric heating is intended to be put forward to solve the above mentioned problem. Two main electrify methods, continuously or intermittently, are discussed. The results of the numeric simulation on the temperature field of a prestressed concrete component indicate that the electric heating infrared detection technology, for its energy consumption, efficiency and safety, is feasible for detecting the channel quality of prestressed concrete component, but the electrify method, continuously or intermittently, needs to be designed to avoid high thermal stress which will damage the strand and the concrete.

articleTitle: Application of preview control in linear motor servo mechanism
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Servo mechanism and its control system play an important role in numerical control machine tool. Based on the analysis of the features and the requirement of the equipment of micro-EDM, linear motor is adopted in the micro-EDM system because of its excellent performance of high resolution, high precision, high speed and quick response. Simulation results verify that the servo mechanism and preview control system can improve the machining efficiency.

articleTitle: Testing electric resistivity with method of whirling currents
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This essay introduces the experimenting principles and methods of testing electric resistivity with method of whirling currents by measuring silicon samples. Compared the results with that of of the classical testing with tetrapolar poles it shows this experiment method is more complicated but the results are reliable. It can measure the electric resistivity of the semiconductor materials within ta wider range. It is more precise and practical when the electric resistivity of the testing samples is big.

articleTitle: GIS-based decision support system for urban land expansion
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The system makes software Arc View GIS as a platform, according to the management information system theory, the use of GIS technology and module design technology and object-oriented programming techniques, design and develop the urban land expansion of decision support system, its main function of the urban land expansion and The process of urban expansion of its land use planning two additional sub-systems to achieve, to support urban management personnel during the course of urban land expansion of urban fringe land use planning decision-making nature, intended to illustrate the process of urban expansion, urban fringe land use changes in the nature, The proportion of primary industry of the city and its rate of increase of prices.

articleTitle: FEM analysis of treating expressway widening project with geocell
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to study the treating effect of geocell on the widening expressway, the Coulomb friction model was used for simulating the nonlinear contact between the geocell composite body and filling of new subgrade, the vertical settlement and lateral displacement and relative settlement of the widening subgrade at various situation which included the different geocell depth of penetrating into the original subgrade and the different width of paved geocell were analyzed. The calculation results showed that the application of geocell can distribute the stress uniformly, and the differential settlement between the new and original subgrade is nearly eliminated. But the treating effect was not proportional to the increase in the width of the geocell and the depth of the geocell penetrating into the original subgrade.

articleTitle: Influence of pH value on availability of heavy metals in municipal sludge
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The availability of heavy metals in four kinds of sludge under the influence of different pH values are studied in the paper. According to the experiment results, the pH value has an important influence on the mobility and bioavailability of heavy metals in sludge. The lower the pH value of sludge is, the less heavy metals are absorped and the more they are released.

articleTitle: Linear generalized synchronization construction of chaotic systems with different dimensions
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a method of generalized synchronization construction of chaotic systems with different dimensions is proposed,where the dimension of response system is not less than the drive system.This approach doesn't require the stability of the linear part of the drive system,so that the application area is wider.Via the pole placement technique,the synchronization speed can be adjusted.The new Lorenz system illustrates the proposed approach is effective.

articleTitle: Damage identification of reinforced concrete beams
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As the acquaintance with the safety of structure is improved, the structure health monitoring play a more important role, in which damage identification is a key problem. In this paper, for reinforced concrete beams, β index and η index based on flexibility matrix are proposed to detect damage. Two RC beams with a span of 7m are tested and the proposed indexes are used to identify damages.

articleTitle: Development of internet of things for vehicle to promote electric vehicles large-scale demonstration application in Chinese cities
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Electric vehicles is a new energy and environmentally friendly vehicles. But in the process of development and popularization of electric vehicles, China is facing many difficulties. By introducing a convenient rental system for electric vehicles based on internet of things for vehicle, electric vehicles can be applied in large-scale in Chinese cities.

articleTitle: The stress and deformation analaysis of repair welding on the excavator bucket bandle
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: For a solution of repair welding, the welding process of the entire multi-layer multi-channel is simulated and analyzed. The results show that has the big welding residual stress and distortion nearby welding joint as a whole, the residual stress is bigger away from the welding joint nearer, and the residual stress existence's high-risk spot is revealed. It provides a theoretical basis for the enterprise to effectively predict welding residual stress and plastic deformation and further reduces residual stress and controls deformation, and is made of guidance function for reasonable choice welding process and the technological parameters.

articleTitle: Study on active time-saving control system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of economy, energy supply is more and more penurious, and fuel price is rising. In many parts of the world, it takes the time-electricity price system in which the ratio of peak and valley price is 4:1 or even higher. In order to make a valuable use of power resources, this paper introduces an advanced active time-saving control system, which makes the full use of time-price differential under the circumstances to achieve the intelligent control to energy valley and peak. Experiment shows that the system is simple, has reasonable structure, easy to install, has high energy saving rate and so on.

articleTitle: Soil microbial biomass carbon, nitrogen and nitrogen mineralization of grazing intensity response
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The study on the soil organic metter, microbial biomass, C and N of meadow grassland under the different condition of grazing intensity, showed that the different condition of grazing intensity has an effect on the soil organic metter, microbial biomass, C and N, the soil organic metter in the area of fence and light grazing higher than that of moderate and heavy grazing(P<0.05), the soil microbial biomass of fence area has significant differences from moderate and heavy grazing area (P<0.05), the soil microbial biomass and N have significant differences under the different type of grazing. Following the increasing of the soil depth, the soil organic metter, microbial biomass, C and N will decrease.

articleTitle: Developing clean energy scientifically according to reasonable division
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to the clean energy developing program and present situation of China, this paper devides provinces into four areas, and then raises staggered plan which suited for the demands of low carbon economy.

articleTitle: Ground source heat pump system reconstruction and analysis of technical feasibility
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This dissertation analyzed air conditioning of ground source heat pump and got operation problems of ground source heat pump; Then works instance as the research object, its operating characteristics were monitored. Through the technical feasibility analysis, the rehabilitation programs of application were proposed. Use of solar energy as an auxiliary can solve the problems of ground source heat pump in the operation. The air conditioning system of the combined heating and cooling has obvious economic advantages and social benefits.

articleTitle: A method is proposed to optimize signal gain and noise for broadband FRA
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A method is proposed to optimize the coupling differential equation of multiwave pumped fiber Raman amplifier and to solve the boundary problem of backward pump based on small signal theory. And, a genetic algorithm is used to approach the flatness of signal gain and noise spectra simultaneously.

articleTitle: Study on durability experiment of sub-sea tunnel grouting materials
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Leakage and corrosion of seawater from fracture zone have a significant impact on sub-sea tunnel due to the complexity of geology condition. Grouting is an important measure to consolidate fracture zone and prevent the leakage of sea-water. In order to get a good effect on controlling the high pressure water leakage in sub-sea tunnel, the application of durable grouting materials is an important factor. The paper introduces the conception of grouting durability and analyses all kinds of eroding factors to sub-sea tunnel grouting materials. Indoor experiments aiming at all durability targets are carried on. The results of experiments show the applicability of grouting materials in the sub-sea tunnel grouting project and provide guidance to some similar research on engineering materials.

articleTitle: Applied research of RFID cigarette pallet management system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper describes the development of RFID background and the advantages and disadvantages of the Cigarette pallet, the radio frequency identification technology has been fully described in the cigarette pallet management system and research. Has analyzed the questions of the RFID cigarette pallet which exist in the warehousing management process and proposed solutions .Combining with bar code technology, used in warehouse management systems will have a broad prospect of developing.

articleTitle: Three-Phase asynchronous Motor Soft-starter via Thyristor for civic water supply system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article introduces Three-Phase asynchronous Motor Soft-starter via Thyristor that is suitable for civic water supply system. It analyzes circuit structure and software for the controller and selects control mode of the soft-starter. The unit improves motor start and stop characteristics, effectively eliminates “water-hammer” effect caused by traditional direct start and stop, and is making more and more important positive impacts on civic water supply system.

articleTitle: The control system and algorithm of brushless DC motor based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to the characteristic of brushless DC motor (BLDCM), taking full advantage of high-speed computation ability of DSP and hardware resources of FPGA, a system of BLDCM is designed based on DSP. In this paper, hardware of this system is introduced firstly, and the effect of each part is presented. Subsequently, design of self -adaptive fuzzy PID controller, as well as superiority of the corresponding algorithm are discussed.

articleTitle: Progress of unilateral contact buckling of steel skin sheet in composite wall
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Steel-concrete composite wall is a novel composite structure composed of thin sheet steel outer skin filled with light weight concrete. The composite wall panel can be used as bearing member and also as maintenance structural plate, which can satisfy functional requirement of building including bearing capacity, heat insulation and preservation. As a concerned matter in engineering field, investigation progress of unilateral contact buckling of steel skin sheet is presented by summary, analysis and contrast of relevant results.

articleTitle: Mobile machine control in the internet of things
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the Internet of Things, a new times of mobile machine control will come. Meanwhile,some new problems will come too. Speak ordinarily, a mobile machine control system should have the properties of realtimeness, stability, reliability, and control precision. But in the environment of the Internet of Things, the transmission of wireless signal is unstable, that may affect the performance of a mobile machine control system. In this paper, some countermeasures are proposaled, which include the combination of remote control and automatic control, the combination of large-scale remote controll and small-scale control, and the combination of global centralized control strategy and local distributed control strategy. By these methods, we can improve reliability and ensure the realtimeness, stability, and control precision of a mobile machinery control system.

articleTitle: Analysis on the worst load angle of Z-shaped concrete columns
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The worst load angle of Z-shaped section reinforced concrete column is calculated at double bias voltage in the method of numerical analysis. The variation of the worst load angle according to different material characteristics and section is analyzed. It is shown that, material characteristics of concrete, reinforcing steel etc. almost has no effect on the worst load angle of Z-type section column, while the variation of section aspect ratio and the ratio of height to thickness has an obvious effect on the worst load angle. In the paper, the equations of correlations is regressed according to calculated results.

Author Keywords: the ratio of height to thickness

articleTitle: The study on phosphorus forms in central and southern distribution of Hongze lake
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Hongze lake is the largest Plains Lake of the Huai River. Hongze lake water quality have a great impact on production and living to the surrounding more than ten million residents. In this paper, using an improved Seven-step sequential extraction method to analysis all forms of phosphorus 5 sampling points in sediments of Hongze lake. To prevent eutrophication of Hongze lake provide the theoretical basis, research the distribution of phosphorus in sediments and its possible impact to Hongze Lake.

articleTitle: The discussion on recyclable cultural buildings for exhibition in the creative Park
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes and compares the two representative groups cultural buildings which located in the Creative Park of Shenzhen and Hangzhou, These two projects are both the kind of the recyclable cultural buildings for exhibition, which is conformation through the transformation of the existing plant, and make it change of its function , the common points of both of them are the art spaces which came from the recyclable industry buildings, but there are different planning orientation and design strategies in both of them.

articleTitle: Sprayed concrete construction technology applications in bridge reinforcement
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The Sprayed concrete construction technologies are introduced to strengthening the bridge, analyzing its application scope and corresponding characteristics. The method of prestressed bars under support type-sprayed concrete reinforcement is easy to construct and guarantee the construction quality, with good ties between the original bridge and felt, reducing the loss of prestress, also preventing levers of corrosion, increasing the cross-sectional area of the beams, and raising bearing capacity of original bridge. The method of PC wire bundle-sprayed concrete reinforcement technique is well used in simple equipments without reducing obstacle clearance; and if taking half of the bridge construction measures and sprayed concrete as protecting enlarge layer of bundled steel wires, the bridge can be reinforced without breaking the traffic.

articleTitle: Optimal design of Flywheel Energy Storage System rotor supported by AMB
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Flywheel Energy Storage System is an efficient and environmental friendly battery, and a rotor dynamics analysis is necessary as the rotor working in a high rotating speed. In this paper, a rotor dynamics analysis of a Flywheel Energy Storage System rotor was carried out by Prohl-Myklestad method, got the critical speeds and unbalance response which are useful for further work. In order to reduce the impact of rotor vibration, an optimization was given with the result that the displacement of some key points fall of 40%.

articleTitle: Dielectric properties of the polyaniline/Zinc oxide composite
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Polyaniline(PAni) was prepared by an in situ polymerization in aqueous solution, and PAni/ZnO composite was synthesized by mechanical method. The composite was characterized using X-ray diffraction (XRD), Ultraviolet-visible spectrometer (UV-vis) and Scanning electron microscope (SEM). The results of XRD confirm the formation of PAni and PAni/ZnO composite. The UV-vis spectrometer study shows that the π-π* absorption peak of PAni/ZnO composite has a red shift of 35 nm, as compared with that of the PAni. In the frequency range of 8.2-12.4GHz, the real part of permittivity (ε') and the loss factor (tanε) of the PAni/ZnO composites are 7.25-7.45 and 0.50-0.51, respectively, which is lower than those of pure PAni.

articleTitle: Discussion on sustainable use of energy based on circular economy — A case study of Beijing
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With Beijing's increasingly tense of energy resources, sustainable use of energy has become a serious problem in Beijing.This paper puts forward countermeasuresis of sustainable energy use in Beijing ,on the basis of the status of energy resources in Beijing and the concept of circular economy.

articleTitle: Design and develop of Multifunctional test-bed for in-wheel-motor
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, firstly put forth design scheme of Multifunctional test-bed for in-wheel-motor; secondly designed test-bed's mechanical structure and electronic control system according as design scheme, finally validated test-bed accord with design requirements via test.

articleTitle: Study on supply chain performance measurement system for agribusiness
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Agribusiness, as a sub-system of China's market economy system, has an extremely important position. The improvement of agribusiness supply chain performance, is an important way to enhance the market competitiveness of agricultural enterprises in China. Based on BP Neural Network Model, the evaluation system of China's agricultural enterprise supply chain performance, which is on the basis of drawing on research findings on the supply chain at home and abroad, is constructed in this paper. The results show that the performance evaluation system constructed in this paper runs better and is. suitable for the performance evaluation on China's agribusiness supply chain.

articleTitle: Application of excel in hydrologic frequency computation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Because of the complex in calculating with coefficient Φ in P-III frequency curve and the difficultin planning with normal probability paper in existing frequency computation, so excel cannot be applied directly to the frequency computation. Plan the normal probability paper in existing frequency computation using the the formidable graph function of Excel software, calculate the coefficient Φ in P-III frequency curve using of Excel software built-in functions. Practice shows that this method is accurate, Application easy, is artistic for charting, and has better practical values.

articleTitle: The reliability of CFRP strengthened Two-way slab with Monte Carlo method based on Matlab
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to reliability theory, the author compiled the Monte Carlo calculating program based on Matlab soft-ware. Through the experiment of CFRP-strengthened RC Two-way slab, the stochastic parameters of random variables were obtained. The reliability of CFRP-strengthened RC Two-way slab were simulated with Monte Carlo method based on Matlab. The result shows that the reliability index calculated by Monte Carlo method and by AFOSM method agree well and the computing process is quick and efficient.

articleTitle: Study based on operation by valve control for water distribution network
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The pressure of water distribution network is one of the major cause which make the network fault, by the regulating valve the local pressure is regulated. The regulating length is obtained through the sensitivity of the coefficient of friction resistance to node pressure, through alteration of the opening of valve, the local pressure is regulated and verification is by example. The result show the local pressure is regulated through the regulation which provides a solution for the urban distribution network operation.

articleTitle: The depolarization effects of Earth-Space link at MMW Bands
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The depolarization effects of Earth-Space link at MMW Bands and their mechanisms are analysed. The models to evaluate XPD induced by clear atmosphere, rain, ice crystals, snow, sand-dust storm and ionized layer are summarized and analysed. The methods to calculate total XPD including the influcece of transmitting antenna are discussed. The results given in this paper are important for frequency resue and depolarization MIMO techniques.

articleTitle: Analysis of wavelet de-noising for porosity inspection in carbon fiber reinforced composite
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The theory of wavelet denoising were studied in this paper. Daubechies wavelet, Symlet wavelet and Coiflets wavelets were used to de-noise the ultrasonic signals of carbon fiber reinforced composite. The results show that the de-noising results of different wavelets for the same signal are different, but they conform to a certain rule; the de-noising results of different signals also conform to a certain rule for the same wavelets. The relationship between ultrasonic attenuation and porosity was compared for original signals and de-noised signals, and the relationship for de-noised signals turned out to be closer to parabola relationship.

articleTitle: Decolorization of acid red dyeing wastewater by Modified Bentonite-Chitosan Adsorbent
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This study introduces the best prepared methods of Modified Bentonite -Chitosan Adsorbent, and analysises the best decolorizing test conditions of printing and dyeing wastewater treatment by it. The results show that, modifying bentonite by 1mol/L H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> is desirable, the best solid-liquid ratio of bentonite and chitosan is 0.833g/ml, the best conditions of the oscillator shake speed is 200r/min, while the best temperature is 45°C,pH is 6, and the amount of added products is 2g/100ml in printing and dyeing wastewater treatment.

articleTitle: Application and performance comparison of several new-type of building wall materials in China
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The proposal of the concept of "low carbon" makes the building design have to use more closely in building materials on the architectural form of regional integration. This paper analyzes the characteristics and situation of the lower building energy consumption in China and the presents specific measures of achieving "low carbon".In particular, it proposes the necessity of the application of the new wall materials in our country.The main existing problems around the Application of new-type wall materials and influence of the "low carbon" economy, launches a wide-ranging and in-depth discussion, having a certain theoretical significance in order to promote the building energy conservation under the new situation.

articleTitle: The thermal-mechanical coupling analysis of diesel engine cylinder head
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Built 3-D solid model of one diesel engine cylinder head with the Pro/E software and its finite element model with the ABQUS software, and discussed the boundary conditions, such as the thermal stress, bolts pre-load and displacement, analyzed its stress and deformation under thermal-mechanical coupling using the finite element method, and obtained some conclusions as the following: (1) the material can meet the strength need; (2) its deformation area is mainly in flame face surface and fuel injector coxcombing; (3) the deformation of flame face was general symmetrical broadways and slightly large near exhaust air duct longways; (4) the deformation of fuel injector coxcombing was general symmetrical.

articleTitle: Turbine inlet parameters' effect on diesel waste heat recovery by Organic Rankine Cycle
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Simulaed thermal properties of exhaust gas ejected by EV80 diesel generator, and recovered this part of heat by means of Organic Rankine Cycle (ORC). Selected R123 as the working fluid to run on the programming process of calculation. The result shows: at the point condition of diesel generator, exhaust heat is fixed, the mass flow rate required by the Organic Rankine cycle waste heat recovery system reduces and increases respectively as the turbine inlet temperature and pressure increasing. The ORC efficiency is basically unchanged with the turbine inlet temperature increasing; In the context of same temperature, the supercritical cycle requires more working fluids than the subcritical cycles in heat exchanger, turbine generates more power output and the thermal efficiency is much higher and the supercritical cycle can recover more exhaust heat.

articleTitle: Effect of cold working on mechanical properties of a cobalt base superalloy
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The influence of cold working deformation on the hardness, tensile strength, elongation and microstructure of a cobalt base superalloy used for pistons rings was studied in this paper. The results show that cobalt base superalloy in solid solution condition has a typical metallic tensile curve, while cobalt base superalloy after cold working treatment has no obvious yield step in tensile stress-strain curves. With the increase of cold deformation rates, the tensile strength and hardness of cobalt base superalloy increase gradually, while the plasticity of cobalt base superalloy decreases significantly. A lot of stacking faults and twins appear in the microstructure of the cold working alloy, so the hardening mechanism of the alloy is twinning strengthening.

articleTitle: In the construction of new countryside ecological landscape construction countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Rural ecological protection and construction of landscape is an important building of new socialist countryside basic project. A new rural construction is showing rapid growth but now the natural ecological environment in rural areas the overall situation is worrying. In particular, the construction of the ecological landscape is even more serious errors. Construction of new rural sense of ecological security is eagerly awaited a different city, look at the actual situation in the vast rural areas of strategic policy to guide the construction of new countryside construction of ecological landscape.

articleTitle: A new high resolution wide swath SAR system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: For the urgent requirement of high resolution and wide swath, and in order to observe the sensitive area in the same time, on the base of combining the azimuth muti-aperture with the range digital beam-forming, high resolution multiple strip mode is proposed, which can attain the same high resolution as strip mode and the same wide swath as Scan mode. Through practical examples and parameter design, the feasibility is proved.

articleTitle: Design on the performance test development bench of high pressure valve class products
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A test system of valve class products based on industrial personal computer is developed. This test system is used for manufactories and quality supervisory departments to do the test of valve class products performance. Based on the control system of IPC and configuration software, the problem of collecting and storing performance parameters of valve class products with high speed was solved. This system uses data acquisition card and programmable logic controller to test the performances of valve class products, and the curves of the performances are described. With the alteration for high pressure manual regulator valve which be used in system, auto-regulation of valve opening was carried out. This data acquisition system has been used in a project of performance parameter testing of military valve class products, the date picking rate can reach 20 times/s and the measuring precision can reach 0.4%.

articleTitle: The exploratory creation of modern hospitals' planning and design based on “inosculation”—The design of the newly-built complex building of Harbin No.242 Hospital
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Combined with the design practice of the newly-built complex building of Harbin No.242 Hospital, this article explains the design philosophy of modern hospitals based on "inosculation" and all-round consideration. Moreover, the meaning of "inosculation" is analyzed in three aspects: environmental planning, architectural form and special arrangement and its active methods and corresponding effects in architectural materializing process.

articleTitle: Based on the matlab permanent disc high magnetic separator magnetic field numerical analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper has designed a kind of new wet permanent magnetism disc type high magnetic ore separator, introduced the operational principle of magnetic separator, established the separation space magnetic field strength mathematical model, and used the Matlab software to carry on the numerical analysis and to fix permanent disc high magnetic separator design parameter, the permanent magnetism disc type high magnetic separator with reasonable structure was made.

articleTitle: Underwater experiment and analysis of three-joint crescent caudal robot fish
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: After the completion of the overall design for the robot fish, in order to validate correctness of robot fish machine kinematics and dynamics analysis and to learn whether each module can work reliably and achieve the desired objectives after processor coordination, an underwater experiment is needed to ensure the correctness of overall organization, the hardware circuit, the control of the software and the feasibility of the presented algorithm. We established the robot fish test system, conducted a series of experiments to verify the design's requirements , and achieved the expected record data , which was helpful to furthering the design of robot fish.

articleTitle: Study on the control system of piezoelectric ceramics micro-positioning stage
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the nonlinearity of the piezoelectric devices such as hysteresis and creep, posioning control of the piezoelectric ceramics micro-positioning stage gets difficult. The multiple control scheme that a feedforward control based on model combines with a fuzzy self-adjusting PID(proportion-integral-derivative) control is proposed. Matlab6.5 software is acted as experimental development platform, and the control scheme is implemented in it. The result showed that positioning accuracy and regulation speed of the control system is satisfied.

articleTitle: Application of Dijkstra algorithm in robot path-planning
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the robot is a maze robot. Dijkstra algorithm is used in the robot path planning. The shortest path is selected in the process of barrier. Simulation results prove the model valid; it can effectively solve the maze robot path planning.

articleTitle: Wind turbine condition monitoring and reliability analysis by SCADA information
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As the deployment of onshore wind turbines becomes established and with an increasing deployment of offshore wind turbines, to ensure a high reliability and availability of these machines has become the focus of interest within the academic and industrial communities. One of the approaches to meet this requirement is to develop a Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) strategy with the aid of an advanced condition monitoring and reliability prediction system. The aim of this paper is to describe the basic idea of how wind farm Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) system contributes to establishing such a strategy. Examples have been given in the paper for providing a clear explanation of the opinions.

articleTitle: Experimental study on the five sort algorithms
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Sorting algorithm is one of the most basic research fields in computer science. It's goal is to make record easier to search, insert and delete. Through the description of five sort algorithms: bubble, select, insert, merger and quick, the time and space complexity was summarized. Furthermore, two categories of O(n<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) and O(nlog n) could be found out. From the aspects of input sequence scale and input sequence random degree, some results were obtained based on the experiments. When the size of records is small, insertion sort or selection sort performs well. When the sequence is ordered, insertion sort or bubble sort performs well. When the size of records is large, quick sort or merge sort performs well. Different application could select appropriate sort algorithm according to these rules.

articleTitle: The technology and application of voice coil actuator
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the Lorentz Force Principle, voice coil actuator is a new-style versatile direct drive motors with special structure. Easy to be controlled, with high acceleration, high speed, high reliability, pony size, smooth force and fast actuation make it an ideal replacement for conventional electric motor. In this paper, the operation principle of voice coil actuator is expatiated, its sizing is discussed. And its current application fields is detailed.

articleTitle: Using the IOT to construct ubiquitous learning environment
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The rapid development of information technology promotes the advent of ubiquitous age, and people's focus is mostly transferred to the ubiquitous learning. For the ubiquitous learning, the learning environment is important. Through studying all kinds of identification technologies, learners need the ubiquitous learning environment which they can get the right learning contents and achieve self learning at the right place and the right time. In order to support learners with increasing social skill, in this paper, a specific technical framework of ubiquitous learning environment based-on the Internet of Things is designed, which includes three major layers: perception layer, network layer, application layer. Moreover, the system architecture of ubiquitous learning is described, in this system an example is used to explain how the systems work. Using IOT learning can be happened at anyplace, anytime, any people, and any content.

articleTitle: Experimental study on vehicle speed estimation using accelerometer and wheel speed measurements
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Accurate estimation of longitudinal vehicle speed using general in-vehicle sensors like wheel speed sensors and accelerometers is crucial for good performance of vehicle dynamic control systems. Most of passenger vehicles are two-wheel drive, which provides speed measurement by wheel speed sensors of non-driven wheels. However, when wheels are under braking, this method is not reliable enough since wheels are at high level of slip. An alternative method is to use the direct integration of the longitudinal acceleration, but offset in the acceleration signal may cause excessive errors in estimation results. This work develops a speed estimation method using Kalman filtering algorithm by establishing an updating method of acceleration offset.

articleTitle: Chip ignition in research on high-speed face milling AM50A magnesium alloy
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The ignition of magnesium alloy chips is a problem during high speed dry machining in industry. It should be avoided in the practical production. Many factors including machining environment, material composition, tool geometry, cutting parameters etc. can influence the cutting processes. Among these factors, cutting parameters is one of most important elements to induce the ignition of magnesium alloys. AM50A is a commercial magnesium alloy which is widely used in industry. However, very few reports about the ignition conditions of AM50A magnesium alloy are available. In this paper, we investigated the ignition conditions of AM50A magnesium alloy at different cutting parameters. The relationship between ignition conditions and chip morphologies was further explored. The macro morphologies of the chips were observed by optical microscope and the micro structure were obtained by scanning electron microscope (SEM). It is found that the macro morphologies of chips can be characterized into powdered chip, tubular helical chip, acicular helical chip, and long belt chip, which correspond to the different ignition conditions. The powdered chips and acicular spiral chips are easily ignited. They have thinner lamellar thickness compared to the other two types of chips. These results may be used to analyze cutting process and prevent the chip ignition in dry machining magnesium alloy.

articleTitle: ABS control design for two-wheel drive electric vehicles
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: An ABS (Anti-lock Braking System) is a safety mechanism for vehicles which prevents the wheels of motor vehicles locked (ceasing of rotation) while braking. This research intends to develop and implement a non-mechanical ABS controller based on the application of regenerative and short-circuit braking mechanism in two-wheel electric vehicle. Boundary layer velocity control is proposed to ensure the optimized wheel-speed, under the minimum slip-ratio between tires and road.

articleTitle: Study on wettability and corrosivity of a new no-clean flux for lead-free solder paste in electronic packaging technology
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Solder paste plays a critical role in SMT (surface mount technology) and reflow soldering. And flux is an important material in composition of solder paste. Due to the drive towards lead-free electronic packaging and no-clean soldering technology, a new no-clean flux contained composite activators was formulated specifically for lead-free paste. Spread test was carried out to evaluate the activity of the newly developed flux with Sn3.0Ag0.5Cu lead-free solder. Influence of flux residues on corrosivity of cu substrate was also investigated. The results showed that the new no-clean flux contained composite activators exhibited better soldering performance. Corrosivity of flux residues related to activators in fluxes. The new no-clean flux contained composite activators had less residues and minor corrosivity than flux which contained simple activators of organic acids. Therefore, composite activators are promising no-clean flux ingredients for lead-free solder paste.

articleTitle: Simultaneous decolorization and degradation of azo dye with electricity generation in microbial fuel cells
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Dye wastewater is representative of highly colored effluent that is resistant to bio degradation and should be decolorized before discharge. The investigation into the decolorization and degradation of simulated dye wastewater containing the azo dye C.I. Acid Orange 7 (AO7) with simultaneous electricity generation in microbial fuel cells (MFCs) is described. Electrons obtained from organics oxidation were consumed for AO7 decolorization and electricity generation in the MFCs. The maximum power density obtained was 5.0 W/m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> for single-chamber MFCs employing glucose as fuel with the presentation of AO7. Nearly complete decolorization and degradation (97%) were achieved after 168 h operation. Furthermore, the decolorization efficiencies increased by factors of about 1.7 and 1.1, comparing the color absorbance with adsorption by granular graphite and open-circuit MFCs, respectively. Results indicate that MFCs can enhance decolorization and degradation of azo dyes such as AO7 with electricity generation compared with traditional methods, providing an effective alternative for dye wastewater treatment and energy recovery.

articleTitle: Electronic control system design and test of pure electric vehicle battery management system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to achieve the full and efficient use of battery power, this paper designed the dispersed battery management system, The system devised the BMU and LECU electronic control system based on C8051F040 microcontroller, it can effectively gather the battery parameters of battery voltage and current and temperature and so on in real-time, and estimate the battery SOC, and implement the fault diagnosis and alarming according to the battery status. The system connects the modules by using 485 bus, and achieves the vehicle communication by applying CAN bus. Finally this paper analyzed and tested the system functions, the experiment results have shown that the system can accurately forecast the battery SOC and the current measurement accuracy can satisfy the practice requirements.

articleTitle: Multi-port gear pump design based on virtual prototyping technology
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the familiar structures of multi-port gear pump are analyzed, and designed based on virtual prototyping technology. A virtual prototyping is built by the function of three-dimensional modeling and virtual assembly of Pro/E, the fluid dynamics of pump is simulated by FLUENU software. The simulation results show that the design based on virtual prototyping technology is an effective and high-quality way to design multi-port gear pump rapidly.

articleTitle: Design and Development of a pluggable PEMFC extended Range Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Extended-Range Electric Vehicles (E-REV) are principally battery electric vehicles with a relatively small auxiliary power unit (APU) to recharge the battery pack or directly to propel the vehicle during driving, which is seen as one of the most promising technological bridges between the vehicles of today and the sustainable concepts of tomorrow. Different powertrain system topologies of E-REVs are introduced in this paper. Based on the R&D work of a pluggable PEMFC E-REV, the design requirements and methods for key components, such as electric hub motor, battery system, Range extender, are given. Finally, the energy management strategy for this PEMFC E-REV is discussed and validated together with the vehicle performances on ADVISOR simulation platform.

articleTitle: Power management and energy harvesting for indoor photovoltaic cells system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Harvesting electrical power from indoor light condition with very low illuminance levels is very attractive and challenging. It is therefore important to optimize system design so that an energy harvester can provide sufficient energy to the wireless sensor network router nodes. In this paper, we present a novel power management circuit for indoor light harvesting, which includes maximum power point (MPP) circuit, energy storage circuit, instantaneous discharging circuit and DC-DC boost converter. The measured results show that the prototype circuit can harvest energy from indoor light condition and successfully drive a smart wireless sensor node with temperature and humidity sensor.

articleTitle: A detection method based on sonar image for underwater pipeline tracker
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The surveillance and inspection of underwater pipelines are carried out by operators who drive a remotely operated underwater vehicle (ROV) with camera mounted on it. However in very turbid water, the camera can not capture any scene, even with auxiliary high-intensity light. In this case the optical detection devices are unable to complete the surveillance task. In recent years, forward looking sonar is widely applied to the underwater inspection, which is not subject to the influence of light and turbidity. So it is suitable for the inspection of pipelines. But the dynamic change of ROV by the water flow will lead to the target to escape from the sonar image easily. In addition, the sonar image is with high noise and low contrast. It is difficult for the operator to identify the pipeline from the images. Moreover, the surveillance of underwater pipelines is tedious and time consuming and it is easy to make mistakes due to the fatigue and distraction of the operator. Therefore, the study focuses on developing image processing algorithms to detect the pipeline automatically. By using the proposed image processing method, firstly the images are enhanced using the Gabor filter. And then these images are applied for an edge detector. Finally the parameters of the pipeline are calculated by Hough transform. To reduce the search area, the Kalman filter is explored to predict the parameters of the pipeline on the next image. And the experiment is shown the vision system is available to the surveillance of underwater pipelines.

articleTitle: The design of water quality environment automatic monitoring system based on wireless sensor network within industrialized aquiculture
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: After analyzing the feature of industrialized breeding and the wireless sensor network, the paper proposes a solution to automatic water monitoring system of industrialized breeding based on Zigbee protocol. The system design based on MG2455 MCU, a product of Radio Pulse Co., is emphasized in the paper, and the real-time monitoring and management of remote water quality data is implemented in the system.

articleTitle: Research on speech characteristics based on compressed sensing theory
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Due to fewer researches and applications of speech compressed sensing, the sparsity of speech signals was studied first. Then the Fourier orthogonal transform method and the Orthogonal Matching Pursuit (OMP) algorithm were used to compress and reconstruct speech signals. The relationship between the signal reconstruction and its performance, such as the speech signal compression ratio, the periodicity of reconstructed signals, and the frame size etc. is also discussed here. Experiments have shown that: (1) voice signal is sparse and compressible; (2) the speech reconstruction of integral period and regular periodicity signals performs better than that of non integral period and irregular periodicity signals; (3) the best frame size of reconstructed speech is about 10ms.

articleTitle: Research on COTDR for measuring distributed temperature and strain
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The coherent optical time domain reflectometer (COTDR) based distributed temperature and strain sensing is studied in this paper. The sensing principle is analyzed and discussed in detail. Rayleigh backscattering in a single-mode optical fiber is measured by COTDR with a precisely frequency-controlled light source, and the cross-correlation of the Rayleigh backscattering is calculate to detect the frequency changes of the cross-correlation peak caused by the changes of temperature and strain. We perform simulations on the COTDR based sensing system by computer and draw some conclusions.

articleTitle: Application of fuzzy predictive-PID control in temperature control system of Freeze-dryer for medicine material
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A new fuzzy predictive-PID control method is used in the Freeze-dryer for medicinal temperature control system to handle the problems of large capacity, large delay and the non-linearity of plant controls. When the temperature change is large, fuzzy predictive control is used to fix the control quantity. Otherwise, fuzzy PID real-time control is used. Using the control algorithm can enhance the algorithm's tracking performance and system anti interference capacity. Matlab software is used to do the simulation. The results show that this method is well adaptive to the alteration, and it improves the static precise and dynamic performance of the system.lt has higher dynamic than the conventional PID control and fuzzy PID control. In another, the control performance of freeze dryer temperature control system is improved.

articleTitle: Kinematics analysis and simulation of a new 3 degrees of freedom spatial robot mechanism composed by closed chain
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A new type of 3-DOF spatial mechanism composed by closed chain is proposed. The mechanism is constituted by two parallel four-bar linkages which are fixed on a moving platform. The moving platform can not only rotate around its own axis but also can translate along the axis. The four-bar linkage has a crank and does not have the quick-return characteristic. The mechanism has the features of symmetry, high stiffness and large workspace. The details of its kinematics have been described by using analytical method. Firstly, the closed-form solutions of both direct position and inverse position analysis are derived. Secondly, the velocity and acceleration analysis are derived. Thirdly, the boundaries of workspace are given. Lastly, a simulation of workspace in certain conditions will be given.

articleTitle: Development of EMI shielding materials characterized by low secondary electromagnetic radiation pollution
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Present work is to develop a novel functional material for Electromagnetic Interference (EMI), which is characterized by low secondary pollution through enhanced absorption loss at high shielding effectiveness. The shielding materials were made by acrylic acid resin containing Ni powder and Ni+NiZnFe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> respectively. The effect of NiZnFe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> addition on EMI shielding effectiveness of shielding composite was investigated in terms of reflection loss and absorption loss in shielding effectiveness. There is no significant difference in conductivity of the composites with or without 2.5% volume fraction of NiZnFe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> powder addition. However, the EMI shielding effectiveness was increased obviously because NiZnFe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> addition. This can be attributed to enhancement of absorption capability of electromagnetic radiation because of NiZnFe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> soft magnetic characteristics. The enhancement of absorption capability for electromagnetic radiation is greatly beneficial to decrease the secondary pollution of EMI which is resulted from the reflection of electromagnetic radiation on shielding materials. The effect of NiZnFe<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> addition on reflection and absorption in shielding effectiveness was discussed and evaluated based on the basic principle of electromagnetic theory.

articleTitle: Study on 3-D Computer Aided Design for the small bore directed-injection engine combustion system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Computer-Aided Design is used to carry out 3-D (three dimensions) design for diesel engine combustion system. The diesel engine combustion system is designed and each part is modeled in Pro/E. Pro/E is a solid modeler and this offers considerable advantage for solid model creation. Normally, the geometry is first sketched in 2-D and then extruded in the third direction to generate a 3-D model. In Pro/E, it is important to first create the base geometry. The base geometry is that captures the design intent of the part to be modeled. This base geometry can be created using either the EXTRUDE or the REVOLVE options. Once this base geometry has been created, additional features like holes, rounds, chamfers, fillets, ribs, etc can be added in the finishing stages of the part creation. The center of the bowl does not coincide with the center of the cylinder due to the presence of valve pockets. The obvious advantage of this configuration is that is gives the true geometry of the piston and the connecting rod ports can be accommodated when the piston is at the top dead center. Further, the simulation mesh is built and the final piston structure is got. The results between original combustion system and the modified combustion system is analyzed. The results indicate the modified combustion system can fulfill Euro-4 instead of original Euro-3 standard and the 3-D model can carry out optimization design for a high-pressure common rail diesel engine.

articleTitle: The energy consumption monitoring platform design for large-scale industry users based on the GPRS
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to optimize the allocation of energy resources, reduce enterprises' electrical energy consumption and achieve the goals of energy conservation and emission reduction, the electrical energy consumption monitoring platform is designed in this paper. With its high transmission rate, real-time online and resource-efficient, GPRS has been widely used in the energy consumption monitoring system. Utilizing the feature of GPRS, this paper designs a wireless energy consumption monitoring system. The system has the function of data acquisition, statistical analysis and prediction which makes it be the base of electrical energy consumption management system.

articleTitle: Heat transfer analysis of uniform annular fin on regular perturbation method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the heat transfer progress on the surface of the uniform annular fin in dry, wet or damp-dry conditions. It deduces the fin temperature, the quantity of heat transfer and its efficiency by using regular perturbation method. The results show that the functions are useful to optimization of surface exchanger.

articleTitle: Modal analysis and experimental study on round-ended CFST coupled column cable stayed bridge
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The modal analysis and experimental study of Micro-expansive CFST coupled column single pylon cable stayed bridge was analyzed and its oscillating frequency and the corresponding mode were obtained from the calculation. A correlative analysis of the oscillating frequencies and modes both from the calculation and the experiments was carried out. The results from the correlative analysis proved that the dynamic analysis by the finite element model of cable stayed bridge was available for practice use.

articleTitle: Study of numerical simulation of Aircraft Lightning Zoning based on CST software
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The lightning direct threat to flight safety, study characteristics of the aircraft struck by lightning based on SAE-ARP5416 lightning protection testing methods and the international standards, using CST EM Studio software to simulate lightning attachment points on equal scale aircraft models. Studying the relevant parameters influence to the simulation results. The relevant parameters obtained based on the simulation of aircraft lightning partition, the zoning results are consistent with the SAE-ARP5414 Aircraft Lightning Zoning results.

articleTitle: Dynamic analysis of doubly fed induction generator during symmetrical voltage swells
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the rapid increase of wind farms especially large offshore wind farms, a new problem associated with the response of doubly fed induction generator to temporary overvoltage has arisen. This paper develops a theoretical analysis of the dynamic behavior during symmetrical three phase voltage swell. Overvoltage may lead to reversal of power in the line side converter. Simulation results are in good agreement with those obtained theoretically.

articleTitle: Minimizing assembly variation in selective assembly for complex assemblies using genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: When a product consists of two or more components, the quality of that product depends upon the quality of the mating parts. The mating parts may be manufactured using different machines and processes with different standard deviations. Therefore, the dimensional distributions of the mating parts are not similar. This results in clearance and surplus parts between the mating parts. In this paper, a new method for selective assembly is proposed to minimize the clearance variation without any surplus part for a complex assembly which consists of three components which are gears. In this assembly, each component will have 1000 mating parts totally but with dissimilar dimensional distribution. Genetic algorithm is used to find the best combination to obtain the minimum clearance variation and zero surplus part in this assembly.

articleTitle: The design and realization of a comprehensive SPI interface controller
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper describes a design and implementation of SPI interface model which is used for a SoC chip. The objective of this design is to realize expediently communicate between SoC chip and peripheral equipment. The paper analyses the sequence of SPI protocol, describes the design project of implement SPI logical function. Besides, the design is compatible with the SPI protocal and the function is also expanded, finally achieves powerful in function. After testbench and FPGA verification, the SoC chip that used this SPI model had been successfully processed. The test results indicate that the SPI interface controller's function and performance are all achieve design target, many communication tests indicate the design is reliable in performance.

articleTitle: Research on channel-base current of lightning return stroke
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In allusion to the disadvantages of double exponential function and Heidler function which are wide-used to describe lightning channel-base current, a new kind of lightning channel-base current model is presented. The comparison among the three kinds of function shows that the new function is more predominant than the other two. It is high efficient to calculate lightning electromagnetic pulse fields (LEMP) on basis of the new function.

articleTitle: All DPLLs based on fuzzy PI control algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: An all DPLL(All-Digital Phase Locked Loop) based on fuzzy PI control algorithm is proposed in this paper. On analyzing system performance of a second-order PI control based PLL(Phase Locked Loop), the relationship between noise bandwidth with PI control parameters is derived, and fuzzy controller of the system is designed. Under the Matlab/Simulink environment, system-level PLL is directly modeled by using DSP Builder®, and then is represented by using VHDL. Software simulation confirms the correctness of the design. The PLL can automatically adjust noise bandwidth according its working state, and it is characteristic of its fast lock speed, small phase jitter, outstanding anti-interference performance and prone to integration and so on.

articleTitle: Research on road feeling control of Steer-by-wire System
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The dynamics model of steering wheel module and aligning torque model of the mechanical steering system were established. According to the shortcomings of the fixed steering ratio in traditional steering system, a control strategy of road feeling was designed from the two aspects: control force of the driver, turning angle of the steering wheel. Fuzzy-PID controller was designed to real-timely control the road feeling simulating motor and achieve the self-aligning of the steering wheel. The simulation results showed the road feeling control strategy could make good use of steer-by-wire and satisfy the steering convenience and sensitivity at low speed and the steering clear and stability at high speed.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic navigation system design of the green house spraying robot
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Compared to spraying pesticides manually outdoors, the environment is more closed, and has a high temperature, humidity and so on for operating the spray work in the greenhouse. In order to protect laborer and reduce labor intensity, we develop a prototype of pesticide spraying robot specially used in the greenhouse. This paper emphatically describes the structural design, the robot control system design and the results of navigation experiment. The experiment shows that this robot can track a signal wire well which is set on the ground for navigation, and it obtains a nice steering ability even for short turns with the speed less than 0.5 m/s. Although the productivity of the prototype is not quite efficient, the robot still meets the requirements of pesticide spraying in the greenhouse without human operators.
