articleTitle: Designing and tuning current loop on AC servo system base on PMSM
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Controlling structures and properties of controller effect dynamic properties of all the system in AC servo system. Base on PMSM, regulating the current loop of AC servo system is the basic of high performance servo systems. Three loops controlling structure of AC servo system was analyzed by this paper. In this paper, dynamic mathematical model of closed current loop were established and simplified. The controller of current loop was designed. The system was corrected by the controller. In NC gear milling machine, tuning and calculation of the current loop was carried in MATLAB/SIMULINK. The result indicated that the tuning of current loop enhanced the rapidly of the system and inhibited the internal interference of the current loop. Properties of the system were enhanced.

articleTitle: Analysis and structural improvement of the rubber part in packer in a way of non-linearity finite element
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Packer's rubber is the central part, of which working mechanics is a typical material and geometry non-linear contacting problem. Based on the work principle of high pressure seal and block device in FGQ 9-5/8 “X7”, working on with ANSYS, here in this article, it analyses the touch stress and pressure in the inner wall of the rubber part in the way of non-linearity finite element. According to the work principle of packer, it can get the open and seal inter-zone theoretically. It optimizes the rubber wall thickness through some advantaged plans, which will improve the stress between casing pipe and rubber part, thus it can bear much stronger stress. In the way of ANSYS to simulate the deformation process, it can be tested that the pressure gap can reach higher.

articleTitle: Study on the hydraulic impedance of surge tank
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Calculation formula of hydraulic impedance of surge tank is derived in this paper, which is suitable to both simple tank and throttled tank. And the effects of surge tank on the hydraulic vibration of pressurized conveyance system of hydropower are studied. The investigation shows that the attenuation factors of system decrease if the hydraulic resistance coefficient of surge tank increases. The hydraulic impedance of hydraulic turbine has almost no affects on the frequencies of system, which are close to the even order frequencies of pipe.

articleTitle: Parameter estimation of the pyrolysis model for fir based on particle swarm algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to solve the problem of parameter estimation of nonlinear model in chemical engineering, a novel heuristic optimization approach is presented. The proposed approach develops and employs particle swarm optimization (PSO) technique to search for optimal solution of the parameter estimation. Firstly, the proposed approach converts the problem of parameter estimation of nonlinear model into an equation solving problem that is prone to be optimized. Secondly, two extrema of PSO are used as the target, and all the particles synchronously move through the solution space roundly and efficiently to find the optimum parameter estimation. The feasibility of the proposed method is demonstrated by the parameter estimation example of the pyrolysis model for fir.

articleTitle: Research on application of data mining based on FP-growth algorithm for digital library
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In the field of the library, there is a huge amount of data from readers' borrowing records every day. We can find an interesting network from the relationship of books by doing data mining works on these records, especially on the analysis of association rules, which can help us to find the needs of readers more clearly. FP-growth (frequent pattern growth) uses an extended prefix-tree (FP-tree) structure to store the database in a compressed form. FP-growth adopts a divide-and-conquer approach to decompose both the mining tasks and the databases. In this paper, we use FP-growth algorithm to analyze the association rule of library circulation records. The results can make great sense to help to improve the quality of library collections.

articleTitle: Miniaturization coaxial cavity filter design used in 3G communication
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A novel stepped impedance resonator is proposed for a cavity resonator filter design. According to the basic principle of stepped impedance resonators SIR, a miniaturization coaxial cavity filter used in 3G communication is designed by using λg/4 type SIR as the basic harmonic unit. Simulation results show that compared with normal cavity filter, this filter has the advantages of small volume and low insertion loss and high-band rejection.

articleTitle: The city bus driving cycle construction
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the introduction of the concept of the coverage rate and frequency of section in traffic method, the typical public traffic routes are selected. Investigations are carried out on bus lines and actual operation data are collected. The principal composition analysis and clustering theory are used to construct a driving cycle in this paper. The research shows that it is a feasible method to using principal composition analysis to compress kinematic sequence characteristics which can reflect the characteristics of road traffic , and the kinematic sequence characteristics can be compressed into three or four common factors which represent for over 80% of the raw data . Then clustering theory are used to extracte these kinematic sequences . By randomly selecting and combining these sequences according to statistical probability, the typical public routes are taken as the subject of study, and the driving cycle based on actual bus speed is analysised and concluded. The driving cycle can also reflect typical public routes.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of intelligent campus security tracking system based on RFID and ZigBee
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper an intelligent campus security tracking system (iCST) has been designed and implemented base on the RFID and ZigBee network. iCST reads the RFID tags data through FRID&ZigBee node, and then sends it to PC node by a custom wireless protocol on the ZigBee. PC node gives corresponding warning or hints by the result of matching master-slave RFID tag information. When the warning occurs, its user can logon the web system to get the real-time tracking for valuables (with embedded slave RFID); where the thief arrives any one access control node, it would be blocked. User can also manage his own valuables such as lending and recovery operation through the Web manager center. Accompanied by deployment of large-scale sensor networks, iCST has a good application prospect from the aspect of experimental effect.

articleTitle: Experimental study on anti-carbonization performance of recycled high performance concrete
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Anti-carbonization performance is an important durability indicator of recycled high performance concrete in atmosphere. An orthogonal experiment was designed in this paper considering water-cement ratio, recycled coarse and fine aggregate, slag, fly ash, carbonization time, as well as the stress level under load. Experimental results showed that (1) water-cement ratio and the amount of cement relate to the degree of hydration of concrete and density, thereby affect the anti-carbonation performance of concrete; (2) carbonation depth has a positive correlation between the carbonization and the square root of the time; and (3) carbonization depth will increase under tensile stress.

articleTitle: Deformation mechanism and constitutive relation of soft soils
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A microstructural catastrophic model was achieved by adopting bifurcation theory and catastrophe theory. Moreover, a constitutive relation was established based on this model and creep equation. Theoretical analyzing shows that the model seems to capture well the observed features of soft clay compression behavior. During the compression, it is only the largest existing pores that collapse under a given effective pressure. The smaller the pores are, the larger the pressure is required. When the stress grows, it is the pores collapsing caused deformation that domain, while when the stress is stable, the creep deformation accounts for the majority of the total.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The design of testing system based on eddy current technology
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Rapid and accurate alignment method for SINS on stationary base aided by double-antenna GPS
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Low-cost strapdown inertial navigation system (SINS) cannot implement high-precision alignment by itself on stationary base, meanwhile, devices errors are hard to be estimated. Focusing on above, double-antenna GPS/SINS integrated initial alignment Kalman filter is established. On conditions of pitch/yaw and roll/yaw (double-antenna GPS output), observability of system and devices errors are quantitatively analyzed by comparing the singular values of the observability matrix to confirm the estimation effect. Finally, the conclusions are verified on actual vehicle-based system. The results show that low-cost SINS can estimate the system and devices errors, not only reduced alignment time to less than 100s, but also improved alignment accuracy to better than 0.1°. The method holds significant application value in practical engineering.

articleTitle: Design of date storage and analysis system for photoelectric encoder based on GUI
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper introduced a design method of data storage and analysis system for photoelectric encoder base on Graphical User Interface (GUI). The data of photoelectric encode was sent to PC by serial port of MATLAB. The data collected storages in text format and analyzed in real-time by GUI graphical interface.

articleTitle: The special strategic status of the Environmental Protection in the implementation of the scientific concept of development
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: It analyzed the special strategic status of the Environmental Protection in the implementation of the scientific concept of development. It pointed out that the “environment and development”, in essence, is the “scientific development”, the environment itself was an integral part of development, thus considering the environmental issues in the development was truly conducive to sustainable development. The solution of “Environment and Development” problem depended on the “conscious development”. At this stage in social development, proposing the concept of scientific development followed the times, and the concept of scientific development and environmental protection were ideologically integration.

articleTitle: Design of shock simulation system for shipborne weapons based on electrohydraulic servomotor
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The variety of shipborne weapons as well as the importance and affect of naval gun mounting servo system are narrated. The existing conditions and problems of naval gun mounting servo system in type approval test are introduced. A new kind of shipborne weapons shock simulation testing system based on electrohydraulic servomotor is given, which could simulate all levels of ocean wave strokes, weapon system inertial moment and shooting strokes. The nominal pressure and flow of both high-power low-frequency hydraulic motor and miniwatt high-frequency hydraulic motor are confirmed by analytical calculation. The experiment demonstrates that the performance of this simulation system meet with the designed technical requirements.

articleTitle: Structure optimization of strap-down inertial navigation system support
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to meet the requirement of inertial navigation components and minimizing the system's weight, topological optimization and size optimization were conducted under conditions of random vibration and impact. Firstly, the structure of inertial navigation support was designed according to types of missile connection and space arrangement of electronic components; and topological optimization was conducted. Then, according to the dynamic characteristics of missile and requirement of inertial navigation system, the method of transforming multi-loading cases to multi-loading constraints was used to optimizing the size of the support under conditions of random vibration and impact. Comparing to the original support structures, the weight of optimal structures reduced by 28.1%; RMS accelerations in installed points reduced by 25.2% under random vibration; the structures also met the requirement of inertial navigation system under condition of impact. The support structure shows improvements in both dynamic characteristic and light weight comparing with the original one.

articleTitle: Chemical characteristics and sources of precipitation around Qinghai Lake valley, NW China
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A total of 33 precipitation samples have heen colle cted from individual precipitation events at the hird island, a sc enic zone of Qinghai Lake Monitoring (36° 32' ~37° 15' N, 99° 36' ~100° 16' E; 3200 m a.s.l) located in the northwes t of Tibetan Plateau from June 2010 to August 2010. The pH value of precipitation r anged from 6.05 to 8.19 with a volume average value of 7.13. Correlation and Enrichment factor analysis (EF) indie ate that crustal aerosols from combustion emissions of residents and continental dust, which are the major sources for these ions.

articleTitle: The judgment of the degree of rural financial deepening in Jilin Province and the measures
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The financial repression constraints the development of the rural economy, but the financial deepening is good to it. The financial deepening is benefit to overcome the financial repression. This paper puts forward the measures to rural financial deepening in Jilin Province, and the measures are as follows: first is to relax the controls of the interest rate in order to make the rural financial market interest rates liberalize; second, is to lower the capital threshold to enter the rural financial market, and relax the regulation; third is to play “leading function” of the Agricultural Development Bank and agricultural policy insurance institutions, leading more capital into the rural market; Fourth is to establish a mechanism making the capital flow into rural areas; fifth is to reduce the direct subsidies to farmers, and the indirect subsidies are implemented to farmers through the agricultural and political financial institutions.

articleTitle: The effect of floor structure on heat transfer of radiant floor heating system with air-source heat pump (ASHP)
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper presents numerical simulation for heat transfer of radiant floor heating system, whose heat source is air-source heat pump (ASHP). The results of simulation for heat transfer show that: 1) With the increasing of the tube spacing in floor layer, the average floor surface temperature decreases and temperature fluctuations enlarge, in the same time practical experiments show that the simulation results are reliable.2) The thinner the floor layer structure, the higher the floor surface temperature, and the more thermal inertia and cost of floor, but the less capacity of heat storage. The thickness of the floor layer structure should be decided by actual design requirements for space heating.3) Floor radiant heating capacity will be significantly reduced with the decreasing of thermal conductivity of floor surface layer. The material of floor surface layer, whose heat transfer coefficient is small, should be avoided to be use in practical engineering.

articleTitle: Study on the construction method and deformation control technology of small interval cross tunnel in water-enriched soil layers
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Combined with the engineering practice of small interval cross tunnel located at Shenzhen metro line 5 Taian ~ Yijing road station, this paper points out a theory which contributes to guide the relevant construction by optimized means of construction scheme and numerical simulations. In addition, it details different construction methods of the small interval cross tunnel in water-rich stratum and summarizes the deformation control technology. Finally, it comes to a conclusion that the construction sequence play an important role in the condition of small interval cross tunnel and the grouting makes significant contributions to the construction in water-rich stratum. This paper supports the reference of similar tunnel construction and may promote the development of overlapped tunnels construction.

articleTitle: Hybrid power supply of rescue robot based on supercapacitors
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper designs a hybrid power supply composed of supercapacitors and a power battery in consideration of their characters for the reason that the power battery cannot provide sufficient current for the rescue robot to climb over large obstacles. The advantages of the hybrid power supply were illustrated by contrast experiments of the robot's slope climbing performance. The results show that hybrid power supply improves the rescue robot's ability of over-obstacle.

articleTitle: Home Health test Analyzer
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The project designs a Home Health Analyzer, which includes micro-control systems and signal acquisition systems. Its features are micro-control systems consisting of micro controllers, which are connected with A/D converter circuit, display screen, keyboard and serial port input circuit; signal acquisition system is made by the A/D converter circuit, which is connected with blood pressure measurement, weight measurement circuit, the temperature measurement circuit, heart rate, heart sounds measurement circuit, and temperature measurement circuit. The project brings a variety of detectors together in one set. It can not only test blood pressure, body weight, body temperature, heart rate, heart sounds easily meeting the demand of people, but also be able to test the health indicators of testing analysis and the stored ones. The analyzer can also analyze indicators which have been stored during a period of time. The instrument based on the measured body indexes, analyses the physical health compared with stored medical knowledge. What's more, it can reminder the user of their health conditions in a warm way of tips or notes. At last, users can adjust to their livesreasonably, prevent and early discovery some diseases through the instrument.

articleTitle: Research on the pit lake water in an abandoned oil shale goaf
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The Jintang oil shale mine, an opencast mine in Maoming, Guangdong Province, has been abandoned for about 20 years after half a century of ore exploration without a reclamation or remediation plan. This article aims at elucidating the revealed and potential environmental risks associated with the pit lake by quantifying pollution in the stagnated water in the goaf. The water in the abandoned goaf had an acidic pH equal to 3.40, whereas concentrations of dissovled iron reached 1.54 mg/L, and 0.00756 mg/L for total cadmium. All these data exceeded the standard scope respectively showed that the natural environment was contaminated by the abandoned oil shale mine. The reason for low pH and overdose of heavy metals were analyzed.These findings urge for an immediate remediation action of the afflicted area. Meanwhile, attentions should be taken to study the mechanism of trace element released from oil shale and the theory of element geochemical migration in order to prevent the accumulation of hazardous trace elements associated with the abolished oil shale mining pits, which was critical to managing the disposal of the abandoned oil shale mine.

articleTitle: Combustion of industrial gas in porous media burner
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The stable combustion of industrial gas in porous media burner was studied in this paper. A two-dimensional mathematic model was set up, and the distributions of temperature and concentrations of gas components in stable combustion are computed by FLUENT. Results show that the emissions in porous combustion of industrial gas are extremely limited. Industrial gas and industrial emissions should be used effectively, thus energy can be conserved.

articleTitle: The methods of compiling oval macro-program in turning operation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper discusses the principle of compiling oval macro-program. Through three examples, it analyses the methods of compiling oval macro-program in turning operation on the basis of ellipse standard equation and ellipse parametric equation. In addition, this paper, by applying simulation software to verify the compiled program, summarizes the programming essentials. This paper is of important reference value to machining components with non-circular curve contour in the NC machining.

articleTitle: The research and application of the optimization technique of continuous annealing line temper mill roll contour
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this article, the writer, having done a research on the stripe shape of the continuous annealing line temper mill, on the base of both the theoretical calculation and the analysis of the production data, established a relevant roll contour supporting optimization model, implemented the optimal calculation with the Hybrid Genetic Algorithm, designed a plan for new roll contour configuration, and analyzed the effect of the 2D varying-thickness theory on the roll gap horizontal rigidity and roll bending control. This article applies the result on the production, improving the stripe shape control effect of the temper mill, reducing roll bending burden.

articleTitle: Influence of lightning attack to field in aircraft
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: When the aircraft suffers lightning, great lightning current will produced in the fuselage. It will imperil aero safely badly. In the paper, electromagnetic simulation software CST MS studio is used to simulate the situation that the plane attacked by lightning. And analysis the changes of field inside and outside the aircraft. The analytical results will provide reference for practical engineering applications.

articleTitle: Safety analysis of high and long-span structure formwork supporting system of fastener-style steel pipe
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this article,it introduces the multiple safety accidents for high formwork supporting frame system of fastener-style steel pipe at first, and it enumerated the problems of high formwork supporting frame system of fastener-style steel pipe in the aspect of materials, designs, construction, calculating and management at present. By researching and analyzing, it put forward to some prevention measures and drew conclusions which were very useful to understand the mechanical capacity of high formwork supporting frame system of fastener-style steel pipe and guide the engineering practice.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Based on the application of the KBE technique of UG-NX4 platform in the design of the panel dies of the automobiles
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: The research on test scheme of the digital Electromechanical Actuator based on CAN Bus
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to realize the digital of Electromechanical Actuator(EMA) control system, the CAN Bus, which has efficient reliable performance and flexible network modes, works as data interface. The EMA test scheme is designed based on the CAN Bus. First of all, the microcontroller DSP with the CAN Bus works as the core of the EMA control system circuit boards. Then the CAN Bus test network is established with the EMA, Ground Test System and Autopilot computer. The function and self-check of the EMA canbe conveniently tested by the network and the result of the test canbe easily displayed in the PC. Finally, the CAN Bus test network is established with the EMA, the Frequency Characteristics Scanner and etc. The purpose is to test the performance of the EMA. The result of the test can be intuitively showed on the Frequency Characteristics Scanner. In a word,the application of the CAN bus provides a new method to test the EMA and reference to engineering the digital EMA, which has vital significance.

articleTitle: The influence of nitrogen pressure on the microstructure and mechanical properties of TiSiN coatings by cathodic arc ion-plating
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: TiSiN nanocomposite Alms have been deposited on YT15 cemented carbide by a cathodic arc plasma plating system. Structure, mechanical and tribological properties were investigated by X-ray diffraction, Scanning electron microscope, tribometry, Profiler and Vickers indentation techniques, systemically. The results show that TiSiN films are the typical structure of TiN crystal inserted in amorphous Si<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> The maximum microhardness is about 4200 HV at 4Pa while the wear property is the best at the pressure of 2 Pa, with an average friction coefficient of 0.54.

articleTitle: Numerical comparative analysis of hybrid ventilation system and single fresh air system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A hybird ventilation system is put forward in this paper. Numerical comparative analysis has been made between hybird ventilation system and fresh air system in order to obtain the performance of the hybird ventilation system. Simulations are carried out in a hotel based on the tracer gas decay method. Comparing detailed analysis results, a comprehensive discussion of indoor air temperature and contaminant concentration distribution is presented. Comparative results show that the hybird ventilation system can provide a high level of indoor air quality and save energy in the case of achieving the same effect.

articleTitle: Policy simulation and analysis of replacing outdated productivity towards iron and steel industry
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Replacing outdated productivity is an important goal of iron & steel industry during 11<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> five-year period. Based on the policies summary, this paper builds a mixed approach integrating bottom-up into top-down model by using MCP algorithm, and then designs the corresponding replaced rate. Results of simulation shows that: (1)Replacing outdated productivity of small iron & steel enterprises is remedied by super large iron & steel enterprises. (2)Replacing outdated productivity has less influence on whole economy, but great influence on resource-based industries. (3)Directly saving energy is more remarkable, but the total effect of policies saving energy less. According these, some suggestion is set up. Scale effect is not only important way to replace outdated productivity, but also the important means to promote enterprises saving energy.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of parallel word occurrence frequency based on message passing interface
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: For large files and files distributed all around the internet, this paper proposed and realized parallel word occurrence frequency counting using C and message passing interface programming. And to solve the specific word occurrence problems like how to extract word precisely, traverse file completely, eliminate redundant words, adapt to any text files, and count the number of letters and word. An improved serial word counting algorithm was designed and implemented. Then the parallel partition strategy based on both balanced file size and balanced task were discussed and a combined partition strategy was designed and implemented using C programming and MapReduce message passing interface (MR-MPI) library. After that the counting of word occurrence frequency for relatively small and very large text file were realized. And last we executed the same task in parallel computing environment. The test showed that the algorithm proposed implements word counting for files of large data set, both in parallel high performance computing and cloud environment with short runtime and high accuracy. Last, some discussion on the parallel implementation of the word counting problem in Google's cloud environment is given out.

articleTitle: On the cost estimation methods of college engineering based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The engineering cost estimation during the early stage of the project is not only the basis of feasibility study in the investment management of construction project, but is also the vital factor for the estimate of the bidding. What's more, its accuracy directly erects influences on the decision of investment and construction cost control for the project. By collecting and clearing up the materials of the completed construction projects, this essay applies the BP neural network in the cost estimation of college engineering, defines the proper value which will influence the engineering cost and then builds up the model of neural network. For the purpose of realizing the model, it also applies the MATLAB in order to train, simulate and test the model. Furthermore, it uses the project case to test the model, the result of which proves that this kind of model is on the one hand of great generalization ability, but it can also precisely estimate the engineering cost.

articleTitle: A design of mixed-signal test controller based on boundary scan
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of microelectronics, it is difficult to test complicated integrated circuit for the traditional test methods. For this circs, JTAG puts forward a new kind of circuit test method - boundary scan technology. According to the IEEE1149.4, a boundary scan controller is designed by ATmega128 MCU and SN74ACT8990. Experiments show that the test controller can locate faults rapidly. The design of the boundary scan controller provides a basis for the further research of mixed electronic system BIT.

articleTitle: Stress analysis of main spindle for permanent drum magnetic separation based on COSMOS
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Structural performance of driven the central axis for permanent drum magnetic separation was researched. Modeling software Solidworks was applied to establish the model and COSMOS was used to analysis the stress. Objective of this paper was to sum up merits and drawbacks of permanent drum magnetic separation. Based on practical use experience of separator, the central axis was modeled and did stress analysis. Compared with ordinary the choice of a structure, the new design of the central axis structural was optimized. To ensure that the selected operation flow, more reliable, to reduce maintenance and repair of equipment work, lowering operating costs. By modeling analysis, safety factor was up to 1.3, which had meet safety requirements.

articleTitle: Structure parameter selection in rolls during hot rolling
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Roll that bears large rolling load during the hot rolling process is one of the important components of rolling mill. This paper describes an investigation into the stress level of roll using ANSYS software to model rolling process. Two FEM model involving in three-dimensional and nonlinear contact have been established successfully to evaluate the working stress of the roll barrel and roll end. The influence factors that include roll body diameter, roll neck dimension and root fillet of keyway in the roll end are also discussed to reduce roll stress. Some structural parameters of the roll have been suggested to reduce roll stress and ensure production safety. The study results provide new ideas for designing roll.

articleTitle: Numerical investigation of gangue waste heat recovery and utilization in tunnel kiln
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The mathematical model of gangue brick tunnel kiln in one coal mine, was established to simulate the heat transfer between brick, air and boiler and to study the waste heat recovery. The temperature distribution in the coal cangue tunnel kiln was studied. Simulation results show that the layout of bricks has certain impact on heat transfer and optimizing the layout of coal cangue brick in the tunnel kiln can improve the efficiency of waste heat utilization. The residence time of brick in tunnel kiln shows important effect on temperature distribution and on brick sintering quality.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of bearing oil whirl by Hilbert-Huang transmation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In actural measurement, it is difficult to find the useful signal among background noise. This paper suggests a new method to pick up signals and find fault information by using Hilbet Huang Transmation. In signal processing, at first small wave transmation was used as low-pass filter, thus part of noise can be filtrated. Then some of intrinsic mode functions have been obtained by using empirical mode decomposition. In accordance with the spectrum of intrinsic mode functions, Hilbet time spectrum and bound spectrum, the fault information contained in signals can be found clearly. In the process of Hilbet Huang Transmation, it can be found that intrinsic mode functions can express bearing oil whirl fault information, so the fault can be diagnosed effectively.

articleTitle: Computational experiment system architecture of extreme flood and drought disaster events
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The reason and response of the complex procedure for the extreme flood and drought disaster events are driven by both nature and man power. The governments' cooperation and the changes for the situations happen in emergency disposal and the procedure of the management, which result in multi-subject, multi-layer, multi-scale, dynamic, complexity and uncertainty. In emergency disposal and management oriented, in order to solve the problems of complex procedure modeling and solution, this paper builds up a new paradigm of complex procedure analysis based on computational experiment. On the basis of evolution computational model according to observation simulation recognition mode, the computational experiment system architecture of the extreme flood and drought disaster events is designed and built, and the referred key technology in computational experiment system of disaster events is analyzed, which follow the separation of physical composition and logical composition. The main contents conclude: (1) the evolution computational model of the data driven extreme flood and drought disaster events; (2) the computational experiment system architecture of extreme flood and drought disaster events; (3) the key technology analysis and design of the computational experiment system.

articleTitle: Experimental study on compressive strength of the red-bed soft rock highway tunnel's surrounding rock
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Taking typical surrounding rock of the red-bed soft rock highway tunnel for example, two representative rock samples(mudstone and muddy siltstone) along the highway tunnel's surrounding rock are chosen to perform tests of compressive strength, by using the uniaxial compressive test and the point load test, the rock compressive strength characteristics under different weathering degree and water action are analyzed; The results indicate that the water sensitivity of mudstone is high and the Water sensitivity of muddy siltstone is blow. The compressive strength of the mudstone decreases with the weathering degree increases significantly.

Author Keywords: the compressive strength of surrounding rock

articleTitle: A new target tracking and positioning method for grayscale images
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To solve the problem of target tracking and positioning that easily affected by illumination and shadows, we apply the 2-D gradient code matching technique to the problem of target positioning, to make use of the features that the gradient direction angles are relatively stable to illumination and shadows variation. At the same time, Kalman filter is exploited to predict the target positions, by which increase the efficiency of the large quantity of computation in global search. Meanwhile, the gradient code matching is implemented in a much smaller range around the predicted position, so that it could reduce the computational complexity significantly.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Application of grey system theory in detection of total station
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Design of AT hydaulic shift system based on the logical-shift formula
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the shift character of actuator components table of AT and the principle of the hydraulic design, it is easy to obtain the logical-shift formula with the help of the logical analysis, which could help to design the hydraulic shift system of AT. Besides, the logical analysis provides a feasibility analysis method about the control state of shift solenoid.

articleTitle: Agile product development paradigm based on mass customization
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The paper discussed the relationship between mode of production and paradigm of product development, analyzed the principles and features of mass customization design, and proposed a product-family-oriented industrial design procedure. The product structure related with this design method provides the possibilities for user to customize or involve in design, as well as it is helpful to design parallelization and agility.

articleTitle: Application of viscoelastic dampers system to super high building for control of wind-induced vibration
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Taking a super high-rise building as the engineering background, a wind resistant design method of high-rise buildings installed with viscoelastic dampers (VED) is presented in this paper. The mechanical model of VED system and the structure is established through the following steps. Firstly, the typical impulsive wind load is obtained by the impulsive wind simulation program developed by the author. Then, utilizing the iterative dynamical time-history analysis method described in the paper, the responses of the structure with VED subjected to impulsive wind load is obtained. The result shows that the maximal impulsive wind-induced displacement and acceleration could be reduced by 21.4% and 17.9%, respectively. Moreover its interceded displacement could also be significantly reduced. The research indicates that the proposed VED system and method can effectively control the wind-induced response of tall buildings.

articleTitle: Study on the macro-treatment model of mine geological environment
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The macro-treatment model of mine geological environment, namely the prevention treatment model, the progressive treatment model and the aftereffect treatment model, was brought forward on the basis of mining level and severity of environmental geology problems. The control factors are emphasized and the scientific measures are advocated in the prevention treatment model. The progressive treatment model focuses on the dynamic characteristics of mine geological environment in the productive mines and uses specific engineering recovery measures. The aftereffect treatment model pays attention to the effective measures and builds the model by the principle of system engineering.

articleTitle: Theoretical analysis of the refrigerants for the moderate and high temperature water-source heat pump
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: One of the key issues in the development of moderate and high temperature heat pump technology is to find out environmentally friendly working fluids with satisfactory cycle performance. The purpose of this paper is selection and proposed moderate and high temperature heat pump working fluid, using HFCs and HCFCs in class pure and mixed refrigerants as the research objects, by theoretical calculation of cycle performance, screening out the theory of pure good cycle performance, and two non-azeotropic mixtures M1,M2.

articleTitle: Radar image simulation based on target microwave properties
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This For the purpose of avoiding high expense and time-consuming caused by high resolution radar imaging system, a radar image modulation method is put forward in this paper, which is based on the properties of target microwave properties. Optic image of the same target is used first to locate and classify the target, then statistic characteristics of the target is used to estimate the average brightness and fluctuation of the target in radar image. Finally, proper point spread function is used to modulate the mistiness of radar image. Possible use of the method is also discussed.

articleTitle: Analysis of the ground deformation to large cross- section tunnel by Pipe-roof Pre-construction Method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Urban underground engineering construction may have bad influence on the environment and even cause disasters. Pipe-roof Pre-construction Method(PPM) had been used in building a metro station of line No.2 of Shenyang subway. It's very important to analyze and evaluate the deformation of the environment in order to ensure the safety of constructing procedure. So, based on the detailed study of geological conditions and PPM, Flac<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3D</sup> software combined with field monitoring data in stations earthwork phase is used. And then, research on the surface and vault settlement, arch feet headroom convergence and tunnel structure deformation law is presented. The results show that: (1) numerical simulation is close to the monitoring data, which ensures the large cross-section single arch tunnel construction safety, and provides guidance for the first successful application and research of this method in China mainland area. (2) The surface deformation and vault subsidence could be less by using PPM to build large sections tunnel, and in the whole PPM construction process of surface subsidence caused by the proportion is less too, which could meet the requirements of controlling the surface subsidence target. (3) It deserves further research and extension for the PPM to build underground space, because it has obviously social and environmental benefits, and can be used to build traversing urban traffic hub of the underground engineering.

articleTitle: Study on the removal of nitrate in groundwater using rice straw as the solid carbon source
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The start-up of denitrification reactor using rice straws as the solid carbon source and impact of various factors on denitrification process were studied. When the initial NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>--N concentration was 24mg/L, 12°C of temperature, 7~7.5 of pH , 6.25h of hydraulic retention time (HRT) ,the reader was started up soon. And pH and temperature have some influences on denitrification process. When the initial pH value was 7.5 and temperature ranged between 20~30°C, 98% of nitrate could be removed, NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>--N concentration of the effluent was lmg/L ,nitrite was not detected , pH did not changed and COD of the effluent was about 30mg/L. The nitrate in groundwater was removed using rice straw as a solid carbon for biological denitrification successfully, moreover, denitrification process has a great ability of acid and alkali resistance and low temperature tolerance. So Using Rice Straw as the Solid Carbon Source has a high practical value for denitrification in groundwater.

articleTitle: Determination of the maximum power generation of renewable energy generating units in an islanded microgrid
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Renewable energy generating units (REGNs) are widely used in microgrids (MGs). REGNs can reduce the operating cost of a MG; they also affect the operating states of the connected grids, especially the voltages. The larger the power generation of REGNs, the greater the impact on voltage of MGs. Therefore, the power generation of a REGN in a MG should be limited for the grid security. In the current study the binary search method is employed to determine the maximum power generation of REGNs in an islanded MG considering the current and voltage limits. The algorithm for determining the maximum power generation of a REGN without violating the current and voltage limits is presented. The practical applicability of the presented algorithm is demonstrated using an example MG with a 380V radial distribution feeder. Simulation results are also presented and discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Variable fuzzy set model for evaluation of intergrity of pile foundation based on SPA
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the set pair analysis (SPA) and the variable fuzzy sets theory, In order to simplify the evaluation procedure of relative difference degree and make the accurate evaluation of the the integrity of pile foundation quantitatively, a new variable fuzzy set model for evaluation of integrity of pile foundation was established. Moreover, it was shown by comparison of results between a practical example and other methods that the proposed method used to evaluate the integrity of pile foundation was feasible and more accurate.

articleTitle: Analysis and improvement of corrosion problem in automobile components
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The corrosion state of various components was investigated to improve anti-corrosion performance of automobile by vehicle accelerated corrosion test and parts neutral salt spray test respectively. The corrosion reasons of typical parts such as galvanized bolt, galvanized pipe, painting support, constant velocity drive shaft, were analyzed in this paper. An improvement solution was presented to adopt Dacromat coated bolt, galvanized PVF metal pipe and electrophoresis bracket, etc. The anti-corrosion objective is achieved for a vehicle to ensure that the function parts can operate at service condition for six years. The equivalent relationships of corrosion damage on the typical automotive parts between the vehicle accelerated corrosion test and salt spray test were built, which can provide a new method for anti-corrosion target decomposition of vehicle.

articleTitle: A organization method study on increasing the cargo capacity of the railways of harbor
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to the data of the throughput of some Chinese ports and related railways, the article analyzes respective advantages and disadvantages of sea-highway and sea railway transportation. Railway transportation is quite inexpensive, quick and safe. The article takes Ningbo Beilun Harbor as an example, suggests building double-track railways for the harbor and adopting automatic blocking system so as to improve the transportation efficiency. Among the goods transferred through die harbor, resource materials account for largest proportion. Therefore there is an unbalance in the two directions of the railway transportation. The railways double track automatic block transportation in the same direction simultaneously can increase the carrying capacity, and the railway signal equipment may guarantee the transportation safety. All in all, railway automatic block transportation in the same direction simultaneously can boost the combined transportation ability and the economic efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on process planning and progress control for large-scale ship building
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Shipbuilding is a complex systematical work, therefore planning and controlling shipbuilding course is a big system engineering. In order to legitimately plan and control ship construction procedure, we employ process modeling technology, process programming technology and conflict resolution mechanism, which are at the base of the time database. We also apply the Kanban management based on WBS (Work Breakdown Structure). In the display boards, different color reveals the processing state of each division, which help the relevant principals have a objective understanding of the shipbuilding procedure. The theory introduced in present paper aim to realize process planning and time controlling of shipbuilding procedure, and to ensure controlling the productive time will be come true.

articleTitle: Study on propagation laws of blasting vibration in deep roadway
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to field condition, blasting vibration of medium deep-hole blasting in deep rock entry were tested for study the influence of entry by blasting vibration in coalmine, attenuation coefficient α of earthquake wave and equation coefficient k are acquire by regression and analysis on point vibration peak velocity and acceleration of tested results, then summarizes propagation laws of blasting vibration in deep rock roadway: radial component (included velocity and acceleration directions) of blasting vibration play a leading role in blasting seismic effect.

articleTitle: Spatio-temporal characteristics of friction torque of rolling bearing for space applications
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Via the experimental investigation, the influence of the vacuum degree on the friction torque of the rolling bearing for space applications is studied to explore the spatio-temporal characteristics of the friction torque. The simulation is conducted by means of a special tester and the observed data of the friction torque are processed with the help of the statistical theory. A nonlinear function with the variable coefficient and standard deviation is discovered, revealing that the time series of the friction torque is characterized by the uncertainty of variables and the variability of functions. The result presents that under the condition of the variable vacuum degree, the time series of the friction torque changes from a nonstationary process to a stationary process as the rolling bearing undergoes two stages from initial wear to normal wear. This shows that the friction torque belongs to a nonlinearly and dynamically evolutionary process.

articleTitle: Research on the degradation of petroleum hydrocarbons on the effect of microbial activity in oil-contaminated sites
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Microbe is the principal part of microbial biodegradation of soil petroleum hydrocarbons, so how to adjust the environmental conditions of the contaminated site and enhance its activity is the key to improving the efficiency of oil degradation. By collecting the original oil-contaminated soil taken in an oil deposit in Northeast and measuring soil microbial activity and indicators of environmental factors, this article discuss the microbial activity's impact on the degradation of oil pollutants, combined with natural attenuation testing.The results show that the soil of contaminated sites is contaminated by petroleum hydrocarbon at different levels, of which the highest content of petroleum hydrocarbon is up to 7.10 mg/kg. Oil mainly contains alkanes, benzene and other light components. Through natural attenuation monitoring, petroleum hydrocarbon content of the sampling points decreases obviously, of which the maximum degradation rate is point T5 that reaches 73%. Soil respiration , the overall microbial activity , decreased from 66.1875mg/kg to 47.8475mg/kg. As far as the enzyme is concerned, the dehydrogenase plays a significant role in the microbial biode gradation of petroleum hydrocarbons, whose activity strength positively correlates with the degradation rate. In the degradation of oil components, the relevance between FDA hydrolase activity and the oil components is the most significant. The stronger FDA hydrolysis activity is, the stronger the ability of biodegradation of each component is. In addition, through analyzing the site soil conditions, PH is in the range of 7.25 ~ 8.13, the nutritional level far below the required one of biodegradation of petroleum hydrocarbons (C: N = 10:1), and soil moisture content lower than the optimum conditions for microbial growth and metabolism. Therefore, it is greatly significant to adjust the soil pH, increase nutrient levels and the regulation of other environmental factors which can increase microbial activity, accelerate the degradation of petroleum hydrocarbons, and enhance the role of soil protection action to groundwater.

articleTitle: Analysis of bed-building discharge in the middle and lower Ba River
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By using the H.N.MaKKaBeeB Method, Return Period Method, Bankfull Discharge Method and the Effective Sediment Transport Discharge Method to the hydrological data of Ba River, the bed-building discharge has been calculated and made as flow conditions of river model experiment. Finally, it was applied to the model experiment about Ba River and the results was compared with the one of balance riverbed from the normal river model experiment made by Northwest Water Conservancy Science Research Institute in 2001. The result shows that 6 years working life of the reservoir of Ba-river No. B rubber dam being regime channel is agreed with that of the prototype. It indicates furthermore that the bed-building discharge used in this river model experiment is correct, and the H.N. MaKKaBeeB Method, Return Period Method, the LuoMinxun formula of Bankfull Discharge Method has a better applicability to calculate bed-building discharge for Ba River.

articleTitle: Airflow through crushed-rock layers
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Pressure drops through packed concrete spheres and crushed rocks were investigated by wind tunnel experiments. The diameters of concrete spheres were 0.041 m and 0.052 m, respectively. The mean particle size of the crushed rocks was 0.096 m. The experimental results show that the Ergun equation with revised coefficient values can be used to predict pressure drops through the coarse spherical particle beds. A practical Ergun-type equation for arbitrary shape particles has been developed based on Krumbein sphericity. The coefficient values of the practical Ergun-type equation for crushed-rock layers were measured.

articleTitle: The simulation of scara robot based on OpenGL and STL
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The paper studies how to implement the motion simulation of scara robot, using Visual Basic 6.0 program language based on OpenGL and STL data model. After reading the STL data model, we can easily render the 3D model of SCARA using OpenGL. Then, according to the SCARA robot kinematics analysis, we can calculate the required joint parameters of the target and obtain the different pose of the robot in the movement. At last, by means of the double buffers of OpenGL, the motion simulation is implemented through redrawing and redisplaying the 3D model in different time.

articleTitle: Research on material removal rate of each element of chemical mechanical polishing
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In the chemical mechanical polishing(CMP), polishing pad, components of polishing solution and polishing pressure have very important influence on the material removal rate (MRR) and the quality of polishing. In this article, we will do some research on above factors respectively, in order to test the influences of various factors on MRR of silicon wafer. On the other hand, we searched for the methods of improving morphology by polishing silicon wafer with prepared polishing solution and detecting its surface morphology. Through the experiments, it was found that the abrasive plays the dominant role in the material removal and the maximal proportion ups to 70.6%, and we also get a fact that the material removal rate add with polishing pressure increase. Detecting the wafer surface morphology after polishing, it was found that the surface roughness reached the nanometer level (<;3.81 nm).

articleTitle: Survey of reliable and efficient MAC layer multicast protocols in MANETs
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: It is a demand of many applications for networks to support multicast. These applications, for instance, can be audio/video conferences, distributed simulation, multi-user games, distributed databases. The broadcast characteristics of wireless channels bring the huge challenge for providing multicast in wireless Ad Hoc networks. Especially, it is impossible to provide multicast/broadcast with quality in application layers without reliable MAC layer multicast. In this paper, the problems of IEEE 802.11 like protocols for providing multicast are analyzed. The solutions and protocols of reliable MAC layer multicast in wireless Ad Hoc networks are surveyed. Finally, the comparison and future open issues are discussed.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research of treatment of wastewater containing copper using new modified ceramic filter media
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Experimental study on two dimensional carbonation of fly ash concrete
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on accelerated carbonation tests, ID and 2D carbonation depths of fly ash concrete were measured. With the help of the influence coefficient Ks of steel bar existence and interaction coefficient K<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">c</sub> of 2D carbonation, the carbonation principle of concrete specimen with steel bar and 2D carbonation principle was analysed. The research results indicate that there are obvious interaction in corner of concrete specimen. The steel bar existence can inhibit concrete carbonation to a certain extent, the influence coefficient of steel bar existence and carbonation age conforms to logarithm relation.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Hydrogen sulfide and carbon dioxide to the gas pipeline corrosion mechanism and protection research
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Observable degree analysis of heavy-duty gas turbine based on svd method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A new method of the observable degree analysis based on the singular value decomposition of the observable matrix was proposed. The method can be used to calculate each state's observable degree more correctly. Two commonly used methods, condition number method and singular value decomposition method, of observable degree analysis were united, and the feature of the two methods was analyzed. The proposed method was applied to analyze the states observable degree of a heavy-duty gas turbine at different conditions, and the result can be used to assess the effectiveness of gas path fault diagnostic schemes quantitatively.

articleTitle: Environmental problems of Baiguishan Wetland Nature Reserve and the countermeasures
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The status quo and major problems of wetland resources in Baiguishan Nature Reserve were analyzed from the angle of sustainable development. And the strategies and countermeasures were put forward for protecting and sustainable exploiting of the wetland resources.

articleTitle: Overview of bridge structure damage criterion under seismic action
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to reduce bridge project under the effects of earthquake damage, it is necessary to bridge structure under earthquake effect of performance evaluation and comparison, this one of the main thing is that the failure criterion determination. So far, domestic and foreign scholars have made numerous earthquake Failure Criteria for bridge structure, which have a wider application based on the ductile deformation, strength and energy-based guidelines and parameters of energy and ductile deformation of the destruction of two-parameter Failure criteria. This paper makes a summary of the criteria's history and merits.

articleTitle: Indentation test of soft tissue for investigating needle tissue machining
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In biopsy operations, a sharp edged needle is used to cut and remove the desired tissue specimen to identify and diagnose cancer and other diseases. Accurate needle insertion into soft tissue is of practical importance in cancer diagnosis and therapies. When the needle is inserting into soft tissue, the nonlinear material behaviors result in large tissue deformation and the needle deflection, which will induce large insertion error. In this paper, the concept of needle tissue machining was introduced. Tissue is a new "work piece material" in cutting process, and its mechanical properties have crucial effects on the machining process. Indentation experiments of porcine livers are performed to measure the force response depending on various indentation depths and indentation velocities. The Kelvin model and Neo-Hookean model are selected to develop the nonlinear model of porcine liver. Matlab codes based on Nonlinear Least Square Method have been created to fit the indentation results. This methodology can be used to investigate needle bending, soft tissue deformation and cutting behaviors.

articleTitle: Analysis of join-structure influencing on guidance system for high-speed maglev train
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: For Analysis of guidance performances and influence factors for maglev curve running. This paper first investigates join-structure influences on guidance system of the neighboring bogies, which is based on kinemics modeling and simulation of double bogies system. Firstly, system structure and simplification condition are described. Secondly, mathematics model for system tracking the guideway is set up. Thirdly, elements distortions of join-structure are computed. Finally, system simulation model is established, it has obtained function curves of join-structure and analyzed influences on guidance system with experimental curves together. Results indicate that forces from joint elements almost counteract, but composition of moments is up to 15KN.m on the circular curve of radius 400m and revolving directions acting on the neighboring bogies are contrary, guidance currents will be increased to supply electromagnetic moments and avoid collisions with guideway. As one influence factor of maglev negotiating the curve, this research on join-structure is in favor of betterments of guidance controller and system structure, thereby, improving the curve negotiation capacity of guidance system.

articleTitle: Preparation and thermal shock properties of Si3N4-WC nanocomposites
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>-WC nanocomposites were fabricated by hot-pressing nano-sized Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub> powders and sub-micrometer WC powders. The effect of WC particles on mechanical properties and thermal shock properties of silicon nitride ceramics were analyzed and discussed. The addition of proper amount of WC particles can improve the flexural strength and the fracture toughness, the optimum amount was 8wt.% and 4wt.% respectively. Si<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>N<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>-WC nanocomposites showed both higher critical temperature difference and better resistance to crack propagation compared to those of the monolithic silicon nitride ceramic.

articleTitle: Experimental study on cooling characteristics of a radiant floor cooling system in Beijing
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The cooling characteristics of a radiant floor cooling system with the embedded pipes for an office building in Beijing had been researched mainly by experiments in this paper. The indoor air and floor temperature changed with supply water and outdoor temperature were tested and analyzed. The experimental results show that: 1) temperature of supply water plays a more important role on the characteristics of a radiant floor cooling system than water velocity and shall be controlled above 17°C to prevent condensation on the floor surface, 2) when the radiant floor cooling system is adopted, indoor mean radiant temperature and operative temperature are lower than air temperature respectively. 3)The vertical air temperature difference is about 2.1∼4.1°C at the height of 0.1m to 1.1m above the floor and meets the related standard during 95% of 24 hours in a day.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of sunlight prototype system on cross-platform
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Currently, the sunshine analysis software based on special graphics software and GIS platform need to repeatly realize calculation process and complicated algorithms to special data and development interface, which directly lead to inconsistent results. Aiming to above problems, the thesis designs and develops some Model-DLLs in which referred algorithms are packed for a variety of graphics software and GIS platform, with COM component technology. The results show that for ArcGIS, AutoCAD, SketchUp and other GIS and graphics platform, the packaged algorithm model of sunshine analysis can achieve unique results, and greatly improve development efficiency and reuse.

articleTitle: The design on vehicle body panels based on three-dimensional laser scanning technology
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to design the vehicle body structure a method on three-dimensional laser scanning was raised. In this paper three-dimensional scanning point cloud data were obtained on a certain vehicle body panels by using the three-dimensional laser scanner. Then the point cloud data processing was completed detailed including three different stages of point processing, polygon processing and the shape processing. According to the prototype features of vehicle body panels the three-dimensional modeling of parts was built and comprehensive digital information was obtained on each part of the panel. The three-dimensional reconstruction on the body panels was completed, which provides a feasible method for the modern body design.

articleTitle: Research and design of vacuum system for A 10MeV cyclotron
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The particle has to be accelerated in a vacuum chamber to prevent accelerated particle colliding with any other gas molecules, besides, the vacuum is used to insulate the accelerating electrodes which work at a very high potential to earth. A vacuum system which operates at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-7</sup> mbar and has to be completely nonmagnetic need to be designed for a 10 MeV cyclotron (CYCHU-10) developing in Huazhong University of Science and Technology (HUST). The vacuum chamber has to meet the requirements of intensity and airtightness which works at specified temperature and pressure condition, while weld container can completely meet these requirements. Otherwise, we should try to make the mechanical and thermal deformation of chamber induced by atmospheric pressure and thermal radiation of the accelerating electrodes (dees), which will affect the accelerating progress as small as possible. Finite-element analysis based on SOLIDWORKS Simulation will be used for mechanical deformation. The preliminary design of the vacuum system will also be described in this paper.

articleTitle: Key-free safe based on palmprint recognition
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A safe can be made safely by making it key-free. Such a safe can be opened by recognizing the owner's palmprint features only. A new method based on wavelet transform is proposed according to the palmprint line direction and space frequency. A support vector machine classifier is formed by combining radial basis of functions(RBF) kernel with polynomials kernel to significantly improve the rate of recognition. Simulation tests demonstrated satisfactory operation of the key-free safe.

articleTitle: Finite element model updating for space truss structure by fuzzy pattern identification
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Taking the roof space truss structure of Shenzhen Citizen Center as the engineering background, a novel finite element model updating method for the large space steel truss structure is proposed in the paper. Among all the components, the numerical model's accuracy depends on the joint rigidity of the nodes. Thus the main purpose of updating is to determine the proper joint rigidity of all nodes. The process is conducted as following: Firstly, nodes are classified according to their size and rigidity, and then by changing joint rigidity parameters of different types of nodes and utilizing finite element method, the database which reflects the relationship between joint rigidity parameters and natural vibration frequencies of model is established. Secondly, structural natural vibration frequencies are selected as the input, and joint rigidity parameters of classified nodes are the output data, the fuzzy pattern system is obtained. Finally, the measured natural vibration frequencies of the roof structure of Shenzhen Citizen Center are inputted into the fuzzy pattern identification system, and then rigidity parameters of three categories of joint are determined. Thus, accurate finite element model of the roof space truss structure of Shenzhen Citizen Center is achieved.

articleTitle: Designing lag observer scheme for unified chaotic systems
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a scheme of lag observer is developed to estimate the variables of unified chaotic systems. Theoretically, the exponential stability of the lag error system can be guaranteed,and the lag estimation of the unknown variables of unified chaotic systems can be achieved. Furthermore,a scheme for secure communication is presented based on the lag observer in theory. Finally, corresponding numerical simulations are provided to show the effectiveness of the proposed schemes.

articleTitle: Study of coupling characteristic of metal chamber with aperture based on FEKO
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Aperture coupling is the primary way that electromagnetic interference energy into the metal chamber, which would damage the electronic equipment. Articles use FEKO electromagnetic simulation software to analysis the aperture coupling electromagnetic field inside the metal chamber with equal-area different shape (square, circular, rectangular) and the different number apertures . Analysis results showed that: equal-area condition, the round hole chamber has the best shielding effectiveness, multiple hole chamber shielding effectiveness is better than a single hole chamber.

articleTitle: Simulation of occupant evacuation based on 3D scenario analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To improve spatial descriptions in evacuation model, this paper establishes an analysis process for variable distributions in 3d continuous space. The features of distributions were captured to simulate spatial cognition and way finding for occupants. Evacuation strategies including follow, walk-aside, crawl and crossover were designed accordingly and a behavioral model was constructed. Technologies such as texture mapping and skeletal animation were employed to represent appearance and behaviors of variables in 3d environment. The results demonstrate that 3d scenario analysis can comprehensively represent spatial relations and facilitate realistic evacuation simulation with graphics engine. The simulation can support computer aided building design regarding evacuation safety in disaster and emergencies.

articleTitle: Influence of temperatures on the mechanical properties of AZ91D Mg alloy processed by ECAP
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Experiments were conducted to evaluate the Influence of temperatures on grain refinement and mechanical properties of AZ91D magnesium alloy processed by ECAP. The results show the grain size decreased as the pressing temperature decreased. The ultra-fine grain size of 0.5μm was fabricated suggested that the two-step ECAP process is useful than one-step ECAP process in grain refinement.
