The mechanical properties became more and more similar as the pressing temperature decreased.

articleTitle: Research on the residual problem of delisting construction enterprises
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Establishing the evaluation mechanism of construction enterprises is helpful to regular the order of construction market. But there will occur some residual problem, such as construction period postpone, economic loss of the proprietor, handing over project, claims and so on. In this paper, some measures are put forward to overcome such problems, and will be in favor to the establishing of the evaluation mechanism of construction enterprises.

articleTitle: Concerning with standby power consumption and creating low carbon life —Trailing and studying the standby power consumption of office equipment in Kunming
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The present paper inspected the actual standby power consumption of commonly used office equipment and microcomputers as well as trailed and studied the use of the office equipment of three typical enterprises in Kunming. The results showed that the office equipment has a huge standby power consumption and there is a broad space in energy saving and emission reduction. An enterprise can save plenty of energy and reduce power consumption and emission to realize a low carbon office work by strengthening the management and raising the conscientiousness of energy saving.

articleTitle: An optimizing tool orientation method for positional 5-axis machining
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Positional 5-axis machining is widely applied in high-speed machining the surfaces of automobile panel dies. Its key factor is to set up an appropriate tool orientation. The relationship between tool orientation and tool-axial inclination was analyzed, and the optimization method based on planar fitting was proposed. It consists of three steps: Firstly, the machining surfaces are scattered to points and fitted a plane, and the tool-axis is tilted a angle α that is recommended as the initial tool-axial inclination, in the plane which is defined by the feed direction and the normal direction of the fitted plane; Secondly, the heel angle of each point on machining surfaces are calculated, and the numeral scales of machining points whose inclinations are in a certain range to all are also counted; Finally, it is drawn that if the tool-axial orientation is optimal based on the counted result, otherwise, it is needed to reselect a new or to re-divide the machining areas until a satisfactory result is gotten. In addition, a software tool was developed to optimize tool orientation for positional 5-axis machining, and an application case was introduced to prove the validity of the method.

articleTitle: The relation between city planning-construction and geological environment
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Nowadays the urbanization is accelerating, the water environment problem increasingly serious, especially the flood disaster, groundwater resources development and protection problems, seriously hindering the healthy and sustainable development of the city. This paper is based on the flood geological record which is since palaeoloxodon, put forward the view of urban flood control planning and construction, and take Shandong Taian and Jinan as examples, discusses the urban development should conform to the geological environmental conditions in brief. This not only satisfy the needs of the city space, but also can guarantee the city basic geological stability and protect the water environment water resources possibly, to ensure the sustainable the city's development.

articleTitle: Soil erosion change on the Fu-niu Mountains of Huaihe River Valley
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Using GIS and relation data, soil erosion change on the Fu-niu Mountains of Huaihe River Valley was made in 1986, 2000 and 2002. From the space this aspect, Soil erosion is mainly distributed in the north and west and south, the east is better than the west, the central region is better than the south and the north. From the time aspect, Soil erosion is a slight decrease, Erosion area rate is 24.74% in 1987, and it reduce to 24.12% in 2000, and it reduce to 22.33% in 2007. The results of the study show, the soil erosion in general presents alleviate trend.

Author Keywords: The Fu-niu Mountains of Huaihe River Valley

articleTitle: Security issues of topology discovery in wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Due to the importance of topology discovery for many tasks of sensor networks, in this paper, we discuss the basic approaches for network topology discovery, point out the security issues of the network topology discovery and propose possible countermeasures.

articleTitle: Centralized control system of nodes based on wireless sensor network
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to the principle of gases and infrared detection, a research of nodes control system which is based on wireless sensor network is proposed. The specific design and the operating principle of this system are described. What is more, details of the various parts of system, including gas detecting circuit, infrared detecting circuit, alarming circuit, signal encoding circuit, high-frequency signal generating and transmitting circuit and signal demodulating, decoding circuit, are given. Finally, experimental results were analyzed, and it did well in aspects of wireless transmission range, interference immunity and response sensitivity. This system processed wide range of utility value and had high social and economic benefits.

articleTitle: The safety management of railway dangerous goods stations
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper discusses about the existing problems of dangerous goods transportation of railway. In order to solve those problems, the author puts forward the following suggestions: proactively improving confirmation of qualities process, improve the corresponding procedure, paying much attention to dangerous goods stations input, strengthening the construction of professional transport team of dangerous goods.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation research on flow pattern of gas-water two-phase flow in horizontal pipeline
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the exploration and development of oil and gas resources in ocean, desert, polar and other regions, multiphase transport technology has been more widely used. When the mixture flows in pipelines, different flow patterns will be formed as parameters' changes. The dynamics and heat transfer characteristics are varied with the changes of flow pattern. So, it is very important to study the flow pattern for the theoretical research of multiphase flow. In this article, numerical simulation software FLUENT is used and the VOF model is selected to simulate the flow regimes of multiphase flow in pipelines. Unsteady, implicit, segregated solver was used to carry out the numerical calculation, and qualitative analysis was done. Simulation results have good match with the Mandhane Flow Pattern map.

articleTitle: Design of 13.56MHz RF card reader based on MF RC500
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to improve security and speediness of access control system, a RF reader design solution of frequency 13.56MHz based on microcontroller chip P89C58X2RN and radio frequency chip MF RC500 is proposed in this paper. The operating characteristics of frequency chip RC500 and RF card MIFARE1 are analyzed, and the hardware circuit of IC reader, RF antenna and the software design are developed. The system has been successfully applied to the access control system of a company, and the RF reader attains preferable application results.

articleTitle: On the quick construction of all edge-balance index sets of the graph Cn×P7
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we completely determine the edge-balance index sets of the graph C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</inf>×P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf>(n ≥3) and give constructive proof.

articleTitle: A fast transient load current regulator
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a fast transient load current regulator, and the simulation result and layout is shown as well. This regulator provides the reference voltage following with the power supply for high speed logic circuit, which introduces a parallel path structure of high speed low loop gain and low speed high loop gain, and have fast load transient. The circuit is based on 0.25um Si-Ge technology of 3.3V/1.5V dual gate; the power supply is 4.5∼5.5V, load capacitance is 400pF, load current is 0∼200mA, working ambient temperature is −40∼135 °C, the maximum transient load current is 280mA, line regulation is 20mV/V, load regulation is 580uV/200mA, and load transient is 60mV/280mA. The DC loop gain, unit gain bandwidth, and phase margin of parallel path are 55.6dB, 1.2GHz and 64.7° in turn. The regulator has three working mode: sleep, standby and active, which power supply is 35.6uA, 10.4mA and 10.4mA in turn. The area of the layout is 234.8*100um<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Design of spectral analyzer based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A spectral analyzer is a instrument that can show the characteristic of the input signal in frequency domain. It is an important tool which is used to develop and research electronic product. With the development of computer and microelectronics, Spectrum analyzing based on Digital Signal Process has been applied in all kinds of fields, and it acts as an important role. A kind of digital spectrum analyzer based on field programmable gate array (FPGA) is designed in this paper, which describes its hardware system structure and working principle and analyze the discrete Fourier transform (DFT) algorithm and the base by 4-FFT decimation in frequency algorithm for core signal processing. The use method of spectrum analyses system is easy and visual after testing in lab. If input the testing signal and change the sampling frequency, we can observe the spectrum of signal on the VGA monitor.

articleTitle: Structure design and fabrication of a bistable microvalve
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A bistable microvalve is presented in this paper. The microvalve is fabricated using a cheap and developing technology combined of micro-milling of a polymer, sputtering, photolithography and adhesive bonding. The bistable characteristic of a magnetic system compensates the high power consumption of thermopneumatic actuators. The initial gap height between the sealing membrane and the valve seat is optimized with respect to a large flow through the valve even at low inlet-outlet pressure difference and providing enough sealing force. Simulation results show that when the valve has an initial gap height of 70 µm, a gas flow can reach over 90% of the flow limit of the valve and the valve can theoretically seal a pressure difference of more than 5 bars. A prototype of the microvalve, which has a PMMA housing in dimensions of 26.0 mm × 26.0 mm × 10.9 mm, was fabricated. The valve can seal a gas flow of 350 kPa practically and the flow passes through the valve quite well even when the pressure difference is low. A gas flow of 490 Pa can generate continuous bubble flow when the tube connected to the outlet is put into water.

articleTitle: Practice of hydraulic tracking predictive test for the closure work of large project
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The main river closure and open channel closure practice of TGP (Three Gorges project) were taken as example in this paper to study the real-time and whole process tracking test of the closure work hydraulic conditions and the technical routines, technical means, predictive methods, predictive results as well as their functions of hydraulic conditions prediction by means of integrating hydraulic model, which can provide references for the closure work of similar large project.

articleTitle: Finite element analysis of stability of the inverse T type breakwater with jackets and pile foundations
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The inverse T type breakwater with jackets and pile foundations is a new type breakwater in port and coastal engineering, which mixes gravity breakwater with pile ones. A 3D elastic-plastic finite element model was estabilished for stability analysis of the inverse T type breakwater with jackets and pile foundations. The displacement field distribution, the stability failure pattern and the bearing behavior of the breakwater were investigated. The failure judgment criterions of the breakwater based on the bearing capacity limit and the displacement threshold were presented and the finite element method for the stability analysis of the breakwater was developed. The effects of relevant parameters on the stability of the inverse T type breakwater with jackets and pile foundations were analyzed. The present research could be a reference for the stability analysis of the new type of structure.

Author Keywords: inverse T type breakwater with jackets and pile foundations

articleTitle: Construction technology and application of curve pushing accumulating sliding in large-span spatial steel structure
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the large span space structure of Ordos's airport extension project, a construction technique of curve pushing accumulating sliding was put forward and the principle of which was elaborated. A whole set of construction techniques was proposed, which included the design of three-directional bearing slipway and skied beams, friction-reducing technique and anti-friction materials, analog loading experimental technique, computer control technique and so on. Through finite element numerical simulations and analysis of the entire construction process, the stability, member stress and structural deformation of the whole structure during the construction process were obtained. The position of the crucial monitoring points could be determined as well. The monitoring during the construction indicated ordinance with the finite element result which verify the proposed technique safe, feasible and effective.

Author Keywords: three-directional bearing slipway and skied beams

articleTitle: Failure analysis of shrink fit tool chuck
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on all kinds of failure mode of shrink fit tool chuck, the critical magnitudes of interference of these cases are calculated in theory and are validated by the FEA software. Through comparative analysis of the two results, the range of magnitude of interference is obtained. At last, the best fit tolerance of shrink fit tool chuck and tool is advanced. Research work provides a reference for the devise of shrink fit tool chuck.

articleTitle: A novel beam model based on ultra-sparse arbitrary spatial array
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In deep space exploration, the communication signal between the deep space detector and command-control center will experience a very large attenuation; the domain of this attenuation can be divided into two parts. One is caused by the spread of spherical wave; the other is due to the scattering and absorption of atmosphere and ionosphere, which value can reach to 40~50dB. If the distributed satellites communications relay can be used in deep space exploration, that the attenuation caused by the scattering and absorption of atmosphere and ionosphere can be avoided, and the quality of communication in deep space exploration will be improved significantly. This paper proposes a beam model of ultra-sparse arbitrary spatial array based on the distributed array of satellite antennas, and the simulation results confirmed the correctness and validity of this proposed model.

articleTitle: The study on degradation of 2,4-dichlorophenol by Pd catalyzed electrode modified with surfactants CTAB
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Pd/PPy(CTAB)/Ti electrode was prepared by electrochemical deposition behaviors of composite membrane of surfactants CTAB and pyrrole. The results of CV revealed that Pd/PPy(CTAB)/Ti electrode can get hydrogen adsorption peak of −146.8mA at −500mV (vs. Hg/Hg<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>SO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>). Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM) images revealed that Pd was deposited almost homogeneous particles on the PPy composite membrane modified with CTAB. The range of its size is from nanons to a few microns. An extended sheets formation can be seen on the tiny particle surfaces under high magnification. This structure has a good spatial extent. The dechlorination experimental results indicate that the removal efficiency of 2, 4-dichlorophenol reaches 99.0% and the current efficiency reaches 28.1% when the dechlorination current and time are 5mA and 80min respectively on Pd/PPy(CTAB)/Ti electrode prepared at optimum conditions. The increase of the initial concentration of 2,4-DP has no influence on the removal efficiency.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Study of Network Planning, optimization for WLAN
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Stepwise confidence interval method for dose-response and effectiveness studies
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper we propose one method with a sequence of binomial data, utilize a stepwise confidence interval method for effectiveness study, and our method have more accurate confidence interval. Through employing our method, all the declarations can be guaranteed to be correct with a probability higher than 100(1-α )%. That is, the error rate is properly controlled.

articleTitle: Fire resistance calculation of large span steel structure
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, McCaffrey plume model is introduced to calculate convection heat flux to large span steel structure during fire, and a critical temperature is defined, below which the stress calculation could be omitted. It's also suggested that the impact of the failure of a certain section on the whole structure should be considered. Such method is applied to the fire safety analysis of the large span steel structure of an airport. The results show that the temperature is sensitive to the height, thus the protection of the low position beams should draw special attention. While the column is too close to the fire source, it could get over heated, even if protected by fire retardant coating, so the accumulation of combustibles close to the column should be prevented during daily operation.

articleTitle: Design of the detection system of CNC lathe thread machining
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The most important function of the CNC lathe is threads machining. By studying the detection of photoelectric Encoder, a thread machining detection system was projected, and proposed specific methods to Pulse Shaping, frequency doubling, phase discrimination, and counting photoelectric encoder output signals. And this is to solve the problems of pulse counting and differentiating directions, controlling precision, synchronization and anti-interference when screw-cutting is on its way. Dual differential receptors SN75115 is introduced into the system as its plastic circuit, and to kick out common-mode interference at the same time. Frequency doubling circuit use the exclusive-or gate associate with flip-flop, and use flip-flop 74LS74D to accomplish phase discrimination and synchronous control. Practice shows that the system has its reality effect to materialize signal detecting with high accuracy and stability as well as position-servo control.

articleTitle: The impact of forest cover degree of surface for runoff and geological environmental
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The paper discusses the relationship of the forest cover rate and the quantity of surface flow of two typical basins in LuZhong mountain area in more than forty years. The result shows that : the increase of the forest cover rate ,helps to the supply of precipitation to the ground water ,and helps to slow down the drainage speed of the precipitation, reduce the flood peak flow in flood season in mountain areas ,which could reduce the arises of debris flow disasters; At the same time add the output of ground water in dry season ,which means add it's dry season runoff. It concludes that the increase of one basin's forest cover rate is helpful to the flood control of a reservoir in north area which has long dry season and concentrative precipitation time and helpful to water resources development and utilization. On the hand, the development of forest cover has significant effect to ground geohydrologic environment that the groundwater recharge from precipitation is increased.

articleTitle: Analysis on vibrator of vibrating compactor based on ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to improve density uniformity of compacted artificial marble slab, the paper analyzes the working process of vibrating compactor, points that the traditional motion mode of vibrator may cause uneven distribution of materials and proposes a new mode of motion. Lastly, using the finite element software ANSYS, we have performed the stress analysis of the whole working process, and obtained the best position of vibrators.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation on tensile properties of Ω-shaped frozen pipe joint
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In recent years, there were many accidents of frozen pipe broken in the civil engineering. This was a serious threat to the project. In order to solve the frozen pipe broken problem the tensile properties of the Ω-shaped frozen pipe joint were studied by numerical simulation method. It indicated that the joint has big elongation indicator and flexibility. The curved part straightens at first under the tension force. And the local occur destruction after the limit deformation. This Ω-shaped frozen pipe joint extends more than 10mm in axial orientation without damage. So this kind of joint has good flexibility in both axial and lateral direction. It can hold up the deformation by temperature, frost and excavation in the frozen wall. This can prevent frozen pipe from breaking. The Ω-shaped frozen pipe joint can been used widely in the civil engineering.

articleTitle: Natural frequency of truss bridge in different support forms
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to study the natural frequency of truss bridge, linear spring unit and bilinear model unit are separately used to simulate board rubber support and sliding support. Then modal analysis has been done by large-scale structure analysis software ANSYS in different support forms. At last, the results have been compared to explain that the forms of middle-rigid & end-flexible supports and middle-flexible & end-sliding supports are suitably used in the truss bridge.

articleTitle: Research on modeling of human-machine hybrid production systems using CPN Tools
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper treats the massively used man-machine hybrid systems as the research objects and firstly defines their basic color collections and product elements. Then according to the definitions the bottom layer model of the human resource center, dynamic purchase order center, human-computer hybrid work center is established by making use of the CPN TOOLS modeling tool. Also, the top level model of the human-computer hybrid system with multiple products and working centers is built basing on the bottom level model.

articleTitle: Construction of gas flow standard facilities by means of positive pressure sonic nozzle
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The sonic nozzle airflow standard facilities are applied widely throughout the world and can be divided into two categories, negative pressure and positive pressure methods. The latter is better than the former at calibrating flowmeters and analyzing the impact of pressure and density on performance of flowmeters. This paper discusses several key issues about establishing standard facilities by the positive pressure method. In order to ensure the stability of stagnation pressure and flow rate, it is vital important to choose rationally the parameters of stable pressure system which is jointly controlled by the air compressors, gasholders and self-operated pressure regulating valves. On the basis of the analysis of the heat transfer process, the water vapor in the compressed air is most likely to be saturated and cause dew to condense out of the compressor air. For this reason, the measures of filtration and drying should be included in the standard facilities. Critical flow function which changes with temperature and pressure must be calculated from ISO equation, instead of using a constant.

articleTitle: Nickel-based monolithic catalyst for tar cracking of biomass pyrolysis
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To eliminate the tar coming from biomass pyrolysis, a kind of nickel-based monolithic catalyst is prepared in this study. The specific surface area, pore volume is characterized. The effect of different acid treatment time, different nickel loading quantity on its catalytic activity is investigated. The results show that the specific surface area is 156m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>/g after acid treatment of 5h. The loading quantity of active component is linear with coating times. The influence of coating times on the gas composition is quite small, and the sum of the content of H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> and CO keeps as high as 90 vol %. After 6h catalytic reaction, the phase structure of catalyst hasn't any change, and the tar conversion decreased from 87.4 wt % to 81.3wt %. The quantity of the coking is tested to be about 1wt %.

articleTitle: Parameter identification of vehicle step steering dynamic system by prediction-error approach
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In the present research, the prediction-error method is applied for the analysis of vehicle handling performance in conjunction of the dynamic simulation model parameter identification. In corporation with Multi-body system dynamics simulation in ADAMS and the theoretical analysis, the mathematical model is established for the vehicle system. By the Newton-Raphson procedure and the Least Square Method, the identification model can be solved iteratively. Then the mathematical model can be thereafter developed by means of the prediction-error method. It is shown from the transient responses of the vehicle system that the model structure is simplied.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Urban road traffic status evaluation analysis based on AHP
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Numerical investigation on shock wave interaction in a turbine cascade
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Interaction process of condensation shock and aerodynamic shock in superheated steam flow and nucleation flow with different exit Mach number was numerically studied. The model was implemented within a full N-S viscous flow solution procedure, and the process of condensation was calculated by the quadrature method of moments. Numerical schlieren photography was performed to show the shock wave distribution in cascade. The boundary layer separation caused by Shockwave reflection on suction side and nucleation were showed and the caused losses is discussed. The numerical result shows condensation shock would change the strength of shock wave and flow angle in cascade, and reduce the boundary layer separation caused by shock wave reflection on suction side, enhance the strength of wake, and affect the related losses.

articleTitle: Density detection of concrete structures with Wood Wool Cement Board as permanent shuttering template
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The internal defects of cast-in-situ concrete structure which use Wood Wool Cement Board as permanent shuttering template can't be directly observed. In this article, practical techniques about identifying quality defects in the concrete using permanent shuttering template is given on the basis of experiments.

articleTitle: Simulation and test study on rotary dryers
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The research was done in the rotary dryer. It included variations of hot air temperature of entrance to the rotary dryer, moisture content of materials, rotational speed and inclination. The experiment indicates that rotational speed directly interferes with retention period of materials in the rotary dryer. Hot air temperature and moisture content of materials also interfere with drying rate of materials.

articleTitle: Local analysis of the anchorage zone between the suspenders and the deck of large span basket handle through tied arch bridge
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The anchorage zone between the suspender and the deck for a large span basket handle through tied arch railway bridge were studied using finite element method, The results show that the steel components bear higher stress as they are closer to the steel filling block under the dead load and the most unfavorable live load. And the stress concentration phenomenon is also more obvious. Both the bottom plate and the buried steel pipe have stress concentrations on the joint lines with the steel filling block respectively. The stress of the steel filling block near its thinner side is larger than that near its thicker side. It's necessary to increase the thickness of the steel filling block to improve its stress condition. The result of this paper can be for the same type of bridge design reference.

articleTitle: Evolution of dehydrogenase activity of activated sludge in biological contact oxidation process for treating photographic waste water
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Evolution of dehydrogenase activity was studied in the activated sludge of biological contact oxidation process for treating photographic waste water, different influence factors were considered such as temperature, content of pollutant, removal rate of pollutant, etc. the result indicated that dehydrogenase could represent the activity of activated sludge quickly and exactly, and it could be one of the important indication and control indicators which were used in the waste water treatment monitoring.

articleTitle: Waterplant remote control system of combining Data Transceivers and GPRS
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: For the system supplying water of city and town water works, it adopts a mode of combining CPM2AH PLC of OMRON company with the distributed I/O module of 4000 series of ADVANTECH company and takes two kinds wireless communication ways of Data Transceiver and GPRS as data transmission approach. The software of upper computer and hardware circuit of wireless remote control system of water works were emphatically designed. The scheme of negative pressure wave- rate of flow follows diagnosing feed pipe net leakage had been studied. The system has realized the well group water pump controlling and the pipe net relevance parameter acquisition and transmission such as rate of flow and pressure. Those have provided a guarantee to safe and stable operation of the supplying water system.

articleTitle: Comparative research on the vibration response between scale-model test and numerical analysis for highway bridge-vehicle coupled
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The objective of this paper is to compare the dynamic response of bridge-vehicle coupled vibration between scale-model test and numerical analysis. In order to study the vibration response of a simple supported bridge subjected to a moving vehicle, three methods are introduced. Firstly, the equations of motion for bridge and vehicle are established respectively, an iteration solution method is presented to analyse the coupled vibration response of vehicle-bridge system based on the same displacement and coupling force at the interface. Nextly, the visualization approach to simulate the dynamic response of vehicle-bridge coupled vibration is put forward, through building 3-D FE models of vehicle and bridge using LS-DYNA. Lastly, based on the similitude law of bridge-vehicle interaction system, the simple girder bridge model test that the scale factor of geometry is 10.0 , the static and dynamic response of model bridge are studied subjected to a moving vehicle . Comparative results between the testing of model bridge and numerical analysis of practical bridge conforms the feasibility of model text equipment and the validity of the text results. At the same time, the results also show efficiency and stabilization of the numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Research on the method of testability modeling based on Bayesian Networks
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Due to the complexity of the fault mechanism and the testing method, the research on the Design for Testability (DFT) for mechanical system becomes difficult. In this paper, according to characteristics of mechanical system, it puts forward using the combination of the Bayesian Networks (BN) and the dependency matrix for testability modeling. The method gives full play to BN's probabilistic reasoning ability, improves the traditional testability modeling method and solves the problems that the traditional testability modeling method just basing on qualitative analysis and considering the condition of insufficiency. It is helpful to develop the testability analysis quickly and accurately and optimize test strategy for the mechanical system.

articleTitle: Analyze relationship of rainfall-runoff through the distributed hydrological modeling
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The relationship of rainfall-runoff is one of the most important processes as it controls model precision. MIKESHE, which represents state-of-art of distributed hydrological model, is applied to the Skjern catchment. Hydro-daisy developed by KVL (Royal Veterinary and Agricultural University), relating easily measurable soil properties to soil hydraulic parameters based on European soil database. The results show that Over the study period, the rainfall pattern contrasted between spring with a low amount (173.59 mm) and the other seasons with rainfall totals around 330.99 mm. autumn and winter were the seasons with most runoff.

articleTitle: Simulation analysis of new safety impact regulation on cab of commercial vehicle
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Safety for the occupants of the cab is a prime consideration for structure design on commercial vehicle. The cab shall be designed and attached to the vehicle in such way that in the event of collision exhibit a survival space for the occupants, meanwhile,the cab must remain attached to the chassis frame. The new more legal and strict safety test requirements are specified by proposal for ECE R29-03[1] of amendments to ECE R29-02[2]. A computational simulation method for Front impact test, A-pillar impact test, Roof strength test of ECE R29-03 was introduced. The non linear explicit finite element program LS-DYNA was used for that purpose. In this paper, the application of this numerical method by the example of a real heavy truck of FAW having been passed according to ECE R29-02 is presented and compared with new requirements of ECE R29-03. Finally, the paper gives some feasible improvement measures for cabin structure design in order to pass the approval test of ECE R29-03

articleTitle: A model of maneuverability for a steam-powered vessel
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Assignments of the vessels change suddenly sometimes, so the vessels need several of operation plans on the marine steam power plant. Based on the thermodynamic calculation theory, maneuverability analysis model of steam-powered vessel is given with the maximum speed index for different operation plans of steam power plant. The result indicates that the maneuverability model is practical and efficient. And there is significance of using for reference for the settlement of maneuverability analysis of other types of power plants.

articleTitle: Study on the creep characteristic and model of overgrown joint rock
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A step incremental-circular loading and unloading method was used, and a set of creep experiment was done to study the creep characteristic of weak and intricate rock with overgrown joint. The testing data were managed according to the retrievable instantaneous elastic strain and lagged viscoelastic strain, and the in-retrievable instantaneous plastic strain and viscoplastic strain. And the essential rules of visco-elasto-plastic characteristic of the weak and intricate rock are obtained. Based on scientific analysis and compared study, Burgers creep model was united with Mohr-Coulomb criterion and a modified Burgers-creep model was formed. The new model is characterized by a visco-elasto-plastic deviatoric behavior and elastoplastic volumetric behavior. The viscoelastic and viscoplastic strain-rate components are assumed to act in series. And some programs about the modified Burgers model were developed to deal with the testing data. The creep characteristic curves were obtained, and the model parameters were fitted and the values were gotten through weighted mean. The testing results show that the creep testing curves are coincident well with the theoretic curves, which validates the modified Burgers-creep model is felicitous to characterize the creep of the kind of rock.

articleTitle: Adsorption characteristics of phenanthrene — A typical petroleum hydrocarbon on the aquifer media
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper researched on the adsorption kinetics and thermodynamics of the typical component of petroleum hydrocarbons -phenanthrene on the four typical media: silty sand, medium sand, coarse sand, and gravel sand from the aquifer in an oilfield, with a self-made rotary adsorption device. The result showed that the adsorption kinetics of phenanthrene on the four aquifer media accords with the pseudo-second-order kinetics model, and the adsorption thermodynamic process meets the Henry adsorption model. The order of the adsorption rate and capacity of phenanthrene on the four aquifer media is silt sand>; medium sand>; coarse sand>; gravel sand. When the benzene and naphthalene co exist in the solution, the adsorption capacity of phenanthrene reduces, while the adsorption rate increases.

articleTitle: A study on interaction of high pressure gas jet and liquid medium
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to control the combustion stability of bulk-loaded liquid propellant gun, the expansion process of gas jet entering liquid was studied by high speed photographic system aiming at the stepped chamber and rectangular chamber. Based on the experiments, two-dimensional model of gas jet expansion process was developed. The unsteady interaction process of gas jet and liquid was simulated by the commercial software FLUENT. The influence of chamber structure on jet expansion was discussed. The calculated results approximately accord with the experimental results.

articleTitle: Application of numerical simulation technology in withdrawal process in Suancigou Coal Mine
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Withdrawing technology at fully mechanized working face is an important part of production and preparation, the speed of withdrawal affects the realization of high yield and efficiency of mine. In the process of fully mechanized working face being close to withdrawal roadway, advanced abutment pressure seriously affects the withdrawal roadway and double crossheading, vertical stress of the withdrawal roadway and double crossheading increase, and roadway deformation is aggravated. Roof caving accidents are easily happen so that they directly affect the speed of withdrawing and the normal continuation at the working face. Through FLAC numerical simulation about withdrawal process at No.6105-1 Panel in Suancigou Coal Mine, date of roadway roof and two sides roadway stress and deformation can be achieved, provide theoretical basis and guidance for the on-site construction, ensure that withdrawing work safely and smoothly be done.

articleTitle: Study on the explosive fracturing technology for low permeability reservoir
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Analyzed the inadequacy of existing fracturing technology and combined with modern oil drilling technology, it discusses the rock breaking mechanism, range of application and technical features of this technology in this paper based on rock blasting theory. Then, it makes a careful analysis of stress about the surrounding rock when exploded, based on what it derived the dimension calculating formula of the crush zone and fracture zone. At last, depending on the explosive fracturing simulation tests which had been carried out with small amount of explosives, it verifies the accuracy of the dimension calculating formula. Studies show that the crushing effect is not obviously which explodes with a small amount of explosives, but it can get some clear macro-cracks; dimensions that calculated by formula which derived by this paper is basically consistent with the experimental measurements and has a reference value.

articleTitle: Study the impact of 9310 working face mining on −670 water sump
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to research on the impact of water sump under seam floor. by mining 93<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">upper</inf>10 working face in Nantun Coal Mine, numerical simulation and theory study are carried out in this paper. In the theoretical study, from the failure pattern of coal floor, criterion is put forward, that is whether the water sump is affected or not is existed in the overlap with floor failure, based on “down three zone”, and empirical and theoretical formula showed that −670 was out of floor failure district, within little influence; Starting from the propagation rules of mine pressure of floor, bearing stress in increased-stress zone were dividedly into point load and triangular, the mine pressure of water sump is calculated based on Boussinesq formula, and the result showed that mine pressure of water sump was much less than 5 percent of original rock stress. In the numerical simulation study, the result showed that the experimental value is in consistent with theory; maximum subsidence value of the water sump roof was about 4mm, maximum horizontal displacement is close to the face was about 14mm, and roadway displacement is smaller. All above could make conclusion that mining 93<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">upper</inf>10 working face has little effect on −670 water sump under seam floor.

articleTitle: Research on yaw moment control for light vehicle electromechanical brake system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This document research on vehicle stability control methods using yaw rate and the mass center sideslip angle aim at electromechanical brake system . Following the linear 2 DoF vehicle handling performance model as control target, a control system model was built based on the dynamic relationship between the vehicle yaw moment and the vehicle state deviations. An chassis control approach about yaw moment decision and divide methods was proposed. The simulation results showed that the controller could improve the vehicle handling and stability performance effectively.

articleTitle: Research on lubricating boundary conditions of rock bit journal bearing
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Because of the complex work environment, the lubricating boundary conditions of rock bit journal bearing are special. It cannot be simply dealt with the boundary conditions as ordinary bearings. Otherwise, the results of the lubrication analysis will be affected. Through the analysis of work environment of rock bit journal bearing and the comparison of difference of ordinary bearings, proposed the lubricating boundary condition of rock bit journal bearing with the environmental stress and sealing pressure differential for consideration, and combined with the user interface and function of MATLAB PDE Toolbox for numerical analysis. The study showed that the rock bit journal bearing has a stronger load capacity under special boundary conditions.

articleTitle: Study of traffic flow detection method based on Nearness Degree Data Fusion Technology
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In the traffic information collection, Multi-sensor can be achieved in time and space information complementary. How to extract and process the discrete data effectively, become an important issue on multi-sensor comprehensive information collection. Based on the principle that same traffic conditions lead to similar traffic status, we present a new multi-sensor detection method for traffic flow by applying Nearness Degree Data Fusion Technology. According to the actual traffic measurement background, in the article we also put forward another improved idea that time factor which has major impact on should be considered into the actual engineering application of the traffic flow detection. Firstly, with reference to noise ratio method of multi-sensor data fusion, the traffic sensor measurements collection is treated as a fuzzy set, it measures the mutual integrated nearness degree of sensors at different times by their maximum and minimum close levels. Then the multi-sensor data fusion methods and algorithms for traffic flow detection based on the defined consistent reliability measurement were designed. At last, an application example experimental was performed by Matlab programming and it proved that the proposed method is simple and effective. The method has good accuracy and stability.

articleTitle: Simulation and realization of Steer-by-Wire system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this thesis, a kind of Steer-by-wire system based on feedback control and stepper motor has been introduced, simulated and built. Simulation of this system proved that feedback control and stepper motor are available in the Steer-by-wire system. Experiments of this system demonstrated this kind of Steer-by-wire system could fit all demands of steering and it can be used in steering system.

articleTitle: Research on selection of prior distribution of Bayesian theory in hydrological uncertainty analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Bayesian theory plays an important role in hydrology uncertainty analysis. In the theory, how to choice the prior distribution correctly is a critical issue. At present, there is no good idea in prior distribution estimation; the only way is to accordance with the principle of non-uniform distribution of the information instead. In this paper, the sensitive parameters of Xin'anjiang model are used to analysis the influence of the prior to posterior distribution, under the reasonable range of parameters in taking several common distributions. The study can provide new reasonably ideas in prior distribution estimation for the future and can improve the Bayesian approach applicability.

articleTitle: Research on feed servo system of CNC Machine based on ControlLogix system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces the hardware design, software design, communication and configuration of feed servo system of CNC Machine, which uses ControlLogix control platform. Position adaptive PI controller is built to solve that every parameters of traditional PI controller cannot be given attention simultaneously. The proposed method improves the dynamic performance and positioning accuracy of the system.

articleTitle: Flexible method research of combined molding and manufacturing system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Tire forming line converts from single production to combination production gradually, from the traditional serial intermittent working pattern to paralleling continuous working pattern. Combine the relevant equipment needed in the process of the tire forming line, and then the molded parts will pass the working places in accordance with certain crafting routes and rhythm sequentially, which will realize the aim of consecutive and repeated production. The designing method should start with the composition and forming pattern. The main pattern can take the form of mobile locating and carry out the forming operation alternately. The programming should reflect the flexibility and use the idea of structured programming, which can make the structure of the programming showed clearly. The generalization and standardization of some programs can make them easy to modify and simplify their regulations. Intelligent robots can replace human beings' operations in some processes. The new methods can improve production efficiency, lower process loss, and decrease production cost.

articleTitle: Research development of antibiotic pollution and toxicity in soil
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Large numbers of antibiotics were used as food additives and veterinary medicines. Most of these antibiotics could not be absorbed by animals and were discharged through dejeeta in the original shape or metabolized forms. At last these antibiotics entered into soil environments in different routes and accumulated in soil. Antibiotics have become the emerging contaminants of soil. To evaluate the potential impacts of antibiotics released into soil environments, this paper reviewed the pollution levels, fate and ecological toxicity of antibiotics in soils to provide basis for preventation and remediation of antibiotics polluted soils.

articleTitle: On the seismic behavior of multi-story frame structure excited by near-fault ground motions
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The seismic response process of a 12-story reinforced concrete frame structure under near-field pulse-like and non-velocity pulse ground motion has been investigated by comparison in the paper. It is analyzed on the influence of near-field pulse-like ground motion to the seismic response of the frame structure from elastic into elastic-plastic stage. The results show that the elastic seismic response of the structure is no significant difference under near-field pulse-like and non-velocity pulse ground motion. However, the structure response under near-field pulse-like is larger than under non-velocity pulse in elastic-plastic stage, particularly the top story displacement, the storey drift and the basic shear who will obviously increase. The response spectrum in current code cannot sufficiently represent the effects of elastic-plastic seismic response to the structure under near-field pulse-like ground motion. The near-field pulse-like ground motion contains generous low frequency components and the spectrum values attenuate slowly along with the period. Hence, the spectrum values are greater and it has distinct influence on long period structures than short period structures.

articleTitle: Hardware design of a full-digital AC-servo driver based on TMS320F2812
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: On account of low real-time, more application parts, complicated computation and difficult to complete AC motor servo control for a general CPU in existing technology, a permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) is used for a actuator, and the component, hardware design and the main control circuit design of a full-digital AC-servo driver by TMS320F2812 as a signal processor are introduced in this paper. The full-digital AC-servo driver is adopted the modular design, and is provided with the compact structure, simple and reasonable design and flexible control characteristics. It can increase control precision and anti-interference ability, finally achieve the development of high effective system.

articleTitle: Research on agricultural product international competitiveness of Northeast China
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: On the base of analyzing the export trade status of the three northeast provinces, and adopting international market share index, trade competitiveness index and revealed comparative advantage index, this paper measures and analyzes agricultural product international competitiveness of the three northeast provinces from 2002 to 2008 from the different aspects of market shares, export scale, net-export. On the basis of this, this paper proposes some countermeasures of enhancing the international competitiveness of the three northeast provinces.

articleTitle: Optimum design for beam-pumping unit based on chaos particle swarm optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Chaos searching has been introduced to particle swarm optimization (PSO). Thereby a hybrid particle swarm optimization algorithm for the design of the conventional pumping unit is put forward, which takes the minimum peak torque factor on the up stroke as the objective function. The improved PSO algorithm has both advantage of simplify for implement of original particle swarm optimization and advantage of fast convergence, easy to escape local minima for chaos optimization algorithm. The results of optimization show the proposed approach has not only better global search capability but fast convergence and high computation precision. With the improved algorithm, better design parameters for beam-pumping unit were obtained compare with parameters from particle swarm optimization or compound form method.

articleTitle: The design of a kind of multivariable nonlinear real-time simulation platform
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a multivariable nonlinear real-time simulation platform is designed based on the actual application background. This platform includes six inputs, six outputs and a special interference source, furthermore, the MATLAB interface is also designed. Based on this platform, experimenters can study and do more research about multivariable control algorithm and anti-interference control algorithm.

articleTitle: Impact on thrust force in construction parameters of slotless permanent magnet linear synchronous motor
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Divided layers model and physical model of slotless permanent magnet linear synchronous motor (PMLSM) are built. Magnetic vector potential is regarded as variables to gain solution of excitation magnetic field and armature response magnetic field. Through two-dimensional analytical method, different construction parameters are analyzed to affect thrust force. The finite element method (FEM) is confirmed agreement with analytical method, indicating the validity of analytical method and the reasonable of method.

articleTitle: Experimental of vertical casing soil-air heat exchanger
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the working principles of the soil-air heat exchanger were presented, and a related experimental study was conducted. The results demonstrated that the experimental system had good performance in terms of continuity and stability. The temperature and humidity of fresh air became lower after long-term steadily running of this system. To sum up, in humid and hot area, cooling and dehumidification of fresh air by using earth energy was an effective measurement to improve indoor air quality and to save energy in summer.

Author Keywords: hot summer and cold winter area

articleTitle: The design of pressuring and conveying snow removal machine on multi-span greenhouse roof
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Snow on the greenhouse roof has a great effect on light transparence and heat loss. It brings bad effect on plant growing also affect greenhouse structure strength. In order to reduce the impact of snow on the greenhouse industry, comprehensively consider greenhouse roof status, such as snow thickness, temperature conditions and so on, we design the pressuring and conveying snow removal machine. It is a subservient, efficient, inexpensive and environmental program for snow removal on greenhouse roof in future.

articleTitle: Design of assembly system for an automobile idle valve
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The automobile idle valve is essential fittings of automobile. So far, the assembly of the automobile idle valve is carried out by manual labor, but its efficacy is low, labor intensity is huge, cost is high. In order to change this backward way of assembling the automobile idle valve by manual labor and to meet the need of automobile quantity developing rapidly in our country, because the cost of manual labor becomes higher and higher. Hope by using the system in practice, the assembly efficiency of car idle valve is enhanced and production costs reduce. The idea of the design and the principle of the operation are described in this paper as well as the control method. The assembly system is simple, easy to operate, for the car idle valve assembly with high reliability.

articleTitle: Simulation research of wireless communication system of LDPC code based on the adaptive modulation and precoding joint optimization technology
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the wireless communication system reliability and throughput, the adaptive modulation and preceding joint optimization wireless communication system model is designed Simulated experiments of this joint optimization wireless communication system model are done in VC++ environment. The experimental results show that the designed wireless communication system of LDPC code based on the adaptive modulation and precoding joint optimization technology can considerably increase wireless transmission system throughput, and has Lowerber BER than Higher-order modulation preceding wireless communication system.

articleTitle: Design of portable avaition bus adapter based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A kind of portable aviation bus adapter based on FPGA was designed, and the design methods of its hardware and software are introduced. It can be widely used in communication with aerial facilities and ground tests. This adapter can meet the needs of credibility and economy.

articleTitle: Characterizing changes in surface ozone levels at an urban site in Xi'an, China
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The surface ozone levels over Xi'an, China were monitored every 5-min using the Model ML/EC9810 ozone analyzer from March 23, 2008 to January 12, 2009. The daily ozone concentrations ranged from 0.43 ppbv to 64.23 ppbv, averaging a yearly mean value of 16.04 ppbv. Seasonal variation of ozone levels showed a clear summer maximum and winter minimum pattern. The diurnal variation of ground ozone showed a typical unimodal distribution, which peaked between 1500 and 1600 of local standard time (LST), and had the minimum value between 0700 and 0800 LST. Significantly positive correlation was found between ozone concentration and ambient temperature, which indicated that intensity of solar radiation was one of the major factors influencing on the surface ozone production. In contrast, high relative humidity was unfavorable to the photochemical reaction on ozone produce. No weekend effect for the ozone concentration was found in Xi'an, which was mainly because the difference of vehicle number between weekday and weekend was not evident.

articleTitle: The inversion of the coefficient of permeability with genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Accurate coefficient of permeability is of vital importance for the underground water computing. In the paper, the coefficient of permeability is identified based on the observed hydraulic heads and drainages. An optimization model is used to identify the coefficient of permeability, which is solved with genetic algorithm. The performances of the proposed identification measure with improved genetic algorithm is testified by actual engineering applications and the results show that the parameter identification algorithm proposed in the paper is robust and globally convergent.

articleTitle: The development planning of Railway Port Economic Zone in Loudi
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Port planning directly impacts on the development of urban economy and regional economy. In order to fully fulfill the function of port, the author puts forward two new planning concepts: Railway-Port-Economic-Zone (RPEZ) & Special-Economic-Operation-Body (SEOB) to replace the traditional ideas. According to the above ideas, the author discusses the calculation method of land-using areas of Loudi RPEZ, and find out that Loudi RPEZ needs 277.7hm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of land. Meanwhile, the author also expounds the planning structure, the function distribution and the important construction contents of Loudi RPEZ. The results show that the planning can meet the demand of rapid development of Loudi RPEZ in the next 20 years, and it can strongly promote the economic development of Central Hunan, especially of Loudi Economic Development Zone.

articleTitle: Study on the accurate model of battery about rapid charger
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: At present, battery charging faces the problems such as charging difficulties and inefficient. An unified model of battery and charging circuit is established by anglicizing the battery model. Given an in-depth analysis by Mars Theorem, the precise relationship between the pulse current size and battery energy is launched. The method of fast battery charging is put forward based on precise models.

articleTitle: Helical-via-type mushroom EBG structure for size reduction
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A novel electromagnetic band gap (EBG) scheme is presented for size reduction. The proposed structure can be considered as a modification of typical mushroom structure with the shorted vertical pin replaced by a helical via. Transmission characteristics of the proposed topology are obtained by using suspending microstrip method. The helical-via-type mushroom structure provides additional degrees of freedom to control the band gap characteristics and owns feature of size reduction. Simulation and experimental results are used to verify the prediction.

articleTitle: Combination prediction model and dynamic analysis of arable land pressure in Shandong
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the model of arable land pressure, this paper calculated the series of cultivated land pressure in Shandong province from 1990 to 2005. The trend of arable land pressure was analyzed by using exponential regression model, polynomial regression model and GM(1,1) model. The combination forecasting model of cultivated land pressure in Shandong was established by means of Particle Swarm Optimization(PSO). The results show that: (1)it is feasible to apply the PSO to solve weight of combination forecasting model. (2) the arable land area is decreasing and the land area per capita decreased from 1990 to 2008, so cultivated land pressure is increasing. The pressure index will be up to 1.8438, 1.9081, 1.9745, 2.0433, 2.1145 and 2.1881 from 2010 to 2015 year, so it is difficulty to keep the arable land resource security. Some measures were proposed for easing arable land pressure.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The practice and application of temperature control technology of massive concrete in large-scale cushion cap
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Simulation on equivalent BSFC control strategy for hybrid electric bus
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A new control strategy for the HEV bus based on the equivalent brake specific fuel consumption(BSFC)has been proposed in this paper. It concerns the derivation of calculation methods for the BSFC of and the general formula for the objective function of the BSFC of the battery package under different operation mode. The performance of the BSFC control strategy is tested using the simulation model of the HEV bus based on the real operation data and driving cycle. The simulation results have shown that the new control algorithm can increase 12.1% fuel economy for the HEV bus compared to the conventional power following strategy.

articleTitle: Anti-tilting technology of online measurement for large-size optical lens
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Online measurement is used widely in the measurement of large-size optical lens due to its advantage that it will not introduce the positioning error. But online measurement still introduces some other errors, especially the tilting error, and the influence of the tilting of the workpiece is serious. In order to solve this problem, an anti-tilting technology will be presented in this paper. Because of the small value of tilting, it can't be adjusted by manual operation. To solve this problem, a method that deal with measurement data by surface fitting and rotation transformation have been applied. Experiments were carried out to verify the feasibility and the validity of this technique.

articleTitle: Study on the strength of sea sand concrete introduced by chloride ions
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In sea sand by the determination of free chlorine ions to study the chloride ion to the strength of sand concrete. Experimental data show that between 0% to 0.1% chloride ion content of sea sand concrete strength comparison between the value of a group that is found in 20% of fly ash were mixed with 3 days flexural strength is increased with the concentration of chloride ion Rise, the other group had no obvious rule, dilute the sand and did not play down the comparison that does not dilute the sand sea sand either 3 days or 28 days strength values are higher than the desalination of sea sand, the presence of chloride ions in sea sand Early strength has a positive role in promoting.

articleTitle: The reliability-analysis of kinematics position accuracy of a kind of 3 - TPT parallel lathe
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The parallel lathe is a kind of new structure lathe, and the kinematics analysis is the foundation of the theoretical research on the lathe. The purpose of reliability analysis of kinematics position accuracy is to make the structural design meet the requirement of reliability. This paper establishes the kinematics equation of a kind of 3-tpt parallel lathe and gives the answers, analyze the reliability of the kinematics position accuracy, get the result of the reliability-analysis. The result indicates the structure of this lathe meets the requirement for reliability.

articleTitle: The design of Reference Sinusoidal Signal Generator Circuit for Photovoltaic Grid Based on CPLD
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The Frequency and Phase that equal to Grid voltage of Reference Sinusoidal Signal is important to the network equipment and Current waveform quality. The Design of Reference Sinusoidal Signal Generator Circuit for Photovoltaic Grid Based on CPLD with Frequency tracking and Phase tracking is given in the paper. The circuit includes Sampling circuit, Signal conversion circuit, Frequency tracking and Phase tracking circuit, D/A Conversion circuit. The Waveform accuracy is discussed and the Experimental results are given in the paper. The CPLD used in the system reduces the size of the digital circuit, reduces the equipment size, and makes Debugging easy. The results show that the circuit can generate Reference Sinusoidal Signal that equal to Grid Voltage with frequency and phase, and the signal has small total harmonic distortion. The circuit is Simple and practical, and has Low prices.

articleTitle: The research on dehydrating of heavy oil by ultrasonic
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Routine dehydration can't be satisfied the practical demand because of the heavier, the higher salinity and the more seriously demulsification of oil. The factors affecting the desalting and dewatering during the ultrasonic pretreatment of crude oil were investigated, including electric field strength, ultrasonic frequency, field temperature, the settlement time, pulse time and working mode, etc. The contrasting results show that sound intensity, radiation time and frequency are the main factors, and the secondary factors are test temperature, working mode and settlement time. Some reasonable operation parameters for ultrasonic demulsification of heavy oil dehydration are determined. The process and technical parameters for the application of heavy oil dehydration by ultrasonic demulsification are provided.

articleTitle: The experimental research and numerical simulation on flow across bluff body in vertical upward gas-liquid two-phase flow with low liquid volume fraction
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, both numerical simulation and experimental research are used to research the vortex street producing and shedding characteristic under different low liquid volume fractions, through comparing the results of these two methods, the error is within 4.64%. When the liquid volume fraction is at 1%, it is obvious that no vortex street shedding exists. Then through the numerical simulation experiment, we reach a conclusion that the existence of droplets will affect the stability of vortex street, and with the increase of liquid volume fraction, the destructive effect is becoming obvious, which also leading to the producing of measurement error.

articleTitle: pH process modeling using neural network
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The method of modeling a kind of highly nonlinear process using neural network is presented, in which a CSTR (Continuous Stired Tank Reactor) system involved a strong acid-strong base react is studied as a typical case of highly nonlinear process, and convergence problem is discussed preliminarily during neural network modeling. It has been pointed out that the three layered BP neural network has a good ability to model the highly nonlinear process of pH.

articleTitle: Numerical simulation of fluid-solid coupling properties for underwater buoy by taking into account virtual mass
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The buoy of underwater mooring was selected as study object, we put forward the virtual mass concept based on analysis of fluid-solid coupling eigenvalue for buoy, the underwater virtual mass matrix for buoy was deduced by the finite computing method of structure vibration modal on flow field and the basic equation of hydrodynamics; the natural properties analysis was carried out considered the action of water by Msc Nastran software and compared the result in air and underwater, the result can be got that the eigenvalue was decreased for the action of water; and a new method was provided for the similar structures design.

articleTitle: Experimental research on positive section' flexural performance of inorganic polymer reinforced concrete beam
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By using fly ash and slag and alkaline stimulate agent,we prepare inorganic polymer reinforced concrete beam, Research on its stress and deformation characteristics under load, To explore the inorganic polymer replace the feasibility of ordinary cement in ordinary civil building providing test data. Test results show that, under load, Inorganic polymer reinforced concrete beam failure process and normal cement concrete is similar, has obvious 4 load-bearing characteristics: elasticity, craze, yield and limit. Inorganic polymer concrete flexural members section conform to plane section assumption. Calculation of inorganic polymer reinforced concrete beam ductility coefficients were 2.55,1.68 and 2.01; Ordinary concrete short-term stiffness computation formula in 《concrete structure design code》 is suitable for inorganic polymer concrete component; Bearing capacity calculation method in 《concrete structure design code》 and 《lightweight aggregate concrete structure design code》 basically apply to inorganic polymer reinforced concrete.

articleTitle: Wleding head control analysis based on the root locus method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The relative stability and the transient performance of a closed-loop control system are directly related to the location of the roots of the characteristic equation in the s-plane. The locus of roots in the s-plane can be determined by a graphical method. The root locus technique is studied in this paper, it is a powerful tool for designing and analyzing feedback control systems. It is possible to use root locus methods for design control system when two or three parameters vary.

articleTitle: Analysis on the coordinated development relationship between the oil and gas industry and the regional economy of Heilongjiang Province
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
