abstract: The coordinated development relationship between the oil and gas industry and the regional economy is one of the important contents of Heilongjiang Province sustainable development. The paper constructs an index system, using the principal component analysis method, to respectively evaluate the development status of the oil and gas industry and the regional economy, by SPSS12.0 and EXCEL. On this basis, the paper constructs a model, to quantitatively evaluate the coordinated development relationship.

articleTitle: Stress analysis and optimal design of titanium sponge crusher rotating blade
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper presents an analysis of titanium sponge crusher rotating blade based on finite element analysis software ANSYS. The stress and displacement distribution of titanium sponge crusher rotating blade under load were studied and the maximum stress value and the location of the maximum stress concentration were determined. The rotating blade was analyzed by altering the blade fillet radius. Subsequently, an optimal design was conducted based on the blade that can withstand the value of the load and the optimal structure of titanium sponge crusher rotating blade was obtained.

articleTitle: Structure optimization of rear door based on side impact of a specific vehicle
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The side impact is one of the most important crash types. The rear door of a specific vehicle is open during side impact. An optimization solution is presented by analyzing the opening reason on the basis of design principle of door lock and door dynamic deformation during side impact. The simulation and vehicle's verification indicate that the optimized door deformation is reasonable and also the door is not open any longer during side crash.

articleTitle: Comprehensive evaluation on water environmental carrying capacity of Qiantang River watershed based on index system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Water environmental carrying capacity was related to economy,society,resource, environment, technology and management. Three indicators and fifteen variables were selected as the evaluation index, the three indicators including sustainable capacity of resource, assimilative capacity of environment and optimal allocation capacity of social economy. A comprehensive evaluation model of water environmental carrying capacity of Qiantang River watershed was developed. On the basis of the model, the current situation of water environmental carrying capacity was evaluated and different scenarios of recent or medium period were analyzed. The result of current situation evaluation showed that the water environmental carrying capacity of three regions decreased in the following order: Hangzhou>; Jinhua>;Quzhou, except 2001. In 2001, the order was Hangzhou >; Quzhou >; Jinhua. The different scenarios analysis indicated that all of the four kinds measure, such as maintain current situation, save water, increase investment of environmental protection, reduce amount of COD per unit discharge, could improve the water environmental carrying capacity of Qiantang River watershed in 2012 and 2015 respectively to different extents.

articleTitle: Scientific analysis on the comparison of several physics textbooks
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Science education should not focus limitedly on the knowledge itself; instead, it should involve method, attitude and a certain spirit. In the process of physics teaching, it is argued that the conscious training of scientific methods is an essential approach to improve students' intelligence, cultivate scientific quality and establish a scientific world view for a comprehensive development. From the angle of physical studying method, the present paper focuses on the analysis among six materials of physics textbooks for Grade Eight, concluding some reference for physics education from the comparison of scientific methods such as observation, experiment, comparison, induction, etc.

articleTitle: Experimental study on application of saline water irrigation in north-west China
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Due to the shortage of fresh water in north-west China, exploitations of saline water become very important for mitigating water shortage for farmland irrigation. In order to research the effect of water and salt transport rule and crop yield under saline water irrigation, the plot experiments under different salinity saline water irrigation and local farmers' irrigation habit in north-west China was conducted. The results showed that soil salinity will accumulate after irrigated by higher than 5g/L of saline water, and keep balance or leach state after irrigated by lower than 3g/L of saline water. There is positive relationship between the salinity of irrigation water and the inhibition rate of corn growth. The rate of corn growth inhibition had significant positive correlation with irrigation water salinity, the threshold of irrigation water salinity for safety growth of corn was 2.9g/L, and the threshold for suitable planting was 6.1g/L.

articleTitle: Simulation and test study on particulate materials flow in rotary dryers
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: On the basis of the mathematical model, the equations have been derived. They are simulated by VB program language. The residence time and the position of a particle at any moment can be defined according to rotational speed of the rotary dryer, radius of the drum, the slope of the drum, wind-force and the particle quality. Simulated results are satisfactory.

articleTitle: Application of the prestressed anchor and shotcrete technology in abutment strengthening works of highway bridge
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Many abutments at two ends of highway bridge are U-type abutment which is a kind of retaining walls malls made of mortar rubble masonry. Because of construction causes and the surface-water soaking of backfill in the U-type abutment, the side walls and front walls of abutment product displacement, which endangers the safety of vehicles on the highway. Through some abutment strengthening works of highway bridge, this thesis provides the design and construction method of abutment strengthening works with the through-prestressed anchor and shotcrete reinforcement fabric technology. It's shown by the practical project that using the through-prestressed anchor and shotcrete panel with reinforcement fabric to strengthen the abutment has many advantages, such as specific load-carrying capability, cheap construction cost, simplified construction, no interruption for vehicle and short duration of construction period. So there is important value to popularize this technology in abutment strengthening works of highway or railroad bridge.

articleTitle: Study on the high-temperature gas field containing H2S sewage corrosive behavior
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The sewage from high-temperature gas field containing H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S has following features: high H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S content, high temperatures and high salinity. Coupon test, microscopic observation of corrosion images and other methods have been used in the research of the corrosion behavior of high-temperature H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S-contained sewage to N80 steel. The sewage corrosion behavior to N80 steel starts from the adsorption of sulfur particles, the corrosion products are a variety of iron sulfide and other compounds of trivalent iron, and the iron sulfide formation of passive film shows the trend of densification at high temperature. As the pH value of the sewage decreases, the corrosive enhances, the smoothness and oxide on the surface of N80 steel can affect the corrosion. The increasing oxygen content leads to the higher corrosion effect. In the sewage, the high concentration of CT ions accelerates the N80 steel corrosion caused by S<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sup> and HS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup>. And the HS<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> concentration in the sewage is the main factor that influences on the corrosion performance to N80 steel.

articleTitle: PTFE composite membrane preparation and performance testing on alloy anode oxidation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To improve the abrasive resistance and corrosion resistance of the aluminum alloy, the means of anodic oxidation was used. One kind of abrasive material-PTFE (Polytetrafluoroethylene) was added into the electrolyte of anodic oxidation to deposit in the aluminum alloy film. The orthogonal test were designed to optimize the technological parameters of the composite anode oxidizes and to obtain the composite oxide film in which PTFE was added. The best process scheme of the alloy anode oxidation was determined to improve the abrasive and corrosion resistance of the composite membrane. The best technology scheme is as follows: the temperature is 10°C, the percent of PTFE is 15%, the current density is 2A/dm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> and the general oxidation time is 40 minutes.

articleTitle: The application of Chaotic masking and chaotic switching in communication
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: -Chaotic masking and chaotic switching are two basic forms of chaos synchronization, they are important in secure communication applications. Chaos masking resemble a traditional sense of modulation, Chaotic masking transmitted out analog signal directly simple to realize, with high security. Chaotic switching is used digital signal modulation, compared with chaos masking signal fidelity of higher.

articleTitle: Analysis of mechanism of semi-circular transverse cracks in light double column bridge piers
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The reasons of semi-circular transverse cracks of the bridge piers are analyzed in the paper. A lot of semi-circular transverse cracks occurred in the top of 1# and 2# bridge piers before the open to traffic. In the loading process of the load test, the cracks show the trend of expansion. The formation causes of these cracks are analyzed from aspects of the material, environment temperature, construction methods and imposed load and the finite element software ANSYS is further used to conduct the local stress analysis of the 1# and 2# bridge piers. It is found that the main reason leading to the transverse cracks on the top of 1# and 2# bridge piers caused by the active earth pressure on the two bridge piers generated by the asymmetry landfill. Recommendation: If the bridge piers in an inclined plane, the bulldozers should be avoided piled up around the piers, if unavoidable, should ensure that the bulldozers on both sides of the piers generated balance active earth pressure in order to avoid similar incidents.

articleTitle: Time sequence control of electromagnetic pulse simulator based
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Electromagnetic Pulse Simulator (EMP) is a experimental equipment for testing interference ability of electronic device. In this paper, Digital Signal Processor (DSP) has been used to control time sequence of Electromagnetic Pulse Simulator, the equipment can generate five continuous pulses within work space of EMP, the parameters of time interval, pulse amplitude can be adjusted for various application purpose. By the way of reasonable design, such as the switch ,the input button, the visual state of LED and so on. The design of time sequence control for spring setting realizes the continuity of electromagnetic radiation. All these advancements will be a good complementary to the traditional EMP which works by manual control.

articleTitle: Analyse the angular velocity estimation errors of α-β-γ filter based on high sampling rate
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to get angular velocity of stabilization servo mechanism from angular position sensors, α-β-γ filter based on high sampling rate was established, model and error characteristics were analyzed. With the hypothesis of constant acceleration, α-β-γ filter and its angular velocity transfer function were deduced. Combing with optimum parameters, the effects of α and sample rate on the error characteristics were evaluated. According to the requirements of stabilization servo mechanism, the frequency characteristics of angular velocity transfer function are analyzed, and the filter parameters are designed. The experimental which filter tracked and smoothed sinusoidal signal, the results show that when the cutoff frequency of angular velocity loop is 44.9rad/s, sampling period and parameters α are 0.08ms and 0.01279 respectively, the phase leading of angular position is 70°. α-β-γ filter tracked sinusoidal signals with maximum angular velocity(30°/s) and maximum angular acceleration(30°/s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>), the error of angular velocity estimation was 0.053°/s. In the engineering of electro-optical stabilization servo mechanism, α-β-γ filter can reduce noise effectively, and reached the requirement of platform angular velocity estimation. Also it is one of the effective methods to get angular velocity from angular position sensors.

articleTitle: A non-linear rheological model for typical soft clay in Tianjin coastal areas
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the non-linear creep property of typical soft clay, which is mucky clay in Tianjin coastal areas, is investigated though indoor triaxial creep tests. The tests are carried out by step loading method, and the creep curves of soft clay in different stress states are acquired from the test data. Combined with the variation laws of the stress-strain isochronal curves, which are created according to the creep curves, the results of creep tests are fitted by Merchant model. The model parameters are confirmed and a non-linear rheological model for the soft clay in Tianjin is established. Based on comparative analysis about variation laws of parameters in the model, it is concluded that the relationship between the main parameters and stress states could be expressed with empirical formulas. It is shown that the elastic modulus of Hooke spring increases in a negative exponent way, and the elastic modulus of Kelvin component decreases in a linear way, with the stress increasing.

articleTitle: Research on method of product configuration based on knowledge and Tabular Layouts of Article Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Long design-cycle is desired to meet the specific requirements of customers for mass customization (MS) product. In order to quickly respond to customer demand, construct the product configuration model and describe the knowledge of configuration design first, and then preliminarily determine the product structure and conduct accurate configuration based on configuration knowledge base; Next make flexible configuration based on Tabular Layouts of Article Characteristics to ensure that the product structure meet customer requirements. After this, implement secondary development of CAD system with Visual Basic language and build a prototype system. Finally an example of configuration design of multifunctional hydraulic hoisting machinery was provided to verify the feasibility of the theory by which the design-cycle is greatly shortened.

articleTitle: Study on parameter vibration of stay cable and resistance measure in consideration of bridge deck vibration
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Stay cable is the main supporting system of cable-stayed bridge. Due to the external excitations, various of harmful vibrations could happen easily. Parameter vibration is the principal form of the harmful vibrations. Through the establishment of motion equation of parameter vibration, the article analyzes the occurrence mechanism of parameter vibration in consideration of coupled vibration of cables and bridge on basis of nonlinear vibration theory. According to the characteristic of parameter vibration, the method of setting dampers, an effective way to reduce vibration, can ensure the safety and the normal operation of bridge.

Author Keywords: coupled vibration of cables and bridge

articleTitle: Research on the characteristics of high-energy laser transmission in atmosphere
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the development of high-energy laser technology, its performance in applications is impacted not only by the beam quality itself, but also by various domino effects occurring during laser transmission in atmosphere, such as atmospheric attenuation and atmospheric turbulence effects which include beam drift, beam spreading, intensity fluctuation and so on. Research on the characteristics of laser transmission in the atmosphere is significant to provide fundamental basis for the application of high-energy laser technology. This paper mainly focuses on some domino effects in the process of high-energy laser technology application. According to the randomness and regionality of the atmosphere, the energy loss law of high-energy laser transmitted in the atmosphere in different distance is simulated and analyzed, which can provide the fundamental basis for high-energy laser designing and manufacturing.

Author Keywords: Characteristics of Laser Transmission in Atmosphere

articleTitle: Development of 2YAC2460 super-heavy vibrating screen
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The problems existing in domestic super-heavy vibrating screens have been deeply analyzed. Research on 2YAC2460 super-heavy vibrating screen through modern designs, the three-dimensional entity design, modeling of elements and assemblies have been done. Besides virtual prototype design and analysis and innovative processing have also been made. After realizing introduction, digestion, absorb and research to the foreign super-heavy vibrating screens, the structure of vibrating screen have got reasonable improvements and manufacturing , it is highly appreciated by users after being installed, debugged and ran.

articleTitle: Analysis of armature's characteristic in the induction coil launcher
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the work mechanism of armature, its material and structure that have great effect on the performance of induction coil launcher is discussed. Then the finite element models of solid armature and winding armature are built. And their electromagnetic field simulation is performed. Both the theoretical analysis and the simulation results have revealed that the eddy current distribution of winding armature excel the solid armature, although the solid armature's structure is simple. And the maximal axial thrust and radial pressure occur on the tail of two kinds of armature, the reinforcement of mechanical strength is necessary. Thus, the armature in possession of simple structure, even distribution of eddy current and high efficiency must be explored for the improvement of the induction coil launcher's performance.

articleTitle: Research on high speed sprag overrunning clutch
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The sprag overrunning clutch is an important functional unit of electro-mechanical transmission system. The defects of the overrunning clutch in traditional cage structure, such as sprag easily to roll over, large wear and poor manufacturing process, etc happened under the condition of high rotate speed. On basis of analyzing the traditional structure of cage, the main parts structure, working principle and characteristics of new-type high-speed cage structure sprag overrunning clutch have been described, and the work performance of the new overrunning clutch has been tested.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: The discussion about ether and the ⋀ term in the Einstein gravitational filed equation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research of mechanical property of pre-twisted rectangular beam
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the extensive application of pre-twisted beam in engineer structure, it is very important to carry out systematic analytical research of pre-twisted beam, put forward a dependable mechanics analysis model and the calculation theories. The paper carries on mechanical property based on small deformation assumption to get the displacement general solution, and verify its accuracy using ANSYS software. The paper indicates that the general displacement method is feasible, and the displacement of pre-twisted cantilever beam is larger than non-twisted beam, and the lateral displacements appearing, because of pre-twisted angle. At the same time, the presented general solution offers an accurate displacement interpolation model.

articleTitle: Optimization of reinforcement design and construction sequence of double-curved arch bridge
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, A comparative study was carried out by finite element numerical simulation on the behavior of the different reinforcing construction sequence of double-curved arch bridge. An optimal construction sequence was obtained by using the influential lines of bending moment and axial force of double-curved arch bridge. The study can be taken for reference by similar design and construction.

articleTitle: Hydraulic support entire strength research under four kinds of typical load working conditions
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Hydraulic support is a key equipment of synthesis mechanization caving coal. Now, lots of countries in the world are increasing investment on hydraulic support design, manufacture and research. This paper took ZT6500/19.5/34 hydraulic support as an example. First, three dimensions solid model of the type simplified hydraulic support was constructed by three dimensions construction model software Solid Works. Then, three dimensions solid model was led in ANSYS software. Finally, the strength test of the type hydraulic support was made under top beam both ends concentration load working condition, top beam torsion II working condition, top beam unbalance load working condition and top beam middle concentration load working condition by ANSYS software. The relevant total displacement distribution rule and equivalent stress distribution rule of the type simplified hydraulic support computation model were found. This research is benefit to the general optimal design and improvement on hydraulic support structure and strength before quantity production. This provides a practical and convenient research way on hydraulic support design and research.

Author Keywords: four kinds of typical load working conditions

articleTitle: Numerical simulation study on mine discharge of Xiyu coal mine in Taiyuan
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Abstract-To guarantee the protection of groundwater resources and the safety of Xiyu coal mine in Taiyuan, numerical simulation method was used to study the mine discharge of No.2 level mining. On the basis of comprehensive analysis of geological and hydrogeological conditions of the study area, conceptual model and mathematical model of karst groundwater movement in Fengfeng formation of middle Ordovician were established, and the Visual MODFLOW software of groundwater simulation was used to solve the numerical model. Using this model, the mine discharge of No.2 level mining was predicted. The results show that the generalization of hydrogeological conditions is right, and the establishment of mathematical model is reasonable. The mine discharge in normal year, wet year and dry year is 3750m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/d, 3802m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/d and 3650m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/d respectively. It can provide scientific basis for the protection of karst groundwater resources and the prevention of mine water of Xiyu coal mine.

articleTitle: Research on dry permanent magnetic separator of fine coal
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: It's popularized that dry permanent magnetic separator for coal separation in order to achieve desulphurization and dust reduction to ease enviromental pollution. However, due to weak magnetic coal minerals, conventional magnetic separator is far from for effective separation of fine coal. This paper proposes a new type of permanent magnetic separator with unique magnetic system structure. Selecting NdFeB magnets and magnetization along the longitudinal symmetry axis to generate high background field, together with the magnetic media of soft cone iron to produce high gradient force. And the new permanent magnetic separator with reasonable magnetic system design is validated through mathematical modeling and analysis. At the polar distance of 0.45mm within the separation space, magnetic field strength can up to 1.3T. The new magnetic separator was used for different power plant for dry coal separation test, When the particle size is below 0.074mm, the desulfurization rate is 52.57%, 48.95%, respectively; and ash removal rate is 41.79%, 43.95%, respectively. The magnetic separator can achieve the dry coal pyrite separation; it also provides technical support for effective solution in coal-burning air pollution.

articleTitle: Orthogonalization in electromagnetic protection
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we use Taylor model to analyse a two-wire transmission line radiated by plane wave. We give a complete solution to the load voltages in response to an electromagnetic interference on two parallel transmission lines, and get the incident direction and polarized direction in which the electromagnetic wave don't cause the interference voltage and current on the load of the two parallel transmission lines.

articleTitle: Prediction of critical cutting conditions of adiabatic shear of Ti6Al4V in high speed cutting
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Considering the influence of compression stress, a critical criterion of adiabatic shear in orthogonal high speed cutting is given by linear perturbation on the compress-shear deformation continuum mechanics basic equations of the primary shear zone. Combining with the relationship of cutting conditions and deformation ones, also the materials constitutive relationship, a prediction model, which expressed by cutting conditions and materials properties is established. The critical cutting conditions of adiabatic shear in high speed cutting of Ti6Al4V are predicted by this model. The comparison of prediction results and that of experiments proves that this method is available.

articleTitle: Experimental study on the effects of ambient pressure conditions on spray characteristics of water mist
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on incomplete statistics, China has about 3,000 historical buildings, and most of them were built in the west plateau areas. Study on fire protection of these historical buildings with water mist has been received a considerable attention currently. The purpose of this paper is to investigate the effects of ambient pressure conditions on characteristics of water mist system, such as flow coefficient, spray cone angle and spray flux density, etc. Since these characteristics can mainly influence water mist fire suppression mechanisms and efficiencies. The experimental results show that when the ambient pressure decreases the spray droplets tend to concentrate at the edge area of the spray cone, i.e., more droplets tend to position outside of the main spray. So the spray intensity increases at the edge area and decreases at the center of the spray cone. In addition, there is no obvious effect of ambient pressure on flow coefficient and spray cone angle of the water mist nozzle.

articleTitle: The design of the barycenter testing platform
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the design of the testing equipment for a small satellite barycenter, this paper introduces the three-point testing principle of the barycenter platform and describes the realization of the system. The hardware of the real measuring system involves a platform with a transmission machine and an electrical testing box and a computer. Industry process control software serves as interface by programmable language visual basic in software. The practical test shows that the system has achieved the design requirement. Finally, some improved elements on the mechanical design are proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Research about intake and exhaust mulffer: A review
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper provides an overview of research on intake and exhaust muffler in the past 3 years. First, a detailed introduction to the basic noise theory of intake and exhaust muffler is given. And then, the status quo of research on inlet and exhaust muffler is in focus in the past 3 years. Finally, a summary on the research status and prospect of research focus in the future is discussed.

articleTitle: Key technologies overview on mobile Internet access and mobility support
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Mobile Internet access becomes a major research focus with the increase of mobile phones. This paper introduced and summarized a variety of wireless technologies supporting mobile Internet access. Firstly, the current progressing wireless access technologies were valued on their strengths and weaknesses. Then the newest mobility support researches and progresses over IP layer, such as MIP, NEMO, SIP and DTN, was introduced. In the end, overlapping coverage network optimization technology, DTN optimized technology for mobile Internet, and quality of service model based utility were proposed as the technology development trends. The integration of above all can achieve good quality of mobile Internet access at little cost.

articleTitle: Climate simulation based on Star model
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces the scheme and usage of statistical regional climate model (Star model). For testing Star model, the authors take the data of Huailai weather station as an example. The results show that Star model is suitable for regional climate simulation.

articleTitle: Design of ecological material of the ring-plate indexing mechanism based on analytic hierarchy process
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to evaluate and select material of the ring-plate indexing mechanism, the analytic hierarchy process(AHP) is adopted to establish appraisal structure model, set up judge matrix and calculate AHP ordering of every part of mechanism. In the end the best option is gained.

articleTitle: Design on 10/350µs Crowbar impulse current system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article combines theoretical calculation and ATP EMTP simulation to design the 10/350μs Crowbar impulse current circuit. Parameters that affect peak value and tail time of the 10/350μs current are obtained. Methods to determine the best main circuit parameters are also concerned. Moreover, the Crowbar pulse ignition circuit which can generate two channels of ignition signals at the same time is introduced here. The two channels of ignition signals have an adjustable time interval between 1 μs to 63 μs and the time error less than 1 μs. According to the above technical design, the 10/350 μs Crowbar impulse current system is produced, with the main capacitance being 24 μF and forming inductance being 16 μH. This system can generate the standard 10/350 μs lightning current waveform with a maximum current value of 100 kA.

articleTitle: The mechanism and parameters ascertainment of ground stabilization in the project of pipe jacking construction traversing pile laterally
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By analysis on the mechanism and behavior of soil deformation induced by pipe jacking construction, the influence law of pile is studied. It is pointed out that when the driving speed is rapid, the stress and deformation of pile caused by pipe jacking extrusion may be greater than that by the ground loss. Based on this, the influence of different parameters of ground stabilization on the stress and deformation of pile is researched, then the principle of how to ascertain the parameters of ground stabilization is proposed. When the parameters of ground stabilization is determined, it will take the stress and deformation of pile not only caused by pipe jacking extrusion but also by ground loss into account, and the grouting range may be ascertained by the force analysis according to hole theory of elasticity mechanics. Finally, this method is applied in engineering practice, and the pile deformation is monitored. Results display that the largest horizontal deformation and vertical deformation of pile are 1.39mm and 1.65mm respectively, which are both less than the limited value, and that is to say the parameters of ground stabilization and grouting range determined by this method are appropriate.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation of flow and drag reduction characteristic of hydrophobic surface
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: For the drag reduction potential application of hydrophobic surface, VOF multiphase model and RNG k - ε turbulent model are adopted to simulate hydrophobic surface flow. The numerical simulation results show that: hydrophobic surface microstructures induce circular low-speed vortex which can produce certain cohesive force and they produce certain pressure force at the same time. But the microstructures have no significant effect on the flow field stability and static pressure distributions of near wall area. At the same velocity, as hydrophobic surface free shear area enlarges, pressure force increases and viscous force decreases gradually and the drag reduction of hydrophobic surface decreases gradually. For the hydrophobic surface with the same free shear area ratio, the drag reduction increases gradually with the increase of the velocity in the velocity range of 2.5 m/s and 10m/s.

articleTitle: Oracle transaction processing method in MES
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this article, the author introduces the definition of oracle transaction, analyzes the isolation and researches the implementation method of oracle transaction in MES.

articleTitle: Periodic solutions for higher order neutral type delay functional differential equation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the author study a kind of higher order neutral functional differential equation with deviating argument By using the coincidence degree, a new result on the existence of periodic solutions is obtained.

articleTitle: Pressure signal wireless transmission system for dense pastes transportation pipeline
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A pressure signal wireless transmission system based on ZigBee wireless transmission technology was designed and applied in dense pastes transportation pipeline. This system consisted of pressure sensors, isolation module for conversion of electric quantity and wireless transceiver modules. Visual C++ software was used to achieve PC's control of wireless transmission. It can realize the circulation acquisition of single or multiple pressure signals, graphical displaying and storage of data. This system is capable of alleviating the problem of complex wiring, cable aging, and greatly facilitating the transmission and acquisition of pipeline pressure signals.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: A pressure sensor based on PVDF films for human
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: City of Harbin Songbei wetland ecosystem functions and protection measures Prospects
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Study on experiment of vertical impact damping system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The vertical impact damping system with multi-degree and multi-parameter has a complicated non-linear essence. To recognize its motion characteristics deeply, the paper experimentalized on cantilever beam damper system. First the mode parameters and inspiriting residences of the experiment device were identified, and after impact force with different frequencies and amplification were imposed on the system, lots of experiment data were gained. By plotting response phase figures of the system and combining experimental phenomena which could be observed, some conclusions about the non-linear of vertical impact damping system were drawn, what would provide references for many engineers.

articleTitle: Study on lubrication and dynamic sealing performance of seals under high pressure and high speed
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The sealing ring, as the rotary sealing devices, are one of the most important components in the wet clutch unit of a heavy load vehicle, whereas the failure of the rings occurred only after a service of about several months. So it is necessary to investigate the wear mechanism and failure cause of sealing rings in order to provide the essential evidence and critical feedback into the design process. According to the environmental and service conditions of seals in the transmission, the characteristics of the fluid film were studied. The pressure and their regular pattern with working conditions were obtained. The lubrication of seals was researched by fluid film. Based on the force analysis of sealing ring, the balance between closing force and bearing force was confirmed to discuss the patterns of sealing friction and wear behavior. Selecting reasonably conditions exerted on seals and simulating the actual operations of the transmission, axial force and its variabilities with pressure and rotating speed were obtained by computation of equations.

articleTitle: Performance of anaerobic sequencing batch reactor (ASBR) for domestic wastewater treatment in low temperature
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Use anaerobic sequencing batch reactor to treat domestic wastewater at about 10∼15ଌC. The performance of ASBR in treating domestic wastewater in low temperature was observed. And the affections that environment temperature, hydraulic retention time, Organic loading rate and influent time affect on ASBR were investigated

articleTitle: Influence of limestone powder on mechanical property of lightweight aggregate concrete
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: On the basis of adopting the natural pumice as coarse aggregate and to compound LC40 strength class of lightweight aggregate concrete, this paper studies the workability, compressive strength, flexural strength and axial compressive strength physical and mechanical properties of lightweight aggregate concrete affected by different dosage fly ash, and from microcosmic structure is analyzed. The results show that mixed limestone powder could ameliorate mixing resistance and physical and mechanical properties of lightweight aggregate concrete more obvious; and dosage limestone powder with 30% is the best for the mechanical properties of lightweight aggregate concrete.

articleTitle: Diffusion leakage model study on chemical materials taking Liquid Ammonia as an example
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: It is important to select the correct diffusion model to predict the leakage concentrate of hazardous materials according to their molecular weight properties. Generally speaking, the Gauss diffusion model is usually used for predict light gas diffusion and SLAB model for weight gas. However diffusion model selection is also determined by storage condition, which can greatly change the physical condition and influence predictive model selection. In paper, we took liquid ammonia as an example. Ammonia is gaseous in normal temperature and pressure, and usually be converted into liquid by high pressure storage condition in practice. The gauss model and LSAB model were used in this paper to compare the difference of diffusion process. The result is as follows. For one thing, the spatial dimension predicted by Gauss model was greatly less than that of SLAB model accompanied by much wide spatial range in horizon direction to the predominant wind direction. For another, referencing to AEGL-1 standard, the longest diffusion distance in 4650s by SLAB model is about 6132 meters and the result predicted by Gauss model is about 2880 meters. The difference of influence spatial scope and diffusion distance predicted by two models is 44.7% and 77.2%. So it should be cautious when selecting diffusion model to predict the hazardous material leakage.

articleTitle: Dynamic formulation of the 2-DOF parallel platform with actuation redundancy and the designs of the drivers
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: On base of the principle of virtual work, the inverse dynamic model of the 2-DOF parallel platform is set up . The dynamic formulation is a system of equations including two equations and three unknown quantities referring to three driving forces. The optimum solution of the driving forces is carried out by employing the generalized inverse matrix with minimizing an objective function which is the square of the sum of three driving forces. The parameters of drivers are designed.

articleTitle: Dynamic failure of single-layer spherical reticulated shell with imperfections
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The single-layer spherical reticulated shell is the structure which is sensitive to imperfections. The initial imperfections reducing structural stability included initial curvature and residual stress of element and installation deviation of nodes. The stress-strain curve concerning the residual stress was got by model CRC, the influence of initial curvature was got by the half-sinusoid and the programs about them were programmed by ANSYS secondary exploitation. Based on these works, the influences of the three imperfections on dynamic failure of the spherical reticulated shell were got by IDA.

articleTitle: Contribution rate of water-soluble polyacrylamide's COD and research of degradation bacterium's degradation behavior
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A kind of polyacrylamide's degradation bacterium is separated from oil gather standing in Shengli oilfield by Hungate technology. Through appraisal result of Form, Physiology and biochemistry and Molecular biology, Bacterial strain is G-, Short Sindbis, Sporeless, The optimal pH is 8.0; The optimal environment is neutral partial alkaline; the optimum temperature is 38°C, the bacterial strains is eosinphilic temperature bacteria, and facultative anaerobic Similarity is 99% between the bacterial strain and Clostridium cylindrosporum (CCY18179). We name the bacterial strain as Clostridium HPAM bacterium H4. The results show that: the different molecular weight of HAPM's COD Contribution rate is lined with concentration. From IR, we can see that the bonds of N-C have broken after biodegradation, viscosity of polymer decreased to 97.26% during 3 days. The bacterial strains have the better biodegradation and off viscosity function.

articleTitle: Study on sintering technology of cemented carbide
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the turbo-air stream classifying principle, the quality of superfine WC powder get further improving by means of superfine pulverizing grader. Experiments show that the technology of air steam classifying has significant effect on increase of the fineness and the particle classification efficiency. By comparing different type of air stream equipment, the QYF fluid-bed superfine pulverizing grader was adopted in the experiment that was manufactured by KunShan superfine pulverizers factory as well as obtaining high quality superfine WC powder with high homogeneous. Finally, the factor was studied that influence the densification and shrinkage, including the low-pressure sintering and inhibitor additions, experimental evidence indicates that Cr3C2 and VC is suitable to as inhibitor additions of ultra-fine cemented carbide. Also, an investigation on the relationship between grain growth and the amount of inhibitor additives was also made. High quality ultra-fine cemented carbide was manufactured with WC grain size lies in the average of 0.3-0.4μm, alloy hardness of higher than 93 and bending strength higher than 3300. The microstructure was found to be composed of very fine and uniform carbides.

articleTitle: Study on control system for oblique lane transportation system of coal mine
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The safety of the oblique lane of coal mine is always the weak link in the coal mine safety production, whose auxiliary transportation system is controlled by manual operation. The low levels of automation equipment and transportation efficiency seriously restrict the development of the coal mine. Now, the oblique lane of coal mine is faced with the low automation and intelligent, which lead to the accidents happen frequently. It hinders the management and development of the intrinsically safe in coal mine. Furthermore, it is difficult to realize that no person walks as the mine car running or no mine car runs as some person walking because of the long tunnel. So the roadster accidents often occur in the coal mine, which results in huge loss. In order to ensure the security and high efficiency in the oblique lane of coal mine, the control system based on DeviceNet is introduced in the paper. The system is composed of the host computer and the lower computer. The touching screen is used as the host computer and the PLC is adopted as the lower computer. The typical position, such as warding off car, car arrester and mine car sliding-down preventive device, is equipped a slave station PLC, which is connected with the master station by DeviceNet. The experiment shows that the system has the advantages of simple structure, convenient operation and strong.

articleTitle: Discussion on transient response analysis based on DSP
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, discussions were made on using DFT and IDFT to calculate the transient acceleration response of a single degree system. Two key points were discussed: the sampling frequencies and the time span. Simulation were made the transient response of a single degree system's transient response, it was found that the sampling frequencies have the greatest influence on the calculation error. The calculation precision's relation with the sampling frequencies were discussed, it shows that to keep calculation error in 10%, 99% energy in the low frequency should be calculated correctly.

articleTitle: Analyze the montanic pipeline construction bend and elbow measurement
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The long-distance pipeline construction of the third Shaanxi-Beijing Line project Plateau Liangshan zone demands a lot of elbows and bends. If Bends and elbows are not correctly measured, the condemnation rate will not high and many elbows remain. Therefore, it's necessary to improve the measurement method according to the geographical conditions of site in the construction based on the traditional ways. For different conditions the measurement methods proposed are various. Thus the accuracy of the measured elbows and bends increases, the accurate measurement to reach allows the elbows and bends match the design well, ensure that no excessive amount of elbows and bends, improves work efficiency, and saves construction cost.

articleTitle: Application in Vehicle Routing Problem of hybrid discrete particle swarm optimization
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Vehicle Routing Problem is the NP problem, and only can it get precise optimum when the problem is simple,so the intelligent elicitation algorithm becomes an important studied fleld.This paper adopts PSO to optimize VRP.The local search capacity of PSO is relatively weak,so this paper combines PSO with simulated annealing and designs the PSO based on SA using the characteristics that SA can accept some ungraded solution under the control of certain probability.Finally the algorithm is applied to the VRP,and the simulation results show that the PSO based on SA can get better optimization effect than SA or PSO single used,which validates the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: The conception of prestressed reactive powder concrete composite box-girder bridge with corrugated steel webs
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The application and development of prestressed concrete composite box-girder bridge with corrugated steel webs and reactive powder concrete were summarized in this paper. The authors analyzed the characteristics of prestressed concrete composite box-girder bridge with corrugated steel webs and tapped the potential and predominance of reactive powder concrete. A new type of prestressed reactive powder concrete composite box-girder bridge with corrugated steel webs was presented in detail. In addition, by taking the Guangxi Longbai Road bridge as prototype, the two trial design of prestressed reactive powder concrete composite box-girder bridge with corrugated steel webs were carried out. The results of design and analysis show that the reactive powder concrete substituting for the concrete in the composite structure with corrugated steel webs can further reduce selfweight and work amount, but also can realize standardized production and cut down the construction period. Therefore, the study in this paper may provide a breakthrough consideration for the development of prestressed concrete composite box-girder bridge with corrugated steel webs.

articleTitle: Application and research of primer-free painting on automobile interior surface
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Compared with primer, various performance of free primer (such as, appearance performance, hardness, adhesive force, water resistance, acid & alkali resistance, oil resistance, salt mist resistance, weathering resistance) were investigated by means of experiments. The qualities of free primer are no obviously charged for the surface of existing enclosure, sill and intermediate pillar. The feasibility of innovation, lower cost and higher efficiency of primer-free painting technology for automobile interior surface were discussed in this study.

articleTitle: The improvement of automobile-use lifter transmission shaft parameter
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: On the basis of the modeling and analyzing of the transmission system of the PQS-3-D elevator for car in the preamble, this article analysis the reason of the small difference of the angular speed, angular acceleration, angular displacement curve between the bilateral symmetry components. Actually, it is the result of that the torsional rigidity of the bilateral drive shafts are different, therefore has made the revision suggestion to the drive shaft parameter. And analysis the output curve after improving, and in the same time, the difference in the corresponding angular speed, angular acceleration, angular displacement curve of the bilateral symmetry components will obviously decrease.

articleTitle: The surface morphology of diamond films by hot cathode DC-PCVD
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This The equipment and experimental conditions which prepared diamond films by hot cathode DC-PCVD were introduced in this paper. The surface morphology of diamond film samples are discussed when the Methane flow rates was 2sccm, 4sccm, 6sccm and 8scc, the Ethanol flow rates was 50sccm, 60sccm, 70sccm and lOOsccm , the Methanol flow rates was 2sccm, 6sccm and lOsccm , the substrate temperature was 1000°C, current of 9A. The surface morphology of diamond film samples were discussed when the substrate temperature was 800°C, 900°C, 1000°C and 1100°C. Finally, the conclusions was obtained.

articleTitle: Study on the numerical simulation research of uranium and strontium's dynamic migration on the soil
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article is though discussed numerical simulation to predict the migration of uranium and strontium in shallow strata in the soil. The result indicated that the uranium will migrate out between 9777a ~ 13587a in landfill T1, and the uranium will migrate out between 62150a ~ 91703a in landfill T2. But the strontium won't migrate away completely. Therefore it is need to take necessary measures to slow migration of uranium.

articleTitle: Research of bored pile drilling technique under complicated geological condition
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The foundation of super large bridge of Jinghu Express Railway over the Huaihe river is composed of eight bored piles whose diameter is 2.2m and the designed length of piles is 50m. The geological condition of bridge site is complicated and piles have to pass through six-meter thick granite. The drilling platform need to be built firstly at the position of the bored piles and then the air lifting reverse circulation drilling machine is used to the construction of bored piles. It was solved for the large diameter bored piles to be constructed in the deep water and complicated geological condition through the design and construction of deep water drilling platform, the drilling pressure and speed control under the different geological condition and so on. The research showed the bored piles could satisfy the technique request of express railway.

articleTitle: Source apportionment and spatial-temporal variance of agricultural non-point source pollution in Chengdu, Sichuan Province
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to understand source apportionment and spatial-temporal variance of agricultural non-point source pollution (NPSP) fully in Chengdu, Sichuan, and to further provide evidence to cut it down, the list analysis was conducted to determine the loading of agricultural NPSP in Chengdu. The results showed that the main sources of pollution were livestock breeding, crop production, rural domestic waste and the main pollutants was COD. According to pollution stress, the pollution extent was plain area > hill area. In recent years, pollution quantities have the trend of ascent. Livestock breeding and rural domestic waste have achieved rapid growth, however, pollution quantities of crop farming has been decreasing. Therefore,poultry and animal pollution prevention is the emphases of our future work, meanwhile, take into account both rural domestic waste and crop production.

articleTitle: Dynamical analysis of a generalized Camassa-Holm equation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Research on traveling wave solutions of generalized Camassa-Holm equation is one of the hottest points in the study of nonlinear dynamic system. The peakon and bifurcations in a generalized Camassa-Holm equation are considered in this paper. By using nonlinear transform and the transform of traveling wave to the generalized Camassa-Holm equation, averaged equation is obtained. We applied the bifurcation theory of planar dynamical system and maple software to investigate the equation. We obtain the peakon from the homoclinic orbit. The results obtained will play an important directive role in the study of Camassa-Holm equation.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis of Small box profiled lightweight reinforced concrete wall structure
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study on pulsed gas metal arc welding and its digital control strategy
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Pulsed gas metal arc welding is an important welding process in advanced manufacturing technology, which makes conventional welding process a finely controllable process. However, this process demands a synergic setting up of pulse parameters in order to retain optimal transfer of droplets which depends on experimental data under various conditions, while the stability of arc length is necessary but difficult to model and has nonlinear and time varying characteristics. In this paper, the process was analyzed in detail, and current control methods were presented and compared. Then, a digital control oriented approach has been suggested, including algorithms of parameters adjustment, PI and fuzzy logic control. An experimental system based on welding inverter and microcontroller was implemented, and the scheme was described here as well.

articleTitle: The analysis of the properties of a tunable split-ring resonator of metamaterials
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The extracting method of the effective permittivity and permeability of split-ring resonator (SRRs for short) of metamaterials is described based on the extraordinary electromagnetic properties of metamaterials. Simulations are made to three types of symmetric SRRs by CST software. Comparison and analysis indicate that SRRs with short metal rod can regulate the resonating frequency of the SRRs. It is also verified that the transmission zero points of the new type of SRRs-based filter can be controlled by changing the distance between the short metal rod and the side of SRRs with mouth.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on security measures under overpass bridge
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Highway construction and protection of sichuan giant panda sanctuaries
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Planned highway will pass through the buffer zone or the core zone of world natural heritage Sichuan giant panda sanctuaries. There is a direct impact on the authenticity and integrity of world natural heritage Sichuan giant panda sanctuaries during the highway construction and operation period. We propose to reduce the construction project on environmental stress and ecological impact by the special management measures.

articleTitle: Preliminary experimental study on producing green building mortar by using recycled construction waste
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As the resource of natural sand is exhausting while construction waste is recycled with a low rate in China, this paper aim at solving this problem by using construction waste to substitute natural sand in producing building mortar. In this study, recycled sand made of construction waste substitutes natural sand with a rate of 0, 20, 40, 60, 80 and 100% to produce cement-based mixed mortar with the strength of M5.0,M7.5 and M10. The results shows that water consumption increases, coursing degree of mortar decreases, and water-retaining capacity of mortar goes up while recycled sand is used more; recycled sand has no significant adverse influence on the strength of middle and low strength mortar, and when the substituting rate is 40%, good particle size distribution is obtained and higher strength of mortar is gained; for mortar of M5.0, M7.5, all substituting rates can meet the designed strength requirement.

articleTitle: Analysis of the statics blending problems by boundary element method for thin-plate with supporting in the domain
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Analyzing the existing problems of bending problems for thin-plant with supporting in the domain by conventional statics boundary element methods, this paper puts forward to boundary statics equation of solving bending problems for thin-plant with supporting in the domain based on linear nature and the solution overlaying of thin-plant bending control equations through load items processing of integral equation. Numerical calculation results show that this modeling method not only reduces a lot of theoretical derivation and calculation process, greatly improves the calculation speed, and computational precision is good, meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: Fluent simulation of thermoacoustic effect
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In Workbench platform it applies Fluent to take numerical simulation to thermal acoustic effect what is working principle of thermoacoustic refrigerator, and it verifies the essence of thermal acoustic effect that the pressure changes will lead to a corresponding change in the temperature. It introduces the building of model, grid, setting the boundary conditions and solution process, analyses pressure and temperature changes in the flow field. The simulation results provides gist for further complete machine simulation of thermoacoustic refrigeration.

articleTitle: Research on the influence of regional tectonic stress field on coal and gas outburst
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on geodynamic zoning, according to topography and landscape features, I∼V class active faults are divided and certain local geology structure is determined. Then, the geological model of tectonic stress field is built. Incorporated with in-situ stress measurements, the numerical simulation of regional tectonic stress field is done by using self-developed Rock Mass Stress-state Analysis System software. Then, the distribution law of rock stress of the eighth mine coal seam V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9–10</inf> roof can be found, and the influence of the tectonic stress field on coal and gas outbursts is analyzed. The results indicate that the distribution of rock stress depends upon the faults and is formed again because of superposition of the action of faults. Tectonic stress field and its uneven distribution provide dynamic conditions for the occurrence of coal and gas outbursts. Therefore, the regional distribution of coal and gas outbursts in the eighth mine is controlled by them from time to space.

articleTitle: Live load analysis under assessment reference period for in-service bridge basing on load survey
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The aggravated service performance attenuation and substantially reducing of the service life for the highway bridge are caused by the overloading and heavy traffic load phenomenon on the highway. Then the bridge evaluation must consider the actual traffic vehicle load condition. Furthermore, the service time of the bridge, involving the technology assessment of bridge structure, also determine the change of the assessment reference period and the load effect of the bridge. Based on the vehicle load survey data and its statistical analysis measured in Luogang Section of No. 107 National Highway, the probability distribution function of the category vehicle load and the representative values of related parameters are obtained. Using the statistical analysis of vehicle loads measured results, a simulation program for the random fleet across the bridge was compiled, and the load effect of the bridge under the simulated random fleet load is calculated. It presents the conclusion that the mid-span moment of simply supported beam bridge of different span follows the gamma distribution, and the distribution parameters are also calculated. Through the analysis for the service life and the assessment reference period of the bridge, a calculating method for the bridge assessment reference period is presented. Then, basing on the load effect calculated by the survey data simulation, the live load effect variation law of the changed assessment reference period under different service life of bridge can be presented.

articleTitle: The innovative design of product based on component value and lines analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The theory of component value analysis and lines analysis were introduced in this paper, we can get a comprehensive description of the product model as a system by lines analysis and identify the inadequacies of the system‥ We can identify the weakest link in the system by components value analysis, so as to provide direction to solve the problem of improving product design. The application of component value and lines analysis to innovation design was illustrated with an engineering instance of future design.

articleTitle: Analysis on principle and key techniques of deterministic finishing
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Soft finishing methods are required to meet the need of modern optical surface while the deterministic finishing processing is needed to ensure the high precession surface.. The concepts and the math model of deterministic finishing are presented. The key technologies of deterministic finishing are analyzed, which include the requirement of removal rate function, the solving method of dwell time, and the finishing scan path. The deterministic finishing methods used at present are Small Tool Lapping and Polishing (STLP), Magneto-Rheological Finishing (MRF), Ion Beam Figuring (IBF), Atmospheric Pressure Plasma Chemical Finishing (APPCF) and so on. The principle, removal rate function characteristic and new development of these deterministic finishing methods are introduced.

articleTitle: Research of variable frequency control technology for heavy adjustor in power plant fuel system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Traditional run way of the heavy adjustor in thermal power plant fuel system and its creation to influence badly is carefully investigated. Based on run characteristics of heavy adjustor, technology scheme that traditional run mode is improved by PLC as central controller and variable frequency control technology is deeply studied, variable frequency control system and electricity reformation circuit is designed, a principle of choosing converter is analyzed. Actual operation of variable frequency control system proves: the problem that high inertia, great torque load is started and multiple motors are synchrodrived is solved. So the system running condition is improved, vibration and impact is greatly reduced when heavy adjustor approaches carriage, tows carriage and stops, electric energy is saved, mechanic equipment is protected, there is engineering applied value

articleTitle: Hydrodynamic computation and numerical simulation on motion responses of three-dimensional planing boat
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The prediction of hydrodynamic characteristics and motion responses is investigated numerically with CFD software FLUENT and self-developed program. Variations of resistance , lift and moment under the condition of the air effect is considered or not at different Froude numbers are numerically simulated. Predicted results show that the lift and moment change obviously when the air effect is included. The maximum increase of lift reaches 31.78% while the reduction of moment is 31.84% at Fr=5.0.Heave-pitch motion characteristics of planing boat at Fr=1.5 is numerically simulated by the real-time solution of planing boat motion equations, time history curves on height of center of gravity and pitch angle are presented.

articleTitle: Health diagnosis for the Yellow River delta wetland, China
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: On the seaboard of Shouguang County, the Judian lake wetland had existed in history, but now has died out. The evolution of the lake wetland was closely linked with the variance of geographic environment. Based on the method of the historical geography, the authors study the evolution of the lake wetland. Judian Lake wetland formed 6000 years ago, evolved from the lagoons near estuary and experienced two periods, the golden age in the Middle Holocene and the shrinking age in the Late Holocene. The disappearance of the Lake wetland resulted from the drying climate, the migration of rivers and the activities of human being. Among the three reasons, the migration of rivers is the main one.

articleTitle: Determination of organic phosphorus pesticide in environmental water by flow injection-spectrophotometry
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: An automatic, convenient method combined flow injection technique for determining organic phosphorus pesticide in environment water was developed based on the inhibition effects of organic phosphorus pesticide to plant-esterase. The optimized determining conditions were acquired, and the analytical characteristics of this method were studied. The linear ranges of dichlorvos' standard curves was 0.008 ~ 4mg/L. The linear equation of dichlorvos was U(mV) = -4874.4 C (mg/L) + 110313. The correlation coefficient of dichlorvos was 0.9984. The detection limit (S/N= 3) was 0.02 mg/L for dichlorvos. The relative standard deviation (RSD) of dichlorvos was 1.04% (n=6). The recoveries ranged from 95% to 105%. The analysis result was good.

articleTitle: Research on esplanade-cleaning robot's target recognition
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A kind of high-efficient target recognition algorithm has been worked out, which is on the basis of developing a esplanade-cleaning robotic prototype with a visual function. Based on the difference in value and target tricolor ratio, the robot can accurately identify the target garbage within its vision quickly. By the least squares method fitting that the target range, robot can accurately drive to the target position and control its manipulator to pick up the target rubbish. This algorithm could make the cleaning-robots working in outdoor plaza independently and without blindness, which can not only improve the efficiency, but also save energy greatly.

articleTitle: Modeling and stability analysis of networked control systems with network-induced delay and data packet dropout
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Network-induced delay (NID) and data packet dropout are two main issues inevitably exist in networked control systems (NCS). NCS with NID and data packet dropout existing simultaneously which are transported through single/ dual channel are modeled in this paper. Stability analysis of this networked control system is discussed, and sufficient condition is presented and proven. Stability of NCS with Bernouli process data packet dropout is especially analyzed. Sufficient and necessary condition of stability of such NCS is given. Simulation results show the correctness and feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: Impact of human activities and climatic change on surface runoff in Hebei Province
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Using hydrological data of Hebei Province to revert to and coherently correct surface runoff series from 1956 to 2000, educing natural annual surface runoff series before land cover changes and after, and comparing with each other, discovering that to plain area of all 12 water resource third class area and mountain areas and six third class area human activities has been of obvious influence. According to the relationship between surface runoff series under actual land cover conditions and climate factors (precipitation, evaporation, temperature), the establishment of several nonlinear statistical model was made, establishing the logarithmic nonlinear statistical model, it's of obvious correlation and high sensitivity. According climate scenarios data of year 2030 and 2050 to predict the change on surface runoff, comparing with the standard climate values, in year 2030, precipitation will increase by 4%∼12%, and the temperature will rise 1.1∼1.4°C, surface runoff change will be 11.436∼13.824 billion m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>; In year 2050, precipitation will increase by 4% to 14%, and the temperature will rise 1.7∼2.2°C, surface runoff change will be 10.68∼13.78 billion m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>.

articleTitle: Application of fuzzy comprehensive assessment in reservoir resettlement post evaluation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the systems of reservoir immigration, and aims to evaluate the post effect of immigrating in reservoir through fuzzy comprehensive assessment. The effect of using fuzzy comprehensive assessment in some reservoir resettlement post evaluation shows that the method is rational,scientific, and high reliability.The result provides a scientific basis for decision-making of reservoir immigration.

articleTitle: Design of wireless sensor networks for safety monitoring at civil engineering construction sites
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Civil engineering construction site is a high-risk area, where many accidents occur, but most construction sites lack necessary safety monitoring and warning system. Compared to traditional monitoring system, the monitoring system based on wireless sensor networks has many advantages. According to the requirements of practical engineering, the safety monitoring system for civil engineering construction is designed based on wireless sensor networks. The structure of system, network topology, and architecture of the wireless sensor nodes, hardware design, performance test and the architecture of information fusion are presented.

articleTitle: Study on mixture formation for a direct injection lean-burn LPG engine
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering

articleTitle: Study of grey correlation analysis on rigid frame bridge construction stress influencing factors
