publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Influencing factors on magnitude of concrete stress during the construction course of rigid frame bridge are introduced, factors' contribution quantity on stress is ascertained through grey correlation analysis, which should be prevented overrun of stresses in order to avoid crack or crush of concrete, Validity of grey correlation analysis is confirmed during stress change trend analyses of one rigid frame bridge construction supervision.

articleTitle: Simulation study of Electrical Capacitance Tomography
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By using ANSYS for formulation and solution of the finite element, a model of Electrical Capacitance Tomography electrodes array was constructed. Based on the model, the sensitivity matrix of the sensor was calculated and sensitivity response was analyzed. The flow pattern of two phase flow was identified by using RBF neural network at first, and then the image was reconstructed by using BP neural network. A method was introduced that take the characteristic parameters of stratified flow, annular flow and core flow as the output of BP Neural Network for image reconstruction. Simulation results showed that it can rapidly reconstruct satisfactory images.

articleTitle: Drag estimation of single tetrahedron block in multi-direction flow surroundings
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Tetrahedron Block (TB) is a commonly used material in river closure and dike protection engineering. A 3D hydrodynamic model, which is based on the commercial Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) code Fluent, is developed to predict velocity fields and drags of the single TB in flow with different free stream directions. The realizable k-ε model is adopted for turbulent closure of the Reynolds Averaged Navier Stokes (RANS) equations. The study demonstrates that the numerical model can help in understanding the complex flow fields around the TB. When the directions of the free streams are changed, the total drags F<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</sub> correspondingly have obvious variation. When the Reynolds number is given as 17777, the drag coefficients C<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">D</sub> vary from 0.832 to 1.849, the drags of TB have an obvious "anisotropic" feature.

articleTitle: The theory on seasonal frozen soil's moisture migration and frost heave in Hetao Irrigation District
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Hetao Irrigation District, one of China's four major irrigation area in the region are widely distributed with the seasonal frozen soil and the hydraulic structure in irrigation being positioned at drainage channels in the whole irrigation. In the long winter, the channel works is bound to withstand freeze-thaw cycles seriously. The topic of its maintenance has always been the focus of the loop Irrigation. To this end, we conducted moisture migration and frost heave analysis of seasonal frozen soil.

articleTitle: Study on crystallization behavior of magnesium ammonium phosphate
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to study crystallization behavior of magnesium ammonium phosphate(MAP) under different conditions, the crystals were obtained by chemical precipitation in de-ionic water with NH<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>Cl, MgCl<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and Na<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>HPO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>. Through the XRD and SEM methods, it is found that MAP were transmuted into Mg<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>(PO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> when pH from 9 to 12. In the condition of pH=9, Mg<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub>(PO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub>)<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> were transmuted into MAP with the increasing of N dosing ratios, the crystals were MAP with the increasing of Mg dosing ratios, the amorphous matter were transmuted into MAP with the increasing of P dosing ratios, and the shape of crystals show definite difference at different ion dosing ratios. The composition of crystals was almost invariable when reactive temperature, crystallization time and mixture speed changed in experimental range, but which affected the shape of crystals.

articleTitle: Modification and properties study of thermo-responsive PVDF flat membrane
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: N-isopropylacrylamide (NIPAAm) was grafted on Poly(vinylidene fluoride) (PVDF) flat membrane by atom transfer radical polymerization (ATRP). The grafting copolymer was characterized by Scanning electron microscopy (SEM), <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sup>H NMR, Fourier transform infrared (FT-IR) and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). Contact angle on membrane surface and water penetration were measured. The results showed that the NIPAAm was grafted on the PVDF membrane successfully and the membrane pore was becoming smaller. After the grafting of NIPAAm, the water contact angles of PVDF membranes reduced, and the hydrophilicity of the grafted membrane was improved. The water fluxes of the modified membrane was abruptly increased at 32 °C. The modified membranes exhibited temperature-responsive permeability.

articleTitle: Data processing of on-machine measuring in fine grinding for optical lens
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According the features of on-machine measuring and compensation machining, a suitable data processing flow is designed using contact or non-contact sensor to collect measuring data, and the no-linear least square method to correct the inclination error of measuring system. The results of verification experiments for data processing presented well reflect error distribution of the actual surface with suitable measuring accuracy. It is also clarified that the on-machine measuring significantly affects the machining accuracy by the compensation machining experiments.

articleTitle: The transient sound radiation monitor of a free beam by a single point vibration measurement
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Methods to reconstruction the whole beam's vibration by a single point vibration measurement was discussed. The vibration field was used to calculate the transient sound of the free-free beam, and then the beam's transient sound radiation prediction method was given. The method to monitor the sound radiation of the beam by single point vibration measurement was valid by experiment. At last, the best position to place the vibration sensors was discussed by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: The simulation of four non-isolated DC boost circuits
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: DC boost circuits are widely used in the design of various power equipments. Because the efficiency and cost advantages of non-isolated boost circuits, people researched and developed them continuously. In this paper, we simulated four non-isolated boost circuits, and then we analyzed and compared their step-up ratio, the voltage and current stresses of power devices, the turn-off losses of diode, applications etc. Through the series of simulations, we can easily understand the advantages of various boost circuits, and they have a certain significance in designing the DC boost circuits.

articleTitle: Research of critical displacement method for earthquake-induced landslides
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The cumulative displacement of landslides caused by earthquake consists of two parts: one is the initial displacement of the slope before the earthquake, the other is the displacement generated by the earthquake. The former can be determined by monitoring data or geological macroscopic survey, while the latter can be calculated by the Newmark method, so that we can obtain the cumulative landslide displacement. Combined with the latest critical displacement evolution theory, and comparing the cumulative displacement with the critical displacement, the paper put forward the critical displacement criterion for earthquake-induced landslide, which provide quantitative reference information for the seismic landslide hazard prediction, the localization in the earthquake-hit region, and the reconstruction work after the earthquake, thereby improve our cognition and understanding of the earthquake-induced landslide hazard.

articleTitle: Effects of shape-gene on the secondary electron emission of curved-surfaces in low-octane primacy electrons
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on semi-classical theorem, Analyzed the secondary electron emission of objects under the incidence of low-octane primacy electrons, calculated the approximate relation between incidence angle and secondary electron emission coefficient, Shape-gene are firstly put forward and further obtained is the method of calculating the secondary electron emission coefficient. Deduced the secondary electron emission coefficient of cylindrical surfaces, the results are also analyzed and discussed.

articleTitle: Study on mixed quality of rare earth extract's double-decked stirring paddle
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article multi-reference frame(MRF) is used to simulate the impellers, and standard k − ε turbulent model and the resolve method of apart the velocity field from concentration field are used in the simulation, Through studying agitation effect including the flow field velocity distribution and the turbulent kinetic power diffusion situation in the double-decked oar trough's discovered in double-decked (on straight leaf, gets down flap) turbine mixing paddle trough the mixing characteristic meet the requirement of rare earth extract technological, moreover ,it can be advantageous to reduce the extract cost and raise the productivity, The research results in the paper provide guidance for the choice and optimized design to the mechanical mixing operations.

articleTitle: Phosphate removal from water by zero-valent iron / activated carbon fiber felt galvanic couples
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This study presents a zero-valent iron / activated carbon fiber felt (ACFF) galvanic couples (Fe<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>/ACFF) process to remove dissolved phosphate from water. The effect of initial phosphate concentration and pH were investigated, and the adsorption capacity and kinetic model were also evaluated using both the Freundlich and the Langmuir isotherm models and the Lagergren model. The results showed that Fe<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</sup>/ACFF galvanic couples using ACFF as the cathode material were feasible for removing phosphate from water, and the maximum removal rate of 99.4% and the minimum equilibrium time of 43 hours were achieved at the initial phosphate concentration of 2mg/L and the pH of 7.0. The adsorption process followed a first-order kinetic model. The Freundlich isotherm model was a better fit with experimental data.

articleTitle: Influence of Si/FeO42− mol ratio on coagulation of poly-silicic-ferric coagulant from fly ash extract
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Ploy-high-ferric-silicic coagulant from fly ash extract with various Si/FeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sup> mol ratios was prepared using potassium ferrate. The influence of Si/FeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sup> mol ratio on both structure morphology and influence mechanism of poly-high-ferric-silicic was investigated. The coagulation efficiency using poly-high-ferric-silicic as coagulant in treating lead wastewater in comparison with that using PFPS as coagulant was studied. The results show that the relative amount of Si or Fe in poly-high-ferric-silicic has a limit ratio. Poly-high-ferric-silicic can give the optimum complex action of Si and Fe only at the optimum Si/FeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sup> ratio range which is near the limit of Si/FeO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sup> ratio. Color, turbidity and Pb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> removal efficiency are excellent and treatment effects are stable in treatment lead wastewater, especially the removal of Pb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup> has been up to 96% more and the poly-high-ferric-silicic dosage is low. Therefore, by comparison, the poly-high-ferric-silicic is a superior coagulant in lead wastewater treatment.

articleTitle: Dynamic performance research for toroidal motor
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Toroidal motor is a new type of motor. The basic structure of the motor is introduced. The voltage equation of the coils is given and the electromagnetic torque is deduced. The changes of the inductances along with the position angle of the planet for the model machine are measured, and then the fitting inductance curve and function are constructed. The transient of the voltage equation with constant speed of the motor is solved. The response of the current to exciting voltage is analyzed, the phenomenon of currents beats is discovered. The system equation with changing speed of the motor and load is also given. The torque-speed characteristic of toroidal motor is presented. A number of useful results are obtained. These results are significant for further research and control of the motor.

articleTitle: High-frequency sequence stratigraphy of carbonate and the corresponding shoal reservoir characteristics
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Deep carbonate of Tarim Basin has become an important study target of shoal reservoirs at present, and the reservoir capacity and its control factors of high-frequent meter scale cyclic carbonate strata have been the purposes of this study. This research has selected the upper layer of strata of Yingshan formation in Keping area of Tarim Basin as the target stata, and analyzed by anatomying its outcrop, sampling and studying microscopic flakes. The result shows that the strata of Yingshan formation has deposited as high-frequent meter-scale cyclic sequence, and been an aggradational pattern between parasequence sets. Each parasequence set contains four parasequences which limestone was thickening during depositing period, the external style and internal composition between parasequence sets and parasequences are apparent self similarity. Calcarenite and bioclastic debris are the main particle types of shoal reservoirs, and the size gradually has increased up. Cement and means of contact between particles are consistent with the aggradational high-frequency sequences. All of the above fully have proved that the depositional energy increases from the parasequence sets A to C, and the high-energy deposition environment provides the basic condition for forming excellent shoal reservoir. Cracks and fissures are the main reservoir spaces of Yingshan formation shoal reservoir, but deep diagenesis shortly has not conducted to form effective dissolution intergranular pore, and reduced the capacity of quality shoal reservoir as the prerequisite for high-energy environment. As a result, the tectonic uplift has been the leading factor to control Yingshan formation to be II category reservoir.

articleTitle: Study on the application of fuzzy-PID control to precision seeding technology of wheat
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to guarantee the seeding quality of Precision Seeding System, the control of seeding metering device should be improved, which is an particularly important link of seeding,. This paper introduces the important link and the application of fuzzy PID control for the link. A design of two-dimension fuzzy controller for stepping motor was described in the paper.Experiment results from simulation proves that the application of Fuzzy PID control could further decrease errors and make better effects on the system,which can improve the seeding uniformity.

articleTitle: Pretreatment experiments for photographic waste water
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A series of pretreatment experiments to photographic waste water have been done to get the highest COD removal rate by different methods of coagulation and ozone oxidization on the condition of different factors. The optimum coagulation conditions were listed as follows: 10 minutes coagulation time, 10 pH value, 2.5% ratio of volume for coagulant dosage. Through pretreatment process of coagulation, the COD of photographic waste water could reduce 25% approximately to 20000∼50000mg/L. the optimum ozone oxidization reacting time was 4 hours and packing media, high temperature, alkaline condition can improve the COD removal efficiency. In the optimum condition the COD removal ratio can achieve 56%.

articleTitle: Improved Genetic Algorithm for structure shape optimization design of mixed discrete variables
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Owing to the weak local searching power and slow iteration in the Genetic Algorithm, some strategies such as optimum individual conservation, infeasible individual transformation and local hesitation strategies are used to impove the Genetic Algorithm, when structure shape optimization design of mixed discrete variables is conducted, if the shape variables are continuous and the cross-section variables are discrete, this two kinds of variables should be considered comprehensively. And two-step searching strategies are put forward. The two-step strategies means that in the early stage of evolution,rough searching is carried through the whole searching range, the searching range is reduced to the adjacency of the optimum solution and then local fine searching is done in the late stage of evolution, thus the searching process is accelerated. The result of the exemplification indicates that the Genetic Algorithm for structure shape optimization design of mixed discrete variables is effective.

articleTitle: MIMO radar 2-D real-time imaging algorithm and simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Conceptually, 2-dimentional(2D) imaging of radar target is a problem of 2D spatial spectrum filling of the target. Accordingly, MIMO(Multiple-Input Multiple-Output) radar real-time imaging technology is proposed in this paper. Firstly, MIMO radar 2D imaging model is established based on electromagnetic scattering integral equation. Secondly, the spatial sampling ability is analyzed from the concept of spatial convolution of the antenna elements. Thirdly, MIMO radar 2-D real-time imaging procedure is presented. Simulation results show the effectiveness of MIMO radar real-time imaging algorithm.

articleTitle: Double-neuro-sliding mode position control for direct drive turning table servo system based on genetic algorithms
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Considering the parameters time variation, high nonlinear, disturbance and mechanical resonance of direct-drive turing table, a double neuro-sliding mode position control based on genetic algorithms is proposed. The turning table control system consists of sliding mode control and sliding swith control, the two control is used by two neural networks respectively, and use elastic BP algorithms and genetic algorithms (GA) to online optimize the weigh of the neural network. Simulation results demonstrate that the scheme can effectively achieve tracking performance and has strong robustness.

articleTitle: Study on Thermal conductivity and wear characteristic of basalt coating sprayed by APS
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: fThree kinds of basalt spraying powder were made by adding different mass proportions of TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>, the weight ratios of TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> were respectively 6%, 12%, 18%. Basalt powder mixed with TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>was sprayed on the surface of 45 steel with the method of atmospheric plasma spraying, then the non-metallic coatings were formed. The thermal conductivity and wear properties of the coatings were studied in this paper. The thermal conductivity of the sprayed and un-sprayed workpieces was measured under different temperatures in the YBF-2 thermal conductivity tester. Experimental results show that the overall thermal conductivity after sprayed was significantly lower than that before sprayed, meanwhile the thermal conductivity is not affected by the temperature at low temperature. The friction and wear test of the coating with basalt powder were carried out in the WMM-1-type friction and wear test machine. The wear experimental results express that the mass loss of the coating increase as the speed increasing, but the wear resistance increases with the increase of the content of TiO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>.

articleTitle: Dynamic properties of 1.5MW wind turbine blade with eccentricity fault
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A finite element model of 1.5MW wind turbine blade is established and verified. The dynamic properties of blade with eccentricity fault are analyzed. The results show that the dynamic response is linearly growing with the increase of mass when different mass-blocks are placed at the same position, and the dynamic response of the third out-of-plane vibration is gradually increasing from the blade root to tip when the same mass-block is placed at different positions. The present study provides a new theoretical basis for eccentricity fault diagnosis of large wind turbine blade.

articleTitle: A kind of LC voltage-controlled oscillator based on centre-tapped inductance
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a circuit of voltage controlled oscillator (VCO) with a centretap inductance LC-tank based on standard 0.13μm CMOS process. In this VCO circuit a cross coupled structure is adopted, which is filtered by an LC filter. In the LC filter a symmetric centretap inductance is connected with an accumulation-mode MOS varactor in parallel, which helps decrease the phase noise. The phase noise is about -113.7dBc/Hz at 1MHz offset from carrier frequency of 5.5GHz, and the tunable frequency varies approximately from 5GHz to 6GHz.

articleTitle: Characteristic recognition of pulse in frequency domain based on probabilistic neural network
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the level of automation for pulse signal processing and recognition, firstly, it used the fast Fourier transform with radix-2FFT algorithm to extract the characteristic parameters of pulse in frequency domain. Secondly, it made the dyadic discrete wavelet transform in four scales with MALLAT algorithm and calculated the detail energy values of four scales to constitute together the feature vector of pulse. Finally, for the shortcomings of traditional identification methods, the probabilistic neural network pulse identification method was proposed. It designed probabilistic neural network classifier and made the classification experiment, and the recognition rate was 93.00%. The results showed that the extracted feature vectors have a strong description capability of pulse.

articleTitle: The discussion of soil elements of the vertical distribution characteristics at scallions origin - Zhangqiu
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The important content of ecological geochemical in Zhangqiu area is soil elements of source and origin. The vertical distribution characteristics about soil elements reflect the content difference between surface and deep soil and provide the important basis for the genetic study of elements. This paper used the survey results of the local ecological geochemical, systematically summarizes the element content changes in the vertical profile, then explore the soil element migration regularity and source in this area. The research shows that the relationship is closed between element content and into soil cane in Zhangqiu area. But because of the farming and pollution, S, Se, Hg, N, P element are significant effects under supergene geochemistry activation.

articleTitle: Dynamic response of low truss bridges subject to lateral loads
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper presents 3D finite element model construction, modal analysis and lateral dynamic response of the low truss bridge instead of vehicle-bridge interaction model. We change general vehicle-bridge interaction model into low truss bridge model applied on lateral dynamic loads from running vehicles. Specifically, the determination of two different transverse dynamic loadings on the railways is included from wheel-rail creepages and uneven rail profiles respectively.

articleTitle: A new adaptive filtering acquisition scheme for PN code
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Adaptive filtering (AF) acquisition scheme has been proved to be an effective pseudo-noise (PN) code acquisition in DS-SS system, which is especially useful to long PN code acquisition in low Signal Noise Ratio (SNR) environment [1]. In order to make use of this scheme in those PN code acquisition systems with data modulation, a modified adaptive filtering method is proposed in this paper, where the effect of polarity reversion caused by data modulation on PN code is removed by employing absolutely successive difference technique in both the received signals and local generated PN code. Compared with AF acquisition scheme, even with data modulation, the proposed method can attain almost similar acquisition performance, which is tested by simulations.

articleTitle: Analysis of formation conditions of collapses in the Himalaya region
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: So far, there are many conclusions about the formation conditions of collapses but most are qualitative analysis. This paper, combined with the actual situation of the study area and using the canonical correlation analysis method based on fuzzy diagnosis method, analyzed the data of Himalayan region collapse disasters. We found that collapses are closely related to human activities, mainly distributed in the transport path along the river. In addition, collapse points have generally steep free surface, lots of surface joints and easily weathered rock strata, which create the conditions of collapses. But the precipitation does not affect collapses significantly.

articleTitle: Study on variation rules between heavy metal ions' concentration and pH value in acid mine drainage
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Using the heavy metal pollution data tested uninterruptedly of the acid mine drainage (AMD) in tailings pond and waste rock site as the case, this paper studies the oxidation mechanism of sulphide minerals and the dilution mechanism of heavy metal ions. And the rules of the connection between pH value and heavy metal ions' concentration are also studied by applying mathematic statistics method. The research shows that: the concentration of heavy metal ions is inversely proportional to pH value outstandingly.

articleTitle: Study on optimal allocation of public service facilities in indemnificatory communities based on demand characteristics-a case study of Sigao Community in Shanghai
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The rapid and large-scale construction of indemnificatory communities leads to the universal lack and inefficiency of public service facilities, directly reducing the life quality and the indemnificatory effect. Taking Sigao Community in Shanghai for example, this paper carries on in-depth analysis to the demand characteristics of the public service facilities in indemnificatory communities based on the research of the residents and their behavior preference. And optimizing countermeasures of configuration contents, timing and layout are put forward in order to satisfy the different needs of medium or low-income stratum.

articleTitle: Research on composite of pre-reservoirs technology for the removal of SS in non-point sources pollution
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this study, the composite of pre-reservoirs system was designed and to explored the removal of suspended particles (SS) in the non-point sources pollution. The operating parameter (residence time) was investigated its effect on the SS removal, and the particle size distribution of effluent was analysis. The results showed that this system could remove the SS with high efficiency. When the residence time was 24hrs, SS could remove over 90%. From the Particle Size Distribution analysis, the results revealed that the particle size > 30µm and <4µm of SS cloud be removed in sediment area by physical sedimentation. And the particle size of 3∼9µm of SS cloud be removed in deep water area by plants interception.

articleTitle: Statistic and analysis of specimens information of the national key protected wild plants in Hubei Province
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the information of specimens in the relevant herbariums, the species and their collecting locality, preserved herbariums and collecting date were counted and analyzed respectively in order to give an overview about specimens of the national key protected wild plants in Hubei Province. The results showed that there are 1906 collect codes of specimens of the national key protected wild plants in total, belonging to 46 species. Among these specimens, the collect codes of specimens of Metasequoia glyptostroboides are the most, which are 135 and count for 7.08%. Most of the specimens were collected from Lichuan, with 461 collect codes and about 27.04% in all. A large number of specimens were preserved in Herbarium Wuhan Institute of Botany (HIB) and they reach 619 and counts for 32.46%. From the collecting date, the collect codes of specimens collected during the 1950s made up 27.56% of total, containing the largest collect codes of 449. Through statistic analysis, we have found out the history of distribution, collection and study of these species. It also provides the basic data for the further research, and helps to protect and make use of the national key protected wild plants effectively in Hubei province.

Author Keywords: the national key protected wild plants

articleTitle: Dynamics simulation of floating automatic rifle
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The dynamics simulation prototype of floating automatic rifle was established. The mathematical-physical model of a kind of friction buffer that includes several friction loops and a buffer spring are developed. The experimental results agree well with the theoretical results and the simulation results. The obtained results are of great importance to improve the design quality of the automatic weapons, especially for those that have particular request for firing rate.

articleTitle: Based on ANSYS to the finite element analysis of the Circular Stacker-Reclaimer
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: YG500/80 Circular Stacker Reclaimer is a large equipment of homogenizing granular material, which combine cantilever material piling machine with scraper conveyor, the equipment has the characteristics of large span and Cantilever operating distance and often work in bad conditions. This paper focuses on the mechanical property of the key parts of the Circular Stacker-Reclaimeris, using ANSYS to analyse and getting the color stress cloud chart of finite element model, hasing the extremely vital significance of providing the design level of this kind of equipment.

articleTitle: Analysis of thermal stresses of concrete small hollow block
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The hollow pint-sized concrete block is a kind of new energy-saving material for wall. In the popularization process umder difference in temperature, the crack of the concrete small hollow bloc is the general problems. Masonry wall temperature load calculation, mainly is the temperature difference fromula. In the calculation of masonry structure, not only should consider experience for a short time, temperature variation of temperature changes, consider the long-term effects in temperature changing. In these two kinds of temperature, under the common function of each wall generates its own temperature can cause structure deformation, at the same time because temperature change inconsistencies, roofing and wall body produces the relative temperature and deformation of the structure, and caused each piece of mutually constrained wall structure deformation will also play a role. Some control measures were put forward. These researches provided theory basis for the wide use of the new energy-saving materials.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Technical exploration of the outburst prevention and the rock burst of working face at coal mine with deep shaft
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Study on self-organization of modular self-reconfigurable robot based on cellular automata
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The modular Self-Reconfigurable Robots were constructed by many each other dependently intelligence entity called "cell" , the tasks have been finished through connection and separation between the cells to form different movement and the shape . The cellular automaton extremely suits to the imitate nature biology evolution process, this paper using the advantages whose neighboring of cellular automaton were mutually sensation and local action, transition rules were independently produced through the genetic algorithm, not having artificially to interfere and code, thus the distributional realization of modular self-reconfigurable robots were realized. Independence production of the transition rules reduced intensity of the code, it provides the foundation to further studied the communication of distributional control and the load of distribution.

articleTitle: Research on dynamic response of phosphogypsum tailing ponds under seismic load
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Takes the Qinghai Yuntian phosphorus gypsum as the study object, using the Byrne model in FLAC, inputting manual simulation earthquake wave, and has simulated the accumulation process of phosphorus gypsum hole pressure in earthquake until the soil body is liquefied. Obtained from the calculation analysis, the upstream slope area near the water surface is easily liquefied but the beach length has great influence on the seismic liquefaction stability of the tailings dam, and the smaller the liquefaction zone, the higher the stability. Based on the tailings project safety issue under earthquake, this paper provides a specific calculation method and the ideas and conclusions can play a reference role on related projects.

articleTitle: The application and problem analysis of RFID
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) is a new kind of high-tech industry in China, although it appears just in recent several years in our country, it is developing rapidly and has been widely used in many fields. In this article, the constitution, working principle and classification of RFID are introduced briefly. Besides, momentous projects based on RFID are analyzed and summarized. At last, the problems encountering in the development of RFID are discussed in brief.

articleTitle: Research for the stability of PV trestle rooted in the land without groundsill in hohhot
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the time in the absence of ground-based directly on the ground the feasibility of installing solar PV bracket will stand across the bottom end of land and ground anchor nail Then, through the theoretical calculations PV Stent in the wind under the action of tipping load torque, and the projection anchors have been set aside when the force suffered, compared with the measured to identify the anchors aside suffered the law of the relationship between force and velocity, based on this rule to determine the bracket in their natural environment without foundation under photovoltaic operation stability, if the plan is feasible , it can shorten the construction time of photovoltaic power plants and reduce the investment cost of PV power generation for future large-scale domestic PV market launch of great significance.

articleTitle: A study on arc tube of ceramic metal halide lamp based on finite element analysis
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This report proposes a calculation equation for wall thickness of ceramic arc tube through calculation and analysis to temperature field distribution of arc tube in working, vapor pressure of materials filled in arc tube. Meanwhile, report also compares advantage or disadvantage of cylinder and ellipsoid arc tube on the base of finite element analysis.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Laser CAD/CAM
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Research on the mechanism of sustainable growth based on dynamic core competence
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Measurement of VOCs emissions from cooking in the Northeast Area of China
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Volatile organic compounds( VOCs) from cooking can affect air quality indoor and outdoor. The compositions of VOCs from cooking in the Northeast Area of China were investigated by using the method of pre-concentration-GC-MS. The average mass concentration of VOCs from cooking was 3407.06±889.5 μg.m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>, which is 1.7 times of fine organic particles. To estimate the contributions of major species in ozone formation, propylene equivalent concentrations were calculated to be 622.5ug.m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>. VOCs emission factors was 5.03g.kg<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>; 994.5t VOCs emitted from cooking in Shenyang city 2007.

articleTitle: Magnetic field analysis of MSMA single-coil self-sensing actuator
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the theoretical analysis and the experimental study of MSMA dual-coil self-sensing actuator, this paper attemped to analyze and show the design of the structure and principle of MSMA single-coil self-sensing actuator. By establishing a model of single-coil self-sensing actuator used by ANSYS finite element-edge element method, the thesis intends to analyze the magnetic field distribution of the model under excitation voltage changes and to further explore the practical value and the promising prospect of MSMA in engineering application with the help of drawing the magnetic flux density curves of EI silicon steel sheet and MSMA changing with the voltage.

articleTitle: Reaserch on the mathematical model of Rotating Electromagnetic Voltage Converter
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Rotating Electromagnetic Voltage Converter (REVC) is a new type of energy converter, which with multi-functions including voltage change, reactive power compensation, harmonics isolation, etc. In the paper, the operating principle of REVC is introduced; the mathematical model of REVC is obtained from relations of voltage, current, inductance and flux linkage. The mathematical model is simulated and analyzed by S-function of Matlab software, and the validity of the model is verified. The prototype is manufactured, and the results of experiment and simulation are consistent.

articleTitle: Analysis the mathematical model and research on the experiment of controllable damping hydro-pneumatic spring
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A research method of the throttle aperture when annular slice deformation is presented. The flow equation of aperture under the turbulence state is deduced using the boundary layer theory. The equivalent relation of the flow is deduced according to the system structure which is designed by independence. The flow coefficient of controllable valve is solved by least squares method under the different current strength. The mathematical model of controllable damping hydro-pneumatic spring is built through the equation above and the fact gas state expression. The variation relation of elastic force and the total export force under the different current strength following the displacement are analyzed. The correctness of model are validated compared with the experimental data, and it is explained that the practicability of the turbulence flow equation.

articleTitle: Identification of seismic facies and its sedimentary facies prediction in DD block
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The DD block is a new exploration area with relative complex structure. At present, due to the lack of any well revealing the target formation (XL formation), previous related studies on its sedimentary facies were mainly based on regional geologic understanding, so it can't provide both available sedimentary facies belt and favorable reservoir area for further exploration and development activities. In this paper, under the guideline of the theory of sequence stratigraphy, based on the only more than 400 kilometers 2-D seismic data (with survey grid of 2×3~3×4 km) in our study area, together with outcrop data, regional depositional setting and previous studies, the authors analyzed the reflection signature and identified its lithology within the XL formation on each seismic profile, then compiled lateral comprehensive vector analysis in profile and plane, after that, we divided seismic facies belts and converted them into sedimentary facies with the help of geological understanding. Finally, the plane distribution of some potential favorable sedimentary facies for reservoir development within the XL formation is outlined. Due to its high-quality seismic data with distinct reflection characteristic, the prediction results can provide some useful information for oil and gas exploration in this area.

Author Keywords: favorable sedimentary facies belt for reservoir development

articleTitle: The safety protection of power dispatching second order system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As for the present safety protection of all level power dispatching automation and data network in china, the potential safety hazard of power dispatching second order system is analyzed. The emphasis of safety protection is pointed out. The solution of overall safety protection of poser dispatching second order system are put forward.

articleTitle: The design and implementation of an Intellectual Fire Truck used for competition
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The Intellectual Fire Truck is based on the series of STC12XX SCM as the control center. It is supported by DC gear motor drive, infrared sensors, flame sensors, display module, power supply circuits along with other circuits. The system is designed as an intellectual multi-function fire truck to trace, avoid barriers, fire fighting, broadcast, count time, display miles and manage itinerary.

articleTitle: The research and schedule of E_carburettor for anti-disturbing
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the deep implement of the emission standard (CHINA stage III) in the motorcycle industry, the emission Limits of CO, HC and NO becomes more and more strict than ever before. The traditional single carburetor solution will be substituted by E_carburetor or fuel injection system. One hand, the use of microprocessor hand will greatly reduce exhaust emissions from motorcycle; on the other hand it will propose even higher requirements for the system reliability and stability. This paper is emphasis on the research of the ignition disturbing generation, which based on the common anti-disturbing measures and for the especial industrial local, proposed the design solution and methods of the EMC network topology model. The technique was verified through the experiments that the anti-disturbing ability of the E_ carburetor is greatly improved.

articleTitle: Simulation of the automatic coal flowing equipment based on Pro/E
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This modeling and simulation on a automatic pendular telescopic coal flowing equipment are introduced here based on the software Pro/E. There are five main components' modeling included the train and the railway are given through this software. Using the software, the simulated assembling is provided, and the moving relation is established about the practice working state. The reasonable drivers are presented in order to carry out the kinetic simulation about this machine.

articleTitle: Experimental measurement system based on CAN bus
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to achieve the data acquisition and resource sharing of laboratory equipments, a data acquisition system based on CAN bus is constituted. In this paper, acquisition interface circuit of each module is designed, and CANopen is used as the application layer protocol on the basis of CAN protocol. The communication between host computer and slave computer can be realized based on C kernel programming and LabVIEW interface. The data acquisition and communication of different equipments are implemented, including electronic scale, ultrasonic ranging module, compass module, infrared thermometer module and encoder. The integration of the system control and resource sharing are achieved through the remote control.

articleTitle: Characteristics of the destroyed masonry structures in Wenchuan Earthquake and its numeric simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Masonry structures are seriously destroyed in Wenchuan Earthquake. The mainly failure characteristics of the damaged houses and buildings are that integrity of the structures is poor, and the joint in the components is very weak. Collapse and destroyed of the whole structure are usually caused by collapse of the wall. Failure modes and its developing trend of the masonry structures under earthquake action are simulated by finite element method in this paper. Results show: Reliability of masonry structure is determined by the strength of itself. Capacities of collapse resistance can be strengthened by improving integrity. The stiffness is a key role, but the ductility is difficult to be displayed. Integrity of masonry building with structure column and ring girder is increased, and its capacity is also improved. The strength of first story would be increased.

articleTitle: Analysis of shear wall formwork burst in construction
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article analyzes the reasons for formwork burst which appeared on the shear wall of the formwork construction process, the formwork and formwork components were compared with model checking, according to current national standards and give an advice on the proposed shear wall construction process formwork.

articleTitle: Strength and fatigue analysis for automotive pedal based on CAE
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The pedal is one of the most important parts assuring the safety and comfort of automotive. This paper adopts FEM (Finite Element Method) analysis the brake pedal assembly according to the industry standard. In order to obtain the strength of the brake pedal and on the base of the strength result of FEM the fatigue analysis is carried out to verify the strength whether meet the industry standard. At last, some experiments are conducted on the product designed by this method and the experimental results show that no fatigue failure happens.

articleTitle: Study on the concrete carbonation depth based on genetic neural network
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The influence factor of concrete carbonation is complex and changeable, thus the dates' discrete degree is bigger through the tests or engineering observation. It also leads to the precision of statistical analysis unsatisfactorily. This paper proposes a kind of method of the genetic neural network to calculate the concrete carbonation depth. The results show that the model of concrete carbonation depth changes with time by using the genetic neural network does not need to precise mathematical and physical model, and more precise result will be got.

articleTitle: PLC control system design of large gantry planer based on variable-frequency drives
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Traditional gantry planer employs direct current drive and relay-contactor control system. It has disadvantages such as miscellaneous control, harder on system maintenance. Siemens M4 controller is used for reconstructing the main driving system and feeding system of gantry planer. Traditional direct current driving is changed into alternative current driving by converters. Parameter control based on modern controller is achieved with the design computation and parameters selecting and setting. According to the control requirements, inputs and outputs distribution of the front-end programmable logic controller is drawn out and control process based on variable-frequency drives for gantry planer is designed. New system has many advantages such as more flexibility, easier maintenance, higher reliability and lower resource consumption. The whole system is simplicity on a great deal.

articleTitle: The stability analysis of the protection pillar under railway coal mining
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: When coal mining under the railway, the surface deformation caused by coal mining must be less than the railway allowed. The stability of the protection pillar is an important factor that affects nearly the surface deformation. Therefore, the stability of protection pillar is the key to coal mining under the railway. In this paper we determine the relationship between the coal pillar width and protection pillar stability through the protection pillar stress distribution and stress concentration analysis, and we also study the impact of the roof subsidence in different width of protection pillar by FLAC3D numerical simulation software. So put forward three kinds of schemes, in order to draw the reasonable width of coal protection pillars by comparative analysis. The safe of the railway and good economic can be achieved.

articleTitle: An application study of EAN.UCC bar code identification system in the quality of agricultural products traceability
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: At present, the agricultural product quality safety problems, quality of agricultural products traceability system of agricultural products quality system is an important element. In this paper, Agricultural products (food) safety traceability system and the quality of the basic requirements traceability information coding were discussed and EAN.UCC bar code identification system in the agricultural (food) quality in the application of traceability were studied. The quality of fast traceability system model needs a unique code to complete structural design.

articleTitle: Critical analysis of LOFT in the renewal of Chinese contemporary cities
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Presently, China is developing flourishingly on the path of urbanization. Renewal and circulation of the city are booming at such an unprecedented speed that industry remains are constantly faced with being demolished or destroyed. Loft, as a promising and new style of architecture, has become one of the significant ways of dealing with the modernization of industry remains. The style of loft has experienced a process, from the initial "pure art" to the present "commercial trend". It has long been favored by many people, but there are still repeated constructions which follow the loft trend blindly. Based on the study of the origins and characteristics of the style of loft, this paper is designed to draw a conclusion of the problems that we are supposed to pay attention to during the development of loft, and to provide references for the study of reconstruction model of industry remains during the process of urban renewal.

articleTitle: Internal friction of nanocrystalline Ni and alloys of Ni and Fe
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Internal friction results from the wastage of the mechanical energy inside materials. It is very sensitive to microstructure and dynamic change process happening in the materials. The major work in this paper is to measure the internal friction of nanocrystalline Ni and alloys of Ni and Fe in low and high temperature by means of the frequency modulation apparatus (FMAA-1). And several relaxation peaks were also found and discussed.

articleTitle: Simulation and factor experiment analysis for cooling and heating load of terminal based on TRNSYS
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Make the dynamic load simulation using TRNSYS as energy simulation software. Analyze the characteristics of load of the Airport Terminal on heating season, and air-conditioning season. Analyze the characteristics of maximum cooling load and maximum heating load and compared with the different areas. Do multi factor experiment using Minitab as data analysis software. Find out the main factors of the cold load in office area, airport lounge and inner zone, and sort the order of the importance of them. Through this work, we get a better understanding of unique characteristics of the Airport Terminal, and hope to give a guide to load design on the Airport Terminal and to the energy-saving acceptance.

articleTitle: Grounding device of structural analysis and discussion
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper analyzes the structure of grounding device, comprising grounding the concept of the general requirements for grounding, common ground and independent ground, ground and a little more grounded, grounding and bonding ring. Including a detailed analysis of the specific composition of various characteristics of grounding devices and applicable conditions.

articleTitle: An experimental study on wheat husk ash affect the strength of mortar
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper, firstly, introduces wheat husk ash, the processing method and describes it's chemical composition and properties. The paper then pays special attention to the effect of wheat husk ash on the strength of mortar. And the testing results are presented and analyzed. At last, the authors of the paper give out their discussion and suggestions on using wheat husk ash.

articleTitle: The influence of the structure of rotor cage bottom plates on the flow-field performance of O-Sepa classifier
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The cage rotor is an important component of O-Sepa classifier. The different construction of case rotor affect directly on characteristic of classifier flow field. The structure is analyzed and numerical value model is built on O-Sepa classifier in the paper. FLUED soft is applied in the study. In order to investigate the effect of structural variations of bottom plate on flow field characteristics, four O-Sepa classifier models with different type bottom plate are analyzed and simulated by CFD. It is found that the different bottom plates have different flow field characteristics around the bottom plate. The structural variations of the bottom plate have some effect on the flow field in the annular region too.

articleTitle: Constructucting method of VIP and VMM based SoC verification environment
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: VIP and VMM-compliant code are reusable both during a project and on later designs. This paper describes the constructing method of Synopsys's VIP and VMM based SoC verification environment, and then takes the Interrupt Controller module as an example to present the designing method of derived environment. The functional coverage is 100% after simulating 90s. Finally, a traditional SoC verification environment was constructed for comparison. The comparison is based on the verification of Interrupt Controller module in the two environments. The result indicates that the traditional verification environment expends 2X code and 2.7X runtime compared to another. Thus it can be seen that the VIP and VMM based SoC verification environment presented in this paper is not only more flexible and reusable, but also helps achieve higher verification productivity while writing less code. Now the verification environment has been used in project.

articleTitle: Design and circuit implementation of a conjugate Lü chaotic system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to generate complex attractor of chaos, a new chaotic system is constructed chaos based on a presented chaotic system. The system constructed in this paper combines with the presented chaotic system to form a switchable chaotic system. The switchable chaotic system can change its behavior automatism from one to another via a switch selector. The system is implemented based on FPGA by EDA technology, experiment shows a good agree with simulation.

articleTitle: CO2 emission reduction through crucial industrial by-product exchange in an industrial area
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Industrial symbiosis (IS) in the existed industrial areas in Taiwan is just in the beginning. The main effort of this article is to examine the performances of CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission reduction through the crucial industrial by-product exchange within the case study Kuanyin industrial area. Life cycle analysis was used to evaluate CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission in each industrial sector in this case for further strategy suggestions. The waste acid etchants were identified as the crucial industrial by-product by screening the database of Industrial Waste Control Center subordinate to Taiwan Environmental Protection Administration. The reused acid etchants input in the etch process in manufacturing printed circuit boards avoided the CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> emission by 773 ton CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>e. The findings encourge ongoing industrial symbiosis programs of this area, and suggest including adjacent industrial districts into the symbiosis programs.

articleTitle: Design of an electromechanical actuator used in a torpedo
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: An electromechanical actuator design is presented in this paper. DSP controller TMS320F240 from TI is introduced to the system, and high performance DC motor and gears are used. For working under water the actuator has seal structures between parts connected to each other. The test results confirm that the design scheme of DSP controller based electromechanical actuator is feasible and the seal structures meet the requirements.

articleTitle: The test and study of Influencing the intensity of the solid excitant slag fly and ash Geopolymer
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The Geopolymer is new inorganic nonmetallic material in recent years to get up. This text was to the factor which influences fly ash Geopolymer cement strength carried on experimenting in great quantities, studying solid alkali stimulus quantity, fly ash quantity and specific surface area, protect system on the influence of the Geopolymer cement performance harden mechanism have been carried out on this topic.

articleTitle: Research on the hardware system of measurement on urban residential areas night light
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The article refer to the problems in which measurement about urban residential areas lighting, on the basis of collecting related data and results in the field, and adopt the methods of intersecting architecture, urban planning, automation, computers, developing a suit of "measurement hardware system of urban residential areas lighting based on a platform for remote control vehicle". The system can exactly and efficiently detect parameters such as illumination and brightness, at the same time, it can comprehensive and objective detect luminous environment, and supply technology endorsement on discovery for developing lighting standards of urban residential.

articleTitle: Experimental study on the thermal expansion coefficient of high-strength/performance concrete at early ages
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper the thermal expansion coefficient of high strength/performance concrete with water-cement ratio of 0.3 at early ages was measured more accurately by improving Yang Yang proposed method previously, in which the temperature change was given to concrete specimens in a lower temperature region from -1 to 5°C. The results showed that a good linear relationship exists between the strain and change of temperature, and the ascending line coincided approximately with the descending line, the influence of autogenous shrinkage was controlled effectively and could be neglected by the method; the coefficient of thermal expansion drops rapidly immediately after initial setting and reaches the minimum at about age of 1 day, then it rises again negligibly to 3 days and converges on a steady value.

articleTitle: Filter technique of variable frequency speed control system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper introduces a novel digital approach applied to a three-phase four-wire active power filter, which is made up of a three-phase four-leg voltage source converter. The controller just detects main current and DC side capacitor voltage and duty cycle of the switches can be calculated simply. This controller has fewer measurement, higher robustness and simpler calculation as comparing to traditional controllers. Simulation results verify that the active power filter with proposed controller can compensate the harmonics effectively.

articleTitle: Design of DC motor position servo controler and simulation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The design of A DC motor bodies for the implementation of three close loop control system is expatiated in this paper. On the basis of the speed regulating system in DC motor, the parameters of the location regulator are designed and adjusted based on the speed regulator and the current regulator using engineering design method in this system. The system is simulated in MATLAB. The simulation results show that the DC motor position servo system have better dynamic and static performance and better following performance.

articleTitle: Stamping of the Engineering Agricultural machinery parts
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Stamping forming is widely used in the production of engineering agricultural machinery parts because of high production rate, high and stable quality of stamping and low production cost. The contradiction was analyzed when engineering agricultural stamping was produced in more variety and small batch and the measures to resolve contradiction were proposed. Stamping structure optimization, adopting new technologies of rapid economic modeling to reduce the cost of mold design and manufacturing and using modern stamping production methods can effectively handle the relationship between production volume and new product development to mold manufacturing costs and production cycle. They have very important significance for the agricultural machinery manufacturing enterprises to improve product quality, strengthen enterprise management and increase economic efficiency.

articleTitle: Simulation of groundwater level variation of a rainfall-related landslide in Japan
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The seasonal rainfall and rainfall-induced variation of groundwater state is the main reason that can provoke the activities of crystalline schist landslide of Japan and even lead to the failure of landslide. Based on the long-term observation data on precipitation and groundwater level at a typical crystalline schist landslide, Zentoku landslide, a method of simulating groundwater level was proposed by designing a Tank model. By analyzing and comparing the actual groundwater data with the simulated results, it was proved that this method is reasonable and available to evaluate and predict the groundwater state of rainfall-related landslide.

articleTitle: Slope finite element generalized reliability algorithms
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Open pit slope stability analysis by the uncertainty existing in the instructions, put forward the need for reliability calculation, and calculation of reliability are discussed for the partial derivative function and the function does not converge to the finite element calculations software and functional problems caused by function argument there was a correlation between this issue and do a thorough study and proposed a new method that the reliability of the generalized finite element reliability. Principle and the use of partial least squares regression analysis of the performance function, to establish the reliability of finite element and generalized combination between the two. Not only simplify the calculation can play a role, and ensure accuracy. Finally, a practical example of a calculation of surface mine.

articleTitle: The residuated lattice properties of MP-Algebras
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, we discuss the properties of the t-norm operation induced by the implication operation of MP-algebra. We prove that an MP-algebra is also a residuated lattice and the R-implication and the S-implication are identity on MP-algebras. In the end, we get another equivalence defination of MP-algebra descripted in the language of t-norm operation.

articleTitle: Study and field application on broken-down tecnology of acoustic and negative pressure
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Due to the damage and sanding of the formation, the oil productivity is severely affected. The applicability of the conventional flowing technology with gassy water is very limited. The effect of broken-down is not very satisfying. In order to solve this problem above mentioned, this paper proposed the Acoustic Assistant drainage and Broken-down Technology. This technology combines the Acoustic Assistant drainage with the flowing technology with gassy water together. Through the common function of acoustic vibration and flowing with gassy water, the sweeping areas are enlarged, at the same time, the back-drainage of the formation is strengthened, which makes the ultimate effect of broken-down is improved. This technology has been widely applied in the GUDAO oilfield, SHENGLI, the effect is obviously better than that of the conventional flowing technology with gassy water. It has a good effect on new wells, the wells with long time shut-in and the wells with low productivity.

articleTitle: Analysis and optimization strategy on sunlight environment of residential area in Harbin
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper takes the typical multi-storey determinant residential area of Harbin as the research object, makes an analysis of existing problems through the residential sunlight environment simulation, and proposes the optimized environment strategies from the aspects of building distance, building height and building facade styles. This paper also provides the basic analysis data to improve the quality of the implementation of local relevant laws and regulations. At the same time it has positive significance of constructing a healthy living environment and building energy-saving residential community.

articleTitle: Analysis and prevention of casting cracks of small tractor gearbox
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper has discussed the small tractor transmission, which is uneven thickness and box part of complex structure. The small tractor transmission appears several reasons of cold cracks for in the casting process. This paper proposed prevention measures and solutions in order to greatly reduce the rejection rate, by the process, physical and chemical analysis, core materials testing, tensile strength of gray cast iron. This method achieved very good results.

articleTitle: Research of AC adjusting speed system based on DTC and neural network supervision control
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The conventional direct torque control system in low speed condition has the larger motor torque ripple, that makes the system's low-speed performance poor. To address this problem, we use neural network supervisory controller to replace the original PID controller based on the traditional direct torque control system, and create a system model by the SimPowerSystems of MATLAB software. This system is simulated on the MATLAB / Simulink simulation platform ,and the simulation results are compared with the original system's. Simulation results show that this method can effectively reduce the torque ripple of the direct torque control system in low-speed condition and improve the system's low-speed performance.

articleTitle: Analysis and computational methods for cascaded networks system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: For electrical networks with equal number of port each side, its various parameter equations were given, and merging algorithm for cascaded network was expressed in terms of T-parameter equation. Resembling structural mechanics analysis and the solutions for control system response, the recurrence method based on T-parameter equations, and the finite element method based on Y-parameter equations were presented for cascaded networks system.

articleTitle: Performance experimental evaluation of compound modified asphalt by pyrophosphate and crumb rubber
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, The chemic modification as grafting polymerization reactivity by several direction experiments which pyrophosphate and crumb rubber was used as additives. The function of compound modification was improved asphalt performances such as penetration, softening point, ductility. As the result shows, after modifying pyrophosphate, the softening point increase, Performance indicators of asphalt were improved significantly. It suggested the dosage bound of pyrophosphate and crumb rubber in compound modification experiments.

articleTitle: Design of step motor control system based on AT89C51
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The control system of step motor is designed based on AT89C51 single chip. Driving circuit and software of speed control system is designed. The working principle and driving circuit of step motor were expatiated emphatically. The control system has high precision of control, and is simple with fewer components and higher reliability.

articleTitle: Comparison and selection on scheme of tunnel construction under soft plastic-flow stratum
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on Nanjing NO. 1 project Gulou-Xuwu subway practice, this paper focus on subway construction technology under great and changeable section, soft plastic-flow stratum condition. Results indicate that it is effective on controlling the ground drop when adopting sidesteps method with shed advancing and injecting.

articleTitle: Influence of cold arm thickness on mechanical property of U-shaped polycrystalline silicon microelectrothermal actuator
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A new method which just increases cold arm thickness of U-shaped polycrystalline silicon microelectrothermal actuator was proposed to efficiently amplify normal contact force caused by a rigid object placed away from the free end of the actuator.
