Finite element simulation results demonstrated that this method is better than the actuator array approach to amplify the normal contact force. As far as manufacturing difficulty and material consumption are concerned, the presented method is also more competitive than the array pattern. Considering amplifying effect on normal contact force, maximum equivalent stress on hot arm and equivalent stress at juncture of hot arm and cold arm, an actuator with hot arm thickness 2µm and cold arm thickness about 7µm is the relatively optimal configuration.

articleTitle: Analysis of cost-benefit of green roof in Xi'an
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the analysis of the actual research data, this paper obtained the construction costs of the simple roof greening and the roof garden greening in Xi'an , and the ecological value of per unit area of the green roof .And, this paper analyzed the economic feasibility of the green roofs in Xi'an standing point of cost-benefit analysis.

articleTitle: The status of indoor air contamination concentration model and evapotranspiration prediction method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Due to the influence of pollutants on human health, this paper introduced the status of pollutants concentration prediction models, including excellent mixing reactor model, mass balance model, and mixture factor model. And then the method which can predict distribution and concentration of pollutants was analyzed.

articleTitle: The recursive algorithm for Riccati matrix and the equivalent action
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Linear quadratic optimal control and Kalman filtering problem can be described by Hamiltonian dual equations uniformly. Based on the T-parameter solution of Hamiltonian dual equations, the recursive formulas for Riccati matrix and the equivalent action were deduced. The backward and forward recursive algorithms were presented for the nodal variables of multiple segments system, and the recursive algorithms can be applied in linear quadratic optimal control and Kalman filtering problem.

articleTitle: The study on the test generation of digital circuit on the basis of the GA and the ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A kind of algorithm about the test generation of digital circuit is provided. This method is on the basis of the GA and the ant colony algorithm. Through the rotation call of the two kinds of algorithm, the test generation vector is optimized. From experimental results, this algorithm is feasible.

articleTitle: Design of a high gain circularly polarized microstrip antenna
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Circularly polarized microstrip antennas catch more and more eyes in military applications with its low profile, conformality, easy integration and good concealment, etc. This paper provides from a practical viewpoint a design of small-sized compact wide-band circularly polarized microstrip antenna with an dual capacitively coupled feeds. The antenna has the advantages of simple feeding ang band width,ideal for a circularly polarized design.

articleTitle: Gravity distribution modulus calculation method of the belt conveyor with horizontal bend
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: For making more rational design of the belt conveyor with horizontal bend , force analysis about gravity distribution modulus of belt and materials are divided into three parts. An important factor of force analysis is gravity distribution modulus. Using the integral principle solve area of the parabola of Material on the cross-section. Derived a precise formula about gravity distribution modulus.

articleTitle: Development and application of software for ultrasonic testing on service stress of concrete
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: On the basis of ultrasonic testing technology for testing service stress of concrete and with the aid of design principles of software engineering and object-oriented programming method, we combine Visual Basic and Fortran, the two kinds of programming languages, to develop a software system for processing the correlation of ultrasound and stress of concrete. This system has a rich graphic interactive environment and friendly interface which is easy to operate. So fast batch processing of great quantities of testing data can be realized and the testing efficiency is greatly improved.

articleTitle: Design of the new multifunctional charge device system for taxi
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A new multifunctional charge device system for taxi was designed by using the simple 74LS series chips as basic device. In this system, monolithic integrated circuits need not be used. It overcame the deficiencies of the traditionally charge device with the cheaper cost, without programming, and with lower energy consumption. Actually, the only five volts direct current was needed for system running. It can not only solve such problems as delayed for waiting but also the inconvenience of upgrading function and preventing the crash of the charge device. Meanwhile the reliability was largely improved.

articleTitle: Wind speed prediction based on Grey Markov model
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to improve the accuracy of wind speed prediction, a model that Grey model combine with Markov model is given. Based on the time-ordered and stochastic volatility of the wind speed sequence, using the modeling method of Gray prediction and the characteristics of Markov model which can forecast the stochastic and volatile data, the Grey Markov model for wind speed forecasting is established. The method uses MATLAB to model the Gray model, and the Markov model is used to correct the predictive value of Gray prediction, finally can get the result of prediction. Through the wind speed prediction of a wind farm, the results show that Grey Markov forecasting has high accuracy and it can preferably predict wind speed.

articleTitle: The design of automatic servo mechanism for the density of the weft knitted fabric high-precision vision measuring system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The density of weft knitted fabric is its important structural parameters. Its measurement is vital for the control of product weight and quality. This paper introduces the design of automatic servo mechanism for the density of the weft knitted fabric high-precision vision measuring system. The servo mechanism offers the vision sensor the natural state and equation of state of tension of the weft knitted fabric by the force sensor and displacement transducer. Under the two states, the servo mechanism can collect information and measure accurately.

articleTitle: Study on a new space pattern of gymnasium on natural ventilation and thermal comfort
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With people's general awareness of passive cooling technology increased, natural ventilation in gymnasium gets more and more concerned. In this paper, a new space gymnasium pattern is conceived and analyzed by the use of CFD software with other classic gymnasium patterns, thus their ventilation and indoor thermal comfort condition can be simulated and compared, which provides an scientific basis for architects when they are designing gymnasium.

articleTitle: Simplified research on pier of simply-supported long bridge subjected to braking force
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Through monolithic analysis on track and bridge structure, the author finds bridge length range and working features of simply-supported long bridge's piers subjected to braking force. According to mechanical features, the simplified calculation model is established. By dynamical analysis and calculation, the dynamical coefficient and displacement response curve at top of pier are gained. The author deduces the ratio of braking force born by long bridge's mid substructure to braking force on track surface in a girder span. The author also deduces variable curves of bridge length subjected to braking force.

articleTitle: Temperature compensation of high-precision I/F converter based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By the theoretical analysis of charge balance type I/F converter, the main factors of the I/F converter scale factor temperature drift is found out. For the scale factor temperature drift, a temperature compensation method of the converter based on BP neural network is put forward. Through the temperature compensation, the average temperature coefficient of the converter scale factor can be controlled within 0.5ppm/°C.

articleTitle: Repair welding of the crack on the large steel casting
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper is about disposal of at the work surface of carbon steel casting supporting roller in the large rotator. Analyzing solderability of supporting roller. Discussing usual problem in the weld process and producing detail process method of solder. Through practical validation, the method is available, which has referential function for solder analogous with steel casting of the large rotator.

articleTitle: Analysis of passive intermodulation based on Taylor polynomial
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A circuit model including passive intermodulation source is set up based on Taylor polynomial method. The reverse and forward PIM power is predicted from this model. Superposition of multiple PIM souces is presented. Analysis indicates that the forward PIM measurement gives the worst case performace of a device with multiple PIM sources.

articleTitle: Study of LED image detecting based on detail holding adaptive median filter
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The algorithm of detail holding adaptive median filter is been bringed forward. Using the sub-filteration window with directivity and setting the filter's sensitivity by threshold, the differentials of pixel gradation and median is been caculated and the consistency of pixels in window are been judged. The shape and scale of window based on the condition of noise influence are been dynamics adjusted. This algorithm can efficiencyly wipe off the pulse noise and mottle by experiment and increase the precision of follow-up image handling and analyzing.

articleTitle: Analysis of one-dimensional thermal consolidation of saturated soil under different thermal loading
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Bused on a one-dimensional thermal consolidation formulation of saturated soil, problems of one-dimensional thermal consolidation of saturated soil under different thermal loading were investigated. The analytical solutions of excess pore water pressure, temperature increase and the settlement of ground are derived by the method of partial differential equation. The one-dimensional thermal consolidation behaviour of saturated soil was analyzed considering several wok conditions. And it was also dicussed by comparing with the consolidation theory of Terzaghi. The results show that the behaviour of excess pore-water pressure and the settlement of ground is affected differently under different thermal Loading in the process of thermal consolidation. In contrast, the temperature affects the settlement of ground more significant then excess pore-water pressure.

articleTitle: The single closed-loop direct control of levitation force for bearingless permanent magnet synchronous motor
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper the polar-coordinate mathematical model of levitation force on bearingless permanent-magnet synchronous motor was deduced. The single closed-loop direct control of levitation force was proposed based on the mathematical model deduction and combined with space vector pulse with modulation algorithm. The traditional closed-loop control of levitation current was ignored using the single closed-loop direct control algorithm. The whole levitation control system was simplified. The simulation results show the proposed control strategy can enhance system dynamic performance and achieve stable levitation under rated speed condition.

articleTitle: The tangential stiffness matrix of Mooney-Rivlin model strain energy function-based rubber material in finite element method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The tangential constitutive matrix is derived in the paper for the nonlinear finite element computation of rubber material as the strain energy function is expressed by Mooney-Rivlin model. The stress and strain of constitutive relation are separately expressed by Piola-Kirchhoff stress and Green strain with Lagrange description. As the incompressibility considered, the strain energy function is decoupled into volume -preserving and dilatational parts. The tangential stiffness matrix is then attained by use of the tangential constitutive matrix. The stiffness matrix is developed to nonlinear finite element computation of hyperelastic material.

articleTitle: Development and implementation of electrode management system in mold making shop
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: It is common knowledge that tens of, even hundreds of different electrodes may be used for making an averagely complicated plastic injection mold. The traditional electrode management mode which mainly relied on hand has been unable to meet the requirements of enterprise development. The paper has introduced that the development of electrode management system in mold making shop of B/S architecture mode based on ASP.NET and SQL Sever technology by using object oriented component ideology. Finally, it illustrates the system in detail by means of one of its modules.

articleTitle: Western architecture: A history of design approach
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The western architectural history is not just theory, design approach. In this paper, through the analysis of the instances in the renaissance, modernism and post-modernism historical stage, reveals that there has been a design approach clue in the history of western architecture. Inspire to use of historical research ideas to establish some design approaches.

articleTitle: Design of the crystallization monitoring system based on CAN bus
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: It is given that the design proposal of the crystallization monitoring system based on CAN bus. The system is composed with the crystallization vibration controller and IPC. The MC9S12DG128 MCU is the core of the crystallization vibration controller, and carrying out data acquisition and automatic control of crystallization vibrating stage, the measured data and status information can be send to the IPC by CAN bus. It is achieved that the status of mold on-site monitoring, control, parameter modification and alarm functions.

articleTitle: The development of 6 DOF driving simulation system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Developing rapidly of automobile industry have been made lacking of driving training resource and the bad quality of driving training. To solve the problem, the 6 DOF driving simulation system are deeply discussed in this paper. It have been built a simulation model for driving operating system and given a algorithm for determining the automobile's position in space based on introducing the systematic structure and working principle for the 6 DOF driving simulation system, elaborated the data acquisition system based on the SCM and 6 DOF moving simulation system based on electric servo controlling. The experiment indicates that the system can simulate well the real driving situation on vision, hearing and feeling. The driving simulation system have gotten economic and social benefits.

articleTitle: Analysis of motorized spindle's thermal property based on thermal contact
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A finite element method is employed to analyze the temperature field in thermal equilibrium state. The effect of cooling system and rotation speed of motorized spindle on temperature rise is also simulated to reveal the nonlinear characteristics of temperature field. The experiment has proved that the finite element method is feasible and efficient, that will provide a theoretical foundation for design and optimization of motorized spindle.

articleTitle: The studying on the automation and control system of unloading line of tipper in PLC
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: It is emphasized to study the work process and craftwork flow on unloading line of tipper in this paper, and all-directions automatic controls of them are made. It is designed that the automatic control system of unloading line and supervisory control system with perfect functions, which may monitor unloading line at any time. By using S7 300 PLC as controller and In touch as monitoring software, work efficiency of unloading line will be increased and work environment will be improved.

articleTitle: Research and application based on RK512 protocal in Impeller Coal Feeder
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Paper introduces the frame format of RK512 protocol and SIEMENS point-to-point communication module CP341. According to the control requirement of the Impeller Coal Feeder, proposed the design mind and control flow chart. According to the call of protocol block, paper provided the data extending of the RK512 Protocol. And according to field programming, it is verified that the module CP341 has the advantages of low-cost, high stability and practicability when it be used with the third party equipment under the RK512 protocol for communication.

articleTitle: Landfill leachate treatment by electrocoagulation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Electrocoagulation was used to treat landfill leachate effluent from biochemical process. The influence factors including polar plate material, pH, polar plate space, current intensity and electro coagulation time were investigated. The optimum condition was using iron as polar plate, polar plate space 20mm, pH 7∼9, current intensity 3A, electrocoagulation time 30min. At this condition, CODcr removal rate was 73.9%, ammonia removal rate 64.3% and BOD<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf> removal rate was 49.2%.

articleTitle: Measurement and control for ball mill system based on information fusion technology
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Aiming at the disadvantage of control method for ball mill, a new measure and control system for ball mill fill level is proposed which is based on information fusion technology. Firstly, the relationship between fill level and process parameters is researched respectively based on mechanism models. Then, the sensors for information fusion are chosen and the device for shell vibration data sampling is introduced. The information fusion for fill level is researched based on LS-SVM algorithm. Finally, a fuzzy control method for ball mill load is proposed on the basis of fill level measurement. Practical application results demonstrate that the fill level measurement and control can be realized by the system effectively.

articleTitle: Development of marine main engine remote control system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: On the basis of analyzing the system demand, define the specific functions, interfaces, communication technology of each module, choose the CAN bus as the communication technology between the modules to construct the remote control system, and then establish the remote control system. By using MC9S12XEP100 single chip as the core microcontroller in the remote control system, corresponding designs of the remote control system in diesel engine have been made, including the selection of MCU, analog, digital input and output circuits, serial communication interface and redundant CAN bus communication interface circuits, etc., give full consideration of electromagnetic compatibility and environmental adaptation in practice. In order to improve the portability and real-time ability of the system, the software system is completely designed by modular design method. Debugging the hardware and software with varieties of debugging tools and verify the rationality of the system.

articleTitle: Study on attitude measurement in gyro-free inertial navigation system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Through analysing the measurement principle of the accelerometer-based gyro-free inertial navigation system, this paper designed a kind of easy to engineering realization of 9 accelerometer configuration scheme, studied attitude measurement principle based on this configuration.Through analysing the acceleration in the carrier movement, obtained angular velocity and linear acceleration.

articleTitle: The application of MATLAB in the Moire method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The Moire method is a new experimental stress analytical method that determines the strain field or displacement field using interferometric fringes produced by grating. The strain and the displacement are calculated by central lines of fringes while fringes obtained by experiment are blur and coarse affecting the calculation accuracy. To portray the lines by hand is affected seriously by the human factors while to process images by programming with software C+,C++ and VB takes a long time. Utilize MATLAB with strong image processing function. It is a convenient and accurate method to utilize MATLAB with strong image processing function. The article discusses the application of MATLAB in the Moire method through the open PMMA ring experiment.

articleTitle: Analysis of thrust and push speed based on BCF advance mode
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The research of robot fish propulsion system has been the focus of the underwater robot research field all the time and two ways are mainly employed to produce thrust: the body or caudal fin propulsion (BCF) and the middle fins or paired fins propulsion (MPF). This paper is based on BCF advance mode and analyses a new underwater robot fish based on three-joint crescent caudal propulsion system, which is designed from the angle of thruster. Compared with the previous robot fish, it has the advantages of high efficiency, high mobility and low noise.

articleTitle: The study of large-scale campus planning methods
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: From the perspective of urban design, this article analyses the existing problems in recent campus planning in China, researches on the large-scale campus planning theory based on density, scale, pedestrian system and open space, it also puts forward several large-scale campus planning methods based on the practice.

articleTitle: Study on attenuation characteristics of stress wave in joint rock based on damage mechanics
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the damage tensor is calculated based on damage theory. And the condition of stress waves diffusing in wall rock is calculated by applying the analytic method of stress waves diffusing in anisotropic rock to wall rock. The horizontal and vertical diffusing curves in two kinds of wall rock are obtained.

articleTitle: Modeling and experimental analysis on the transverse nonlinear vibration of metal belt transmission with permanent magnets
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Due to the permenent magnets on the pulley, metal belt in longitudinal motions is influenced by magnet in the system of metal belt transmission with permanent magnets. If we view the magnetic force as an external stimuli, it will result in transverse forced vibrantion of the metal belt. This article used the Kelvin viscoelastic model at first place, and founded the dynamic model of transverse nonlinear forced vibration in the metal belt transmission with permanent magnets, then, made a numerical simulation analysis through ANSYS, finally, by experiment, analyzed the dynamic response chracteristics of metal belt and the influence of the nonlinear.

articleTitle: Diameter protocol analysis and applications
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As mobile communication systems and the rapid development of Internet technology, in order to provide more variety of services, the integration with kind of networks has become a necessity. This is urgent need of the new-generated AAA (authentication, authorization and accounting) technology based on IP. Diameter protocol as a new AAA protocol will play an important role in next generation network. First detailed analysis of the diameter protocol, then IMS Cx interface base on the diameter protocol as an typical application are fulfilled designed.

articleTitle: Prevention and control for water hazard in Fenxiao coal mine
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to current threat situation of Fenxiao coal mine that general suffered jeopardize with five factors including goaf water, abandoned mine water, surface water, alluvial water and area of aquifer water, beside, based on typical case of water hazard in recently years, various water hazard characteristics and hazard rating of coal mine safety were illustrated. Combined current situation of prevent and control of water to the mine work, reasons of water hazard and main problems in prevent and control of water were analyzed. In order to prevent serious water hazard accident, several concrete prevent ways and strategies, which taking strategy of prevention priority, improving exploration approaches, perfecting prevention institution, reinforcing technical management and valuing project input, should be conducted. These above ways and strategies should be aimed at different circumstances of water hazard in Fenxiao coal mine.

articleTitle: The analysis of accident black spot at the intersection of NO. 320 state road crossed with Lingjia Bridge
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: NO. 320 state road is crossed with Lingjia Bridge, and there are frequent accidents recent years at the intersection. In the article, we make the statistics of the characteristics related to the period accidents occurred, and do further research of the causes. Then compared with accident black spots in other parts, we find their similarities and respective characteristics. And we conduct on-site investigation and analysis of existing risks, to provide the basis for the improvement measures.

Author Keywords: Related to the Period Accidents Occurred Accident Causes

articleTitle: A hydroelectric station intake construction simulation of high slope excavation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By using the finite element method calculation model, the construction of high rock slope excavation analysis and simulation of construction process simulation, and with the monitoring results were analyzed. Feature points on the slope of the calculated displacement of the outer section layout view is consistent with the measured displacement, the bolt stress gauge measured and calculated in terms of size and rules are basically the same.

articleTitle: Research on art graduation design exhibition based on Virtual reality
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper mainly researched the meaning and method of art graduation design exhibition which held every year in our college of art and design. Developed virtual model of art graduation design exhibition carrying through virtual scene design, virtual interact design, later stage optimizing. Finally realized the art graduation design exhibition based on virtual reality. The result show that VR technology has taken very much important play in art graduation design exhibition and provide new ideas and techniques for it.

articleTitle: The current situation and development strategy of photovoltaic industry in China
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Developing photovoltaic industry is not only an inevitable choice for China which responds to the trend of new resources, but also an objective necessary for optimizing resource structure, fostering new industry and facilitating industry transferring. This text analyses the current situation and dilemma of China's photovoltaic industry, and advances the industry development strategy.

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Analysis of comparing between Tokyo and Paris urban planning
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Retracted.

articleTitle: Research on alternating projection algorithm in evaluation of urban space quality
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Quality of urban space needs assessment to establish evaluation index system, and then summarize and evaluate the indicator. Based on the assessment of urban spatial quality of the actual situation, the article established the urban space quality evaluation system for quality assessment of urban space. This article also discussed the issue of a special aggregate index, and its practical significance is not in advance, but the summary coefficient calculated based on the sample. In this paper, the interaction between convex projection methods gives the least squares estimation model, using EM algorithm gives the maximum likelihood estimation, thus the quality of evaluation index system of urban space provides a new analysis method.

articleTitle: Studies on anti-dip layered rock mass high slope stability model test
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: According to layered structure of anti-dip rock slope deformation and failure mechanism of the two-dimensional and three-dimensional centrifuge model test, experimental results show that the correct choice of anchor position can inhibit the transfer of the form of toppling failure to give full play the role of anchor, and foot of the slope layered structure of the anti-orientation and stability of slope is critical.

articleTitle: The covitation erosion behavior of copper alloy in the corrosive medium
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The cavitation of ZQAl9-4-4-2 nickel-iron-manganese aluminum brone has been studied in 2.4% NaCl solution. Microstructure of it has been observed with scanning electron microscopy, transmission electron microscopy. The results show that micro-cracks formed in boundary of the α/к phase first, and borizontal expansion easily. And between the second phase and boundary, twin grain gates were formed, which strengthen the matrix and enhanced the ability of the material resistance to cavitation erosin.

articleTitle: Design on broad-band dual-layer microstrip antenna
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, a dual-layer micro-strip antenna worked at 1.268GHz was designed and analyzed. High and low stacked patches, dual-layer dielectric materials and probe-fed structure were introduced into the design of the antenna. The high patch was used as the incentive patch, and the low patch was used as the coupled patch. Prototype of the antenna had been constructed and tested based on the calculated results of HFSS. The simulation results indicated that the frequency channels of the antenna was 1.268GHz, the bandwidth of the micro-strip antenna achieved 35MHz, and the gain achieved 6dB.

articleTitle: Study on richards model in the prediction of wharf foundation settlement
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the actual measurement data in 10 field testing wharf foundation sites, the curve fitting of foundation settlement versus time curves was carried out, and had a prediction of foundation settlement. Aiming at the settlement characteristics of wharf foundation, Richards mathematical model was selected. The fitting results of 10 field measurement data with the model showed that the fitting precision was high, the correlativity coefficients R was from 0.97191∼0.99950, the average value was 0.99087. The fitting effect with the model was better than the hyperbolic model. The average value of absolute value of error between prediction value and actual measurement value was 4.17196%, and especially, was 1.31328% in the tail of fitting curves. The following conclusions can be drawn that the Richards mathematical model have good adaptability and it is accurate and credible for fitting of foundation settlement versus time curves, and corresponding fitting equations can be used to forecast settlement of wharf foundation.

articleTitle: Study on decolorization of yeast wastewater using ferric chloride
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Polishing treatment of yeast wastewater by ferric chloride was investigated in this study. Main parameters of the coagulated effluent, such as color, COD and residual turbidity, were measured and molecular weight, size distribution, and charge property were characterized. The results show that final pH is the most influential factor of coagulation efficiency using ferric chloride with the optimum pH in the range of 4-5. Under the optimal conditions, color and COD removal efficiencies were up to 86% and 96%, respectively.

articleTitle: Trend analysis and prediction of mine earthquake of Pingdingshan coal mining area
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Mine earthquake is one type of the mine dynamic phenomena that threats the safety production of mine.with the mining depth increasing, the frequency and intensity of the mine earthquake are increasing in the mine, which bring the huge stress to safety production. According to the record of mine earthquake provided by Pingdingshan Seismological Bureau, analysed the b-value sequential characteristic and energy creep trend of the mine earthquake about Pingdingshan coal mining area with seismology and statistical method, revealed mine earthquake frequency and intensity trend of Pingdingshan coal mining area in the future; Fit ML-lgN linear curve of mine earthquak by the method of minimum square, and predicted the largest magnitude of the mine earthquake which may occur in Pingdingshan coal mining area in the future.

articleTitle: Homer-dixon's environmental security theory: Analysis and enlightenments to the development and management of international rivers in China
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Homer-Dixon revealed the causal relationship among population growth, environmental scarcity, social adaption and violent conflict. The theory plays an important role in the application of the development and management of international rivers in China. In order to prevent and avoid inter-state conflicts caused by environmental security issues in international rivers, the key of social adaption is to increase the efficiency of environmental cooperation and management in the process of development and management of international rivers.

articleTitle: Design and kinematic analysis on vacuum-chuck automatic-grasping mechanism
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A new type of automatic grasping mechanism has been designed. Kinematic analysis on the mechanism has been done. Its application in automatic machine grasping rubber of table-tennis bat is introduced.

articleTitle: Dual adaptive predictive functional control of boiler deaerator system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: For the deaerator non-linear, time-varying large delay, and model features dual use of a class of adaptive predictive functional control algorithm, the use of dual control to adjust the existing adaptive control law to obtain information on unknown parameters and to effectively suppress the strong coupling caused by controlling the amount of volatility. The simulation shows that the algorithm is a simple computation, robustness, stronger controls of higher quality control methods, the deaerator system using this algorithm than the conventional system has a superior performance.

articleTitle: Dynamic weighing system for mining shovel based on sensors network technique
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In view of the weakness of present weighing system for mining shovel, this paper raises a designing method for mining shovel weighing system based on wireless sensors network technique. The configuration of hardware of sensor node, and software design are introduced in detail. Experiments show that the system has high measuring precision, good stabilization and is easy to be installed.

articleTitle: Application of fault tree analysis for fault diagnosis in screw pump
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: As the critical equipment to achieve continuous production of emulsion explosive, screw pump was also a major source of faults. Fault tree analysis (FTA) was introduced for the safety diagnosing of screw pump, the problem in front of emulsifier maintenance in the process of screw pump explosive production was solved, and the existing faults in fault tree were shown. Practice shown that the method has a better ability of fault diagnosis, it could offer a relative disposal measure of the fault and has a positive effect on preventing fateful production accident.

articleTitle: Research on cavitation flow in jet pump based on FLUENT
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Two dimensional flow field in the jet pump was computed by FLUENT software based on the body-fitted coordinate system. The compute model was divided into 10090 computing elements by GAMBIT software. Finite element method and k-ε double equation were used in the calculation. Boundary condition of pressure import and pressure export was calculated by SIMPLE method. It indicated that the flow field would emerge turbulence when the area ratio of cavitating flow was 10.9 in the jet pump. Strong vibration and high noise would generate when it appearing two-phase flow cavitation from outlet to end of the throat pipe. It provided a brief theoretical basis for researching and designing of jet pump.

articleTitle: Research on g-function of Camellia algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the finite field theory, a common matrix equation on g-function of S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>-box of Camellia algorithm is deduced, which is clear more than Camellia documents and very useful to understanding and using Camellia algorithm.

articleTitle: Based on the grey theory of a plane hydraulic system wear trend prediction methods
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Because the trend of wear increases with time lapsing, the grey system theories can accurately forecast the growing trend of the wear. This paper uses the model of GM(1,1) to forecast and analyze the wear trend of aircraft hydraulic system, and enumerates computing examples to validate the analysis results.

articleTitle: The application of μC/OS-II in welding machine control system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: On the base of introducing embedded system, the paper presents the method of porting open source embedded RTOS μ C/OS- II to DSP. It supplies the way of solving the important and difficult problems, such as open and shut of interrupt, switch of task. The system after porting is cut out and tested under multitask environment at last.

articleTitle: Regional expression of modern architecture technology
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: From the way of modern technology and construction of two regional levels, combined with the development of many outstanding architectural example of modern architecture are summarized in the technical creation of the regional expression used to analyze the regional expression of several construction techniques Important factor.To contribute to regional when the expression of modern technology in the practical application, and to obtain useful to modern architectural design inspiration.

articleTitle: Desulfovibrio desulfuricans treatment of acid mine wastewater when the sodium lactate is as carbon source
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The experiment using sodium lactate as carbon source and natural depressions for the reactor, deal with mine drainage by adding to Desulfovibrio desulfuricans and explore the treatment effect under different conditions. Results show that: reductive is more fully when water depth is bigger; the ideal inoculum is 10%; the initial pH and the value of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2-</sup> both impact the removal rate; temperature has a big impact on Desulfovibrio desulfuricans treatment of Acid Mine Waste as well.

articleTitle: Study on the dynamic equilibrium of control system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The steady-state of control system, dynamic equilibrium state and the singular solution of corresponding motion equation, which are three concepts produced in different domain, are considered as different appellation of the one concept in this paper. Based on this consideration, the expression of steady-state output of linear time-invariant system with analytic function input is deduced conveniently, and it is proved that the correspondingly periodical steady-state output exists for the system with the input which can be expanded as Fourier series. Moreover, the above conclusion can be naturally extended to the non-linear system.

articleTitle: Discussion of influencing factors in electrochemical oxidation treatment of landfill leachate
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Treatment of landfill leachate is a worldwide problem, and electrochemical methods can deal with it effectively. When the landfill leachate is treated by electrochemical methods , besides voltage, current, plate spacing and pH should be controlled , the electrode materials, CI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> concentration , Fe<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>, Fe<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> additive amount and the dosage of aeration should also be controlled These factors on the leachate treatment effect can also have an important impact. According to water conditions , single factor experiments and orthogonal experiments should be used to select the most suitable electrode materials, CI<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-</sup> concentration, Fe<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2+</sup>, Fe<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> dosing quantity and the dosage of aeration , in order to achieve the best removal efficiency.

articleTitle: Design on broadband multilayer parasitic microstrip array antenna
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A 2×2 multilayer parasitic microstrip array antenna (MPMAA) worked at 9 GHz is presented. A parallel side feed system has been used for the first layer, and an impedance match network is used for the antenna to match the coaxial transmission line feed. Coupling feed system has been used for the second and third layers. Prototype of the proposed antenna has been constructed and tested based on the calculated results of HFSS. The experimental results show that the antenna obtains a wide bandwidth (8.4 GHz~10.1 GHz) and a maximum gain of 10.5 dB. It also obtains great radicalization characteristic.

articleTitle: Study on serial collaborative optimization algorithm based on Nelder-Mead algorithm
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In aircraft multidisciplinary design optimization, Multi-method Collaborative Optimization Algorithm (MCOA) has been proposed because of the complex mathematical models. However, not only the optimization result is not very precise with general serial collaborative optimization algorithm of MCOA, but also the convergence has not been rigorously proven. In order to improve the accuracy and robustness, a method of serial collaborative optimization again algorithm based on genetic algorithm and Nelder-Mead algorithm was presented in this paper, in brief, which is first genetic algorithm then Nelder-Mead algorithm then genetic algorithm again in a circulation. Its global convergence was analyzed, accuracy and robustness was improved by a test of three typical optimization functions compared with the single algorithm and general serial collaborative optimization algorithm. The experiment results demonstrate that the method is feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Dynamic method of embedded large cylindrical structures considering plastic strain of soft soil
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Combining the advantages of the simplified method and FEM, a dynamic analysis model for the calculation of the large cylinder structures considering the accumulated plastic strain of soft soil under cyclic loads was developed. In the model, the large cylinder was divided into discrete rigid elements, and the ground soil was replaced by discrete 3D nonlinear spring-dashpot systems. The characteristics of non-linear and accumulated plastic strain of soft soil were simulated by combining the equivalent linear model and D-P yield criterion. The ideal elastic-plastic characteristics of D-P model is imitated by letting the spring stiffness of the soil-spring equal to zero or a very small value when the soil-spring reached yield state, and added a constant force on the yield point. The application of the proposed method was illustrated by an example, and the results approached to the model experiment.

articleTitle: Total optimization design: A method of design and optimization for direct drive systems
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a method of design and optimization for direct drive systems. The proposed method consists of four steps. As the first step, principle optimization design is expected to find out the optimal principle and schematic. And the second step, structural optimization design, is aimed at hunting out the optimal structure for the optimal principle. During the third step, a variety of conventional parametric optimization methods can be put to use. The last step completes other designs and optimizations to get the final design. In contrast with the conventional method, the proposed method can work out a better design result for direct drive systems.

articleTitle: The effect of intake valve lift load control on gasoline engine fuel economy
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The conventional SI engine with throttle-driven load control, has a disadvantage in fuel economy dominantly caused by its pumping loss. In the paper, throttle-free load control strategy, namely the application of valve lift adjustment and phase optimization, was employed to reduce the pumping loss and improve the fuel economy. Tests were carried out on a single-cylinder research engine equipped with 4VVAS(4 Variable Valve Actuation System) cylinder head, which can independently control the intake and exhaust valve lifts and timings. Results show that pumping loss can be reduced 20∼30% by using the valve lift load control, and a 3∼12% of fuel consumption benefit can be obtained.

articleTitle: Multi-method integration software for radar low-altitude target elevation off-line measurement
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The on-line measure precision of low-altitude target elevation doesn't satisfy the requirement of low-altitude/low-angle target. A software has been designed to extract the elevation of low-altitude target after measurement from the saved video signal by the radar system, it consists of six methods: C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> algorithm, Bias compensation algorithm, dynamic bias compensation algorithm, C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>-bias compensation algorithm, bias compensation of C<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> dynamic phase estimate and Maximum Likelihood estimate algorithm. The results indicate they are effective and feasible in the off-line elevation extraction and they can remarkably improve the precision of elevation measurement extraction, Satisfying the precision requirement of trial.

articleTitle: Effect of alfalfa(Lolium multiflorum L)on degradation of trichlorophenol in soil
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The roles of alfalfa(Lolium multiflorum L) on remediation of TCP contaminated soil, the growth of alfalfa were studied in a pot experiment. The results showed that TCP content in soil decreased with culture time during 75d culture period. Alfalfa promotes this decrease. 75 days pot experiment showed that the concentration of TCP in soil grown alfalfa was significantly lower than that without plant grown (P < 0. 05). Under 1,10 and 100mg/ kg TCP treatments, TCP biodegradability amounted to 55.2%, 80.2% and 90.1% respectively. While that of soil without plant growth were 20.1%, 30.2%, 49.2%, respectively. The activity of soil polyphenol oxidase, dehydrogenase and catalase are increasing in soil with plant grown and were obviously higher than those without plant growing (p < 0.05), which improved soil degradation ability of soil microbial and plants. There is also inhibition of high contamination on enzyme. Though soil itself can biodegrade TCP, alfalfa could improve bioremediation role of TCP contaminated soil, thought enhance the degradation rate of TCP in soil and increase alfalfa yield and the microbial activity in rhizosphere soil.

articleTitle: Use Triton X100 as additive for mesoporous carbon counter electrode to improve the photoelectric properties of dye-sensitized solar cells
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The counter electrodes have been prepared using mesoporous carbon (MC) derived from phenolic resin as catalytic material through a low temperature technology, emphasizing on investigation of the effect of Triton X-100 in MC counter electrode on the performance of dye-sensitized solar cells (DSCs). Addition of Triton X100 in MC electrode strengthened its catalytic activity for the triiodide and decreased its sheet resistance, finally result in increased fill factor and short circuit photocurrent density of corresponding DSCs. The conversion efficiency of DSCs was finally increased from 4.96 % to 5.53%. Improved performances were mainly attributed to the improvement of the contact interface between MC layer and substrate as well as the connection of between MC particles.

articleTitle: Derivation of analytical calculation of area mobility of a thin plate under a uniform velocity excitation
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In order to investigate the power transmission over the contact area between two structures, the method of area mobility is often used. For the calculations of area mobility over a two-dimensional excitation area, the patterns of the excitations must be considered. In this paper, a method for calculating the area mobility of a finite plate subject to a uniform velocity excitation is derived analytically by using the bending wave equation and the concept of effective point mobility. This method provides an easy and convenient way to estimate the area mobility theoretically and to analyse the power transmission through the contact area. The analytical calculation method derived is applied for different parameters and a convergent result is obtained.

articleTitle: The field measurement and analysis of freezing shaft lining pressure in special stratum of Inner Mongolia area
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Through the filed monitoring of freezing shaft lining pressure of the Bojiang-Haizi coal mine wind well in Inner Mongolia Cretaceous and Jurassic strata, four stages of freezing shaft lining pressure development were obtained, and the pressure caused by freezing construction method in Cretaceous stratum were larger than pressure in Jurassic. However, pressure in these two strata were small, less than 2MPa, and the pressure was beneficial to the shaft lining structural safety. It showed that freezing method was suitable for Inner Mongolia area Cretaceous and Jurassic strata, and provided the basis for the design and construction of freezing shaft lining in this area.

articleTitle: Thermal conductivity testing system of loose coal
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: A set of system which can test thermal conductivity of loose coal is developed. The device is designed based on parallel hot-wired method. The loose coal is heated in constant power when test, signal of real temperature is input to the MCU, processing results is transmit to computer in serial port communication. Then, thermal conductivity of loose coal is computed in the upper computer. The test result is agreed with documented value.

articleTitle: The study and simulation of Clutch control strategy in starting process
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the rapid development of auto industry, AMT is an inevitable trend of the development of automobile. Automatic clutch is the most important modules of AMT, as well as the difficulty and the core of AMT control system. In this paper the characteristics and engaging regularity of the clutch engaging process are firstly analyzed, and then the engaging control strategy based on fuzzy theory is proposed. The intention fuzzy controller of start and the engaging fuzzy controller are designed. Finally the simulation model of the clutch engaging process is established by MATLAB simulink. the simulation results proves that the control strategy and the design the controller are reasonable.

articleTitle: Research of deformation behavior of unloading soils
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Through simulation of unloading stress path of excavation works, a series of experiments have been down on stress path with the former state silty clay from a excavation project of yangtse tunnel engineering. This paper analyzes their stress-strain curve. Analysis shows that stress-strain curve and stress path have close relationship. Part of the final curve with a good characteristic, some not with hyperbolic curve characteristics and need further study.

Author Keywords: constant stress increment rtio stress path

articleTitle: Notice of Retraction: Design and implementation for CMMB frame-head and control information demultiplex error handing based on finite automaton
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article has been retracted by the publisher.

articleTitle: Range of flame free-jet in jet firing system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The range of flame free-jet in jet firing system are studied by the liquid breakup principle. The analytic functions are built based on the view of that liquid break up the cooperative affects of the gravity, air resistance and tension. The main factors affecting are outlined. This paper sets up a empirical formula by the least-square method in accordance with the experimental date. Results show that the presure, elevation and diameter have significant influence about the range. Compared with experimental date, the formula is found to be exact and reliable.

articleTitle: Research and application on thermal dispatch supporting system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Thermal dispatch supporting system is developed in Shanxi Grid to overcome the problems in the field of the safety and steady operation of Shanxi Power System that resulting from the rapid increasing of the installed capacity proportion of thermal and air-cooled generating units. Real-time data acquisition and remote monitoring of the operation status of the generating unit and its desulphurization system and heating facilities are realized. Both performance calculation and economic operation analyzing & optimizing of the generating unit is achieved. The vacuum-influenced and heat-supplying-influenced unit generation capability, priority lists for the real-time dispatching, real coal-consuming characteristics and emission characteristics are obtained to provide decision-making for dispatching which coordinate the requirements of grid, power plant and the whole society.

articleTitle: Prediction of the coal gas distribution with GIS-FUZZY
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: We use the evaluation method of fuzzy mathematics to convert to a computer language on the GIS system. According to the principle of the selected independent of each other to main factors, we determine the layer of coal gas content factor set. With the regional geology of the mine of Chen Jiashan and Xia Shijie, we have analyzed the affecting factors of the mining gas content. According to the data obtained to determine the membership function of each factor and analyze the overlay with the Maplnfo in order to achieve the area gas content and distribution of prediction. The practical application of GIS overlay analysis has proved that it is efficient, reliable, and has the great advantage in the evaluation of resource.

articleTitle: Investigation on densification of metal foam under dynamic loading
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In the present study, a one-dimensional steady shock model based on a rate -independent, rigid, perfectly plastic locking idealization (R-P-P-L) of the nominal stress-train curve for metal foam is proposed to analyze the stress and densification in metal foam subjected to dynamic compression. The results showed that, the length of the densification increases exponentially with increasing of impact velocity and then reaches a constant, and can be affected by the density and plateau stress of the foams.

articleTitle: Distance discriminant analysis method for stability prediction of rock slope in hydropower engineering regions
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The stability prediction of rock slopes is a key and complicated problem. We took 24 typical rock slopes in hydropower engineering regions in China as examples, to build distance discriminant analysis (DDA) model with posterior probability for slope stability prediction. The 5 combined indexes, i. e, slope rock mass quality coefficient (SRMR), orientation coefficient of structural plane (F), modified coefficient of structural plane types (λ), slope height coefficient (ξ) and modified coefficient of construction methods (Kw), were used as the discriminant factors. The analysis results show that DDA method has a lower error rate, the average accuracy rate is 91.67%. By using the DDA method, we can obtain the posterior probability belonging to the different classification as well as the classification of slope stability. Therefore, the method may provide a new way for slope stability prediction.

articleTitle: Design for BIT of electronic system based on boundary scan
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Boundary scan test is a standard measurability design technology, and it is more convenient for the measurement of complex circuits. Based on the basic principle of boundary scan and one system's CPU board, the boundary scan design and configuration of the system's control circuit are presented and validated. According to the experiments of the designed CPU, the circuit can realize the functions of the boundary scan test and locate faults rapidly. It could efficaciously promote the measurability of the electronic system.

articleTitle: Study on the “RRR” type-approval of proprietary brand
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To reply with the recycling rules of the world and persistent progress of vehicle, it is necessary to develop European "RRR" type-approval. The background, content and process of proprietary brand's "RRR" type-approval were introduced. Calculation methods of recycling rate and recovery rate were also described.

articleTitle: Principle of work analysis and experimental research of magnetic separation column
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper has analyzed the basic structure and operational principle of magnetic separation column, and conducted the concentration separation experimental study to some iron ore concentrate. The result indicated that under the most superior condition the iron concentrate grade from original 58.42% rose to 64.32%, the iron ore concentrate production rate come to 87.52%, the separation effect was good, confirms the magnetic separation column have the superiority to further enhance the iron ore concentrate grade.

articleTitle: Effect of a latent heat thermal energy storage unit used in project
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The latent heat thermal energy storage system using phase change material (PCM) is quite attractive, mainly due to their high energy storage density and their ability to provide heat in a narrow temperature range. A latent heat thermal energy storage unit is designed, which is installed conveniently and have a fast period of charge and discharge. The latent heat thermal energy storage unit is applied to a demonstration project in conjunction with solar collectors and tank. Results showed that the designed unit in this paper eases the large fluctuations of water temperature in tank and make the system work more stably. The latent heat thermal energy storage unit plays a significant role in project.

articleTitle: Dynamic analysis of nonlinear elasticity beam using DQ semi-analytical method
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper presents a new semi-analytical approach for the nonlinear vibration analysis of nonlinear elasticity beam. The time domain response and frequency response of a nonlinear elasticity beam's free vibration will be obtained, Considering the efforts of the static deformation on the dynamic characteristics. The method makes use of Linz Ted-Poincaré perturbation technique to transform the nonlinear governing equations into a linear differential equation system, whose solutions are then sought through the use of differential quadrature approximation in space domain and an analytical series expansion in time domain. Validation of present method is conducted in numerical examples through direct comparisons with existing solution, showing that the proposed semi-analytical method has excellent convergence and can give very accurate results at a long time interval. This method successfully avoids the accumulation of errors and has good precision. which makes it possible to the solution of the nonlinear dynamic problems.

articleTitle: Synchronization and parameter identification of hyperchaotic Lorenz systems
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: In this paper, the synchronization and parameter identification of hyperchaotic Lorenz systems are investigated. Based on the finite-time stability theory, nonlinear controllers and parameter identifiers are contrived simultaneously to achieve complete synchronization and parameter identification of the hyperchaotic Lorenz systems in the limited time . The scheme is simple to be implemented in practice. Simulation results are presented to demonstrate that the proposed controllers and identifiers are feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Effect of altitude height on combustion noise of DI-diesel engines
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Taking the YN4100QB diesel engines as the research object, acoustic power of the radiation noise from the surface of the engine has been tested and calculated, which utilizes the measuring method of superficial acoustic pressure levels based on the simulation system of atmospheric pressure. The engine's combustion noise, mechanical noise and inlet noise have also been successfully separated with the experiment of the noise source identification of diesel engines. All the measures are taken to probe into the influencing mechanism of atmospheric pressure on combustion noise of DI-diesel engines. Comparisons are made about the difference of combustion noise in diesel engines so as to obtain its variation regulation with different altitudes.

articleTitle: Application of FLAC strength reduction method to analysis of slope stability
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: With the continuous development of numerical simulation technology, It shows the great advantage for FLAC software in geotechnical simulation. This paper FLAC combination with the strength reduction technology, and applied to slope stability analysis, to calculate the stability of the slope coefficient and the approximate location of the potential slip surface and shape, It provides the basis for engineering practice. By the law, the evaluation of slope stability analysis for North Opencast coal mine of YiMei, it determine the stability of the slope coefficient and the location of dangerous side, it was validated by the rigid body limit equilibrium method, the results of the analysis method is feasible.

articleTitle: Approximation of large time delay for MIMO systems by using matrix Pade-type
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This paper deals with a approximating method for large time-delays of multi-input multi-output (MIMO) dynamical systems. The methodology is an improved rational approximation approach. Time delay terms of the state space equations can be described by delay matrix in the complex domain and approximated by rational matrix Pade-type functions. The minimum variance estimation error is minimized to obtain rational approximation of MIMO systems to guarantee the poles located in the left half plane. Matrix Pade-type approximation can largely reduce the instability and the overshoot, so the fast-response property is improved. Simulation results of the proposed method are presented to illustrate the correctness and effectively.

articleTitle: Research on deforming force of magnesium alloy tube extrusion
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Deforming force of magnesium alloy tube extrusion about cone dies had been studied theoretically by block method and numerical simulation method, and the formulas and predictive Results were certificated by experiments. The results showed that theoretical results of extrusion force given by calculating formula and numerical simulation method were approaching to those of experiments and the average value of relative error is about 10 % and 14 % respectively. It was concluded that theoretical calculating formula in this paper and numerical simulation method were veracious and had certain practical value in engineering.

articleTitle: A new synchronous decorrelating decision-feedback method in CDMA system
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Under the synchronous condition, based on the character of the receiving signal constructs, a new decorrelating decision feedback method with successive interference cancellation is obtained. With this new sub-optimal method, not only can the computation of the reverse matrix of the correlating matrix be avoided, but also the computing complexity does validly decrease,the simulation and example also support this conclusion.

articleTitle: The simulation study of the maximum learning incremental worker-station assignment based on learning- forgetting
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The paper simulates worker-station assignment based on learning- forgetting, and develops the model of the maximum learning incremental. The goal of this model is the maximum learning incremental. Job rotation is used in this model. One worker is trained more than one job. It makes the process of learning longer. After the long process of learning, workers become generalists. The production system is more flexible. Dependence on staff is relatively small in the production system. It is perfect for modern enterprises in make-to-order and competitive environment. Simulations of the production system are performed under given particular production environment for heterogeneous workers based on specific objectives. It is of the guiding role in practice production system.

Author Keywords: the model of the learning incremental

articleTitle: Research on deformation characteristics of slope based on slope monitoring
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: By mean of the long-term monitoring date of some key conservancy slop engineering,this paper design slope monitoring system,basing on the characteristics of slope deformation and stress field,deeply analysing the changing pattern an trend of various monitoring data.analysing the trends and characteristics of slope deformation ,combining classification method of slope stability ,using analysis method of displacement rate ι displacement phase increasing and measuring skew curve of the step's height and so on ,these three deformation indicators feedback the slope stability trends.This analysis method of rapid feedback not only analyzes the monitoring data effectively,but also timely determine the slope stability situational so to provide the basis for modifying the design and a guarantee for the safe construction of the landslide control,this method can provide a reference for similar projects.

articleTitle: Dynamics study on stable operations of central pin assembly of the dynamics stability vehicles
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Using interaction nonlinear numerical method, the dynamic response of center pin assembly system under stable operations at the efficiency of 0.2 km/h ~2.5 km/h are analyzed with finite element software ABAQUS/Standard. The result reveals that with the increase of system working rate, the maximum stress and contacting force increase, and on the other hand the maximum strain and maximum displacement decrease.

articleTitle: Analysis on river regime of the North Branch in the Changjiang River estuary
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Based on the data of water depth and channel cubage in the North Branch, the flow spilt ratio of the North Branch and the South Branch, The reasons for the sediment deposition in the North Branch are analyzed, and a 3D hydrodynamic model is set up to simulate the tidal currents in the Changjiang River estuary. This model has been validated with the measured data, the computed results of water level, flow velocity magnitude and direction agree well with the measured data. The present hydrodynamic condition in the North Branch is further analyzed by use of this model; consequently, the research results can provide the government decision-maker for technical supports to meet the navigation requirement of 3000 tons ship.

Author Keywords: the North Branch of the Changjiang River Estuary

articleTitle: The application of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method in factory site scheme selection of thermo-electricity project
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: Factory site scheme selection of thermo-electricity project is an important work, which directly affect whether the project can achieve the desired objectives and post-project operation effects. This paper discussed the factory site scheme selection using multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, combining with the characteristics of factory site scheme selection; finally demonstrate the scientific and fair of the model with examples.

articleTitle: Study of stability in surrounding rock masses and in-situ stress measurement for deeply buried metal mine
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The following results are obtained based on the study of in-situ stress measurements using stress relief by overcoring technique and stability of surrounding rock masses in the some deeply buried metal mine: (1) the dominative stress at depth of 820m is tectonic stress and the maximum principal stress is 28.1MPa The principal stress dispersion is 21.4MPa very big and which is apt to cause the rib spoiling damage phenomenon of the surrounding rock masses. Which explain well the phenomenon of rib spoiling, floor heave and roof falling of the mine rock tunnels at present. (2) The elastic modulus and Poisson's ratio of sandstone were obtained through laboratory experiment, in which the tested rock core were get from the field test. The surrounding rock of tunnel is a typical brittle rock with high strength. It is a burst-prone mine in high level tectonic stress under the action, which was revealed the internal factors of the mine tunnels local occurred in rockburst. (3) According to the in-situ stress orientation and size, some measures were puts forward to maintain the stability of surrounding rock masses. The above results can provide references for similar projects, in which deformation mechanics of surrounding rock masses, defects of prophase support system and prevention rockburst.

articleTitle: Character recognition research based on BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: This article is about the method on how to extract character recognition of vehicle brand by the combination of EMD and nonlineary PCA. The main idea is to identify the image of the object which contains character recognition technology in BP neural network that momentum factor has been added in advance. After that compared with the improved neural network performance in different parameter occasions, the test proved that this method can increase the training speed and precision of character Recognition neural network.

articleTitle: Influence of bulking agents on speciation of heavy metals during sewage sludge composting
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: The major limitation of soil application of sewage sludge compost is the total heavy metal contents and their bioavailability and mobility. This study was conducted to evaluate the effect of mature compost as a bulking agent on reduction the mobility and bioavailability of Zn, Cu, Pb and Cr during the sewage sludge composting process. The three composting processes: sewage sludge(SS), sewage sludge + wood chips(SS+WC) and sewage sludge + mature compost(SS+MC) in our study showed that stable fractions of Zn, Cu, Pb and Cr could be increased over time by composting. While the different composting processes, exhibited different effects on the speciation of heavy metal. All the metals showed the relatively lower mobility and bioavailability in the SS+MC treatments. The GPC spectra shown that the concentrate of humci substances decreased in the order of SS+MC>;SS+WC>;SS. Furthermore, the FTIR spectral studies confirmed that humic substances (drived from SS+MC) has more content of reactive functional groups such as C=O and carboxylic groups. Investigation of the correlation matrices of metal fractions with pH, composting temperature, humic substances and organic matter content indicated that the humic substances heavily influenced the changes of heavy metal speciation during SS+MC composting. Accordingly, the higher reduction of mobility and bioavailability of heavy metal in the SS+MC treatments mainly attributed to the enhancement of humification process by adding mature compost as bulking agent.

articleTitle: Experimental study and numerical simulation of active vibration control on high order mode of piezoelectric flexible beam
publicationTitle: 2011 Second International Conference on Mechanic Automation and Control Engineering
abstract: To reduce effective load and lower the launch cost, many light-weight flexible structures are employed in spacecraft. The research of active control on flexible structural vibration is very important in spacecraft design. Active vibration control on a flexible beam with piezoelectric pieces bonded in surface is investigated experimentally using independent modal space control method, which is able to control the first three modes independently. A comparison between the system responses before and after control indicates that the modal damping of flexible structure is greatly improved after active control is performed, indicating remarkable vibration suppression effect. Dynamic equation of the flexible beam is deducted by Hamilton principle, and numerical simulation of active vibration control on the first three order vibration modes is also conducted in this paper. The simulation result matches experimental result very well. Both experimental and numerical results indicate that the independent modal control method using piezoelectric patch as driving element is a very effective approach to realize vibration suppression, which has promising applications in aerospace field.
